name: Hunter.ProofsFinale.hpath_chart_heavy
statement:
theorem hpath_chart_heavy {m : ℕ} {p : HPath (m + 4)} (hp : p.Exitless)
    (hN : (m + 4) * ((m + 3) * (m + 2)) < p.numVerts)
    (hbw2 : ∀ j i, j ≤ m + 1 → i < m + 2 → bw p (j * (m + 3) + i + 1) = 2)
    (hbw3 : ∀ j, j < m + 1 → bw p (j * (m + 3) + (m + 2) + 1) = 3) :
    4 ≤ bw p ((m + 3) * (m + 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hk4 : 4 ≤ m + 4 := by omega
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ m + 4 := by omega
  set N := (m + 3) * (m + 2) with hNdef
  
  set w0 := (p.vert 0 : List ℕ) with hw0
  have hw0pw : IsPermWord (m + 4) w0 := (p.vert 0).2
  have hw0len : w0.length = m + 4 := hw0pw.length
  set A' := w0.take (m + 1) with hA'
  have hA'len : A'.length = m + 1 := by rw [hA', List.length_take, hw0len]; omega
  have hdroplen : (w0.drop (m + 1)).length = 3 := by rw [List.length_drop, hw0len]; omega
  obtain ⟨z, b, c, hbc⟩ := List.length_eq_three.mp hdroplen
  have hw0split : w0 = A' ++ [z, b, c] := by
    rw [hA', ← hbc, List.take_append_drop]
  
  set q : ℕ → List ℕ := fun s => blockWord p s with hq
  have hq0 : q 0 = A' ++ [z, b, c] := by
    rw [hq]; show blockWord p 0 = A' ++ [z, b, c]
    rw [blockWord, Nat.mul_zero]; exact hw0split
  
  have hperm : ∀ s, IsPermWord (A'.length + 3) (q s) := by
    intro s; rw [hA'len]
    show IsPermWord (m + 4) (blockWord p s); exact blockWord_isPermWord p s
  
  have hs : IsPermWord (A'.length + 3) (A' ++ [z, b, c]) := by
    rw [hA'len, ← hw0split]; exact hw0pw
  
  have hdist : ∀ s t, s < (A'.length + 2) * (A'.length + 1) →
      t < (A'.length + 2) * (A'.length + 1) → s ≠ t → rotClass (q s) ≠ rotClass (q t) := by
    intro s t hsl htl hst
    rw [hA'len] at hsl htl
    have hsN : (m + 4) * s < p.numVerts := lt_of_lt_of_le
      (Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (show s < N by rw [hNdef]; exact hsl) (by omega)) (le_of_lt hN)
    have htN : (m + 4) * t < p.numVerts := lt_of_lt_of_le
      (Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (show t < N by rw [hNdef]; exact htl) (by omega)) (le_of_lt hN)
    exact blockWord_distinct hk1 hp hsN htN hst
  
  have hw2 : ∀ j i, j ≤ A'.length → i < A'.length + 1 →
      bwt (A'.length + 3) (q (j * (A'.length + 2) + i)) (q (j * (A'.length + 2) + i + 1)) = 2 := by
    intro j i hj hi
    rw [hA'len] at hj hi ⊢
    have htlt : (m + 4) * (j * (m + 3) + i + 1) < p.numVerts := by
      have hidx : j * (m + 3) + i + 1 ≤ N := by
        have h1 : j * (m + 3) ≤ (m + 1) * (m + 3) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hj
        rw [hNdef]; nlinarith [hj, hi]
      calc (m + 4) * (j * (m + 3) + i + 1) ≤ (m + 4) * N :=
            Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hidx
        _ < p.numVerts := hN
    have hbe := bw_eq_bwt hk1 hp (t := j * (m + 3) + i + 1) (by omega) htlt
    have : bw p (j * (m + 3) + i + 1) = 2 := hbw2 j i hj hi
    rw [this] at hbe
    rw [show j * (m + 3) + i + 1 - 1 = j * (m + 3) + i from by omega] at hbe
    simp only [hq]; exact hbe.symm
  
  have hw3 : ∀ j, j < A'.length →
      bwt (A'.length + 3) (q (j * (A'.length + 2) + (A'.length + 1)))
        (q (j * (A'.length + 2) + (A'.length + 1) + 1)) = 3 := by
    intro j hj
    rw [hA'len] at hj ⊢
    have htlt : (m + 4) * (j * (m + 3) + (m + 2) + 1) < p.numVerts := by
      have hidx : j * (m + 3) + (m + 2) + 1 ≤ N := by
        have h1 : j * (m + 3) ≤ m * (m + 3) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega)
        rw [hNdef]; nlinarith [hj]
      calc (m + 4) * (j * (m + 3) + (m + 2) + 1) ≤ (m + 4) * N := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hidx
        _ < p.numVerts := hN
    have hbe := bw_eq_bwt hk1 hp (t := j * (m + 3) + (m + 2) + 1) (by omega) htlt
    have : bw p (j * (m + 3) + (m + 2) + 1) = 3 := hbw3 j hj
    rw [this] at hbe
    rw [show j * (m + 3) + (m + 2) + 1 - 1 = j * (m + 3) + (m + 2) from by omega] at hbe
    simp only [hq]; exact hbe.symm
  
  have hfresh : ∀ t, t < (A'.length + 2) * (A'.length + 1) →
      rotClass (q ((A'.length + 2) * (A'.length + 1))) ≠ rotClass (q t) := by
    intro t htl
    rw [hA'len] at htl ⊢
    have hNlt : (m + 4) * N < p.numVerts := hN
    have htN : (m + 4) * t < p.numVerts := lt_of_lt_of_le
      (Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (show t < N by rw [hNdef]; exact htl) (by omega)) (le_of_lt hN)
    have htlt2 : t < N := by rw [hNdef]; exact htl
    have hne : N ≠ t := by omega
    have := blockWord_distinct hk1 hp hNlt htN hne
    simp only [hq]; simpa [hNdef] using this
  
  have hheavy := chart_continuation_heavy (A' := A') (z := z) (b := b) (c := c)
    (by rw [hA'len]; omega) hs (q := q) hperm hq0 hdist hw2 hw3 hfresh
  rw [hA'len] at hheavy
  
  have hNlt : (m + 4) * N < p.numVerts := hN
  have hNeq : (m + 1 + 2) * (m + 1 + 1) = N := by rw [hNdef]
  have hbe := bw_eq_bwt hk1 hp (t := N) (by rw [hNdef]; nlinarith) hNlt
  rw [hNeq, show (m + 1 + 2) * (m + 1 + 1) - 1 = N - 1 from by rw [hNeq]] at hheavy
  simp only [hq] at hheavy
  rw [hbe]
  exact hheavy

name: Hunter.HPath.numVerts_pos
statement: theorem numVerts_pos (p : HPath k) : 0 < p.numVerts
proof:
:=
  List.length_pos_of_ne_nil p.ne

name: Hunter.HPath.vert_zero
statement: theorem vert_zero (p : HPath k) : p.vert 0 = p.first
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, t, h⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil p.ne
  simp only [vert, first, h, List.getD_cons_zero, List.head_cons]

name: Hunter.HPath.first_mem
statement: theorem first_mem (p : HPath k) : p.first ∈ p.verts
proof:
:= by
  rw [first]; exact List.head_mem p.ne

name: Hunter.HPath.last_mem
statement: theorem last_mem (p : HPath k) : p.last ∈ p.verts
proof:
:= by
  rw [last]; exact List.getLast_mem p.ne

name: Hunter.HPath.mem_vertsFinset
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_vertsFinset {p : HPath k} {v : Vtx k} :
    v ∈ p.vertsFinset ↔ v ∈ p.verts
proof: := List.mem_toFinset

name: Hunter.HPath.numVerts_eq_card_of_hamiltonian
statement:
theorem numVerts_eq_card_of_hamiltonian {p : HPath k} (h : p.IsHamiltonian) :
    p.numVerts = Fintype.card (Vtx k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [numVerts, ← List.toFinset_card_of_nodup p.nodup]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.eq_univ_of_forall
  intro v; exact List.mem_toFinset.mpr (h v)

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta2.Vset3_of_metaWord_rotate
statement:
theorem Vset3_of_metaWord_rotate {α₁ α₂ : ℕ} {K : RotClass} {A B : Vtx k}
    (hA : A ∈ Vset3 k α₁ α₂ K)
    (hstep : (B : List ℕ).erase α₁ = ((A : List ℕ).erase α₁).rotate 1) :
    B ∈ Vset3 k α₁ α₂ K
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_Vset3] at hA ⊢
  rw [hstep, rotClass_erase_rotate_one (A.2.nodup.erase α₁)]
  exact hA

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta2.Vset3_of_metaWord_complete_alpha
statement:
theorem Vset3_of_metaWord_complete_alpha {α₁ α₂ : ℕ} {K : RotClass} {A B : Vtx k}
    (hk : 3 ≤ k)
    (hα2 : α₂ = ((A : List ℕ).erase α₁).getLastD 0)
    (hK : K = rotClass ((A : List ℕ).erase α₁).dropLast)
    (hlen : ((A : List ℕ).erase α₁).length = k - 1)
    (hstep : (B : List ℕ).erase α₁ = door (((A : List ℕ).erase α₁).rotate (k - 2))) :
    B ∈ Vset3 k α₁ α₂ K
proof:
:= by
  set w := (A : List ℕ).erase α₁ with hw
  
  have hrot : (w.rotate (k - 2)).rotate 1 = w := by
    rw [List.rotate_rotate, show (k - 2) + 1 = k - 1 from by omega, ← hlen, List.rotate_length]
  have h2le : 2 ≤ (w.rotate (k - 2)).length := by rw [List.length_rotate, hlen]; omega
  
  have hgl : genLoop (door (w.rotate (k - 2))) = genLoop w := by
    rw [genLoop_door_eq_rho_of_len h2le]
    show genLoop ((w.rotate (k - 2)).rotate 1) = genLoop w
    rw [hrot]
  
  set u := (B : List ℕ).erase α₁ with hu
  have hunod : u.Nodup := B.2.nodup.erase α₁
  have hueq : u = door (w.rotate (k - 2)) := hstep
  have hglu : genLoop u = (α₂, K) := by
    rw [hueq, hgl, genLoop, ← hα2, ← hK]
  have humark : u.getLastD 0 = α₂ := congrArg Prod.fst hglu
  have huclass : rotClass u.dropLast = K := congrArg Prod.snd hglu
  rw [mem_Vset3, ← hu, ← humark, erase_getLastD hunod]
  exact huclass

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta2.meta_hinv
statement:
theorem meta_hinv {α₁ α₂ : ℕ} {K : RotClass} {Astar : ℕ → Vtx k} (hk : 3 ≤ k)
    (hlen : ∀ j, ((Astar j : List ℕ).erase α₁).length = k - 1)
    (hg0 : genLoop ((Astar 0 : List ℕ).erase α₁) = (α₂, K))
    (hstep : ∀ j, (Astar (j + 1) : List ℕ).erase α₁ =
        door (((Astar j : List ℕ).erase α₁).rotate (k - 2))) :
    ∀ j, genLoop ((Astar j : List ℕ).erase α₁) = (α₂, K)
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero => exact hg0
  | succ j ih =>
    rw [hstep j]
    have hrot : (((Astar j : List ℕ).erase α₁).rotate (k - 2)).rotate 1 =
        (Astar j : List ℕ).erase α₁ := by
      rw [List.rotate_rotate, show (k - 2) + 1 = k - 1 from by omega, ← hlen j, List.rotate_length]
    have h2le : 2 ≤ (((Astar j : List ℕ).erase α₁).rotate (k - 2)).length := by
      rw [List.length_rotate, hlen j]; omega
    rw [genLoop_door_eq_rho_of_len h2le]
    show genLoop ((((Astar j : List ℕ).erase α₁).rotate (k - 2)).rotate 1) = (α₂, K)
    rw [hrot]; exact ih

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta2.mem_Vset3_of_genLoop_metaWord
statement:
theorem mem_Vset3_of_genLoop_metaWord {α₁ α₂ : ℕ} {K : RotClass} {A : Vtx k}
    (h : genLoop ((A : List ℕ).erase α₁) = (α₂, K)) : A ∈ Vset3 k α₁ α₂ K
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_Vset3]
  have h1 : ((A : List ℕ).erase α₁).getLastD 0 = α₂ := congrArg Prod.fst h
  have h2 : rotClass ((A : List ℕ).erase α₁).dropLast = K := congrArg Prod.snd h
  rw [← h1, erase_getLastD (A.2.nodup.erase α₁)]
  exact h2

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta2.meta_hinv_mem_Vset3
statement:
theorem meta_hinv_mem_Vset3 {α₁ α₂ : ℕ} {K : RotClass} {Astar : ℕ → Vtx k} (hk : 3 ≤ k)
    (hlen : ∀ j, ((Astar j : List ℕ).erase α₁).length = k - 1)
    (hg0 : genLoop ((Astar 0 : List ℕ).erase α₁) = (α₂, K))
    (hstep : ∀ j, (Astar (j + 1) : List ℕ).erase α₁ =
        door (((Astar j : List ℕ).erase α₁).rotate (k - 2))) :
    ∀ j, Astar j ∈ Vset3 k α₁ α₂ K
proof:
:=
  fun j => mem_Vset3_of_genLoop_metaWord (meta_hinv hk hlen hg0 hstep j)

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta2.Vset3_of_metaWord_rotate_iter
statement:
theorem Vset3_of_metaWord_rotate_iter {α₁ α₂ : ℕ} {K : RotClass} {A B : Vtx k} {r : ℕ}
    (hA : A ∈ Vset3 k α₁ α₂ K)
    (hstep : (B : List ℕ).erase α₁ = ((A : List ℕ).erase α₁).rotate r) :
    B ∈ Vset3 k α₁ α₂ K
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_Vset3] at hA ⊢
  rw [hstep, rotClass_erase_rotate (A.2.nodup.erase α₁) r]
  exact hA

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta2.meta_pigeonhole
statement:
theorem meta_pigeonhole (hk : 3 ≤ k) {α₁ α₂ : ℕ} {K : RotClass} {A : Vtx k}
    (hα1 : α₁ = (A : List ℕ).getLastD 0)
    (hα2 : α₂ = ((A : List ℕ).dropLast).getLastD 0)
    (hK : K = rotClass ((A : List ℕ).dropLast.dropLast))
    {m : ℕ} (blk : Fin m × Fin (k - 1) → Vtx k)
    (hmem : ∀ i, blk i ∈ Vset3 k α₁ α₂ K)
    (hcyc : ∀ i i', i ≠ i' → rotClass (blk i : List ℕ) ≠ rotClass (blk i' : List ℕ)) :
    m ≤ k - 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hinj : Function.Injective blk := fun i i' h => by
    by_contra hne; exact hcyc i i' hne (by rw [h])
  set S : Finset (Vtx k) := Finset.univ.image blk with hS
  have hScard : S.card = m * (k - 1) := by
    rw [hS, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hinj, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_prod,
        Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_fin]
  have hmemS : ∀ v ∈ S, v ∈ Vset3 k α₁ α₂ K := by
    intro v hv; rw [hS, Finset.mem_image] at hv
    obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := hv; exact hmem i
  have hdisjS : ∀ u ∈ S, ∀ v ∈ S, u ≠ v →
      rotClass (u : List ℕ) ≠ rotClass (v : List ℕ) := by
    intro u hu v hv huv
    rw [hS, Finset.mem_image] at hu hv
    obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := hu; obtain ⟨i', _, rfl⟩ := hv
    exact hcyc i i' (fun h => huv (by rw [h]))
  have hcard := card_le_of_mem_Vset3 hk hα1 hα2 hK S hmemS hdisjS
  rw [hScard, show (k - 1) * (k - 2) = (k - 2) * (k - 1) from Nat.mul_comm _ _] at hcard
  exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right hcard (by omega)

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta2.meta_no_reentry
statement:
theorem meta_no_reentry (hk : 1 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) {ι : Type*}
    [LinearOrder ι] (pos : ι → ℕ) (hdvd : ∀ i, k ∣ pos i)
    (hmono : ∀ i i', i < i' → pos i + k ≤ pos i')
    (hlt : ∀ i, pos i < p.numVerts) :
    ∀ i i', i ≠ i' →
      rotClass (p.vert (pos i) : List ℕ) ≠ rotClass (p.vert (pos i') : List ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  intro i i' hne
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h | h
  · exact no_reentry hk hp (hdvd i) (hmono i i' h) (hlt i')
  · exact (no_reentry hk hp (hdvd i') (hmono i' i h) (hlt i)).symm

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta2.meta_confinement
statement:
theorem meta_confinement (hk : 3 ≤ k) {α₁ α₂ : ℕ} {K : RotClass}
    {Astar : ℕ → Vtx k} {m : ℕ} (blk : Fin m × Fin (k - 1) → Vtx k)
    (hα1 : α₁ = (Astar 0 : List ℕ).getLastD 0)
    (hα2 : α₂ = ((Astar 0 : List ℕ).dropLast).getLastD 0)
    (hK : K = rotClass ((Astar 0 : List ℕ).dropLast.dropLast))
    (hlen : ∀ j, ((Astar j : List ℕ).erase α₁).length = k - 1)
    (hstep : ∀ j, (Astar (j + 1) : List ℕ).erase α₁ =
        door (((Astar j : List ℕ).erase α₁).rotate (k - 2)))
    (hblk : ∀ i : Fin m × Fin (k - 1),
        (blk i : List ℕ).erase α₁ = ((Astar i.1 : List ℕ).erase α₁).rotate i.2)
    (hcyc : ∀ i i', i ≠ i' → rotClass (blk i : List ℕ) ≠ rotClass (blk i' : List ℕ)) :
    m ≤ k - 2
proof:
:= by
  have herase0 : (Astar 0 : List ℕ).erase α₁ = (Astar 0 : List ℕ).dropLast := by
    rw [hα1, erase_getLastD (Astar 0).2.nodup]
  have hg0 : genLoop ((Astar 0 : List ℕ).erase α₁) = (α₂, K) := by
    rw [herase0, genLoop, ← hα2, ← hK]
  have hmemStar : ∀ j, Astar j ∈ Vset3 k α₁ α₂ K := meta_hinv_mem_Vset3 hk hlen hg0 hstep
  have hmemBlk : ∀ i : Fin m × Fin (k - 1), blk i ∈ Vset3 k α₁ α₂ K := fun i =>
    Vset3_of_metaWord_rotate_iter (hmemStar i.1) (hblk i)
  exact meta_pigeonhole hk hα1 hα2 hK blk hmemBlk hcyc

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta2.Vset3_of_sigmaSq_step
statement:
theorem Vset3_of_sigmaSq_step {α₁ α₂ : ℕ} {K : RotClass} {x B : Vtx k} (hk : 3 ≤ k)
    (hA : sigma x ∈ Vset3 k α₁ α₂ K)
    (hα1 : α₁ = (sigma x : List ℕ).getLastD 0)
    (hB : (B : List ℕ) = sigmaSqWord (x : List ℕ)) :
    B ∈ Vset3 k α₁ α₂ K
proof:
:= by
  have hsx : (sigma x : List ℕ) = rho (x : List ℕ) := rfl
  have hstep : (B : List ℕ).erase α₁ = ((sigma x : List ℕ).erase α₁).rotate 2 := by
    conv_rhs => rw [hsx]
    rw [hB, hα1, hsx, sigmaSqWord_erase_marker hk x.2]
  exact Vset3_of_metaWord_rotate_iter hA hstep

name: Hunter.ProofsWalk.ell0_eq_k_mul_Mper
statement: theorem ell0_eq_k_mul_Mper (_hk : 3 ≤ k) : ell0 k = k * Mper k
proof:
:= by
  have hrhs : k * Mper k = k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2)) - k := by
    rw [Mper, Nat.mul_sub, Nat.mul_one]
  rw [ell0, hrhs, Nat.mul_assoc]

name: Hunter.ProofsWalk.key_div
statement:
theorem key_div (hk : 2 ≤ k) {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 ≤ b) :
    (k * b - 1) / (k * (k - 1)) = (b - 1) / (k - 1)
proof:
:= by
  set q := (b - 1) / (k - 1) with hq
  set r := (b - 1) % (k - 1) with hr
  have hdm : (k - 1) * q + r = b - 1 := by rw [hq, hr]; exact Nat.div_add_mod (b - 1) (k - 1)
  have hrlt : r < k - 1 := by rw [hr]; exact Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  
  have hge : k ≤ k * b := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right k (by omega)
  have hsplit : k * b - 1 = k * (k - 1) * q + (k * r + (k - 1)) := by
    have hmb : k * (b - 1) = k * ((k - 1) * q + r) := by rw [hdm]
    have h2 : k * (b - 1) = k * (k - 1) * q + k * r := by rw [hmb]; ring
    have hkbe : k * b = k * (b - 1) + k := by
      have hm1 : k * (b - 1) = k * b - k := by rw [Nat.mul_sub, Nat.mul_one]
      omega
    omega
  have hrem : k * r + (k - 1) < k * (k - 1) := by
    have hkk : k * (k - 1) = k * (k - 2) + k := by
      have he : k - 1 = (k - 2) + 1 := by omega
      rw [he, Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one]
    have hkr : k * r ≤ k * (k - 2) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) (by omega)
    omega
  rw [hsplit, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_mul_div_left _ _ (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)),
      Nat.div_eq_of_lt hrem, Nat.zero_add]

name: Hunter.ProofsWalk.j_glue
statement:
theorem j_glue (hk : 4 ≤ k) {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 ≤ b) :
    j k (k * b) = Dfr k b + (k * b - 1) + (b - 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction b using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ b ih =>
    have hkpos : 0 < k := by omega
    have hcd_k : (k * b) ⌈/⌉ k = b := by
      rw [Proved.ceilDiv_of_dvd hkpos ⟨b, rfl⟩, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left b hkpos]
    by_cases hbase : b ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2)
    · 
      have hkb1 : 1 ≤ k * b := by
        have := Nat.mul_pos (show 0 < k by omega) (show 0 < b by omega); omega
      have hkble : k * b ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by
        have : k * b ≤ k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2)) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) hbase
        rw [← Nat.mul_assoc] at this; exact this
      have hbf := ProofsCascade.base_frontier (by omega) hkb1 hkble
      rw [hcd_k] at hbf
      
      have hcd_kk : (k * b) ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1)) = (b - 1) / (k - 1) + 1 := by
        rw [Proved.ceilDiv_succ_pred hkb1 (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)),
            key_div (by omega) hb]
      rw [hcd_kk] at hbf
      have hDfr : Dfr k b = (b - 1) / (k - 1) := Dfr_base hbase
      rw [hbf, hDfr]; omega
    · 
      push Not at hbase
      have hM := Mper_pos (by omega : 3 ≤ k)
      have hMval : Mper k = (k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1 := rfl
      have hbM : Mper k < b := by omega
      have hbM1 : 1 ≤ b - Mper k := by omega
      have hbMlt : b - Mper k < b := by omega
      
      have hbaseR : k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) < k * b := by
        have : k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2)) < k * b := (Nat.mul_lt_mul_left hkpos).mpr hbase
        rw [← Nat.mul_assoc] at this; exact this
      have hjr := ProofsRecursion.j_rec_unfold_one (by omega) hbaseR
      
      have hell0 : ell0 k = k * Mper k := ell0_eq_k_mul_Mper (by omega)
      have hsub : k * b - ell0 k = k * (b - Mper k) := by
        rw [hell0, ← Nat.mul_sub]
      
      have hell0_le : ell0 k ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by rw [ell0]; omega
      have hell0_pos : 1 ≤ ell0 k := ProofsRecursion.ell0_pos (by omega)
      have hjbe : j k (ell0 k)
          = ell0 k + (ell0 k ⌈/⌉ k) + (ell0 k ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1))) - 3 :=
        j_base (Or.inl hell0_le)
      have hcd_ell0_k : ell0 k ⌈/⌉ k = Mper k := by
        rw [hell0, Proved.ceilDiv_of_dvd hkpos ⟨Mper k, rfl⟩, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hkpos]
      have hcd_ell0_kk : ell0 k ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1)) = k - 2 := ProofsExcess.ceilDiv_ell0 (by omega)
      rw [hcd_ell0_k, hcd_ell0_kk] at hjbe
      
      have hIH := ih (b - Mper k) hbMlt hbM1
      rw [hsub] at hjr
      rw [hIH] at hjr
      
      have hDshift : Dfr k b = Dfr k (b - Mper k) + (k - 2) := by
        have hlt : (k - 1) * (k - 2) < b := by omega
        rw [Dfr_shift_rec (by omega) hlt]
      
      have hkMle : k * Mper k ≤ k * b := by
        rw [← hell0]; rw [ell0]; omega
      have hMle : Mper k ≤ b := by omega
      rw [hjr, hjbe, hDshift]
      have hell0v : ell0 k = k * Mper k := hell0
      
      rw [hell0v]
      have h1 : k * (b - Mper k) = k * b - k * Mper k := by rw [Nat.mul_sub]
      rw [h1]
      have hkM : k * Mper k ≤ k * b := hkMle
      have hMb : Mper k ≤ b := hMle
      have hk2 : 2 ≤ k * Mper k := by
        have : 1 * 1 ≤ k * Mper k := Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (by omega)
        have := Nat.mul_le_mul (show 2 ≤ k by omega) (show 1 ≤ Mper k by omega); omega
      omega

name: Hunter.ProofsWalk.PE_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem PE_zero (p : HPath k) : PE p 0 = 0
proof: := by simp [PE]

name: Hunter.ProofsWalk.PE_step
statement:
theorem PE_step (hk : 1 ≤ k) (p : HPath k) (t : ℕ) :
    PE p t + (bw p (t + 1) - 2) ≤ PE p (t + 1)
proof:
:= by
  set f : ℕ → ℕ := fun i => ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) - 2 with hf
  have hexp : k * (t + 1) = k * t + k := by rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one]
  have hpos : 1 ≤ k * (t + 1) := by
    have := Nat.mul_pos (show 0 < k by omega) (show 0 < t + 1 by omega); omega
  have hle : k * t ≤ k * (t + 1) := by omega
  have hsplit : PE p (t + 1) = PE p t + ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico (k * t) (k * (t + 1)), f i := by
    simp only [PE, ← hf]
    rw [Finset.range_eq_Ico, Finset.range_eq_Ico,
        ← Finset.sum_Ico_consecutive f (Nat.zero_le (k * t)) hle]
  
  have hidx : k * (t + 1) - 1 + 1 = k * (t + 1) := by omega
  have hmem : (k * (t + 1) - 1) ∈ Finset.Ico (k * t) (k * (t + 1)) := by
    rw [Finset.mem_Ico]; omega
  have hsingle : f (k * (t + 1) - 1) ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico (k * t) (k * (t + 1)), f i :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (f := f) (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) hmem
  have hfval : f (k * (t + 1) - 1) = bw p (t + 1) - 2 := by
    simp only [hf, bw]; rw [hidx]
  rw [hsplit, ← hfval]; omega

name: Hunter.ProofsWalk.PE_le_excess
statement:
theorem PE_le_excess (hk : 1 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (t : ℕ) (hN : k * t < p.numVerts) :
    PE p t ≤ excess p
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : Finset.range (k * t) ⊆ Finset.range (p.numVerts - 1) := by
    intro x hx; rw [Finset.mem_range] at hx ⊢; omega
  rw [ProofsMeta3.excess_eq_sum_edgeWeight hk p, PE]
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub (fun _ _ _ => Nat.zero_le _)

name: Hunter.ProofsWalk.walk_step
statement:
theorem walk_step (hk : 4 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) {t : ℕ} (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (hN : k * (t + 1) < p.numVerts)
    (hj : metaDepth p t ≤ k - 3) (hj' : metaDepth p (t + 1) ≤ k - 3)
    (hmmc : ¬ (IsMarkerMove p (t + 1) ∧ IsComplete p t)) :
    Dfr k (t + 1) + hpot k (doorDepth p (t + 1)) (metaDepth p (t + 1)) (t + 1)
      ≤ (bw p (t + 1) - 2) + (Dfr k t + hpot k (doorDepth p t) (metaDepth p t) t)
proof:
:= by
  have hk' : 3 ≤ k := by omega
  have hexp : k * (t + 1) = k * t + k := by rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one]
  have hNt : k * t < p.numVerts := by omega
  have hd_le : doorDepth p t ≤ k - 2 := doorDepth_le_km2 hk' hp t hNt
  set d := doorDepth p t with hddef
  set jj := metaDepth p t with hjdef
  
  have hnotdoor_dd : ¬ IsDoor p (t + 1) → doorDepth p (t + 1) = 0 := doorDepth_not_door
  rcases boundary_classify_ledger hk' hp (show 1 ≤ t + 1 by omega) hN with
    hdoor | hα | hσ | hmm | hheavy
  · 
    have hbw : bw p (t + 1) = 2 := hdoor
    have hdd : doorDepth p (t + 1) = d + 1 := doorDepth_door hdoor
    have hmd : metaDepth p (t + 1) = jj := metaDepth_door hdoor
    have hdlt : d < k - 2 := by
      have h := doorDepth_le_km2 hk' hp (t + 1) hN; rw [hdd] at h; omega
    have hdi := door_ineq hk (show 1 ≤ t from ht) hdlt hj
    rw [hdd, hmd, hbw]; omega
  · 
    have hbw : bw p (t + 1) = 3 := hα.1
    have hnd : ¬ IsDoor p (t + 1) := by rw [IsDoor, hbw]; omega
    have hdd : doorDepth p (t + 1) = 0 := hnotdoor_dd hnd
    by_cases hc : IsComplete p t
    · 
      have hdc : d = k - 2 := hc
      have hmd : metaDepth p (t + 1) = jj + 1 := metaDepth_alpha_complete hα hc
      have hjk4 : jj ≤ k - 4 := by rw [hmd] at hj'; omega
      have hai := alpha_ineq hk (show 1 ≤ t from ht) hjk4
      rw [hdd, hmd, hbw, hdc]; omega
    · 
      have hmh : IsMetaHeavy p (t + 1) := ⟨hnd, fun h => hc h.2⟩
      have hmd : metaDepth p (t + 1) = 0 := metaDepth_metaHeavy hmh
      have hne : d ≠ k - 2 := hc
      have hd3 : d ≤ k - 3 := by omega
      have hri := reset_ineq hk (show 1 ≤ t from ht) hd3 hj
      rw [hdd, hmd, hbw]; omega
  · 
    have hbw : bw p (t + 1) = 3 := hσ.1
    have hnd : ¬ IsDoor p (t + 1) := by rw [IsDoor, hbw]; omega
    have hdd : doorDepth p (t + 1) = 0 := hnotdoor_dd hnd
    have hmh : IsMetaHeavy p (t + 1) := metaHeavy_of_isSigmaSq hk' hp hN hσ
    have hmd : metaDepth p (t + 1) = 0 := metaDepth_metaHeavy hmh
    have hinc : ¬ IsComplete p t := by
      have := sigmaSq_incomplete_only hk' hp hN hσ
      rwa [show t + 1 - 1 = t from rfl] at this
    have hne : d ≠ k - 2 := hinc
    have hd3 : d ≤ k - 3 := by omega
    have hri := reset_ineq hk (show 1 ≤ t from ht) hd3 hj
    rw [hdd, hmd, hbw]; omega
  · 
    have hbw : bw p (t + 1) = 3 := hmm.1
    have hnd : ¬ IsDoor p (t + 1) := by rw [IsDoor, hbw]; omega
    have hdd : doorDepth p (t + 1) = 0 := hnotdoor_dd hnd
    have hmh : IsMetaHeavy p (t + 1) := metaHeavy_of_isMarkerMove hmm
    have hmd : metaDepth p (t + 1) = 0 := metaDepth_metaHeavy hmh
    have hinc : ¬ IsComplete p t := fun hc => hmmc ⟨hmm, hc⟩
    have hne : d ≠ k - 2 := hinc
    have hd3 : d ≤ k - 3 := by omega
    have hri := reset_ineq hk (show 1 ≤ t from ht) hd3 hj
    rw [hdd, hmd, hbw]; omega
  · 
    have hbw : 4 ≤ bw p (t + 1) := hheavy
    have hnd : ¬ IsDoor p (t + 1) := by rw [IsDoor]; omega
    have hdd : doorDepth p (t + 1) = 0 := hnotdoor_dd hnd
    have hmh : IsMetaHeavy p (t + 1) := metaHeavy_of_isHeavy hheavy
    have hmd : metaDepth p (t + 1) = 0 := metaDepth_metaHeavy hmh
    have hhi := heavy_ineq hk (show 1 ≤ t from ht) hd_le hj
    rw [hdd, hmd]; omega

name: Hunter.ProofsWalk.Dfr_Mper_le
statement: theorem Dfr_Mper_le (hk : 4 ≤ k) : Dfr k (Mper k) ≤ k - 3
proof:
:= by
  have hle : Mper k ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by rw [Mper]; omega
  rw [Dfr_base hle]
  calc (Mper k - 1) / (k - 1) ≤ Mper k / (k - 1) := Nat.div_le_div_right (by omega)
    _ = k - 3 := Mper_div (by omega)

name: Hunter.ProofsWalk.hpot_000
statement: theorem hpot_000 (hk : 4 ≤ k) : hpot k 0 0 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hW : Wpot k 0 0 = Mper k := by simp only [Wpot, Nat.sub_zero, Mper]
  have hDm := Dfr_Mper_le hk
  simp only [hpot, hW, Nat.zero_add, Dfr_zero, Nat.sub_zero]
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsWalk.hpot_block1
statement: theorem hpot_block1 (hk : 4 ≤ k) (p : HPath k) : hpot k (doorDepth p 1) 0 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hk' : 3 ≤ k := by omega
  have hd1 : doorDepth p 1 ≤ 1 := doorDepth_le p 1
  have hP : 6 ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2) := prod_ge hk
  have hWle : 1 + Wpot k (doorDepth p 1) 0 ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by
    have hWm : Wpot k (doorDepth p 1) 0 = (k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1 - doorDepth p 1 := by
      simp only [Wpot, Nat.sub_zero]
    rw [hWm]; omega
  have hDle : Dfr k (1 + Wpot k (doorDepth p 1) 0) ≤ k - 3 := by
    calc Dfr k (1 + Wpot k (doorDepth p 1) 0)
        ≤ Dfr k ((k - 1) * (k - 2)) := Dfr_mono hk hWle
      _ = k - 3 := by
          rw [Dfr_base (le_refl _)]
          exact Mper_div hk'
  have hval : hpot k (doorDepth p 1) 0 1
      = Dfr k (1 + Wpot k (doorDepth p 1) 0) - Dfr k 1 - (k - 3 - 0) := rfl
  rw [hval, Dfr_one hk']
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsWalk.walk_invariant
statement:
theorem walk_invariant (hk : 4 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless)
    (hRunCap : ∀ s, k * s < p.numVerts → metaDepth p s ≤ k - 3)
    (hMMC : ∀ s, 1 ≤ s → k * (s + 1) < p.numVerts →
        ¬ (IsMarkerMove p (s + 1) ∧ IsComplete p s)) :
    ∀ t, k * t < p.numVerts →
      Dfr k t + hpot k (doorDepth p t) (metaDepth p t) t ≤ PE p t
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | zero =>
    intro _
    rw [PE_zero, doorDepth_zero, metaDepth_zero, Dfr_zero, hpot_000 hk]
  | succ t ih =>
    intro hN1
    have hexp : k * (t + 1) = k * t + k := by rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one]
    have hNt : k * t < p.numVerts := by omega
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos t with ht0 | htpos
    · 
      subst ht0
      have hm1 : metaDepth p 1 = 0 := by
        have hnc : ¬ (IsAlpha p 1 ∧ IsComplete p 0) := by
          rintro ⟨_, hc⟩
          have hc' : doorDepth p 0 = k - 2 := hc
          rw [doorDepth_zero] at hc'; omega
        show (if IsAlpha p 1 ∧ IsComplete p 0 then metaDepth p 0 + 1
              else if IsMetaHeavy p 1 then 0 else metaDepth p 0) = 0
        rw [if_neg hnc]
        by_cases hmh : IsMetaHeavy p 1
        · rw [if_pos hmh]
        · rw [if_neg hmh]; rfl
      rw [hm1, hpot_block1 hk, Dfr_one (by omega)]
      exact Nat.zero_le _
    · 
      have hstep := walk_step hk hp htpos hN1 (hRunCap t hNt) (hRunCap (t + 1) hN1)
        (hMMC t htpos hN1)
      have hpe := PE_step (by omega) p t
      have IHt := ih hNt
      omega

name: Hunter.ProofsWalk.excess_ge_Dfr_block
statement:
theorem excess_ge_Dfr_block (hk : 4 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) (h0 : 0 < p.numVerts)
    (hRunCap : ∀ s, k * s < p.numVerts → metaDepth p s ≤ k - 3)
    (hMMC : ∀ s, 1 ≤ s → k * (s + 1) < p.numVerts →
        ¬ (IsMarkerMove p (s + 1) ∧ IsComplete p s)) :
    Dfr k ((p.numVerts - 1) / k) ≤ excess p
proof:
:= by
  set T := (p.numVerts - 1) / k with hT
  have hkpos : 0 < k := by omega
  have hkT : k * T ≤ p.numVerts - 1 := by
    rw [hT, Nat.mul_comm]; exact Nat.div_mul_le_self _ _
  have hTN : k * T < p.numVerts := by omega
  have hinv := walk_invariant hk hp hRunCap hMMC T hTN
  have hple := PE_le_excess (by omega) T hTN
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsPhi.getElem?_flatten_blocks
statement:
theorem getElem?_flatten_blocks (vs : List (Vtx k)) {s : ℕ} (hs : s < vs.length)
    {r : ℕ} (hr : r < k) :
    (vs.map (fun v => (List.range k).map (fun r => sigma^[r] v))).flatten[k * s + r]?
      = some (sigma^[r] (vs[s]'hs))
proof:
:= by
  induction vs generalizing s with
  | nil => simp at hs
  | cons v vs ih =>
    have hblen : ((List.range k).map (fun r => sigma^[r] v)).length = k := by
      rw [List.length_map, List.length_range]
    rw [List.map_cons, List.flatten_cons]
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos s with hs0 | hspos
    · subst hs0
      rw [Nat.mul_zero, Nat.zero_add,
        List.getElem?_append_left (by rw [hblen]; exact hr),
        List.getElem?_map, List.getElem?_range hr]
      simp
    · obtain ⟨s', rfl⟩ : ∃ s', s = s' + 1 := ⟨s - 1, by omega⟩
      have hge : ((List.range k).map (fun r => sigma^[r] v)).length ≤ k * (s' + 1) + r := by
        rw [hblen]; have e : k * (s' + 1) = k * s' + k := by ring
        omega
      rw [List.getElem?_append_right hge, hblen]
      have hidxeq : k * (s' + 1) + r - k = k * s' + r := by
        have e : k * (s' + 1) = k * s' + k := by ring
        omega
      rw [hidxeq]
      have hs' : s' < vs.length := by
        have := hs; simp only [List.length_cons] at this; omega
      rw [ih hs']
      simp

name: Hunter.ProofsPhi.phi_numVerts
statement:
theorem phi_numVerts {p : HPath k} {vs : List (Vtx k)}
    (hverts : p.verts
      = (vs.map (fun v => (List.range k).map (fun r => sigma^[r] v))).flatten) :
    p.numVerts = k * vs.length
proof:
:= by
  rw [HPath.numVerts, hverts, List.length_flatten, List.map_map]
  have hmap : (vs.map (List.length ∘ fun v => (List.range k).map (fun r => sigma^[r] v)))
      = vs.map (fun _ => k) := by
    apply List.map_congr_left
    intro v _
    simp
  rw [hmap, List.map_const', List.sum_replicate, smul_eq_mul, Nat.mul_comm]

name: Hunter.ProofsPhi.phi_vert
statement:
theorem phi_vert {p : HPath k} {vs : List (Vtx k)}
    (hverts : p.verts
      = (vs.map (fun v => (List.range k).map (fun r => sigma^[r] v))).flatten)
    {s : ℕ} (hs : s < vs.length) {r : ℕ} (hr : r < k) :
    p.vert (k * s + r) = sigma^[r] (vs[s]'hs)
proof:
:= by
  have hlen := phi_numVerts hverts
  have hlt : k * s + r < p.numVerts := by
    rw [hlen]
    have hks : k * (s + 1) ≤ k * vs.length := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) hs
    have e : k * (s + 1) = k * s + k := by ring
    omega
  have h1 : p.verts[k * s + r]? = some (sigma^[r] (vs[s]'hs)) := by
    rw [hverts]; exact getElem?_flatten_blocks vs hs hr
  have h2 : p.verts[k * s + r]? = some (p.vert (k * s + r)) := by
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt, vert_getElem p hlt]
  exact (Option.some_inj.mp (h2.symm.trans h1))

name: Hunter.Proved.clm_phi_sufficiency
statement: theorem clm_phi_sufficiency {k : ℕ} {p : HPath k} (hp : IsPhiForm p) : p.StronglyExitless
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨vs, _hnodup, hverts⟩ := hp
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with hk0 | hk
  · 
    exfalso
    subst hk0
    apply p.ne
    rw [hverts]
    simp
  · 
    have hlen : p.numVerts = k * vs.length := phi_numVerts hverts
    have ht0 : 0 < vs.length := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos vs.length with h | h
      · exfalso; have := p.numVerts_pos; rw [hlen, h, Nat.mul_zero] at this; omega
      · exact h
    have hvert : ∀ (s : ℕ) (hs : s < vs.length) (r : ℕ), r < k →
        p.vert (k * s + r) = sigma^[r] (vs[s]'hs) :=
      fun s hs r hr => phi_vert hverts hs hr
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · 
      intro he
      obtain ⟨i, hi2, hw, hlt⟩ := he
      set s := i / k with hsdef
      set r := i % k with hrdef
      have hik : k * s + r = i := Nat.div_add_mod i k
      have hrk : r < k := Nat.mod_lt i hk
      have hs : s < vs.length := by
        rcases lt_or_ge s vs.length with h | h
        · exact h
        · exfalso
          have hle : k * vs.length ≤ k * s := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) h
          rw [hlen] at hi2
          omega
      have hv0 : p.vert i = sigma^[r] (vs[s]'hs) := by
        rw [← hik]; exact hvert s hs r hrk
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (r + 1) k with hlt' | hge'
      · 
        have hv1 : p.vert (i + 1) = sigma^[r + 1] (vs[s]'hs) := by
          have he1 : k * s + (r + 1) = i + 1 := by omega
          rw [← he1]; exact hvert s hs (r + 1) hlt'
        have hstep : p.vert (i + 1) = sigma (p.vert i) := by
          rw [hv1, hv0, sigma_iter_succ']
        have hone : ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) = 1 := by
          rw [hstep]; exact ew_sigma hk _
        omega
      · 
        have hrk1 : r + 1 = k := by omega
        have hsig : sigma (p.vert i) = vs[s]'hs := by
          rw [hv0, sigma_iter_succ', hrk1, sigma_iter_period]
        have hks_lt : k * s < p.numVerts := by omega
        have hvs : vs[s]'hs = p.vert (k * s) := by
          have h0 := hvert s hs 0 hk
          simp only [Nat.add_zero, Function.iterate_zero, id_eq] at h0
          exact h0.symm
        have hpos : p.pos (sigma (p.vert i)) = k * s := by
          rw [hsig, hvs, pos_vert p hks_lt]
        rw [hpos] at hlt
        omega
    · 
      rw [Proved.last_eq_vert]
      set t := vs.length with htdef
      have hNeq : p.numVerts - 1 = k * (t - 1) + (k - 1) := by
        rw [hlen]
        have hkt : k * t = k * (t - 1) + k := by
          conv_lhs => rw [show t = (t - 1) + 1 from by omega]
          ring
        omega
      rw [hNeq]
      have hst : t - 1 < vs.length := by omega
      have hv := hvert (t - 1) hst (k - 1) (by omega)
      rw [hv, sigma_iter_succ', show k - 1 + 1 = k from by omega, sigma_iter_period]
      have h0 := hvert (t - 1) hst 0 hk
      simp only [Nat.add_zero, Function.iterate_zero, id_eq] at h0
      rw [← h0]
      exact vert_mem p (by
        rw [hlen]; exact Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (by omega) hk)

name: Hunter.Proved.bridge_stronglyExitless_iff_phiForm
statement:
theorem bridge_stronglyExitless_iff_phiForm {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} :
    p.StronglyExitless ↔ IsPhiForm p
proof:
:=
  ⟨Proved.clm_phi_necessity_amended hk, clm_phi_sufficiency⟩

name: Hunter.Proved.bridge_stronglyExitless_iff_unionOfCycles
statement:
theorem bridge_stronglyExitless_iff_unionOfCycles {k : ℕ} {p : HPath k} (hexit : p.Exitless) :
    p.StronglyExitless ↔ p.IsUnionOfCycles
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hse
    exact Proved.clm_1cyclesubset hse
  · intro huoc
    refine ⟨hexit, ?_⟩
    have hsub : cyc p.last ⊆ p.vertsFinset := huoc p.last p.last_mem
    have hmem : sigma p.last ∈ cyc p.last := by
      have h := ProofsExitless.sigma_iter_mem_cyc 1 p.last
      rwa [Function.iterate_one] at h
    exact HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mp (hsub hmem)

name: Hunter.ProofsLink2.ceil_blocks_sub_mul
proof:
:=
  ProofsRigid.ceilDiv_sub_mul hk p.numVerts_pos hR

name: Hunter.ProofsLink2.mul_lt_numVerts_of_lt_ceil
statement:
theorem mul_lt_numVerts_of_lt_ceil (hk : 1 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} {R : ℕ}
    (hR : R < p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k) : k * R < p.numVerts
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := p.numVerts_pos
  rw [Proved.ceilDiv_succ_pred h0 hk] at hR
  have hRle : R ≤ (p.numVerts - 1) / k := by omega
  have hle : k * R ≤ k * ((p.numVerts - 1) / k) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left k hRle
  have hkey := Nat.div_add_mod (p.numVerts - 1) k
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsLink2.G_succ_ge
statement: theorem G_succ_ge (hk : 4 ≤ k) (x : ℕ) : G k x + 1 ≤ G k (x + 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, k = m + 4 := ⟨k - 4, by omega⟩
  have hd : 0 < m + 2 := by omega
  simp only [G, show m + 4 - 1 = m + 3 from rfl, show m + 4 - 2 = m + 2 from rfl]
  
  have hpoly : (x + 1 + 1) * (m + 3) = (x + 1) * (m + 3) + (m + 3) := by ring
  have hdiv : (x + 1) / (m + 2) ≤ x / (m + 2) + 1 := by
    calc (x + 1) / (m + 2) ≤ (x + (m + 2)) / (m + 2) := Nat.div_le_div_right (by omega)
      _ = x / (m + 2) + 1 := Nat.add_div_right x hd
  have hBx : x / (m + 2) ≤ x := Nat.div_le_self _ _
  have hP1 : x + 1 ≤ (x + 1) * (m + 3) := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by omega)
  have hBx1 : (x + 1) / (m + 2) ≤ x + 1 := Nat.div_le_self _ _
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsLink2.G_drop_N
statement:
theorem G_drop_N (hk : 4 ≤ k) {E : ℕ} (hE : k - 1 ≤ E) :
    (k - 1) * (k - 2) + G k (E - (k - 1)) ≤ G k E
proof:
:= by
  have hE2 : k - 2 ≤ E := by omega
  have hper : G k E = G k (E - (k - 2)) + Mper k := ProofsInduction.G_period hk hE2
  have hstep : G k (E - (k - 1)) + 1 ≤ G k (E - (k - 2)) := by
    have heq : E - (k - 2) = (E - (k - 1)) + 1 := by omega
    rw [heq]; exact G_succ_ge hk (E - (k - 1))
  have hMper : Mper k = (k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1 := rfl
  have hMpos : 1 ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2) := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsLink2.G_small_blocks
statement:
theorem G_small_blocks (hk : 4 ≤ k) {E b : ℕ}
    (hE : k - 2 ≤ E) (hb : b ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : b ≤ G k E
proof:
:= by
  have hmono : G k (k - 2) ≤ G k E := ProofsInduction.G_mono hk hE
  have hge : (k - 1) * (k - 2) ≤ G k (k - 2) := by
    rw [ProofsInduction.G_period hk (le_refl (k - 2)), Nat.sub_self, ProofsPotential.Mper]
    have hg0 : 1 ≤ G k 0 := by
      rw [ProofsInduction.G_base (show (3 : ℕ) ≤ k by omega) (show (0 : ℕ) ≤ k - 3 by omega)]
      have := Nat.mul_pos (show 0 < 0 + 1 by omega) (show 0 < k - 1 by omega); omega
    have hQ : 1 ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2) := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)
    omega
  exact le_trans hb (le_trans hge hmono)

name: Hunter.ProofsLink2.suffix_blockCeil
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : q.numVerts = p.numVerts - k * R := by
    simp only [numVerts, hq, List.length_drop]
  rw [hlen]
  exact ceil_blocks_sub_mul hk (le_of_lt hR)

name: Hunter.ProofsLink2.frontPay_le_split_sum
statement:
theorem frontPay_le_split_sum (hk : 1 ≤ k) (p : HPath k) (R : ℕ) :
    frontPay p R ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k * R), perEdgeExc p j
proof:
:= by
  have hterm : ∀ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 R, bw p t - 2 = perEdgeExc p (k * t - 1) := by
    intro t ht
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at ht
    have hkt1 : 1 ≤ k * t := by
      calc 1 ≤ k := hk
        _ = k * 1 := (Nat.mul_one k).symm
        _ ≤ k * t := Nat.mul_le_mul_left k ht.1
    have hkt : k * t - 1 + 1 = k * t := by omega
    rw [ProofsChart.perEdgeExc_eq hk, hkt, bw]
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun t => k * t - 1) (Finset.Icc 1 R : Finset ℕ) := by
    intro x hx y hy hxy
    rw [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_Icc] at hx hy
    simp only at hxy
    have hx1 : 1 ≤ k * x := by
      calc 1 ≤ k := hk
        _ = k * 1 := (Nat.mul_one k).symm
        _ ≤ k * x := Nat.mul_le_mul_left k hx.1
    have hy1 : 1 ≤ k * y := by
      calc 1 ≤ k := hk
        _ = k * 1 := (Nat.mul_one k).symm
        _ ≤ k * y := Nat.mul_le_mul_left k hy.1
    have : k * x = k * y := by omega
    exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (by omega) this
  rw [frontPay, Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm]
  have himg : ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 R, perEdgeExc p (k * t - 1)
      = ∑ j ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 R).image (fun t => k * t - 1), perEdgeExc p j :=
    (Finset.sum_image (f := fun j => perEdgeExc p j) hinj).symm
  rw [himg]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?_ (fun _ _ _ => Nat.zero_le _)
  intro j hj
  rw [Finset.mem_image] at hj
  obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hj
  rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at ht
  rw [Finset.mem_range]
  have hkt : k * t ≤ k * R := Nat.mul_le_mul_left k ht.2
  have hkt1 : 1 ≤ k * t := by
    calc 1 ≤ k := hk
      _ = k * 1 := (Nat.mul_one k).symm
      _ ≤ k * t := Nat.mul_le_mul_left k ht.1
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsLink2.suffix_excess_le_of_frontPay
statement:
theorem suffix_excess_le_of_frontPay (hk : 1 ≤ k) {p q : HPath k}
    (hp : p.Exitless) {R c : ℕ} (hR : k * R < p.numVerts)
    (hq : q.verts = p.verts.drop (k * R)) (hpay : c ≤ frontPay p R) :
    excess q ≤ excess p - c
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit : excess p = (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k * R), perEdgeExc p j) + excess q :=
    ProofsChart.excess_split hk hp ⟨R, rfl⟩ hR hq
  have hle := frontPay_le_split_sum hk p R
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsLink2.excess_eq_perEdge
statement:
theorem excess_eq_perEdge (hk : 1 ≤ k) (p : HPath k) :
    excess p = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p.numVerts - 1), perEdgeExc p i
proof:
:= by
  rw [ProofsMeta3.excess_eq_sum_edgeWeight hk]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => (ProofsChart.perEdgeExc_eq hk p i).symm)

name: Hunter.ProofsLink2.posBoundaryCount_le_excess
statement:
theorem posBoundaryCount_le_excess (hk : 4 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless)
    (h0 : 0 < p.numVerts) :
    posBoundaryCount p (p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k) ≤ excess p
proof:
:= by
  have hbT : p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k - 1 = (p.numVerts - 1) / k := by
    rw [Proved.ceilDiv_succ_pred h0 (by omega), Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  unfold posBoundaryCount
  rw [hbT]
  set T := (p.numVerts - 1) / k with hT
  have hkey : k * T + (p.numVerts - 1) % k = p.numVerts - 1 := by
    rw [hT]; exact Nat.div_add_mod _ _
  have hkTle : k * T ≤ p.numVerts - 1 := by omega
  set S := (Finset.Icc 1 T).filter (fun t => ¬ IsDoor p t) with hS
  have hkt_pos : ∀ t, 1 ≤ t → 1 ≤ k * t := by
    intro t ht1
    calc 1 ≤ k := by omega
      _ = k * 1 := (Nat.mul_one k).symm
      _ ≤ k * t := Nat.mul_le_mul_left k ht1
  have hge1 : ∀ t ∈ S, 1 ≤ perEdgeExc p (k * t - 1) := by
    intro t ht
    rw [hS, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc] at ht
    obtain ⟨⟨ht1, htT⟩, hnd⟩ := ht
    have hkt1 := hkt_pos t ht1
    have hktle : k * t ≤ k * T := Nat.mul_le_mul_left k htT
    have hktlt : k * t < p.numVerts := by omega
    have hkt : k * t - 1 + 1 = k * t := by omega
    have hbwdef : bw p t = ew k (p.vert (k * t - 1)) (p.vert (k * t)) := rfl
    have hb2 : 2 ≤ bw p t := by
      have hbg := ProofsWindow.boundary_ge_two (by omega : (1 : ℕ) ≤ k) hp (i := k * t - 1)
        (by rw [hkt]; exact hktlt) (by rw [hkt]; exact ⟨t, rfl⟩)
      rw [hkt] at hbg
      rw [hbwdef]; exact hbg
    have hbne : bw p t ≠ 2 := hnd
    rw [ProofsChart.perEdgeExc_eq (by omega : (1 : ℕ) ≤ k), hkt, ← hbwdef]
    omega
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun t => k * t - 1) (S : Finset ℕ) := by
    intro x hx y hy hxy
    rw [Finset.mem_coe, hS, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc] at hx hy
    simp only at hxy
    have hx1 := hkt_pos x hx.1.1
    have hy1 := hkt_pos y hy.1.1
    have : k * x = k * y := by omega
    exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (by omega) this
  have hsub : S.image (fun t => k * t - 1) ⊆ Finset.range (p.numVerts - 1) := by
    intro j hj
    rw [Finset.mem_image] at hj
    obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hj
    rw [hS, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc] at ht
    obtain ⟨⟨ht1, htT⟩, _⟩ := ht
    have hkt1 := hkt_pos t ht1
    have hktle : k * t ≤ k * T := Nat.mul_le_mul_left k htT
    rw [Finset.mem_range]; omega
  calc S.card = ∑ _t ∈ S, 1 := by rw [Finset.card_eq_sum_ones]
    _ ≤ ∑ t ∈ S, perEdgeExc p (k * t - 1) := Finset.sum_le_sum hge1
    _ = ∑ j ∈ S.image (fun t => k * t - 1), perEdgeExc p j :=
        (Finset.sum_image (f := fun j => perEdgeExc p j) hinj).symm
    _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (p.numVerts - 1), perEdgeExc p j :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub (fun _ _ _ => Nat.zero_le _)
    _ = excess p := (excess_eq_perEdge (by omega) p).symm

name: Hunter.ProofsLink2.block_run_bound
statement:
theorem block_run_bound (hk : 4 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) :
    ∀ t, k * t < p.numVerts →
      t ≤ ((Finset.Icc 1 t).filter (fun s => ¬ IsDoor p s)).card * (k - 1)
          + doorDepth p t
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | zero => intro _; simp
  | succ t ih =>
      intro hlt
      have hltt : k * t < p.numVerts := by
        have : k * t ≤ k * (t + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left k (by omega); omega
      have iht := ih hltt
      have hddt : doorDepth p t ≤ k - 2 := ProofsLedger2.doorDepth_le_km2 (by omega) hp t hltt
      have hins : Finset.Icc 1 (t + 1) = insert (t + 1) (Finset.Icc 1 t) := by
        ext s; simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_Icc]; omega
      have hnotmem : (t + 1) ∉ (Finset.Icc 1 t).filter (fun s => ¬ IsDoor p s) := by
        rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc]; omega
      by_cases hd : IsDoor p (t + 1)
      · have hfilter : (Finset.Icc 1 (t + 1)).filter (fun s => ¬ IsDoor p s)
            = (Finset.Icc 1 t).filter (fun s => ¬ IsDoor p s) := by
          rw [hins, Finset.filter_insert, if_neg (not_not.mpr hd)]
        rw [hfilter, doorDepth_door hd]; omega
      · have hfilter : (Finset.Icc 1 (t + 1)).filter (fun s => ¬ IsDoor p s)
            = insert (t + 1) ((Finset.Icc 1 t).filter (fun s => ¬ IsDoor p s)) := by
          rw [hins, Finset.filter_insert, if_pos hd]
        rw [hfilter, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hnotmem, doorDepth_not_door hd]
        have hexp : (((Finset.Icc 1 t).filter (fun s => ¬ IsDoor p s)).card + 1) * (k - 1)
            = ((Finset.Icc 1 t).filter (fun s => ¬ IsDoor p s)).card * (k - 1) + (k - 1) := by
          ring
        omega

name: Hunter.ProofsLink2.blocks_le_runs
statement:
theorem blocks_le_runs (hk : 4 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) (h0 : 0 < p.numVerts) :
    p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k ≤ (posBoundaryCount p (p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k) + 1) * (k - 1)
proof:
:= by
  set b := p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k with hb
  have hbT : b = (p.numVerts - 1) / k + 1 := Proved.ceilDiv_succ_pred h0 (by omega)
  set T := (p.numVerts - 1) / k with hT
  have hkey : k * T + (p.numVerts - 1) % k = p.numVerts - 1 := by
    rw [hT]; exact Nat.div_add_mod _ _
  have hkTlt : k * T < p.numVerts := by omega
  have hinv := block_run_bound hk hp T hkTlt
  have hddt : doorDepth p T ≤ k - 2 := ProofsLedger2.doorDepth_le_km2 (by omega) hp T hkTlt
  have hpbc : posBoundaryCount p b = ((Finset.Icc 1 T).filter (fun s => ¬ IsDoor p s)).card := by
    unfold posBoundaryCount; rw [hbT, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  rw [hpbc, hbT]
  have hexp : (((Finset.Icc 1 T).filter (fun s => ¬ IsDoor p s)).card + 1) * (k - 1)
      = ((Finset.Icc 1 T).filter (fun s => ¬ IsDoor p s)).card * (k - 1) + (k - 1) := by ring
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsLink2.base_blockCeil_le_G
statement:
theorem base_blockCeil_le_G (hk : 4 ≤ k) {E : ℕ} (hE : E ≤ k - 3)
    {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) (h0 : 0 < p.numVerts) (hpe : excess p = E) :
    p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k ≤ G k E
proof:
:= by
  have hpbc := posBoundaryCount_le_excess hk hp h0
  have hruns := blocks_le_runs hk hp h0
  rw [hpe] at hpbc
  rw [ProofsInduction.G_base (show (3 : ℕ) ≤ k by omega) hE]
  have hmul : (posBoundaryCount p (p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k) + 1) * (k - 1) ≤ (E + 1) * (k - 1) :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (le_refl (k - 1))
  exact le_trans hruns hmul

name: Hunter.ProofsLink2.chart_heavy_of_frontLow
statement:
theorem chart_heavy_of_frontLow (hprof : ProfileHyp) (hk : 4 ≤ k) {p : HPath k}
    (hp : p.Exitless) (hcut : k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2)) < p.numVerts)
    (hlow : frontPay p ((k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1) ≤ k - 3) :
    4 ≤ bw p ((k - 1) * (k - 2))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, k = m + 4 := ⟨k - 4, by omega⟩
  have hcut' : (m + 4) * ((m + 3) * (m + 2)) < p.numVerts := hcut
  have hlow' : frontPay p ((m + 3) * (m + 2) - 1) ≤ m + 1 := hlow
  obtain ⟨hbw2, hbw3⟩ := hprof hp hcut' hlow'
  exact ProofsFinale.hpath_chart_heavy hp hcut' hbw2 hbw3

name: Hunter.ProofsLink2.frontPay_succ
statement:
theorem frontPay_succ (p : HPath k) (R : ℕ) :
    frontPay p (R + 1) = frontPay p R + (bw p (R + 1) - 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [frontPay, frontPay, Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega : (1 : ℕ) ≤ R + 1)]

name: Hunter.ProofsLink2.frontPay_le_excess
statement:
theorem frontPay_le_excess (hk : 4 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} {R : ℕ}
    (hR : k * R < p.numVerts) : frontPay p R ≤ excess p
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := frontPay_le_split_sum (by omega) p R
  have h2 : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k * R), perEdgeExc p j
      ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (p.numVerts - 1), perEdgeExc p j := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
    · intro j hj; rw [Finset.mem_range] at hj ⊢; omega
    · exact fun _ _ _ => Nat.zero_le _
  rw [excess_eq_perEdge (by omega)]; omega

name: Hunter.ProofsLink2.heavyCount_le_frontPay
statement:
theorem heavyCount_le_frontPay (p : HPath k) (R : ℕ) :
    ((Finset.Icc 1 R).filter (fun t => 3 ≤ bw p t)).card ≤ frontPay p R
proof:
:= by
  rw [frontPay]
  set F := (Finset.Icc 1 R).filter (fun t => 3 ≤ bw p t) with hF
  calc F.card = ∑ _t ∈ F, 1 := by rw [Finset.card_eq_sum_ones]
    _ ≤ ∑ t ∈ F, (bw p t - 2) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro t ht
        rw [hF, Finset.mem_filter] at ht
        omega
    _ ≤ ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 R, (bw p t - 2) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
          (fun _ _ _ => Nat.zero_le _)

name: Hunter.ProofsLink2.frontPay_window_ge
statement:
theorem frontPay_window_ge (hk : 4 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless)
    (hcut : k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2)) < p.numVerts) :
    k - 3 ≤ frontPay p ((k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1)
proof:
:= by
  set N := (k - 1) * (k - 2) with hNdef
  have hNpos : 1 ≤ N := by rw [hNdef]; exact Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)
  have hcut' : k * (N - 1) < p.numVerts := by
    have : k * (N - 1) ≤ k * N := Nat.mul_le_mul_left k (by omega)
    omega
  have hwin := ProofsMeta6.window_heavy_count (show 3 ≤ k by omega) hp 0 (N - 1)
    (by rw [Nat.zero_add]; exact hcut')
  simp only [Nat.zero_add] at hwin
  have hpredeq : ((Finset.Icc 1 (N - 1)).filter
        (fun j => 3 ≤ ew k (p.vert (k * j - 1)) (p.vert (k * j))))
      = (Finset.Icc 1 (N - 1)).filter (fun j => 3 ≤ bw p j) := rfl
  rw [hpredeq] at hwin
  have hwm : (N - 1) ⌈/⌉ (k - 1) = k - 2 := by
    rw [hNdef]; exact ProofsMeta6.windowM_ceilDiv (by omega)
  rw [hwm] at hwin
  have hheavy := heavyCount_le_frontPay p (N - 1)
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsLink2.blockCeil_le_G_excess_frontChart
statement:
theorem blockCeil_le_G_excess_frontChart (hprof : ProfileHyp) (hk : 4 ≤ k)
    {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) (h0 : 0 < p.numVerts) :
    p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k ≤ G k (excess p)
proof:
:= by
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
  have main : ∀ E, ∀ p : HPath k, p.Exitless → 0 < p.numVerts → excess p = E →
      p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k ≤ G k E := by
    intro E
    induction E using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | _ E ih =>
        intro p hp h0 hE
        set b := p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k with hb
        by_cases hbase : E ≤ k - 3
        · exact base_blockCeil_le_G hk hbase hp h0 hE
        · have hEge : k - 2 ≤ E := by omega
          by_cases hsmall : b ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2)
          · exact G_small_blocks hk hEge hsmall
          · have hNb : (k - 1) * (k - 2) < b := by omega
            have hNpos : 1 ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2) := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)
            by_cases hA : k - 2 ≤ frontPay p (Mper k)
            · 
              have hMval : Mper k = (k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1 := rfl
              have hMb : Mper k < b := by omega
              have hcut : k * Mper k < p.numVerts := mul_lt_numVerts_of_lt_ceil hk1 (by rw [← hb]; exact hMb)
              obtain ⟨q, hqv, hqe⟩ := ProofsChart.suffix_exitless hk1 hp ⟨Mper k, rfl⟩ hcut
              have hxq : excess q ≤ excess p - (k - 2) :=
                suffix_excess_le_of_frontPay hk1 hp hcut hqv hA
              have hqceil : q.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k = b - Mper k := by
                rw [hb]; exact suffix_blockCeil hk1 hcut hqv
              have hlt : excess q < E := by omega
              have hGq := ih (excess q) hlt q hqe q.numVerts_pos rfl
              rw [hqceil] at hGq
              have hmono : G k (excess q) ≤ G k (E - (k - 2)) := G_mono hk (by omega)
              have hper : G k E = G k (E - (k - 2)) + Mper k := G_period hk (by omega)
              omega
            · 
              have hlowB : frontPay p ((k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1) ≤ k - 3 := by
                have hMval : Mper k = (k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1 := rfl
                rw [← hMval]; omega
              have hcutN : k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2)) < p.numVerts :=
                mul_lt_numVerts_of_lt_ceil hk1 (by rw [← hb]; exact hNb)
              have hbwN : 4 ≤ bw p ((k - 1) * (k - 2)) :=
                chart_heavy_of_frontLow hprof hk hp hcutN hlowB
              have hfloor : k - 3 ≤ frontPay p ((k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1) :=
                frontPay_window_ge hk hp hcutN
              
              have hNeq : (k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1 + 1 = (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by omega
              have hsucc := frontPay_succ p ((k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1)
              rw [hNeq] at hsucc
              have hpayN : k - 1 ≤ frontPay p ((k - 1) * (k - 2)) := by omega
              have hfple : frontPay p ((k - 1) * (k - 2)) ≤ excess p := frontPay_le_excess hk hcutN
              have hEge' : k - 1 ≤ E := by omega
              obtain ⟨q, hqv, hqe⟩ :=
                ProofsChart.suffix_exitless hk1 hp ⟨(k - 1) * (k - 2), rfl⟩ hcutN
              have hxq : excess q ≤ excess p - (k - 1) :=
                suffix_excess_le_of_frontPay hk1 hp hcutN hqv hpayN
              have hqceil : q.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k = b - (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by
                rw [hb]; exact suffix_blockCeil hk1 hcutN hqv
              have hlt : excess q < E := by omega
              have hGq := ih (excess q) hlt q hqe q.numVerts_pos rfl
              rw [hqceil] at hGq
              have hmono : G k (excess q) ≤ G k (E - (k - 1)) := G_mono hk (by omega)
              have hdrop := G_drop_N hk hEge'
              omega
  exact main (excess p) p hp h0 rfl

name: Hunter.ProofsLink2.tightJumpFree_of_excessBlockCeil

name: Hunter.ProofsConfinement.erase_getLastD
statement:
theorem erase_getLastD {w : List ℕ} (hw : w.Nodup) :
    w.erase (w.getLastD 0) = w.dropLast
proof:
:= by
  rcases List.eq_nil_or_concat w with rfl | ⟨l, a, rfl⟩
  · rfl
  · rw [List.concat_eq_append] at hw ⊢
    have hal : a ∉ l := by
      rw [List.nodup_append] at hw
      intro h; exact hw.2.2 a h a (List.mem_singleton_self a) rfl
    have hgl : (l ++ [a]).getLastD 0 = a := by simp
    rw [hgl, List.erase_append_right _ hal, List.erase_cons_head, List.append_nil,
        List.dropLast_concat]

name: Hunter.ProofsConfinement.rotClass_erase_rotate_one
statement:
theorem rotClass_erase_rotate_one {α : ℕ} {y : List ℕ} (hnd : y.Nodup) :
    rotClass ((y.rotate 1).erase α) = rotClass (y.erase α)
proof:
:= by
  rcases y with _ | ⟨a, t⟩
  · simp
  · have hy : (a :: t).rotate 1 = t ++ [a] := by simp
    rw [hy]
    apply Quotient.sound
    by_cases hα : α = a
    · subst hα
      have hat : α ∉ t := (List.nodup_cons.mp hnd).1
      rw [List.erase_append_right _ hat, List.erase_cons_head, List.append_nil,
        List.erase_cons_head]
    · by_cases hmem : α ∈ t
      · rw [List.erase_append_left _ hmem,
          List.erase_cons_tail (by simpa using Ne.symm hα)]
        exact List.IsRotated.symm
          (⟨1, by simp⟩ : (a :: t.erase α) ~r (t.erase α ++ [a]))
      · have h1 : (t ++ [a]).erase α = t ++ [a] := by
          apply List.erase_of_not_mem
          simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton]
          rintro (h | h)
          · exact hmem h
          · exact hα h
        have h2 : (a :: t).erase α = a :: t := by
          apply List.erase_of_not_mem
          simp only [List.mem_cons]
          rintro (h | h)
          · exact hα h
          · exact hmem h
        rw [h1, h2]
        exact List.IsRotated.symm (⟨1, by simp⟩ : (a :: t) ~r (t ++ [a]))

name: Hunter.ProofsConfinement.rotClass_erase_rotate
statement:
theorem rotClass_erase_rotate {α : ℕ} {w : List ℕ} (hnd : w.Nodup) (r : ℕ) :
    rotClass ((w.rotate r).erase α) = rotClass (w.erase α)
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => simp
  | succ r ih =>
    have hrot : w.rotate (r + 1) = (w.rotate r).rotate 1 := by rw [List.rotate_rotate]
    rw [hrot, rotClass_erase_rotate_one ((List.rotate_perm w r).nodup_iff.mpr hnd), ih]

name: Hunter.ProofsConfinement.wt_two_word_cases
statement:
theorem wt_two_word_cases {u v : List ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hu : IsPermWord k u)
    (hv : IsPermWord k v) (hover : u.drop 2 = v.take (k - 2)) :
    v = u.rotate 2 ∨ v = door u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, t, rfl⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil (hu.ne_nil (by omega))
  obtain ⟨b, s, rfl⟩ : ∃ b s, t = b :: s := by
    rcases t with _ | ⟨b, s⟩
    · have := hu.length; simp at this; omega
    · exact ⟨b, s, rfl⟩
  have hulen : (a :: b :: s).length = k := hu.length
  have hslen : s.length = k - 2 := by simp at hulen; omega
  have hdrop : (a :: b :: s).drop 2 = s := rfl
  set r := v.drop (k - 2) with hr
  have hvsplit : v = s ++ r := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← List.take_append_drop (k - 2) v]
    rw [← hover, hdrop]
  have hrlen : r.length = 2 := by
    rw [hr, List.length_drop, hv.length]; omega
  have hnd : (a :: b :: s).Nodup := hu.nodup
  have has : a ∉ s := by
    have := (List.nodup_cons.mp hnd).1; simp at this; exact this.2
  have hbs : b ∉ s := (List.nodup_cons.mp (List.nodup_cons.mp hnd).2).1
  have hab : a ≠ b := by
    have := (List.nodup_cons.mp hnd).1; simp at this; exact this.1
  have hsymbols : v.toFinset = (a :: b :: s).toFinset := by
    rw [hv.toFinset_eq, hu.toFinset_eq]
  have hav : a ∈ v := by rw [← List.mem_toFinset, hsymbols]; simp
  have hbv : b ∈ v := by rw [← List.mem_toFinset, hsymbols]; simp
  have har : a ∈ r := by
    rw [hvsplit, List.mem_append] at hav
    rcases hav with h | h
    · exact absurd h has
    · exact h
  have hbr : b ∈ r := by
    rw [hvsplit, List.mem_append] at hbv
    rcases hbv with h | h
    · exact absurd h hbs
    · exact h
  obtain ⟨x, y, hxy⟩ : ∃ x y, r = [x, y] := by
    rcases r with _ | ⟨x, r'⟩
    · simp at hrlen
    · rcases r' with _ | ⟨y, r''⟩
      · simp at hrlen
      · rcases r'' with _ | _
        · exact ⟨x, y, rfl⟩
        · simp at hrlen
  rw [hxy] at har hbr
  simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at har hbr
  have hrot : (a :: b :: s).rotate 2 = s ++ [a, b] := by
    rw [List.rotate_eq_drop_append_take
      (by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega : 2 ≤ (a :: b :: s).length)]
    rfl
  have hdoor : door (a :: b :: s) = s ++ [b, a] := by
    show (a :: b :: s).drop 2 ++ [(a :: b :: s).getD 1 0, (a :: b :: s).getD 0 0] = _
    rfl
  rcases har with rfl | rfl
  · rcases hbr with rfl | rfl
    · exact absurd rfl hab
    · left; rw [hvsplit, hxy, hrot]
  · rcases hbr with rfl | rfl
    · right; rw [hvsplit, hxy, hdoor]
    · exact absurd rfl hab.symm

name: Hunter.ProofsConfinement.genLoop_door_eq_genLoop_rho
statement:
theorem genLoop_door_eq_genLoop_rho {σ : List ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hσ : IsPermWord k σ) :
    genLoop (door σ) = genLoop (rho σ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, t, rfl⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil (hσ.ne_nil (by omega))
  obtain ⟨b, s, rfl⟩ : ∃ b s, t = b :: s := by
    rcases t with _ | ⟨b, s⟩
    · have := hσ.length; simp at this; omega
    · exact ⟨b, s, rfl⟩
  have hrho : rho (a :: b :: s) = b :: s ++ [a] := by
    show (a :: b :: s).rotate 1 = _; simp
  have hdoor : door (a :: b :: s) = s ++ [b, a] := rfl
  rw [hrho, hdoor]
  unfold genLoop
  have h1 : (s ++ [b, a]).getLastD 0 = a := by
    have : s ++ [b, a] = (s ++ [b]) ++ [a] := by simp
    rw [this, List.getLastD_concat]
  have h2 : (b :: s ++ [a]).getLastD 0 = a := by
    have : b :: s ++ [a] = (b :: s) ++ [a] := by simp
    rw [this, List.getLastD_concat]
  have h3 : (s ++ [b, a]).dropLast = s ++ [b] := by
    have : s ++ [b, a] = (s ++ [b]) ++ [a] := by simp
    rw [this, List.dropLast_concat]
  have h4 : (b :: s ++ [a]).dropLast = b :: s := by
    have : b :: s ++ [a] = (b :: s) ++ [a] := by simp
    rw [this, List.dropLast_concat]
  rw [h1, h2, h3, h4]
  refine Prod.ext rfl ?_
  show rotClass (s ++ [b]) = rotClass (b :: s)
  apply Quotient.sound
  exact List.IsRotated.symm ⟨1, by simp⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsConfinement.insert_pos_inj
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ {a b : ℕ}, a < b → b ≤ w.length →
      w.take a ++ α :: w.drop a = w.take b ++ α :: w.drop b → False := by
    intro a b hab hb heq'
    have hlta : (w.take a).length = a := by rw [List.length_take]; omega
    have hltb : (w.take b).length = b := by rw [List.length_take]; omega
    have e := congrArg (fun l => l[a]?) heq'
    rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by omega : (w.take a).length ≤ a), hlta,
      Nat.sub_self, List.getElem?_append_left (by rw [hltb]; omega : a < (w.take b).length),
      List.getElem?_take_of_lt hab, List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by omega : a < w.length)]
      at e
    have hαa : α = w[a]'(by omega) := by
      have e0 : (α :: w.drop a)[0]? = some α := rfl
      rw [e0] at e; exact Option.some_inj.mp e
    apply hα; rw [hαa]; exact List.getElem_mem (by omega)
  rcases Nat.lt_trichotomy j j' with h | h | h
  · exact absurd heq (fun he => key h hj' he)
  · exact h
  · exact absurd heq.symm (fun he => key h hj he)

name: Hunter.ProofsConfinement.mem_Vset
statement:
theorem mem_Vset {α : ℕ} {K : RotClass} {v : Vtx k} :
    v ∈ Vset k α K ↔ rotClass ((v : List ℕ).erase α) = K
proof:
:= by
  rw [Vset, Finset.mem_filter]
  exact ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, h⟩⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsConfinement.sigma_mem_Vset
statement:
theorem sigma_mem_Vset {α : ℕ} {K : RotClass} {v : Vtx k} (h : v ∈ Vset k α K) :
    sigma v ∈ Vset k α K
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_Vset] at h ⊢
  show rotClass (((v : List ℕ).rotate 1).erase α) = K
  rw [rotClass_erase_rotate_one v.2.nodup, h]

name: Hunter.ProofsConfinement.card_Vset_le
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases List.eq_nil_or_concat (A : List ℕ) with hnil | ⟨u₀, aLast, hAeq⟩
  · exact absurd hnil (A.2.ne_nil (by omega))
  · rw [List.concat_eq_append] at hAeq
    have hnd : ((u₀ ++ [aLast]).Nodup) := hAeq ▸ A.2.nodup
    have hαa : α = aLast := by rw [hα, hAeq, List.getLastD_concat]
    have hdl : (A : List ℕ).dropLast = u₀ := by rw [hAeq, List.dropLast_concat]
    have hKu : K = rotClass u₀ := by rw [hK, hdl]
    have hu0nd : u₀.Nodup := (List.nodup_append.mp hnd).1
    have hαu0 : aLast ∉ u₀ :=
      fun h => (List.nodup_append.mp hnd).2.2 aLast h aLast (by simp) rfl
    have hu0len : u₀.length = k - 1 := by
      have := A.2.length; rw [hAeq] at this; simp at this; omega
    have hlenpos : 0 < u₀.length := by rw [hu0len]; omega
    have hαIcc : aLast ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k := by
      rw [← A.2.toFinset_eq, List.mem_toFinset, hAeq]; simp
    set f : ℕ × ℕ → List ℕ :=
      fun p => (u₀.rotate p.1).take p.2 ++ aLast :: (u₀.rotate p.1).drop p.2 with hf
    have hsub : (Vset k α K).image Subtype.val ⊆
        ((Finset.range (k - 1)) ×ˢ (Finset.range k)).image f := by
      intro w hw
      rw [Finset.mem_image] at hw
      obtain ⟨v, hvV, rfl⟩ := hw
      rw [mem_Vset, hαa, hKu] at hvV
      have hασ : aLast ∈ (v : List ℕ) := by
        rw [← List.mem_toFinset, v.2.toFinset_eq]; exact hαIcc
      obtain ⟨t, r', hsplit⟩ := List.append_of_mem hασ
      have hvnd : (v : List ℕ).Nodup := v.2.nodup
      rw [hsplit, List.nodup_append] at hvnd
      have hαt : aLast ∉ t := fun h => hvnd.2.2 aLast h aLast (List.mem_cons_self ..) rfl
      have herase2 : (v : List ℕ).erase aLast = t ++ r' := by
        rw [hsplit, List.erase_append_right _ hαt, List.erase_cons_head]
      have hclass : rotClass (t ++ r') = rotClass u₀ := by rw [← herase2]; exact hvV
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := rotClass_eq_iff.mp hclass.symm
      have hrot : u₀.rotate (m % u₀.length) = t ++ r' := by rw [List.rotate_mod]; exact hm
      have hjlen : t.length + 1 + r'.length = k := by
        have := v.2.length; rw [hsplit] at this; simp at this; omega
      refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(m % u₀.length, t.length), ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact Finset.mem_product.mpr
          ⟨Finset.mem_range.mpr (by rw [← hu0len]; exact Nat.mod_lt _ hlenpos),
           Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)⟩
      · show (u₀.rotate (m % u₀.length)).take t.length ++
            aLast :: (u₀.rotate (m % u₀.length)).drop t.length = (v : List ℕ)
        rw [hrot, List.take_left, List.drop_left]
        exact hsplit.symm
    have hinjval : Function.Injective (Subtype.val : Vtx k → List ℕ) :=
      fun a b h => Subtype.ext h
    calc (Vset k α K).card
        = ((Vset k α K).image Subtype.val).card :=
          (Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hinjval).symm
      _ ≤ (((Finset.range (k - 1)) ×ˢ (Finset.range k)).image f).card :=
          Finset.card_le_card hsub
      _ ≤ ((Finset.range (k - 1)) ×ˢ (Finset.range k)).card := Finset.card_image_le
      _ = (k - 1) * k := by
          rw [Finset.card_product, Finset.card_range, Finset.card_range]
      _ = k * (k - 1) := Nat.mul_comm _ _

name: Hunter.ProofsConfinement.mem_Vset_of_genLoop
statement:
theorem mem_Vset_of_genLoop {α : ℕ} {K : RotClass} {v : Vtx k}
    (h : genLoop (v : List ℕ) = (α, K)) : v ∈ Vset k α K
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_Vset]
  have h1 : (v : List ℕ).getLastD 0 = α := congrArg Prod.fst h
  have h2 : rotClass (v : List ℕ).dropLast = K := congrArg Prod.snd h
  rw [← h1, erase_getLastD v.2.nodup]; exact h2

name: Hunter.ProofsConfinement.sigma_iter_mem_Vset
statement:
theorem sigma_iter_mem_Vset {α : ℕ} {K : RotClass} {v : Vtx k}
    (h : v ∈ Vset k α K) (r : ℕ) : sigma^[r] v ∈ Vset k α K
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => simpa using h
  | succ r ih => rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']; exact sigma_mem_Vset ih

name: Hunter.ProofsConfinement.cyc_subset_Vset
statement:
theorem cyc_subset_Vset {α : ℕ} {K : RotClass} {v : Vtx k} (hk1 : 1 ≤ k)
    (h : v ∈ Vset k α K) : cyc v ⊆ Vset k α K
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu
  obtain ⟨r, _, rfl⟩ := (mem_cyc_iff_exists hk1).mp hu
  exact sigma_iter_mem_Vset h r

name: Hunter.ProofsConfinement.cyc_disjoint
statement:
theorem cyc_disjoint {u v : Vtx k} (h : rotClass u.1 ≠ rotClass v.1) :
    Disjoint (cyc u) (cyc v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro x hxu hxv
  rw [mem_cyc] at hxu hxv
  exact h (hxu.symm.trans hxv)

name: Hunter.ProofsConfinement.door_of_boundary
statement:
theorem door_of_boundary (hk : 2 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) {i : ℕ}
    (hi : i + 1 < p.numVerts) (hd : k ∣ (i + 1))
    (hw : ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) = 2) :
    (p.vert (i + 1) : List ℕ) = door (p.vert i : List ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
  have hu : IsPermWord k (p.vert i : List ℕ) := (p.vert i).2
  have hv : IsPermWord k (p.vert (i + 1) : List ℕ) := (p.vert (i + 1)).2
  have hew : wt k (p.vert i : List ℕ) (p.vert (i + 1) : List ℕ) = 2 := hw
  have hspec := (wt_spec (u := (p.vert i : List ℕ)) (v := (p.vert (i + 1) : List ℕ))
    hk1 (le_of_eq hu.length)).2.2
  rw [hew] at hspec
  rcases wt_two_word_cases hk hu hv hspec with hrot | hdoor
  · exfalso
    have hsigma2 : p.vert (i + 1) = sigma^[2] (p.vert i) := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [hrot, sigma_iter_val]
    set B := k * (i / k) with hBdef
    have hBdvd : k ∣ B := ⟨i / k, rfl⟩
    have him : i % k = k - 1 := mod_eq_pred_of_dvd_succ hk1 hd
    have hiB : i = B + (k - 1) := by
      rw [hBdef]; have := Nat.div_add_mod i k; omega
    have hB1n : B + 1 < p.numVerts := by omega
    have hverti : p.vert i = sigma^[k - 1] (p.vert B) := by
      have h := vert_eq_sigma_iter hk1 hp i (by omega)
      rwa [him, ← hBdef] at h
    have hstep : sigma^[2] (p.vert i) = sigma^[1] (p.vert B) := by
      rw [hverti, ← Function.iterate_add_apply, show 2 + (k - 1) = 1 + k from by omega,
          Function.iterate_add_apply, sigma_iter_period]
    have hb1 : p.vert (B + 1) = sigma^[1] (p.vert B) :=
      block_is_full_cycle hk1 hp hBdvd (by omega) hB1n
    have heq : p.vert (i + 1) = p.vert (B + 1) := by rw [hsigma2, hstep, ← hb1]
    have := vert_inj p hi hB1n heq
    omega
  · exact hdoor

name: Hunter.ProofsConfinement.confinement
statement:
theorem confinement (hk : 2 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) {t₀ : ℕ}
    (hlast : k * (t₀ + k - 1) < p.numVerts)
    (hdoors : ∀ t, t₀ < t → t ≤ t₀ + k - 1 →
        ew k (p.vert (k * t - 1)) (p.vert (k * t)) = 2) : False
proof:
:= by
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
  set A : ℕ → Vtx k := fun t => p.vert (k * t) with hA
  set α : ℕ := (A t₀ : List ℕ).getLastD 0 with hαdef
  set K : RotClass := rotClass (A t₀ : List ℕ).dropLast with hKdef
  
  have hinv : ∀ j, j ≤ k - 1 → genLoop (A (t₀ + j) : List ℕ) = (α, K) := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero => intro _; rw [Nat.add_zero]; rfl
    | succ j ih =>
      intro hj
      have hIH := ih (by omega)
      set s := t₀ + j with hs
      have hs1le : s + 1 ≤ t₀ + k - 1 := by omega
      set i := k * (s + 1) - 1 with hidef
      have hks : k * (s + 1) = k * s + k := by ring
      have hib : i = k * s + (k - 1) := by omega
      have hi1eq : i + 1 = k * (s + 1) := by omega
      have hkslt : k * (s + 1) ≤ k * (t₀ + k - 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) hs1le
      have hin : i + 1 < p.numVerts := by omega
      have hd : k ∣ (i + 1) := by rw [hi1eq]; exact ⟨s + 1, rfl⟩
      have hwt : ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) = 2 := by
        have h := hdoors (s + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
        rw [show k * (s + 1) - 1 = i from hidef.symm, show k * (s + 1) = i + 1 from hi1eq.symm]
          at h
        exact h
      have hAeq : A (s + 1) = p.vert (i + 1) := by
        show p.vert (k * (s + 1)) = p.vert (i + 1)
        rw [hi1eq]
      have hdoorx : (A (s + 1) : List ℕ) = door (p.vert i : List ℕ) := by
        rw [hAeq]; exact door_of_boundary hk hp hin hd hwt
      
      have hxfull : p.vert i = sigma^[k - 1] (A s) := by
        have h := block_is_full_cycle hk1 hp (⟨s, rfl⟩ : k ∣ k * s) (by omega : k - 1 < k)
          (by omega : k * s + (k - 1) < p.numVerts)
        rw [hib]; exact h
      have hsigmax : sigma (p.vert i) = A s := by
        rw [hxfull, sigma_iter_succ' (k - 1) (A s), show (k - 1) + 1 = k from by omega,
            sigma_iter_period]
      have hrhox : rho (p.vert i : List ℕ) = (A s : List ℕ) := by
        show (p.vert i : List ℕ).rotate 1 = (A s : List ℕ)
        rw [← hsigmax]; rfl
      calc genLoop (A (t₀ + (j + 1)) : List ℕ)
          = genLoop (A (s + 1) : List ℕ) := by rw [show t₀ + (j + 1) = s + 1 from by omega]
        _ = genLoop (door (p.vert i : List ℕ)) := by rw [hdoorx]
        _ = genLoop (rho (p.vert i : List ℕ)) := genLoop_door_eq_genLoop_rho hk (p.vert i).2
        _ = genLoop (A s : List ℕ) := by rw [hrhox]
        _ = (α, K) := hIH
  
  have hne : ∀ a b, a < b → b ≤ k - 1 →
      rotClass (A (t₀ + a) : List ℕ) ≠ rotClass (A (t₀ + b) : List ℕ) := by
    intro a b hab hb
    have hdvd : k ∣ k * (t₀ + a) := ⟨t₀ + a, rfl⟩
    have hBk : k * (t₀ + a) + k ≤ k * (t₀ + b) := by
      have he : k * (t₀ + a) + k = k * (t₀ + a + 1) := by ring
      rw [he]; exact Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) (by omega)
    have hB'n : k * (t₀ + b) < p.numVerts := by
      have hle : k * (t₀ + b) ≤ k * (t₀ + k - 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) (by omega)
      omega
    exact no_reentry hk1 hp hdvd hBk hB'n
  
  have hAmem : ∀ j, j ≤ k - 1 → A (t₀ + j) ∈ Vset k α K :=
    fun j hj => mem_Vset_of_genLoop (hinv j hj)
  set bigU : Finset (Vtx k) := (Finset.range k).biUnion (fun j => cyc (A (t₀ + j))) with hbigU
  have hdisj : ∀ j ∈ Finset.range k, ∀ j' ∈ Finset.range k, j ≠ j' →
      Disjoint (cyc (A (t₀ + j))) (cyc (A (t₀ + j'))) := by
    intro j hj j' hj' hjne
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hj hj'
    apply cyc_disjoint
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j j' with h | h
    · exact hne j j' h (by omega)
    · exact (hne j' j (by omega) (by omega)).symm
  have hcardk : bigU.card = k * k := by
    rw [hbigU, Finset.card_biUnion hdisj,
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => card_cyc hk1 (A (t₀ + j))),
        Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, smul_eq_mul]
  have hsub : bigU ⊆ Vset k α K := by
    rw [hbigU]
    intro x hx
    rw [Finset.mem_biUnion] at hx
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hxj⟩ := hx
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hj
    exact cyc_subset_Vset hk1 (hAmem j (by omega)) hxj
  have hVle : (Vset k α K).card ≤ k * (k - 1) := card_Vset_le (A := A t₀) hk hαdef hKdef
  have hle : k * k ≤ k * (k - 1) := by
    rw [← hcardk]; exact le_trans (Finset.card_le_card hsub) hVle
  have hlt : k * (k - 1) < k * k := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (by omega) (by omega)
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsConfinement.one_le_of_ceilDiv
statement: theorem one_le_of_ceilDiv {d T : ℕ} (h : 1 ≤ T ⌈/⌉ d) : 1 ≤ T
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos T with h0 | h1
  · rw [h0] at h; simp at h
  · exact h1

name: Hunter.ProofsConfinement.cover_bound
statement:
theorem cover_bound {d T : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) (H : Finset ℕ)
    (hwin : ∀ a, 1 ≤ a → a + d ≤ T → ∃ h ∈ H, a ≤ h ∧ h ≤ a + d - 1) :
    T ⌈/⌉ d - 1 ≤ H.card
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : Finset.range (T ⌈/⌉ d - 1) ⊆ H.image (fun h => (h - 1) / d) := by
    intro g hg
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hg
    have hT1 : 1 ≤ T := one_le_of_ceilDiv (d := d) (by omega)
    have hpred : T ⌈/⌉ d = (T - 1) / d + 1 := ceilDiv_succ_pred hT1 (by omega)
    have hgd : g + 1 ≤ (T - 1) / d := by omega
    have hdm : (T - 1) / d * d ≤ T - 1 := Nat.div_mul_le_self (T - 1) d
    have hb1 : (g + 1) * d ≤ T - 1 :=
      le_trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right d hgd) hdm
    have hexp : g * d + 1 + d = (g + 1) * d + 1 := by ring
    obtain ⟨h, hhH, hlo, hhi⟩ := hwin (g * d + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨h, hhH, ?_⟩
    have hdg : d * g ≤ h - 1 := by
      have : g * d = d * g := by ring
      omega
    set r := h - 1 - d * g with hrdef
    have hr1 : h - 1 = d * g + r := by omega
    have hr2 : r < d := by
      have hcomm : g * d = d * g := by ring
      omega
    rw [hr1, Nat.mul_add_div (by omega : 0 < d), Nat.div_eq_of_lt hr2, Nat.add_zero]
  calc T ⌈/⌉ d - 1 = (Finset.range (T ⌈/⌉ d - 1)).card := (Finset.card_range _).symm
    _ ≤ (H.image (fun h => (h - 1) / d)).card := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    _ ≤ H.card := Finset.card_image_le

name: Hunter.ProofsConfinement.ceilDiv_ceilDiv
statement:
theorem ceilDiv_ceilDiv {ℓ b c : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) :
    (ℓ ⌈/⌉ b) ⌈/⌉ c = ℓ ⌈/⌉ (b * c)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ n, (ℓ ⌈/⌉ b) ⌈/⌉ c ≤ n ↔ ℓ ⌈/⌉ (b * c) ≤ n := by
    intro n
    rw [ceilDiv_le_iff_le_mul hc, ceilDiv_le_iff_le_mul hb,
        ceilDiv_le_iff_le_mul (Nat.mul_pos hb hc), Nat.mul_assoc]
  exact le_antisymm ((key _).mpr le_rfl) ((key _).mp le_rfl)

name: Hunter.Proved.prp_3edgebound
statement:
theorem prp_3edgebound {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) :
    edgeCountGe p 3 ≥ p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1)) - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
  set ℓ := p.numVerts with hℓdef
  have hℓ1 : 1 ≤ ℓ := p.numVerts_pos
  set T := ℓ ⌈/⌉ k with hTdef
  have hTexp : T = (ℓ - 1) / k + 1 := by
    have h0k : 0 < k := by omega
    have hc := ceilDiv_succ_pred hℓ1 h0k
    rw [hTdef, hc]
  have hTe : T - 1 = (ℓ - 1) / k := by rw [hTexp, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  have hdml : (ℓ - 1) / k * k ≤ ℓ - 1 := Nat.div_mul_le_self (ℓ - 1) k
  have hkT1 : k * (T - 1) ≤ ℓ - 1 := by
    rw [hTe, Nat.mul_comm]; exact hdml
  set HB : Finset ℕ := (Finset.Icc 1 (T - 1)).filter
    (fun t => 3 ≤ ew k (p.vert (k * t - 1)) (p.vert (k * t))) with hHBdef
  
  have hwin : ∀ a, 1 ≤ a → a + (k - 1) ≤ T → ∃ h ∈ HB, a ≤ h ∧ h ≤ a + (k - 1) - 1 := by
    intro a ha haT
    by_contra hcon
    refine confinement hk hp (t₀ := a - 1) ?_ ?_
    · have hle : k * ((a - 1) + k - 1) ≤ k * (T - 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) (by omega)
      omega
    · intro t ht1 ht2
      have hktpos : 0 < k * t := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)
      have hi1 : k * t - 1 + 1 = k * t := by omega
      have hktlt : k * t < ℓ := by
        have hle : k * t ≤ k * (T - 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) (by omega)
        omega
      have hin : (k * t - 1) + 1 < ℓ := by rw [hi1]; exact hktlt
      have hpe := prp_periodicedges hk1 hp hin
      have hge1 := ew_ge_one hk1 (p.vert (k * t - 1)) (p.vert ((k * t - 1) + 1))
      have hdvd : k ∣ ((k * t - 1) + 1) := by rw [hi1]; exact ⟨t, rfl⟩
      have hne1 : ew k (p.vert (k * t - 1)) (p.vert ((k * t - 1) + 1)) ≠ 1 :=
        fun he => (hpe.mp he) hdvd
      rw [hi1] at hge1 hne1
      have hn3 : ¬ 3 ≤ ew k (p.vert (k * t - 1)) (p.vert (k * t)) := by
        intro h3
        apply hcon
        refine ⟨t, ?_, by omega, by omega⟩
        rw [hHBdef, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc]
        exact ⟨⟨by omega, by omega⟩, h3⟩
      omega
  
  have hcard : HB.card = edgeCountGe p 3 := by
    rw [edgeCountGe, ← hℓdef]
    apply Finset.card_nbij' (fun t => k * t - 1) (fun i => (i + 1) / k)
    · intro t ht
      simp only [Finset.mem_coe, hHBdef, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc] at ht
      obtain ⟨⟨ht1, ht2⟩, ht3⟩ := ht
      have hktp : 1 ≤ k * t := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)
      have hi1 : k * t - 1 + 1 = k * t := by omega
      have hktle : k * t ≤ ℓ - 1 := le_trans (Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) ht2) hkT1
      show k * t - 1 ∈ (Finset.range (ℓ - 1)).filter
        (fun i => 3 ≤ ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)))
      rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
      refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
      rw [hi1]; exact ht3
    · intro i hi
      simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at hi
      obtain ⟨hilt, hi3⟩ := hi
      have hin : i + 1 < ℓ := by omega
      have hkdvd : k ∣ (i + 1) := by
        by_contra hnd
        have := (prp_periodicedges hk1 hp hin).mpr hnd
        omega
      have hkt : k * ((i + 1) / k) = i + 1 := Nat.mul_div_cancel' hkdvd
      have hkt1 : k * ((i + 1) / k) - 1 = i := by rw [hkt, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
      have htle : (i + 1) / k ≤ T - 1 := by
        rw [hTe]
        apply Nat.div_le_div_right; omega
      have htpos : 1 ≤ (i + 1) / k := by
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos ((i + 1) / k) with h0 | h1
        · rw [h0, Nat.mul_zero] at hkt; omega
        · exact h1
      show (i + 1) / k ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 (T - 1)).filter
        (fun t => 3 ≤ ew k (p.vert (k * t - 1)) (p.vert (k * t)))
      rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc]
      refine ⟨⟨htpos, htle⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [hkt1, hkt]; exact hi3
    · intro t ht
      simp only [Finset.mem_coe, hHBdef, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc] at ht
      have hktp : 1 ≤ k * t := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)
      have hi1 : k * t - 1 + 1 = k * t := by omega
      show (k * t - 1 + 1) / k = t
      rw [hi1, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ (by omega : 0 < k)]
    · intro i hi
      simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at hi
      obtain ⟨hilt, hi3⟩ := hi
      have hin : i + 1 < ℓ := by omega
      have hkdvd : k ∣ (i + 1) := by
        by_contra hnd
        have := (prp_periodicedges hk1 hp hin).mpr hnd
        omega
      have hkt : k * ((i + 1) / k) = i + 1 := Nat.mul_div_cancel' hkdvd
      show k * ((i + 1) / k) - 1 = i
      rw [hkt, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  
  have hcov := cover_bound (d := k - 1) (T := T) (by omega) HB hwin
  have hnest : T ⌈/⌉ (k - 1) = ℓ ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1)) := by
    rw [hTdef]; exact ceilDiv_ceilDiv (by omega) (by omega)
  rw [hcard, hnest] at hcov
  exact hcov

name: Hunter.Proved.thm2_base_unconditional
statement:
theorem thm2_base_unconditional {k ℓ : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hℓ0 : 0 < ℓ)
    (hℓ : ℓ ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) (hex : HasExitlessPath k ℓ) :
    j k ℓ ≤ iExitless k ℓ
proof:
:=
  thm2_base hk hℓ0 hℓ hex (fun q hq => prp_3edgebound (by omega) hq)

name: Hunter.ProofsQED.thm2_final
statement:
theorem thm2_final (h : TheResidual) :
    ∀ k ℓ, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k ℓ → j k ℓ ≤ iExitless k ℓ
proof:
:=
  ProofsEndgame.thm2_of_tightJumpFreeAll h

name: Hunter.ProofsQED.thm1v1_final
statement:
theorem thm1v1_final (h : TheResidual)
    (hproof : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) →
        (L k : ℝ) ≥ (iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ)
          + (((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
              (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)))
            * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ))) :
    ∃ (C : ℝ) (k₀ : ℕ), ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k →
      (Lstar k : ℝ) ≥ coeff k * (k.factorial : ℝ) + (k : ℝ) - C
proof:
:=
  ProofsEndgame.thm1v1_of_tightJumpFreeAll h hproof

name: Hunter.ProofsQED.thm1v2_final
statement:
theorem thm1v2_final (h : TheResidual)
    (hproof : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) →
        (L k : ℝ) ≥ (iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ)
          + (((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
              (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)))
            * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ))) :
    ∃ (C : ℝ) (k₀ : ℕ), ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k → (L k : ℝ) ≥ coeff k * (k.factorial : ℝ) - C
proof:
:=
  ProofsEndgame.thm1v2_of_blockCeilAll
    (ProofsEndgame.excessBlockCeilAll_of_tightJumpFreeAll h) hproof

name: Hunter.ProofsQED.eq_weak_final
statement:
theorem eq_weak_final (h : TheResidual)
    (hproof : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) →
        (L k : ℝ) ≥ (iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ)
          + (((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
              (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)))
            * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ))) :
    ∃ (C : ℝ) (k₀ : ℕ), ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k →
      (Lstar k : ℝ) ≥ (k.factorial : ℝ) + ((k - 1).factorial : ℝ) + ((k - 2).factorial : ℝ)
