        + ((k - 4).factorial : ℝ) - 2 * ((k - 5).factorial : ℝ) - C * ((k - 6).factorial : ℝ)
proof:
:=
  ProofsEndgame.eq_weak_of_blockCeilAll
    (ProofsEndgame.excessBlockCeilAll_of_tightJumpFreeAll h) hproof

name: Hunter.ProofsQED.excessBlockCeilAll_of_residual
statement: theorem excessBlockCeilAll_of_residual (h : TheResidual) : ProofsEndgame.ExcessBlockCeilAll
proof:
:=
  ProofsEndgame.excessBlockCeilAll_of_tightJumpFreeAll h

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger2.runStart_le
statement: theorem runStart_le (p : HPath k) (t : ℕ) : runStart p t ≤ t
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => simp [runStart_zero]
  | succ t ih =>
    by_cases h : IsMetaHeavy p (t + 1)
    · rw [runStart_metaHeavy h]
    · rw [runStart_not_metaHeavy h]; omega

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger2.runLen_eq
statement:
theorem runLen_eq (hk : 3 ≤ k) (p : HPath k) (t : ℕ) :
    runStart p t + metaDepth p t * (k - 1) + doorDepth p t = t
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => simp [runStart_zero, metaDepth_zero]
  | succ t ih =>
    by_cases hdoor : IsDoor p (t + 1)
    · 
      have hnmh : ¬ IsMetaHeavy p (t + 1) := fun hmh => hmh.1 hdoor
      rw [doorDepth_door hdoor, metaDepth_door hdoor, runStart_not_metaHeavy hnmh]
      omega
    · by_cases hac : IsAlpha p (t + 1) ∧ IsComplete p t
      · 
        have hnmh : ¬ IsMetaHeavy p (t + 1) := fun hmh => hmh.2 hac
        have hcomp : doorDepth p t = k - 2 := hac.2
        have hdd : doorDepth p (t + 1) = 0 := doorDepth_not_door hdoor
        have hmd : metaDepth p (t + 1) = metaDepth p t + 1 :=
          metaDepth_alpha_complete hac.1 hac.2
        have hrs : runStart p (t + 1) = runStart p t := runStart_not_metaHeavy hnmh
        rw [hdd, hmd, hrs]
        have hexp : (metaDepth p t + 1) * (k - 1) = metaDepth p t * (k - 1) + (k - 1) := by ring
        rw [hexp]
        
        have hk1 : k - 1 = (k - 2) + 1 := by omega
        rw [hcomp] at ih
        omega
      · 
        have hmh : IsMetaHeavy p (t + 1) := ⟨hdoor, hac⟩
        rw [doorDepth_not_door hdoor, metaDepth_metaHeavy hmh, runStart_metaHeavy hmh]
        simp

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger2.doorDepth_le_km2
statement:
theorem doorDepth_le_km2 (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) (t : ℕ)
    (hN : k * t < p.numVerts) : doorDepth p t ≤ k - 2
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcon           
  have hdle := doorDepth_le p t
  have htk1 : k - 1 ≤ t := by omega
  refine confinement (by omega : 2 ≤ k) hp (t₀ := t - (k - 1)) ?_ ?_
  · 
    have : (t - (k - 1)) + k - 1 = t := by omega
    rw [this]; exact hN
  · intro s hs1 hs2
    
    have hjlt : t - s < doorDepth p t := by omega
    have hdr := isDoor_of_lt_doorDepth p t (t - s) hjlt
    have hidx : t - (t - s) = s := by omega
    rw [hidx, IsDoor, bw] at hdr
    exact hdr

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger2.runStart_const
statement:
theorem runStart_const (p : HPath k) (u₀ : ℕ) :
    ∀ e, (∀ s, u₀ < s → s ≤ u₀ + e → ¬ IsMetaHeavy p s) → runStart p (u₀ + e) = runStart p u₀
proof:
:= by
  intro e
  induction e with
  | zero => intro _; rfl
  | succ e ih =>
    intro hno
    have hnmh : ¬ IsMetaHeavy p (u₀ + (e + 1)) := hno (u₀ + (e + 1)) (by omega) (by omega)
    have hstep : runStart p (u₀ + (e + 1)) = runStart p (u₀ + e) := by
      have he : u₀ + (e + 1) = (u₀ + e) + 1 := by omega
      rw [he, runStart_not_metaHeavy (by rw [← he]; exact hnmh)]
    rw [hstep]
    exact ih (fun s hs1 hs2 => hno s hs1 (by omega))

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger2.metaHeavy_count_ge
statement:
theorem metaHeavy_count_ge (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless)
    (hmd : ∀ t, k * t < p.numVerts → metaDepth p t ≤ k - 2)
    (a M : ℕ) (hM : k * (a + M) < p.numVerts) :
    M ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 2) + 1) - 1 ≤ metaHeavyCount p a M
proof:
:= by
  unfold metaHeavyCount
  refine cover_bound (d := k * (k - 2) + 1) (T := M) (by omega) _ ?_
  intro b hb1 hbd
  by_contra hcon
  
  have hno : ∀ s, a + b ≤ s → s ≤ a + (b + (k * (k - 2) + 1) - 1) → ¬ IsMetaHeavy p s := by
    intro s hs1 hs2 hmh
    refine hcon ⟨s - a, ?_, by omega, by omega⟩
    rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc]
    refine ⟨⟨by omega, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
    have hsa : a + (s - a) = s := by omega
    rw [hsa]; exact hmh
  set t := a + (b + (k * (k - 2) + 1) - 1) with ht
  
  have htrange : k * t < p.numVerts := by
    have htlt : t + 1 ≤ a + M := by omega
    have hkey : k * t + k ≤ k * (a + M) := by
      calc k * t + k = k * (t + 1) := by ring
        _ ≤ k * (a + M) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) htlt
    omega
  have hmdt : metaDepth p t ≤ k - 2 := hmd t htrange
  have hddt : doorDepth p t ≤ k - 2 := doorDepth_le_km2 hk hp t htrange
  
  have hrs : runStart p t = runStart p (a + b - 1) := by
    rw [ht, show a + (b + (k * (k - 2) + 1) - 1) = (a + b - 1) + (k * (k - 2) + 1) from by omega]
    exact runStart_const p (a + b - 1) (k * (k - 2) + 1)
      (fun s hs1 hs2 => hno s (by omega) (by omega))
  have hrsle : runStart p (a + b - 1) ≤ a + b - 1 := runStart_le p (a + b - 1)
  
  have hlen := runLen_eq hk p t
  have hmul : metaDepth p t * (k - 1) ≤ (k - 2) * (k - 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hmdt
  have hQ1 : (k - 2) * (k - 1) + (k - 2) = k * (k - 2) := by
    have hk1 : (k - 1) + 1 = k := by omega
    calc (k - 2) * (k - 1) + (k - 2) = (k - 2) * ((k - 1) + 1) := by ring
      _ = (k - 2) * k := by rw [hk1]
      _ = k * (k - 2) := by ring
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger2.metaHeavy_imp_weight3
statement:
theorem metaHeavy_imp_weight3 (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) {t : ℕ}
    (ht : 1 ≤ t) (hN : k * t < p.numVerts) (h : IsMetaHeavy p t) : 3 ≤ bw p t
proof:
:= by
  have hkt : 1 ≤ k * t := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 (by positivity)
  have hi1 : k * t - 1 + 1 = k * t := by omega
  have hin : (k * t - 1) + 1 < p.numVerts := by rw [hi1]; exact hN
  have hd : k ∣ ((k * t - 1) + 1) := by rw [hi1]; exact ⟨t, rfl⟩
  have hge2 := ProofsWindow.boundary_ge_two (by omega : 1 ≤ k) hp hin hd
  rw [hi1] at hge2
  have hnd := h.1
  rw [IsDoor, bw] at hnd
  rw [bw]; omega

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger2.metaHeavyCount_le_weight3
statement:
theorem metaHeavyCount_le_weight3 (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless)
    (a M : ℕ) (hM : k * (a + M) < p.numVerts) :
    metaHeavyCount p a M ≤
      ((Finset.Icc 1 M).filter
        (fun j => 3 ≤ ew k (p.vert (k * (a + j) - 1)) (p.vert (k * (a + j))))).card
proof:
:= by
  unfold metaHeavyCount
  apply Finset.card_le_card
  intro j hj
  rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc] at hj ⊢
  obtain ⟨⟨hj1, hjM⟩, hmh⟩ := hj
  refine ⟨⟨hj1, hjM⟩, ?_⟩
  have hN' : k * (a + j) < p.numVerts := by
    have : k * (a + j) ≤ k * (a + M) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) (by omega)
    omega
  have hw := metaHeavy_imp_weight3 hk hp (by omega : 1 ≤ a + j) hN' hmh
  rw [bw] at hw; exact hw

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger2.dCount_le
statement: theorem dCount_le (p : HPath k) (a e : ℕ) : dCount p a e ≤ e
proof:
:= by
  induction e with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ e ih => rw [dCount]; split <;> omega

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger2.doorTele
statement:
theorem doorTele (p : HPath k) (a e : ℕ) :
    doorDepth p a + dCount p a e = doorDepth p (a + e) + rSum p a e
proof:
:= by
  induction e with
  | zero => simp [dCount, rSum]
  | succ e ih =>
    by_cases h : IsDoor p (a + (e + 1))
    · have hdd : doorDepth p (a + (e + 1)) = doorDepth p (a + e) + 1 := doorDepth_door h
      rw [dCount, rSum, if_pos h, if_pos h, hdd]; omega
    · have hdd : doorDepth p (a + (e + 1)) = 0 := doorDepth_not_door h
      rw [dCount, rSum, if_neg h, if_neg h, hdd]; omega

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger2.rSum_le
statement:
theorem rSum_le (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) (a M : ℕ)
    (hM : k * (a + M) < p.numVerts) :
    ∀ e, e ≤ M → rSum p a e ≤ (e - dCount p a e) * (k - 2)
proof:
:= by
  intro e
  induction e with
  | zero => intro _; simp [rSum, dCount]
  | succ e ih =>
    intro heM
    have ihe := ih (by omega)
    have hdle := dCount_le p a e
    by_cases h : IsDoor p (a + (e + 1))
    · rw [rSum, dCount, if_pos h, if_pos h]
      have hR : ((e + 1) - (dCount p a e + 1)) * (k - 2) = (e - dCount p a e) * (k - 2) := by
        congr 1; omega
      omega
    · rw [rSum, dCount, if_neg h, if_neg h]
      simp only [Nat.add_zero]
      have hrange : k * (a + e) < p.numVerts := by
        have : k * (a + e) ≤ k * (a + M) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) (by omega)
        omega
      have hdd : doorDepth p (a + e) ≤ k - 2 := doorDepth_le_km2 hk hp (a + e) hrange
      have hR : ((e + 1) - dCount p a e) * (k - 2)
          = (e - dCount p a e) * (k - 2) + (k - 2) := by
        rw [show (e + 1) - dCount p a e = (e - dCount p a e) + 1 from by omega]; ring
      omega

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger2.rSum_le_strong
statement:
theorem rSum_le_strong (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) (a M : ℕ)
    (hM : k * (a + M) < p.numVerts) :
    ∀ e, e ≤ M → (∃ s, 1 ≤ s ∧ s ≤ e ∧ ¬ IsDoor p (a + s) ∧ doorDepth p (a + s - 1) ≤ k - 3) →
      rSum p a e + 1 ≤ (e - dCount p a e) * (k - 2)
proof:
:= by
  intro e
  induction e with
  | zero => intro _ ⟨s, hs1, hs2, _⟩; omega
  | succ e ih =>
    intro heM ⟨s, hs1, hs2, hsnd, hsinc⟩
    have hdle := dCount_le p a e
    have hrange : k * (a + e) < p.numVerts := by
      have : k * (a + e) ≤ k * (a + M) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) (by omega)
      omega
    have hdd : doorDepth p (a + e) ≤ k - 2 := doorDepth_le_km2 hk hp (a + e) hrange
    by_cases h : IsDoor p (a + (e + 1))
    · 
      have hsle : s ≤ e := by
        rcases hs2.lt_or_eq with hlt | heq
        · omega
        · rw [heq] at hsnd; exact absurd h hsnd
      have ihe := ih (by omega) ⟨s, hs1, hsle, hsnd, hsinc⟩
      rw [rSum, dCount, if_pos h, if_pos h]
      have hR : ((e + 1) - (dCount p a e + 1)) * (k - 2) = (e - dCount p a e) * (k - 2) := by
        congr 1; omega
      omega
    · rw [rSum, dCount, if_neg h, if_neg h]
      simp only [Nat.add_zero]
      have hR : ((e + 1) - dCount p a e) * (k - 2)
          = (e - dCount p a e) * (k - 2) + (k - 2) := by
        rw [show (e + 1) - dCount p a e = (e - dCount p a e) + 1 from by omega]; ring
      by_cases hs_top : s = e + 1
      · 
        have hplain := rSum_le hk hp a M hM e (by omega)
        have hddinc : doorDepth p (a + e) ≤ k - 3 := by
          have hidx : a + s - 1 = a + e := by omega
          rw [hidx] at hsinc; exact hsinc
        omega
      · 
        have ihe := ih (by omega) ⟨s, hs1, by omega, hsnd, hsinc⟩
        omega

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger2.dCount_eq_card
statement:
theorem dCount_eq_card (p : HPath k) (a e : ℕ) :
    dCount p a e = ((Finset.Icc 1 e).filter (fun j => IsDoor p (a + j))).card
proof:
:= by
  induction e with
  | zero => simp [dCount]
  | succ e ih =>
    rw [Finset.card_filter, Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega : (1 : ℕ) ≤ e + 1),
        ← Finset.card_filter, dCount, ih]

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger2.window_incomplete_slack
statement:
theorem window_incomplete_slack (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) (a : ℕ)
    (hM : k * (a + ((k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1)) < p.numVerts)
    (s₀ : ℕ) (hs01 : 1 ≤ s₀) (hs02 : s₀ ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1)
    (hnd : ¬ IsDoor p (a + s₀)) (hinc : doorDepth p (a + s₀ - 1) ≤ k - 3) :
    k - 2 ≤ ((Finset.Icc 1 ((k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1)).filter
        (fun j => 3 ≤ ew k (p.vert (k * (a + j) - 1)) (p.vert (k * (a + j))))).card
proof:
:= by
  set M := (k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1 with hMdef
  
  set W := M - dCount p a M with hWdef
  have hdle := dCount_le p a M
  
  have htele := doorTele p a M
  have hstrong := rSum_le_strong hk hp a M hM M (le_refl M) ⟨s₀, hs01, hs02, hnd, hinc⟩
  rw [← hWdef] at hstrong                       
  have hfin : doorDepth p (a + M) ≤ k - 2 := doorDepth_le_km2 hk hp (a + M) hM
  
  have hWk : k - 2 ≤ W := by
    have hdc : dCount p a M + W = M := by omega
    have hWid : W * (k - 2) + W = W * (k - 1) := by
      rw [show k - 1 = (k - 2) + 1 from by omega]; ring
    
    have hchain : M ≤ W * (k - 1) + (k - 3) := by omega
    
    have hprodpos : 1 ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by
      calc 1 = 1 * 1 := by ring
        _ ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2) := Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (by omega)
    have hM1 : M + 1 = (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by rw [hMdef]; omega
    
    have hAid : (k - 1) * (k - 2) = (k - 3) * (k - 1) + (k - 1) := by
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, k - 3 = m := ⟨k - 3, rfl⟩
      have e1 : k - 1 = m + 2 := by omega
      have e2 : k - 2 = m + 1 := by omega
      rw [e1, e2, hm]; ring
    by_contra hlt
    have hWle : W ≤ k - 3 := by omega
    have hWmul : W * (k - 1) ≤ (k - 3) * (k - 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hWle
    omega
  
  have hWcard : W = ((Finset.Icc 1 M).filter (fun j => ¬ IsDoor p (a + j))).card := by
    have hdcard := dCount_eq_card p a M
    have hpart : ((Finset.Icc 1 M).filter (fun j => IsDoor p (a + j))).card
        + ((Finset.Icc 1 M).filter (fun j => ¬ IsDoor p (a + j))).card = M := by
      rw [Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not, Nat.card_Icc]; omega
    rw [hWdef, hdcard]; omega
  rw [hWcard] at hWk
  refine le_trans hWk (Finset.card_le_card ?_)
  intro j hj
  rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc] at hj ⊢
  obtain ⟨⟨hj1, hjM⟩, hjnd⟩ := hj
  refine ⟨⟨hj1, hjM⟩, ?_⟩
  have hN' : k * (a + j) < p.numVerts := by
    have : k * (a + j) ≤ k * (a + M) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) (by omega)
    omega
  have hkt : 1 ≤ k * (a + j) := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 (by positivity)
  have hi1 : k * (a + j) - 1 + 1 = k * (a + j) := by omega
  have hin : (k * (a + j) - 1) + 1 < p.numVerts := by rw [hi1]; exact hN'
  have hd : k ∣ ((k * (a + j) - 1) + 1) := by rw [hi1]; exact ⟨a + j, rfl⟩
  have hge2 := ProofsWindow.boundary_ge_two (by omega : 1 ≤ k) hp hin hd
  rw [hi1] at hge2
  rw [IsDoor, bw] at hjnd
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy2.marker_last_getElem
statement:
theorem marker_last_getElem (S : List ℕ) (M : ℕ) {r : ℕ} (hr : r ≤ S.length) :
    ((S ++ [M]).rotate r)[S.length - r]? = some M
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : (S ++ [M]).length = S.length + 1 := by simp
  rw [List.getElem?_rotate (l := S ++ [M]) (n := r) (m := S.length - r) (by rw [hlen]; omega),
    hlen,
    show (S.length - r + r) % (S.length + 1) = S.length from by
      rw [show S.length - r + r = S.length from by omega]; exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega),
    List.getElem?_append_right (by omega), show S.length - S.length = 0 from by omega]
  rfl

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy2.marker_pins
statement:
theorem marker_pins {S₁ S₂ : List ℕ} {M a b : ℕ}
    (hnd : (S₁ ++ [M]).Nodup) (hlen : S₁.length = S₂.length)
    (ha : a ≤ S₁.length) (hb : b ≤ S₂.length)
    (h : (S₁ ++ [M]).rotate a = (S₂ ++ [M]).rotate b) : a = b ∧ S₁ = S₂
proof:
:= by
  set W := (S₁ ++ [M]).rotate a with hW
  have hWnd : W.Nodup := (List.rotate_perm (S₁ ++ [M]) a).nodup_iff.mpr hnd
  have hWlen : W.length = S₁.length + 1 := by rw [hW, List.length_rotate]; simp
  have gi : W[S₁.length - a]? = some M := marker_last_getElem S₁ M ha
  have gj : W[S₂.length - b]? = some M := by rw [h]; exact marker_last_getElem S₂ M hb
  have hia : S₁.length - a < W.length := by rw [hWlen]; omega
  have hib : S₂.length - b < W.length := by rw [hWlen, ← hlen]; omega
  have gi' : W[S₁.length - a] = M := by
    have := gi; rwa [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hia, Option.some_inj] at this
  have gj' : W[S₂.length - b] = M := by
    have := gj; rwa [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hib, Option.some_inj] at this
  have hidx : S₁.length - a = S₂.length - b := (hWnd.getElem_inj_iff).mp (gi'.trans gj'.symm)
  have hab : a = b := by rw [hlen] at ha; omega
  refine ⟨hab, ?_⟩
  have hfull : S₁ ++ [M] = S₂ ++ [M] := by
    apply List.rotate_injective a
    rw [← hab] at h; exact h
  exact List.append_cancel_right hfull

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy2.LW_isPermWord
statement: theorem LW_isPermWord (hk : 2 ≤ k) (L : ℕ) : IsPermWord (k - 1) (LW k L)
proof:
:=
  ProofsGreedy.baseW_isPermWord (k := k - 1) (by omega) L

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy2.snoc_marker_isPermWord
statement:
theorem snoc_marker_isPermWord (hk : 1 ≤ k) {S : List ℕ} (hS : IsPermWord (k - 1) S) :
    IsPermWord k (S ++ [k])
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [List.nodup_append]
    refine ⟨hS.nodup, List.nodup_singleton k, ?_⟩
    intro a ha b hb
    rw [List.mem_singleton] at hb
    have hmem : a ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (k - 1) := by
      rw [← hS.toFinset_eq]; exact List.mem_toFinset.mpr ha
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hmem; omega
  · rw [List.toFinset_append, hS.toFinset_eq]
    ext x
    simp only [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_Icc, List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_singleton]
    omega

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy2.SWord_isPermWord
statement: theorem SWord_isPermWord (hk : 2 ≤ k) (Q : ℕ) : IsPermWord (k - 1) (SWord k Q)
proof:
:=
  isPermWord_rotate (LW_isPermWord hk _) _

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy2.SWord_length
statement: theorem SWord_length (hk : 2 ≤ k) (Q : ℕ) : (SWord k Q).length = k - 1
proof:
:=
  (SWord_isPermWord hk Q).length

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy2.cVword_isPermWord
statement: theorem cVword_isPermWord (hk : 3 ≤ k) (Q : ℕ) : IsPermWord k (SWord k Q ++ [k])
proof:
:=
  snoc_marker_isPermWord (by omega) (SWord_isPermWord (by omega) Q)

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy2.cV_val
statement: @[simp] theorem cV_val (hk : 3 ≤ k) (Q : ℕ) : (cV k hk Q : List ℕ) = SWord k Q ++ [k]
proof: := rfl

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy2.gV2_val
statement:
theorem gV2_val (hk : 3 ≤ k) (i : ℕ) :
    (gV2 k hk i : List ℕ) = (SWord k (i / k) ++ [k]).rotate (i % k)
proof:
:= by
  unfold gV2; rw [sigma_iter_val, cV_val]

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy2.loop_lt
statement:
theorem loop_lt (hk : 3 ≤ k) {ℓ i : ℕ} (hℓ : ℓ ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) (hi : i < ℓ) :
    i / (k * (k - 1)) < k - 2
proof:
:= by
  apply (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega))).mpr
  have hassoc : (k - 2) * (k * (k - 1)) = k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by ring
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy2.gV2_inj
proof:
:= by
  have hkpos : 0 < k := by omega
  have hril : i % k < k := Nat.mod_lt i hkpos
  have hrjl : j % k < k := Nat.mod_lt j hkpos
  have hw : (gV2 k hk i : List ℕ) = (gV2 k hk j : List ℕ) := by rw [h]
  rw [gV2_val, gV2_val] at hw
  
  have hnd1 : (SWord k (i / k) ++ [k]).Nodup := (cVword_isPermWord hk (i / k)).nodup
  have hlen1 : (SWord k (i / k)).length = (SWord k (j / k)).length := by
    rw [SWord_length (by omega) (i / k), SWord_length (by omega) (j / k)]
  have hai : i % k ≤ (SWord k (i / k)).length := by
    rw [SWord_length (by omega) (i / k)]; omega
  have haj : j % k ≤ (SWord k (j / k)).length := by
    rw [SWord_length (by omega) (j / k)]; omega
  obtain ⟨hr_eq, hS⟩ := marker_pins hnd1 hlen1 hai haj hw
  
  rw [SWord, SWord, LW, LW] at hS
  have hnd2 : ((ProofsGreedy.W0 (k - 1)).rotate (i / k / (k - 1)) ++ [k - 1]).Nodup :=
    (LW_isPermWord (by omega) (i / k / (k - 1))).nodup
  have hlen2 : ((ProofsGreedy.W0 (k - 1)).rotate (i / k / (k - 1))).length
      = ((ProofsGreedy.W0 (k - 1)).rotate (j / k / (k - 1))).length := by
    rw [List.length_rotate, List.length_rotate]
  have hci : i / k % (k - 1) ≤ ((ProofsGreedy.W0 (k - 1)).rotate (i / k / (k - 1))).length := by
    rw [List.length_rotate, ProofsGreedy.W0_length]
    have := Nat.mod_lt (i / k) (show 0 < k - 1 by omega); omega
  have hcj : j / k % (k - 1) ≤ ((ProofsGreedy.W0 (k - 1)).rotate (j / k / (k - 1))).length := by
    rw [List.length_rotate, ProofsGreedy.W0_length]
    have := Nat.mod_lt (j / k) (show 0 < k - 1 by omega); omega
  obtain ⟨hc_eq, hU⟩ := marker_pins hnd2 hlen2 hci hcj hS
  
  have hLi : i / k / (k - 1) = i / (k * (k - 1)) := Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul i k (k - 1)
  have hLj : j / k / (k - 1) = j / (k * (k - 1)) := Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul j k (k - 1)
  have hL_eq : i / k / (k - 1) = j / k / (k - 1) := by
    apply rotate_injOn_lt (ProofsGreedy.W0_nodup (k - 1))
      (by rw [ProofsGreedy.W0_length]; omega) (by rw [ProofsGreedy.W0_length]; omega) hU
  
  have hQ : i / k = j / k := by
    have e3i := Nat.div_add_mod (i / k) (k - 1)
    have e3j := Nat.div_add_mod (j / k) (k - 1)
    rw [hL_eq, hc_eq] at e3i
    omega
  have hkQ : k * (i / k) = k * (j / k) := by rw [hQ]
  have hi := Nat.div_add_mod i k
  have hj := Nat.div_add_mod j k
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy2.gV2_succ_within
statement:
theorem gV2_succ_within (hk : 3 ≤ k) {i : ℕ} (h : i % k < k - 1) :
    gV2 k hk (i + 1) = sigma (gV2 k hk i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hd, hm⟩ := ProofsGreedy.step_within (show 1 ≤ k by omega) h
  unfold gV2; rw [hd, hm, Function.iterate_succ_apply']

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy2.gV2_boundary_sigma
statement:
theorem gV2_boundary_sigma (hk : 3 ≤ k) {i : ℕ} (h : i % k = k - 1) :
    sigma (gV2 k hk i) = gV2 k hk (k * (i / k))
proof:
:= by
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
  have hrhs : gV2 k hk (k * (i / k)) = cV k hk (i / k) := by
    unfold gV2
    rw [Nat.mul_mod_right, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hk1, Function.iterate_zero_apply]
  rw [hrhs]
  have hlhs : sigma (gV2 k hk i) = sigma^[i % k + 1] (cV k hk (i / k)) := by
    unfold gV2; exact (Function.iterate_succ_apply' sigma (i % k) _).symm
  rw [hlhs, show i % k + 1 = k from by omega, sigma_iter_period]

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy2.gV2_boundary_word_i
statement:
theorem gV2_boundary_word_i (hk : 3 ≤ k) {i : ℕ} (h : i % k = k - 1) :
    (gV2 k hk i : List ℕ) = k :: SWord k (i / k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gV2_val, h, show k - 1 = (SWord k (i / k)).length from (SWord_length (by omega) _).symm,
    ProofsGreedy.rot_snoc]

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy2.gV2_boundary_word_succ
statement:
theorem gV2_boundary_word_succ (hk : 3 ≤ k) {i : ℕ} (h : i % k = k - 1) :
    (gV2 k hk (i + 1) : List ℕ) = SWord k (i / k + 1) ++ [k]
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hd, hm⟩ := ProofsGreedy.step_boundary (show 1 ≤ k by omega) h
  rw [gV2_val, hd, hm, List.rotate_zero]

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy2.SWord_succ_cycle
statement:
theorem SWord_succ_cycle (hk : 3 ≤ k) {Q : ℕ} (hc : Q % (k - 1) < k - 2) :
    SWord k (Q + 1) = (SWord k Q).rotate 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hd, hm⟩ := ProofsGreedy.step_within (k := k - 1) (show (1 : ℕ) ≤ k - 1 by omega)
    (i := Q) (show Q % (k - 1) < (k - 1) - 1 by omega)
  rw [SWord, SWord, hd, hm, List.rotate_rotate]

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy2.SWord_loop
statement:
theorem SWord_loop (hk : 3 ≤ k) {Q : ℕ} (hc : Q % (k - 1) = k - 2) :
    SWord k (Q + 1) = LW k (Q / (k - 1) + 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hd, hm⟩ := ProofsGreedy.step_boundary (k := k - 1) (show (1 : ℕ) ≤ k - 1 by omega)
    (i := Q) (show Q % (k - 1) = (k - 1) - 1 by omega)
  rw [SWord, hd, hm, List.rotate_zero]

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy2.SWord_loop_src
statement:
theorem SWord_loop_src (hk : 3 ≤ k) {Q : ℕ} (hc : Q % (k - 1) = k - 2) :
    SWord k Q = (k - 1) :: (ProofsGreedy.W0 (k - 1)).rotate (Q / (k - 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [SWord, LW, hc,
    show k - 2 = ((ProofsGreedy.W0 (k - 1)).rotate (Q / (k - 1))).length from by
      rw [List.length_rotate, ProofsGreedy.W0_length]; omega]
  exact ProofsGreedy.rot_snoc _ _

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy2.ew_within_eq_one
statement:
theorem ew_within_eq_one (hk : 3 ≤ k) {i : ℕ} (h : i % k < k - 1) :
    ew k (gV2 k hk i) (gV2 k hk (i + 1)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [gV2_succ_within hk h, ew_sigma (by omega)]

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy2.ew_cycle_le_two
statement:
theorem ew_cycle_le_two (hk : 3 ≤ k) {i : ℕ} (hb : i % k = k - 1)
    (hc : i / k % (k - 1) < k - 2) : ew k (gV2 k hk i) (gV2 k hk (i + 1)) ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h3 : (gV2 k hk i : List ℕ).drop 2 = (gV2 k hk (i + 1) : List ℕ).take (k - 2) := by
    rw [gV2_boundary_word_i hk hb, gV2_boundary_word_succ hk hb, SWord_succ_cycle hk hc]
    set L := SWord k (i / k) with hL
    have hLlen : L.length = k - 1 := by rw [hL, SWord_length (by omega)]
    rw [List.rotate_eq_drop_append_take (l := L) (n := 1) (by rw [hLlen]; omega)]
    have hdrop : (k :: L).drop 2 = L.drop 1 := rfl
    rw [hdrop, List.append_assoc,
      List.take_left' (l₁ := L.drop 1) (by rw [List.length_drop, hLlen]; omega)]
  exact wt_le (by norm_num) (by omega : 2 ≤ k) h3

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy2.ew_loop_le_three
statement:
theorem ew_loop_le_three (hk : 3 ≤ k) {i : ℕ} (hb : i % k = k - 1)
    (hc : i / k % (k - 1) = k - 2) : ew k (gV2 k hk i) (gV2 k hk (i + 1)) ≤ 3
proof:
:= by
  have h3 : (gV2 k hk i : List ℕ).drop 3 = (gV2 k hk (i + 1) : List ℕ).take (k - 3) := by
    rw [gV2_boundary_word_i hk hb, SWord_loop_src hk hc,
      gV2_boundary_word_succ hk hb, SWord_loop hk hc, LW]
    set R := (ProofsGreedy.W0 (k - 1)).rotate (i / k / (k - 1)) with hR
    have hRlen : R.length = k - 2 := by rw [hR, List.length_rotate, ProofsGreedy.W0_length]; omega
    have hW01 : (ProofsGreedy.W0 (k - 1)).rotate (i / k / (k - 1) + 1) = R.rotate 1 := by
      rw [hR, List.rotate_rotate]
    rw [hW01, List.rotate_eq_drop_append_take (l := R) (n := 1) (by rw [hRlen]; omega)]
    have hdrop : (k :: (k - 1) :: R).drop 3 = R.drop 1 := rfl
    rw [hdrop, List.append_assoc, List.append_assoc,
      List.take_left' (l₁ := R.drop 1) (by rw [List.length_drop, hRlen]; omega)]
  exact wt_le (by norm_num) (by omega : 3 ≤ k) h3

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy2.mod_mul_add
statement:
theorem mod_mul_add (_hk : 3 ≤ k) (i : ℕ) :
    i % (k * (k - 1)) = k * (i / k % (k - 1)) + i % k
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : i = k * (k - 1) * (i / (k * (k - 1))) + i % (k * (k - 1)) :=
    (Nat.div_add_mod i (k * (k - 1))).symm
  have e2 : i / (k * (k - 1)) = i / k / (k - 1) := (Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul i k (k - 1)).symm
  have e4 : i = k * (i / k) + i % k := (Nat.div_add_mod i k).symm
  have hkQ : k * (i / k) = k * (k - 1) * (i / k / (k - 1)) + k * (i / k % (k - 1)) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← Nat.div_add_mod (i / k) (k - 1)]
    rw [Nat.mul_add, ← Nat.mul_assoc]
  rw [e2] at e1
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy2.loopbdry_mod
statement:
theorem loopbdry_mod (hk : 3 ≤ k) {i : ℕ} (hb : i % k = k - 1) (hc : i / k % (k - 1) = k - 2) :
    i % (k * (k - 1)) = k * (k - 1) - 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [mod_mul_add hk, hb, hc]
  have h1 : k * (k - 1) = k * (k - 2) + k := by
    rw [show k - 1 = (k - 2) + 1 from by omega, Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one]
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy2.edge3_loopbdry
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (i % k) (k - 1) with hlt | hge
  · rw [ew_within_eq_one hk hlt] at h3; omega
  · have hb : i % k = k - 1 := by have := Nat.mod_lt i (show 0 < k by omega); omega
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (i / k % (k - 1)) (k - 2) with hcc | hcc
    · have := ew_cycle_le_two hk hb hcc; omega
    · have hc : i / k % (k - 1) = k - 2 := by
        have := Nat.mod_lt (i / k) (show 0 < k - 1 by omega); omega
      exact ⟨hb, hc⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy2.card_le_of_loopbdry
statement:
theorem card_le_of_loopbdry {m ℓ : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) {F : Finset ℕ}
    (hF : ∀ i ∈ F, i < ℓ - 1 ∧ i % m = m - 1) : F.card ≤ (ℓ - 1) / m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.card_range ((ℓ - 1) / m)]
  apply Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn (fun i => i / m)
  · intro i hi
    simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_range] at hi ⊢
    obtain ⟨hlt, hmod⟩ := hF i hi
    have hdecomp : i = m * (i / m) + (m - 1) := by have := Nat.div_add_mod i m; omega
    have hB : (i / m + 1) * m = m * (i / m) + m := by
      rw [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul, Nat.mul_comm]
    have hle : (i / m + 1) * m ≤ ℓ - 1 := by omega
    have hlt2 : i / m + 1 ≤ (ℓ - 1) / m := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hm).mpr hle
    omega
  · intro i hi i' hi' heq
    simp only [Finset.mem_coe] at hi hi'
    obtain ⟨_, hmod⟩ := hF i hi
    obtain ⟨_, hmod'⟩ := hF i' hi'
    have heq' : i / m = i' / m := heq
    have hdi : i = m * (i / m) + (m - 1) := by have := Nat.div_add_mod i m; omega
    have hdi' : i' = m * (i' / m) + (m - 1) := by have := Nat.div_add_mod i' m; omega
    have hprod : m * (i / m) = m * (i' / m) := by rw [heq']
    omega

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy2.greedyP2_numVerts
statement:
theorem greedyP2_numVerts (hk : 3 ≤ k) {ℓ : ℕ} (hℓ0 : 0 < ℓ) (hℓ : ℓ ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) :
    (greedyP2 k hk ℓ hℓ0 hℓ).numVerts = ℓ
proof:
:= by
  show ((List.range ℓ).map (gV2 k hk)).length = ℓ
  rw [List.length_map, List.length_range]

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy2.greedyP2_vert
statement:
theorem greedyP2_vert (hk : 3 ≤ k) {ℓ : ℕ} (hℓ0 : 0 < ℓ) (hℓ : ℓ ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) {t : ℕ}
    (ht : t < ℓ) : (greedyP2 k hk ℓ hℓ0 hℓ).vert t = gV2 k hk t
proof:
:= by
  rw [vert_getElem _ (by rw [greedyP2_numVerts hk hℓ0 hℓ]; exact ht)]
  show ((List.range ℓ).map (gV2 k hk))[t]'_ = gV2 k hk t
  rw [List.getElem_map, List.getElem_range]

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy2.greedyP2_exitless
statement:
theorem greedyP2_exitless (hk : 3 ≤ k) {ℓ : ℕ} (hℓ0 : 0 < ℓ)
    (hℓ : ℓ ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : (greedyP2 k hk ℓ hℓ0 hℓ).Exitless
proof:
:= by
  set p := greedyP2 k hk ℓ hℓ0 hℓ with hpdef
  have hnum : p.numVerts = ℓ := greedyP2_numVerts hk hℓ0 hℓ
  intro he
  obtain ⟨i, hi1, hi2, hi3⟩ := he
  rw [hnum] at hi1
  have hil : i < ℓ := by omega
  have hi1l : i + 1 < ℓ := hi1
  have hvi : p.vert i = gV2 k hk i := greedyP2_vert hk hℓ0 hℓ hil
  have hvi1 : p.vert (i + 1) = gV2 k hk (i + 1) := greedyP2_vert hk hℓ0 hℓ hi1l
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (i % k) (k - 1) with hlt | hge
  · rw [hvi, hvi1, ew_within_eq_one hk hlt] at hi2
    omega
  · have hb : i % k = k - 1 := by have := Nat.mod_lt i (show 0 < k from by omega); omega
    have hmul : k * (i / k) ≤ i := Nat.mul_div_le i k
    have hml : k * (i / k) < ℓ := by omega
    have hσ : sigma (p.vert i) = p.vert (k * (i / k)) := by
      rw [hvi, gV2_boundary_sigma hk hb, greedyP2_vert hk hℓ0 hℓ hml]
    rw [hσ, pos_vert p (by rw [hnum]; exact hml)] at hi3
    omega

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy2.greedyP2_wtP
statement:
theorem greedyP2_wtP (hk : 3 ≤ k) {ℓ : ℕ} (hℓ0 : 0 < ℓ) (hℓ : ℓ ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) :
    (greedyP2 k hk ℓ hℓ0 hℓ).wtP = j k ℓ
proof:
:= by
  set p := greedyP2 k hk ℓ hℓ0 hℓ with hpdef
  have hnum : p.numVerts = ℓ := greedyP2_numVerts hk hℓ0 hℓ
  have hpe : p.Exitless := greedyP2_exitless hk hℓ0 hℓ
  
  have hle3 : ∀ i, i + 1 < ℓ → ew k (gV2 k hk i) (gV2 k hk (i + 1)) ≤ 3 := by
    intro i _
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (i % k) (k - 1) with hlt | hge
    · rw [ew_within_eq_one hk hlt]; norm_num
    · have hb : i % k = k - 1 := by have := Nat.mod_lt i (show 0 < k from by omega); omega
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (i / k % (k - 1)) (k - 2) with hcc | hcc
      · exact le_trans (ew_cycle_le_two hk hb hcc) (by norm_num)
      · have hc : i / k % (k - 1) = k - 2 := by
          have := Nat.mod_lt (i / k) (show 0 < k - 1 from by omega); omega
        exact ew_loop_le_three hk hb hc
  
  have hr0 : ∀ r, 4 ≤ r → edgeCountGe p r = 0 := by
    intro r hr
    rw [edgeCountGe, Finset.card_eq_zero, Finset.filter_eq_empty_iff]
    intro i hi
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hi
    have hile : i + 1 < ℓ := by rw [hnum] at hi; omega
    rw [greedyP2_vert hk hℓ0 hℓ (by omega : i < ℓ), greedyP2_vert hk hℓ0 hℓ hile]
    have := hle3 i hile
    omega
  
  have hexc : excess p = edgeCountGe p 3 := by
    rw [excess, show Finset.Icc 3 k = insert 3 (Finset.Icc 4 k) from by
          apply Finset.ext; intro q; simp only [Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_insert]; omega,
        Finset.sum_insert (by simp only [Finset.mem_Icc]; omega),
        Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun r hr => hr0 r (by rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hr; omega)),
        Nat.add_zero]
  
  have hD : edgeCountGe p 3 ≤ ℓ ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1)) - 1 := by
    have hmpos : 0 < k * (k - 1) := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)
    have hDeq : ℓ ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1)) - 1 = (ℓ - 1) / (k * (k - 1)) := by
      rw [ceilDiv_succ_pred (by omega : 1 ≤ ℓ) hmpos, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    rw [edgeCountGe, hnum, hDeq]
    apply card_le_of_loopbdry hmpos
    intro i hi
    rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at hi
    obtain ⟨hir, h3⟩ := hi
    have hile : i + 1 < ℓ := by omega
    rw [greedyP2_vert hk hℓ0 hℓ (by omega : i < ℓ), greedyP2_vert hk hℓ0 hℓ hile] at h3
    obtain ⟨hb, hc⟩ := edge3_loopbdry hk h3
    exact ⟨by omega, loopbdry_mod hk hb hc⟩
  
  have hjbeq : j k ℓ = ℓ + (ℓ ⌈/⌉ k) + (ℓ ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1))) - 3 := j_base (Or.inl hℓ)
  have hlow := wtP_ge_jbase hk hpe (by rw [hnum]; exact hℓ0)
  rw [hnum] at hlow
  have hdec := wtP_decompose hk hpe
  rw [hnum, hexc] at hdec
  have hck1 : 1 ≤ ℓ ⌈/⌉ k := by
    rw [ceilDiv_succ_pred (by omega : 1 ≤ ℓ) (by omega : 0 < k)]; exact Nat.le_add_left 1 _
  have hck2 : 1 ≤ ℓ ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1)) := by
    rw [ceilDiv_succ_pred (by omega : 1 ≤ ℓ) (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega))]
    exact Nat.le_add_left 1 _
  omega

name: Hunter.Proved.greedy_g
statement:
theorem greedy_g {k ℓ : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hℓ0 : 0 < ℓ) (hℓ : ℓ ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) :
    ∃ p : HPath k, p.Exitless ∧ p.numVerts = ℓ ∧ p.wtP = j k ℓ
proof:
:=
  ⟨greedyP2 k hk ℓ hℓ0 hℓ, greedyP2_exitless hk hℓ0 hℓ, greedyP2_numVerts hk hℓ0 hℓ,
    greedyP2_wtP hk hℓ0 hℓ⟩

name: Hunter.Proved.thm2_equality_base
statement:
theorem thm2_equality_base {k ℓ : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hℓ0 : 0 < ℓ)
    (hℓ : ℓ ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : iExitless k ℓ = j k ℓ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hpe, hpv, hpw⟩ := greedy_g hk hℓ0 hℓ
  have hle : iExitless k ℓ ≤ j k ℓ := by rw [← hpw]; exact Nat.sInf_le ⟨p, hpe, hpv, rfl⟩
  have hge : j k ℓ ≤ iExitless k ℓ := thm2_base_unconditional hk hℓ0 hℓ ⟨p, hpe, hpv⟩
  omega

name: Hunter.Proved.thm2_equality
statement:
theorem thm2_equality {k ℓ : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hℓ0 : 0 < ℓ)
    (hℓ : ℓ ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) (_hex : HasExitlessPath k ℓ) :
    iExitless k ℓ = j k ℓ
proof:
:=
  thm2_equality_base hk hℓ0 hℓ

name: Hunter.Proved.hasExitlessPath_base
statement:
theorem hasExitlessPath_base {k ℓ : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hℓ0 : 0 < ℓ)
    (hℓ : ℓ ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : HasExitlessPath k ℓ
proof:
:=
  ⟨greedyP2 k hk ℓ hℓ0 hℓ, greedyP2_exitless hk hℓ0 hℓ, greedyP2_numVerts hk hℓ0 hℓ⟩

name: Hunter.Proved.hasExitlessPath_pivot
statement:
theorem hasExitlessPath_pivot (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) :
    HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2))
proof:
:=
  hasExitlessPath_base hk (Nat.mul_pos (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)) (by omega)) (le_refl _)

name: Hunter.ProofsMore.ceil_ell0_k
statement: theorem ceil_ell0_k {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) : (ell0 k) ⌈/⌉ k = k * k - 3 * k + 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, k = m + 3 := ⟨k - 3, by omega⟩
  have hdvd : ell0 (m + 3) = (m + 3) * (m * m + 3 * m + 1) := by
    simp only [ell0]
    rw [show m + 3 - 1 = m + 2 from by omega, show m + 3 - 2 = m + 1 from by omega]
    have h1 : (m + 3) * (m + 2) * (m + 1) = m * m * m + 6 * m * m + 11 * m + 6 := by ring
    have h2 : (m + 3) * (m * m + 3 * m + 1) = m * m * m + 6 * m * m + 10 * m + 3 := by ring
    rw [h1, h2]; omega
  have hkq : (m + 3) * (m + 3) - 3 * (m + 3) + 1 = m * m + 3 * m + 1 := by
    have : (m + 3) * (m + 3) = m * m + 6 * m + 9 := by ring
    omega
  rw [hdvd, hkq]
  exact Hunter.ProofsReductions.cd_exact (m + 3) (m * m + 3 * m + 1) (by omega)

name: Hunter.ProofsMore.ceil_ell0_kk
statement: theorem ceil_ell0_kk {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) : (ell0 k) ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1)) = k - 2
proof:
:= by
  have hd : 0 < k * (k - 1) := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)
  have hkkk : k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) = (k * (k - 1)) * (k - 2) := by ring
  have hell0 : ell0 k = (k * (k - 1)) * (k - 2) - k := by rw [ell0, hkkk]
  rw [Nat.ceilDiv_eq_add_pred_div, hell0]
  set d := k * (k - 1) with hddef
  have hdk : k + 1 ≤ d := by
    rw [hddef]
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, k = m + 3 := ⟨k - 3, by omega⟩
    rw [show m + 3 - 1 = m + 2 from by omega]
    nlinarith [Nat.zero_le m]
  have hdk2 : k ≤ d * (k - 2) :=
    le_trans (by omega) (Nat.mul_le_mul hdk (show 1 ≤ k - 2 by omega))
  have hrw : d * (k - 2) - k + d - 1 = d * (k - 2) + (d - k - 1) := by omega
  rw [hrw, Nat.mul_add_div (by omega : 0 < d), Nat.div_eq_of_lt (by omega : d - k - 1 < d)]
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsMore.j_ell0
statement: theorem j_ell0 {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) : j k (ell0 k) = k ^ 2 * (k - 2) - k - 4
proof:
:= by
  have hbase : ell0 k ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by rw [ell0]; omega
  rw [j_base (Or.inl hbase), ceil_ell0_k hk, ceil_ell0_kk hk]
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, k = m + 3 := ⟨k - 3, by omega⟩
  have hell : ell0 (m + 3) = m * m * m + 6 * (m * m) + 10 * m + 3 := by
    simp only [ell0]
    rw [show m + 3 - 1 = m + 2 from by omega, show m + 3 - 2 = m + 1 from by omega]
    have h1 : (m + 3) * (m + 2) * (m + 1) = m * m * m + 6 * (m * m) + 11 * m + 6 := by ring
    rw [h1]; omega
  have hc1 : (m + 3) * (m + 3) - 3 * (m + 3) + 1 = (m * m) + 3 * m + 1 := by
    have : (m + 3) * (m + 3) = (m * m) + 6 * m + 9 := by ring
    omega
  have hrhs : (m + 3) ^ 2 * (m + 1) = m * m * m + 7 * (m * m) + 15 * m + 9 := by ring
  rw [show m + 3 - 2 = m + 1 from by omega, hell, hc1, hrhs]
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsMore.A_eq_a
statement:
theorem A_eq_a {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) :
    (j k (ell0 k) : ℝ) + 3 = (j k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [j_ell0 hk, Hunter.ProofsReductions.j_pivot hk]
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, k = m + 3 := ⟨k - 3, by omega⟩
  have hL : (m + 3) ^ 2 * (m + 3 - 2) - (m + 3) - 4 = m * m * m + 7 * m * m + 14 * m + 2 := by
    have : (m + 3) ^ 2 * (m + 3 - 2) = m * m * m + 7 * m * m + 15 * m + 9 := by
      rw [show m + 3 - 2 = m + 1 from by omega]; ring
    omega
  have hR : (m + 3) ^ 2 * (m + 3 - 2) - 3 = m * m * m + 7 * m * m + 15 * m + 6 := by
    have : (m + 3) ^ 2 * (m + 3 - 2) = m * m * m + 7 * m * m + 15 * m + 9 := by
      rw [show m + 3 - 2 = m + 1 from by omega]; ring
    omega
  rw [hL, hR]
  push_cast
  ring

name: Hunter.ProofsMore.k_le_pivot
statement: theorem k_le_pivot {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) : k ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, k = m + 3 := ⟨k - 3, by omega⟩
  rw [show m + 3 - 1 = m + 2 from by omega, show m + 3 - 2 = m + 1 from by omega]
  have h : (m + 3) * (m + 2) * (m + 1) = m * m * m + 6 * (m * m) + 11 * m + 6 := by ring
  rw [h]; omega

name: Hunter.ProofsMore.ell0_pos
statement: theorem ell0_pos {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) : 0 < ell0 k
proof:
:= by
  rw [ell0]
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, k = m + 3 := ⟨k - 3, by omega⟩
  rw [show m + 3 - 1 = m + 2 from by omega, show m + 3 - 2 = m + 1 from by omega]
  have h : (m + 3) * (m + 2) * (m + 1) = m * m * m + 6 * (m * m) + 11 * m + 6 := by ring
  rw [h]; omega

name: Hunter.ProofsMore.ell0_add_k
statement: theorem ell0_add_k {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) : ell0 k + k = k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h := k_le_pivot hk; rw [ell0]; omega

name: Hunter.ProofsMore.j_unfold
proof:
:= by
  have hE : 0 < ell0 k := ell0_pos hk
  have hpk : k ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := k_le_pivot hk
  have hpiveq : ell0 k + k = k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := ell0_add_k hk
  induction t generalizing ℓ with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have hsm : (n + 1) * ell0 k = n * ell0 k + ell0 k := by rw [Nat.succ_mul]
    have hsm2 : (n + 1 + 1) * ell0 k = (n + 1) * ell0 k + ell0 k := by rw [Nat.succ_mul]
    
    have hpiv : k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) < ℓ := by
      have hge : ell0 k ≤ (n + 1) * ell0 k := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (by omega)
      omega
    have hcond : ¬ (ℓ ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) ∨ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) - k = 0) := by
      push Not
      refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
      have : k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) - k = ell0 k := by rw [ell0]
      omega
    rw [j_rec hcond]
    
    have hb1 : n * ell0 k + k < ℓ - ell0 k := by omega
    have hb2 : ℓ - ell0 k ≤ (n + 1) * ell0 k + k := by omega
    have hih := ih (ℓ := ℓ - ell0 k) hb1 hb2
    rw [hih]
    have hsub : ℓ - ell0 k - n * ell0 k = ℓ - (n + 1) * ell0 k := by omega
    rw [hsub]
    ring

name: Hunter.ProofsMore.prop2
statement:
theorem prop2 {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) {t ℓ : ℕ} (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (h1 : t * ell0 k + k < ℓ) (h2 : ℓ ≤ (t + 1) * ell0 k + k) :
    ((j k ((t + 1) * ell0 k + k) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
        ((((t + 1) * ell0 k + k : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ))
      ≤ ((j k ℓ : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) / ((ℓ : ℝ) - (k : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hE : 0 < ell0 k := ell0_pos hk
  have hsm : (t + 1) * ell0 k = t * ell0 k + ell0 k := by rw [Nat.succ_mul]
  have hpiveq : ell0 k + k = k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := ell0_add_k hk
  
  have hℓ'lb : k < ℓ - t * ell0 k := by omega
  have hℓ'ub : ℓ - t * ell0 k ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by omega
  have hℓeq : ℓ = (ℓ - t * ell0 k) + t * ell0 k := by omega
  
  have hjℓ : j k ℓ = t * (j k (ell0 k) + 3) + j k (ℓ - t * ell0 k) := j_unfold hk t h1 h2
  have hR1 : t * ell0 k + k < (t + 1) * ell0 k + k := by omega
  have hjR : j k ((t + 1) * ell0 k + k)
      = t * (j k (ell0 k) + 3) + j k ((t + 1) * ell0 k + k - t * ell0 k) :=
    j_unfold hk t hR1 (le_refl _)
  have hRsub : (t + 1) * ell0 k + k - t * ell0 k = k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by omega
  rw [hRsub] at hjR
  
  have hEpos : (0 : ℝ) < (ell0 k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hE
  have hcpos : (0 : ℝ) < ((ℓ - t * ell0 k : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) := by
    have : (k : ℝ) < ((ℓ - t * ell0 k : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hℓ'lb
    linarith
  
  have hPE : ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) = (ell0 k : ℝ) := by
    have hc : ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) = (ell0 k : ℝ) + (k : ℝ) := by
      rw [← hpiveq]; push_cast; ring
    rw [hc]; ring
  
  have hp1 := Hunter.Proved.prop1 hk hℓ'lb hℓ'ub
  rw [hPE] at hp1
  have hac : ((j k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) *
        (((ℓ - t * ell0 k : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ))
      ≤ ((j k (ℓ - t * ell0 k) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) * (ell0 k : ℝ) := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hEpos hcpos] at hp1
    linarith [hp1]
  have hAa := A_eq_a hk
  
  have hnumR : (j k ((t + 1) * ell0 k + k) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2
      = ((t : ℝ) + 1) * ((j k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) := by
    have hcast : ((j k ((t + 1) * ell0 k + k) : ℕ) : ℝ)
        = (t : ℝ) * (((j k (ell0 k) : ℕ) : ℝ) + 3) + ((j k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      rw [hjR]; push_cast; ring
    rw [hcast, hAa]; ring
  have hdenR : (((t + 1) * ell0 k + k : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) = ((t : ℝ) + 1) * (ell0 k : ℝ) := by
    push_cast; ring
  have hnumℓ : (j k ℓ : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2
      = (t : ℝ) * ((j k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2)
        + ((j k (ℓ - t * ell0 k) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) := by
    have hcast : ((j k ℓ : ℕ) : ℝ)
        = (t : ℝ) * (((j k (ell0 k) : ℕ) : ℝ) + 3) + ((j k (ℓ - t * ell0 k) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      rw [hjℓ]; push_cast; ring
    rw [hcast, hAa]; ring
  have hdenℓ : (ℓ : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)
      = (((ℓ - t * ell0 k : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)) + (t : ℝ) * (ell0 k : ℝ) := by
    have hℓcast : ((ℓ : ℕ) : ℝ) = ((ℓ - t * ell0 k : ℕ) : ℝ) + (t : ℝ) * (ell0 k : ℝ) := by
      have hle : t * ell0 k ≤ ℓ := by omega
      rw [Nat.cast_sub hle]; push_cast; ring
    rw [hℓcast]; ring
  rw [hnumR, hdenR, hnumℓ, hdenℓ]
  have hden1 : (0 : ℝ) < ((t : ℝ) + 1) * (ell0 k : ℝ) :=
    mul_pos (by positivity) hEpos
  have hden2 : (0 : ℝ) < (((ℓ - t * ell0 k : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)) + (t : ℝ) * (ell0 k : ℝ) :=
    add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg hcpos (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg t) hEpos.le)
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hden1 hden2]
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hac (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (t : ℝ) + 1 by positivity)]

name: Hunter.ProofsMore.ratio_R_eq_pivot
proof:
:= by
  have hE : 0 < ell0 k := ell0_pos hk
  have hEpos : (0 : ℝ) < (ell0 k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hE
  have hEne : (ell0 k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := hEpos.ne'
  have ht1ne : ((t : ℝ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hpiveq : ell0 k + k = k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := ell0_add_k hk
  have hPE : ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) = (ell0 k : ℝ) := by
    have hc : ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) = (ell0 k : ℝ) + (k : ℝ) := by
      rw [← hpiveq]; push_cast; ring
    rw [hc]; ring
  have hR1 : t * ell0 k + k < (t + 1) * ell0 k + k := by
    have hsm : (t + 1) * ell0 k = t * ell0 k + ell0 k := by rw [Nat.succ_mul]
    omega
  have hRsub : (t + 1) * ell0 k + k - t * ell0 k = k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by
    have hsm : (t + 1) * ell0 k = t * ell0 k + ell0 k := by rw [Nat.succ_mul]
    omega
  have hjR : j k ((t + 1) * ell0 k + k)
      = t * (j k (ell0 k) + 3) + j k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) := by
    have hh := j_unfold hk t hR1 (le_refl _)
    rwa [hRsub] at hh
  have hAa := A_eq_a hk
  have hnumR : (j k ((t + 1) * ell0 k + k) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2
      = ((t : ℝ) + 1) * ((j k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) := by
    have hcast : ((j k ((t + 1) * ell0 k + k) : ℕ) : ℝ)
        = (t : ℝ) * (((j k (ell0 k) : ℕ) : ℝ) + 3) + ((j k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      rw [hjR]; push_cast; ring
    rw [hcast, hAa]; ring
  have hdenR : (((t + 1) * ell0 k + k : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) = ((t : ℝ) + 1) * (ell0 k : ℝ) := by
    push_cast; ring
  rw [hPE, hnumR, hdenR]
  field_simp

name: Hunter.ProofsMore.prop3
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hle : ℓ ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)
  · exact Hunter.Proved.prop1 hk h hle
  · push Not at hle
    have hE : 0 < ell0 k := ell0_pos hk
    have hpiveq : ell0 k + k = k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := ell0_add_k hk
    set t := (ℓ - k - 1) / ell0 k with htdef
    have hcomm : ell0 k * t = t * ell0 k := mul_comm _ _
    have hdm := Nat.div_add_mod (ℓ - k - 1) (ell0 k)
    rw [← htdef] at hdm
    have hml := Nat.mod_lt (ℓ - k - 1) hE
    have h1 : t * ell0 k + k < ℓ := by rw [← hcomm]; omega
    have h2 : ℓ ≤ (t + 1) * ell0 k + k := by
      have hsm : (t + 1) * ell0 k = ell0 k * t + ell0 k := by rw [Nat.succ_mul, hcomm]
      omega
    have ht1 : 1 ≤ t := by
      have hb : ell0 k ≤ ℓ - k - 1 := by omega
      exact (Nat.one_le_div_iff hE).mpr hb
    rw [ratio_R_eq_pivot hk t]
    exact prop2 hk ht1 h1 h2

name: Hunter.ProofsMore.coeff_fact_bound
statement:
theorem coeff_fact_bound {k : ℕ} (hk : 6 ≤ k) :
    (k.factorial : ℝ) + ((k - 1).factorial : ℝ) + ((k - 2).factorial : ℝ)
        + ((k - 4).factorial : ℝ) - 2 * ((k - 5).factorial : ℝ)
      ≤ coeff k * (k.factorial : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, k = m + 6 := ⟨k - 6, by omega⟩
  rw [show m + 6 - 1 = m + 5 from rfl, show m + 6 - 2 = m + 4 from rfl,
    show m + 6 - 4 = m + 2 from rfl, show m + 6 - 5 = m + 1 from rfl]
  have e2 : (m + 2).factorial = (m + 2) * (m + 1).factorial := Nat.factorial_succ (m + 1)
  have e3 : (m + 3).factorial = (m + 3) * (m + 2).factorial := Nat.factorial_succ (m + 2)
  have e4 : (m + 4).factorial = (m + 4) * (m + 3).factorial := Nat.factorial_succ (m + 3)
  have e5 : (m + 5).factorial = (m + 5) * (m + 4).factorial := Nat.factorial_succ (m + 4)
  have e6 : (m + 6).factorial = (m + 6) * (m + 5).factorial := Nat.factorial_succ (m + 5)
  have big4 : (m + 4).factorial = (m + 4) * (m + 3) * (m + 2) * (m + 1).factorial := by
    rw [e4, e3, e2]; ring
  have big5 : (m + 5).factorial = (m + 5) * (m + 4) * (m + 3) * (m + 2) * (m + 1).factorial := by
    rw [e5, e4, e3, e2]; ring
  have big6 : (m + 6).factorial
      = (m + 6) * (m + 5) * (m + 4) * (m + 3) * (m + 2) * (m + 1).factorial := by
    rw [e6, e5, e4, e3, e2]; ring
  have hFpos : (0 : ℝ) < ((m + 1).factorial : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (m + 1).factorial_pos
  have hm : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg m
  have hden : (0 : ℝ) < (m : ℝ) * (m : ℝ) + 9 * (m : ℝ) + 19 := by positivity
  have h6 : ((m : ℝ) + 6) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have h51 : ((m : ℝ) + 6 - 1) ≠ 0 := (show (0 : ℝ) < (m : ℝ) + 6 - 1 by nlinarith [hm]).ne'
  have h42 : ((m : ℝ) + 6 - 2) ≠ 0 := (show (0 : ℝ) < (m : ℝ) + 6 - 2 by nlinarith [hm]).ne'
  have hEne : ((m : ℝ) + 6) * ((m : ℝ) + 6 - 1) * ((m : ℝ) + 6 - 2) - ((m : ℝ) + 6) ≠ 0 := by
    have : ((m : ℝ) + 6) * ((m : ℝ) + 6 - 1) * ((m : ℝ) + 6 - 2) - ((m : ℝ) + 6)
        = ((m : ℝ) + 6) * ((m : ℝ) * (m : ℝ) + 9 * (m : ℝ) + 19) := by ring
    rw [this]; positivity
  have hq : (m : ℝ) ^ 2 + 9 * (m : ℝ) + 19 ≠ 0 := by positivity
  
  have hcoeffRHS : coeff (m + 6) * ((m + 6).factorial : ℝ)
        * ((m : ℝ) * (m : ℝ) + 9 * (m : ℝ) + 19)
      = (((m + 6).factorial : ℝ) + ((m + 5).factorial : ℝ) + ((m + 4).factorial : ℝ))
          * ((m : ℝ) * (m : ℝ) + 9 * (m : ℝ) + 19)
        + ((m + 4) * (m + 3) * (m + 2) : ℝ) * ((m + 1).factorial : ℝ) := by
    rw [coeff, big6, big5, big4]
    push_cast
    rw [show ((m : ℝ) + 6) * ((m : ℝ) + 6 - 1) * ((m : ℝ) + 6 - 2) - ((m : ℝ) + 6)
        = ((m : ℝ) + 6) * ((m : ℝ) ^ 2 + 9 * (m : ℝ) + 19) from by ring]
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have hmul : (((m + 6).factorial : ℝ) + ((m + 5).factorial : ℝ) + ((m + 4).factorial : ℝ)
        + ((m + 2).factorial : ℝ) - 2 * ((m + 1).factorial : ℝ))
        * ((m : ℝ) * (m : ℝ) + 9 * (m : ℝ) + 19)
      ≤ coeff (m + 6) * ((m + 6).factorial : ℝ)
        * ((m : ℝ) * (m : ℝ) + 9 * (m : ℝ) + 19) := by
    rw [hcoeffRHS, e2]
    push_cast
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (show (m : ℝ) * ((m : ℝ) * (m : ℝ) + 9 * (m : ℝ) + 19)
          ≤ ((m : ℝ) + 4) * ((m : ℝ) + 3) * ((m : ℝ) + 2) by nlinarith [hm]) hFpos.le, hFpos, hm]
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right hmul hden

name: Hunter.Proved.prop2
statement:
theorem prop2 {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) {t ℓ : ℕ} (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (h1 : t * ell0 k + k < ℓ) (h2 : ℓ ≤ (t + 1) * ell0 k + k) :
    ((j k ((t + 1) * ell0 k + k) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
        ((((t + 1) * ell0 k + k : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ))
      ≤ ((j k ℓ : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) / ((ℓ : ℝ) - (k : ℝ))
proof:
:=
  Hunter.ProofsMore.prop2 hk ht h1 h2

name: Hunter.Proved.prop3
proof:
:=
  Hunter.ProofsMore.prop3 hk h

name: Hunter.Proved.eq_weak_of_thm1v1
statement:
theorem eq_weak_of_thm1v1
    (hthm1 : ∃ (C : ℝ) (k₀ : ℕ), ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k →
      (Lstar k : ℝ) ≥ coeff k * (k.factorial : ℝ) + (k : ℝ) - C) :
    ∃ (C : ℝ) (k₀ : ℕ), ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k →
      (Lstar k : ℝ) ≥ (k.factorial : ℝ) + ((k - 1).factorial : ℝ) + ((k - 2).factorial : ℝ)
        + ((k - 4).factorial : ℝ) - 2 * ((k - 5).factorial : ℝ) - C * ((k - 6).factorial : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C1, k1, hb⟩ := hthm1
  refine ⟨max C1 0, max k1 6, fun k hk => ?_⟩
  have hk1 : k1 ≤ k := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hk
  have hk6 : 6 ≤ k := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hk
  have hC0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ max C1 0 := le_max_right _ _
  have hCge : C1 ≤ max C1 0 := le_max_left _ _
  have hb' := hb k hk1
  have hcf := Hunter.ProofsMore.coeff_fact_bound hk6
  have hfac6 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((k - 6).factorial : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (k - 6).factorial_pos
  have hk0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg k
  have hp : max C1 0 ≤ max C1 0 * ((k - 6).factorial : ℝ) := le_mul_of_one_le_right hC0 hfac6
  linarith [hb', hcf, hp, hCge, hk0]

name: Hunter.ProofsTheorem.hpotD_eq
statement: theorem hpotD_eq (k d' b : ℕ) : hpotD k d' b = hpot k (d' + 1) 0 b
proof: := rfl

name: Hunter.ProofsTheorem.hpotD_nonneg
statement:
theorem hpotD_nonneg (hk : 4 ≤ k) {b d' : ℕ} (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hd : d' + 1 ≤ k - 2) :
    hpotD k d' b + (k - 3) + Dfr k b = Dfr k (b + Wpot k (d' + 1) 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h := hpot_val hk hb (show (0 : ℕ) ≤ k - 3 by omega) hd
  simpa [hpotD] using h

name: Hunter.ProofsTheorem.mmc_ineq
statement:
theorem mmc_ineq (hk : 4 ≤ k) {b j : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hj : j ≤ k - 3) :
    hpot k 1 0 (b + 1) + Dfr k (b + 1) ≤ 1 + hpot k (k - 2) j b + Dfr k b
proof:
:= by
  
  have v1 := hpot_val hk (show 1 ≤ b by omega) hj (show k - 2 ≤ k - 2 by omega)
  
  have v2 := hpot_val hk (show 1 ≤ b + 1 by omega) (show (0 : ℕ) ≤ k - 3 by omega)
    (show (1 : ℕ) ≤ k - 2 by omega)
  
  have hidx : (b + 1) + Wpot k 1 0 = b + Mper k := by
    have hAlb : 2 ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by
      have := Nat.mul_le_mul (show 2 ≤ k - 1 by omega) (show 1 ≤ k - 2 by omega); omega
    simp only [Wpot, Mper, Nat.sub_zero]; omega
  rw [hidx] at v2
  
  have hshift := Dfr_shift_exact (show 3 ≤ k by omega) (show 2 ≤ b by omega)
  
  have hcred : k - 3 - 0 = k - 3 := by omega
  rw [hcred] at v2
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsTheorem.Ddoor_ineq
statement:
theorem Ddoor_ineq (hk : 4 ≤ k) {b d' : ℕ} (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hd : d' + 1 < k - 2) :
    hpotD k (d' + 1) (b + 1) + Dfr k (b + 1) ≤ hpotD k d' b + Dfr k b
proof:
:= by
  have h := door_ineq hk hb hd (show (0 : ℕ) ≤ k - 3 by omega)
  simpa [hpotD] using h

name: Hunter.ProofsTheorem.Dreset_ineq
statement:
theorem Dreset_ineq (hk : 4 ≤ k) {b d' : ℕ} (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hd : d' + 1 ≤ k - 3) :
    hpot k 0 0 (b + 1) + Dfr k (b + 1) ≤ 1 + hpotD k d' b + Dfr k b
proof:
:= by
  have h := reset_ineq hk hb hd (show (0 : ℕ) ≤ k - 3 by omega)
  simpa [hpotD] using h

name: Hunter.ProofsTheorem.Dheavy_ineq
statement:
theorem Dheavy_ineq (hk : 4 ≤ k) {b d' : ℕ} (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hd : d' + 1 ≤ k - 2) :
    hpot k 0 0 (b + 1) + Dfr k (b + 1) ≤ 2 + hpotD k d' b + Dfr k b
proof:
:= by
  have h := heavy_ineq hk hb hd (show (0 : ℕ) ≤ k - 3 by omega)
  simpa [hpotD] using h

name: Hunter.ProofsTheorem.loopStart_door
statement:
theorem loopStart_door {p : HPath k} {t : ℕ} (h : IsDoor p (t + 1)) :
    loopStart p (t + 1) = loopStart p t
proof:
:= by
  have hle := doorDepth_le p t
  rw [loopStart, loopStart, doorDepth_door h]; omega

name: Hunter.ProofsTheorem.loopStart_not_door
statement:
theorem loopStart_not_door {p : HPath k} {t : ℕ} (h : ¬ IsDoor p (t + 1)) :
    loopStart p (t + 1) = t + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [loopStart, doorDepth_not_door h]; omega

name: Hunter.ProofsTheorem.isDefective_door
statement:
theorem isDefective_door {p : HPath k} {t : ℕ} (h : IsDoor p (t + 1)) :
    IsDefective p (t + 1) ↔ IsDefective p t
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsDefective; rw [loopStart_door h]

name: Hunter.ProofsTheorem.isDefective_not_door
statement:
theorem isDefective_not_door {p : HPath k} {t : ℕ} (h : ¬ IsDoor p (t + 1)) :
    IsDefective p (t + 1) ↔ (IsMarkerMove p (t + 1) ∧ IsComplete p t)
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsDefective defOpen; rw [loopStart_not_door h]; simp

name: Hunter.ProofsTheorem.isDefective_incomplete
statement:
theorem isDefective_incomplete (hk : 4 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) {t : ℕ}
    (hN : k * t < p.numVerts) (hdef : IsDefective p t) : ¬ IsComplete p t
proof:
:= by
  intro hc
  have hcd : doorDepth p t = k - 2 := hc
  set r := loopStart p t with hr
  have hrt : r = t - doorDepth p t := rfl
  have hle := doorDepth_le p t
  have htr : t = r + (k - 2) := by rw [hr, loopStart, hcd]; omega
  obtain ⟨hmm, hcomp⟩ := hdef
  
  have hr1 : 1 ≤ r := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos r with h0 | hpos
    · exfalso
      have : doorDepth p (r - 1) = k - 2 := hcomp
      rw [h0] at this; simp only [Nat.zero_sub, doorDepth_zero] at this; omega
    · exact hpos
  have hNfill : k * (r + (k - 2)) < p.numVerts := by rw [← htr]; exact hN
  have hne := Proved.fill_path (show 3 ≤ k by omega) hp hr1 hNfill hmm hcomp
  rw [← htr] at hne
  exact hne hc

name: Hunter.ProofsTheorem.Hext_def
statement:
theorem Hext_def {p : HPath k} {t : ℕ} (h : IsDefective p t) :
    Hext p t = hpotD k (doorDepth p t) t
proof: := by rw [Hext, if_pos h]

name: Hunter.ProofsTheorem.Hext_norm
statement:
theorem Hext_norm {p : HPath k} {t : ℕ} (h : ¬ IsDefective p t) :
    Hext p t = hpot k (doorDepth p t) (metaDepth p t) t
proof: := by rw [Hext, if_neg h]

name: Hunter.ProofsTheorem.ext_walk_step
statement:
theorem ext_walk_step (hk : 4 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) {t : ℕ} (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (hN : k * (t + 1) < p.numVerts)
    (hj : metaDepth p t ≤ k - 3) (hj' : metaDepth p (t + 1) ≤ k - 3)
    (hDE : IsDefective p t → doorDepth p t = k - 3 → ¬ IsDoor p (t + 1) → IsHeavy p (t + 1)) :
    Dfr k (t + 1) + Hext p (t + 1) ≤ (bw p (t + 1) - 2) + (Dfr k t + Hext p t)
proof:
:= by
  have hk' : 3 ≤ k := by omega
  have hexp : k * (t + 1) = k * t + k := by rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one]
  have hNt : k * t < p.numVerts := by omega
  have hd_le : doorDepth p t ≤ k - 2 := doorDepth_le_km2 hk' hp t hNt
  have hd_le' : doorDepth p (t + 1) ≤ k - 2 := doorDepth_le_km2 hk' hp (t + 1) hN
  set d := doorDepth p t with hddef
  set m := metaDepth p t with hmdef
  have hnotdoor_dd : ¬ IsDoor p (t + 1) → doorDepth p (t + 1) = 0 := doorDepth_not_door
  
  have hcomp_notdef : IsComplete p t → ¬ IsDefective p t :=
    fun hc hdef => isDefective_incomplete hk hp hNt hdef hc
  by_cases hdeft : IsDefective p t
  · 
    have hHt : Hext p t = hpotD k d t := Hext_def hdeft
    have hinc : ¬ IsComplete p t := isDefective_incomplete hk hp hNt hdeft
    have hdk3 : d ≤ k - 3 := by
      have : d ≠ k - 2 := hinc
      omega
    by_cases hdoor : IsDoor p (t + 1)
    · 
      have hbw : bw p (t + 1) = 2 := hdoor
      have hdd : doorDepth p (t + 1) = d + 1 := doorDepth_door hdoor
      have hdef' : IsDefective p (t + 1) := (isDefective_door hdoor).mpr hdeft
      have hinc' : ¬ IsComplete p (t + 1) := isDefective_incomplete hk hp hN hdef'
      have hd1lt : d + 1 < k - 2 := by
        have : doorDepth p (t + 1) ≠ k - 2 := hinc'
        rw [hdd] at this; omega
      have hHt' : Hext p (t + 1) = hpotD k (d + 1) (t + 1) := by
        rw [Hext_def hdef', hdd]
      have hdi := Ddoor_ineq hk (show 1 ≤ t from ht) hd1lt
      rw [hHt', hHt, hbw]; omega
    · 
      have hdd : doorDepth p (t + 1) = 0 := hnotdoor_dd hdoor
      have hdef'_iff := isDefective_not_door hdoor
      have hnotdef' : ¬ IsDefective p (t + 1) := by
        rw [hdef'_iff]; rintro ⟨_, hc⟩; exact hinc hc
      
      have hmh : IsMetaHeavy p (t + 1) := by
        refine ⟨hdoor, ?_⟩; rintro ⟨_, hc⟩; exact hinc hc
      have hmd' : metaDepth p (t + 1) = 0 := metaDepth_metaHeavy hmh
      have hHt' : Hext p (t + 1) = hpot k 0 0 (t + 1) := by
        rw [Hext_norm hnotdef', hdd, hmd']
      by_cases hheavy : IsHeavy p (t + 1)
      · 
        have hbw : 4 ≤ bw p (t + 1) := hheavy
        have hhi := Dheavy_ineq hk (show 1 ≤ t from ht) (show d + 1 ≤ k - 2 by omega)
        rw [hHt', hHt]; omega
      · 
        have hbw3 : bw p (t + 1) = 3 := by
          rcases boundary_classify_ledger hk' hp (show 1 ≤ t + 1 by omega) hN with
            h | h | h | h | h
          · exact absurd h hdoor
          · exact h.1
          · exact h.1
          · exact h.1
          · exact absurd h hheavy
        have hdk4 : d ≤ k - 4 := by
          by_contra hc
          have hd3 : d = k - 3 := by omega
          exact hheavy (hDE hdeft hd3 hdoor)
        have hri := Dreset_ineq hk (show 1 ≤ t from ht) (show d + 1 ≤ k - 3 by omega)
        rw [hHt', hHt, hbw3]; omega
  · 
    have hHt : Hext p t = hpot k d m t := Hext_norm hdeft
    rcases boundary_classify_ledger hk' hp (show 1 ≤ t + 1 by omega) hN with
      hdoor | hα | hσ | hmm | hheavy
    · 
      have hbw : bw p (t + 1) = 2 := hdoor
      have hdd : doorDepth p (t + 1) = d + 1 := doorDepth_door hdoor
      have hmd : metaDepth p (t + 1) = m := metaDepth_door hdoor
      have hnotdef' : ¬ IsDefective p (t + 1) := fun h => hdeft ((isDefective_door hdoor).mp h)
      have hHt' : Hext p (t + 1) = hpot k (d + 1) m (t + 1) := by
        rw [Hext_norm hnotdef', hdd, hmd]
      have hdlt : d < k - 2 := by rw [hdd] at hd_le'; omega
      have hdi := door_ineq hk (show 1 ≤ t from ht) hdlt hj
      rw [hHt', hHt, hbw]; omega
    · 
      have hbw : bw p (t + 1) = 3 := hα.1
      have hnd : ¬ IsDoor p (t + 1) := by rw [IsDoor, hbw]; omega
      have hdd : doorDepth p (t + 1) = 0 := hnotdoor_dd hnd
      have hnmm : ¬ IsMarkerMove p (t + 1) := fun h => not_isAlpha_of_isMarkerMove h hα
      have hnotdef' : ¬ IsDefective p (t + 1) := by
        rw [isDefective_not_door hnd]; rintro ⟨h, _⟩; exact hnmm h
      by_cases hc : IsComplete p t
      · 
        have hdc : d = k - 2 := hc
        have hmd : metaDepth p (t + 1) = m + 1 := metaDepth_alpha_complete hα hc
        have hjk4 : m ≤ k - 4 := by rw [hmd] at hj'; omega
        have hHt' : Hext p (t + 1) = hpot k 0 (m + 1) (t + 1) := by
          rw [Hext_norm hnotdef', hdd, hmd]
        have hai := alpha_ineq hk (show 1 ≤ t from ht) hjk4
        rw [hHt', hHt, hbw, hdc]; omega
      · 
        have hmh : IsMetaHeavy p (t + 1) := ⟨hnd, fun h => hc h.2⟩
        have hmd : metaDepth p (t + 1) = 0 := metaDepth_metaHeavy hmh
        have hne : d ≠ k - 2 := hc
        have hd3 : d ≤ k - 3 := by omega
        have hHt' : Hext p (t + 1) = hpot k 0 0 (t + 1) := by
          rw [Hext_norm hnotdef', hdd, hmd]
        have hri := reset_ineq hk (show 1 ≤ t from ht) hd3 hj
        rw [hHt', hHt, hbw]; omega
    · 
      have hbw : bw p (t + 1) = 3 := hσ.1
      have hnd : ¬ IsDoor p (t + 1) := by rw [IsDoor, hbw]; omega
      have hdd : doorDepth p (t + 1) = 0 := hnotdoor_dd hnd
      have hmh : IsMetaHeavy p (t + 1) := metaHeavy_of_isSigmaSq hk' hp hN hσ
      have hmd : metaDepth p (t + 1) = 0 := metaDepth_metaHeavy hmh
      have hnmm : ¬ IsMarkerMove p (t + 1) := fun h => not_isSigmaSq_of_isMarkerMove h hσ
      have hnotdef' : ¬ IsDefective p (t + 1) := by
        rw [isDefective_not_door hnd]; rintro ⟨h, _⟩; exact hnmm h
      have hinc : ¬ IsComplete p t := by
        have := sigmaSq_incomplete_only hk' hp hN hσ
        rwa [show t + 1 - 1 = t from rfl] at this
      have hne : d ≠ k - 2 := hinc
      have hd3 : d ≤ k - 3 := by omega
      have hHt' : Hext p (t + 1) = hpot k 0 0 (t + 1) := by
        rw [Hext_norm hnotdef', hdd, hmd]
      have hri := reset_ineq hk (show 1 ≤ t from ht) hd3 hj
      rw [hHt', hHt, hbw]; omega
    · 
      have hbw : bw p (t + 1) = 3 := hmm.1
      have hnd : ¬ IsDoor p (t + 1) := by rw [IsDoor, hbw]; omega
      have hdd : doorDepth p (t + 1) = 0 := hnotdoor_dd hnd
      have hmh : IsMetaHeavy p (t + 1) := metaHeavy_of_isMarkerMove hmm
      have hmd : metaDepth p (t + 1) = 0 := metaDepth_metaHeavy hmh
      by_cases hc : IsComplete p t
      · 
        have hdc : d = k - 2 := hc
        have hdef' : IsDefective p (t + 1) := by
          rw [isDefective_not_door hnd]; exact ⟨hmm, hc⟩
        have hHt' : Hext p (t + 1) = hpot k 1 0 (t + 1) := by
          rw [Hext_def hdef', hdd]; rfl
        have ht2 : 2 ≤ t := by
          have : k - 2 ≤ t := by rw [← hdc]; exact doorDepth_le p t
          omega
        have hmi := mmc_ineq hk ht2 hj
        rw [hHt', hHt, hbw, hdc]; omega
      · 
        have hne : d ≠ k - 2 := hc
        have hd3 : d ≤ k - 3 := by omega
        have hnotdef' : ¬ IsDefective p (t + 1) := by
          rw [isDefective_not_door hnd]; rintro ⟨_, hcc⟩; exact hc hcc
        have hHt' : Hext p (t + 1) = hpot k 0 0 (t + 1) := by
          rw [Hext_norm hnotdef', hdd, hmd]
        have hri := reset_ineq hk (show 1 ≤ t from ht) hd3 hj
        rw [hHt', hHt, hbw]; omega
    · 
      have hbw : 4 ≤ bw p (t + 1) := hheavy
      have hnd : ¬ IsDoor p (t + 1) := by rw [IsDoor]; omega
      have hdd : doorDepth p (t + 1) = 0 := hnotdoor_dd hnd
      have hmh : IsMetaHeavy p (t + 1) := metaHeavy_of_isHeavy hheavy
      have hmd : metaDepth p (t + 1) = 0 := metaDepth_metaHeavy hmh
      have hnmm : ¬ IsMarkerMove p (t + 1) := by rintro ⟨h3, _⟩; omega
      have hnotdef' : ¬ IsDefective p (t + 1) := by
        rw [isDefective_not_door hnd]; rintro ⟨h, _⟩; exact hnmm h
      have hHt' : Hext p (t + 1) = hpot k 0 0 (t + 1) := by
        rw [Hext_norm hnotdef', hdd, hmd]
      have hhi := heavy_ineq hk (show 1 ≤ t from ht) hd_le hj
      rw [hHt', hHt]; omega

name: Hunter.ProofsTheorem.not_isDefective_le1
statement:
theorem not_isDefective_le1 (hk : 4 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} {s : ℕ} (hs : s ≤ 1) :
    ¬ IsDefective p s
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hc : IsComplete p (loopStart p s - 1) := h.2
  have h0 : loopStart p s - 1 = 0 := by rw [loopStart]; omega
  have hc' : doorDepth p (loopStart p s - 1) = k - 2 := hc
  rw [h0, doorDepth_zero] at hc'; omega

name: Hunter.ProofsTheorem.ext_walk_invariant
statement:
theorem ext_walk_invariant (hk : 4 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless)
    (hDE : DefectiveDeepExit k) :
    ∀ t, k * t < p.numVerts → Dfr k t + Hext p t ≤ PE p t
proof:
:= by
  have hRunCap := runCap_discharged hk hp
  intro t
  induction t with
  | zero =>
    intro _
    rw [PE_zero, Hext_norm (not_isDefective_le1 hk (by omega)), doorDepth_zero, metaDepth_zero,
        Dfr_zero, hpot_000 hk]
  | succ t ih =>
    intro hN1
    have hexp : k * (t + 1) = k * t + k := by rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one]
    have hNt : k * t < p.numVerts := by omega
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos t with ht0 | htpos
    · subst ht0
      have hm1 : metaDepth p 1 = 0 := by
        have hnc : ¬ (IsAlpha p 1 ∧ IsComplete p 0) := by
          rintro ⟨_, hcc⟩
          have hc' : doorDepth p 0 = k - 2 := hcc
          rw [doorDepth_zero] at hc'; omega
        show (if IsAlpha p 1 ∧ IsComplete p 0 then metaDepth p 0 + 1
              else if IsMetaHeavy p 1 then 0 else metaDepth p 0) = 0
        rw [if_neg hnc]
        by_cases hmh : IsMetaHeavy p 1
        · rw [if_pos hmh]
        · rw [if_neg hmh]; rfl
      rw [Hext_norm (not_isDefective_le1 hk (le_refl 1)), hm1, hpot_block1 hk, Dfr_one (by omega)]
      exact Nat.zero_le _
    · have hstep := ext_walk_step hk hp htpos hN1 (hRunCap t hNt) (hRunCap (t + 1) hN1)
        (hDE p hp t hN1)
      have hpe := PE_step (by omega) p t
      have IHt := ih hNt
      omega

name: Hunter.ProofsTheorem.ext_excess_ge_Dfr_block
statement:
theorem ext_excess_ge_Dfr_block (hk : 4 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) (h0 : 0 < p.numVerts)
    (hDE : DefectiveDeepExit k) :
    Dfr k ((p.numVerts - 1) / k) ≤ excess p
proof:
:= by
  set T := (p.numVerts - 1) / k with hT
  have hkpos : 0 < k := by omega
  have hkT : k * T ≤ p.numVerts - 1 := by rw [hT, Nat.mul_comm]; exact Nat.div_mul_le_self _ _
  have hTN : k * T < p.numVerts := by omega
  have hinv := ext_walk_invariant hk hp hDE T hTN
  have hple := PE_le_excess (by omega) T hTN
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsTheorem.tail_pays
statement:
theorem tail_pays (hk : 4 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) {t : ℕ} (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (hN : k * (t + 1) < p.numVerts)
    (hj : metaDepth p t ≤ k - 3) (hj' : metaDepth p (t + 1) ≤ k - 3)
    (hDE : IsDefective p t → doorDepth p t = k - 3 → ¬ IsDoor p (t + 1) → IsHeavy p (t + 1)) :
    Dfr k (t + 1) - Dfr k t ≤ (bw p (t + 1) - 2) + Hext p t
proof:
:= by
  have h := ext_walk_step hk hp ht hN hj hj' hDE
  omega

name: Hunter.Proved.m1WalkBound_of_defExit
statement:
theorem m1WalkBound_of_defExit (hk : 4 ≤ k) (hDE : DefectiveDeepExit k)
    (hG3 : TerminalFrontierTail k) : M1WalkBound k
proof:
:= by
  intro q hqe h0
  exact hG3 q hqe h0 (ext_excess_ge_Dfr_block hk hqe h0 hDE)

name: Hunter.Proved.thm2_final
statement:
theorem thm2_final {ℓ : ℕ} (hk : 4 ≤ k) (hDE : DefectiveDeepExit k)
    (hG3 : TerminalFrontierTail k) (hℓ : HasExitlessPath k ℓ) :
    j k ℓ ≤ iExitless k ℓ
proof:
:=
  Proved.thm2_of_m1 (by omega) (m1WalkBound_of_defExit hk hDE hG3) hℓ

name: Hunter.Proved.m1WalkBoundAll_of_defExit
statement:
theorem m1WalkBoundAll_of_defExit (hbase : M1WalkBound 3)
    (hDE : DefectiveDeepExitAll) (hG3 : TerminalFrontierTailAll) : Proved.M1WalkBoundAll
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k 4 with hlt | hge
  · interval_cases k
    · exact hbase
  · exact m1WalkBound_of_defExit hge (hDE k hge) (hG3 k hge)

name: Hunter.Proved.thm1v1_theorem
statement:
theorem thm1v1_theorem (hbase : M1WalkBound 3)
    (hDE : DefectiveDeepExitAll) (hG3 : TerminalFrontierTailAll)
    (hproof : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) →
        (L k : ℝ) ≥ (iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ)
          + (((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
              (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)))
            * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ)))
    (hexists : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2))) :
    ∃ (C : ℝ) (k₀ : ℕ), ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k →
      (Lstar k : ℝ) ≥ coeff k * (k.factorial : ℝ) + (k : ℝ) - C
proof:
:=
  Proved.thm1v1_of_m1 (m1WalkBoundAll_of_defExit hbase hDE hG3) hproof hexists

name: Hunter.Proved.thm1v2_theorem
statement:
theorem thm1v2_theorem (hbase : M1WalkBound 3)
    (hDE : DefectiveDeepExitAll) (hG3 : TerminalFrontierTailAll)
    (hproof : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) →
        (L k : ℝ) ≥ (iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ)
          + (((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
              (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)))
            * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ)))
    (hexists : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2))) :
    ∃ (C : ℝ) (k₀ : ℕ), ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k → (L k : ℝ) ≥ coeff k * (k.factorial : ℝ) - C
proof:
:=
  Proved.thm1v2_of_m1 (m1WalkBoundAll_of_defExit hbase hDE hG3) hproof hexists

name: Hunter.Proved.eq_weak_theorem
statement:
theorem eq_weak_theorem (hbase : M1WalkBound 3)
    (hDE : DefectiveDeepExitAll) (hG3 : TerminalFrontierTailAll)
    (hproof : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) →
        (L k : ℝ) ≥ (iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ)
          + (((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
              (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)))
            * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ)))
    (hexists : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2))) :
    ∃ (C : ℝ) (k₀ : ℕ), ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k →
      (Lstar k : ℝ) ≥ (k.factorial : ℝ) + ((k - 1).factorial : ℝ) + ((k - 2).factorial : ℝ)
        + ((k - 4).factorial : ℝ) - 2 * ((k - 5).factorial : ℝ) - C * ((k - 6).factorial : ℝ)
proof:
:=
  ProofsMF.eq_weak_of_MF
    (Proved.frontierTightHeavyAll_of_m1All (m1WalkBoundAll_of_defExit hbase hDE hG3))
    hproof hexists

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta3.sum_indicator_Icc3
statement:
theorem sum_indicator_Icc3 {e : ℕ} (hek : e ≤ k) :
    ∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 3 k, (if q ≤ e then (1 : ℕ) else 0) = e - 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.card_filter]
  have hfilt : (Finset.Icc 3 k).filter (fun q => q ≤ e) = Finset.Icc 3 e := by
    apply Finset.ext; intro q
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc]
    omega
  rw [hfilt, Nat.card_Icc]
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta3.excess_eq_sum_edgeWeight
statement:
theorem excess_eq_sum_edgeWeight (hk : 1 ≤ k) (p : HPath k) :
    excess p = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p.numVerts - 1),
      (ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) - 2)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ q : ℕ, edgeCountGe p q = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p.numVerts - 1),
      (if q ≤ ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) then (1 : ℕ) else 0) := by
    intro q; rw [edgeCountGe, Finset.card_filter]
  rw [excess]
  simp_rw [key]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  exact sum_indicator_Icc3 (ew_le_k hk _ _)

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta3.boundary_classify
statement:
theorem boundary_classify (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) {i : ℕ}
    (hi : i + 1 < p.numVerts) (hd : k ∣ (i + 1)) :
    ((p.vert (i + 1) : List ℕ) = door (p.vert i : List ℕ) ∧
        ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) = 2) ∨
    (ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) = 3 ∧
        (p.vert (i + 1) : List ℕ).getLastD 0 = marker p i ∧
        ((p.vert (i + 1) : List ℕ) = alphaWord (p.vert i : List ℕ) ∨
         (p.vert (i + 1) : List ℕ) = sigmaSqWord (p.vert i : List ℕ))) ∨
    (ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) = 3 ∧
        (p.vert (i + 1) : List ℕ).getLastD 0 ≠ marker p i) ∨
    (4 ≤ ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  have hk2 : 2 ≤ k := by omega
  have h2 := boundary_ge_two (by omega : 1 ≤ k) hp hi hd
  set w := ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) with hwdef
  
  rcases (by omega : w = 2 ∨ w = 3 ∨ 4 ≤ w) with hw2 | hw3 | hw4
  · exact Or.inl ⟨door_of_boundary hk2 hp hi hd hw2, hw2⟩
  · 
    by_cases hmark : (p.vert (i + 1) : List ℕ).getLastD 0 = marker p i
    · refine Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hw3, hmark, ?_⟩)
      exact weight3_marker_edge_cases hk hw3 hmark
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hw3, hmark⟩))
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr hw4))

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta3.boundary_contribution
statement:
theorem boundary_contribution (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) {i : ℕ}
    (hi : i + 1 < p.numVerts) (hd : k ∣ (i + 1)) :
    (ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) - 2 = 0 ∧
        (p.vert (i + 1) : List ℕ) = door (p.vert i : List ℕ)) ∨
    (ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) - 2 = 1) ∨
    (2 ≤ ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) - 2)
proof:
:= by
  rcases boundary_classify hk hp hi hd with ⟨hdoor, hw2⟩ | ⟨hw3, _⟩ | ⟨hw3, _⟩ | hw4
  · exact Or.inl ⟨by omega, hdoor⟩
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (by omega))
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (by omega))
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (by omega))

name: Hunter.mem_out
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_out {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} {U : Finset (Vtx k)} {e} :
    e ∈ out X U ↔ e ∈ X ∧ e.1 ∈ U
proof: := Finset.mem_filter

name: Hunter.mem_into
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_into {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} {U : Finset (Vtx k)} {e} :
    e ∈ into X U ↔ e ∈ X ∧ e.2 ∈ U
proof: := Finset.mem_filter

name: Hunter.out_subset
statement: theorem out_subset {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} {U} : out X U ⊆ X
proof: := Finset.filter_subset _ _

name: Hunter.into_subset
statement: theorem into_subset {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} {U} : into X U ⊆ X
proof: := Finset.filter_subset _ _

name: Hunter.ew_sigma
statement: theorem ew_sigma (hk : 1 ≤ k) (v : Vtx k) : ew k v (sigma v) = 1
proof:
:=
  wt_rho hk v.2

name: Hunter.tau_val_of_door
statement:
theorem tau_val_of_door {v : Vtx k} (h : IsPermWord k (door v.1)) :
    (tau v).1 = door v.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [tau, dif_pos h]

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger.doorDepth_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem doorDepth_zero (p : HPath k) : doorDepth p 0 = 0
proof: := rfl

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger.doorDepth_door
statement:
theorem doorDepth_door {p : HPath k} {t : ℕ} (h : IsDoor p (t + 1)) :
    doorDepth p (t + 1) = doorDepth p t + 1
proof:
:= by
  show (if IsDoor p (t + 1) then doorDepth p t + 1 else 0) = doorDepth p t + 1
  rw [if_pos h]

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger.doorDepth_not_door
statement:
theorem doorDepth_not_door {p : HPath k} {t : ℕ} (h : ¬ IsDoor p (t + 1)) :
    doorDepth p (t + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  show (if IsDoor p (t + 1) then doorDepth p t + 1 else 0) = 0
  rw [if_neg h]

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger.doorDepth_le
statement: theorem doorDepth_le (p : HPath k) (t : ℕ) : doorDepth p t ≤ t
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => simp
  | succ t ih =>
    by_cases h : IsDoor p (t + 1)
    · rw [doorDepth_door h]; omega
    · rw [doorDepth_not_door h]; omega

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger.isDoor_of_lt_doorDepth
statement:
theorem isDoor_of_lt_doorDepth (p : HPath k) :
    ∀ t j, j < doorDepth p t → IsDoor p (t - j)
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | zero => intro j hj; simp at hj
  | succ t ih =>
    intro j hj
    by_cases h : IsDoor p (t + 1)
    · rw [doorDepth_door h] at hj
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j with hj0 | hjpos
      · subst hj0; simpa using h
      · have : t + 1 - j = t - (j - 1) := by omega
        rw [this]; exact ih (j - 1) (by omega)
    · rw [doorDepth_not_door h] at hj; omega

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger.metaDepth_zero
statement: theorem metaDepth_zero (p : HPath k) : metaDepth p 0 = 0
proof: := rfl

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger.metaDepth_alpha_complete
proof:
:= by
  show (if IsAlpha p (t + 1) ∧ IsComplete p t then metaDepth p t + 1
        else if IsMetaHeavy p (t + 1) then 0 else metaDepth p t) = metaDepth p t + 1
  rw [if_pos ⟨hα, hc⟩]

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger.metaDepth_metaHeavy
statement:
theorem metaDepth_metaHeavy {p : HPath k} {t : ℕ} (h : IsMetaHeavy p (t + 1)) :
    metaDepth p (t + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  show (if IsAlpha p (t + 1) ∧ IsComplete p t then metaDepth p t + 1
        else if IsMetaHeavy p (t + 1) then 0 else metaDepth p t) = 0
  have hne : ¬ (IsAlpha p (t + 1) ∧ IsComplete p t) := by
    rintro ⟨ha, hcc⟩; exact h.2 ⟨ha, hcc⟩
  rw [if_neg hne, if_pos h]

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger.metaDepth_door
statement:
theorem metaDepth_door {p : HPath k} {t : ℕ} (h : IsDoor p (t + 1)) :
    metaDepth p (t + 1) = metaDepth p t
proof:
:= by
  show (if IsAlpha p (t + 1) ∧ IsComplete p t then metaDepth p t + 1
        else if IsMetaHeavy p (t + 1) then 0 else metaDepth p t) = metaDepth p t
  have hnα : ¬ (IsAlpha p (t + 1) ∧ IsComplete p t) := by
    rintro ⟨ha, _⟩; exact absurd ha.1 (by rw [IsDoor] at h; omega)
  have hnmh : ¬ IsMetaHeavy p (t + 1) := fun hmh => hmh.1 h
  rw [if_neg hnα, if_neg hnmh]

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger.runStart_zero
statement: theorem runStart_zero (p : HPath k) : runStart p 0 = 0
proof: := rfl

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger.runStart_metaHeavy
statement:
theorem runStart_metaHeavy {p : HPath k} {t : ℕ} (h : IsMetaHeavy p (t + 1)) :
    runStart p (t + 1) = t + 1
proof:
:= by
  show (if IsMetaHeavy p (t + 1) then t + 1 else runStart p t) = t + 1
  rw [if_pos h]

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger.runStart_not_metaHeavy
statement:
theorem runStart_not_metaHeavy {p : HPath k} {t : ℕ} (h : ¬ IsMetaHeavy p (t + 1)) :
    runStart p (t + 1) = runStart p t
proof:
:= by
  show (if IsMetaHeavy p (t + 1) then t + 1 else runStart p t) = runStart p t
  rw [if_neg h]

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger.boundary_classify_ledger
proof:
:= by
  have hkt : 1 ≤ k * t := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 (by positivity)
  have hkt1 : k * t - 1 + 1 = k * t := by omega
  have hd : k ∣ (k * t - 1 + 1) := by rw [hkt1]; exact ⟨t, rfl⟩
  have hi : (k * t - 1) + 1 < p.numVerts := by rw [hkt1]; exact hN
  have hcls := boundary_classify hk hp hi hd
  rw [hkt1] at hcls
  
  rcases hcls with ⟨_, hw2⟩ | ⟨hw3, hmp, hword⟩ | ⟨hw3, hnmp⟩ | hw4
  · exact Or.inl hw2
  · rcases hword with hα | hσ
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hw3, hmp, hα⟩)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hw3, hmp, hσ⟩))
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hw3, hnmp⟩)))
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr hw4)))

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger.not_isAlpha_of_isDoor
statement: theorem not_isAlpha_of_isDoor {p : HPath k} {t : ℕ} (h : IsDoor p t) : ¬ IsAlpha p t
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsDoor] at h; rintro ⟨h3, _⟩; omega

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger.not_isDoor_of_isHeavy
statement: theorem not_isDoor_of_isHeavy {p : HPath k} {t : ℕ} (h : IsHeavy p t) : ¬ IsDoor p t
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsHeavy] at h; rw [IsDoor]; omega

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger.not_isAlpha_of_isHeavy
statement: theorem not_isAlpha_of_isHeavy {p : HPath k} {t : ℕ} (h : IsHeavy p t) : ¬ IsAlpha p t
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsHeavy] at h; rintro ⟨h3, _⟩; omega

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger.not_isAlpha_of_isMarkerMove
statement:
theorem not_isAlpha_of_isMarkerMove {p : HPath k} {t : ℕ} (h : IsMarkerMove p t) :
    ¬ IsAlpha p t
proof: := fun ha => h.2 ha.2.1

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger.not_isSigmaSq_of_isMarkerMove
statement:
theorem not_isSigmaSq_of_isMarkerMove {p : HPath k} {t : ℕ} (h : IsMarkerMove p t) :
    ¬ IsSigmaSq p t
proof: := fun hs => h.2 hs.2.1

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger.sigmaSq_incomplete_only
statement:
theorem sigmaSq_incomplete_only {p : HPath k} (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hp : p.Exitless) {t : ℕ}
    (hN : k * t < p.numVerts) (hσ : IsSigmaSq p t) : ¬ IsComplete p (t - 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro hcomp
  rw [IsComplete] at hcomp
  have hdle := doorDepth_le p (t - 1)
  rw [hcomp] at hdle
  set t₀ := t - (k - 1) with ht0
  have ht0k : t₀ + (k - 1) = t := by omega
  
  have hdoor : ∀ r, 1 ≤ r → r ≤ k - 2 →
      ew k (p.vert (k * (t₀ + r) - 1)) (p.vert (k * (t₀ + r))) = 2 := by
    intro r hr1 hr2
    have hj : (k - 2) - r < doorDepth p (t - 1) := by rw [hcomp]; omega
    have hdr := isDoor_of_lt_doorDepth p (t - 1) ((k - 2) - r) hj
    have hidx : (t - 1) - ((k - 2) - r) = t₀ + r := by omega
    rw [hidx, IsDoor, bw] at hdr
    exact hdr
  have hσword : (p.vert (k * (t₀ + (k - 1))) : List ℕ)
      = sigmaSqWord (p.vert (k * (t₀ + (k - 1)) - 1) : List ℕ) := by
    rw [ht0k]; exact hσ.2.2
  have hN' : k * (t₀ + (k - 1)) < p.numVerts := by rw [ht0k]; exact hN
  exact lemmaA_sigmaSq_excluded hk hp t₀ hN' hdoor hσword

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger.metaHeavy_of_isSigmaSq
statement:
theorem metaHeavy_of_isSigmaSq {p : HPath k} (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hp : p.Exitless) {t : ℕ}
    (hN : k * t < p.numVerts) (h : IsSigmaSq p t) : IsMetaHeavy p t
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have := h.1; rw [IsDoor]; omega
  · rintro ⟨_, hc⟩; exact sigmaSq_incomplete_only hk hp hN h hc

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger.metaHeavy_of_isMarkerMove
statement:
theorem metaHeavy_of_isMarkerMove {p : HPath k} {t : ℕ} (h : IsMarkerMove p t) :
    IsMetaHeavy p t
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have := h.1; rw [IsDoor]; omega
  · rintro ⟨ha, _⟩; exact h.2 ha.2.1

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger.metaHeavy_of_isHeavy
statement: theorem metaHeavy_of_isHeavy {p : HPath k} {t : ℕ} (h : IsHeavy p t) : IsMetaHeavy p t
proof:
:=
  ⟨not_isDoor_of_isHeavy h, fun hac => not_isAlpha_of_isHeavy h hac.1⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger.metaDepth_sigmaSq_reset
statement:
theorem metaDepth_sigmaSq_reset {p : HPath k} (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hp : p.Exitless) {t : ℕ}
    (hN : k * (t + 1) < p.numVerts) (h : IsSigmaSq p (t + 1)) : metaDepth p (t + 1) = 0
proof:
:=
  metaDepth_metaHeavy (metaHeavy_of_isSigmaSq hk hp hN h)

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger.metaDepth_markerMove_reset
statement:
theorem metaDepth_markerMove_reset {p : HPath k} {t : ℕ} (h : IsMarkerMove p (t + 1)) :
    metaDepth p (t + 1) = 0
proof:
:=
  metaDepth_metaHeavy (metaHeavy_of_isMarkerMove h)

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger.metaDepth_heavy_reset
statement:
theorem metaDepth_heavy_reset {p : HPath k} {t : ℕ} (h : IsHeavy p (t + 1)) :
    metaDepth p (t + 1) = 0
proof:
:=
  metaDepth_metaHeavy (metaHeavy_of_isHeavy h)

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger.runStart_reset
statement:
theorem runStart_reset {p : HPath k} {t : ℕ} (h : IsMetaHeavy p (t + 1)) :
    runStart p (t + 1) = t + 1
