proof: := runStart_metaHeavy h

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger.ledger_marker_const
statement:
theorem ledger_marker_const {p : HPath k} (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hp : p.Exitless) :
    ∀ t, k * t < p.numVerts → blockMarker p t = α₁ p t
proof:
:= by
  have hk2 : 2 ≤ k := by omega
  intro t
  induction t with
  | zero => intro _; rw [α₁, runStart_zero]
  | succ t ih =>
    intro hN
    have hNt : k * t < p.numVerts := by
      have : k * t ≤ k * (t + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left k (by omega)
      omega
    by_cases hmh : IsMetaHeavy p (t + 1)
    · rw [α₁, runStart_metaHeavy hmh]
    · have hrs : runStart p (t + 1) = runStart p t := runStart_not_metaHeavy hmh
      have hα1 : α₁ p (t + 1) = blockMarker p (runStart p t) := by rw [α₁, hrs]
      have ihv : blockMarker p t = blockMarker p (runStart p t) := by
        have := ih hNt; rw [α₁] at this; exact this
      rw [hα1]
      by_cases hdoor : IsDoor p (t + 1)
      · have hw : ew k (p.vert (k * (t + 1) - 1)) (p.vert (k * (t + 1))) = 2 := hdoor
        have hmk : (p.vert (k * ((t + 1) - 1)) : List ℕ).getLastD 0
            = blockMarker p (runStart p t) := by
          rw [show (t + 1) - 1 = t from rfl]; exact ihv
        have hstep := marker_door_step hk2 hp (t := t + 1) (by omega) hN hw hmk
        rw [blockMarker]; exact hstep
      · have hAC : IsAlpha p (t + 1) ∧ IsComplete p ((t + 1) - 1) := by
          by_contra hc; exact hmh ⟨hdoor, hc⟩
        have hmark : (p.vert (k * (t + 1)) : List ℕ).getLastD 0
            = (rho (p.vert (k * (t + 1) - 1) : List ℕ)).getLastD 0 := hAC.1.2.1
        have hmk : (p.vert (k * ((t + 1) - 1)) : List ℕ).getLastD 0
            = blockMarker p (runStart p t) := by
          rw [show (t + 1) - 1 = t from rfl]; exact ihv
        have hstep := marker_alpha_step (by omega : 1 ≤ k) hp (t := t + 1) (by omega)
          (le_of_lt hN) hmark hmk
        rw [blockMarker]; exact hstep

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger.door_run_metaWord
statement:
theorem door_run_metaWord {p : HPath k} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hp : p.Exitless) (t₀ d : ℕ)
    (hN : k * (t₀ + d) < p.numVerts)
    (hdoor : ∀ r, 1 ≤ r → r ≤ d →
        ew k (p.vert (k * (t₀ + r) - 1)) (p.vert (k * (t₀ + r))) = 2) :
    ∀ r, r ≤ d →
      (p.vert (k * (t₀ + r)) : List ℕ).getLastD 0 = (p.vert (k * t₀) : List ℕ).getLastD 0 ∧
      (p.vert (k * (t₀ + r)) : List ℕ).erase ((p.vert (k * t₀) : List ℕ).getLastD 0)
        = ((p.vert (k * t₀) : List ℕ).erase ((p.vert (k * t₀) : List ℕ).getLastD 0)).rotate r
proof:
:= by
  set α₁v : ℕ := (p.vert (k * t₀) : List ℕ).getLastD 0 with hα1def
  set u : List ℕ := (p.vert (k * t₀) : List ℕ).erase α₁v with hudef
  have hpos : ∀ s, s ≤ d → k * (t₀ + s) < p.numVerts := by
    intro s hs
    have : k * (t₀ + s) ≤ k * (t₀ + d) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) (by omega)
    omega
  intro r
  induction r with
  | zero =>
    intro _
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Nat.add_zero]
    · rw [Nat.add_zero, List.rotate_zero, hudef]
  | succ r ih =>
    intro hr
    obtain ⟨hmarkr, hmetar⟩ := ih (by omega)
    have hN' : k * (t₀ + (r + 1)) < p.numVerts := hpos (r + 1) (by omega)
    have hw : ew k (p.vert (k * (t₀ + (r + 1)) - 1)) (p.vert (k * (t₀ + (r + 1)))) = 2 :=
      hdoor (r + 1) (by omega) hr
    have hmk : (p.vert (k * (t₀ + (r + 1) - 1)) : List ℕ).getLastD 0 = α₁v := by
      rw [show t₀ + (r + 1) - 1 = t₀ + r from by omega]; exact hmarkr
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact marker_door_step hk hp (t := t₀ + (r + 1)) (by omega) hN' hw hmk
    · have hstep := metaWord_door_block hk hp (t := t₀ + (r + 1)) (by omega) hN' hw hmk
      rw [show t₀ + (r + 1) - 1 = t₀ + r from by omega, hmetar, List.rotate_rotate] at hstep
      exact hstep

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger.ledger_confined
proof:
:= by
  have hk2 : 2 ≤ k := by omega
  have hdt := doorDepth_le p t
  set d := doorDepth p t with hd
  set t₀ := loopStart p t with ht0
  have ht0d : t₀ + d = t := by rw [ht0, loopStart, ← hd]; omega
  have hN' : k * (t₀ + d) < p.numVerts := by rw [ht0d]; exact hN
  
  have hdoor : ∀ r, 1 ≤ r → r ≤ d →
      ew k (p.vert (k * (t₀ + r) - 1)) (p.vert (k * (t₀ + r))) = 2 := by
    intro r hr1 hr2
    have hj : d - r < doorDepth p t := by rw [← hd]; omega
    have hdr := isDoor_of_lt_doorDepth p t (d - r) hj
    have hidx : t - (d - r) = t₀ + r := by rw [ht0, loopStart, ← hd]; omega
    rw [hidx, IsDoor, bw] at hdr
    exact hdr
  have hrun := door_run_metaWord hk2 hp t₀ d hN' hdoor
  
  have hbase : p.vert (k * t₀) ∈ Vset3 k ((p.vert (k * t₀) : List ℕ).getLastD 0)
      (((p.vert (k * t₀) : List ℕ).erase ((p.vert (k * t₀) : List ℕ).getLastD 0)).getLastD 0)
      (rotClass ((p.vert (k * t₀) : List ℕ).erase
        ((p.vert (k * t₀) : List ℕ).getLastD 0)).dropLast) := by
    apply mem_Vset3_of_genLoop_metaWord; rfl
  intro r hr
  obtain ⟨_, hmeta⟩ := hrun r hr
  rw [curVset3, ← ht0]
  exact Vset3_of_metaWord_rotate_iter hbase hmeta

name: Hunter.ProofsLedger.metaDepth_le_of_run
statement:
theorem metaDepth_le_of_run {p : HPath k} (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hp : p.Exitless) (t₀ m : ℕ)
    (hN : k * (t₀ + m * (k - 1)) ≤ p.numVerts)
    (hdoor : ∀ j r, j < m → 1 ≤ r → r ≤ k - 2 → IsDoor p (t₀ + j * (k - 1) + r))
    (halpha : ∀ c, 1 ≤ c → c < m → IsAlpha p (t₀ + c * (k - 1))) :
    m ≤ k - 2
proof:
:= by
  refine alpha_run_bound hk hp t₀ m hN ?_ ?_
  · intro j r hj hr1 hr2
    have h := hdoor j r hj hr1 hr2
    rw [IsDoor, bw] at h; exact h
  · intro c hc1 hc2
    have h := halpha c hc1 hc2
    exact ⟨h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.mem_C0_iff
statement: theorem mem_C0_iff {P : HPath k} {v : Vtx k} : v ∈ C0 P ↔ firstInCycle P v
proof:
:= by
  rw [C0, Finset.mem_filter]; exact ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, h⟩⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.mem_Cm1_iff
statement: theorem mem_Cm1_iff {P : HPath k} {v : Vtx k} : v ∈ Cm1 P ↔ sigma v ∈ C0 P
proof:
:= by
  rw [Cm1, Finset.mem_filter]; exact ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, h⟩⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.exists_c0_in_cyc
statement:
theorem exists_c0_in_cyc (P : HPath k) (v : Vtx k) :
    ∃ c, firstInCycle P c ∧ rotClass c.1 = rotClass v.1
proof:
:= by
  have hne : (cyc v).Nonempty := ⟨v, ProofsExitless.mem_cyc.mpr rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hcmem, hcmin⟩ := (cyc v).exists_min_image (fun u => P.pos u) hne
  have hcr : rotClass c.1 = rotClass v.1 := ProofsExitless.mem_cyc.mp hcmem
  refine ⟨c, ?_, hcr⟩
  intro u hu
  have huc : u ∈ cyc v := ProofsExitless.mem_cyc.mpr (hu.trans hcr)
  exact hcmin u huc

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.c0rep_first
statement: theorem c0rep_first (P : HPath k) (v : Vtx k) : firstInCycle P (c0rep P v)
proof:
:=
  (exists_c0_in_cyc P v).choose_spec.1

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.c0rep_rotClass
statement:
theorem c0rep_rotClass (P : HPath k) (v : Vtx k) :
    rotClass (c0rep P v).1 = rotClass v.1
proof: := (exists_c0_in_cyc P v).choose_spec.2

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.c0rep_mem_C0
statement: theorem c0rep_mem_C0 (P : HPath k) (v : Vtx k) : c0rep P v ∈ C0 P
proof:
:=
  mem_C0_iff.mpr (c0rep_first P v)

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.c0_unique
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : P.pos a ≤ P.pos b := ha b hr.symm
  have h2 : P.pos b ≤ P.pos a := hb a hr
  have hpos : P.pos a = P.pos b := le_antisymm h1 h2
  rw [← ProofsExitless.vert_pos P (hP a), hpos, ProofsExitless.vert_pos P (hP b)]

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.c0rep_sigma
statement:
theorem c0rep_sigma {P : HPath k} (hP : P.IsHamiltonian) (v : Vtx k) :
    c0rep P (sigma v) = c0rep P v
proof:
:= by
  apply c0_unique hP (c0rep_first P (sigma v)) (c0rep_first P v)
  rw [c0rep_rotClass, c0rep_rotClass, ProofsStructure.rotClass_sigma]

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.c0rep_of_mem_C0
statement:
theorem c0rep_of_mem_C0 {P : HPath k} (hP : P.IsHamiltonian) {v : Vtx k} (hv : v ∈ C0 P) :
    c0rep P v = v
proof:
:=
  c0_unique hP (c0rep_first P v) (mem_C0_iff.mp hv) (c0rep_rotClass P v)

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.aExp_spec
statement:
theorem aExp_spec (hk : 1 ≤ k) (P : HPath k) (v : Vtx k) :
    aExp P v < k ∧ v = sigma^[aExp P v] (c0rep P v)
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : v ∈ cyc (c0rep P v) := ProofsExitless.mem_cyc.mpr (c0rep_rotClass P v).symm
  have hex : ∃ r, r < k ∧ v = sigma^[r] (c0rep P v) :=
    (ProofsExitless.mem_cyc_iff_exists hk).mp hmem
  rw [aExp, dif_pos hex]
  exact ⟨hex.choose_spec.1, hex.choose_spec.2⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.pot_lt_of_edge
statement:
theorem pot_lt_of_edge {P : HPath k} (hP : P.IsHamiltonian) (hk : 2 ≤ k) {u w : Vtx k}
    (h : (u, w) ∈ F P) : pot P u < pot P w
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hu : u ∈ Cm1 P
  · 
    have hne : outV (F P) u ≠ ∅ := by
      rw [← Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
      exact ⟨(u, w), by simp only [outV, mem_out, Finset.mem_singleton]; exact ⟨h, trivial⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨w', hw'C0, hout⟩ := Proved.clm_rule3 hP hu hne
    have hww : w = w' := by
      have hmem : (u, w) ∈ outV (F P) u := by
        simp only [outV, mem_out, Finset.mem_singleton]; exact ⟨h, trivial⟩
      rw [hout, Finset.mem_singleton] at hmem
      exact (Prod.ext_iff.mp hmem).2
    subst hww
    have hwnCm1 : w ∉ Cm1 P := ProofsStructure.C0_not_Cm1 hP hk hw'C0
    
    have hwalk : IsWalk (F P) [u, w] := by
      rw [IsWalk, List.isChain_iff_getElem]
      intro i hi
      have hlen : [u, w].length = 2 := rfl
      rw [hlen] at hi
      obtain rfl : i = 0 := by omega
      simpa using h
    have hposlt : P.pos u < P.pos w := by
      have hkey := Proved.walking_aux hP hwalk 1 0 1 (by simp) (by simp) rfl (by omega)
        (by simpa using Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inr hu))
      simpa using hkey
    
    obtain ⟨hau_lt, -⟩ := aExp_spec (by omega : 1 ≤ k) P u
    obtain ⟨haw_lt, -⟩ := aExp_spec (by omega : 1 ≤ k) P w
    have hcu : P.pos (c0rep P u) ≤ P.pos u :=
      c0rep_first P u u (c0rep_rotClass P u).symm
    have hcw : c0rep P w = w := c0rep_of_mem_C0 hP hw'C0
    have hlt : P.pos (c0rep P u) < P.pos w := lt_of_le_of_lt hcu hposlt
    unfold pot
    rw [hcw]
    
    have hstep : k * P.pos (c0rep P u) + k ≤ k * P.pos w :=
      calc k * P.pos (c0rep P u) + k = k * (P.pos (c0rep P u) + 1) := by ring
        _ ≤ k * P.pos w := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) (by omega)
    omega
  · 
    have h2 := Proved.clm_rule2 hP hu
    have hw : w = sigma u := by
      have hmem : (u, w) ∈ outV (F P) u := by
        simp only [outV, mem_out, Finset.mem_singleton]; exact ⟨h, trivial⟩
      rw [h2, Finset.mem_singleton] at hmem
      exact (Prod.ext_iff.mp hmem).2
    subst hw
    have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
    set c := c0rep P u with hc
    have hcsig : c0rep P (sigma u) = c := c0rep_sigma hP u
    obtain ⟨hau_lt, hau_eq⟩ := aExp_spec hk1 P u
    obtain ⟨haw_lt, haw_eq⟩ := aExp_spec hk1 P (sigma u)
    have haw_eq2 : sigma u = sigma^[aExp P u + 1] c := by
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ← hau_eq]
    
    have hau1 : aExp P u + 1 < k := by
      by_contra hcon
      have heq : aExp P u = k - 1 := by omega
      have hsig : sigma u = c := by
        have hb := haw_eq2
        rw [heq, show k - 1 + 1 = k from by omega] at hb
        rw [hb]; exact ProofsExitless.sigma_iter_period c
      have hcC0 : c ∈ C0 P := hc ▸ c0rep_mem_C0 P u
      exact hu (mem_Cm1_iff.mpr (hsig ▸ hcC0))
    
    have haweq : aExp P (sigma u) = aExp P u + 1 := by
      have h' : sigma^[aExp P (sigma u)] c = sigma^[aExp P u + 1] c := by
        rw [hcsig] at haw_eq; rw [← haw_eq, ← haw_eq2]
      exact ProofsExitless.sigma_iter_inj c haw_lt hau1 h'
    unfold pot
    rw [hcsig, haweq, ← hc]
    omega

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.nodup_of_strictmono
statement:
theorem nodup_of_strictmono {α : Type*} {D : List α} {g : α → ℕ}
    (h : ∀ i (hi : i + 1 < D.length), g (D[i]'(by omega)) < g (D[i + 1]'hi)) : D.Nodup
proof:
:= by
  have hc : List.IsChain (· < ·) (D.map g) := by
    rw [List.isChain_iff_getElem]
    intro i hi
    rw [List.length_map] at hi
    rw [List.getElem_map, List.getElem_map]
    exact h i hi
  have hp : List.Pairwise (· < ·) (D.map g) := List.isChain_iff_pairwise.mp hc
  exact List.Nodup.of_map g (hp.imp (fun hlt => Nat.ne_of_lt hlt))

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.nodup_of_strictanti
statement:
theorem nodup_of_strictanti {α : Type*} {D : List α} {g : α → ℕ}
    (h : ∀ i (hi : i + 1 < D.length), g (D[i + 1]'hi) < g (D[i]'(by omega))) : D.Nodup
proof:
:= by
  have hc : List.IsChain (· > ·) (D.map g) := by
    rw [List.isChain_iff_getElem]
    intro i hi
    rw [List.length_map] at hi
    rw [List.getElem_map, List.getElem_map]
    exact h i hi
  have hp : List.Pairwise (· > ·) (D.map g) := List.isChain_iff_pairwise.mp hc
  exact List.Nodup.of_map g (hp.imp (fun hgt => (Nat.ne_of_lt hgt).symm))

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.acyc
statement:
theorem acyc {P : HPath k} (hP : P.IsHamiltonian) (hk : 2 ≤ k) {D : List (Vtx k)}
    (hD : IsWalk (F P) D) : D.Nodup
proof:
:= by
  apply nodup_of_strictmono (g := pot P)
  intro i hi
  have hedge : (D[i], D[i + 1]) ∈ F P := List.IsChain.getElem hD i hi
  exact pot_lt_of_edge hP hk hedge

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.edge_of_succ_some
statement:
theorem edge_of_succ_some {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} {v w : Vtx k}
    (h : succ X v = some w) : (v, w) ∈ X
proof:
:= by
  unfold succ at h
  by_cases hex : ∃ w, (v, w) ∈ X
  · rw [dif_pos hex] at h
    have hw : hex.choose = w := Option.some.inj h
    have := hex.choose_spec
    rwa [hw] at this
  · rw [dif_neg hex] at h; exact absurd h (by simp)

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.succ_some_of_edge
statement:
theorem succ_some_of_edge {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} {v w : Vtx k}
    (hcard : (outV X v).card ≤ 1) (h : (v, w) ∈ X) : succ X v = some w
proof:
:= by
  have hex : ∃ w, (v, w) ∈ X := ⟨w, h⟩
  unfold succ; rw [dif_pos hex]
  congr 1
  have hvw : (v, w) ∈ outV X v := by
    simp only [outV, mem_out, Finset.mem_singleton]; exact ⟨h, trivial⟩
  have hcw : (v, hex.choose) ∈ outV X v := by
    simp only [outV, mem_out, Finset.mem_singleton]; exact ⟨hex.choose_spec, trivial⟩
  have := Finset.card_le_one.mp hcard _ hcw _ hvw
  exact (Prod.ext_iff.mp this).2

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.edge_of_pred_some
statement:
theorem edge_of_pred_some {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} {v u : Vtx k}
    (h : pred X v = some u) : (u, v) ∈ X
proof:
:= by
  unfold pred at h
  by_cases hex : ∃ u, (u, v) ∈ X
  · rw [dif_pos hex] at h
    have hu : hex.choose = u := Option.some.inj h
    have := hex.choose_spec
    rwa [hu] at this
  · rw [dif_neg hex] at h; exact absurd h (by simp)

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.pred_eq_none_iff
statement:
theorem pred_eq_none_iff {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} {v : Vtx k} :
    pred X v = none ↔ intoV X v = ∅
proof:
:= by
  unfold pred
  by_cases hex : ∃ u, (u, v) ∈ X
  · rw [dif_pos hex]
    have hne : (intoV X v).Nonempty := by
      obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hex
      exact ⟨(u, v), by simp only [intoV, mem_into, Finset.mem_singleton]; exact ⟨hu, trivial⟩⟩
    constructor
    · intro h; exact absurd h (by simp)
    · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mp hne) (by rw [h]; simp)
  · rw [dif_neg hex]
    simp only [true_iff]
    rw [Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
    intro e he
    rw [intoV, mem_into, Finset.mem_singleton] at he
    exact hex ⟨e.1, by rw [← he.2]; exact he.1⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.iterOpt_succ_none
statement:
theorem iterOpt_succ_none (f : Vtx k → Option (Vtx k)) {n : ℕ} {v : Vtx k} (h : f v = none) :
    iterOpt f (n + 1) v = [v]
proof: := by simp only [iterOpt, h]

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.iterOpt_succ_some
statement:
theorem iterOpt_succ_some (f : Vtx k → Option (Vtx k)) {n : ℕ} {v w : Vtx k} (h : f v = some w) :
    iterOpt f (n + 1) v = v :: iterOpt f n w
proof: := by simp only [iterOpt, h]

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.iterOpt_head
statement:
theorem iterOpt_head (f : Vtx k → Option (Vtx k)) (n : ℕ) (v : Vtx k) :
    ∃ t, iterOpt f n v = v :: t
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => exact ⟨[], rfl⟩
  | succ n => exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.iterOpt_ne_nil
statement:
theorem iterOpt_ne_nil (f : Vtx k → Option (Vtx k)) (n : ℕ) (v : Vtx k) :
    iterOpt f n v ≠ []
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := iterOpt_head f n v; rw [ht]; exact List.cons_ne_nil v t

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.iterOpt_head_eq
statement:
theorem iterOpt_head_eq (f : Vtx k → Option (Vtx k)) (n : ℕ) (v : Vtx k) :
    (iterOpt f n v).head (iterOpt_ne_nil f n v) = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := iterOpt_head f n v
  simp only [ht, List.head_cons]

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.iterOpt_chain
statement:
theorem iterOpt_chain (f : Vtx k → Option (Vtx k)) (n : ℕ) (v : Vtx k) :
    List.IsChain (fun a b => f a = some b) (iterOpt f n v)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing v with
  | zero => exact List.isChain_singleton _
  | succ n ih =>
    cases hfv : f v with
    | none => rw [iterOpt_succ_none f hfv]; exact List.isChain_singleton _
    | some w =>
      rw [iterOpt_succ_some f hfv]
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := iterOpt_head f n w
      rw [ht]
      rw [List.isChain_cons_cons]
      refine ⟨hfv, ?_⟩
      rw [← ht]; exact ih w

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.iterOpt_length_le
statement:
theorem iterOpt_length_le (f : Vtx k → Option (Vtx k)) (n : ℕ) (v : Vtx k) :
    (iterOpt f n v).length ≤ n + 1
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing v with
  | zero => simp [iterOpt]
  | succ n ih =>
    cases hfv : f v with
    | none => rw [iterOpt_succ_none f hfv]; simp
    | some w =>
      rw [iterOpt_succ_some f hfv, List.length_cons]
      have := ih w; omega

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.iterOpt_mem_closed
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro v hv x hx; rw [iterOpt] at hx; rw [List.mem_singleton] at hx; rwa [hx]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro v hv x hx
    cases hfv : f v with
    | none => rw [iterOpt_succ_none f hfv, List.mem_singleton] at hx; rwa [hx]
    | some w =>
      rw [iterOpt_succ_some f hfv, List.mem_cons] at hx
      rcases hx with hx | hx
      · rwa [hx]
      · exact ih w (hstep v w hfv hv) x hx

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.iterOpt_last_spec
statement:
theorem iterOpt_last_spec (f : Vtx k → Option (Vtx k)) (n : ℕ) (v : Vtx k) :
    (∀ z, (iterOpt f n v).getLast? = some z → f z = none) ∨
      (iterOpt f n v).length = n + 1
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing v with
  | zero => right; simp [iterOpt]
  | succ n ih =>
    cases hfv : f v with
    | none =>
      left
      intro z hz
      rw [iterOpt_succ_none f hfv, List.getLast?_singleton] at hz
      rw [← Option.some.inj hz]; exact hfv
    | some w =>
      have hcons := iterOpt_succ_some f (n := n) hfv
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := iterOpt_head f n w
      rcases ih w with hL | hR
      · left
        intro z hz
        rw [hcons, ht, List.getLast?_cons_cons] at hz
        exact hL z (by rw [ht]; exact hz)
      · right
        rw [hcons, List.length_cons, hR]

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.chain_rel_of_zip
statement:
theorem chain_rel_of_zip {R : Vtx k → Vtx k → Prop} {L : List (Vtx k)}
    (hL : L.IsChain R) {a b : Vtx k} (h : (a, b) ∈ L.zip L.tail) : R a b
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons x l ih =>
    cases l with
    | nil => simp at h
    | cons y t =>
      rw [List.tail_cons] at h
      simp only [List.zip_cons_cons, List.mem_cons] at h
      rw [List.isChain_cons_cons] at hL
      rcases h with h | h
      · injection h with h1 h2; subst h1; subst h2; exact hL.1
      · exact ih hL.2 (by rw [List.tail_cons]; exact h)

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.chain_step_mem
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => simp at hx
  | cons a l ih =>
    cases l with
    | nil =>
      have hfa : f a = none := hlast a (by simp)
      rw [List.mem_singleton] at hx; rw [hx, hfa] at hxy; exact absurd hxy (by simp)
    | cons b t =>
      rw [List.isChain_cons_cons] at hL
      have hlast' : ∀ z, (b :: t).getLast? = some z → f z = none := by
        intro z hz; exact hlast z (by rw [List.getLast?_cons_cons]; exact hz)
      rw [List.mem_cons] at hx
      simp only [List.tail_cons, List.zip_cons_cons, List.mem_cons]
      rcases hx with hx | hx
      · left
        have hb : f x = some b := by rw [hx]; exact hL.1
        rw [hxy] at hb
        have hyb : y = b := Option.some.inj hb
        rw [hx, hyb]
      · right
        have := ih hL.2 hlast' hx
        rwa [List.tail_cons] at this

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.chain_prev_mem
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => simp at hx
  | cons a l ih =>
    cases l with
    | nil =>
      rw [List.mem_singleton] at hx
      rw [hx] at hxh; simp at hxh
    | cons b t =>
      simp only [List.head?_cons, ne_eq, Option.some.injEq] at hxh
      simp only [List.tail_cons, List.zip_cons_cons]
      rw [List.mem_cons] at hx
      by_cases hxb : x = b
      · exact ⟨a, by rw [hxb]; exact List.mem_cons_self⟩
      · have hxt : x ∈ t := by
          rcases hx with h | h
          · exact absurd h.symm hxh
          · rw [List.mem_cons] at h; rcases h with h | h
            · exact absurd h hxb
            · exact h
        rw [List.isChain_cons_cons] at hL
        have hxh' : (b :: t).head? ≠ some x := by
          simp only [List.head?_cons, ne_eq, Option.some.injEq]; exact fun hc => hxb hc.symm
        obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := ih hL.2 (List.mem_cons_of_mem b hxt) hxh'
        exact ⟨c, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (by rwa [List.tail_cons] at hc)⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.succ_eq_none_iff
statement:
theorem succ_eq_none_iff {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} {v : Vtx k} :
    succ X v = none ↔ outV X v = ∅
proof:
:= by
  unfold succ
  by_cases hex : ∃ w, (v, w) ∈ X
  · rw [dif_pos hex]
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hex
    have hne : (outV X v).Nonempty :=
      ⟨(v, w), by simp only [outV, mem_out]; exact ⟨hw, Finset.mem_singleton_self _⟩⟩
    constructor
    · intro h; exact absurd h (by simp)
    · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mp hne) (by rw [h]; simp)
  · rw [dif_neg hex]
    simp only [true_iff]
    rw [Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
    intro e he
    rw [outV, mem_out, Finset.mem_singleton] at he
    exact hex ⟨e.2, by rw [← he.2]; exact he.1⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.weakStep_symm
statement:
theorem weakStep_symm {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} {a b : Vtx k} (h : weakStep X a b) :
    weakStep X b a
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with h | h
  · exact Or.inr h
  · exact Or.inl h

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.weakConn_symm
statement:
theorem weakConn_symm {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} {a b : Vtx k} (h : weakConn X a b) :
    weakConn X b a
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  | tail _ hstep ih => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.head (weakStep_symm hstep) ih

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.mem_vertsOf_of_weakStep
statement:
theorem mem_vertsOf_of_weakStep {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} {a b : Vtx k}
    (h : weakStep X a b) : b ∈ vertsOf X
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertsOf, Finset.mem_filter]
  refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
  rcases h with h | h
  · exact ⟨(a, b), h, Or.inr rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨(b, a), h, Or.inl rfl⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.two_le_of_mem_F
statement:
theorem two_le_of_mem_F {P : HPath k} (hP : P.IsHamiltonian) {e : Vtx k × Vtx k}
    (he : e ∈ F P) : 2 ≤ k
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hc
  haveI := ProofsStructure.vtx_subsingleton (show k ≤ 1 by omega)
  have ha : e.1 ∈ Cm1 P := ProofsStructure.mem_Cm1_of_le_one (by omega) P e.1
  have hout : outV (F P) e.1 ≠ ∅ := by
    rw [← Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
    exact ⟨e, by simp only [outV, mem_out]; exact ⟨he, Finset.mem_singleton_self _⟩⟩
  have heq := Proved.clm_rule1 hP ha hout
  have hPempty : P.edges = ∅ := by
    have hlen : P.verts.length ≤ 1 := ProofsSpine.length_le_one_of_subsingleton P.nodup
    rw [HPath.edges, Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
    intro x hx; rw [List.mem_toFinset] at hx
    have h3 := List.length_pos_of_mem (ProofsSpine.snd_mem_tail hx)
    rw [List.length_tail] at h3; omega
  rw [heq] at hout
  exact hout (by rw [outV, out, hPempty]; exact Finset.filter_empty _)

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.lem_pathrule_core
statement:
theorem lem_pathrule_core {P : HPath k} (hP : P.IsHamiltonian) :
    ∀ C ∈ Comps (F P), ∃ p : HPath k, p.vertsFinset = C ∧ IsPathComponent p (F P)
proof:
:= by
  intro C hC
  
  rw [Comps, Finset.mem_image] at hC
  obtain ⟨v₀, hv₀V, hCeq⟩ := hC
  have hCmem : ∀ u, u ∈ C ↔ u ∈ vertsOf (F P) ∧ weakConn (F P) v₀ u := by
    intro u; rw [← hCeq, Finset.mem_filter]
  have hv₀C : v₀ ∈ C := (hCmem v₀).mpr ⟨hv₀V, Relation.ReflTransGen.refl⟩
  
  obtain ⟨e₀, he₀X, -⟩ := (by rw [vertsOf, Finset.mem_filter] at hv₀V; exact hv₀V.2)
  have hk2 : 2 ≤ k := two_le_of_mem_F hP he₀X
  
  have houtcard : ∀ v, (outV (F P) v).card ≤ 1 := fun v => (Proved.clm_degree (sset_sPrecond P) v).1
  have hintocard : ∀ v, (intoV (F P) v).card ≤ 1 := fun v => (Proved.clm_degree (sset_sPrecond P) v).2
  
  have hCclosed : ∀ a b, a ∈ C → weakStep (F P) a b → b ∈ C := by
    intro a b ha hab
    rw [hCmem] at ha ⊢
    exact ⟨mem_vertsOf_of_weakStep hab, ha.2.tail hab⟩
  
  have hstepC : ∀ a b, succ (F P) a = some b → a ∈ C → b ∈ C := fun a b hab ha =>
    hCclosed a b ha (Or.inl (edge_of_succ_some hab))
  have hstepBack : ∀ a b, pred (F P) a = some b → a ∈ C → b ∈ C := fun a b hab ha =>
    hCclosed a b ha (Or.inr (edge_of_pred_some hab))
  set N := (vertsOf (F P)).card with hN
  
  set B := iterOpt (pred (F P)) N v₀ with hB
  have hBmem : ∀ x ∈ B, x ∈ C := iterOpt_mem_closed (pred (F P)) hstepBack N v₀ hv₀C
  have hBchain : B.IsChain (fun a b => pred (F P) a = some b) := iterOpt_chain _ N v₀
  have hBnodup : B.Nodup := by
    apply nodup_of_strictanti (g := pot P)
    intro i hi
    have hrel := List.IsChain.getElem hBchain i hi
    exact pot_lt_of_edge hP hk2 (edge_of_pred_some hrel)
  have hBsub : B.toFinset ⊆ vertsOf (F P) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [List.mem_toFinset] at hx
    have := hBmem x hx
    rw [hCmem] at this; exact this.1
  have hBlen : B.length ≤ N := by
    rw [← List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hBnodup]; exact Finset.card_le_card hBsub
  have hBlast : ∀ z, B.getLast? = some z → pred (F P) z = none := by
    rcases iterOpt_last_spec (pred (F P)) N v₀ with h | h
    · exact h
    · rw [← hB] at h; omega
  set s := B.getLast (iterOpt_ne_nil _ N v₀) with hs
  have hsB : s ∈ B := List.getLast_mem (iterOpt_ne_nil _ N v₀)
  have hsC : s ∈ C := hBmem s hsB
  have hsource : intoV (F P) s = ∅ := by
    rw [← pred_eq_none_iff]
    apply hBlast s
    rw [hs]
    exact List.getLast?_eq_getLast_of_ne_nil (iterOpt_ne_nil _ N v₀)
  
  set L := iterOpt (succ (F P)) N s with hL
  have hLmem : ∀ x ∈ L, x ∈ C := iterOpt_mem_closed (succ (F P)) hstepC N s hsC
  have hLchain : L.IsChain (fun a b => succ (F P) a = some b) := iterOpt_chain _ N s
  have hLnodup : L.Nodup := by
    apply nodup_of_strictmono (g := pot P)
    intro i hi
    have hrel := List.IsChain.getElem hLchain i hi
    exact pot_lt_of_edge hP hk2 (edge_of_succ_some hrel)
  have hLne : L ≠ [] := iterOpt_ne_nil _ N s
  have hLhead : L.head hLne = s := iterOpt_head_eq _ N s
  have hLsub : L.toFinset ⊆ vertsOf (F P) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [List.mem_toFinset] at hx
    have := hLmem x hx
    rw [hCmem] at this; exact this.1
  have hLlen : L.length ≤ N := by
    rw [← List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hLnodup]; exact Finset.card_le_card hLsub
  have hLlast : ∀ z, L.getLast? = some z → succ (F P) z = none := by
    rcases iterOpt_last_spec (succ (F P)) N s with h | h
    · exact h
    · rw [← hL] at h; omega
  
  have hLclosed : ∀ x y, x ∈ L.toFinset → weakStep (F P) x y → y ∈ L.toFinset := by
    intro x y hx hxy
    rw [List.mem_toFinset] at hx
    rcases hxy with hedge | hedge
    · 
      have hstep := chain_step_mem hLchain hLlast hx (succ_some_of_edge (houtcard x) hedge)
      exact List.mem_toFinset.mpr (List.mem_of_mem_tail (List.of_mem_zip hstep).2)
    · 
      have hxs : x ≠ s := by
        intro hc; rw [hc] at hedge
        have : (y, s) ∈ intoV (F P) s := by
          rw [intoV, mem_into]; exact ⟨hedge, Finset.mem_singleton_self _⟩
        rw [hsource] at this; exact absurd this (Finset.notMem_empty _)
      have hhead : L.head? ≠ some x := by
        obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := iterOpt_head (succ (F P)) N s
        rw [← hL] at ht
        rw [ht, List.head?_cons]
        intro hc; exact hxs (Option.some.inj hc).symm
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := chain_prev_mem hLchain hx hhead
      have hbedge : (b, x) ∈ F P := edge_of_succ_some (chain_rel_of_zip hLchain hb)
      
      have hby : b = y := by
        have h1 : (b, x) ∈ intoV (F P) x := by
          rw [intoV, mem_into]; exact ⟨hbedge, Finset.mem_singleton_self _⟩
        have h2 : (y, x) ∈ intoV (F P) x := by
          rw [intoV, mem_into]; exact ⟨hedge, Finset.mem_singleton_self _⟩
        have := Finset.card_le_one.mp (hintocard x) _ h1 _ h2
        exact (Prod.ext_iff.mp this).1
      rw [← hby]
      exact List.mem_toFinset.mpr (List.of_mem_zip hb).1
  
  have hsL : s ∈ L.toFinset := List.mem_toFinset.mpr (hLhead ▸ List.head_mem hLne)
  have hVsubC : L.toFinset ⊆ C := by
    intro x hx; exact hLmem x (List.mem_toFinset.mp hx)
  have hCsubV : C ⊆ L.toFinset := by
    intro y hy
    
    have hsy : weakConn (F P) s y := by
      have hsv : weakConn (F P) v₀ s := ((hCmem s).mp hsC).2
      have hyv : weakConn (F P) v₀ y := ((hCmem y).mp hy).2
      exact (weakConn_symm hsv).trans hyv
    
    clear hy
    induction hsy with
    | refl => exact hsL
    | tail _ hstep ih => exact hLclosed _ _ ih hstep
  have hVC : L.toFinset = C := Finset.Subset.antisymm hVsubC hCsubV
  
  refine ⟨⟨L, hLne, hLnodup⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · show L.toFinset = C; exact hVC
  · 
    intro e he
    rw [HPath.edges, List.mem_toFinset] at he
    have hrel : succ (F P) e.1 = some e.2 := chain_rel_of_zip hLchain he
    have := edge_of_succ_some hrel
    simpa using this
  · 
    intro e he
    have hVsimp : (⟨L, hLne, hLnodup⟩ : HPath k).vertsFinset = C := hVC
    rw [hVsimp]
    constructor
    · intro h1; exact hCclosed e.1 e.2 h1 (Or.inl (show (e.1, e.2) ∈ F P by simpa using he))
    · intro h2; exact hCclosed e.2 e.1 h2 (Or.inr (show (e.1, e.2) ∈ F P by simpa using he))
  · 
    intro e he h1
    have hx : e.1 ∈ L := List.mem_toFinset.mp h1
    have hstep := chain_step_mem hLchain hLlast hx
      (succ_some_of_edge (houtcard e.1) (show (e.1, e.2) ∈ F P by simpa using he))
    show e ∈ (⟨L, hLne, hLnodup⟩ : HPath k).edges
    rw [HPath.edges, List.mem_toFinset]
    simpa using hstep

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.pc_vertsFinset_weakstep
statement:
theorem pc_vertsFinset_weakstep {P p : HPath k} (hp : IsPathComponent p (F P)) {x y : Vtx k}
    (hx : x ∈ p.vertsFinset) (hxy : weakStep (F P) x y) : y ∈ p.vertsFinset
proof:
:= by
  rcases hxy with h | h
  · exact (hp.2.1 (x, y) h).mp hx
  · exact (hp.2.1 (y, x) h).mpr hx

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.pc_vertsFinset_weakconn
statement:
theorem pc_vertsFinset_weakconn {P p : HPath k} (hp : IsPathComponent p (F P)) {x y : Vtx k}
    (hx : x ∈ p.vertsFinset) (hxy : weakConn (F P) x y) : y ∈ p.vertsFinset
proof:
:= by
  induction hxy with
  | refl => exact hx
  | tail _ hstep ih => exact pc_vertsFinset_weakstep hp ih hstep

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.weakConn_c0_forward
statement:
theorem weakConn_c0_forward {P : HPath k} (hP : P.IsHamiltonian) {c0 : Vtx k}
    (hc0 : c0 ∈ C0 P) : ∀ b, b < k → weakConn (F P) c0 (sigma^[b] c0)
proof:
:= by
  intro b
  induction b with
  | zero => intro _; exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  | succ n ih =>
    intro hb
    have hcn : weakConn (F P) c0 (sigma^[n] c0) := ih (by omega)
    have hnotCm1 : sigma^[n] c0 ∉ Cm1 P := by
      rw [mem_Cm1_iff]
      intro hc
      rw [← Function.iterate_succ_apply' sigma n c0] at hc
      have heq : sigma^[n + 1] c0 = c0 :=
        c0_unique hP (mem_C0_iff.mp hc) (mem_C0_iff.mp hc0)
          (ProofsExitless.rotClass_sigma_iter (n + 1) c0)
      have hcontra : n + 1 = 0 :=
        ProofsExitless.sigma_iter_inj c0 hb (by omega) (by rw [heq]; simp)
      omega
    have hedge : (sigma^[n] c0, sigma (sigma^[n] c0)) ∈ F P :=
      ProofsStructure.mem_F_sigma_of_not_Cm1 hnotCm1
    have hstep : weakConn (F P) c0 (sigma (sigma^[n] c0)) := hcn.tail (Or.inl hedge)
    rwa [← Function.iterate_succ_apply' sigma n c0] at hstep

name: Hunter.ProofsPathrule.cyc_subset_pc
statement:
theorem cyc_subset_pc {P p : HPath k} (hP : P.IsHamiltonian) (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (hp : IsPathComponent p (F P)) {v : Vtx k} (hv : v ∈ p.vertsFinset) :
    cyc v ⊆ p.vertsFinset
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
  have hc0C0 : c0rep P v ∈ C0 P := c0rep_mem_C0 P v
  obtain ⟨ha, hav⟩ := aExp_spec hk1 P v
  have hcv : weakConn (F P) (c0rep P v) v := by
    have := weakConn_c0_forward hP hc0C0 (aExp P v) ha
    rwa [← hav] at this
  have hucyc : u ∈ cyc (c0rep P v) := by
    rw [ProofsExitless.mem_cyc] at hu ⊢
    rw [hu]; exact (c0rep_rotClass P v).symm
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hub⟩ := (ProofsExitless.mem_cyc_iff_exists hk1).mp hucyc
  have hcu : weakConn (F P) (c0rep P v) u := by
    have := weakConn_c0_forward hP hc0C0 b hb
    rwa [← hub] at this
  exact pc_vertsFinset_weakconn hp hv ((weakConn_symm hcv).trans hcu)

name: Hunter.Proved.lem_pathrule
statement:
theorem lem_pathrule {k : ℕ} {P : HPath k} (hP : P.IsHamiltonian) :
    ∀ C ∈ Comps (F P), ∃ p : HPath k, p.vertsFinset = C ∧ IsPathComponent p (F P)
proof:
:=
  ProofsPathrule.lem_pathrule_core hP

name: Hunter.Proved.cor_exitlessrule
statement:
theorem cor_exitlessrule {k : ℕ} {P : HPath k} (hP : P.IsHamiltonian) :
    IsUnionOfStronglyExitlessPaths (F P)
proof:
:= by
  intro C hC
  have hk2 : 2 ≤ k := by
    have hC' := hC
    rw [Comps, Finset.mem_image] at hC'
    obtain ⟨v₀, hv₀V, -⟩ := hC'
    rw [vertsOf, Finset.mem_filter] at hv₀V
    obtain ⟨e₀, he₀X, -⟩ := hv₀V.2
    exact ProofsPathrule.two_le_of_mem_F hP he₀X
  obtain ⟨p, hpV, hp⟩ := ProofsPathrule.lem_pathrule_core hP C hC
  refine ⟨p, hpV, hp, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    rw [HPath.Exitless]
    intro hEE
    obtain ⟨i, hi1, hw, hlt⟩ := hEE
    by_cases hvCm1 : p.vert i ∈ Cm1 P
    · 
      have hi : i < p.numVerts := by omega
      have hviv : p.vert i ∈ p.verts := ProofsExitless.vert_mem p hi
      have hsvV : sigma (p.vert i) ∈ p.verts := by
        have hcyc : sigma (p.vert i) ∈ cyc (p.vert i) :=
          ProofsExitless.mem_cyc.mpr (ProofsStructure.rotClass_sigma (p.vert i))
        exact HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mp
          (ProofsPathrule.cyc_subset_pc hP hk2 hp (HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mpr hviv) hcyc)
      have hposvi : p.pos (p.vert i) = i := ProofsExitless.pos_vert p hi
      have hlt' : p.pos (p.vert i) < p.pos (sigma (p.vert i)) := by rw [hposvi]; exact hlt
      have hord := Proved.clm_ordering hP hp (Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inr hvCm1)) hviv hsvV hlt'
      have hsvC0 : sigma (p.vert i) ∈ C0 P := ProofsPathrule.mem_Cm1_iff.mp hvCm1
      have hle : P.pos (sigma (p.vert i)) ≤ P.pos (p.vert i) :=
        (ProofsPathrule.mem_C0_iff.mp hsvC0) (p.vert i)
          (ProofsStructure.rotClass_sigma (p.vert i)).symm
      omega
    · 
      have h2 := Proved.clm_rule2 hP hvCm1
      have hmem : (p.vert i, p.vert (i + 1)) ∈ outV (F P) (p.vert i) := by
        simp only [outV, mem_out, Finset.mem_singleton]
        exact ⟨hp.1 (ProofsStructure.vert_consec_mem_edges hi1), trivial⟩
      rw [h2, Finset.mem_singleton] at hmem
      have hsucc : p.vert (i + 1) = sigma (p.vert i) := (Prod.ext_iff.mp hmem).2
      rw [hsucc, ew_sigma (show (1 : ℕ) ≤ k by omega) (p.vert i)] at hw
      omega
  · 
    have hcyc : sigma p.last ∈ cyc p.last :=
      ProofsExitless.mem_cyc.mpr (ProofsStructure.rotClass_sigma p.last)
    exact HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mp
      (ProofsPathrule.cyc_subset_pc hP hk2 hp (HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mpr p.last_mem) hcyc)

name: Hunter.Proved.prp_Xk_se_necessity_amended'
statement:
theorem prp_Xk_se_necessity_amended' {k : ℕ} {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (hX : X ∈ Xk k) : vertsOf X = Finset.univ ∧ IsUnionOfStronglyExitlessPaths X
proof:
:=
  prp_Xk_se_necessity_amended hk (fun _ hP => cor_exitlessrule hP) hX

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta8.metaWord_sigmaSq_step
statement:
theorem metaWord_sigmaSq_step (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} {i : ℕ}
    (hσ : (p.vert (i + 1) : List ℕ) = sigmaSqWord (p.vert i)) :
    (p.vert (i + 1) : List ℕ).erase ((rho (p.vert i : List ℕ)).getLastD 0) =
      ((rho (p.vert i : List ℕ)).erase ((rho (p.vert i : List ℕ)).getLastD 0)).rotate 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [hσ]; exact sigmaSqWord_erase_marker hk (p.vert i).2

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta8.metaWord_sigmaSq_block
statement:
theorem metaWord_sigmaSq_block (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) {t α₁ : ℕ}
    (ht : 1 ≤ t) (hN : k * t < p.numVerts)
    (hσ : (p.vert (k * t) : List ℕ) = sigmaSqWord (p.vert (k * t - 1)))
    (hmk : (p.vert (k * (t - 1)) : List ℕ).getLastD 0 = α₁) :
    (p.vert (k * t) : List ℕ).erase α₁ = ((p.vert (k * (t - 1)) : List ℕ).erase α₁).rotate 2
proof:
:= by
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
  have hkt : 0 < k * t := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)
  have hi1 : k * t - 1 + 1 = k * t := by omega
  have hrho := rho_boundary_prev hk1 hp ht (by omega : k * t ≤ p.numVerts)
  have hdyn : (rho (p.vert (k * t - 1) : List ℕ)).getLastD 0 = α₁ := by rw [hrho]; exact hmk
  have hstep := metaWord_sigmaSq_step hk (p := p) (i := k * t - 1) (by rw [hi1]; exact hσ)
  rw [hi1, hdyn, hrho] at hstep
  exact hstep

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta8.marker_sigmaSq_step
statement:
theorem marker_sigmaSq_step (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) {t α₁ : ℕ}
    (ht : 1 ≤ t) (hN : k * t ≤ p.numVerts)
    (hσ : (p.vert (k * t) : List ℕ) = sigmaSqWord (p.vert (k * t - 1)))
    (hmk : (p.vert (k * (t - 1)) : List ℕ).getLastD 0 = α₁) :
    (p.vert (k * t) : List ℕ).getLastD 0 = α₁
proof:
:= by
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
  have hmark : (p.vert (k * t) : List ℕ).getLastD 0
      = (rho (p.vert (k * t - 1) : List ℕ)).getLastD 0 := by
    rw [hσ]; exact sigmaSqWord_marker hk (p.vert (k * t - 1)).2
  exact marker_alpha_step hk1 hp ht hN hmark hmk

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta8.mem_Vset3_self
statement:
theorem mem_Vset3_self (A : Vtx k) :
    A ∈ Vset3 k ((A : List ℕ).getLastD 0) (((A : List ℕ).dropLast).getLastD 0)
      (rotClass ((A : List ℕ).dropLast.dropLast))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_Vset3, erase_getLastD A.2.nodup,
    erase_getLastD ((List.dropLast_sublist _).nodup A.2.nodup)]

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta8.rotStep_confined
statement:
theorem rotStep_confined (hk : 3 ≤ k) {α₁ α₂ : ℕ} {K : RotClass} {A : Vtx k}
    (hα1 : α₁ = (A : List ℕ).getLastD 0)
    (hα2 : α₂ = ((A : List ℕ).dropLast).getLastD 0)
    (hK : K = rotClass ((A : List ℕ).dropLast.dropLast))
    {m : ℕ} (B : Fin m → Vtx k)
    (hmem : ∀ i, B i ∈ Vset3 k α₁ α₂ K)
    (hcyc : ∀ i i', i ≠ i' → rotClass (B i : List ℕ) ≠ rotClass (B i' : List ℕ)) :
    m ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hinj : Function.Injective B := fun i i' h => by
    by_contra hne; exact hcyc i i' hne (by rw [h])
  set S : Finset (Vtx k) := Finset.univ.image B with hS
  have hScard : S.card = m := by
    rw [hS, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hinj, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  have hmemS : ∀ v ∈ S, v ∈ Vset3 k α₁ α₂ K := by
    intro v hv; rw [hS, Finset.mem_image] at hv
    obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := hv; exact hmem i
  have hdisjS : ∀ u ∈ S, ∀ v ∈ S, u ≠ v →
      rotClass (u : List ℕ) ≠ rotClass (v : List ℕ) := by
    intro u hu v hv huv
    rw [hS, Finset.mem_image] at hu hv
    obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := hu; obtain ⟨i', _, rfl⟩ := hv
    exact hcyc i i' (fun h => huv (by rw [h]))
  have hcard := card_le_of_mem_Vset3 hk hα1 hα2 hK S hmemS hdisjS
  rwa [hScard] at hcard

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta8.rot_run_bound
statement:
theorem rot_run_bound (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) (t₀ m : ℕ)
    (hN : k * (t₀ + m) ≤ p.numVerts)
    (hbdry : ∀ r, 1 ≤ r → r < m →
        ew k (p.vert (k * (t₀ + r) - 1)) (p.vert (k * (t₀ + r))) = 2 ∨
        (p.vert (k * (t₀ + r)) : List ℕ) = sigmaSqWord (p.vert (k * (t₀ + r) - 1))) :
    m ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
  have hk2 : 2 ≤ k := by omega
  set α₁ : ℕ := (p.vert (k * t₀) : List ℕ).getLastD 0 with hα1def
  set α₂ : ℕ := ((p.vert (k * t₀) : List ℕ).dropLast).getLastD 0 with hα2def
  set K : RotClass := rotClass ((p.vert (k * t₀) : List ℕ).dropLast.dropLast) with hKdef
  
  have hposlt : ∀ r, r < m → k * (t₀ + r) < p.numVerts := by
    intro r hr
    have h1 : k * (t₀ + r) + k ≤ k * (t₀ + m) := by
      calc k * (t₀ + r) + k = k * (t₀ + r + 1) := by ring
        _ ≤ k * (t₀ + m) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) (by omega)
    omega
  
  have hmkStart : ∀ r, r < m → (p.vert (k * (t₀ + r)) : List ℕ).getLastD 0 = α₁ := by
    intro r
    induction r with
    | zero => intro _; rw [Nat.add_zero]
    | succ r ih =>
      intro hr
      have hprev : (p.vert (k * (t₀ + r)) : List ℕ).getLastD 0 = α₁ := ih (by omega)
      have hmk : (p.vert (k * (t₀ + (r + 1) - 1)) : List ℕ).getLastD 0 = α₁ := by
        rw [show t₀ + (r + 1) - 1 = t₀ + r from by omega]; exact hprev
      rcases hbdry (r + 1) (by omega) hr with hdoor | hσ
      · exact marker_door_step hk2 hp (t := t₀ + (r + 1)) (by omega) (hposlt _ hr) hdoor hmk
      · exact marker_sigmaSq_step hk hp (t := t₀ + (r + 1)) (by omega)
          (le_of_lt (hposlt _ hr)) hσ hmk
  
  have hrot : ∀ r, r < m →
      ∃ s, (p.vert (k * (t₀ + r)) : List ℕ).erase α₁
        = ((p.vert (k * t₀) : List ℕ).erase α₁).rotate s := by
    intro r
    induction r with
    | zero => intro _; exact ⟨0, by rw [Nat.add_zero, List.rotate_zero]⟩
    | succ r ih =>
      intro hr
      obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := ih (by omega)
      have hmk : (p.vert (k * (t₀ + r)) : List ℕ).getLastD 0 = α₁ := hmkStart r (by omega)
      have hmk' : (p.vert (k * (t₀ + (r + 1) - 1)) : List ℕ).getLastD 0 = α₁ := by
        rw [show t₀ + (r + 1) - 1 = t₀ + r from by omega]; exact hmk
      rcases hbdry (r + 1) (by omega) hr with hdoor | hσ
      · have hstep := metaWord_door_block hk2 hp (t := t₀ + (r + 1)) (by omega)
          (hposlt _ hr) hdoor hmk'
        rw [show t₀ + (r + 1) - 1 = t₀ + r from by omega, hs, List.rotate_rotate] at hstep
        exact ⟨s + 1, hstep⟩
      · have hstep := metaWord_sigmaSq_block hk hp (t := t₀ + (r + 1)) (by omega)
          (hposlt _ hr) hσ hmk'
        rw [show t₀ + (r + 1) - 1 = t₀ + r from by omega, hs, List.rotate_rotate] at hstep
        exact ⟨s + 2, hstep⟩
  
  have hmem : ∀ i : Fin m, (fun i : Fin m => p.vert (k * (t₀ + (i : ℕ)))) i ∈ Vset3 k α₁ α₂ K := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hrot i.1 i.2
    exact Vset3_of_metaWord_rotate_iter (A := p.vert (k * t₀))
      (by rw [hα1def, hα2def, hKdef]; exact mem_Vset3_self _) hs
  
  have hcyc : ∀ i i' : Fin m, i ≠ i' →
      rotClass ((fun i : Fin m => p.vert (k * (t₀ + (i : ℕ)))) i : List ℕ)
        ≠ rotClass ((fun i : Fin m => p.vert (k * (t₀ + (i : ℕ)))) i' : List ℕ) :=
    meta_no_reentry hk1 hp (fun i : Fin m => k * (t₀ + (i : ℕ)))
      (fun i => ⟨t₀ + (i : ℕ), rfl⟩)
      (fun i i' h => by
        have : (i : ℕ) < (i' : ℕ) := h
        calc k * (t₀ + (i : ℕ)) + k = k * (t₀ + (i : ℕ) + 1) := by ring
          _ ≤ k * (t₀ + (i' : ℕ)) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) (by omega))
      (fun i => hposlt i.1 i.2)
  exact rotStep_confined hk (A := p.vert (k * t₀)) hα1def hα2def hKdef _ hmem hcyc

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta8.mixed_runs_pay
statement:
theorem mixed_runs_pay (_hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (_hp : p.Exitless) {i : ℕ}
    (_hi : i + 1 < p.numVerts) (_hd : k ∣ (i + 1))
    (hw3 : ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) = 3) :
    ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) - 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsExcess.excess_ge_Dbase
statement:
theorem excess_ge_Dbase {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) {q : HPath k} (hq : q.Exitless) :
    q.numVerts ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1)) - 1 ≤ excess q
proof:
:=
  le_trans (Proved.prp_3edgebound (by omega) hq) (edgeCountGe3_le_excess hk q)

name: Hunter.ProofsExcess.excess_frontier_of_j_le_jbase
statement:
theorem excess_frontier_of_j_le_jbase {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) {q : HPath k} (hq : q.Exitless)
    (h0 : 0 < q.numVerts)
    (hj : j k q.numVerts ≤
        q.numVerts + (q.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k) + (q.numVerts ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1))) - 3) :
    j k q.numVerts ≤ (q.numVerts - 1) + (q.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k - 1) + excess q
proof:
:= by
  have hN1 : 1 ≤ q.numVerts := h0
  have he := excess_ge_Dbase hk hq
  have hck1 : 1 ≤ q.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k := by
    rw [ceilDiv_succ_pred hN1 (by omega : 0 < k)]; exact Nat.le_add_left 1 _
  have hck2 : 1 ≤ q.numVerts ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1)) := by
    rw [ceilDiv_succ_pred hN1 (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega : 0 < k - 1))]
    exact Nat.le_add_left 1 _
  set A := q.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k
  set B := q.numVerts ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1))
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsExcess.thm2_of_j_le_jbase
statement:
theorem thm2_of_j_le_jbase {k ℓ : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k)
    (hj : j k ℓ ≤ ℓ + (ℓ ⌈/⌉ k) + (ℓ ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1))) - 3)
    (hex : HasExitlessPath k ℓ) :
    j k ℓ ≤ iExitless k ℓ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hpe, hpv⟩ := hex
  have hne : {m | ∃ q : HPath k, q.Exitless ∧ q.numVerts = ℓ ∧ q.wtP = m}.Nonempty :=
    ⟨p.wtP, p, hpe, hpv, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨q, hqe, hqv, hqw⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem hne
  have h0 : 0 < q.numVerts := q.numVerts_pos
  calc j k ℓ
      = j k q.numVerts := by rw [hqv]
    _ ≤ q.numVerts + (q.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k) + (q.numVerts ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1))) - 3 := by
        rw [hqv]; exact hj
    _ ≤ q.wtP := wtP_ge_jbase hk hqe h0
    _ = iExitless k ℓ := hqw

name: Hunter.ProofsExcess.prefix_exitless_aux
statement:
theorem prefix_exitless_aux {k : ℕ} {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) :
    ∀ d, d < p.numVerts →
      ∃ q : HPath k, q.verts = p.verts.take (p.numVerts - d) ∧ q.Exitless
proof:
:= by
  intro d
  induction d with
  | zero =>
    intro _
    refine ⟨p, ?_, hp⟩
    rw [Nat.sub_zero]
    exact List.take_length.symm
  | succ d ih =>
    intro hd
    obtain ⟨q, hqv, hqe⟩ := ih (by omega)
    have hqnv : q.numVerts = p.numVerts - d := by
      show q.verts.length = _; rw [hqv, List.length_take]
      have : p.numVerts - d ≤ p.verts.length := by
        show p.numVerts - d ≤ p.numVerts; omega
      omega
    have hq2 : 2 ≤ q.numVerts := by rw [hqnv]; omega
    obtain ⟨r, hrv, hre⟩ := Proved.clm_prefix hqe hq2
    refine ⟨r, ?_, hre⟩
    have e1 : r.verts = q.verts.take (q.numVerts - 1) := by
      rw [hrv]; exact List.dropLast_eq_take
    rw [e1, hqnv, hqv, List.take_take]
    congr 1
    omega

name: Hunter.ProofsExcess.prefix_exitless
statement:
theorem prefix_exitless {k : ℕ} {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hnle : n ≤ p.numVerts) :
    ∃ q : HPath k, q.verts = p.verts.take n ∧ q.Exitless
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hqv, hqe⟩ := prefix_exitless_aux hp (p.numVerts - n) (by omega)
  exact ⟨q, by rw [hqv, show p.numVerts - (p.numVerts - n) = n from by omega], hqe⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsExcess.mem_Vset3
statement:
theorem mem_Vset3 {α₁ α₂ : ℕ} {K : RotClass} {v : Vtx k} :
    v ∈ Vset3 k α₁ α₂ K ↔ rotClass (((v : List ℕ).erase α₁).erase α₂) = K
proof:
:= by
  rw [Vset3, Finset.mem_filter]
  exact ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, h⟩⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsExcess.sigma_mem_Vset3
statement:
theorem sigma_mem_Vset3 {α₁ α₂ : ℕ} {K : RotClass} {v : Vtx k}
    (h : v ∈ Vset3 k α₁ α₂ K) : sigma v ∈ Vset3 k α₁ α₂ K
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_Vset3] at h ⊢
  show rotClass ((((v : List ℕ).rotate 1).erase α₁).erase α₂) = K
  have hr : (v : List ℕ).erase α₁ ~r ((v : List ℕ).rotate 1).erase α₁ :=
    (rotClass_eq_iff.mp (rotClass_erase_rotate_one v.2.nodup)).symm
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hr
  rw [← hs, rotClass_erase_rotate (v.2.nodup.erase α₁) s]
  exact h

name: Hunter.ProofsExcess.sigma_iter_mem_Vset3
statement:
theorem sigma_iter_mem_Vset3 {α₁ α₂ : ℕ} {K : RotClass} {v : Vtx k}
    (h : v ∈ Vset3 k α₁ α₂ K) (r : ℕ) : sigma^[r] v ∈ Vset3 k α₁ α₂ K
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => simpa using h
  | succ r ih => rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']; exact sigma_mem_Vset3 ih

name: Hunter.ProofsExcess.cyc_subset_Vset3
statement:
theorem cyc_subset_Vset3 {α₁ α₂ : ℕ} {K : RotClass} {v : Vtx k} (hk1 : 1 ≤ k)
    (h : v ∈ Vset3 k α₁ α₂ K) : cyc v ⊆ Vset3 k α₁ α₂ K
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu
  obtain ⟨r, _, rfl⟩ := (mem_cyc_iff_exists hk1).mp hu
  exact sigma_iter_mem_Vset3 h r

name: Hunter.ProofsExcess.card_Vset3_le
statement:
theorem card_Vset3_le {A : Vtx k} (hk : 3 ≤ k) {α₁ α₂ : ℕ} {K : RotClass}
    (hα1 : α₁ = (A : List ℕ).getLastD 0)
    (hα2 : α₂ = ((A : List ℕ).dropLast).getLastD 0)
    (hK : K = rotClass ((A : List ℕ).dropLast.dropLast)) :
    (Vset3 k α₁ α₂ K).card ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  rcases List.eq_nil_or_concat (A : List ℕ) with hnil | ⟨A', a, hAeq⟩
  · exact absurd hnil (A.2.ne_nil (by omega))
  rw [List.concat_eq_append] at hAeq
  rcases List.eq_nil_or_concat A' with hnil' | ⟨u₀₀, b, hA'eq⟩
  · exfalso; have hl := A.2.length; rw [hAeq, hnil'] at hl; simp at hl; omega
  rw [List.concat_eq_append] at hA'eq
  have hAeq3 : (A : List ℕ) = (u₀₀ ++ [b]) ++ [a] := by rw [hAeq, hA'eq]
  have hnd3 : ((u₀₀ ++ [b]) ++ [a]).Nodup := by rw [← hAeq3]; exact A.2.nodup
  have hAlen : ((u₀₀ ++ [b]) ++ [a]).length = k := by rw [← hAeq3]; exact A.2.length
  have hu0len : u₀₀.length = k - 2 := by
    simp only [List.length_append, List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hAlen; omega
  have hlenpos : 0 < u₀₀.length := by rw [hu0len]; omega
  
  have hαa : α₁ = a := by rw [hα1, hAeq3, List.getLastD_concat]
  have hAdl : (A : List ℕ).dropLast = u₀₀ ++ [b] := by rw [hAeq3, List.dropLast_concat]
  have hαb : α₂ = b := by rw [hα2, hAdl, List.getLastD_concat]
  have hKu : K = rotClass u₀₀ := by rw [hK, hAeq3, List.dropLast_concat, List.dropLast_concat]
  
  have haIcc : a ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k := by
    rw [← A.2.toFinset_eq, List.mem_toFinset, hAeq3]; simp
  have hbIcc : b ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k := by
    rw [← A.2.toFinset_eq, List.mem_toFinset, hAeq3]; simp
  have haU : a ∉ u₀₀ ++ [b] :=
    fun h => (List.nodup_append.mp hnd3).2.2 a h a (List.mem_cons_self ..) rfl
  have hab : a ≠ b := fun h => haU (by rw [h]; simp)
  
  set f : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ → List ℕ := fun p =>
    ((u₀₀.rotate p.1).take p.2.1 ++ α₂ :: (u₀₀.rotate p.1).drop p.2.1).take p.2.2 ++
      α₁ :: ((u₀₀.rotate p.1).take p.2.1 ++ α₂ :: (u₀₀.rotate p.1).drop p.2.1).drop p.2.2
    with hf
  have hsub : (Vset3 k α₁ α₂ K).image Subtype.val ⊆
      (Finset.range (k - 2) ×ˢ (Finset.range (k - 1) ×ˢ Finset.range k)).image f := by
    intro w hw
    rw [Finset.mem_image] at hw
    obtain ⟨v, hvV, rfl⟩ := hw
    rw [mem_Vset3] at hvV
    
    have hav : a ∈ (v : List ℕ) := by rw [← List.mem_toFinset, v.2.toFinset_eq]; exact haIcc
    have hbv : b ∈ (v : List ℕ) := by rw [← List.mem_toFinset, v.2.toFinset_eq]; exact hbIcc
    obtain ⟨t₁, r₁, hv1⟩ := List.append_of_mem hav
    have hvnd1 : (t₁ ++ a :: r₁).Nodup := by rw [← hv1]; exact v.2.nodup
    have hat1 : a ∉ t₁ :=
      fun h => (List.nodup_append.mp hvnd1).2.2 a h a (List.mem_cons_self ..) rfl
    have herasea : (v : List ℕ).erase a = t₁ ++ r₁ := by
      rw [hv1, List.erase_append_right _ hat1, List.erase_cons_head]
    
    have hbva : b ∈ (v : List ℕ).erase a := (List.mem_erase_of_ne hab.symm).mpr hbv
    obtain ⟨t₂, r₂, hva⟩ := List.append_of_mem hbva
    have hvbnd : (t₂ ++ b :: r₂).Nodup := by rw [← hva]; exact v.2.nodup.erase a
    have hbt2 : b ∉ t₂ :=
      fun h => (List.nodup_append.mp hvbnd).2.2 b h b (List.mem_cons_self ..) rfl
    have hbase : ((v : List ℕ).erase a).erase b = t₂ ++ r₂ := by
      rw [hva, List.erase_append_right _ hbt2, List.erase_cons_head]
    
    rw [hαa, hαb, hKu, hbase] at hvV
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := rotClass_eq_iff.mp hvV.symm
    have hrot : u₀₀.rotate (m % u₀₀.length) = t₂ ++ r₂ := by rw [List.rotate_mod]; exact hm
    
    have hvlen : (v : List ℕ).length = k := v.2.length
    have ht1lt : t₁.length < k := by
      have h := congrArg List.length hv1; rw [hvlen] at h
      simp only [List.length_append, List.length_cons] at h; omega
    have ht2lt : t₂.length < k - 1 := by
      have hel : ((v : List ℕ).erase a).length = k - 1 := by
        rw [List.length_erase_of_mem hav, hvlen]
      have h := congrArg List.length hva; rw [hel] at h
      simp only [List.length_append, List.length_cons] at h; omega
    refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(m % u₀₀.length, t₂.length, t₁.length), ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨?_, Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
      · exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (by rw [← hu0len]; exact Nat.mod_lt _ hlenpos)
      · exact Finset.mem_range.mpr ht2lt
      · exact Finset.mem_range.mpr ht1lt
    · show ((u₀₀.rotate (m % u₀₀.length)).take t₂.length ++ α₂ ::
          (u₀₀.rotate (m % u₀₀.length)).drop t₂.length).take t₁.length ++ α₁ ::
          ((u₀₀.rotate (m % u₀₀.length)).take t₂.length ++ α₂ ::
          (u₀₀.rotate (m % u₀₀.length)).drop t₂.length).drop t₁.length = (v : List ℕ)
      have hinner : (u₀₀.rotate (m % u₀₀.length)).take t₂.length ++ α₂ ::
          (u₀₀.rotate (m % u₀₀.length)).drop t₂.length = (v : List ℕ).erase a := by
        rw [hrot, List.take_left, List.drop_left, hαb, ← hva]
      rw [hinner, herasea, List.take_left, List.drop_left, hαa, ← hv1]
  have hinjval : Function.Injective (Subtype.val : Vtx k → List ℕ) := fun a b h => Subtype.ext h
  calc (Vset3 k α₁ α₂ K).card
      = ((Vset3 k α₁ α₂ K).image Subtype.val).card :=
        (Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hinjval).symm
    _ ≤ ((Finset.range (k - 2) ×ˢ (Finset.range (k - 1) ×ˢ Finset.range k)).image f).card :=
        Finset.card_le_card hsub
    _ ≤ (Finset.range (k - 2) ×ˢ (Finset.range (k - 1) ×ˢ Finset.range k)).card :=
        Finset.card_image_le
    _ = (k - 2) * ((k - 1) * k) := by
        rw [Finset.card_product, Finset.card_product, Finset.card_range, Finset.card_range,
          Finset.card_range]
    _ = k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by ring

name: Hunter.ProofsExcess.ceilDiv_add_dvd
statement:
theorem ceilDiv_add_dvd {a b k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (hb : k ∣ b) :
    (a + b) ⌈/⌉ k = a ⌈/⌉ k + b / k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hb
  rw [Nat.ceilDiv_eq_add_pred_div, Nat.ceilDiv_eq_add_pred_div, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left t hk,
      show a + k * t + k - 1 = (a + k - 1) + k * t from by omega,
      Nat.add_mul_div_left _ _ hk]

name: Hunter.ProofsExcess.ceilDiv_ell0
statement: theorem ceilDiv_ell0 {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) : ell0 k ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1)) = k - 2
proof:
:= by
  have hN1 : 1 ≤ ell0 k := ProofsRecursion.ell0_pos hk
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, k = m + 3 := ⟨k - 3, by omega⟩
  have e1 : m + 3 - 1 = m + 2 := by omega
  have e2 : m + 3 - 2 = m + 1 := by omega
  have hDpos : 0 < (m + 3) * (m + 3 - 1) := by rw [e1]; positivity
  rw [Proved.ceilDiv_succ_pred hN1 hDpos]
  have hval : ell0 (m + 3) - 1 = (m + 3) * (m + 3 - 1) * m + (m ^ 2 + 4 * m + 2) := by
    rw [ell0, e1, e2]
    have expand : (m + 3) * (m + 2) * (m + 1) = (m + 3) * (m + 2) * m + (m + 3) * (m + 2) := by
      ring
    have expand2 : (m + 3) * (m + 2) = m ^ 2 + 5 * m + 6 := by ring
    omega
  have hlt : m ^ 2 + 4 * m + 2 < (m + 3) * (m + 3 - 1) := by rw [e1]; nlinarith
  rw [hval, Nat.mul_add_div hDpos, Nat.div_eq_of_lt hlt]
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsExcess.k_dvd_ell0
statement: theorem k_dvd_ell0 {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) : k ∣ ell0 k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, k = m + 3 := ⟨k - 3, by omega⟩
  simp only [ell0, show m + 3 - 1 = m + 2 from by omega, show m + 3 - 2 = m + 1 from by omega]
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ : ∃ P, (m + 2) * (m + 1) = P + 1 := by
    have hpos : 0 < (m + 2) * (m + 1) := by positivity
    exact ⟨(m + 2) * (m + 1) - 1, by omega⟩
  refine ⟨P, ?_⟩
  have hexp : (m + 3) * (m + 2) * (m + 1) = (m + 3) * P + (m + 3) := by
    rw [show (m + 3) * (m + 2) * (m + 1) = (m + 3) * ((m + 2) * (m + 1)) from by ring, hP]; ring
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsExcess.j_le_jbase_recursion
statement:
theorem j_le_jbase_recursion {k ℓ : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k)
    (hlo : k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) < ℓ) (hhi : ℓ ≤ k ^ 2 * (k - 2)) :
    j k ℓ ≤ ℓ + (ℓ ⌈/⌉ k) + (ℓ ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1))) - 3
proof:
:= by
  have hk0 : 0 < k := by omega
  have hkk1pos : 0 < k * (k - 1) := Nat.mul_pos hk0 (by omega)
  have hdvd : k ∣ ell0 k := k_dvd_ell0 hk
  
  have hrel1 : k ^ 2 * (k - 2) = k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) + k * (k - 2) := by
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, k = m + 3 := ⟨k - 3, by omega⟩
    simp only [show m + 3 - 1 = m + 2 from by omega, show m + 3 - 2 = m + 1 from by omega]; ring
  have hrel2 : k * (k - 2) + k = k * (k - 1) := by
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, k = m + 3 := ⟨k - 3, by omega⟩
    simp only [show m + 3 - 1 = m + 2 from by omega, show m + 3 - 2 = m + 1 from by omega]; ring
  have hrel3 : k * (k - 1) ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by
    have : 1 ≤ k - 2 := by omega
    calc k * (k - 1) = k * (k - 1) * 1 := by rw [Nat.mul_one]
      _ ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ this
  have hell0B : ell0 k = k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) - k := rfl
  
  have hell0lt : ell0 k < ℓ := by omega
  have hsle : ℓ - ell0 k ≤ k * (k - 1) := by omega
  have hsle_base : ℓ - ell0 k ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := le_trans hsle hrel3
  have hs1 : 1 ≤ ℓ - ell0 k := by omega
  have hℓsum : ℓ = (ℓ - ell0 k) + ell0 k := by omega
  
  have hcadd : ℓ ⌈/⌉ k = (ℓ - ell0 k) ⌈/⌉ k + ell0 k / k := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hℓsum]
    exact ceilDiv_add_dvd hk0 hdvd
  have hce : ell0 k ⌈/⌉ k = ell0 k / k := Proved.ceilDiv_of_dvd hk0 hdvd
  have hcs1 : (ℓ - ell0 k) ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1)) = 1 := by
    rw [Proved.ceilDiv_succ_pred hs1 hkk1pos, Nat.div_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
  have hce0 : ell0 k ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1)) = k - 2 := ceilDiv_ell0 hk
  have hcll : k - 1 ≤ ℓ ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1)) := by
    by_contra hc
    have hle : ℓ ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1)) ≤ k - 2 := by omega
    rw [ceilDiv_le_iff_le_mul hkk1pos] at hle
    omega
  
  have hk2k : k * 2 ≤ k * (k - 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) (by omega)
  have hkle : k ≤ ell0 k := by rw [hell0B]; omega
  have hCs1 : 1 ≤ (ℓ - ell0 k) ⌈/⌉ k := by
    rw [Proved.ceilDiv_succ_pred hs1 hk0]; exact Nat.le_add_left 1 _
  
  have hjs : j k (ℓ - ell0 k) =
      (ℓ - ell0 k) + ((ℓ - ell0 k) ⌈/⌉ k) + ((ℓ - ell0 k) ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1))) - 3 :=
    j_base (Or.inl hsle_base)
  have hje0 : j k (ell0 k) =
      ell0 k + (ell0 k ⌈/⌉ k) + (ell0 k ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1))) - 3 := by
    apply j_base; left
    have := ProofsRecursion.ell0_pos hk; rw [hell0B] at this ⊢; omega
  have hjrec : j k ℓ = j k (ℓ - ell0 k) + j k (ell0 k) + 3 := j_rec_unfold_one hk hlo
  
  rw [hcs1] at hjs
  rw [hce, hce0] at hje0
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsExcess.thm2_upto
statement:
theorem thm2_upto {k ℓ : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hhi : ℓ ≤ k ^ 2 * (k - 2))
    (hex : HasExitlessPath k ℓ) :
    j k ℓ ≤ iExitless k ℓ
proof:
:= by
  apply thm2_of_j_le_jbase hk _ hex
  by_cases hb : ℓ ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)
  · rw [j_base (Or.inl hb)]
  · exact j_le_jbase_recursion hk (by omega) hhi

name: Hunter.IsPermWord.nodup
statement: theorem IsPermWord.nodup {k : ℕ} {w : List ℕ} (h : IsPermWord k w) : w.Nodup

name: Hunter.IsPermWord.toFinset_eq
statement:
theorem IsPermWord.toFinset_eq {k : ℕ} {w : List ℕ} (h : IsPermWord k w) :
    w.toFinset = Finset.Icc 1 k

name: Hunter.IsPermWord.length
statement: theorem IsPermWord.length {k : ℕ} {w : List ℕ} (h : IsPermWord k w) : w.length = k
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := List.toFinset_card_of_nodup h.1
  rw [h.2, Nat.card_Icc] at h1
  omega

name: Hunter.IsPermWord.ne_nil
statement:
theorem IsPermWord.ne_nil {k : ℕ} {w : List ℕ} (h : IsPermWord k w) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    w ≠ []
proof:
:= by
  intro hw
  have hlen := h.length
  rw [hw] at hlen; simp at hlen; omega

name: Hunter.isPermWord_rotate
statement:
theorem isPermWord_rotate {k : ℕ} {w : List ℕ} (h : IsPermWord k w) (j : ℕ) :
    IsPermWord k (w.rotate j)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(List.rotate_perm w j).nodup_iff.mpr h.1, ?_⟩
  rw [List.toFinset_eq_of_perm _ _ (List.rotate_perm w j), h.2]

name: Hunter.IsPermWord.perm
statement:
theorem IsPermWord.perm {k : ℕ} {w w' : List ℕ} (h : IsPermWord k w) (hp : w ~ w') :
    IsPermWord k w'
proof:
:=
  ⟨hp.nodup_iff.mp h.1, by rw [← List.toFinset_eq_of_perm _ _ hp, h.2]⟩

name: Hunter.isPermWord_of_isRotated
statement:
theorem isPermWord_of_isRotated {k : ℕ} {w w' : List ℕ} (h : IsPermWord k w)
    (hr : w ~r w') : IsPermWord k w'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hr; exact isPermWord_rotate h j

name: Hunter.wt_spec
statement:
theorem wt_spec {k : ℕ} {u v : List ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hu : u.length ≤ k) :
    1 ≤ wt k u v ∧ wt k u v ≤ k ∧ u.drop (wt k u v) = v.take (k - wt k u v)
proof:
:=
  Nat.sInf_mem (⟨k, hk, le_refl k, by simp [List.drop_eq_nil_of_le hu]⟩ :
    {d | 1 ≤ d ∧ d ≤ k ∧ u.drop d = v.take (k - d)}.Nonempty)

name: Hunter.wt_le
statement:
theorem wt_le {k : ℕ} {u v : List ℕ} {d : ℕ} (h1 : 1 ≤ d) (h2 : d ≤ k)
    (h3 : u.drop d = v.take (k - d)) : wt k u v ≤ d
proof:
:=
  Nat.sInf_le ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩

name: Hunter.wt_rho
statement:
theorem wt_rho {k : ℕ} {u : List ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hu : IsPermWord k u) :
    wt k u (rho u) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : u.length = k := hu.length
  have h1 : u.drop 1 = (rho u).take (k - 1) := by
    rw [rho, List.rotate_eq_drop_append_take (by omega),
      List.take_left' (by rw [List.length_drop]; omega)]
  have h2 := wt_le (le_refl 1) (by omega) h1
  have h3 := (wt_spec (u := u) (v := rho u) hk (by omega)).1
  omega

name: Hunter.eq_rho_of_wt_one
statement:
theorem eq_rho_of_wt_one {k : ℕ} {u v : List ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hu : IsPermWord k u)
    (hv : IsPermWord k v) (h : wt k u v = 1) : v = rho u
proof:
:= by
  have hspec := (wt_spec hk (le_of_eq hu.length) (v := v)).2.2
  rw [h] at hspec
  have hvlen := hv.length
  have hulen := hu.length
  obtain ⟨a, t, rfl⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil (hu.ne_nil hk)
  have hdrop : (a :: t).drop 1 = t := rfl
  rw [hdrop] at hspec
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ : ∃ z, v.drop (k - 1) = [z] := by
    apply List.length_eq_one_iff.mp
    rw [List.length_drop]; omega
  have hveq : v = t ++ [z] := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← List.take_append_drop (k - 1) v]
    rw [hz, ← hspec]
  have htlen : t.length = k - 1 := by
    have := hulen; simp only [List.length_cons] at this; omega
  have hza : z = a := by
    have hzIcc : z ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k := by
      rw [← hv.toFinset_eq, hveq]; simp
    have huIcc : (a :: t).toFinset = Finset.Icc 1 k := hu.toFinset_eq
    rw [List.toFinset_cons] at huIcc
    rw [← huIcc, Finset.mem_insert] at hzIcc
    rcases hzIcc with h1 | h1
    · exact h1
    · exfalso
      have hvnd := hv.nodup
      rw [hveq] at hvnd
      rw [List.nodup_append] at hvnd
      rw [List.mem_toFinset] at h1
      exact hvnd.2.2 z h1 z (List.mem_singleton_self z) rfl
  rw [hveq, hza]
  show t ++ [a] = (a :: t).rotate 1
  simp

name: Hunter.rotClass_eq_iff
statement: theorem rotClass_eq_iff {w w' : List ℕ} : rotClass w = rotClass w' ↔ w ~r w'
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h; exact Quotient.exact h
  · intro h; exact Quotient.sound h

name: Hunter.mem_permsOf
statement:
theorem mem_permsOf {S : Finset ℕ} {w : List ℕ} :
    w ∈ permsOf S ↔ w.Nodup ∧ w.toFinset = S
proof:
:= by
  rw [permsOf, List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_permutations]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨h.nodup_iff.mpr (S.sort_nodup _),
      by rw [List.toFinset_eq_of_perm _ _ h, S.sort_toFinset]⟩
  · rintro ⟨hnd, hS⟩
    exact List.perm_of_nodup_nodup_toFinset_eq hnd (S.sort_nodup _)
      (by rw [hS, S.sort_toFinset])

name: Hunter.permWords_finite
statement: theorem permWords_finite (k : ℕ) : {w | IsPermWord k w}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  have hset : {w | IsPermWord k w} = ↑(permsOf (Finset.Icc 1 k)) := by
    ext w
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Finset.mem_coe, mem_permsOf]
    exact ⟨fun h => ⟨h.nodup, h.toFinset_eq⟩, fun h => ⟨h.1, h.2⟩⟩
  rw [hset]; exact (permsOf _).finite_toSet

name: Hunter.door_perm
statement: theorem door_perm {w : List ℕ} (hw : 2 ≤ w.length) : door w ~ w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, s, rfl⟩ : ∃ a b s, w = a :: b :: s := by
    rcases w with _ | ⟨a, _ | ⟨b, s⟩⟩
    · simp at hw
    · simp at hw
    · exact ⟨a, b, s, rfl⟩
  have hdoor : door (a :: b :: s) = s ++ [b, a] := rfl
  rw [hdoor]
  calc s ++ [b, a] ~ [b, a] ++ s := List.perm_append_comm
    _ ~ [a, b] ++ s := ((List.Perm.swap b a []).append_right s).symm
    _ = a :: b :: s := rfl

name: Hunter.door_isPermWord
statement:
theorem door_isPermWord {k : ℕ} {w : List ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hw : IsPermWord k w) :
    IsPermWord k (door w)
proof:
:=
  hw.perm (door_perm (by rw [hw.length]; omega)).symm

name: Hunter.alphaWord_perm
statement: theorem alphaWord_perm {w : List ℕ} : alphaWord w ~ w
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : alphaWord w ~ w.drop 3 ++ w.take 3 :=
    (List.perm_append_left_iff _).mpr (List.reverse_perm _)
  have h2 : w.drop 3 ++ w.take 3 ~ w.take 3 ++ w.drop 3 := List.perm_append_comm
  rw [List.take_append_drop] at h2
  exact h1.trans h2

name: Hunter.alphaWord_isPermWord
statement:
theorem alphaWord_isPermWord {k : ℕ} {w : List ℕ} (hw : IsPermWord k w) :
    IsPermWord k (alphaWord w)
proof:
:=
  hw.perm alphaWord_perm.symm

name: Hunter.ProofsTail.terminalFrontierTail_of_excessFrontier
statement:
theorem terminalFrontierTail_of_excessFrontier (hfr : ExcessFrontier k) :

name: Hunter.ProofsTail.excessFrontier_of_terminalFrontierTail
statement:
theorem excessFrontier_of_terminalFrontierTail (hk : 4 ≤ k) (hG3 : TerminalFrontierTail k) :
    ExcessFrontier k
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp h0
  exact hG3 p hp h0 (ext_excess_ge_Dfr_block hk hp h0 (ProofsLast.defectiveDeepExit hk))

name: Hunter.ProofsTail.terminalFrontierTail_iff_m1WalkBound
statement:
theorem terminalFrontierTail_iff_m1WalkBound (hk : 4 ≤ k) :
    TerminalFrontierTail k ↔ M1WalkBound k
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hG3 => m1WalkBound_iff_excessFrontier.mpr (excessFrontier_of_terminalFrontierTail hk hG3),
   fun hM1 => terminalFrontierTail_of_excessFrontier (m1WalkBound_iff_excessFrontier.mp hM1)⟩

theorem terminalFrontierTail_iff_excessFrontier (hk : 4 ≤ k) :
