name: Hunter.ProofsTail.m1WalkBound_three
statement: theorem m1WalkBound_three : M1WalkBound 3
proof:
:= by
  intro q hqe h0
  have hcard : q.numVerts ≤ Fintype.card (Vtx 3) := q.nodup.length_le_card
  rw [ProofsRecursion.card_Vtx] at hcard
  have hle : q.numVerts ≤ 3 * (3 - 1) * (3 - 2) := by
    simp only [Nat.factorial] at hcard; omega
  exact ProofsRecursion.excess_frontier_base (by norm_num) hqe h0 hle

name: Hunter.ProofsTail.terminalFrontierTailAll_iff
statement: theorem terminalFrontierTailAll_iff : TerminalFrontierTailAll ↔ (∀ k, 4 ≤ k → M1WalkBound k)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hAll k hk => (terminalFrontierTail_iff_m1WalkBound hk).mp (hAll k hk),
   fun hAll k hk => (terminalFrontierTail_iff_m1WalkBound hk).mpr (hAll k hk)⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsTail.thm2All_of_tail
statement:
theorem thm2All_of_tail (hG3 : TerminalFrontierTailAll) :
    ∀ k ℓ, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k ℓ → j k ℓ ≤ iExitless k ℓ
proof:
:=
  fun k _ℓ hk hℓ => Proved.thm2_ge3_of_tail hk (fun h5 => hG3 k (by omega)) hℓ

name: Hunter.ProofsTail.thm1v1_of_tail_sharp
statement:
theorem thm1v1_of_tail_sharp (hG3 : TerminalFrontierTailAll)
    (hproof : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) →
        (L k : ℝ) ≥ (iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ)
          + (((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
              (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)))
            * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ))) :
    ∃ (C : ℝ) (k₀ : ℕ), ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k →
      (Lstar k : ℝ) ≥ coeff k * (k.factorial : ℝ) + (k : ℝ) - C
proof:
:=
  Proved.thm1v1_of_tail m1WalkBound_three hG3 hproof
    (fun k hk => Proved.hasExitlessPath_pivot k hk)

name: Hunter.ProofsTail.thm1v2_of_tail_sharp
statement:
theorem thm1v2_of_tail_sharp (hG3 : TerminalFrontierTailAll)
    (hproof : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) →
        (L k : ℝ) ≥ (iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ)
          + (((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
              (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)))
            * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ))) :
    ∃ (C : ℝ) (k₀ : ℕ), ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k → (L k : ℝ) ≥ coeff k * (k.factorial : ℝ) - C
proof:
:=
  Proved.thm1v2_of_tail m1WalkBound_three hG3 hproof
    (fun k hk => Proved.hasExitlessPath_pivot k hk)

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta4.door_getLastD
statement: theorem door_getLastD (w : List ℕ) : (door w).getLastD 0 = w.getD 0 0
proof:
:= by
  show (w.drop 2 ++ [w.getD 1 0, w.getD 0 0]).getLastD 0 = w.getD 0 0
  rw [show w.drop 2 ++ [w.getD 1 0, w.getD 0 0]
        = (w.drop 2 ++ [w.getD 1 0]) ++ [w.getD 0 0] from by simp, List.getLastD_concat]

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta4.rho_getLastD
statement: theorem rho_getLastD (w : List ℕ) : (rho w).getLastD 0 = w.getD 0 0
proof:
:= by
  cases w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a s =>
    show ((a :: s).rotate 1).getLastD 0 = a
    rw [show (a :: s).rotate 1 = s ++ [a] from by simp, List.getLastD_concat]

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta4.rotate_len_eq
statement: theorem rotate_len_eq (v : Vtx k) : (v : List ℕ).rotate k = v
proof:
:= by
  have hrl : (v : List ℕ).rotate k = (v : List ℕ).rotate (v : List ℕ).length := by
    rw [v.2.length]
  rw [hrl, List.rotate_length]

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta4.rho_boundary_prev
proof:
:= by
  have hkt : 0 < k * t := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)
  have hmul : k * t = k * (t - 1) + k := by
    conv_lhs => rw [show t = (t - 1) + 1 from by omega]
    rw [Nat.mul_succ]
  have heq : k * (t - 1) + (k - 1) = k * t - 1 := by omega
  have hlt : k * (t - 1) + (k - 1) < p.numVerts := by rw [heq]; omega
  have hbc := block_is_full_cycle hk hp (⟨t - 1, rfl⟩ : k ∣ k * (t - 1)) (by omega : k - 1 < k) hlt
  rw [heq] at hbc
  show (p.vert (k * t - 1) : List ℕ).rotate 1 = (p.vert (k * (t - 1)) : List ℕ)
  rw [hbc, sigma_iter_val, List.rotate_rotate, show (k - 1) + 1 = k from by omega]
  exact rotate_len_eq _

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta4.metaWord_door_block
statement:
theorem metaWord_door_block (hk : 2 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) {t α₁ : ℕ}
    (ht : 1 ≤ t) (hN : k * t < p.numVerts)
    (hw : ew k (p.vert (k * t - 1)) (p.vert (k * t)) = 2)
    (hmk : (p.vert (k * (t - 1)) : List ℕ).getLastD 0 = α₁) :
    (p.vert (k * t) : List ℕ).erase α₁ = ((p.vert (k * (t - 1)) : List ℕ).erase α₁).rotate 1
proof:
:= by
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
  have hkt : 0 < k * t := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)
  have hi1 : k * t - 1 + 1 = k * t := by omega
  have hrho := rho_boundary_prev hk1 hp ht (by omega : k * t ≤ p.numVerts)
  have hdyn : (rho (p.vert (k * t - 1) : List ℕ)).getLastD 0 = α₁ := by rw [hrho]; exact hmk
  have hstep := metaWord_door_step hk hp (i := k * t - 1) (by rw [hi1]; exact hN)
    (by rw [hi1]; exact ⟨t, rfl⟩) (by rw [hi1]; exact hw)
  rw [hi1, hdyn, hrho] at hstep
  exact hstep

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta4.metaWord_alpha_block
statement:
theorem metaWord_alpha_block (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) {t α₁ : ℕ}
    (ht : 1 ≤ t) (hN : k * t < p.numVerts)
    (hw : ew k (p.vert (k * t - 1)) (p.vert (k * t)) = 3)
    (hmark : (p.vert (k * t) : List ℕ).getLastD 0
      = (rho (p.vert (k * t - 1) : List ℕ)).getLastD 0)
    (hα : (p.vert (k * t) : List ℕ) = alphaWord (p.vert (k * t - 1) : List ℕ))
    (hmk : (p.vert (k * (t - 1)) : List ℕ).getLastD 0 = α₁) :
    (p.vert (k * t) : List ℕ).erase α₁ = door ((p.vert (k * (t - 1)) : List ℕ).erase α₁)
proof:
:= by
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
  have hkt : 0 < k * t := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)
  have hi1 : k * t - 1 + 1 = k * t := by omega
  have hrho := rho_boundary_prev hk1 hp ht (by omega : k * t ≤ p.numVerts)
  have hdyn : (rho (p.vert (k * t - 1) : List ℕ)).getLastD 0 = α₁ := by rw [hrho]; exact hmk
  have hstep := metaWord_alpha_step hk (i := k * t - 1) (by rw [hi1]; exact hN)
    (by rw [hi1]; exact hw) (by rw [hi1]; exact hmark) (by rw [hi1]; exact hα)
  rw [hi1, hdyn, hrho] at hstep
  exact hstep

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta4.marker_door_step
statement:
theorem marker_door_step (hk : 2 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) {t α₁ : ℕ}
    (ht : 1 ≤ t) (hN : k * t < p.numVerts)
    (hw : ew k (p.vert (k * t - 1)) (p.vert (k * t)) = 2)
    (hmk : (p.vert (k * (t - 1)) : List ℕ).getLastD 0 = α₁) :
    (p.vert (k * t) : List ℕ).getLastD 0 = α₁
proof:
:= by
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
  have hkt : 0 < k * t := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)
  have hi1 : k * t - 1 + 1 = k * t := by omega
  have hrho := rho_boundary_prev hk1 hp ht (by omega : k * t ≤ p.numVerts)
  have hdoor := door_of_boundary hk hp (i := k * t - 1) (by rw [hi1]; exact hN)
    (by rw [hi1]; exact ⟨t, rfl⟩) (by rw [hi1]; exact hw)
  rw [hi1] at hdoor
  rw [hdoor, door_getLastD, ← rho_getLastD, hrho]; exact hmk

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta4.marker_alpha_step
statement:
theorem marker_alpha_step (hk : 1 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) {t α₁ : ℕ}
    (ht : 1 ≤ t) (hN : k * t ≤ p.numVerts)
    (hmark : (p.vert (k * t) : List ℕ).getLastD 0
      = (rho (p.vert (k * t - 1) : List ℕ)).getLastD 0)
    (hmk : (p.vert (k * (t - 1)) : List ℕ).getLastD 0 = α₁) :
    (p.vert (k * t) : List ℕ).getLastD 0 = α₁
proof:
:= by
  rw [hmark, rho_boundary_prev hk hp ht hN]; exact hmk

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta4.meta_confinement'
statement:
theorem meta_confinement' (hk : 3 ≤ k) {α₁ α₂ : ℕ} {K : RotClass}
    {Astar : ℕ → Vtx k} {m : ℕ} (blk : Fin m × Fin (k - 1) → Vtx k)
    (hα1 : α₁ = (Astar 0 : List ℕ).getLastD 0)
    (hα2 : α₂ = ((Astar 0 : List ℕ).dropLast).getLastD 0)
    (hK : K = rotClass ((Astar 0 : List ℕ).dropLast.dropLast))
    (hlen : ∀ j, j < m → ((Astar j : List ℕ).erase α₁).length = k - 1)
    (hstep : ∀ j, j + 1 < m → (Astar (j + 1) : List ℕ).erase α₁ =
        door (((Astar j : List ℕ).erase α₁).rotate (k - 2)))
    (hblk : ∀ i : Fin m × Fin (k - 1),
        (blk i : List ℕ).erase α₁ = ((Astar i.1 : List ℕ).erase α₁).rotate i.2)
    (hcyc : ∀ i i', i ≠ i' → rotClass (blk i : List ℕ) ≠ rotClass (blk i' : List ℕ)) :
    m ≤ k - 2
proof:
:= by
  have herase0 : (Astar 0 : List ℕ).erase α₁ = (Astar 0 : List ℕ).dropLast := by
    rw [hα1, erase_getLastD (Astar 0).2.nodup]
  have hg0 : genLoop ((Astar 0 : List ℕ).erase α₁) = (α₂, K) := by
    rw [herase0, genLoop, ← hα2, ← hK]
  have hinv : ∀ j, j < m → genLoop ((Astar j : List ℕ).erase α₁) = (α₂, K) := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero => intro _; exact hg0
    | succ j ih =>
      intro hj
      rw [hstep j hj]
      have hlenj := hlen j (by omega)
      have hrot : (((Astar j : List ℕ).erase α₁).rotate (k - 2)).rotate 1 =
          (Astar j : List ℕ).erase α₁ := by
        rw [List.rotate_rotate, show (k - 2) + 1 = k - 1 from by omega, ← hlenj, List.rotate_length]
      have h2le : 2 ≤ (((Astar j : List ℕ).erase α₁).rotate (k - 2)).length := by
        rw [List.length_rotate, hlenj]; omega
      rw [genLoop_door_eq_rho_of_len h2le]
      show genLoop ((((Astar j : List ℕ).erase α₁).rotate (k - 2)).rotate 1) = (α₂, K)
      rw [hrot]; exact ih (by omega)
  have hmemStar : ∀ j, j < m → Astar j ∈ Vset3 k α₁ α₂ K :=
    fun j hj => mem_Vset3_of_genLoop_metaWord (hinv j hj)
  have hmemBlk : ∀ i : Fin m × Fin (k - 1), blk i ∈ Vset3 k α₁ α₂ K := fun i =>
    Vset3_of_metaWord_rotate_iter (hmemStar i.1 i.1.isLt) (hblk i)
  exact meta_pigeonhole hk hα1 hα2 hK blk hmemBlk hcyc

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta4.alpha_run_bound
statement:
theorem alpha_run_bound (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) (t₀ m : ℕ)
    (hN : k * (t₀ + m * (k - 1)) ≤ p.numVerts)
    (hdoor : ∀ j r, j < m → 1 ≤ r → r ≤ k - 2 →
        ew k (p.vert (k * (t₀ + j * (k - 1) + r) - 1))
          (p.vert (k * (t₀ + j * (k - 1) + r))) = 2)
    (halpha : ∀ c, 1 ≤ c → c < m →
        ew k (p.vert (k * (t₀ + c * (k - 1)) - 1)) (p.vert (k * (t₀ + c * (k - 1)))) = 3 ∧
        (p.vert (k * (t₀ + c * (k - 1))) : List ℕ).getLastD 0
          = (rho (p.vert (k * (t₀ + c * (k - 1)) - 1) : List ℕ)).getLastD 0 ∧
        (p.vert (k * (t₀ + c * (k - 1))) : List ℕ)
          = alphaWord (p.vert (k * (t₀ + c * (k - 1)) - 1) : List ℕ)) :
    m ≤ k - 2
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with hm0 | hmpos
  · subst hm0; omega
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
  have hk2 : 2 ≤ k := by omega
  
  have hSpos : 1 ≤ t₀ + m * (k - 1) := by
    have h1 : 1 * (k - 1) ≤ m * (k - 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul hmpos (le_refl _); omega
  have hposlt : ∀ T, T ≤ t₀ + m * (k - 1) - 1 → k * T < p.numVerts := by
    intro T hT
    have hSk : k * (t₀ + m * (k - 1) - 1) + k = k * (t₀ + m * (k - 1)) := by
      conv_rhs => rw [show t₀ + m * (k - 1) = (t₀ + m * (k - 1) - 1) + 1 from by omega]
      rw [Nat.mul_succ]
    calc k * T ≤ k * (t₀ + m * (k - 1) - 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) hT
      _ < k * (t₀ + m * (k - 1)) := by omega
      _ ≤ p.numVerts := hN
  have hAr_le : ∀ j, j < m → ∀ r, r ≤ k - 2 → t₀ + j * (k - 1) + r ≤ t₀ + m * (k - 1) - 1 := by
    intro j hj r hr
    have hjm : j * (k - 1) ≤ (m - 1) * (k - 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (le_refl _)
    have hm1 : (m - 1) * (k - 1) + (k - 1) = m * (k - 1) := by
      conv_rhs => rw [show m = (m - 1) + 1 from by omega]
      rw [Nat.succ_mul]
    omega
  have hblklt : ∀ j, j < m → ∀ r, r ≤ k - 2 → k * (t₀ + j * (k - 1) + r) < p.numVerts :=
    fun j hj r hr => hposlt _ (hAr_le j hj r hr)
  have hc_le : ∀ c, c < m → t₀ + c * (k - 1) ≤ t₀ + m * (k - 1) - 1 := by
    intro c hc
    have hcm : c * (k - 1) ≤ (m - 1) * (k - 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (le_refl _)
    have hm1 : (m - 1) * (k - 1) + (k - 1) = m * (k - 1) := by
      conv_rhs => rw [show m = (m - 1) + 1 from by omega]
      rw [Nat.succ_mul]
    omega
  
  set α₁ : ℕ := (p.vert (k * t₀) : List ℕ).getLastD 0 with hα1def
  set α₂ : ℕ := ((p.vert (k * t₀) : List ℕ).dropLast).getLastD 0 with hα2def
  set K : RotClass := rotClass ((p.vert (k * t₀) : List ℕ).dropLast.dropLast) with hKdef
  
  have hmkInner : ∀ j, j < m → (p.vert (k * (t₀ + j * (k - 1))) : List ℕ).getLastD 0 = α₁ →
      ∀ r, r ≤ k - 2 → (p.vert (k * (t₀ + j * (k - 1) + r)) : List ℕ).getLastD 0 = α₁ := by
    intro j hj hstart r
    induction r with
    | zero => intro _; rw [Nat.add_zero]; exact hstart
    | succ r ih =>
      intro hr
      have hrle : r ≤ k - 2 := by omega
      exact marker_door_step hk2 hp (t := t₀ + j * (k - 1) + (r + 1)) (by omega)
        (hblklt j hj (r + 1) hr) (hdoor j (r + 1) hj (by omega) hr) (ih hrle)
  have hmkStart : ∀ j, j < m → (p.vert (k * (t₀ + j * (k - 1))) : List ℕ).getLastD 0 = α₁ := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero =>
      intro _
      rw [show t₀ + 0 * (k - 1) = t₀ from by omega, hα1def]
    | succ j ih =>
      intro hj
      have hstartj := ih (by omega)
      have hinner := hmkInner j (by omega) hstartj (k - 2) (le_refl _)
      obtain ⟨_, hmark, _⟩ := halpha (j + 1) (by omega) hj
      have hmkprevA : (p.vert (k * (t₀ + (j + 1) * (k - 1) - 1)) : List ℕ).getLastD 0 = α₁ := by
        rw [show t₀ + (j + 1) * (k - 1) - 1 = t₀ + j * (k - 1) + (k - 2) from by
          have he : (j + 1) * (k - 1) = j * (k - 1) + (k - 1) := Nat.succ_mul j (k - 1); omega]
        exact hinner
      exact marker_alpha_step hk1 hp (t := t₀ + (j + 1) * (k - 1))
        (by have h : 1 * 1 ≤ (j + 1) * (k - 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.succ_pos j) (by omega); omega)
        (le_of_lt (hposlt _ (hc_le (j + 1) hj))) hmark hmkprevA
  have hmkAll : ∀ j, j < m → ∀ r, r ≤ k - 2 →
      (p.vert (k * (t₀ + j * (k - 1) + r)) : List ℕ).getLastD 0 = α₁ :=
    fun j hj r hr => hmkInner j hj (hmkStart j hj) r hr
  
  have hrot : ∀ j, j < m → ∀ r, r ≤ k - 2 →
      (p.vert (k * (t₀ + j * (k - 1) + r)) : List ℕ).erase α₁
        = ((p.vert (k * (t₀ + j * (k - 1))) : List ℕ).erase α₁).rotate r := by
    intro j hj r
    induction r with
    | zero => intro _; rw [Nat.add_zero, List.rotate_zero]
    | succ r ih =>
      intro hr
      have hrle : r ≤ k - 2 := by omega
      have hstep := metaWord_door_block hk2 hp (t := t₀ + j * (k - 1) + (r + 1)) (by omega)
        (hblklt j hj (r + 1) hr) (hdoor j (r + 1) hj (by omega) hr) (hmkAll j hj r hrle)
      rw [hstep, show t₀ + j * (k - 1) + (r + 1) - 1 = t₀ + j * (k - 1) + r from by omega,
          ih hrle, List.rotate_rotate]
  
  have hstepMC : ∀ j, j + 1 < m →
      (p.vert (k * (t₀ + (j + 1) * (k - 1))) : List ℕ).erase α₁
        = door (((p.vert (k * (t₀ + j * (k - 1))) : List ℕ).erase α₁).rotate (k - 2)) := by
    intro j hj
    obtain ⟨hw3, hmark, hα⟩ := halpha (j + 1) (by omega) hj
    have hmkprev : (p.vert (k * (t₀ + (j + 1) * (k - 1) - 1)) : List ℕ).getLastD 0 = α₁ := by
      rw [show t₀ + (j + 1) * (k - 1) - 1 = t₀ + j * (k - 1) + (k - 2) from by
        have he : (j + 1) * (k - 1) = j * (k - 1) + (k - 1) := Nat.succ_mul j (k - 1); omega]
      exact hmkAll j (by omega) (k - 2) (le_refl _)
    have hab := metaWord_alpha_block hk hp (t := t₀ + (j + 1) * (k - 1))
      (by have h : 1 * 1 ≤ (j + 1) * (k - 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.succ_pos j) (by omega); omega)
      (hposlt _ (hc_le (j + 1) hj)) hw3 hmark hα hmkprev
    rw [hab, show t₀ + (j + 1) * (k - 1) - 1 = t₀ + j * (k - 1) + (k - 2) from by
        have he : (j + 1) * (k - 1) = j * (k - 1) + (k - 1) := Nat.succ_mul j (k - 1); omega,
        hrot j (by omega) (k - 2) (le_refl _)]
  
  have hlenMC : ∀ j, j < m →
      ((p.vert (k * (t₀ + j * (k - 1))) : List ℕ).erase α₁).length = k - 1 := by
    intro j hj
    rw [← hmkStart j hj, erase_getLastD (p.vert (k * (t₀ + j * (k - 1)))).2.nodup,
        List.length_dropLast, (p.vert (k * (t₀ + j * (k - 1)))).2.length]
  
  have hninj : ∀ a a' : Fin m × Fin (k - 1),
      (a.1 : ℕ) * (k - 1) + (a.2 : ℕ) = (a'.1 : ℕ) * (k - 1) + (a'.2 : ℕ) → a = a' := by
    intro a a' h
    have hd : 0 < k - 1 := by omega
    have h2 : (a.2 : ℕ) = (a'.2 : ℕ) := by
      have e1 : ((a.1 : ℕ) * (k - 1) + (a.2 : ℕ)) % (k - 1) = (a.2 : ℕ) := by
        rw [Nat.mul_comm (a.1 : ℕ) (k - 1), Nat.mul_add_mod, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt a.2.isLt]
      have e2 : ((a'.1 : ℕ) * (k - 1) + (a'.2 : ℕ)) % (k - 1) = (a'.2 : ℕ) := by
        rw [Nat.mul_comm (a'.1 : ℕ) (k - 1), Nat.mul_add_mod, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt a'.2.isLt]
      rw [← e1, ← e2, h]
    have h1 : (a.1 : ℕ) = (a'.1 : ℕ) :=
      Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right hd (by omega)
    exact Prod.ext (Fin.ext h1) (Fin.ext h2)
  have hkey : ∀ a a' : Fin m × Fin (k - 1),
      (a.1 : ℕ) * (k - 1) + (a.2 : ℕ) < (a'.1 : ℕ) * (k - 1) + (a'.2 : ℕ) →
      rotClass (p.vert (k * (t₀ + (a.1 : ℕ) * (k - 1) + (a.2 : ℕ))) : List ℕ)
        ≠ rotClass (p.vert (k * (t₀ + (a'.1 : ℕ) * (k - 1) + (a'.2 : ℕ))) : List ℕ) := by
    intro a a' hlt
    have hBk : k * (t₀ + (a.1 : ℕ) * (k - 1) + (a.2 : ℕ)) + k
        ≤ k * (t₀ + (a'.1 : ℕ) * (k - 1) + (a'.2 : ℕ)) := by
      rw [(Nat.mul_succ k _).symm]
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) (by omega)
    have hB'n : k * (t₀ + (a'.1 : ℕ) * (k - 1) + (a'.2 : ℕ)) < p.numVerts :=
      hposlt _ (hAr_le a'.1 a'.1.isLt a'.2 (by have := a'.2.isLt; omega))
    exact no_reentry hk1 hp ⟨_, rfl⟩ hBk hB'n
  have hcycMC : ∀ i i' : Fin m × Fin (k - 1), i ≠ i' →
      rotClass (p.vert (k * (t₀ + (i.1 : ℕ) * (k - 1) + (i.2 : ℕ))) : List ℕ)
        ≠ rotClass (p.vert (k * (t₀ + (i'.1 : ℕ) * (k - 1) + (i'.2 : ℕ))) : List ℕ) := by
    intro i i' hne
    rcases lt_trichotomy ((i.1 : ℕ) * (k - 1) + (i.2 : ℕ)) ((i'.1 : ℕ) * (k - 1) + (i'.2 : ℕ))
      with h | h | h
    · exact hkey i i' h
    · exact absurd (hninj i i' h) hne
    · exact (hkey i' i h).symm
  
  refine meta_confinement' hk (α₁ := α₁) (α₂ := α₂) (K := K)
    (Astar := fun j => p.vert (k * (t₀ + j * (k - 1))))
    (blk := fun i => p.vert (k * (t₀ + (i.1 : ℕ) * (k - 1) + (i.2 : ℕ))))
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · show α₁ = (p.vert (k * (t₀ + 0 * (k - 1))) : List ℕ).getLastD 0
    rw [hα1def, show t₀ + 0 * (k - 1) = t₀ from by omega]
  · show α₂ = ((p.vert (k * (t₀ + 0 * (k - 1))) : List ℕ).dropLast).getLastD 0
    rw [hα2def, show t₀ + 0 * (k - 1) = t₀ from by omega]
  · show K = rotClass ((p.vert (k * (t₀ + 0 * (k - 1))) : List ℕ).dropLast.dropLast)
    rw [hKdef, show t₀ + 0 * (k - 1) = t₀ from by omega]
  · exact hlenMC
  · exact hstepMC
  · exact fun i => hrot i.1 i.1.isLt i.2 (by have := i.2.isLt; omega)
  · exact hcycMC

name: Hunter.Proved.alpha_run_bound
statement:
theorem alpha_run_bound {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) (t₀ m : ℕ)
    (hN : k * (t₀ + m * (k - 1)) ≤ p.numVerts)
    (hdoor : ∀ j r, j < m → 1 ≤ r → r ≤ k - 2 →
        ew k (p.vert (k * (t₀ + j * (k - 1) + r) - 1))
          (p.vert (k * (t₀ + j * (k - 1) + r))) = 2)
    (halpha : ∀ c, 1 ≤ c → c < m →
        ew k (p.vert (k * (t₀ + c * (k - 1)) - 1)) (p.vert (k * (t₀ + c * (k - 1)))) = 3 ∧
        (p.vert (k * (t₀ + c * (k - 1))) : List ℕ).getLastD 0
          = (rho (p.vert (k * (t₀ + c * (k - 1)) - 1) : List ℕ)).getLastD 0 ∧
        (p.vert (k * (t₀ + c * (k - 1))) : List ℕ)
          = alphaWord (p.vert (k * (t₀ + c * (k - 1)) - 1) : List ℕ)) :
    m ≤ k - 2
proof:
:=
  ProofsMeta4.alpha_run_bound hk hp t₀ m hN hdoor halpha

name: Hunter.Proved.runs_pay
statement:
theorem runs_pay {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) (t₀ m : ℕ)
    (hN : k * (t₀ + m * (k - 1)) ≤ p.numVerts)
    (hdoor : ∀ j r, j < m → 1 ≤ r → r ≤ k - 2 →
        ew k (p.vert (k * (t₀ + j * (k - 1) + r) - 1))
          (p.vert (k * (t₀ + j * (k - 1) + r))) = 2)
    (halpha : ∀ c, 1 ≤ c → c < m →
        ew k (p.vert (k * (t₀ + c * (k - 1)) - 1)) (p.vert (k * (t₀ + c * (k - 1)))) = 3 ∧
        (p.vert (k * (t₀ + c * (k - 1))) : List ℕ).getLastD 0
          = (rho (p.vert (k * (t₀ + c * (k - 1)) - 1) : List ℕ)).getLastD 0 ∧
        (p.vert (k * (t₀ + c * (k - 1))) : List ℕ)
          = alphaWord (p.vert (k * (t₀ + c * (k - 1)) - 1) : List ℕ)) :
    m ≤ k - 2 ∧
    ∀ c, 1 ≤ c → c < m →
      ew k (p.vert (k * (t₀ + c * (k - 1)) - 1)) (p.vert (k * (t₀ + c * (k - 1)))) - 2 = 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨ProofsMeta4.alpha_run_bound hk hp t₀ m hN hdoor halpha,
   fun c hc1 hcm => by have h := (halpha c hc1 hcm).1; omega⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsLanding.weight3_markerMove_last
statement:
theorem weight3_markerMove_last {x v : List ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hx : IsPermWord k x)
    (hv : IsPermWord k v) (hover : x.drop 3 = v.take (k - 3))
    (hmark : v.getLastD 0 ≠ (rho x).getLastD 0) :
    v.getLastD 0 = x.getD 1 0 ∨ v.getLastD 0 = x.getD 2 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, t, rfl⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil (hx.ne_nil (by omega))
  obtain ⟨b, c, s, rfl⟩ : ∃ b c s, t = b :: c :: s := by
    rcases t with _ | ⟨b, _ | ⟨c, s⟩⟩
    · have := hx.length; simp at this; omega
    · have := hx.length; simp at this; omega
    · exact ⟨b, c, s, rfl⟩
  
  have hxlen : (a :: b :: c :: s).length = k := hx.length
  have hslen : s.length = k - 3 := by simp at hxlen; omega
  have hdrop : (a :: b :: c :: s).drop 3 = s := rfl
  
  have hrho : rho (a :: b :: c :: s) = (b :: c :: s) ++ [a] := by
    show (a :: b :: c :: s).rotate 1 = _; simp
  have hmarkval : (rho (a :: b :: c :: s)).getLastD 0 = a := by
    rw [hrho, show (b :: c :: s) ++ [a] = ((b :: c :: s) ++ [a]) by rfl, List.getLastD_concat]
  rw [hmarkval] at hmark
  
  have hg1 : (a :: b :: c :: s).getD 1 0 = b := rfl
  have hg2 : (a :: b :: c :: s).getD 2 0 = c := rfl
  rw [hg1, hg2]
  
  set r := v.drop (k - 3) with hr
  have hvsplit : v = s ++ r := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← List.take_append_drop (k - 3) v]
    rw [← hover, hdrop]
  have hrlen : r.length = 3 := by rw [hr, List.length_drop, hv.length]; omega
  
  have hnd : (a :: b :: c :: s).Nodup := hx.nodup
  have hab' : a ∉ (b :: c :: s) := (List.nodup_cons.mp hnd).1
  have hbcs : (b :: c :: s).Nodup := (List.nodup_cons.mp hnd).2
  have hbc' : b ∉ (c :: s) := (List.nodup_cons.mp hbcs).1
  have hcs : (c :: s).Nodup := (List.nodup_cons.mp hbcs).2
  have hcs' : c ∉ s := (List.nodup_cons.mp hcs).1
  have has : a ∉ s := fun h => hab' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h))
  have hbs : b ∉ s := fun h => hbc' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h)
  
  obtain ⟨x1, x2, x3, hxyz⟩ := List.length_eq_three.mp hrlen
  have hgl : v.getLastD 0 = x3 := by
    rw [hvsplit, hxyz, show s ++ [x1, x2, x3] = (s ++ [x1, x2]) ++ [x3] by simp,
        List.getLastD_concat]
  rw [hgl] at hmark ⊢
  
  have hsymbols : v.toFinset = (a :: b :: c :: s).toFinset := by
    rw [hv.toFinset_eq, hx.toFinset_eq]
  have hx3v : x3 ∈ v := by
    rw [hvsplit, hxyz]; exact List.mem_append_right _ (by simp)
  have hx3mem : x3 = a ∨ x3 = b ∨ x3 = c ∨ x3 ∈ s := by
    have hmem : x3 ∈ (a :: b :: c :: s) := by
      have : x3 ∈ v.toFinset := List.mem_toFinset.mpr hx3v
      rw [hsymbols, List.mem_toFinset] at this; exact this
    rw [List.mem_cons, List.mem_cons, List.mem_cons] at hmem; exact hmem
  
  have hvnd : v.Nodup := hv.nodup
  have hx3ns : x3 ∉ s := by
    rw [hvsplit, hxyz] at hvnd
    have hdisj := (List.nodup_append.mp hvnd).2.2
    intro hmem
    exact hdisj x3 hmem x3 (by simp) rfl
  
  rcases hx3mem with h | h | h | h
  · exact absurd h hmark
  · exact Or.inl h
  · exact Or.inr h
  · exact absurd h hx3ns

name: Hunter.ProofsLanding.weight3_markerMove_mem
statement:
theorem weight3_markerMove_mem {x v : List ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hx : IsPermWord k x)
    (hv : IsPermWord k v) (hover : x.drop 3 = v.take (k - 3))
    (hmark : v.getLastD 0 ≠ (rho x).getLastD 0) :
    v.getLastD 0 ∈ [x.getD 1 0, x.getD 2 0]
proof:
:= by
  have h := weight3_markerMove_last hk hx hv hover hmark
  rw [List.mem_cons, List.mem_cons]
  rcases h with h | h
  · exact Or.inl h
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)

name: Hunter.ProofsWP.weakStep_symm
statement:
theorem weakStep_symm {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} {u v : Vtx k}
    (h : weakStep X u v) : weakStep X v u
proof: := Or.symm h

name: Hunter.ProofsWP.weakConn_symm
statement:
theorem weakConn_symm {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} {u v : Vtx k}
    (h : weakConn X u v) : weakConn X v u
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  | tail _ hbc ih => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.head (weakStep_symm hbc) ih

name: Hunter.ProofsWP.mem_block
statement:
theorem mem_block {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} {v u : Vtx k} :
    u ∈ block X v ↔ u ∈ vertsOf X ∧ weakConn X v u
proof: := Finset.mem_filter

name: Hunter.ProofsWP.self_mem_block
statement:
theorem self_mem_block {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} {v : Vtx k} (hv : v ∈ vertsOf X) :
    v ∈ block X v
proof: := mem_block.mpr ⟨hv, Relation.ReflTransGen.refl⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsWP.block_eq_of_conn
statement:
theorem block_eq_of_conn {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} {v w : Vtx k}
    (h : weakConn X v w) : block X v = block X w
proof:
:= by
  ext u
  simp only [mem_block]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hu, hvu⟩; exact ⟨hu, (weakConn_symm h).trans hvu⟩
  · rintro ⟨hu, hwu⟩; exact ⟨hu, h.trans hwu⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsWP.comps_eq_image
statement:
theorem comps_eq_image (X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)) :
    Comps X = (vertsOf X).image (block X)
proof: := rfl

name: Hunter.ProofsWP.mem_comps
statement:
theorem mem_comps {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} {C : Finset (Vtx k)} :
    C ∈ Comps X ↔ ∃ v ∈ vertsOf X, block X v = C
proof:
:= by
  rw [comps_eq_image, Finset.mem_image]

name: Hunter.ProofsWP.block_mem_comps
statement:
theorem block_mem_comps {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} {v : Vtx k} (hv : v ∈ vertsOf X) :
    block X v ∈ Comps X
proof: := mem_comps.mpr ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsWP.comp_eq_block_of_mem
statement:
theorem comp_eq_block_of_mem {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} {C : Finset (Vtx k)} {u : Vtx k}
    (hC : C ∈ Comps X) (hu : u ∈ C) : C = block X u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := mem_comps.mp hC
  exact (block_eq_of_conn (mem_block.mp hu).2)

name: Hunter.ProofsWP.mem_vertsOf
statement:
theorem mem_vertsOf {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} {v : Vtx k} :
    v ∈ vertsOf X ↔ ∃ e ∈ X, v = e.1 ∨ v = e.2
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertsOf, Finset.mem_filter]
  exact ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, h⟩⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsWP.comps_disjoint
statement:
theorem comps_disjoint {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} {C C' : Finset (Vtx k)}
    (hC : C ∈ Comps X) (hC' : C' ∈ Comps X) (hne : C ≠ C') : Disjoint C C'
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro v hv hv'
  exact hne ((comp_eq_block_of_mem hC hv).trans (comp_eq_block_of_mem hC' hv').symm)

name: Hunter.ProofsWP.compTails_subset
statement:
theorem compTails_subset {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} {C : Finset (Vtx k)} :
    compTails X C ⊆ C
proof: := Finset.filter_subset _ _

name: Hunter.ProofsWP.compHeads_subset
statement:
theorem compHeads_subset {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} {C : Finset (Vtx k)} :
    compHeads X C ⊆ C
proof: := Finset.filter_subset _ _

name: Hunter.ProofsWP.compHeads_eq
statement:
theorem compHeads_eq {p : HPath k} {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)}
    (hp : IsPathComponent p X) : compHeads X p.vertsFinset = {p.last}
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  rw [compHeads, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hvV, hout⟩
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := ProofsStructure.out_edge_of_ne_last (HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mp hvV) hne
    have hwX : (v, w) ∈ X := hp.1 hw
    have hmem : (v, w) ∈ outV X v := by
      rw [outV, mem_out]; exact ⟨hwX, Finset.mem_singleton_self v⟩
    rw [hout] at hmem; exact absurd hmem (Finset.notMem_empty _)
  · rintro rfl
    refine ⟨HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mpr p.last_mem, ?_⟩
    rw [Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
    rintro e he
    rw [outV, mem_out, Finset.mem_singleton] at he
    obtain ⟨heX, he1⟩ := he
    have h1V : e.1 ∈ p.vertsFinset := by rw [he1]; exact HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mpr p.last_mem
    have hee : e ∈ p.edges := hp.2.2 e heX h1V
    exact (ProofsStructure.ne_last_of_out_edge hee) he1

name: Hunter.ProofsWP.tails_eq_biUnion
statement:
theorem tails_eq_biUnion {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} (hV : vertsOf X = Finset.univ) :
    tails X = (Comps X).biUnion (compTails X)
proof:
:= by
  ext t
  rw [Finset.mem_biUnion]
  constructor
  · intro ht
    rw [tails, Finset.mem_filter] at ht
    have htv : t ∈ vertsOf X := hV ▸ Finset.mem_univ t
    refine ⟨block X t, block_mem_comps htv, ?_⟩
    rw [compTails, Finset.mem_filter]
    exact ⟨self_mem_block htv, ht.2⟩
  · rintro ⟨C, _, htC⟩
    rw [compTails, Finset.mem_filter] at htC
    rw [tails, Finset.mem_filter]
    exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, htC.2⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsWP.heads_eq_biUnion
statement:
theorem heads_eq_biUnion {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} (hV : vertsOf X = Finset.univ) :
    heads X = (Comps X).biUnion (compHeads X)
proof:
:= by
  ext t
  rw [Finset.mem_biUnion]
  constructor
  · intro ht
    rw [heads, Finset.mem_filter] at ht
    have htv : t ∈ vertsOf X := hV ▸ Finset.mem_univ t
    refine ⟨block X t, block_mem_comps htv, ?_⟩
    rw [compHeads, Finset.mem_filter]
    exact ⟨self_mem_block htv, ht.2⟩
  · rintro ⟨C, _, htC⟩
    rw [compHeads, Finset.mem_filter] at htC
    rw [heads, Finset.mem_filter]
    exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, htC.2⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsWP.card_tails_eq_numComps
statement:
theorem card_tails_eq_numComps {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} (hV : vertsOf X = Finset.univ)
    (hsingle : ∀ C ∈ Comps X, ∃ t, compTails X C = {t}) :
    (tails X).card = numComps X
proof:
:= by
  rw [tails_eq_biUnion hV,
    Finset.card_biUnion (fun C hC C' hC' hne =>
      (comps_disjoint hC hC' hne).mono compTails_subset compTails_subset)]
  have hone : ∀ C ∈ Comps X, (compTails X C).card = 1 := by
    intro C hC; obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hsingle C hC; rw [ht, Finset.card_singleton]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hone, Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, numComps]

name: Hunter.ProofsWP.card_heads_eq_numComps
statement:
theorem card_heads_eq_numComps {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} (hV : vertsOf X = Finset.univ)
    (hsingle : ∀ C ∈ Comps X, ∃ t, compHeads X C = {t}) :
    (heads X).card = numComps X
proof:
:= by
  rw [heads_eq_biUnion hV,
    Finset.card_biUnion (fun C hC C' hC' hne =>
      (comps_disjoint hC hC' hne).mono compHeads_subset compHeads_subset)]
  have hone : ∀ C ∈ Comps X, (compHeads X C).card = 1 := by
    intro C hC; obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hsingle C hC; rw [ht, Finset.card_singleton]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hone, Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, numComps]

name: Hunter.ProofsWP.vertsFinset_univ_of_ham
statement:
theorem vertsFinset_univ_of_ham {P : HPath k} (hP : P.IsHamiltonian) :
    P.vertsFinset = Finset.univ
proof:
:=
  Finset.eq_univ_of_forall (fun v => HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mpr (hP v))

name: Hunter.ProofsWP.edge_ends_mem
statement:
theorem edge_ends_mem {p : HPath k} {e : Vtx k × Vtx k} (he : e ∈ p.edges) :
    e.1 ∈ p.verts ∧ e.2 ∈ p.verts
proof:
:= by
  rw [ProofsSpine.mem_edges_iff] at he
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := List.of_mem_zip he
  exact ⟨h1, p.verts.tail_sublist.subset h2⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsWP.isPathComponent_self
statement: theorem isPathComponent_self (p : HPath k) : IsPathComponent p p.edges
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨subset_rfl, fun e he => ?_, fun e he _ => he⟩
  constructor
  · intro _; exact HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mpr (edge_ends_mem he).2
  · intro _; exact HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mpr (edge_ends_mem he).1

name: Hunter.ProofsWP.tails_edges_ham
statement:
theorem tails_edges_ham {P : HPath k} (hP : P.IsHamiltonian) :
    tails P.edges = {P.first}
proof:
:= by
  have h := ProofsSpine.compTails_eq (isPathComponent_self P)
  rw [vertsFinset_univ_of_ham hP] at h
  exact h

name: Hunter.ProofsWP.heads_edges_ham
statement:
theorem heads_edges_ham {P : HPath k} (hP : P.IsHamiltonian) :
    heads P.edges = {P.last}
proof:
:= by
  have h := compHeads_eq (isPathComponent_self P)
  rw [vertsFinset_univ_of_ham hP] at h
  exact h

name: Hunter.ProofsWP.compTails_F_single
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hpv, hpc⟩ := h_pathrule C hC
  exact ⟨p.first, hpv ▸ ProofsSpine.compTails_eq hpc⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsWP.compHeads_F_single
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hpv, hpc⟩ := h_pathrule C hC
  exact ⟨p.last, hpv ▸ compHeads_eq hpc⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsWP.two_le_ew_E2
statement:
theorem two_le_ew_E2 {P : HPath k} (hk : 1 ≤ k) {e : Vtx k × Vtx k}
    (he : e ∈ E2removed P (Sset P)) : 2 ≤ ew k e.1 e.2
proof:
:= by
  rw [E2removed, Finset.mem_filter] at he
  obtain ⟨heP, hd⟩ := he
  have h1 : 1 ≤ ew k e.1 e.2 := ProofsSpine.one_le_ew_of_mem_edges heP
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (ew k e.1 e.2) 2 with hlt | hge
  · exfalso
    have hone : ew k e.1 e.2 = 1 := by omega
    have hsig : e.2 = sigma e.1 := (ProofsExitless.ew_eq_one_iff hk).mp hone
    have hd' : sigma e.1 ∈ doubles P (Sset P) := hsig ▸ hd
    have hmemS : e.1 ∈ Sset P := ProofsStructure.mem_S_of_sigma_double hd'
    have hnp : (e.1, sigma e.1) ∉ P.edges := sset_sPrecond P e.1 hmemS
    rw [← hsig] at hnp
    exact hnp heP
  · exact hge

name: Hunter.ProofsWP.outV_last_empty
statement: theorem outV_last_empty {P : HPath k} (hP : P.IsHamiltonian) : outV P.edges P.last = ∅
proof:
:= by
  have h := heads_edges_ham hP
  have hmem : P.last ∈ heads P.edges := by rw [h]; exact Finset.mem_singleton_self _
  rw [heads, Finset.mem_filter] at hmem
  exact hmem.2

name: Hunter.ProofsWP.last_mem_heads_F_iff
statement:
theorem last_mem_heads_F_iff {P : HPath k} (hP : P.IsHamiltonian) :
    P.last ∈ heads (F P) ↔ P.last ∈ Cm1 P
proof:
:= by
  rw [heads, Finset.mem_filter]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨-, hout⟩
    by_contra hc
    rw [Hunter.Proved.clm_rule2 hP hc] at hout
    exact absurd hout (Finset.singleton_ne_empty _)
  · intro hc
    refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    by_contra hne
    have h1 := Hunter.Proved.clm_rule1 hP hc hne
    rw [outV_last_empty hP] at h1
    exact hne h1

name: Hunter.ProofsWP.one_le_numComps_F
statement:
theorem one_le_numComps_F {P : HPath k} (hP : P.IsHamiltonian) (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    1 ≤ numComps (F P)
proof:
:= by
  have hV := ProofsStructure.vertsOf_F_eq_univ hP hk
  obtain ⟨v⟩ := ProofsSpine.vtx_nonempty k
  have hvV : v ∈ vertsOf (F P) := hV ▸ Finset.mem_univ v
  exact Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨block (F P) v, block_mem_comps hvV⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsWP.card_out_source_eq
statement:
theorem card_out_source_eq {P : HPath k} {U : Finset (Vtx k)}
    (hU : ∀ v ∈ U, outV P.edges v ≠ ∅) : (out P.edges U).card = U.card
proof:
:= by
  have himg : (out P.edges U).image Prod.fst = U := by
    ext v
    simp only [Finset.mem_image, out, Finset.mem_filter]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨e, ⟨-, he1⟩, rfl⟩; exact he1
    · intro hv
      obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr (hU v hv)
      simp only [outV, mem_out, Finset.mem_singleton] at he
      exact ⟨e, ⟨he.1, he.2 ▸ hv⟩, he.2⟩
  have hinj : Set.InjOn Prod.fst (out P.edges U : Set (Vtx k × Vtx k)) := by
    intro a ha b hb hab
    simp only [Finset.mem_coe, out, Finset.mem_filter] at ha hb
    exact Finset.card_le_one.mp (ProofsSpine.path_out_le_one P a.1) a
      (by simp only [outV, mem_out, Finset.mem_singleton]; exact ⟨ha.1, trivial⟩) b
      (by simp only [outV, mem_out, Finset.mem_singleton]; exact ⟨hb.1, hab.symm⟩)
  rw [← Finset.card_image_of_injOn hinj, himg]

name: Hunter.ProofsWP.last_notMem_out_edge
statement: theorem last_notMem_out_edge {P : HPath k} : (P.last, sigma P.last) ∉ P.edges
proof:
:=
  fun h => (ProofsStructure.ne_last_of_out_edge h) rfl

name: Hunter.ProofsWP.indicatorI_eq_ite
statement:
theorem indicatorI_eq_ite {P : HPath k} (hP : P.IsHamiltonian) :
    indicatorI P (Sset P) = if P.last ∈ heads (F P) then 0 else 1
proof:
:= by
  have hSiff : P.last ∈ Sset P ↔ P.last ∉ Cm1 P := by
    rw [Sset, Finset.mem_filter]
    exact ⟨fun h => h.2.1, fun h => ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, h, last_notMem_out_edge⟩⟩
  rw [indicatorI]
  by_cases hh : P.last ∈ heads (F P)
  · rw [if_pos hh, if_neg]
    rw [hSiff]; exact fun hc => hc ((last_mem_heads_F_iff hP).mp hh)
  · rw [if_neg hh, if_pos]
    rw [hSiff]; exact fun hc => hh ((last_mem_heads_F_iff hP).mpr hc)

name: Hunter.ProofsWP.head_count
statement:
theorem head_count {P : HPath k} (hP : P.IsHamiltonian) (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (h_pathrule : ∀ C ∈ Comps (F P), ∃ p : HPath k, p.vertsFinset = C ∧ IsPathComponent p (F P)) :
    (heads (F P) \ heads P.edges).card + (if P.last ∈ heads (F P) then 1 else 0)
      = numComps (F P)
proof:
:= by
  have hV := ProofsStructure.vertsOf_F_eq_univ hP hk
  have hnc : (heads (F P)).card = numComps (F P) :=
    card_heads_eq_numComps hV (fun C hC => compHeads_F_single h_pathrule hC)
  rw [heads_edges_ham hP]
  have hinter : (heads (F P) ∩ {P.last}).card = if P.last ∈ heads (F P) then 1 else 0 := by
    by_cases hh : P.last ∈ heads (F P)
    · rw [if_pos hh, Finset.inter_singleton_of_mem hh, Finset.card_singleton]
    · rw [if_neg hh, Finset.inter_singleton_of_notMem hh, Finset.card_empty]
  rw [← hinter, Finset.card_sdiff_add_card_inter, hnc]

name: Hunter.ProofsWP.head_sum_lower
statement:
theorem head_sum_lower {P : HPath k} (hP : P.IsHamiltonian) (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (h_pathrule : ∀ C ∈ Comps (F P), ∃ p : HPath k, p.vertsFinset = C ∧ IsPathComponent p (F P)) :
    2 * ((numComps (F P) : ℤ) - 1) + (indicatorI P (Sset P) : ℤ)
      ≤ ∑ e ∈ out P.edges (heads (F P) \ heads P.edges), (ew k e.1 e.2 : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  set Hp := heads (F P) \ heads P.edges with hHp
  set OUT := out P.edges Hp with hOUT
  
  have hOUTE2 : OUT = E2removed P (Sset P) := (Hunter.Proved.clm_e2 (sset_sPrecond P)).symm
  have htwo : ∀ e ∈ OUT, 2 ≤ ew k e.1 e.2 := by
    intro e he; rw [hOUTE2] at he; exact two_le_ew_E2 (by omega) he
  
  have hns : 2 * OUT.card ≤ ∑ e ∈ OUT, ew k e.1 e.2 := by
    have := Finset.card_nsmul_le_sum OUT (fun e => ew k e.1 e.2) 2 htwo
    simpa [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] using this
  have hcastsum : (∑ e ∈ OUT, (ew k e.1 e.2 : ℤ)) = ((∑ e ∈ OUT, ew k e.1 e.2 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
    push_cast; rfl
  
  have hOUTcard : OUT.card = Hp.card := by
    apply card_out_source_eq
    intro v hv
    rw [hHp, Finset.mem_sdiff] at hv
    intro hcon
    exact hv.2 (by rw [heads, Finset.mem_filter]; exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hcon⟩)
  
  have hcount := head_count hP hk h_pathrule
  rw [← hHp] at hcount
  have hI := indicatorI_eq_ite hP
  have hnc1 := one_le_numComps_F hP hk
  rw [hcastsum]
  have hge : (2 * OUT.card : ℤ) ≤ (∑ e ∈ OUT, ew k e.1 e.2 : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast hns
  refine le_trans ?_ hge
  rw [hOUTcard, hI]
  
  by_cases hh : P.last ∈ heads (F P)
  · rw [if_pos hh] at hcount ⊢
    push_cast; omega
  · rw [if_neg hh] at hcount ⊢
    push_cast; omega

name: Hunter.ProofsWP.tail_data
statement:
theorem tail_data {P : HPath k} (hP : P.IsHamiltonian) (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (h_pathrule : ∀ C ∈ Comps (F P), ∃ p : HPath k, p.vertsFinset = C ∧ IsPathComponent p (F P))
    {t : Vtx k} (ht : t ∈ tails (F P)) :
    ∃ p : HPath k, p.vertsFinset = block (F P) t ∧ p.first = t ∧ IsPathComponent p (F P) ∧
      ∀ u ∈ block (F P) t, P.pos t ≤ P.pos u
proof:
:= by
  have hV := ProofsStructure.vertsOf_F_eq_univ hP hk
  have htv : t ∈ vertsOf (F P) := hV ▸ Finset.mem_univ t
  have hC : block (F P) t ∈ Comps (F P) := block_mem_comps htv
  obtain ⟨p, hpv, hpc⟩ := h_pathrule _ hC
  have hct : compTails (F P) (block (F P) t) = {p.first} := hpv ▸ ProofsSpine.compTails_eq hpc
  have htin : t ∈ compTails (F P) (block (F P) t) := by
    rw [compTails, Finset.mem_filter]
    refine ⟨self_mem_block htv, ?_⟩
    rw [tails, Finset.mem_filter] at ht; exact ht.2
  rw [hct, Finset.mem_singleton] at htin
  refine ⟨p, hpv, htin.symm, hpc, ?_⟩
  intro u hu
  rw [← hpv] at hu
  rw [htin]
  exact Hunter.Proved.cor_pathfirst hP hpc (HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mp hu)

name: Hunter.ProofsWP.first_mem_tails
statement:
theorem first_mem_tails {P : HPath k} (hP : P.IsHamiltonian) (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (h_pathrule : ∀ C ∈ Comps (F P), ∃ p : HPath k, p.vertsFinset = C ∧ IsPathComponent p (F P)) :
    P.first ∈ tails (F P)
proof:
:= by
  have hV := ProofsStructure.vertsOf_F_eq_univ hP hk
  have hfv : P.first ∈ vertsOf (F P) := hV ▸ Finset.mem_univ _
  have hC : block (F P) P.first ∈ Comps (F P) := block_mem_comps hfv
  obtain ⟨p, hpv, hpc⟩ := h_pathrule _ hC
  have hct : compTails (F P) (block (F P) P.first) = {p.first} :=
    hpv ▸ ProofsSpine.compTails_eq hpc
  have hpfmem : P.first ∈ p.verts := by
    rw [← HPath.mem_vertsFinset, hpv]; exact self_mem_block hfv
  have hcp := Hunter.Proved.cor_pathfirst hP hpc hpfmem
  rw [ProofsStructure.pos_first] at hcp
  have hpf0 : P.pos p.first = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hcp
  have hpfeq : P.first = p.first := by
    have := ProofsExitless.vert_pos P (hP p.first)
    rw [hpf0, P.vert_zero] at this; exact this
  rw [tails, Finset.mem_filter]
  refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
  have hmem : P.first ∈ compTails (F P) (block (F P) P.first) := by
    rw [hct, Finset.mem_singleton]; exact hpfeq
  rw [compTails, Finset.mem_filter] at hmem
  exact hmem.2

name: Hunter.ProofsWP.compMinto_le_ew
statement:
theorem compMinto_le_ew {P : HPath k} (hP : P.IsHamiltonian) (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (h_pathrule : ∀ C ∈ Comps (F P), ∃ p : HPath k, p.vertsFinset = C ∧ IsPathComponent p (F P))
    {e : Vtx k × Vtx k} (heP : e ∈ P.edges) (ht : e.2 ∈ tails (F P)) :
    compMinto (F P) (block (F P) e.2) ≤ ew k e.1 e.2
proof:
:= by
  have hV := ProofsStructure.vertsOf_F_eq_univ hP hk
  obtain ⟨p, hpv, hpf, hpc, hmin⟩ := tail_data hP hk h_pathrule ht
  have h2v : e.2 ∈ vertsOf (F P) := hV ▸ Finset.mem_univ _
  have h1notin : e.1 ∉ block (F P) e.2 := by
    intro hc
    have hle := hmin e.1 hc
    have hlt : P.pos e.1 < P.pos e.2 := by rw [ProofsStructure.edge_pos_succ heP]; omega
    omega
  apply Nat.sInf_le
  refine ⟨e.1, h1notin, e.2, ?_, rfl⟩
  rw [compTails, Finset.mem_filter]
  refine ⟨self_mem_block h2v, ?_⟩
  rw [tails, Finset.mem_filter] at ht; exact ht.2

name: Hunter.ProofsWP.minThrough_add_compMinto_le
statement:
theorem minThrough_add_compMinto_le {P : HPath k} (hP : P.IsHamiltonian) (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    MinThrough (F P) + compMinto (F P) (block (F P) P.first)
      ≤ ∑ C ∈ Comps (F P), compMinto (F P) C
proof:
:= by
  have hfv : P.first ∈ vertsOf (F P) := (ProofsStructure.vertsOf_F_eq_univ hP hk) ▸ Finset.mem_univ _
  have hC₀ : block (F P) P.first ∈ Comps (F P) := block_mem_comps hfv
  rw [MinThrough]
  by_cases hle : (Comps (F P)).card ≤ 1
  · rw [if_pos hle, zero_add]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun C => compMinto (F P) C) (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) hC₀
  · rw [if_neg hle]
    have hsup : compMinto (F P) (block (F P) P.first)
        ≤ (Comps (F P)).sup (fun C => compMinto (F P) C) := Finset.le_sup hC₀
    have hsupsum : (Comps (F P)).sup (fun C => compMinto (F P) C)
        ≤ ∑ C ∈ Comps (F P), compMinto (F P) C :=
      Finset.sup_le (fun C hC => Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) hC)
    omega

name: Hunter.ProofsWP.tail_sum_lower
statement:
theorem tail_sum_lower {P : HPath k} (hP : P.IsHamiltonian) (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (h_pathrule : ∀ C ∈ Comps (F P), ∃ p : HPath k, p.vertsFinset = C ∧ IsPathComponent p (F P)) :
    (MinThrough (F P) : ℤ) - ((numComps (F P) : ℤ) - 1)
      ≤ ∑ e ∈ into P.edges (tails (F P) \ tails P.edges), ((ew k e.1 e.2 : ℤ) - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hV := ProofsStructure.vertsOf_F_eq_univ hP hk
  set E := into P.edges (tails (F P) \ tails P.edges) with hE
  set C₀ := block (F P) P.first with hC₀def
  set D := Comps (F P) \ {C₀} with hDdef
  have hC₀ : C₀ ∈ Comps (F P) :=
    block_mem_comps (hV ▸ Finset.mem_univ (P.first))
  have hfirstT : P.first ∈ tails (F P) := first_mem_tails hP hk h_pathrule
  
  have huniqTail : ∀ {a b : Vtx k}, a ∈ tails (F P) → b ∈ tails (F P) →
      block (F P) a = block (F P) b → a = b := by
    intro a b ha hb hab
    have hav : a ∈ vertsOf (F P) := hV ▸ Finset.mem_univ _
    have hbv : b ∈ vertsOf (F P) := hV ▸ Finset.mem_univ _
    obtain ⟨t, htsingle⟩ := compTails_F_single h_pathrule (block_mem_comps hav)
    have hain : a ∈ compTails (F P) (block (F P) a) := by
      rw [compTails, Finset.mem_filter]
      exact ⟨self_mem_block hav, (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2⟩
    have hbin : b ∈ compTails (F P) (block (F P) a) := by
      rw [compTails, Finset.mem_filter]
      refine ⟨?_, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hb).2⟩
      rw [hab]; exact self_mem_block hbv
    rw [htsingle, Finset.mem_singleton] at hain hbin
    rw [hain, hbin]
  
  have hmemE : ∀ {e : Vtx k × Vtx k}, e ∈ E →
      e ∈ P.edges ∧ e.2 ∈ tails (F P) ∧ e.2 ≠ P.first := by
    intro e he
    rw [hE, mem_into, Finset.mem_sdiff, tails_edges_ham hP, Finset.mem_singleton] at he
    exact ⟨he.1, he.2.1, he.2.2⟩
  have hi : ∀ e (he : e ∈ E), block (F P) e.2 ∈ D := by
    intro e he
    obtain ⟨heP, ht, hne⟩ := hmemE he
    rw [hDdef, Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_singleton]
    refine ⟨block_mem_comps (hV ▸ Finset.mem_univ _), ?_⟩
    intro hcon
    exact hne (huniqTail ht hfirstT hcon)
  have i_inj : ∀ e₁ (he₁ : e₁ ∈ E) e₂ (he₂ : e₂ ∈ E),
      block (F P) e₁.2 = block (F P) e₂.2 → e₁ = e₂ := by
    intro e₁ he₁ e₂ he₂ hb
    obtain ⟨he₁P, ht₁, -⟩ := hmemE he₁
    obtain ⟨he₂P, ht₂, -⟩ := hmemE he₂
    have h22 : e₁.2 = e₂.2 := huniqTail ht₁ ht₂ hb
    exact Finset.card_le_one.mp (ProofsSpine.path_into_le_one P e₁.2) e₁
      (by rw [intoV, mem_into]; exact ⟨he₁P, Finset.mem_singleton_self _⟩) e₂
      (by rw [intoV, mem_into]; exact ⟨he₂P, h22 ▸ Finset.mem_singleton_self _⟩)
  have i_surj : ∀ C ∈ D, ∃ e, ∃ (_ : e ∈ E), block (F P) e.2 = C := by
    intro C hCD
    rw [hDdef, Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_singleton] at hCD
    obtain ⟨hCcomp, hCne⟩ := hCD
    obtain ⟨t, htsingle⟩ := compTails_F_single h_pathrule hCcomp
    have htC : t ∈ C := compTails_subset (by rw [htsingle]; exact Finset.mem_singleton_self _)
    have htT : t ∈ tails (F P) := by
      rw [tails, Finset.mem_filter]
      have : t ∈ compTails (F P) C := by rw [htsingle]; exact Finset.mem_singleton_self _
      rw [compTails, Finset.mem_filter] at this
      exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, this.2⟩
    have hblockt : block (F P) t = C := (comp_eq_block_of_mem hCcomp htC).symm
    have htne : t ≠ P.first := by
      intro hcon; exact hCne (by rw [← hblockt, hcon])
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := ProofsSpine.exists_pred (hP t) htne
    refine ⟨(u, t), ?_, hblockt⟩
    rw [hE, mem_into, Finset.mem_sdiff, tails_edges_ham hP, Finset.mem_singleton]
    exact ⟨hu, htT, htne⟩
  
  have hbij : ∑ e ∈ E, ((compMinto (F P) (block (F P) e.2) : ℤ) - 1)
      = ∑ C ∈ D, ((compMinto (F P) C : ℤ) - 1) :=
    Finset.sum_bij (fun e _ => block (F P) e.2) hi i_inj i_surj (fun e _ => rfl)
  
  have hpt : ∑ e ∈ E, ((compMinto (F P) (block (F P) e.2) : ℤ) - 1)
      ≤ ∑ e ∈ E, ((ew k e.1 e.2 : ℤ) - 1) := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro e he
    obtain ⟨heP, ht, -⟩ := hmemE he
    have hle := compMinto_le_ew hP hk h_pathrule heP ht
    have : (compMinto (F P) (block (F P) e.2) : ℤ) ≤ (ew k e.1 e.2 : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hle
    linarith
  
  have hnc1 := one_le_numComps_F hP hk
  have hDcard : D.card = numComps (F P) - 1 := by
    have h := Finset.card_sdiff_add_card_eq_card (Finset.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hC₀)
    rw [Finset.card_singleton, ← hDdef] at h
    rw [numComps]
    omega
  have hsumsdiff : (∑ C ∈ D, (compMinto (F P) C : ℤ)) + (compMinto (F P) C₀ : ℤ)
      = ∑ C ∈ Comps (F P), (compMinto (F P) C : ℤ) := by
    have := Finset.sum_sdiff (f := fun C => (compMinto (F P) C : ℤ))
      (Finset.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hC₀)
    rwa [Finset.sum_singleton, ← hDdef] at this
  have hDval : ∑ C ∈ D, ((compMinto (F P) C : ℤ) - 1)
      = (∑ C ∈ Comps (F P), (compMinto (F P) C : ℤ)) - (compMinto (F P) C₀ : ℤ)
        - ((numComps (F P) : ℤ) - 1) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one, hDcard]
    push_cast [hnc1]
    linarith [hsumsdiff]
  
  have hmt : (MinThrough (F P) : ℤ) + (compMinto (F P) C₀ : ℤ)
      ≤ ∑ C ∈ Comps (F P), (compMinto (F P) C : ℤ) := by
    have := minThrough_add_compMinto_le hP hk
    rw [← hC₀def] at this
    calc (MinThrough (F P) : ℤ) + (compMinto (F P) C₀ : ℤ)
        = ((MinThrough (F P) + compMinto (F P) C₀ : ℕ) : ℤ) := by push_cast; ring
      _ ≤ ((∑ C ∈ Comps (F P), compMinto (F P) C : ℕ) : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast this
      _ = ∑ C ∈ Comps (F P), (compMinto (F P) C : ℤ) := by push_cast; rfl
  
  calc (MinThrough (F P) : ℤ) - ((numComps (F P) : ℤ) - 1)
      ≤ ((∑ C ∈ Comps (F P), (compMinto (F P) C : ℤ)) - (compMinto (F P) C₀ : ℤ))
          - ((numComps (F P) : ℤ) - 1) := by linarith [hmt]
    _ = ∑ C ∈ D, ((compMinto (F P) C : ℤ) - 1) := by rw [hDval]
    _ = ∑ e ∈ E, ((compMinto (F P) (block (F P) e.2) : ℤ) - 1) := hbij.symm
    _ ≤ ∑ e ∈ E, ((ew k e.1 e.2 : ℤ) - 1) := hpt

name: Hunter.Proved.prp_wPgivenX
statement:
theorem prp_wPgivenX {P : HPath k} (hP : P.IsHamiltonian) (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (h_pathrule : ∀ C ∈ Comps (F P), ∃ p : HPath k, p.vertsFinset = C ∧ IsPathComponent p (F P)) :
    P.wtP ≥ (numComps (F P) - 1) + MinThrough (F P) + wEdges (F P)
proof:
:= by
  have hSV : Sset P ⊆ P.vertsFinset := by
    rw [ProofsWP.vertsFinset_univ_of_ham hP]; exact Finset.subset_univ _
  have h_eqq := Hunter.Proved.clm_eqq_amended (by omega : (1 : ℕ) ≤ k) hSV (sset_sPrecond P)
  have hwr := Hunter.Proved.lem_weightrule (sset_sPrecond P) h_eqq
  rw [← ProofsStructure.F_eq] at hwr
  have hA := ProofsWP.tail_sum_lower hP hk h_pathrule
  have hB := ProofsWP.head_sum_lower hP hk h_pathrule
  have hnc1 := ProofsWP.one_le_numComps_F hP hk
  have hz : (P.wtP : ℤ)
      ≥ (wEdges (F P) : ℤ) + (MinThrough (F P) : ℤ) + ((numComps (F P) : ℤ) - 1) := by
    linarith [hwr, hA, hB]
  have hgoal : (((numComps (F P) - 1) + MinThrough (F P) + wEdges (F P) : ℕ) : ℤ)
      ≤ (P.wtP : ℤ) := by
    calc (((numComps (F P) - 1) + MinThrough (F P) + wEdges (F P) : ℕ) : ℤ)
        = (numComps (F P) : ℤ) - 1 + (MinThrough (F P) : ℤ) + (wEdges (F P) : ℤ) := by
          push_cast [Nat.cast_sub hnc1]; ring
      _ ≤ (P.wtP : ℤ) := by linarith [hz]
  exact_mod_cast hgoal

name: Hunter.Proved.b1_unconditional
statement:
theorem b1_unconditional (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (h_pathrule : ∀ (P : HPath k), P.IsHamiltonian →
      ∀ C ∈ Comps (F P), ∃ p : HPath k, p.vertsFinset = C ∧ IsPathComponent p (F P)) :
    L k ≥ sInf {m | ∃ X, X ∈ Xk k ∧ m = (numComps X - 1) + MinThrough X + wEdges X}
proof:
:=
  Hunter.Proved.b1 (fun P hP => prp_wPgivenX hP hk (h_pathrule P hP))

name: Hunter.superperm_length_ge_hunterPointwise
statement:
theorem superperm_length_ge_hunterPointwise {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) :
    (Ssuper k : ℝ) ≥
      (k : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((k : ℝ) - 2) - 3
        + coeff k *
          ((k.factorial : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) - 1) * ((k : ℝ) - 2))
        + (k : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hpivot : HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) :=
    Proved.hasExitlessPath_pivot k hk
  have hPpos : 0 < k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, k = m + 3 := ⟨k - 3, by omega⟩
    rw [show m + 3 - 1 = m + 2 from by omega,
      show m + 3 - 2 = m + 1 from by omega]
    positivity
  have hi : iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) = k ^ 2 * (k - 2) - 3 := by
    rw [thm2_equality hk hPpos (le_refl _) hpivot,
      ProofsReductions.j_pivot hk]
  have hL := proof_thm1v2 hk hpivot
  rw [hi, ProofsReductions.castI hk, ProofsReductions.castP (by omega),
    ProofsReductions.ratio_eq_coeff hk] at hL
  rw [← Proved.bridge_Lstar_eq_Ssuper (show 1 ≤ k by omega), lstar_eq]
  push_cast
  linarith

  have hn : Ssuper 5 ≤ 152 := by omega

name: Hunter.ProofsAssembly.excess_window_split
statement:
theorem excess_window_split (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p q : HPath k}
    (hlt : k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) < p.numVerts)
    (hprefix : q.verts = p.verts.take (p.numVerts - ell0 k)) :
    excess q + ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ((k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1), (bw p (winA p + j) - 2) ≤ excess p
proof:
:= by
  set N := p.numVerts with hNdef
  set n := N - ell0 k with hndef
  set M := (k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1 with hMdef
  
  have he0val : ell0 k = k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) - k := rfl
  have hkprod : k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2)) = k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by ring
  have hPk : k ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by
    have h1 : k * 1 ≤ k * (k - 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) (by omega)
    have h2 : k * (k - 1) * 1 ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl _) (by omega)
    omega
  have he0lt : ell0 k < N := by rw [he0val]; omega
  have hNsum : N = n + ell0 k := by rw [hndef]; omega
  have hn1 : k < n := by rw [hndef, he0val]; omega
  have hnle : n ≤ N := by omega
  have hqn : q.numVerts = n := by
    have hlen : q.verts.length = (p.verts.take (N - ell0 k)).length := by rw [hprefix]
    have hNl : p.verts.length = N := rfl
    rw [List.length_take, hNl] at hlen
    show q.verts.length = n
    rw [hlen, hndef]; omega
  have hdvd : k ∣ ell0 k := k_dvd_ell0 hk
  have hkM : k * M = ell0 k := by
    have hB1 : (k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1 + 1 = (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by
      have : 1 ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by nlinarith [show 1 ≤ k - 1 by omega, show 1 ≤ k - 2 by omega]
      omega
    have hstep : k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1) + k = k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by
      calc k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1) + k = k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1 + 1) := by ring
        _ = k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2)) := by rw [hB1]
        _ = k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by ring
    rw [hMdef, he0val]; omega
  set a := winA p with hadef
  have hn_eq : n - 1 = p.numVerts - ell0 k - 1 := by omega
  have haval : a = (n - 1) / k := by
    rw [hadef]; unfold winA; rw [hn_eq]
  have hdivmod : k * a + (n - 1) % k = n - 1 := by rw [haval]; exact Nat.div_add_mod (n - 1) k
  have hmodlt : (n - 1) % k < k := Nat.mod_lt (n - 1) (by omega)
  have hM_lt : k * (a + M) < N := by
    have hexp : k * (a + M) = k * a + ell0 k := by rw [Nat.mul_add, hkM]
    omega
  
  set f : ℕ → ℕ := fun i => ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) - 2 with hfdef
  
  have hexcp : excess p = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N - 1), f i := excess_eq_sum_edgeWeight (by omega) p
  have hexcq : excess q = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n - 1), f i := by
    rw [excess_eq_sum_edgeWeight (by omega) q, hqn]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hi
    rw [hfdef]
    rw [prefix_vert_eq hprefix hnle (show i < n by omega),
        prefix_vert_eq hprefix hnle (show i + 1 < n by omega)]
  
  have hsplit : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N - 1), f i
      = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n - 1), f i + ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico (n - 1) (N - 1), f i := by
    rw [Finset.range_eq_Ico, Finset.range_eq_Ico,
        ← Finset.sum_Ico_consecutive f (Nat.zero_le (n - 1)) (by omega : n - 1 ≤ N - 1)]
  
  set g : ℕ → ℕ := fun j => k * (a + j) - 1 with hgdef
  have hginj : ∀ x ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, ∀ y ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, g x = g y → x = y := by
    intro x hx y hy hxy
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hx hy
    have h1 : 0 < k * (a + x) := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)
    have h2 : 0 < k * (a + y) := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)
    rw [hgdef] at hxy; dsimp only at hxy
    have : k * (a + x) = k * (a + y) := by omega
    have := Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (by omega : 0 < k) this
    omega
  have hgsub : (Finset.Icc 1 M).image g ⊆ Finset.Ico (n - 1) (N - 1) := by
    intro i hi
    rw [Finset.mem_image] at hi
    obtain ⟨j, hjIcc, hij⟩ := hi
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hjIcc
    rw [Finset.mem_Ico, ← hij, hgdef]; dsimp only
    have hlo : k * (a + 1) ≤ k * (a + j) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) (by omega)
    have hhi : k * (a + j) ≤ k * (a + M) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) (by omega)
    have ha1 : k * (a + 1) = k * a + k := by ring
    constructor <;> omega
  have himg : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, (bw p (a + j) - 2)
      = ∑ i ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 M).image g, f i := by
    rw [Finset.sum_image hginj]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hj
    have e1 : k * (a + j) - 1 + 1 = k * (a + j) := by
      have : 1 ≤ k * (a + j) := by
        have := Nat.mul_pos (show 0 < k by omega) (show 0 < a + j by omega); omega
      omega
    simp only [hfdef, hgdef, bw]
    rw [e1]
  have hle : ∑ i ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 M).image g, f i ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico (n - 1) (N - 1), f i :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hgsub (fun _ _ _ => Nat.zero_le _)
  rw [hexcp, hsplit, ← hexcq, himg]
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsAssembly.winA_range
proof:
:= by
  have he0val : ell0 k = k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) - k := rfl
  have hPk : k ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by
    have h1 : k * 1 ≤ k * (k - 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) (by omega)
    have h2 : k * (k - 1) * 1 ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl _) (by omega)
    omega
  have he0lt : ell0 k < p.numVerts := by rw [he0val]; omega
  have hkM : k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1) = ell0 k := by
    have hB1 : (k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1 + 1 = (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by
      have : 1 ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by nlinarith [show 1 ≤ k - 1 by omega, show 1 ≤ k - 2 by omega]
      omega
    have hstep : k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1) + k = k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by
      calc k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1) + k = k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1 + 1) := by ring
        _ = k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2)) := by rw [hB1]
        _ = k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by ring
    rw [he0val]; omega
  have hae : winA p = (p.numVerts - ell0 k - 1) / k := rfl
  have hdm : k * winA p + (p.numVerts - ell0 k - 1) % k = p.numVerts - ell0 k - 1 := by
    rw [hae]; exact Nat.div_add_mod _ k
  have hmlt : (p.numVerts - ell0 k - 1) % k < k := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  have hka_le : k * winA p ≤ p.numVerts - ell0 k - 1 := by omega
  calc k * (winA p + ((k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1))
      = k * winA p + k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1) := by rw [Nat.mul_add]
    _ = k * winA p + ell0 k := by rw [hkM]
    _ ≤ (p.numVerts - ell0 k - 1) + ell0 k := by omega
    _ < p.numVerts := by omega

name: Hunter.ProofsAssembly.frontierTightHeavy_of_saturated
statement:
theorem frontierTightHeavy_of_saturated (hk : 3 ≤ k)
    (hsat : SaturatedTightHeavy k) : FrontierTightHeavy k
proof:
:= by
  intro p q hpe hqe hlt hprefix htight
  set a := winA p with hadef
  set M := (k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1 with hMdef
  have hrange : k * (a + M) < p.numVerts := by rw [hadef, hMdef]; exact winA_range hk hlt
  
  have hsplit := excess_window_split hk hlt hprefix
  rw [← hadef, ← hMdef] at hsplit
  
  set W3 := (Finset.filter (fun j => 3 ≤ bw p (a + j)) (Finset.Icc 1 M)).card with hW3
  set H4 := (Finset.filter (fun j => 4 ≤ bw p (a + j)) (Finset.Icc 1 M)).card with hH4
  
  have hpay : W3 + H4 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, (bw p (a + j) - 2) := by
    rw [hW3, hH4, Finset.card_filter, Finset.card_filter, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro j _
    by_cases h3 : 3 ≤ bw p (a + j) <;> by_cases h4 : 4 ≤ bw p (a + j) <;>
      simp only [h3, h4, if_true, if_false] <;> omega
  
  have hfloor : k - 3 ≤ W3 := by
    have h := window_heavy_count hk hpe a M hrange
    rw [hMdef, windowM_ceilDiv hk] at h
    have hcard : (Finset.filter (fun j => 3 ≤ ew k (p.vert (k * (a + j) - 1)) (p.vert (k * (a + j))))
        (Finset.Icc 1 M)).card = W3 := rfl
    rw [hcard] at h; omega
  by_cases hA : ∃ j, 1 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ M ∧ 4 ≤ bw p (a + j)
  · 
    obtain ⟨j, hj1, hjM, hj4⟩ := hA
    have hH4pos : 1 ≤ H4 := by
      rw [hH4]
      apply Finset.one_le_card.mpr
      exact ⟨j, by rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc]; exact ⟨⟨hj1, hjM⟩, hj4⟩⟩
    omega
  · by_cases hB : ∃ j, 1 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ M ∧ ¬ IsDoor p (a + j) ∧ doorDepth p (a + j - 1) ≤ k - 3
    · 
      obtain ⟨s₀, hs01, hs02, hnd, hinc⟩ := hB
      have h := window_incomplete_slack hk hpe a (by rw [← hMdef]; exact hrange)
        s₀ hs01 (by rw [← hMdef]; exact hs02) hnd hinc
      have hcard : (Finset.filter
          (fun j => 3 ≤ ew k (p.vert (k * (a + j) - 1)) (p.vert (k * (a + j))))
          (Finset.Icc 1 M)).card = W3 := rfl
      rw [← hMdef] at h
      rw [hcard] at h
      omega
    · 
      apply hsat p q hpe hqe hlt hprefix htight
      rw [← hadef, ← hMdef]
      refine ⟨fun j hj1 hjM => ?_, fun j hj1 hjM => ?_⟩
      · by_contra hc
        exact hA ⟨j, hj1, hjM, by omega⟩
      · by_cases hd : IsDoor p (a + j)
        · exact Or.inl hd
        · exact Or.inr (by by_contra hc; exact hB ⟨j, hj1, hjM, hd, by omega⟩)

name: Hunter.ProofsHeadline.proof_thm1v2_all
statement:
theorem proof_thm1v2_all :
    ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) →
      (L k : ℝ) ≥ (iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ)
        + (((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
            (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)))
          * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk hpivot
  have hk2 : 2 ≤ k := by omega
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
  set P : ℕ := k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) with hPdef
  
  have hPR : ((P : ℕ) : ℝ) = (k : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) - 1) * ((k : ℝ) - 2) := ProofsReductions.castP hk2
  have hPk_pos : (0 : ℝ) < ((P : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) := by
    rw [hPR]; exact ProofsReductions.D_pos hk
  have hPpos : 0 < P := by
    have hkR : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hR : (0 : ℝ) < ((P : ℕ) : ℝ) := by linarith [hPk_pos]
    exact_mod_cast hR
  
  set iP : ℝ := (iExitless k P : ℝ) with hiPdef
  set rP : ℝ := (iP - (k : ℝ) + 2) / (((P : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)) with hrPdef
  
  have hrP_key : rP * (((P : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)) = iP - (k : ℝ) + 2 := by
    rw [hrPdef]; field_simp
  
  have hthm2eq : iExitless k P = j k P :=
    Hunter.Proved.thm2_equality hk hPpos (le_refl _) hpivot
  
  have hprop4 : ∀ ℓ, k < ℓ → HasExitlessPath k ℓ →
      rP ≤ ((iExitless k ℓ : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) / ((ℓ : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)) := by
    intro ℓ hℓ hex
    exact Hunter.Proved.prop4 hk hℓ hex hpivot
      (fun m hm => Hunter.Proved.prop3 hk hm)
      (fun m hm => Hunter.Proved.thm2_unconditional k m hk hm)
      hthm2eq
  
  have hSR_ne : {q : ℝ | ∃ ℓ, k < ℓ ∧ HasExitlessPath k ℓ ∧
      q = ((iExitless k ℓ : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) / ((ℓ : ℝ) - (k : ℝ))}.Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨rP, P, ?_, hpivot, ?_⟩
    · 
      have : (k : ℝ) < ((P : ℕ) : ℝ) := by linarith [hPk_pos]
      exact_mod_cast this
    · rw [hrPdef]
  have hRk_ge : rP ≤ Rk k := by
    have hle : rP ≤ sInf {q : ℝ | ∃ ℓ, k < ℓ ∧ HasExitlessPath k ℓ ∧
        q = ((iExitless k ℓ : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) / ((ℓ : ℝ) - (k : ℝ))} := by
      apply le_csInf hSR_ne
      rintro q ⟨ℓ, hℓ, hex, rfl⟩
      exact hprop4 ℓ hℓ hex
    exact le_trans hle (Hunter.Proved.red_R_closed hk)
  
  have hXk'_ne : (Xk' k).Nonempty :=
    ProofsB2.Xk'_nonempty_of_Xk_nonempty hk2 (Hunter.Proved.Xk_nonempty k)
  have hSE : Xk' k = {p : HPath k | p.StronglyExitless} := Hunter.Proved.prp_Xkcomps_closed hk2
  have hgInner_ge : iP - rP * ((P : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ProofsGB2.gInner k rP := by
    rw [ProofsGB2.gInner]
    apply le_csInf
    · obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hXk'_ne; exact ⟨_, p, hp, rfl⟩
    rintro q ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    have hse : p.StronglyExitless := by rw [hSE] at hp; exact hp
    have hexit : p.Exitless := hse.1
    have hdvd : k ∣ p.numVerts := Hunter.Proved.dvd_numVerts_of_stronglyExitless hk1 hse
    have hge_k : k ≤ p.numVerts := Nat.le_of_dvd p.numVerts_pos hdvd
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hge_k with heq | hlt
    · 
      have hnv : (p.numVerts : ℝ) = (k : ℝ) := by rw [← heq]
      have hw : (k : ℝ) - 1 ≤ (p.wtP : ℝ) := by
        have := wtP_ge_numVerts_sub_one hk1 hexit
        rw [← heq] at this
        have hcast : ((k - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (p.wtP : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast this
        rwa [Nat.cast_sub hk1, Nat.cast_one] at hcast
      rw [hnv]
      nlinarith [hrP_key, hw]
    · 
      have hexP : HasExitlessPath k p.numVerts := ⟨p, hexit, rfl⟩
      have hiw : (iExitless k p.numVerts : ℝ) ≤ (p.wtP : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast iExitless_le_wtP hexit
      have hr4 := hprop4 p.numVerts hlt hexP
      have hd : (0 : ℝ) < (p.numVerts : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) := by
        have : (k : ℝ) < (p.numVerts : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hlt
        linarith
      have hmul : rP * ((p.numVerts : ℝ) - (k : ℝ))
          ≤ (iExitless k p.numVerts : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2 := by
        rw [le_div_iff₀ hd] at hr4; linarith [hr4]
      nlinarith [hrP_key, hmul, hiw]
  
  have hb2 : (L k : ℝ) ≥ Rk k * (k.factorial : ℝ) + ProofsGB2.gInner k (Rk k) :=
    Hunter.Proved.b2_gInner hk2
  have hmono : rP * (k.factorial : ℝ) + ProofsGB2.gInner k rP
      ≤ Rk k * (k.factorial : ℝ) + ProofsGB2.gInner k (Rk k) :=
    Hunter.Proved.gInner_mono hk2 rP (Rk k) hRk_ge
  
  have hfin : (L k : ℝ) ≥ rP * (k.factorial : ℝ) + (iP - rP * ((P : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
    calc (L k : ℝ) ≥ Rk k * (k.factorial : ℝ) + ProofsGB2.gInner k (Rk k) := hb2
      _ ≥ rP * (k.factorial : ℝ) + ProofsGB2.gInner k rP := hmono
      _ ≥ rP * (k.factorial : ℝ) + (iP - rP * ((P : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by linarith [hgInner_ge]
  
  rw [ge_iff_le]
  calc (iExitless k P : ℝ) + rP * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - ((P : ℕ) : ℝ))
      = rP * (k.factorial : ℝ) + (iP - rP * ((P : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by rw [hiPdef]; ring
    _ ≤ (L k : ℝ) := hfin

name: Hunter.ProofsHeadline.prop4_closed
statement:
theorem prop4_closed (hk : 3 ≤ k) {ℓ : ℕ} (h : k < ℓ) (hex : HasExitlessPath k ℓ)
    (hpivot : HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2))) :
    ((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
        (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ))
      ≤ ((iExitless k ℓ : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) / ((ℓ : ℝ) - (k : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hPpos : 0 < k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, k = m + 3 := ⟨k - 3, by omega⟩
    rw [show m + 3 - 1 = m + 2 from by omega, show m + 3 - 2 = m + 1 from by omega]; positivity
  exact Hunter.Proved.prop4 hk h hex hpivot
    (fun m hm => Hunter.Proved.prop3 hk hm)
    (fun m hm => Hunter.Proved.thm2_unconditional k m hk hm)
    (Hunter.Proved.thm2_equality hk hPpos (le_refl _) hpivot)

name: Hunter.ProofsHeadline.thm1v1_unconditional
statement:

    ∃ (C : ℝ) (k₀ : ℕ), ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k →
      (Lstar k : ℝ) ≥ coeff k * (k.factorial : ℝ) + (k : ℝ) - C

name: Hunter.ProofsHeadline.thm1v2_unconditional
statement:

name: Hunter.ProofsHeadline.eq_weak_unconditional
statement:
theorem eq_weak_unconditional :

      (Lstar k : ℝ) ≥ (k.factorial : ℝ) + ((k - 1).factorial : ℝ) + ((k - 2).factorial : ℝ)
        + ((k - 4).factorial : ℝ) - 2 * ((k - 5).factorial : ℝ) - C * ((k - 6).factorial : ℝ)
proof:
:=
  ProofsQED.eq_weak_final Hunter.Proved.tightJumpFree proof_thm1v2_all

name: Hunter.ProofsSynthesis.excessFrontier_of_MF
statement:
theorem excessFrontier_of_MF (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hMF : FrontierTightHeavy k) :
    ExcessFrontier k
proof:
:= by
  have main : ∀ ℓ : ℕ, ∀ p : HPath k, p.Exitless → p.numVerts = ℓ →
      j k p.numVerts ≤ (p.numVerts - 1) + (p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k - 1) + excess p := by
    intro ℓ
    induction ℓ using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | _ ℓ ih =>
      intro p hpe hpℓ
      have h0 : 0 < p.numVerts := p.numVerts_pos
      by_cases hbaseR : p.numVerts ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)
      · exact excess_frontier_base hk hpe h0 hbaseR
      · rw [Nat.not_le] at hbaseR
        
        have he0pos : 0 < ell0 k := ell0_pos hk
        have hm : 2 ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by
          have h := Nat.mul_le_mul (show 2 ≤ k - 1 by omega) (show 1 ≤ k - 2 by omega)
          omega
        have hprod : k * 2 ≤ k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2)) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) hm
        have heq : k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2)) = k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by ring
        have he0val : ell0 k = k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) - k := rfl
        have hkle0 : k ≤ ell0 k := by rw [he0val]; omega
        have he0base : ell0 k ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by rw [he0val]; omega
        
        set n := p.numVerts - ell0 k with hn
        have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := by rw [hn]; omega
        have hnle : n ≤ p.numVerts := by rw [hn]; omega
        have hnlt : n < p.numVerts := by rw [hn]; omega
        have hNsum : p.numVerts = n + ell0 k := by rw [hn]; omega
        obtain ⟨q, hqv, hqe⟩ := prefix_exitless hpe hn1 hnle
        have hqnv : q.numVerts = n := by
          have hlen : p.verts.length = p.numVerts := rfl
          show q.verts.length = n
          rw [hqv, List.length_take, hlen]; omega
        have hpre : q.verts = p.verts.take (p.numVerts - ell0 k) := by rw [hqv, hn]
        
        have hnltℓ : n < ℓ := by rw [← hpℓ]; exact hnlt
        have hIH := ih n hnltℓ q hqe hqnv
        rw [hqnv] at hIH
        
        have hdvd : k ∣ ell0 k := k_dvd_ell0 hk
        have hje0 : j k (ell0 k) = ell0 k + (ell0 k / k) + (k - 2) - 3 := by
          rw [j_base (Or.inl he0base), Proved.ceilDiv_of_dvd (show 0 < k by omega) hdvd,
              ceilDiv_ell0 hk]
        have hsplit : p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k = n ⌈/⌉ k + ell0 k / k := by
          rw [hNsum]; exact ceilDiv_add_dvd (show 0 < k by omega) hdvd
        have hjrec : j k p.numVerts = j k n + j k (ell0 k) + 3 := by
          have hr := j_rec_unfold_one hk hbaseR
          rw [← hn] at hr; exact hr
        
        have hXn1 : 1 ≤ n ⌈/⌉ k := by
          rw [Proved.ceilDiv_succ_pred hn1 (show 0 < k by omega)]; exact Nat.le_add_left 1 _
        have hXe1 : 1 ≤ ell0 k / k :=
          (Nat.one_le_div_iff (show 0 < k by omega)).mpr hkle0
        
        by_cases htight : j k n = (n - 1) + (n ⌈/⌉ k - 1) + excess q
        · 
          have hwin : excess q + (k - 2) ≤ excess p := by
            apply hMF p q hpe hqe hbaseR hpre
            rw [hqnv]; exact htight
          omega
        · 
          have hfloor : excess q + (k - 3) ≤ excess p :=
            windowExcess_ge_km3 hk hpe hbaseR hpre
          omega
  intro q hqe h0
  have := main q.numVerts q hqe rfl
  omega

statement:

name: Hunter.ProofsSynthesis.list_dropLast_getLastD
statement:
theorem list_dropLast_getLastD (w : List ℕ) (hw : w ≠ []) :
    w = w.dropLast ++ [w.getLastD 0]
proof:
:= by
  rcases List.eq_nil_or_concat w with rfl | ⟨l, a, rfl⟩
