name: Hunter.ProofsRunExtract.runExtract
statement:
theorem runExtract (hk : 2 ≤ k) (p : HPath k) :
    ∀ t,
      t = runStart p t + metaDepth p t * (k - 1) + doorDepth p t ∧
      (∀ j r, j < metaDepth p t → 1 ≤ r → r ≤ k - 2 →
          IsDoor p (runStart p t + j * (k - 1) + r)) ∧
      (∀ c, 1 ≤ c → c ≤ metaDepth p t → IsAlpha p (runStart p t + c * (k - 1))) ∧
      (∀ r, 1 ≤ r → r ≤ doorDepth p t →
          IsDoor p (runStart p t + metaDepth p t * (k - 1) + r))
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [runStart_zero, metaDepth_zero, doorDepth_zero]; simp
    · intro j r hj hr1 hr2; rw [metaDepth_zero] at hj; omega
    · intro c hc1 hc2; rw [metaDepth_zero] at hc2; omega
    · intro r hr1 hr2; rw [doorDepth_zero] at hr2; omega
  | succ t ih =>
    obtain ⟨ihA, ihB, ihC, ihD⟩ := ih
    by_cases hdoor : IsDoor p (t + 1)
    · 
      have hrs := runStart_not_metaHeavy (p := p) (t := t) (fun hmh => hmh.1 hdoor)
      have hmd := metaDepth_door hdoor
      have hdd := doorDepth_door hdoor
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hrs, hmd, hdd]; omega
      · rw [hrs, hmd]; exact ihB
      · rw [hrs, hmd]; exact ihC
      · rw [hrs, hmd, hdd]
        intro r hr1 hr2
        by_cases hrle : r ≤ doorDepth p t
        · exact ihD r hr1 hrle
        · have hre : r = doorDepth p t + 1 := by omega
          have hpos : runStart p t + metaDepth p t * (k - 1) + r = t + 1 := by omega
          rw [hpos]; exact hdoor
    · by_cases hac : IsAlpha p (t + 1) ∧ IsComplete p t
      · 
        obtain ⟨ha, hc⟩ := hac
        have hdeq : doorDepth p t = k - 2 := hc
        have hnd : ¬ IsDoor p (t + 1) := by
          rw [IsDoor]; have := ha.1; omega
        have hrs := runStart_not_metaHeavy (p := p) (t := t) (fun hmh => hmh.2 ⟨ha, hc⟩)
        have hmd := metaDepth_alpha_complete ha hc
        have hdd := doorDepth_not_door hnd
        have hexp : (metaDepth p t + 1) * (k - 1) = metaDepth p t * (k - 1) + (k - 1) :=
          Nat.succ_mul _ _
        refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [hrs, hmd, hdd, hexp]; omega
        · rw [hrs, hmd]
          intro j r hj hr1 hr2
          by_cases hjm : j < metaDepth p t
          · exact ihB j r hjm hr1 hr2
          · have hje : j = metaDepth p t := by omega
            subst hje
            exact ihD r hr1 (by omega)
        · rw [hrs, hmd]
          intro c hc1 hc2
          by_cases hcm : c ≤ metaDepth p t
          · exact ihC c hc1 hcm
          · have hce : c = metaDepth p t + 1 := by omega
            subst hce
            have hpos : runStart p t + (metaDepth p t + 1) * (k - 1) = t + 1 := by
              rw [hexp]; omega
            rw [hpos]; exact ha
        · rw [hrs, hmd, hdd]
          intro r hr1 hr2; omega
      · 
        have hmh : IsMetaHeavy p (t + 1) := ⟨hdoor, hac⟩
        have hrs := runStart_metaHeavy hmh
        have hmd := metaDepth_metaHeavy hmh
        have hdd := doorDepth_not_door hdoor
        refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [hrs, hmd, hdd]; omega
        · rw [hrs, hmd]; intro j r hj hr1 hr2; omega
        · rw [hrs, hmd]; intro c hc1 hc2; omega
        · rw [hrs, hmd, hdd]; intro r hr1 hr2; omega

name: Hunter.ProofsRunExtract.metaDepth_le
statement:
theorem metaDepth_le (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) (t : ℕ)
    (hN : k * t ≤ p.numVerts) : metaDepth p t ≤ k - 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hA, hB, hC, _⟩ := runExtract (by omega) p t
  refine metaDepth_le_of_run hk hp (runStart p t) (metaDepth p t) ?_ hB ?_
  · have hle : runStart p t + metaDepth p t * (k - 1) ≤ t := by omega
    calc k * (runStart p t + metaDepth p t * (k - 1))
        ≤ k * t := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) hle
      _ ≤ p.numVerts := hN
  · intro c hc1 hc2; exact hC c hc1 (le_of_lt hc2)

name: Hunter.ProofsRunExtract.run_payment
statement:
theorem run_payment (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) (t : ℕ)
    (hN : k * t ≤ p.numVerts) :
    metaDepth p t ≤ k - 2 ∧
    ∀ c, 1 ≤ c → c ≤ metaDepth p t → bw p (runStart p t + c * (k - 1)) = 3
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, _, hC, _⟩ := runExtract (by omega) p t
  exact ⟨metaDepth_le hk hp t hN, fun c hc1 hc2 => (hC c hc1 hc2).1⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsRunExtract.metaHeavy_bw_ge3
statement:
theorem metaHeavy_bw_ge3 (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) {s : ℕ}
    (hs : 1 ≤ s) (hN : k * s < p.numVerts) (h : IsMetaHeavy p s) : 3 ≤ bw p s
proof:
:= by
  rcases boundary_classify_ledger hk hp hs hN with hd | ha | hσ | hmm | hh
  · exact absurd hd h.1
  · exact ha.1.ge
  · exact hσ.1.ge
  · exact hmm.1.ge
  · rw [IsHeavy] at hh; omega

name: Hunter.ProofsRunExtract.metaHeavy_pays_and_resets
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨metaHeavy_bw_ge3 hk hp hs hN h, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨s', rfl⟩ : ∃ s', s = s' + 1 := ⟨s - 1, by omega⟩
  exact metaDepth_metaHeavy h

name: Hunter.ProofsRunExtract.run_loopStart_confined
statement:
theorem run_loopStart_confined (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) (t : ℕ)
    (hN : k * t < p.numVerts) :
    ∀ j, j ≤ metaDepth p t →
      (p.vert (k * (runStart p t + j * (k - 1))) : List ℕ).getLastD 0
          = (p.vert (k * runStart p t) : List ℕ).getLastD 0 ∧
      genLoop ((p.vert (k * (runStart p t + j * (k - 1))) : List ℕ).erase
          ((p.vert (k * runStart p t) : List ℕ).getLastD 0))
        = genLoop ((p.vert (k * runStart p t) : List ℕ).erase
          ((p.vert (k * runStart p t) : List ℕ).getLastD 0))
proof:
:= by
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
  have hk2 : 2 ≤ k := by omega
  obtain ⟨hA, hB, hC, _⟩ := runExtract hk2 p t
  set t₀ := runStart p t with ht0
  set m := metaDepth p t with hm
  set α₁ := (p.vert (k * t₀) : List ℕ).getLastD 0 with hα1
  have hcle : ∀ c, c ≤ m → t₀ + c * (k - 1) ≤ t := by
    intro c hc
    have : c * (k - 1) ≤ m * (k - 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul hc (le_refl _)
    omega
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    intro _
    rw [show t₀ + 0 * (k - 1) = t₀ from by ring]
    exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  | succ j ih =>
    intro hj
    obtain ⟨hmarkj, hglj⟩ := ih (by omega)
    have haj1 : t₀ + (j + 1) * (k - 1) = (t₀ + j * (k - 1)) + (k - 1) := by
      rw [Nat.succ_mul]; ring
    have haj1m1 : t₀ + (j + 1) * (k - 1) - 1 = t₀ + j * (k - 1) + (k - 2) := by
      rw [haj1]; omega
    
    have hdoorj : ∀ r, 1 ≤ r → r ≤ k - 2 →
        ew k (p.vert (k * (t₀ + j * (k - 1) + r) - 1))
          (p.vert (k * (t₀ + j * (k - 1) + r))) = 2 :=
      fun r hr1 hr2 => hB j r (by omega) hr1 hr2
    have hNj : k * (t₀ + j * (k - 1) + (k - 2)) < p.numVerts := by
      have hle : t₀ + j * (k - 1) + (k - 2) ≤ t := by
        have h1 : (j + 1) * (k - 1) ≤ m * (k - 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (le_refl _)
        have h2 : (j + 1) * (k - 1) = j * (k - 1) + (k - 1) := Nat.succ_mul j (k - 1)
        omega
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) hle) hN
    have hrun := door_run_metaWord hk2 hp (t₀ + j * (k - 1)) (k - 2) hNj hdoorj
    obtain ⟨hmarkr, hmetar⟩ := hrun (k - 2) (le_refl _)
    have hAlpha := hC (j + 1) (by omega) hj
    have hmarkAlpha : (p.vert (k * (t₀ + (j + 1) * (k - 1))) : List ℕ).getLastD 0
        = (rho (p.vert (k * (t₀ + (j + 1) * (k - 1)) - 1) : List ℕ)).getLastD 0 := hAlpha.2.1
    have hNj1 : k * (t₀ + (j + 1) * (k - 1)) < p.numVerts :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) (hcle (j + 1) hj)) hN
    have ht1 : 1 ≤ t₀ + (j + 1) * (k - 1) := by
      have : 1 * 1 ≤ (j + 1) * (k - 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (by omega); omega
    have hmkprev : (p.vert (k * (t₀ + (j + 1) * (k - 1) - 1)) : List ℕ).getLastD 0 = α₁ := by
      rw [haj1m1, hmarkr]; exact hmarkj
    
    have hlenj : ((p.vert (k * (t₀ + j * (k - 1))) : List ℕ).erase α₁).length = k - 1 := by
      rw [← hmarkj, erase_getLastD (p.vert (k * (t₀ + j * (k - 1)))).2.nodup,
          List.length_dropLast, (p.vert (k * (t₀ + j * (k - 1)))).2.length]
    
    have hstep : (p.vert (k * (t₀ + (j + 1) * (k - 1))) : List ℕ).erase α₁
        = door (((p.vert (k * (t₀ + j * (k - 1))) : List ℕ).erase α₁).rotate (k - 2)) := by
      have hab := metaWord_alpha_block hk hp ht1 hNj1 hAlpha.1 hmarkAlpha hAlpha.2.2 hmkprev
      rw [show (p.vert (k * (t₀ + j * (k - 1))) : List ℕ).getLastD 0 = α₁ from hmarkj] at hmetar
      rw [hab, haj1m1, hmetar]
    have hrot1 :
        (((p.vert (k * (t₀ + j * (k - 1))) : List ℕ).erase α₁).rotate (k - 2)).rotate 1
          = (p.vert (k * (t₀ + j * (k - 1))) : List ℕ).erase α₁ := by
      rw [List.rotate_rotate]
      have hexp : (k - 2) + 1 = ((p.vert (k * (t₀ + j * (k - 1))) : List ℕ).erase α₁).length := by
        rw [hlenj]; omega
      rw [hexp, List.rotate_length]
    have h2le :
        2 ≤ (((p.vert (k * (t₀ + j * (k - 1))) : List ℕ).erase α₁).rotate (k - 2)).length := by
      rw [List.length_rotate, hlenj]; omega
    refine ⟨marker_alpha_step hk1 hp ht1 (le_of_lt hNj1) hmarkAlpha hmkprev, ?_⟩
    rw [hstep, genLoop_door_eq_rho_of_len h2le]
    show genLoop ((((p.vert (k * (t₀ + j * (k - 1))) : List ℕ).erase α₁).rotate (k - 2)).rotate 1)
      = _
    rw [hrot1]; exact hglj

name: Hunter.ProofsRunExtract.run_confined
statement:
theorem run_confined (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) (t : ℕ)
    (hN : k * t < p.numVerts) :
    ∀ j r,
      (j < metaDepth p t ∧ 1 ≤ r ∧ r ≤ k - 2) ∨ (j = metaDepth p t ∧ r ≤ doorDepth p t) →
      p.vert (k * (runStart p t + j * (k - 1) + r))
        ∈ Vset3 k ((p.vert (k * runStart p t) : List ℕ).getLastD 0)
            (((p.vert (k * runStart p t) : List ℕ).erase
                ((p.vert (k * runStart p t) : List ℕ).getLastD 0)).getLastD 0)
            (rotClass (((p.vert (k * runStart p t) : List ℕ).erase
                ((p.vert (k * runStart p t) : List ℕ).getLastD 0)).dropLast))
proof:
:= by
  have hk2 : 2 ≤ k := by omega
  obtain ⟨hA, hB, _, hD⟩ := runExtract hk2 p t
  
  have hmem : ∀ j, j ≤ metaDepth p t →
      p.vert (k * (runStart p t + j * (k - 1)))
        ∈ Vset3 k ((p.vert (k * runStart p t) : List ℕ).getLastD 0)
            (((p.vert (k * runStart p t) : List ℕ).erase
                ((p.vert (k * runStart p t) : List ℕ).getLastD 0)).getLastD 0)
            (rotClass (((p.vert (k * runStart p t) : List ℕ).erase
                ((p.vert (k * runStart p t) : List ℕ).getLastD 0)).dropLast)) ∧
      (p.vert (k * (runStart p t + j * (k - 1))) : List ℕ).getLastD 0
        = (p.vert (k * runStart p t) : List ℕ).getLastD 0 := by
    intro j hj
    obtain ⟨hmk, hgl⟩ := run_loopStart_confined hk hp t hN j hj
    have hpair : genLoop ((p.vert (k * (runStart p t + j * (k - 1))) : List ℕ).erase
            ((p.vert (k * runStart p t) : List ℕ).getLastD 0))
        = (((p.vert (k * runStart p t) : List ℕ).erase
              ((p.vert (k * runStart p t) : List ℕ).getLastD 0)).getLastD 0,
           rotClass (((p.vert (k * runStart p t) : List ℕ).erase
              ((p.vert (k * runStart p t) : List ℕ).getLastD 0)).dropLast)) := hgl
    exact ⟨mem_Vset3_of_genLoop_metaWord hpair, hmk⟩
  
  intro j r hjr
  rcases hjr with ⟨hjm, hr1, hr2⟩ | ⟨hjm, hrd⟩
  · obtain ⟨hmemj, hmarkj⟩ := hmem j (le_of_lt hjm)
    have hdoorj : ∀ s, 1 ≤ s → s ≤ k - 2 →
        ew k (p.vert (k * (runStart p t + j * (k - 1) + s) - 1))
          (p.vert (k * (runStart p t + j * (k - 1) + s))) = 2 :=
      fun s hs1 hs2 => hB j s hjm hs1 hs2
    have hNj : k * (runStart p t + j * (k - 1) + (k - 2)) < p.numVerts := by
      have hle : runStart p t + j * (k - 1) + (k - 2) ≤ t := by
        have h1 : (j + 1) * (k - 1) ≤ metaDepth p t * (k - 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (le_refl _)
        have h2 : (j + 1) * (k - 1) = j * (k - 1) + (k - 1) := Nat.succ_mul j (k - 1)
        omega
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) hle) hN
    obtain ⟨_, hrotr⟩ :=
      door_run_metaWord hk2 hp (runStart p t + j * (k - 1)) (k - 2) hNj hdoorj r (by omega)
    rw [hmarkj] at hrotr
    exact Vset3_of_metaWord_rotate_iter hmemj hrotr
  · subst hjm
    obtain ⟨hmemm, hmarkm⟩ := hmem (metaDepth p t) (le_refl _)
    have hdoorm : ∀ s, 1 ≤ s → s ≤ doorDepth p t →
        ew k (p.vert (k * (runStart p t + metaDepth p t * (k - 1) + s) - 1))
          (p.vert (k * (runStart p t + metaDepth p t * (k - 1) + s))) = 2 :=
      fun s hs1 hs2 => hD s hs1 hs2
    have hNm : k * (runStart p t + metaDepth p t * (k - 1) + doorDepth p t) < p.numVerts := by
      rw [← hA]; exact hN
    obtain ⟨_, hrotr⟩ :=
      door_run_metaWord hk2 hp (runStart p t + metaDepth p t * (k - 1)) (doorDepth p t) hNm hdoorm
        r hrd
    rw [hmarkm] at hrotr
    exact Vset3_of_metaWord_rotate_iter hmemm hrotr

name: Hunter.ProofsFinal.ceilDiv_step
statement:
theorem ceilDiv_step (hk : 0 < k) {n : ℕ} (hn : k ≤ n) :
    n ⌈/⌉ k = (n - k) ⌈/⌉ k + 1
proof:
:= by
  have h : (n - k) + k = n := by omega
  have := ceilDiv_add_dvd (a := n - k) (b := k) hk ⟨1, by ring⟩
  rw [h] at this
  rw [this, Nat.div_self hk]

name: Hunter.ProofsFinal.bw_ge_three_of_doorDepth_zero
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ : ∃ a', a = a' + 1 := ⟨a - 1, by omega⟩
  have hnd : ¬ IsDoor p (a' + 1) := by
    intro hd
    rw [doorDepth_door hd] at hdd; omega
  
  have hkt : 1 ≤ k * (a' + 1) := Nat.mul_pos hk (by omega)
  have hi1 : k * (a' + 1) - 1 + 1 = k * (a' + 1) := by omega
  have hin : (k * (a' + 1) - 1) + 1 < p.numVerts := by rw [hi1]; exact hN
  have hd : k ∣ ((k * (a' + 1) - 1) + 1) := by rw [hi1]; exact ⟨a' + 1, rfl⟩
  have hge2 := boundary_ge_two hk hp hin hd
  rw [hi1] at hge2
  rw [IsDoor, bw] at hnd
  unfold bw
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsFinal.excess_prefix_eq
statement:
theorem excess_prefix_eq (hk : 1 ≤ k) {p q : HPath k} {m : ℕ} (hm : m ≤ p.numVerts)
    (hq : q.verts = p.verts.take m) :
    excess q = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m - 1), (ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) - 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hqn : q.numVerts = m := by
    have hlen : q.verts.length = (p.verts.take m).length := by rw [hq]
    have hNl : p.verts.length = p.numVerts := rfl
    rw [List.length_take, hNl] at hlen
    show q.verts.length = m
    rw [hlen]; omega
  rw [excess_eq_sum_edgeWeight hk q, hqn]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [Finset.mem_range] at hi
  rw [prefix_vert_eq hq hm (show i < m by omega),
      prefix_vert_eq hq hm (show i + 1 < m by omega)]

name: Hunter.ProofsFinal.excess_block_step
statement:
theorem excess_block_step (hk : 1 ≤ k) {p q q' : HPath k} {n a : ℕ}
    (hn : k ≤ n) (hnN : n ≤ p.numVerts) (ha : 1 ≤ a) (haval : a = (n - 1) / k)
    (hq : q.verts = p.verts.take n) (hq' : q'.verts = p.verts.take (n - k)) :
    excess q' + (bw p a - 2) ≤ excess q
proof:
:= by
  set f : ℕ → ℕ := fun i => ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) - 2 with hfdef
  have heq : excess q = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n - 1), f i := excess_prefix_eq hk hnN hq
  have heq' : excess q' = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k - 1), f i :=
    excess_prefix_eq hk (by omega) hq'
  
  have hka1 : k * a ≤ n - 1 := by
    rw [haval, Nat.mul_comm]; exact Nat.div_mul_le_self (n - 1) k
  have hmod : (n - 1) % k < k := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  have hdm : k * ((n - 1) / k) + (n - 1) % k = n - 1 := Nat.div_add_mod (n - 1) k
  have hka2 : n - 1 < k * a + k := by rw [haval]; omega
  have hkapos : 1 ≤ k * a := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) ha
  
  have hsplit : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n - 1), f i
      = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n - k - 1), f i + ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico (n - k - 1) (n - 1), f i := by
    rw [Finset.range_eq_Ico, Finset.range_eq_Ico,
        ← Finset.sum_Ico_consecutive f (Nat.zero_le (n - k - 1)) (by omega : n - k - 1 ≤ n - 1)]
  
  have hmem : (k * a - 1) ∈ Finset.Ico (n - k - 1) (n - 1) := by
    rw [Finset.mem_Ico]; omega
  have hsingle : f (k * a - 1) ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico (n - k - 1) (n - 1), f i :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (f := f) (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) hmem
  have hfval : f (k * a - 1) = bw p a - 2 := by
    have e1 : k * a - 1 + 1 = k * a := by omega
    simp only [hfdef, bw]; rw [e1]
  rw [heq, heq', hsplit, ← hfval]
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsFinal.tight_window_pays
statement:
theorem tight_window_pays (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p q : HPath k} (hpe : p.Exitless) (hqe : q.Exitless)
    (hlt : k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) < p.numVerts)
    (hprefix : q.verts = p.verts.take (p.numVerts - ell0 k))
    (hdoor : doorDepth p (winA p) ≠ 0) :
    excess q + (k - 2) ≤ excess p
proof:
:= by
  set a := winA p with hadef
  set M := (k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1 with hMdef
  have hrange : k * (a + M) < p.numVerts := by rw [hadef, hMdef]; exact winA_range hk hlt
  have hsplit := excess_window_split hk hlt hprefix
  rw [← hadef, ← hMdef] at hsplit
  set W3 := (Finset.filter (fun j => 3 ≤ bw p (a + j)) (Finset.Icc 1 M)).card with hW3
  set H4 := (Finset.filter (fun j => 4 ≤ bw p (a + j)) (Finset.Icc 1 M)).card with hH4
  have hpay : W3 + H4 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, (bw p (a + j) - 2) := by
    rw [hW3, hH4, Finset.card_filter, Finset.card_filter, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro j _
    by_cases h3 : 3 ≤ bw p (a + j) <;> by_cases h4 : 4 ≤ bw p (a + j) <;>
      simp only [h3, h4, if_true, if_false] <;> omega
  have hfloor : k - 3 ≤ W3 := by
    have h := window_heavy_count hk hpe a M hrange
    rw [hMdef, windowM_ceilDiv hk] at h
    have hcard : (Finset.filter (fun j => 3 ≤ ew k (p.vert (k * (a + j) - 1)) (p.vert (k * (a + j))))
        (Finset.Icc 1 M)).card = W3 := rfl
    rw [hcard] at h; omega
  by_cases hA : ∃ j, 1 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ M ∧ 4 ≤ bw p (a + j)
  · obtain ⟨j, hj1, hjM, hj4⟩ := hA
    have hH4pos : 1 ≤ H4 := by
      rw [hH4]; apply Finset.one_le_card.mpr
      exact ⟨j, by rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc]; exact ⟨⟨hj1, hjM⟩, hj4⟩⟩
    omega
  · by_cases hB : ∃ j, 1 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ M ∧ ¬ IsDoor p (a + j) ∧ doorDepth p (a + j - 1) ≤ k - 3
    · obtain ⟨s₀, hs01, hs02, hnd, hinc⟩ := hB
      have h := window_incomplete_slack hk hpe a (by rw [← hMdef]; exact hrange)
        s₀ hs01 (by rw [← hMdef]; exact hs02) hnd hinc
      have hcard : (Finset.filter
          (fun j => 3 ≤ ew k (p.vert (k * (a + j) - 1)) (p.vert (k * (a + j))))
          (Finset.Icc 1 M)).card = W3 := rfl
      rw [← hMdef] at h; rw [hcard] at h; omega
    · 
      have hWsat : WindowSaturated p a M := by
        refine ⟨fun j hj1 hjM => ?_, fun j hj1 hjM => ?_⟩
        · by_contra hc; exact hA ⟨j, hj1, hjM, by omega⟩
        · by_cases hd : IsDoor p (a + j)
          · exact Or.inl hd
          · exact Or.inr (by by_contra hc; exact hB ⟨j, hj1, hjM, hd, by omega⟩)
      exact saturatedHeavy_of_doorPos hk hpe hqe hlt hprefix hWsat hdoor

name: Hunter.ProofsFinal.excessFrontier_of_jumpLoopEntryFree
statement:
theorem excessFrontier_of_jumpLoopEntryFree (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hJ : JumpLoopEntryFree k) :
    ExcessFrontier k
proof:
:= by
  have main : ∀ ℓ : ℕ, ∀ p : HPath k, p.Exitless → p.numVerts = ℓ →
      j k p.numVerts ≤ (p.numVerts - 1) + (p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k - 1) + excess p := by
    intro ℓ
    induction ℓ using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | _ ℓ ih =>
      intro p hpe hpℓ
      have h0 : 0 < p.numVerts := p.numVerts_pos
      by_cases hbaseR : p.numVerts ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)
      · exact excess_frontier_base hk hpe h0 hbaseR
      · rw [Nat.not_le] at hbaseR
        have he0pos : 0 < ell0 k := ell0_pos hk
        have hm : 2 ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by
          have h := Nat.mul_le_mul (show 2 ≤ k - 1 by omega) (show 1 ≤ k - 2 by omega)
          omega
        have hprod : k * 2 ≤ k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2)) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) hm
        have heq : k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2)) = k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by ring
        have he0val : ell0 k = k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) - k := rfl
        have hkle0 : k ≤ ell0 k := by rw [he0val]; omega
        have he0base : ell0 k ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by rw [he0val]; omega
        set n := p.numVerts - ell0 k with hn
        have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := by rw [hn]; omega
        have hnk : k < n := by rw [hn, he0val]; omega
        have hnle : n ≤ p.numVerts := by rw [hn]; omega
        have hnlt : n < p.numVerts := by rw [hn]; omega
        have hNsum : p.numVerts = n + ell0 k := by rw [hn]; omega
        obtain ⟨q, hqv, hqe⟩ := prefix_exitless hpe hn1 hnle
        have hqnv : q.numVerts = n := by
          have hlen : p.verts.length = p.numVerts := rfl
          show q.verts.length = n
          rw [hqv, List.length_take, hlen]; omega
        have hpre : q.verts = p.verts.take (p.numVerts - ell0 k) := by rw [hqv, hn]
        have hnltℓ : n < ℓ := by rw [← hpℓ]; exact hnlt
        have hIH := ih n hnltℓ q hqe hqnv
        rw [hqnv] at hIH
        have hdvd : k ∣ ell0 k := k_dvd_ell0 hk
        have hje0 : j k (ell0 k) = ell0 k + (ell0 k / k) + (k - 2) - 3 := by
          rw [j_base (Or.inl he0base), Proved.ceilDiv_of_dvd (show 0 < k by omega) hdvd,
              ceilDiv_ell0 hk]
        have hsplit : p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k = n ⌈/⌉ k + ell0 k / k := by
          rw [hNsum]; exact ceilDiv_add_dvd (show 0 < k by omega) hdvd
        have hjrec : j k p.numVerts = j k n + j k (ell0 k) + 3 := by
          have hr := j_rec_unfold_one hk hbaseR
          rw [← hn] at hr; exact hr
        have hXn1 : 1 ≤ n ⌈/⌉ k := by
          rw [Proved.ceilDiv_succ_pred hn1 (show 0 < k by omega)]; exact Nat.le_add_left 1 _
        have hXe1 : 1 ≤ ell0 k / k :=
          (Nat.one_le_div_iff (show 0 < k by omega)).mpr hkle0
        by_cases htight : j k n = (n - 1) + (n ⌈/⌉ k - 1) + excess q
        · 
          have haval : winA p = (n - 1) / k := by
            show (p.numVerts - ell0 k - 1) / k = (n - 1) / k
            have hnn : p.numVerts - ell0 k - 1 = n - 1 := by omega
            rw [hnn]
          have ha1 : 1 ≤ winA p := by
            rw [haval]; exact (Nat.one_le_div_iff (show 0 < k by omega)).mpr (by omega)
          have hdoor : doorDepth p (winA p) ≠ 0 := by
            intro hdd0
            by_cases hjump : j k n = j k (n - k) + (k + 1)
            · 
              obtain ⟨q', hq'v, hq'e⟩ := prefix_exitless hpe (show 1 ≤ n - k by omega)
                (show n - k ≤ p.numVerts by omega)
              have hq'nv : q'.numVerts = n - k := by
                have hlen : p.verts.length = p.numVerts := rfl
                show q'.verts.length = n - k
                rw [hq'v, List.length_take, hlen]; omega
              have hIH' := ih (n - k) (by omega) q' hq'e hq'nv
              rw [hq'nv] at hIH'
              have hkaN : k * winA p < p.numVerts := by
                have : k * winA p ≤ n - 1 := by
                  rw [haval, Nat.mul_comm]; exact Nat.div_mul_le_self (n - 1) k
                omega
              have hbw3 : 3 ≤ bw p (winA p) :=
                bw_ge_three_of_doorDepth_zero (by omega) hpe ha1 hkaN hdd0
              have hstep : excess q' + (bw p (winA p) - 2) ≤ excess q :=
                excess_block_step (by omega) (by omega) hnle ha1 haval hqv hq'v
              have hcstep : n ⌈/⌉ k = (n - k) ⌈/⌉ k + 1 := ceilDiv_step (by omega) (by omega)
              have hXnk1 : 1 ≤ (n - k) ⌈/⌉ k := by
                rw [Proved.ceilDiv_succ_pred (show 1 ≤ n - k by omega) (show 0 < k by omega)]
                exact Nat.le_add_left 1 _
              omega
            · 
              exact hJ p q hpe hqe hbaseR hpre (by rw [hqnv]; exact htight) (by rw [← hn]; exact hjump) hdd0
          have hwin : excess q + (k - 2) ≤ excess p := tight_window_pays hk hpe hqe hbaseR hpre hdoor
          omega
        · 
          have hfloor : excess q + (k - 3) ≤ excess p :=
            windowExcess_ge_km3 hk hpe hbaseR hpre
          omega
  intro q hqe h0
  have := main q.numVerts q hqe rfl
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsFinal.winA_residue_of_doorDepth_zero
statement:
theorem winA_residue_of_doorDepth_zero (hk : 3 ≤ k) (p : HPath k)
    (hdd : doorDepth p (winA p) = 0) :
    winA p % (k - 1) = runStart p (winA p) % (k - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := runLen_eq hk p (winA p)
  rw [hdd, Nat.add_zero] at h
  calc winA p % (k - 1)
      = (runStart p (winA p) + metaDepth p (winA p) * (k - 1)) % (k - 1) := by rw [h]
    _ = runStart p (winA p) % (k - 1) := by rw [Nat.add_mul_mod_self_right]

name: Hunter.ProofsFinal.jumpLoopEntryFree_of_tightLoopEntryFree
statement:
theorem jumpLoopEntryFree_of_tightLoopEntryFree (h : TightLoopEntryFree k) :
    JumpLoopEntryFree k
proof:
:=
  fun p q hpe hqe hlt hpre htight _ => h p q hpe hqe hlt hpre htight

name: Hunter.ProofsFinal.frontierTightHeavy_of_excessFrontier
statement:
theorem frontierTightHeavy_of_excessFrontier (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hfr : ExcessFrontier k) :
    FrontierTightHeavy k
proof:
:= by
  intro p q hpe hqe hbaseR hprefix htight
  have he0pos : 0 < ell0 k := ell0_pos hk
  have he0val : ell0 k = k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) - k := rfl
  have hm : 2 ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by
    have h := Nat.mul_le_mul (show 2 ≤ k - 1 by omega) (show 1 ≤ k - 2 by omega); omega
  have hprod : k * 2 ≤ k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2)) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) hm
  have heq : k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2)) = k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by ring
  have hkle0 : k ≤ ell0 k := by rw [he0val]; omega
  have he0base : ell0 k ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by rw [he0val]; omega
  set N := p.numVerts with hNdef
  set n := N - ell0 k with hn
  have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := by rw [hn]; omega
  have hnle : n ≤ N := by rw [hn]; omega
  have hNsum : N = n + ell0 k := by rw [hn]; omega
  have hqnv : q.numVerts = n := by
    have hlen : p.verts.length = N := rfl
    show q.verts.length = n
    rw [hprefix, List.length_take, hlen]; omega
  have h0p : 0 < N := by omega
  have hfrp := hfr p hpe h0p
  rw [← hNdef] at hfrp
  rw [hqnv] at htight
  have hdvd : k ∣ ell0 k := k_dvd_ell0 hk
  have hje0 : j k (ell0 k) = ell0 k + (ell0 k / k) + (k - 2) - 3 := by
    rw [j_base (Or.inl he0base), Proved.ceilDiv_of_dvd (show 0 < k by omega) hdvd, ceilDiv_ell0 hk]
  have hsplit : N ⌈/⌉ k = n ⌈/⌉ k + ell0 k / k := by
    rw [hNsum]; exact ceilDiv_add_dvd (show 0 < k by omega) hdvd
  have hjrec : j k N = j k n + j k (ell0 k) + 3 := by
    have hr := j_rec_unfold_one hk hbaseR; rw [← hn] at hr; exact hr
  have hXn1 : 1 ≤ n ⌈/⌉ k := by
    rw [Proved.ceilDiv_succ_pred hn1 (show 0 < k by omega)]; exact Nat.le_add_left 1 _
  have hXe1 : 1 ≤ ell0 k / k := (Nat.one_le_div_iff (show 0 < k by omega)).mpr hkle0
  have hXN1 : 1 ≤ N ⌈/⌉ k := by
    rw [Proved.ceilDiv_succ_pred (show 1 ≤ N by omega) (show 0 < k by omega)]
    exact Nat.le_add_left 1 _
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsFinal.frontierTightHeavyAll_of_jumpLoopEntryFreeAll
statement:
theorem frontierTightHeavyAll_of_jumpLoopEntryFreeAll (hJ : JumpLoopEntryFreeAll) :
    FrontierTightHeavyAll
proof:
:=
  fun k hk => frontierTightHeavy_of_excessFrontier hk
    (excessFrontier_of_jumpLoopEntryFree hk (hJ k hk))

name: Hunter.ProofsFinal.thm2_of_jumpLoopEntryFree
statement:
theorem thm2_of_jumpLoopEntryFree {k ℓ : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hJ : JumpLoopEntryFree k)
    (hℓ : HasExitlessPath k ℓ) :
    j k ℓ ≤ iExitless k ℓ
proof:
:=
  thm2_of_frontier hk (excessFrontier_of_jumpLoopEntryFree hk hJ) hℓ

name: Hunter.ProofsFinal.thm2_global_of_jumpLoopEntryFree
statement:
theorem thm2_global_of_jumpLoopEntryFree (hJ : JumpLoopEntryFreeAll) :
    ∀ k ℓ, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k ℓ → j k ℓ ≤ iExitless k ℓ
proof:
:=
  fun k _ℓ hk hℓ => thm2_of_jumpLoopEntryFree hk (hJ k hk) hℓ

name: Hunter.ProofsFinal.thm1v1_of_jumpLoopEntryFree
statement:
theorem thm1v1_of_jumpLoopEntryFree (hJ : JumpLoopEntryFreeAll)
    (hproof : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) →
        (L k : ℝ) ≥ (iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ)
          + (((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
              (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)))
            * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ)))
    (hexists : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2))) :
    ∃ (C : ℝ) (k₀ : ℕ), ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k →
      (Lstar k : ℝ) ≥ coeff k * (k.factorial : ℝ) + (k : ℝ) - C
proof:
:=
  ProofsMF.thm1v1_of_MF (frontierTightHeavyAll_of_jumpLoopEntryFreeAll hJ) hproof hexists

name: Hunter.ProofsFinal.thm1v2_of_jumpLoopEntryFree
statement:
theorem thm1v2_of_jumpLoopEntryFree (hJ : JumpLoopEntryFreeAll)
    (hproof : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) →
        (L k : ℝ) ≥ (iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ)
          + (((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
              (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)))
            * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ)))
    (hexists : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2))) :
    ∃ (C : ℝ) (k₀ : ℕ), ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k → (L k : ℝ) ≥ coeff k * (k.factorial : ℝ) - C
proof:
:=
  ProofsMF.thm1v2_of_MF (frontierTightHeavyAll_of_jumpLoopEntryFreeAll hJ) hproof hexists

name: Hunter.ProofsSpine.zip_map_eq_zipWith
statement:
theorem zip_map_eq_zipWith {α β γ : Type*} (f : α → β → γ) :
    ∀ (l : List α) (l' : List β), (l.zip l').map (fun e => f e.1 e.2) = l.zipWith f l'
proof:
| [], _ => rfl
  | _ :: _, [] => rfl
  | a :: l, b :: l' => by
      rw [List.zip_cons_cons, List.map_cons, List.zipWith_cons_cons, zip_map_eq_zipWith f l l']

name: Hunter.ProofsSpine.zip_tail_nodup
statement: theorem zip_tail_nodup {p : HPath k} : (p.verts.zip p.verts.tail).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  apply List.Nodup.of_map Prod.snd
  rw [List.map_snd_zip (by rw [List.length_tail]; omega)]
  exact (p.verts.tail_sublist).nodup p.nodup

name: Hunter.ProofsSpine.mem_edges_iff
statement:
theorem mem_edges_iff {p : HPath k} {e : Vtx k × Vtx k} :
    e ∈ p.edges ↔ e ∈ p.verts.zip p.verts.tail
proof: := List.mem_toFinset

name: Hunter.ProofsSpine.first_eq
statement:
theorem first_eq {p : HPath k} {a : Vtx k} {t : List (Vtx k)} (hvts : p.verts = a :: t) :
    p.first = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← p.vert_zero, HPath.vert]
  simp only [hvts, List.getD_cons_zero]

name: Hunter.ProofsSpine.first_not_mem_tail
statement: theorem first_not_mem_tail (p : HPath k) : p.first ∉ p.verts.tail
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, t, hv⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil p.ne
  have hnd : (a :: t).Nodup := hv ▸ p.nodup
  rw [first_eq hv, hv, List.tail_cons]
  exact (List.nodup_cons.mp hnd).1

name: Hunter.ProofsSpine.snd_mem_tail
statement:
theorem snd_mem_tail {p : HPath k} {e : Vtx k × Vtx k}
    (h : e ∈ p.verts.zip p.verts.tail) : e.2 ∈ p.verts.tail
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : e.2 ∈ (p.verts.zip p.verts.tail).map Prod.snd := List.mem_map.mpr ⟨e, h, rfl⟩
  rwa [List.map_snd_zip (by rw [List.length_tail]; omega)] at hmem

name: Hunter.ProofsSpine.exists_pred
statement:
theorem exists_pred {p : HPath k} {v : Vtx k} (hv : v ∈ p.verts) (hne : v ≠ p.first) :
    ∃ u, (u, v) ∈ p.edges
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, t, hvts⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil p.ne
  have hfirst : p.first = a := first_eq hvts
  have hvt : v ∈ t := by
    rw [hvts, List.mem_cons] at hv
    rcases hv with h | h
    · exact absurd (hfirst ▸ h) hne
    · exact h
  have htail : p.verts.tail = t := by rw [hvts]; rfl
  have hmem : v ∈ (p.verts.zip p.verts.tail).map Prod.snd := by
    rw [List.map_snd_zip (by rw [List.length_tail]; omega), htail]; exact hvt
  obtain ⟨e, he, hesnd⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hmem
  refine ⟨e.1, ?_⟩
  rw [mem_edges_iff]
  have : (e.1, v) = e := by rw [← hesnd]
  rw [this]; exact he

name: Hunter.ProofsSpine.compTails_eq
statement:
theorem compTails_eq {p : HPath k} {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)}
    (hp : IsPathComponent p X) : compTails X p.vertsFinset = {p.first}
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  rw [compTails, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hvV, hinto⟩
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := exists_pred (HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mp hvV) hne
    have huX : (u, v) ∈ X := hp.1 hu
    have hmem : (u, v) ∈ intoV X v := by
      rw [intoV, mem_into]; exact ⟨huX, Finset.mem_singleton_self v⟩
    rw [hinto] at hmem; exact absurd hmem (Finset.notMem_empty _)
  · rintro rfl
    refine ⟨HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mpr p.first_mem, ?_⟩
    rw [Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
    rintro e he
    rw [intoV, mem_into, Finset.mem_singleton] at he
    obtain ⟨heX, he2⟩ := he
    have h2V : e.2 ∈ p.vertsFinset := by rw [he2]; exact HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mpr p.first_mem
    have h1V : e.1 ∈ p.vertsFinset := (hp.2.1 e heX).mpr h2V
    have hee : e ∈ p.edges := hp.2.2 e heX h1V
    rw [mem_edges_iff] at hee
    have hsnd : e.2 ∈ p.verts.tail := snd_mem_tail hee
    rw [he2] at hsnd
    exact first_not_mem_tail p hsnd

name: Hunter.ProofsSpine.path_out_le_one
statement: theorem path_out_le_one (P : HPath k) (v : Vtx k) : (outV P.edges v).card ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.card_le_one]
  intro a ha b hb
  simp only [outV, mem_out, Finset.mem_singleton, HPath.edges, List.mem_toFinset] at ha hb
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hia⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp ha.1
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hjb⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hb.1
  have hi' : i < P.verts.length := List.lt_length_left_of_zip hi
  have hj' : j < P.verts.length := List.lt_length_left_of_zip hj
  have hai : P.verts[i]'hi' = v := by
    have h := ha.2; rw [← hia] at h; simpa using h
  have hbj : P.verts[j]'hj' = v := by
    have h := hb.2; rw [← hjb] at h; simpa using h
  have hij : i = j := (P.nodup.getElem_inj_iff).mp (hai.trans hbj.symm)
  subst hij
  exact hia.symm.trans hjb

name: Hunter.ProofsSpine.path_into_le_one
statement: theorem path_into_le_one (P : HPath k) (v : Vtx k) : (intoV P.edges v).card ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.card_le_one]
  intro a ha b hb
  simp only [intoV, mem_into, Finset.mem_singleton, HPath.edges, List.mem_toFinset] at ha hb
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hia⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp ha.1
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hjb⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hb.1
  have hi1 : i + 1 < P.verts.length := by
    have h := List.lt_length_right_of_zip hi; rw [List.length_tail] at h; omega
  have hj1 : j + 1 < P.verts.length := by
    have h := List.lt_length_right_of_zip hj; rw [List.length_tail] at h; omega
  have hai : P.verts[i + 1]'hi1 = v := by
    have h := ha.2; rw [← hia] at h; simpa using h
  have hbj : P.verts[j + 1]'hj1 = v := by
    have h := hb.2; rw [← hjb] at h; simpa using h
  have hij : i + 1 = j + 1 := (P.nodup.getElem_inj_iff).mp (hai.trans hbj.symm)
  have hij' : i = j := by omega
  subst hij'
  exact hia.symm.trans hjb

name: Hunter.ProofsSpine.length_le_one_of_subsingleton
statement:
theorem length_le_one_of_subsingleton {α : Type*} [Subsingleton α] {l : List α}
    (h : l.Nodup) : l.length ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  match l, h with
  | [], _ => simp
  | [_], _ => simp
  | a :: b :: t, h =>
      exact absurd (show b ∈ b :: t from List.mem_cons_self)
        (Subsingleton.elim a b ▸ (List.nodup_cons.mp h).1)

name: Hunter.ProofsSpine.edges_eq_empty_zero
statement: theorem edges_eq_empty_zero (P : HPath 0) : P.edges = ∅
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : Subsingleton (Vtx 0) := ⟨fun x y => Subtype.ext (by
    have hx : x.1 = [] := (List.toFinset_eq_empty_iff x.1).mp
      (x.2.2.trans (Finset.Icc_eq_empty (by omega)))
    have hy : y.1 = [] := (List.toFinset_eq_empty_iff y.1).mp
      (y.2.2.trans (Finset.Icc_eq_empty (by omega)))
    rw [hx, hy])⟩
  have hlen : P.verts.length ≤ 1 := length_le_one_of_subsingleton P.nodup
  rw [HPath.edges, Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
  intro e he
  rw [List.mem_toFinset] at he
  have h2 := snd_mem_tail he
  have hpos : 0 < P.verts.tail.length := List.length_pos_of_mem h2
  rw [List.length_tail] at hpos
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsSpine.one_le_ew_of_mem_edges
statement:
theorem one_le_ew_of_mem_edges {P : HPath k} {e : Vtx k × Vtx k}
    (he : e ∈ P.edges) : 1 ≤ ew k e.1 e.2
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with rfl | hk
  · rw [edges_eq_empty_zero P] at he; exact absurd he (Finset.notMem_empty _)
  · rw [ew]; exact (wt_spec hk (le_of_eq e.1.2.length)).1

name: Hunter.ProofsSpine.sigma_inj
statement: theorem sigma_inj : Function.Injective (sigma : Vtx k → Vtx k)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hval : a.1.rotate 1 = b.1.rotate 1 := congrArg Subtype.val h
  exact List.rotate_injective 1 hval

name: Hunter.ProofsSpine.outV_mono
statement:
theorem outV_mono {X Y : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} (h : X ⊆ Y) (v : Vtx k) :
    outV X v ⊆ outV Y v
proof: := Finset.filter_subset_filter _ h

name: Hunter.ProofsSpine.intoV_mono
statement:
theorem intoV_mono {X Y : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} (h : X ⊆ Y) (v : Vtx k) :
    intoV X v ⊆ intoV Y v
proof: := Finset.filter_subset_filter _ h

name: Hunter.ProofsSpine.intoV_union
statement:
theorem intoV_union (X Y : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)) (v : Vtx k) :
    intoV (X ∪ Y) v = intoV X v ∪ intoV Y v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [intoV, into, Finset.filter_union]

name: Hunter.ProofsSpine.intoV_addedEdges_le_one
statement:
theorem intoV_addedEdges_le_one (S : Finset (Vtx k)) (v : Vtx k) :
    (intoV (addedEdges S) v).card ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.card_le_one]
  intro e he e' he'
  simp only [intoV, mem_into, addedEdges, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_singleton] at he he'
  obtain ⟨⟨w, _, hwe⟩, he2⟩ := he
  obtain ⟨⟨w', _, hw'e⟩, he'2⟩ := he'
  rw [← hwe] at he2 ⊢
  rw [← hw'e] at he'2 ⊢
  have hs2 : sigma w = v := he2
  have hs'2 : sigma w' = v := he'2
  have hww : w = w' := sigma_inj (hs2.trans hs'2.symm)
  rw [hww]

name: Hunter.ProofsSpine.outV_Xstep1_le_one
statement:
theorem outV_Xstep1_le_one (P : HPath k) (S : Finset (Vtx k)) (v : Vtx k) :
    (outV (Xstep1 P S) v).card ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hvS : v ∈ S
  · refine le_trans (Finset.card_le_card ?_) (le_of_eq (Finset.card_singleton (v, sigma v)))
    intro e he
    simp only [outV, mem_out, Finset.mem_singleton] at he ⊢
    obtain ⟨heX, he1⟩ := he
    rw [Xstep1, Finset.mem_union] at heX
    rcases heX with hP | hA
    · exfalso
      rw [Finset.mem_sdiff, E1removed, Finset.mem_filter] at hP
      exact hP.2 ⟨hP.1, by rw [he1]; exact hvS⟩
    · rw [addedEdges, Finset.mem_image] at hA
      obtain ⟨w, _, hwe⟩ := hA
      have hwv : w = v := by rw [← hwe] at he1; exact he1
      rw [← hwe, hwv]
  · refine le_trans (Finset.card_le_card ?_) (path_out_le_one P v)
    intro e he
    simp only [outV, mem_out, Finset.mem_singleton] at he ⊢
    obtain ⟨heX, he1⟩ := he
    rw [Xstep1, Finset.mem_union] at heX
    rcases heX with hP | hA
    · rw [Finset.mem_sdiff] at hP
      exact ⟨hP.1, he1⟩
    · exfalso
      rw [addedEdges, Finset.mem_image] at hA
      obtain ⟨w, hwS, hwe⟩ := hA
      have hwv : w = v := by rw [← hwe] at he1; exact he1
      exact hvS (hwv ▸ hwS)

name: Hunter.ProofsSpine.outV_fPS_le_one
statement:
theorem outV_fPS_le_one (P : HPath k) (S : Finset (Vtx k)) (v : Vtx k) :
    (outV (fPS P S) v).card ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  le_trans (Finset.card_le_card (outV_mono (fPS_subset_step1 P S) v)) (outV_Xstep1_le_one P S v)

name: Hunter.ProofsSpine.intoV_fPS_le_one
statement:
theorem intoV_fPS_le_one (P : HPath k) (S : Finset (Vtx k)) (_hS : SPrecond P S) (v : Vtx k) :
    (intoV (fPS P S) v).card ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hAle : (intoV (P.edges \ E1removed P S) v).card ≤ 1 :=
    le_trans (Finset.card_le_card (intoV_mono Finset.sdiff_subset v)) (path_into_le_one P v)
  have hBle : (intoV (addedEdges S) v).card ≤ 1 := intoV_addedEdges_le_one S v
  have hdecomp : intoV (Xstep1 P S) v =
      intoV (P.edges \ E1removed P S) v ∪ intoV (addedEdges S) v := by
    unfold Xstep1; exact intoV_union _ _ v
  have hstep1le2 : (intoV (Xstep1 P S) v).card ≤ 2 := by
    rw [hdecomp]; exact le_trans (Finset.card_union_le _ _) (by omega)
  by_cases hcard : (intoV (Xstep1 P S) v).card ≤ 1
  · exact le_trans (Finset.card_le_card (intoV_mono (fPS_subset_step1 P S) v)) hcard
  · rw [not_le] at hcard
    have hcard2 : (intoV (Xstep1 P S) v).card = 2 := le_antisymm hstep1le2 (by omega)
    have hvd : v ∈ doubles P S := by
      simp only [doubles, Finset.mem_filter]; exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ v, hcard2⟩
    refine le_trans (Finset.card_le_card ?_) hBle
    intro e he
    simp only [intoV, mem_into, Finset.mem_singleton] at he ⊢
    obtain ⟨heF, he2⟩ := he
    rw [fPS, Finset.mem_sdiff] at heF
    obtain ⟨heX1, heE2⟩ := heF
    rw [Xstep1, Finset.mem_union] at heX1
    rcases heX1 with hP | hA
    · exfalso
      apply heE2
      rw [Finset.mem_sdiff] at hP
      simp only [E2removed, Finset.mem_filter]
      exact ⟨hP.1, by rw [he2]; exact hvd⟩
    · exact ⟨hA, he2⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsSpine.double_has_surviving_inedge
statement:
theorem double_has_surviving_inedge (P : HPath k) (S : Finset (Vtx k)) (hS : SPrecond P S)
    {b : Vtx k} (hb : b ∈ doubles P S) : (intoV (fPS P S) b).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  simp only [doubles, Finset.mem_filter] at hb
  obtain ⟨-, hb2⟩ := hb
  have hdecomp : intoV (Xstep1 P S) b =
      intoV (P.edges \ E1removed P S) b ∪ intoV (addedEdges S) b := by
    unfold Xstep1; exact intoV_union _ _ b
  have hAle : (intoV (P.edges \ E1removed P S) b).card ≤ 1 :=
    le_trans (Finset.card_le_card (intoV_mono Finset.sdiff_subset b)) (path_into_le_one P b)
  have hBne : (intoV (addedEdges S) b).Nonempty := by
    rw [Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
    intro hB
    rw [hdecomp, hB, Finset.union_empty] at hb2
    omega
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hBne
  simp only [intoV, mem_into, Finset.mem_singleton] at he
  obtain ⟨heA, he2⟩ := he
  refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
  simp only [intoV, mem_into, Finset.mem_singleton]
  refine ⟨?_, he2⟩
  rw [fPS, Finset.mem_sdiff]
  refine ⟨by rw [Xstep1, Finset.mem_union]; exact Or.inr heA, ?_⟩
  intro hcon
  have hmemP : e ∈ P.edges := E2removed_subset P S hcon
  rw [addedEdges, Finset.mem_image] at heA
  obtain ⟨w, hwS, hwe⟩ := heA
  rw [← hwe] at hmemP
  exact hS w hwS hmemP

name: Hunter.ProofsSpine.outV_fPS_ne_empty_of_mem_S
statement:
theorem outV_fPS_ne_empty_of_mem_S (P : HPath k) (S : Finset (Vtx k)) (hS : SPrecond P S)
    {a : Vtx k} (ha : a ∈ S) : (outV (fPS P S) a).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(a, sigma a), ?_⟩
  simp only [outV, mem_out, Finset.mem_singleton]
  refine ⟨?_, trivial⟩
  rw [fPS, Finset.mem_sdiff]
  constructor
  · rw [Xstep1, Finset.mem_union]; right
    rw [addedEdges, Finset.mem_image]; exact ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
  · intro hcon
    exact hS a ha (E2removed_subset P S hcon)

name: Hunter.ProofsSpine.key_doubles_iff
statement:
theorem key_doubles_iff (P : HPath k) (S : Finset (Vtx k)) (hS : SPrecond P S)
    {e : Vtx k × Vtx k} (heP : e ∈ P.edges) :
    e.2 ∈ doubles P S ↔ outV (fPS P S) e.1 = ∅
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : e.1 ∈ S
  · have hRHS : outV (fPS P S) e.1 ≠ ∅ := by
      rw [← Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty]; exact outV_fPS_ne_empty_of_mem_S P S hS ha
    have hLHS : e.2 ∉ doubles P S := by
      intro hd
      simp only [doubles, Finset.mem_filter] at hd
      obtain ⟨-, hd2⟩ := hd
      have hAempty : intoV (P.edges \ E1removed P S) e.2 = ∅ := by
        rw [Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
        intro x hx
        simp only [intoV, mem_into, Finset.mem_singleton] at hx
        obtain ⟨hxmem, hx2⟩ := hx
        rw [Finset.mem_sdiff] at hxmem
        have hxe : x = e :=
          Finset.card_le_one.mp (path_into_le_one P e.2) x
            (by simp only [intoV, mem_into, Finset.mem_singleton]; exact ⟨hxmem.1, hx2⟩) e
            (by simp only [intoV, mem_into, Finset.mem_singleton]; exact ⟨heP, trivial⟩)
        exact hxmem.2 (by rw [hxe, E1removed, Finset.mem_filter]; exact ⟨heP, ha⟩)
      have hdecomp : intoV (Xstep1 P S) e.2 =
          intoV (P.edges \ E1removed P S) e.2 ∪ intoV (addedEdges S) e.2 := by
        unfold Xstep1; exact intoV_union _ _ e.2
      rw [hdecomp, hAempty, Finset.empty_union] at hd2
      have := intoV_addedEdges_le_one S e.2
      omega
    exact ⟨fun h => absurd h hLHS, fun h => absurd h hRHS⟩
  · have heX1 : e ∈ Xstep1 P S := by
      rw [Xstep1, Finset.mem_union]; left; rw [Finset.mem_sdiff]
      exact ⟨heP, fun hc => ha (by rw [E1removed, Finset.mem_filter] at hc; exact hc.2)⟩
    have hStep1out : outV (Xstep1 P S) e.1 = {e} := by
      apply Finset.eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem.mpr
      refine ⟨by simp only [outV, mem_out, Finset.mem_singleton]; exact ⟨heX1, trivial⟩, ?_⟩
      intro x hx
      exact Finset.card_le_one.mp (outV_Xstep1_le_one P S e.1) x hx e
        (by simp only [outV, mem_out, Finset.mem_singleton]; exact ⟨heX1, trivial⟩)
    constructor
    · intro hd
      rw [Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
      intro x hx
      have hxs : x ∈ outV (Xstep1 P S) e.1 := outV_mono (fPS_subset_step1 P S) e.1 hx
      rw [hStep1out, Finset.mem_singleton] at hxs
      subst hxs
      simp only [outV, mem_out, Finset.mem_singleton] at hx
      obtain ⟨hefps, -⟩ := hx
      rw [fPS, Finset.mem_sdiff] at hefps
      exact hefps.2 (by rw [E2removed, Finset.mem_filter]; exact ⟨heP, hd⟩)
    · intro hne
      by_contra hd
      have hefps : e ∈ fPS P S := by
        rw [fPS, Finset.mem_sdiff]
        exact ⟨heX1, fun hc => hd (by rw [E2removed, Finset.mem_filter] at hc; exact hc.2)⟩
      have hmem : e ∈ outV (fPS P S) e.1 := by
        simp only [outV, mem_out, Finset.mem_singleton]; exact ⟨hefps, trivial⟩
      rw [hne] at hmem; exact absurd hmem (Finset.notMem_empty _)

name: Hunter.ProofsSpine.vtx_nonempty
statement: theorem vtx_nonempty (k : ℕ) : Nonempty (Vtx k)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨(List.range k).map (· + 1), ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · exact (List.nodup_range).map (fun a b h => by omega)
  · ext x
    simp only [List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_map, List.mem_range, Finset.mem_Icc]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩; omega
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩; exact ⟨x - 1, by omega, by omega⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsSpine.exists_ham
statement: theorem exists_ham (k : ℕ) : ∃ P : HPath k, P.IsHamiltonian
proof:
:= by
  haveI := vtx_nonempty k
  refine ⟨⟨Finset.univ.toList, ?_, Finset.nodup_toList _⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [Ne, Finset.toList_eq_nil]; exact Finset.univ_nonempty.ne_empty
  · intro v; exact Finset.mem_toList.mpr (Finset.mem_univ v)

name: Hunter.Proved.bridge_wEdges_edges_eq_wtP
statement: theorem bridge_wEdges_edges_eq_wtP {k : ℕ} (p : HPath k) : wEdges p.edges = p.wtP
proof:
:= by
  rw [wEdges, HPath.edges, HPath.wtP,
    List.sum_toFinset _ ProofsSpine.zip_tail_nodup,
    ProofsSpine.zip_map_eq_zipWith (ew k)]

name: Hunter.Proved.bridge_compMinto_eq_minto
statement:
theorem bridge_compMinto_eq_minto {k : ℕ} {p : HPath k} {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)}
    (hp : IsPathComponent p X) : compMinto X p.vertsFinset = p.minto
proof:
:= by
  rw [compMinto, ProofsSpine.compTails_eq hp, HPath.minto]
  congr 1
  ext d
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, hvC, s, hs, hew⟩
    rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hs
    subst hs
    exact ⟨v, fun h => hvC (HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mpr h), hew⟩
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, hew⟩
    exact ⟨v, fun h => hv (HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mp h), p.first, Finset.mem_singleton_self _, hew⟩

name: Hunter.Proved.clm_degree
statement:
theorem clm_degree {k : ℕ} {P : HPath k} {S : Finset (Vtx k)} (hS : SPrecond P S) :
    ∀ v : Vtx k, (outV (fPS P S) v).card ≤ 1 ∧ (intoV (fPS P S) v).card ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  fun v => ⟨ProofsSpine.outV_fPS_le_one P S v, ProofsSpine.intoV_fPS_le_one P S hS v⟩

name: Hunter.Proved.clm_e1
statement:
theorem clm_e1 {k : ℕ} {P : HPath k} {S : Finset (Vtx k)} (hS : SPrecond P S) :
    into P.edges (tails (fPS P S) \ tails P.edges) ⊆ E1removed P S
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  rw [into, Finset.mem_filter] at he
  obtain ⟨heP, he2⟩ := he
  rw [Finset.mem_sdiff] at he2
  obtain ⟨he2t, -⟩ := he2
  rw [tails, Finset.mem_filter] at he2t
  have hempty : intoV (fPS P S) e.2 = ∅ := he2t.2
  by_contra hcon
  have he1S : e.1 ∉ S := fun hS' => hcon (by rw [E1removed, Finset.mem_filter]; exact ⟨heP, hS'⟩)
  by_cases hd : e.2 ∈ doubles P S
  · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := ProofsSpine.double_has_surviving_inedge P S hS hd
    rw [hempty] at hx; exact absurd hx (Finset.notMem_empty _)
  · have hefps : e ∈ fPS P S := by
      rw [fPS, Finset.mem_sdiff]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Xstep1, Finset.mem_union]; left
        rw [Finset.mem_sdiff]
        exact ⟨heP, fun hc => he1S (by rw [E1removed, Finset.mem_filter] at hc; exact hc.2)⟩
      · exact fun hc => hd (by rw [E2removed, Finset.mem_filter] at hc; exact hc.2)
    have hmem : e ∈ intoV (fPS P S) e.2 := by
      rw [intoV, mem_into]; exact ⟨hefps, Finset.mem_singleton_self _⟩
    rw [hempty] at hmem; exact absurd hmem (Finset.notMem_empty _)

name: Hunter.Proved.clm_e2
statement:
theorem clm_e2 {k : ℕ} {P : HPath k} {S : Finset (Vtx k)} (hS : SPrecond P S) :
    E2removed P S = out P.edges (heads (fPS P S) \ heads P.edges)
proof:
:= by
  ext e
  simp only [E2removed, out, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_sdiff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨heP, hd⟩
    refine ⟨heP, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [heads, Finset.mem_filter]
      exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, (ProofsSpine.key_doubles_iff P S hS heP).mp hd⟩
    · rw [heads, Finset.mem_filter, not_and]
      intro _
      exact Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mp
        ⟨e, by simp only [outV, mem_out, Finset.mem_singleton]; exact ⟨heP, trivial⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨heP, hhead, -⟩
    rw [heads, Finset.mem_filter] at hhead
    exact ⟨heP, (ProofsSpine.key_doubles_iff P S hS heP).mpr hhead.2⟩

name: Hunter.Proved.b1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P₁, hHam₁⟩ := ProofsSpine.exists_ham k
  have hne : {m | ∃ P : HPath k, P.IsHamiltonian ∧ P.wtP = m}.Nonempty :=
    ⟨P₁.wtP, P₁, hHam₁, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨P₀, hHam₀, hP₀⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem hne
  rw [ge_iff_le]
  calc sInf {m | ∃ X, X ∈ Xk k ∧ m = (numComps X - 1) + MinThrough X + wEdges X}
      ≤ (numComps (F P₀) - 1) + MinThrough (F P₀) + wEdges (F P₀) :=
        Nat.sInf_le ⟨F P₀, ⟨P₀, hHam₀, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    _ ≤ P₀.wtP := h_wP P₀ hHam₀
    _ = L k := hP₀

name: Hunter.Proved.lem_weightrule
statement:
theorem lem_weightrule {k : ℕ} {P : HPath k} {S : Finset (Vtx k)} (hS : SPrecond P S)
    (h_eqq : (P.wtP : ℤ) = (wEdges (fPS P S) : ℤ)
      + ∑ e ∈ E1removed P S, ((ew k e.1 e.2 : ℤ) - 1)
      - (indicatorI P S : ℤ)
      + ∑ e ∈ E2removed P S, (ew k e.1 e.2 : ℤ)) :
    (P.wtP : ℤ) ≥ (wEdges (fPS P S) : ℤ)
      + ∑ e ∈ into P.edges (tails (fPS P S) \ tails P.edges), ((ew k e.1 e.2 : ℤ) - 1)
      - (indicatorI P S : ℤ)
      + ∑ e ∈ out P.edges (heads (fPS P S) \ heads P.edges), (ew k e.1 e.2 : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hmono : ∑ e ∈ into P.edges (tails (fPS P S) \ tails P.edges), ((ew k e.1 e.2 : ℤ) - 1)
      ≤ ∑ e ∈ E1removed P S, ((ew k e.1 e.2 : ℤ) - 1) := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (clm_e1 hS)
    intro e he _
    have h1 : 1 ≤ ew k e.1 e.2 :=
      ProofsSpine.one_le_ew_of_mem_edges (E1removed_subset P S he)
    have : (1 : ℤ) ≤ (ew k e.1 e.2 : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast h1
    linarith
  rw [h_eqq, ← clm_e2 hS, ge_iff_le]
  linarith [hmono]

name: Hunter.ProofsInduction.G_base
statement: theorem G_base (hk : 3 ≤ k) {E : ℕ} (hE : E ≤ k - 3) : G k E = (E + 1) * (k - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hlt : E < k - 2 := by omega
  rw [G, Nat.div_eq_of_lt hlt, Nat.sub_zero]

name: Hunter.ProofsInduction.div_sub_period
statement:
theorem div_sub_period {E : ℕ} (hk : 4 ≤ k) (hE : k - 2 ≤ E) :
    E / (k - 2) = (E - (k - 2)) / (k - 2) + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hd : 0 < k - 2 := by omega
  have := Nat.add_div_right (E - (k - 2)) hd
  rwa [Nat.sub_add_cancel hE] at this

name: Hunter.ProofsInduction.G_period
statement:
theorem G_period (hk : 4 ≤ k) {E : ℕ} (hE : k - 2 ≤ E) :
    G k E = G k (E - (k - 2)) + Mper k
proof:
:= by
  have hd : 0 < k - 2 := by omega
  have hdiv := div_sub_period hk hE            
  set d := k - 2 with hddef
  set n := k - 1 with hn
  set P := (E - d + 1) * n with hP
  set DN := d * n with hDN
  have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := by omega
  
  have hprodE : (E + 1) * n = P + DN := by
    rw [hP, hDN]; have : E + 1 = (E - d + 1) + d := by omega
    rw [this, Nat.add_mul]
  have hmper : Mper k = DN - 1 := by
    rw [Mper, ← hddef, ← hn, hDN, Nat.mul_comm]
  have hDN1 : 1 ≤ DN := by rw [hDN]; exact Nat.mul_pos hd (by omega)
  have hEle : E - d ≤ P := le_trans (Nat.le_succ _)
    (by rw [hP]; exact le_mul_of_one_le_right (Nat.zero_le _) hn1)
  have hqP : (E - d) / d ≤ P := le_trans (Nat.div_le_self _ _) hEle
  
  have hGE : G k E = P + DN - E / d := by rw [G, ← hddef, ← hn, hprodE]
  have hGEd : G k (E - d) = P - (E - d) / d := by rw [G, ← hddef, ← hn, ← hP]
  rw [hGE, hGEd, hmper, hdiv]
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsInduction.G_le_succ
statement: theorem G_le_succ (hk : 4 ≤ k) (E : ℕ) : G k E ≤ G k (E + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hd : 0 < k - 2 := by omega
  set d := k - 2 with hddef
  set n := k - 1 with hn
  set P := (E + 1) * n with hP
  have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := by omega
  have hfl : (E + 1) / d ≤ E / d + 1 := by
    have hle : (E + 1) / d ≤ (E + d) / d := Nat.div_le_div_right (by omega)
    rwa [Nat.add_div_right E hd] at hle
  have hb1 : E / d ≤ P := le_trans (Nat.div_le_self _ _)
    (by rw [hP]; calc E ≤ E + 1 := Nat.le_succ _
          _ ≤ (E + 1) * n := le_mul_of_one_le_right (Nat.zero_le _) hn1)
  have hGE : G k E = P - E / d := by rw [G, ← hddef, ← hn]
  have hGS : G k (E + 1) = P + n - (E + 1) / d := by
    rw [G, ← hddef, ← hn, show (E + 1 + 1) * n = P + n by rw [hP, Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul]]
  rw [hGE, hGS]
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsInduction.G_mono
statement: theorem G_mono (hk : 4 ≤ k) : Monotone (G k)
proof:
:=
  monotone_nat_of_le_succ (G_le_succ hk)

name: Hunter.ProofsInduction.Dfr_le_iff_le_G
statement:
theorem Dfr_le_iff_le_G (hk : 4 ≤ k) :
    ∀ b, 1 ≤ b → ∀ E, (Dfr k b ≤ E ↔ b ≤ G k E)
proof:
:= by
  intro b
  induction b using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ b ih =>
    intro hb1 E
    set MM := (k - 1) * (k - 2) with hMM
    have hMper : Mper k = MM - 1 := by rw [Mper, hMM]
    have hMM6 : 6 ≤ MM := by
      rw [hMM]; exact le_trans (by norm_num)
        (Nat.mul_le_mul (show 3 ≤ k - 1 by omega) (show 2 ≤ k - 2 by omega))
    by_cases hbase : b ≤ MM
    · 
      rw [Dfr_base (by rw [← hMM]; exact hbase)]
      by_cases hE3 : E ≤ k - 3
      · 
        rw [G_base (by omega) hE3]
        set X := (E + 1) * (k - 1) with hX
        have hdivlt : (b - 1) / (k - 1) < (E + 1) ↔ (b - 1) < X :=
          Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul (by omega : 0 < k - 1)
        constructor
        · intro h; have : (b - 1) / (k - 1) < E + 1 := by omega
          have := hdivlt.mp this; omega
        · intro h; have : (b - 1) < X := by omega
          have := hdivlt.mpr this; omega
      · 
        have hEk2 : k - 2 ≤ E := by omega
        have hLHS : (b - 1) / (k - 1) ≤ E := by
          have h1 : (b - 1) / (k - 1) ≤ Mper k / (k - 1) :=
            Nat.div_le_div_right (by omega)
          rw [Mper_div (by omega)] at h1; omega
        have hRHS : b ≤ G k E := by
          have hmono : G k (k - 2) ≤ G k E := G_mono (by omega) hEk2
          have hGkm2 : (k - 1) * (k - 2) ≤ G k (k - 2) := by
            rw [G, Nat.div_self (by omega), show k - 2 + 1 = k - 1 by omega]
            obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ : ∃ a, k = a + 4 := ⟨k - 4, by omega⟩
            show (a + 3) * (a + 2) ≤ (a + 3) * (a + 3) - 1
            have hexp : (a + 3) * (a + 3) = (a + 3) * (a + 2) + (a + 3) := by ring
            omega
          have hbMM : b ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2) := hMM ▸ hbase
          omega
        exact iff_of_true hLHS hRHS
    · 
      rw [Nat.not_le] at hbase
      have hDfr : Dfr k b = Dfr k (b - Mper k) + (k - 2) :=
        Dfr_shift_rec (by omega) (by rw [← hMM]; exact hbase)
      by_cases hE3 : E ≤ k - 3
      · 
        have hLHS : ¬ Dfr k b ≤ E := by rw [hDfr]; omega
        have hRHS : ¬ b ≤ G k E := by
          rw [G_base (by omega) hE3]
          have hle : (E + 1) * (k - 1) ≤ (k - 2) * (k - 1) :=
            Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega)
          have hcomm : (k - 2) * (k - 1) = MM := by rw [hMM]; ring
          omega
        exact iff_of_false hLHS hRHS
      · 
        have hEk2 : k - 2 ≤ E := by omega
        have hGP : G k E = G k (E - (k - 2)) + Mper k := G_period hk hEk2
        have hb' : 1 ≤ b - Mper k := by omega
        have hbMlt : b - Mper k < b := by omega
        have IH := ih (b - Mper k) hbMlt hb' (E - (k - 2))
        set A := Dfr k (b - Mper k) with hA
        set Y := G k (E - (k - 2)) with hY
        rw [hDfr, hGP]
        constructor
        · intro h; have hA' : A ≤ E - (k - 2) := by omega
          have := IH.mp hA'; omega
        · intro h; have hbY : b - Mper k ≤ Y := by omega
          have := IH.mpr hbY; omega

name: Hunter.ProofsInduction.le_G_of_Dfr_le
statement:
theorem le_G_of_Dfr_le (hk : 4 ≤ k) {b E : ℕ} (hb1 : 1 ≤ b) (h : Dfr k b ≤ E) :
    b ≤ G k E
proof:
:=
  (Dfr_le_iff_le_G hk b hb1 E).mp h

name: Hunter.ProofsInduction.blockCount_le_G_excess
statement:
theorem blockCount_le_G_excess (hk : 4 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless)
    (h0 : 0 < p.numVerts) : (p.numVerts - 1) / k ≤ G k (excess p)
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos ((p.numVerts - 1) / k) with hz | hpos
  · rw [hz]; exact Nat.zero_le _
  · exact le_G_of_Dfr_le hk hpos
      (ProofsTheorem.ext_excess_ge_Dfr_block hk hp h0 (ProofsLast.defectiveDeepExit hk))

name: Hunter.Proved.excess_frontier_chart
statement:
theorem excess_frontier_chart (hk : 4 ≤ k) (h_closure : TerminalFrontierTail k) :
    ExcessFrontier k
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp h0
  exact h_closure p hp h0
    (ProofsTheorem.ext_excess_ge_Dfr_block hk hp h0 (ProofsLast.defectiveDeepExit hk))

name: Hunter.Proved.thm2_of_chart
statement:
theorem thm2_of_chart {ℓ : ℕ} (hk : 4 ≤ k) (h_closure : TerminalFrontierTail k)
    (hℓ : HasExitlessPath k ℓ) : j k ℓ ≤ iExitless k ℓ
proof:
:=
  thm2_of_frontier (by omega) (excess_frontier_chart hk h_closure) hℓ

name: Hunter.ProofsRigidity2.tau2_step
statement:
theorem tau2_step (hk : 2 ≤ k) {P : List ℕ} (hP : P.length = k - 1) (x : ℕ) (i : ℕ) :
    tau2 k (P.rotate i ++ [x]) = P.rotate (i + 1) ++ [x]
proof:
:= by
  have hWlen : (P.rotate i).length = k - 1 := by rw [List.length_rotate, hP]
  obtain ⟨w0, ws, hW⟩ : ∃ w0 ws, P.rotate i = w0 :: ws := by
    rcases hpr : P.rotate i with _ | ⟨w0, ws⟩
    · rw [hpr] at hWlen; simp at hWlen; omega
    · exact ⟨w0, ws, rfl⟩
  
  have hbexit : bexit k (P.rotate i ++ [x]) = x :: (P.rotate i) := by
    unfold bexit
    rw [show k - 1 = (P.rotate i).length from hWlen.symm, List.rotate_append_length_eq]
    rfl
  
  rw [tau2, hbexit, hW]
  show door (x :: w0 :: ws) = P.rotate (i + 1) ++ [x]
  have hdoor : door (x :: w0 :: ws) = ws ++ [w0, x] := rfl
  rw [hdoor, ← List.rotate_rotate, hW]
  
  have hr1 : (w0 :: ws).rotate 1 = ws ++ [w0] := by
    rw [List.rotate_cons_succ, List.rotate_zero]
  rw [hr1]; simp

name: Hunter.ProofsRigidity2.tau2_iter
statement:
theorem tau2_iter (hk : 2 ≤ k) {P : List ℕ} (hP : P.length = k - 1) (x : ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    (tau2 k)^[n] (P ++ [x]) = P.rotate n ++ [x]
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih, tau2_step hk hP]

name: Hunter.ProofsRigidity2.runW_zero
statement: theorem runW_zero (A : List ℕ) (b c : ℕ) : runW A b c 0 = A ++ [b, c]
proof:
:= by
  simp [runW]

name: Hunter.ProofsRigidity2.runW_eq_iter
statement:
theorem runW_eq_iter (hk : 2 ≤ k) {A : List ℕ} (hA : A.length = k - 2) (b c : ℕ) (i : ℕ) :
    runW A b c i = (tau2 k)^[i] (A ++ [b, c])
proof:
:= by
  have hP : (A ++ [b]).length = k - 1 := by rw [List.length_append]; simp; omega
  rw [runW, show A ++ [b, c] = (A ++ [b]) ++ [c] by simp, tau2_iter hk hP c i]

name: Hunter.ProofsRigidity2.runW_last
statement: theorem runW_last (A : List ℕ) (b c : ℕ) : runW A b c A.length = b :: A ++ [c]
proof:
:= by
  unfold runW
  rw [List.rotate_append_length_eq]
  simp

name: Hunter.ProofsRigidity2.bexit_runW_last
statement:
theorem bexit_runW_last (hk : 2 ≤ k) {A : List ℕ} (hA : A.length = k - 2) (b c : ℕ) :
    bexit k (runW A b c A.length) = c :: b :: A
proof:
:= by
  rw [runW_last]
  unfold bexit
  rw [show k - 1 = (b :: A).length by simp; omega,
    show b :: A ++ [c] = (b :: A) ++ [c] from rfl, List.rotate_append_length_eq]
  rfl

name: Hunter.ProofsRigidity2.runW_perm
statement: theorem runW_perm (A : List ℕ) (b c : ℕ) (i : ℕ) : runW A b c i ~ A ++ [b, c]
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : runW A b c i ~ (A ++ [b]) ++ [c] :=
    (List.perm_append_right_iff _).mpr (List.rotate_perm (A ++ [b]) i)
  simpa [List.append_assoc] using h1

name: Hunter.ProofsRigidity2.isPermWord_runW
statement:
theorem isPermWord_runW {A : List ℕ} {b c : ℕ}
    (hu : IsPermWord k (A ++ [b, c])) (i : ℕ) : IsPermWord k (runW A b c i)
proof:
:=
  hu.perm (runW_perm A b c i).symm

name: Hunter.ProofsRigidity2.isPermWord_bexit
statement: theorem isPermWord_bexit {w : List ℕ} (hw : IsPermWord k w) : IsPermWord k (bexit k w)
proof:
:=
  isPermWord_rotate hw (k - 1)

name: Hunter.ProofsRigidity2.T3_eq
statement: theorem T3_eq : runW (a₁ :: As) b c 1 = As ++ [b, a₁, c]
proof:
:= by
  rw [runW, show (a₁ :: As) ++ [b] = [a₁] ++ (As ++ [b]) by simp,
    show (1 : ℕ) = ([a₁] : List ℕ).length from rfl, List.rotate_append_length_eq]
  simp

name: Hunter.ProofsRigidity2.T4_eq
statement: theorem T4_eq : (runW (a₁ :: As) b c 0).rotate 1 = As ++ [b, c, a₁]
proof:
:= by
  rw [runW_zero, show (a₁ :: As) ++ [b, c] = [a₁] ++ (As ++ [b, c]) by simp,
    show (1 : ℕ) = ([a₁] : List ℕ).length from rfl, List.rotate_append_length_eq]
  simp

name: Hunter.ProofsRigidity2.T6_eq
statement: theorem T6_eq : (runW (a₁ :: As) b c (a₁ :: As).length).rotate 2 = As ++ [c, b, a₁]
proof:
:= by
  rw [runW_last, show b :: (a₁ :: As) ++ [c] = [b, a₁] ++ (As ++ [c]) by simp,
    show (2 : ℕ) = ([b, a₁] : List ℕ).length from rfl, List.rotate_append_length_eq]
  simp

name: Hunter.ProofsRigidity2.T1_eq
statement: theorem T1_eq : runW ((a₁ :: As).rotate 1) b c 0 = As ++ [a₁, b, c]
proof:
:= by
  rw [runW_zero, show (a₁ :: As).rotate 1 = As ++ [a₁] by
    rw [List.rotate_cons_succ, List.rotate_zero]]
  simp

name: Hunter.ProofsRigidity2.T2_collide
statement:
theorem T2_collide :
    rotClass ((tau2 (As.length + 3))^[As.length] (As ++ [a₁, c, b]))
      = rotClass (runW (a₁ :: As) b c 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hP : (As ++ [a₁, c]).length = (As.length + 3) - 1 := by simp
  rw [show As ++ [a₁, c, b] = (As ++ [a₁, c]) ++ [b] by simp,
    tau2_iter (by omega) hP b As.length,
    List.rotate_append_length_eq]
  have key : (runW (a₁ :: As) b c 1).rotate (As.length + 1) = [a₁, c] ++ As ++ [b] := by
    rw [T3_eq, show As ++ [b, a₁, c] = (As ++ [b]) ++ [a₁, c] by simp,
      show As.length + 1 = (As ++ [b]).length by simp, List.rotate_append_length_eq]
    simp
  rw [← key, ProofsClosure3.rotClass_rotate]

name: Hunter.ProofsRigidity2.T5_collide
statement:
theorem T5_collide :
    rotClass ((tau2 (As.length + 3))^[As.length] (As ++ [c, a₁, b]))
      = rotClass (runW (a₁ :: As) b c 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hP : (As ++ [c, a₁]).length = (As.length + 3) - 1 := by simp
  rw [show As ++ [c, a₁, b] = (As ++ [c, a₁]) ++ [b] by simp,
    tau2_iter (by omega) hP b As.length,
    List.rotate_append_length_eq]
  have key : (runW (a₁ :: As) b c 0).rotate (As.length + 2) = [c, a₁] ++ As ++ [b] := by
    rw [runW_zero, show (a₁ :: As) ++ [b, c] = (a₁ :: As ++ [b]) ++ [c] by simp,
      show As.length + 2 = (a₁ :: As ++ [b]).length by simp, List.rotate_append_length_eq]
    simp
  rw [← key, ProofsClosure3.rotClass_rotate]

name: Hunter.ProofsRigidity2.fresh_w2_forced
statement:
theorem fresh_w2_forced {u v : List ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hu : IsPermWord k u) (hv : IsPermWord k v)
    (hw2 : bwt k u v = 2) (hfresh : rotClass v ≠ rotClass u) : v = tau2 k u
proof:
:= by
  have hx : IsPermWord k (bexit k u) := isPermWord_bexit hu
  have hover : (bexit k u).drop 2 = v.take (k - 2) := by
    have hspec := (wt_spec (u := bexit k u) (v := v) (by omega) (le_of_eq hx.length)).2.2
    rwa [show wt k (bexit k u) v = 2 from hw2] at hspec
  rcases ProofsConfinement.wt_two_word_cases hk hx hv hover with hrot | hdoor
  · exfalso; apply hfresh
    rw [hrot]
    show rotClass ((bexit k u).rotate 2) = rotClass u
    rw [bexit, List.rotate_rotate, ProofsClosure3.rotClass_rotate]
  · rw [hdoor]; rfl

name: Hunter.ProofsRigidity2.tau2_period
statement:
theorem tau2_period (hk : 2 ≤ k) {A : List ℕ} (hA : A.length = k - 2) (b c : ℕ) :
    (tau2 k)^[k - 1] (A ++ [b, c]) = A ++ [b, c]
proof:
:= by
  have hP : (A ++ [b]).length = k - 1 := by rw [List.length_append]; simp; omega
  rw [show A ++ [b, c] = (A ++ [b]) ++ [c] by simp, tau2_iter hk hP c (k - 1),
    show k - 1 = (A ++ [b]).length from hP.symm, List.rotate_length]

name: Hunter.ProofsRigidity2.runlen_pigeonhole
statement:
theorem runlen_pigeonhole {r m n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hr : r ≤ m) (L : Fin r → ℕ)
    (hcap : ∀ i, L i ≤ n) (hsum : (∑ i, L i) = n * m) : r = m ∧ ∀ i, L i = n
proof:
:= by
  have hle : (∑ i, L i) ≤ r * n := by
    calc (∑ i : Fin r, L i) ≤ ∑ _i : Fin r, n := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hcap i)
      _ = r * n := by rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul]
  have hrm : r = m := by
    have h1 : n * m ≤ r * n := hsum ▸ hle
    have h2 : r * n ≤ m * n := Nat.mul_le_mul_right n hr
    nlinarith [Nat.mul_le_mul_right n hr]
  subst hrm
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
  have heq : (∑ i, L i) = ∑ _i : Fin r, n := by
    rw [hsum, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul, Nat.mul_comm]
  have := (Finset.sum_eq_sum_iff_of_le (fun i _ => hcap i)).mp heq
  exact fun i => this i (Finset.mem_univ i)

name: Hunter.ProofsRigidity2.boundary_exact
statement:
theorem boundary_exact {p : ℕ} (w : Fin p → ℕ) (hge : ∀ i, 1 ≤ w i)
    (hsum : (∑ i, w i) = p) : ∀ i, w i = 1
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (∑ i, w i) = ∑ _i : Fin p, 1 := by
    rw [hsum, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul, Nat.mul_one]
  have := (Finset.sum_eq_sum_iff_of_le (fun i _ => hge i)).mp heq.symm
  exact fun i => (this i (Finset.mem_univ i)).symm

name: Hunter.ProofsRigidity2.forced_step
statement:
theorem forced_step
    (he : IsPermWord (As.length + 3) (c :: b :: a₁ :: As))
    {v : List ℕ} (hv : IsPermWord (As.length + 3) v)
    (hover : (c :: b :: a₁ :: As).drop 3 = v.take (As.length))
    (hvfresh : ¬ RunVisited (a₁ :: As) b c (rotClass v))
    (hlast : ¬ RunVisited (a₁ :: As) b c
        (rotClass ((tau2 (As.length + 3))^[As.length] v))) :
    v = runW ((a₁ :: As).rotate 1) b c 0
proof:
:= by
  have hstart : (a₁ :: As).length = As.length + 1 := by simp
  have hcases := ProofsClosure3.w3_six_cases As a₁ b c he hv
    (by simpa [ProofsClosure3.finalExit] using hover)
  rcases hcases with h | h | h | h | h | h
  · 
    rw [h, T1_eq]
  · 
    exfalso; apply hlast
    rw [h, T2_collide]
    exact ⟨1, by rw [hstart]; omega, rfl⟩
  · 
    exfalso; apply hvfresh
    exact ⟨1, by rw [hstart]; omega, by rw [h, ← T3_eq]⟩
  · 
    exfalso; apply hvfresh
    refine ⟨0, by omega, ?_⟩
    rw [h, ← T4_eq, ProofsClosure3.rotClass_rotate]
  · 
    exfalso; apply hlast
    rw [h, T5_collide]
    exact ⟨0, by omega, rfl⟩
  · 
    exfalso; apply hvfresh
    refine ⟨(a₁ :: As).length, le_refl _, ?_⟩
    rw [h, ← T6_eq, ProofsClosure3.rotClass_rotate]

name: Hunter.ProofsRigidity2.run_forced
statement:
theorem run_forced (hk : 2 ≤ k) {A : List ℕ} (hA : A.length = k - 2) {b c : ℕ}
    {q : ℕ → List ℕ} (h0 : q 0 = A ++ [b, c])
    (hperm : ∀ i, IsPermWord k (q i))
    (hdist : ∀ i, i < A.length → rotClass (q (i + 1)) ≠ rotClass (q i))
    (hw2 : ∀ i, i < A.length → bwt k (q i) (q (i + 1)) = 2) :
    ∀ i, i ≤ A.length → q i = runW A b c i
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  induction i with
  | zero => intro _; rw [h0, runW_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro hn
    have hnlt : n < A.length := by omega
    have hqn : q n = runW A b c n := ih (by omega)
    have hstep : q (n + 1) = tau2 k (q n) :=
      fresh_w2_forced hk (hperm n) (hperm (n + 1)) (hw2 n hnlt) (hdist n hnlt)
    rw [hstep, hqn, runW_eq_iter hk hA b c n,
      (Function.iterate_succ_apply' (tau2 k) n (A ++ [b, c])).symm,
      ← runW_eq_iter hk hA b c (n + 1)]

name: Hunter.ImpRed.pathW_cons2

    pathW (a :: b :: t) = ew k a b + pathW (b :: t)

:= by
  simp only [pathW, List.tail_cons, List.zipWith_cons_cons, List.sum_cons]

name: Hunter.ImpRed.pathW_append_cons
statement:
theorem pathW_append_cons (l : List (Vtx k)) (x : Vtx k) (m : List (Vtx k)) :
    pathW (l ++ x :: m) = pathW (l ++ [x]) + pathW (x :: m)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l' ih =>
    cases l' with
    | nil =>
      show pathW (a :: x :: m) = pathW (a :: x :: []) + pathW (x :: m)
      rw [pathW_cons2, pathW_cons2, pathW_single]; omega
    | cons b l'' =>
      show pathW (a :: b :: (l'' ++ x :: m)) = pathW (a :: b :: (l'' ++ [x])) + pathW (x :: m)
      rw [pathW_cons2, pathW_cons2]
      show ew k a b + pathW ((b :: l'') ++ x :: m)
         = ew k a b + pathW ((b :: l'') ++ [x]) + pathW (x :: m)
      rw [ih]; omega

name: Hunter.ImpRed.ew_triangle
statement:
theorem ew_triangle (hk : 1 ≤ k) (u v w : Vtx k) :
    ew k u w ≤ ew k u v + ew k v w
proof:
:= by
  have hu : u.1.length = k := u.2.length
  have hv : v.1.length = k := v.2.length
  obtain ⟨h1a, _h1b, h1c⟩ := wt_spec (u := u.1) (v := v.1) hk (le_of_eq hu)
  obtain ⟨_h2a, _h2b, h2c⟩ := wt_spec (u := v.1) (v := w.1) hk (le_of_eq hv)
  show wt k u.1 w.1 ≤ wt k u.1 v.1 + wt k v.1 w.1
  set d1 := wt k u.1 v.1 with hd1
  set d2 := wt k v.1 w.1 with hd2
  by_cases hsum : d1 + d2 ≤ k
  · apply wt_le (by omega) hsum
    calc u.1.drop (d1 + d2)
        = (u.1.drop d1).drop d2 := by rw [← List.drop_drop]
      _ = (v.1.take (k - d1)).drop d2 := by rw [h1c]
      _ = (v.1.drop d2).take ((k - d1) - d2) := by rw [List.drop_take]
      _ = (w.1.take (k - d2)).take ((k - d1) - d2) := by rw [h2c]
      _ = w.1.take (min ((k - d1) - d2) (k - d2)) := by rw [List.take_take]
      _ = w.1.take (k - (d1 + d2)) := by congr 1; omega
  · have hle := (wt_spec (u := u.1) (v := w.1) hk (le_of_eq hu)).2.1
    omega

name: Hunter.ImpRed.pathW_splice
statement:
theorem pathW_splice (p s : List (Vtx k)) (b : Vtx k) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    pathW (p ++ s) ≤ pathW (p ++ b :: s)
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | nil =>
    cases s with
    | nil => simp
    | cons d s' => simp only [List.nil_append, pathW_cons2]; omega
  | cons c p' ih =>
    cases p' with
    | nil =>
      simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
      cases s with
      | nil => simp only [pathW_cons2, pathW_single]; omega
      | cons d s' =>
        simp only [pathW_cons2]
        have htri := ew_triangle hk c b d
        omega
    | cons e p'' =>
      simp only [List.cons_append, pathW_cons2] at ih ⊢
      omega

name: Hunter.ImpRed.pathW_insert_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [pathW_append_cons pre v (v' :: v'' :: suf),
      pathW_append_cons pre v (v'' :: suf),
      pathW_cons2 v v' (v'' :: suf), pathW_cons2 v' v'' suf,
      pathW_cons2 v v'' suf]
  omega

name: Hunter.ImpRed.zip_tail_split
statement:
theorem zip_tail_split : ∀ {L : List (Vtx k)} {a b : Vtx k},
    (a, b) ∈ L.zip L.tail → ∃ A B, L = A ++ a :: b :: B
proof:
| [], _a, _b, h => by simp at h
  | [_c], _a, _b, h => by simp at h
  | c :: d :: t, a, b, h => by
      rw [List.tail_cons, List.zip_cons_cons, List.mem_cons] at h
      rcases h with h | h
      · rw [Prod.mk.injEq] at h
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h
        exact ⟨[], t, rfl⟩
      · have h' : (a, b) ∈ (d :: t).zip (d :: t).tail := by rwa [List.tail_cons]
        obtain ⟨A', B', hAB⟩ := zip_tail_split h'
        exact ⟨c :: A', B', by rw [List.cons_append, ← hAB]⟩

name: Hunter.ImpRed.append_mem_zip_tail
statement:
theorem append_mem_zip_tail : ∀ (C : List (Vtx k)) (a b : Vtx k) (D : List (Vtx k)),
    (a, b) ∈ (C ++ a :: b :: D).zip (C ++ a :: b :: D).tail
proof:
| [], a, b, D => by
      rw [List.nil_append, List.tail_cons, List.zip_cons_cons]; simp
  | c :: C', a, b, D => by
      have ih := append_mem_zip_tail C' a b D
      obtain ⟨m0, M', hM⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil
        (show C' ++ a :: b :: D ≠ [] by simp)
      rw [List.cons_append, List.tail_cons, hM, List.zip_cons_cons, List.mem_cons]
      right
      rwa [hM, List.tail_cons] at ih

name: Hunter.ImpRed.mem_edges_of_split
statement:
theorem mem_edges_of_split {q : HPath k} {C D : List (Vtx k)} {a b : Vtx k}
    (hq : q.verts = C ++ a :: b :: D) : (a, b) ∈ q.edges
proof:
:= by
  rw [ProofsSpine.mem_edges_iff, hq]
  exact append_mem_zip_tail C a b D

name: Hunter.ImpRed.assemble
statement:
theorem assemble (hk : 1 ≤ k) {P : HPath k} (hP : P.IsHamiltonian)
    {v v' v'' : Vtx k} (htri : ew k v v'' = ew k v v' + ew k v' v'')
    (hv'nev'' : v' ≠ v'')
    {p s pre suf : List (Vtx k)}
    (hLdef : P.verts = p ++ v' :: s)
    (hMeq : p ++ s = pre ++ v :: v'' :: suf) :
    ∃ P' : HPath k, P'.IsHamiltonian ∧ (v, v'') ∉ P'.edges ∧ P'.wtP ≤ P.wtP
proof:
:= by
  have hne : pre ++ v :: v' :: v'' :: suf ≠ [] :=
    List.ne_nil_of_mem (a := v) (by simp)
  have hperm1 : P.verts ~ v' :: (p ++ s) := by rw [hLdef]; exact List.perm_middle
  have hperm2 : (pre ++ v :: v' :: v'' :: suf) ~ v' :: (p ++ s) := by
    have hrw : pre ++ v :: v' :: v'' :: suf = (pre ++ [v]) ++ v' :: (v'' :: suf) := by simp
    have heq : (pre ++ [v]) ++ (v'' :: suf) = p ++ s := by rw [hMeq]; simp
    rw [hrw]
    calc (pre ++ [v]) ++ v' :: (v'' :: suf)
        ~ v' :: ((pre ++ [v]) ++ (v'' :: suf)) := List.perm_middle
      _ = v' :: (p ++ s) := by rw [heq]
  have hPL' : P.verts ~ (pre ++ v :: v' :: v'' :: suf) := hperm1.trans hperm2.symm
  have hnodup : (pre ++ v :: v' :: v'' :: suf).Nodup := hPL'.nodup P.nodup
  refine ⟨⟨pre ++ v :: v' :: v'' :: suf, hne, hnodup⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro u; exact hPL'.mem_iff.mp (hP u)
  · intro hcontra
    have hvv' : (v, v') ∈ (⟨pre ++ v :: v' :: v'' :: suf, hne, hnodup⟩ : HPath k).edges :=
      mem_edges_of_split (C := pre) (D := v'' :: suf) rfl
    have hsub : ({(v, v'), (v, v'')} : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)) ⊆
        outV (⟨pre ++ v :: v' :: v'' :: suf, hne, hnodup⟩ : HPath k).edges v := by
      intro e he
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at he
      rcases he with rfl | rfl
      · rw [outV, mem_out]; exact ⟨hvv', Finset.mem_singleton_self v⟩
      · rw [outV, mem_out]; exact ⟨hcontra, Finset.mem_singleton_self v⟩
    have hpair : ((v, v') : Vtx k × Vtx k) ≠ (v, v'') := by simp [hv'nev'']
    have hle := ProofsSpine.path_out_le_one
      (⟨pre ++ v :: v' :: v'' :: suf, hne, hnodup⟩ : HPath k) v
    have h2le : 2 ≤
        (outV (⟨pre ++ v :: v' :: v'' :: suf, hne, hnodup⟩ : HPath k).edges v).card := by
      calc 2 = ({(v, v'), (v, v'')} : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)).card :=
              (Finset.card_pair hpair).symm
        _ ≤ _ := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    omega
  · show pathW (pre ++ v :: v' :: v'' :: suf) ≤ P.wtP
    have e1 : pathW (pre ++ v :: v' :: v'' :: suf) = pathW (p ++ s) := by
      rw [pathW_insert_eq htri pre suf, ← hMeq]
    have e3 : P.wtP = pathW (p ++ v' :: s) := by
      change pathW P.verts = _; rw [hLdef]
    rw [e1, e3]
    exact pathW_splice p s v' hk

name: Hunter.ImpRed.imp_reduced_proof
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with hk0 | hk
  · subst hk0
    rw [ProofsSpine.edges_eq_empty_zero P] at hedge
    exact absurd hedge (Finset.notMem_empty _)
  have ew_pos : ∀ (x y : Vtx k), 1 ≤ ew k x y := fun x y => by
    rw [ew]; exact (wt_spec hk (le_of_eq x.2.length)).1
  have hv'nev : v' ≠ v := by
    rintro rfl; have := ew_pos v' v'; omega
  have hv'nev'' : v' ≠ v'' := by
    rintro rfl; have := ew_pos v' v'; omega
  have hzip : (v, v'') ∈ P.verts.zip P.verts.tail := ProofsSpine.mem_edges_iff.mp hedge
  obtain ⟨A, B, hAB⟩ := zip_tail_split hzip
  have hv'mem : v' ∈ P.verts := hP v'
  rw [hAB, List.mem_append, List.mem_cons, List.mem_cons] at hv'mem
  rcases hv'mem with hv'A | hv'eqv | hv'eqv'' | hv'B
  · obtain ⟨A1, A2, hA⟩ := List.mem_iff_append.mp hv'A
    refine assemble hk hP htri hv'nev'' (p := A1) (s := A2 ++ v :: v'' :: B)
      (pre := A1 ++ A2) (suf := B) ?_ ?_
    · rw [hAB, hA]; simp
    · simp
  · exact absurd hv'eqv hv'nev
  · exact absurd hv'eqv'' hv'nev''
  · obtain ⟨B1, B2, hB⟩ := List.mem_iff_append.mp hv'B
    refine assemble hk hP htri hv'nev'' (p := A ++ v :: v'' :: B1) (s := B2)
      (pre := A) (suf := B1 ++ B2) ?_ ?_
    · rw [hAB, hB]; simp
    · simp

name: Hunter.imp_reduced
proof:
:=
  ImpRed.imp_reduced_proof hP htri hedge

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta5.excessFrontier_of_amortizedWindow
statement:
theorem excessFrontier_of_amortizedWindow (hk : 3 ≤ k) (Φ : HPath k → ℕ)
    (hbase : BaseBound k Φ) (hstep : AmortizedWindow k Φ) :
    ExcessFrontier k
proof:
:= by
  
  have main : ∀ ℓ : ℕ, ∀ p : HPath k, p.Exitless → p.numVerts = ℓ →
      j k p.numVerts + Φ p ≤ (p.numVerts - 1) + (p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k - 1) + excess p := by
    intro ℓ
    induction ℓ using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | _ ℓ ih =>
      intro p hpe hpℓ
      have h0 : 0 < p.numVerts := p.numVerts_pos
      by_cases hbaseR : p.numVerts ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)
      · exact hbase p hpe h0 hbaseR
      · rw [Nat.not_le] at hbaseR
        
        have he0pos : 0 < ell0 k := ell0_pos hk
        have hm : 2 ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by
          have h := Nat.mul_le_mul (show 2 ≤ k - 1 by omega) (show 1 ≤ k - 2 by omega)
          omega
        have hprod : k * 2 ≤ k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2)) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) hm
        have heq : k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2)) = k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by ring
        have he0val : ell0 k = k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) - k := rfl
        have hkle0 : k ≤ ell0 k := by rw [he0val]; omega
        have he0base : ell0 k ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by rw [he0val]; omega
        
        set n := p.numVerts - ell0 k with hn
        have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := by rw [hn]; omega
        have hnle : n ≤ p.numVerts := by rw [hn]; omega
        have hnlt : n < p.numVerts := by rw [hn]; omega
        have hNsum : p.numVerts = n + ell0 k := by rw [hn]; omega
        obtain ⟨q, hqv, hqe⟩ := prefix_exitless hpe hn1 hnle
        have hqnv : q.numVerts = n := by
          have hlen : p.verts.length = p.numVerts := rfl
          show q.verts.length = n
          rw [hqv, List.length_take, hlen]; omega
        
        have hnltℓ : n < ℓ := by rw [← hpℓ]; exact hnlt
        have hIH := ih n hnltℓ q hqe hqnv
        rw [hqnv] at hIH
        
        have hwin : excess q + (k - 2) + Φ p ≤ excess p + Φ q := by
          apply hstep p q hpe hqe hbaseR
          rw [hqv, hn]
        
        have hdvd : k ∣ ell0 k := k_dvd_ell0 hk
        have hje0 : j k (ell0 k) = ell0 k + (ell0 k / k) + (k - 2) - 3 := by
          rw [j_base (Or.inl he0base), Proved.ceilDiv_of_dvd (show 0 < k by omega) hdvd,
              ceilDiv_ell0 hk]
        have hsplit : p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k = n ⌈/⌉ k + ell0 k / k := by
          rw [hNsum]; exact ceilDiv_add_dvd (show 0 < k by omega) hdvd
        have hjrec : j k p.numVerts = j k n + j k (ell0 k) + 3 := by
          have hr := j_rec_unfold_one hk hbaseR
          rw [← hn] at hr; exact hr
        
        have hXn1 : 1 ≤ n ⌈/⌉ k := by
          rw [Proved.ceilDiv_succ_pred hn1 (show 0 < k by omega)]; exact Nat.le_add_left 1 _
        have hXe1 : 1 ≤ ell0 k / k :=
          (Nat.one_le_div_iff (show 0 < k by omega)).mpr hkle0
        omega
  intro q hqe h0
  have := main q.numVerts q hqe rfl
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta5.run_supply_sum
statement:
theorem run_supply_sum {m : ℕ} {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hpay : ∀ c, 1 ≤ c → c < m → f c = 1) :
    ∑ c ∈ Finset.Ico 1 m, f c = m - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hcongr : ∀ c ∈ Finset.Ico 1 m, f c = 1 := by
    intro c hc
    rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hc
    exact hpay c hc.1 hc.2
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hcongr, Finset.sum_const, Nat.card_Ico, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta5.run_banks
statement:
theorem run_banks (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) (t₀ m : ℕ)
    (hN : k * (t₀ + m * (k - 1)) ≤ p.numVerts)
    (hdoor : ∀ j r, j < m → 1 ≤ r → r ≤ k - 2 →
        ew k (p.vert (k * (t₀ + j * (k - 1) + r) - 1))
          (p.vert (k * (t₀ + j * (k - 1) + r))) = 2)
    (halpha : ∀ c, 1 ≤ c → c < m →
        ew k (p.vert (k * (t₀ + c * (k - 1)) - 1)) (p.vert (k * (t₀ + c * (k - 1)))) = 3 ∧
        (p.vert (k * (t₀ + c * (k - 1))) : List ℕ).getLastD 0
          = (rho (p.vert (k * (t₀ + c * (k - 1)) - 1) : List ℕ)).getLastD 0 ∧
        (p.vert (k * (t₀ + c * (k - 1))) : List ℕ)
          = alphaWord (p.vert (k * (t₀ + c * (k - 1)) - 1) : List ℕ)) :
    m ≤ k - 2 ∧
    ∑ c ∈ Finset.Ico 1 m,
        (ew k (p.vert (k * (t₀ + c * (k - 1)) - 1)) (p.vert (k * (t₀ + c * (k - 1)))) - 2)
      = m - 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hbound, hpay⟩ := Proved.runs_pay hk hp t₀ m hN hdoor halpha
  exact ⟨hbound, run_supply_sum hpay⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta5.amortizedWindow_holds_at_witness
statement:
theorem amortizedWindow_holds_at_witness :
    ∃ (P q : HPath 5),
      P.Exitless ∧ q.Exitless ∧
      5 * (5 - 1) * (5 - 2) < P.numVerts ∧
      q.verts = P.verts.take (P.numVerts - ell0 5) ∧
      excess q = 4 ∧ excess P = 6 ∧
      
      excess q + (5 - 2) + 0 ≤ excess P + 1 ∧
      
      ¬ (excess q + (5 - 2) ≤ excess P)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : Refutations.P.Exitless := Refutations.P_exitless
  have hlt : 5 * (5 - 1) * (5 - 2) < Refutations.P.numVerts := by
    rw [Refutations.P_numVerts]; norm_num
  obtain ⟨q, hqv, hqe⟩ :=
