    prefix_exitless hp (by norm_num : (1 : ℕ) ≤ 65) (by rw [Refutations.P_numVerts]; norm_num)
  have hpre : q.verts = Refutations.P.verts.take (Refutations.P.numVerts - ell0 5) := by
    rw [hqv, Refutations.prefix_len]
  have hep : excess Refutations.P = 6 := by rw [Refutations.excess_eq]; decide
  have heq : excess q = 4 := by rw [Refutations.excess_eq, hqv]; decide
  refine ⟨Refutations.P, q, hp, hqe, hlt, hpre, heq, hep, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hep, heq]
  · rw [hep, heq]; norm_num

name: Hunter.ProofsRecursion.ew_le_k
statement: theorem ew_le_k (hk : 1 ≤ k) (u v : Vtx k) : ew k u v ≤ k
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : (u : List ℕ).length = k := u.2.length
  exact (wt_spec hk (le_of_eq hlen)).2.1

name: Hunter.ProofsRecursion.wtP_ge_jbase
statement:
theorem wtP_ge_jbase {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless)
    (hℓ0 : 0 < p.numVerts) :
    p.numVerts + (p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k) + (p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1))) - 3 ≤ p.wtP
proof:
:= by
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
  have hN1 : 1 ≤ p.numVerts := hℓ0
  have h1 := Proved.prp_1edgebound hk1 hp
  have h2 := Proved.prp_2edgebound hk1 hp
  have h3 := Proved.prp_3edgebound (by omega : 2 ≤ k) hp
  have hsum := wtP_ge_edgeCounts hk1 (p := p)
  have hck1 : 1 ≤ p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k := by
    rw [ceilDiv_succ_pred hN1 (by omega : 0 < k)]; exact Nat.le_add_left 1 _
  have hck2 : 1 ≤ p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1)) := by
    rw [ceilDiv_succ_pred hN1 (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega : 0 < k - 1))]
    exact Nat.le_add_left 1 _
  set A := p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k
  set B := p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1))
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsRecursion.sum_indicator_Icc
statement:
theorem sum_indicator_Icc {e : ℕ} (he1 : 1 ≤ e) (hek : e ≤ k) :
    ∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k, (if q ≤ e then (1 : ℕ) else 0) = e
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.card_filter]
  have hfilt : (Finset.Icc 1 k).filter (fun q => q ≤ e) = Finset.Icc 1 e := by
    apply Finset.ext; intro q
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc]
    omega
  rw [hfilt, Nat.card_Icc]
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsRecursion.wtP_eq_sum_edgeCountGe
statement:
theorem wtP_eq_sum_edgeCountGe {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (p : HPath k) :
    p.wtP = ∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k, edgeCountGe p q
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ q : ℕ, edgeCountGe p q = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p.numVerts - 1),
      (if q ≤ ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) then 1 else 0) := by
    intro q; rw [edgeCountGe, Finset.card_filter]
  rw [wtP_eq_sum]
  simp_rw [key]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  exact (sum_indicator_Icc (ew_ge_one hk _ _) (ew_le_k hk _ _)).symm

name: Hunter.ProofsRecursion.wtP_decompose
statement:
theorem wtP_decompose {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) :
    p.wtP = (p.numVerts - 1) + (p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k - 1) + excess p
proof:
:= by
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
  rw [wtP_eq_sum_edgeCountGe hk1 p]
  
  have h13 : Finset.Icc 1 k = insert 1 (insert 2 (Finset.Icc 3 k)) := by
    apply Finset.ext; intro q
    simp only [Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_insert]
    omega
  have h1ni : (1 : ℕ) ∉ insert 2 (Finset.Icc 3 k) := by
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_Icc]; omega
  have h2ni : (2 : ℕ) ∉ Finset.Icc 3 k := by
    simp only [Finset.mem_Icc]; omega
  rw [h13, Finset.sum_insert h1ni, Finset.sum_insert h2ni]
  have e1 := Proved.prp_1edgebound hk1 hp
  have e2 := Proved.prp_2edgebound hk1 hp
  rw [e1, e2, excess, Nat.add_assoc]

name: Hunter.ProofsRecursion.edgeCountGe3_le_excess
statement:
theorem edgeCountGe3_le_excess {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) (p : HPath k) :
    edgeCountGe p 3 ≤ excess p
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun r => edgeCountGe p r) (fun i _ => Nat.zero_le _)
  simp only [Finset.mem_Icc]; omega

name: Hunter.ProofsRecursion.excess_frontier_base
statement:
theorem excess_frontier_base {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) {q : HPath k} (hq : q.Exitless)
    (h0 : 0 < q.numVerts) (hle : q.numVerts ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) :
    j k q.numVerts ≤ (q.numVerts - 1) + (q.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k - 1) + excess q
proof:
:= by
  have hN1 : 1 ≤ q.numVerts := h0
  have he3 := edgeCountGe3_le_excess hk q
  have h3 := Proved.prp_3edgebound (by omega : 2 ≤ k) hq
  have hck1 : 1 ≤ q.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k := by
    rw [ceilDiv_succ_pred hN1 (by omega : 0 < k)]; exact Nat.le_add_left 1 _
  have hck2 : 1 ≤ q.numVerts ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1)) := by
    rw [ceilDiv_succ_pred hN1 (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega : 0 < k - 1))]
    exact Nat.le_add_left 1 _
  rw [j_base (Or.inl hle)]
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsRecursion.thm2_of_frontier
statement:
theorem thm2_of_frontier {k ℓ : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hfr : ExcessFrontier k)
    (hex : HasExitlessPath k ℓ) :
    j k ℓ ≤ iExitless k ℓ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hpe, hpv⟩ := hex
  have hne : {m | ∃ q : HPath k, q.Exitless ∧ q.numVerts = ℓ ∧ q.wtP = m}.Nonempty :=
    ⟨p.wtP, p, hpe, hpv, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨q, hqe, hqv, hqw⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem hne
  have h0 : 0 < q.numVerts := q.numVerts_pos
  calc j k ℓ = j k q.numVerts := by rw [hqv]
    _ ≤ (q.numVerts - 1) + (q.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k - 1) + excess q := hfr q hqe h0
    _ = q.wtP := (wtP_decompose hk hqe).symm
    _ = iExitless k ℓ := hqw

name: Hunter.ProofsRecursion.ell0_pos
statement: theorem ell0_pos {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) : 0 < ell0 k
proof:
:= by
  have hm : 2 ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by
    have h := Nat.mul_le_mul (show 2 ≤ k - 1 by omega) (show 1 ≤ k - 2 by omega)
    omega
  have hprod : k * 2 ≤ k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2)) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) hm
  have heq : k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2)) = k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by ring
  rw [heq] at hprod
  rw [ell0]; omega

name: Hunter.ProofsRecursion.j_rec_unfold_one
statement:
theorem j_rec_unfold_one {k ℓ : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hℓ : k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) < ℓ) :
    j k ℓ = j k (ℓ - ell0 k) + j k (ell0 k) + 3
proof:
:= by
  apply j_rec
  have h0 := ell0_pos hk
  rw [ell0] at h0
  simp only [not_or]
  exact ⟨by omega, by omega⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsRecursion.card_permsOf
statement: theorem card_permsOf (S : Finset ℕ) : (permsOf S).card = Nat.factorial S.card
proof:
:= by
  rw [permsOf, List.toFinset_card_of_nodup
      (List.nodup_permutations _ (S.sort_nodup (· ≤ ·))),
      List.length_permutations, Finset.length_sort]

name: Hunter.ProofsRecursion.card_Vtx
statement: theorem card_Vtx (k : ℕ) : Fintype.card (Vtx k) = Nat.factorial k
proof:
:= by
  have e : Vtx k ≃ {w // w ∈ permsOf (Finset.Icc 1 k)} :=
    Equiv.subtypeEquivRight (fun w =>
      ⟨fun h => mem_permsOf.mpr ⟨h.1, h.2⟩,
       fun h => ⟨(mem_permsOf.mp h).1, (mem_permsOf.mp h).2⟩⟩)
  rw [Fintype.card_congr e, Fintype.card_coe, card_permsOf, Nat.card_Icc, Nat.add_sub_cancel]

name: Hunter.ProofsRecursion.thm2_small
statement:
theorem thm2_small {k ℓ : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hk4 : k ≤ 4) (hex : HasExitlessPath k ℓ) :
    j k ℓ ≤ iExitless k ℓ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hpe, hpv⟩ := hex
  have hℓ0 : 0 < ℓ := by rw [← hpv]; exact p.numVerts_pos
  have hcard : ℓ ≤ Fintype.card (Vtx k) := by rw [← hpv]; exact p.nodup.length_le_card
  rw [card_Vtx] at hcard
  have hle : ℓ ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by
    rcases (by omega : k = 3 ∨ k = 4) with rfl | rfl <;>
      · simp only [Nat.factorial] at hcard; omega
  exact thm2_base_unconditional hk hℓ0 hle ⟨p, hpe, hpv⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsWindow.prefix_vert_eq
statement:
theorem prefix_vert_eq {p q : HPath k} {n : ℕ} (hn : q.verts = p.verts.take n)
    (hnle : n ≤ p.numVerts) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < n) : q.vert i = p.vert i
proof:
:= by
  have hNlen : p.verts.length = p.numVerts := rfl
  have hip : i < p.verts.length := by rw [hNlen]; omega
  have hiq : i < q.verts.length := by rw [hn, List.length_take]; omega
  show q.verts.getD i _ = p.verts.getD i _
  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem q.verts _ hiq, List.getD_eq_getElem p.verts _ hip]
  have : q.verts[i] = (p.verts.take n)[i]'(by rw [← hn]; exact hiq) := by
    congr 1
  rw [this, List.getElem_take]

name: Hunter.ProofsWindow.edgeCountGe_prefix_le
statement:
theorem edgeCountGe_prefix_le {p q : HPath k} {n : ℕ} (hn : q.verts = p.verts.take n)
    (hnle : n ≤ p.numVerts) (hqn : q.numVerts = n) (r : ℕ) :
    edgeCountGe q r ≤ edgeCountGe p r
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgeCountGe, edgeCountGe, hqn]
  have hfeq :
      (Finset.range (n - 1)).filter (fun i => r ≤ ew k (q.vert i) (q.vert (i + 1)))
        = (Finset.range (n - 1)).filter (fun i => r ≤ ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1))) := by
    apply Finset.filter_congr
    intro i hi
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hi
    rw [prefix_vert_eq hn hnle (show i < n by omega),
        prefix_vert_eq hn hnle (show i + 1 < n by omega)]
  rw [hfeq]
  apply Finset.card_le_card
  intro x hx
  rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at hx ⊢
  exact ⟨by omega, hx.2⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsWindow.windowExcess_of_windowHeavy3
statement:
theorem windowExcess_of_windowHeavy3 (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hw : WindowHeavy3 k) :
    WindowExcess k
proof:
:= by
  intro p q hpe hqe hlt hprefix
  have hnle : p.numVerts - ell0 k ≤ p.numVerts := Nat.sub_le _ _
  have hqn : q.numVerts = p.numVerts - ell0 k := by
    have hlen : q.verts.length = (p.verts.take (p.numVerts - ell0 k)).length := by
      rw [hprefix]
    have hN : p.verts.length = p.numVerts := rfl
    rw [List.length_take, hN] at hlen
    show q.verts.length = _
    rw [hlen]; omega
  have hmono : ∀ r, edgeCountGe q r ≤ edgeCountGe p r :=
    fun r => edgeCountGe_prefix_le hprefix hnle hqn r
  have hres : edgeCountGe q 3 + (k - 2) ≤ edgeCountGe p 3 := hw p q hpe hqe hlt hprefix
  rw [excess, excess]
  have h3mem : (3 : ℕ) ∈ Finset.Icc 3 k := by rw [Finset.mem_Icc]; omega
  rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ (edgeCountGe p) h3mem,
      ← Finset.add_sum_erase _ (edgeCountGe q) h3mem]
  have hsum : ∑ r ∈ (Finset.Icc 3 k).erase 3, edgeCountGe q r
            ≤ ∑ r ∈ (Finset.Icc 3 k).erase 3, edgeCountGe p r :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum (fun r _ => hmono r)
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsWindow.thm2_of_windowHeavy3
statement:
theorem thm2_of_windowHeavy3 {k ℓ : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hw : WindowHeavy3 k)
    (hℓ : HasExitlessPath k ℓ) :
    j k ℓ ≤ iExitless k ℓ
proof:
:=
  thm2_of_windowExcess hk (windowExcess_of_windowHeavy3 hk hw) hℓ

name: Hunter.ProofsWindow.boundary_ge_two
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := ew_ge_one hk (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1))
  have hne : ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) ≠ 1 :=
    fun he => (prp_periodicedges hk hp hin).mp he hd
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsWindow.heavy_is_boundary
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hnd
  have he1 : ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) = 1 := (prp_periodicedges hk hp hin).mpr hnd
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta9.door_never_ejects
statement:
theorem door_never_ejects (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) {t : ℕ}
    (ht : 1 ≤ t) (hN : k * t < p.numVerts)
    (hw : ew k (p.vert (k * t - 1)) (p.vert (k * t)) = 2) :
    p.vert (k * t) ∈ Vset3 k
      ((p.vert (k * (t - 1)) : List ℕ).getLastD 0)
      (((p.vert (k * (t - 1)) : List ℕ).dropLast).getLastD 0)
      (rotClass ((p.vert (k * (t - 1)) : List ℕ).dropLast.dropLast))
proof:
:= by
  have hstep : (p.vert (k * t) : List ℕ).erase ((p.vert (k * (t - 1)) : List ℕ).getLastD 0)
      = ((p.vert (k * (t - 1)) : List ℕ).erase
          ((p.vert (k * (t - 1)) : List ℕ).getLastD 0)).rotate 1 :=
    metaWord_door_block (α₁ := (p.vert (k * (t - 1)) : List ℕ).getLastD 0)
      (by omega : 2 ≤ k) hp ht hN hw rfl
  exact Vset3_of_metaWord_rotate_iter
    (ProofsMeta8.mem_Vset3_self (p.vert (k * (t - 1)))) hstep

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta9.phiState_P
statement: theorem phiState_P : PhiState 5 Refutations.P = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ¬ Refutations.P.numVerts ≤ 5 * (5 - 1) * (5 - 2) := by
    rw [Refutations.P_numVerts]; norm_num
  have h2 : ew 5 (Refutations.P.vert (Refutations.P.numVerts - 5 - 1))
      (Refutations.P.vert (Refutations.P.numVerts - 5)) = 2 := by
    rw [Refutations.ew5_eq]; decide
  unfold PhiState
  rw [if_neg h1, if_pos h2]

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta9.nonReleaseSupply_5_phiState_false
statement:
theorem nonReleaseSupply_5_phiState_false :
    ¬ NonReleaseSupply 5 (PhiState 5)
proof:
:= by
  intro hNR
  
  have hp : Refutations.P.Exitless := Refutations.P_exitless
  obtain ⟨q, hqv, hqe⟩ := prefix_exitless hp (by norm_num : (1 : ℕ) ≤ 65)
    (by rw [Refutations.P_numVerts]; norm_num)
  have hlen : Refutations.P.verts.length = 120 := Refutations.P_numVerts
  have hqn : q.numVerts = 65 := by
    show q.verts.length = 65
    rw [hqv, List.length_take, hlen]; rfl
  have hpre : q.verts = Refutations.P.verts.take (Refutations.P.numVerts - ell0 5) := by
    rw [hqv, Refutations.prefix_len]
  have hlt : 5 * (5 - 1) * (5 - 2) < Refutations.P.numVerts := by
    rw [Refutations.P_numVerts]; norm_num
  
  have hPhiP : PhiState 5 Refutations.P = 1 := phiState_P
  
  have hPhiq : PhiState 5 q = 0 := by
    have h1 : ¬ q.numVerts ≤ 5 * (5 - 1) * (5 - 2) := by rw [hqn]; norm_num
    have h2 : ¬ ew 5 (q.vert (q.numVerts - 5 - 1)) (q.vert (q.numVerts - 5)) = 2 := by
      rw [hqn,
        prefix_vert_eq hqv (by rw [Refutations.P_numVerts]; norm_num) (by norm_num : 65 - 5 - 1 < 65),
        prefix_vert_eq hqv (by rw [Refutations.P_numVerts]; norm_num) (by norm_num : 65 - 5 < 65),
        Refutations.ew5_eq]
      decide
    unfold PhiState
    rw [if_neg h1, if_neg h2]
  
  have hexP : excess Refutations.P = 6 := by rw [Refutations.excess_eq]; decide
  have hexq : excess q = 4 := by rw [Refutations.excess_eq, hqv]; decide
  
  have hrel : PhiState 5 q ≤ PhiState 5 Refutations.P := by rw [hPhiP, hPhiq]; omega
  
  have hbad := hNR Refutations.P q hp hqe hlt hpre hrel
  rw [hexP, hexq, hPhiP, hPhiq] at hbad
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsGB2.verts_biUnion
statement:
theorem verts_biUnion (X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)) :
    (Comps X).biUnion (fun C => C) = vertsOf X
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp only [Finset.mem_biUnion]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨C, hC, hvC⟩
    obtain ⟨u, huV, hb⟩ := ProofsWP.mem_comps.mp hC
    rw [← hb] at hvC
    exact (ProofsWP.mem_block.mp hvC).1
  · intro hv
    exact ⟨ProofsWP.block X v, ProofsWP.block_mem_comps hv, ProofsWP.self_mem_block hv⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsGB2.card_verts_eq_sum
statement:
theorem card_verts_eq_sum (X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)) :
    (vertsOf X).card = ∑ C ∈ Comps X, C.card
proof:
:= by
  rw [← verts_biUnion X,
    Finset.card_biUnion (fun _ hC _ hC' hne => ProofsWP.comps_disjoint hC hC' hne)]

name: Hunter.ProofsGB2.edges_biUnion
statement:
theorem edges_biUnion (X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)) :
    (Comps X).biUnion (inducedEdges X) = X
proof:
:= by
  ext e
  simp only [Finset.mem_biUnion]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨C, hC, heC⟩
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp heC).1
  · intro heX
    have hv1 : e.1 ∈ vertsOf X := ProofsWP.mem_vertsOf.mpr ⟨e, heX, Or.inl rfl⟩
    exact ⟨ProofsWP.block X e.1, ProofsWP.block_mem_comps hv1,
      Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨heX, ProofsWP.self_mem_block hv1⟩⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsGB2.inducedEdges_disjoint
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro e he he'
  have h1 : e.1 ∈ C := (Finset.mem_filter.mp he).2
  have h2 : e.1 ∈ C' := (Finset.mem_filter.mp he').2
  exact (Finset.disjoint_left.mp (ProofsWP.comps_disjoint hC hC' hne) h1) h2

name: Hunter.ProofsGB2.wEdges_eq_sum
statement:
theorem wEdges_eq_sum (X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)) :
    wEdges X = ∑ C ∈ Comps X, wEdges (inducedEdges X C)
proof:
:= by
  calc wEdges X = ∑ e ∈ X, ew k e.1 e.2 := rfl
    _ = ∑ e ∈ (Comps X).biUnion (inducedEdges X), ew k e.1 e.2 := by rw [edges_biUnion X]
    _ = ∑ C ∈ Comps X, ∑ e ∈ inducedEdges X C, ew k e.1 e.2 :=
        Finset.sum_biUnion (fun C hC C' hC' hne => inducedEdges_disjoint hC hC' hne)
    _ = ∑ C ∈ Comps X, wEdges (inducedEdges X C) := rfl

name: Hunter.ProofsGB2.sup_compMinto_le_sum
statement:
theorem sup_compMinto_le_sum (X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)) :
    (Comps X).sup (compMinto X) ≤ ∑ C ∈ Comps X, compMinto X C
proof:
:=
  Finset.sup_le (fun _C hC => Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) hC)

name: Hunter.ProofsGB2.minThrough_add_sup
statement:
theorem minThrough_add_sup (X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)) :
    MinThrough X + (Comps X).sup (compMinto X) = ∑ C ∈ Comps X, compMinto X C
proof:
:= by
  rw [MinThrough]
  by_cases hc : (Comps X).card ≤ 1
  · rw [if_pos hc, zero_add]
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (Comps X).card with h0 | hpos
    · rw [Finset.card_eq_zero] at h0; rw [h0]; simp
    · have h1 : (Comps X).card = 1 := le_antisymm hc hpos
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp h1
      rw [ha, Finset.sup_singleton, Finset.sum_singleton]
  · rw [if_neg hc, Nat.sub_add_cancel (sup_compMinto_le_sum X)]

name: Hunter.ProofsGB2.card_vertsFinset
statement: theorem card_vertsFinset (p : HPath k) : p.vertsFinset.card = p.numVerts
proof:
:=
  List.toFinset_card_of_nodup p.nodup

name: Hunter.ProofsGB2.inducedEdges_eq_edges
statement:
theorem inducedEdges_eq_edges {p : HPath k} {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)}
    (hpc : IsPathComponent p X) : inducedEdges X p.vertsFinset = p.edges
proof:
:= by
  ext e
  simp only [inducedEdges, Finset.mem_filter]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨heX, he1⟩; exact hpc.2.2 e heX he1
  · intro he; exact ⟨hpc.1 he, HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mpr (ProofsWP.edge_ends_mem he).1⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsGB2.Rk_bddBelow
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
  rintro q ⟨p, -, -, rfl⟩
  positivity

name: Hunter.ProofsGB2.Rk_nonneg
statement: theorem Rk_nonneg (k : ℕ) : 0 ≤ Rk k
proof:
:= by
  rw [Rk]
  apply Real.sInf_nonneg
  rintro q ⟨p, -, -, rfl⟩
  positivity

name: Hunter.ProofsGB2.pv_ge
statement:
theorem pv_ge {P : HPath k} (hP : P.IsHamiltonian) (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    {C Cmax : Finset (Vtx k)} (hC : C ∈ Comps (F P)) (hCmax : Cmax ∈ Comps (F P))
    (hne : C ≠ Cmax) (hCmaxk : k ≤ Cmax.card)
    (hsumcard : ∑ D ∈ Comps (F P), D.card = k.factorial) :
    (1 : ℝ) + (compMinto (F P) C : ℝ) + (wEdges (inducedEdges (F P) C) : ℝ)
      ≥ Rk k * (C.card : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hpV, hpc⟩ := Hunter.Proved.lem_pathrule hP C hC
  have hpse : p.StronglyExitless := ProofsB2.stronglyExitless_of_isPathComponent hP hk hpc
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := le_trans (by norm_num) hk
  have hCcard : C.card = p.numVerts := by rw [← hpV]; exact card_vertsFinset p
  have hmintoC : compMinto (F P) C = p.minto := by
    rw [← hpV]; exact Hunter.Proved.bridge_compMinto_eq_minto hpc
  have hwEC : wEdges (inducedEdges (F P) C) = p.wtP := by
    rw [← hpV, inducedEdges_eq_edges hpc]; exact Hunter.Proved.bridge_wEdges_edges_eq_wtP p
  
  have hsum2 : C.card + Cmax.card ≤ k.factorial := by
    rw [← hsumcard, ← Finset.sum_erase_add (Comps (F P)) (fun D => D.card) hC]
    have hCmax_erase : Cmax ∈ (Comps (F P)).erase C :=
      Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨fun h => hne h.symm, hCmax⟩
    have hle := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun D => D.card) (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) hCmax_erase
    omega
  have hpnv_le : p.numVerts ≤ k.factorial - k := by rw [← hCcard]; omega
  
  have hpXk' : p ∈ Xk' k := ⟨F P, ⟨P, hP, rfl⟩, hpc⟩
  have hppos : 0 < p.numVerts := p.numVerts_pos
  have hmem : (pValue p : ℝ) / (p.numVerts : ℝ) ∈ {q : ℝ | ∃ p', p' ∈ Xk' k ∧
      p'.numVerts ≤ k.factorial - k ∧ q = (pValue p' : ℝ) / (p'.numVerts : ℝ)} :=
    ⟨p, hpXk', hpnv_le, rfl⟩
  have hRkle : Rk k ≤ (pValue p : ℝ) / (p.numVerts : ℝ) := csInf_le (Rk_bddBelow k) hmem
  have hnvpos : (0 : ℝ) < (p.numVerts : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hppos
  have hbound : Rk k * (p.numVerts : ℝ) ≤ (pValue p : ℝ) := (le_div_iff₀ hnvpos).mp hRkle
  have hcast : (1 : ℝ) + (compMinto (F P) C : ℝ) + (wEdges (inducedEdges (F P) C) : ℝ)
      = (pValue p : ℝ) := by
    rw [hmintoC, hwEC]; simp only [pValue]; push_cast; ring
  rw [hcast, hCcard]
  linarith [hbound]

name: Hunter.ProofsGB2.numVerts_le_factorial
statement: theorem numVerts_le_factorial (p : HPath k) : (p.numVerts : ℝ) ≤ (k.factorial : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have := p.nodup.length_le_card
  rw [ProofsRecursion.card_Vtx] at this
  exact_mod_cast this

name: Hunter.ProofsGB2.innerSet_bddBelow
statement:
theorem innerSet_bddBelow (k : ℕ) (r : ℝ) :
    BddBelow {q : ℝ | ∃ p, p ∈ Xk' k ∧ q = (p.wtP : ℝ) - r * (p.numVerts : ℝ)}
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨-(|r| * (k.factorial : ℝ)), ?_⟩
  rintro q ⟨p, -, rfl⟩
  have h1 : (p.numVerts : ℝ) ≤ (k.factorial : ℝ) := numVerts_le_factorial p
  have h3 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (p.numVerts : ℝ) := by positivity
  have h4 : r * (p.numVerts : ℝ) ≤ |r| * (k.factorial : ℝ) :=
    calc r * (p.numVerts : ℝ) ≤ |r * (p.numVerts : ℝ)| := le_abs_self _
      _ = |r| * (p.numVerts : ℝ) := by rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg h3]
      _ ≤ |r| * (k.factorial : ℝ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (abs_nonneg r)
  have h2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (p.wtP : ℝ) := by positivity
  linarith

name: Hunter.ProofsGB2.gInner_mono
statement:
theorem gInner_mono (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hne_Xk : (Xk k).Nonempty) (r s : ℝ) (hrs : r ≤ s) :
    r * (k.factorial : ℝ) + gInner k r ≤ s * (k.factorial : ℝ) + gInner k s
proof:
:= by
  have hSne : {q : ℝ | ∃ p, p ∈ Xk' k ∧ q = (p.wtP : ℝ) - s * (p.numVerts : ℝ)}.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := ProofsB2.Xk'_nonempty_of_Xk_nonempty hk hne_Xk
    exact ⟨_, p, hp, rfl⟩
  have hkey : gInner k r + (r - s) * (k.factorial : ℝ) ≤ gInner k s := by
    show gInner k r + (r - s) * (k.factorial : ℝ)
      ≤ sInf {q : ℝ | ∃ p, p ∈ Xk' k ∧ q = (p.wtP : ℝ) - s * (p.numVerts : ℝ)}
    apply le_csInf hSne
    rintro y ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    have hple : gInner k r ≤ (p.wtP : ℝ) - r * (p.numVerts : ℝ) :=
      csInf_le (innerSet_bddBelow k r) ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    have hnv : (p.numVerts : ℝ) ≤ (k.factorial : ℝ) := numVerts_le_factorial p
    nlinarith [hple, hnv, hrs]
  linarith [hkey]

name: Hunter.ProofsGB2.b2Set_bddBelow
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
  rintro q ⟨p, -, rfl⟩
  have h1 : (p.numVerts : ℝ) ≤ (k.factorial : ℝ) := numVerts_le_factorial p
  have h2 : 0 ≤ Rk k := Rk_nonneg k
  have h3 : 0 ≤ Rk k * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - (p.numVerts : ℝ)) := mul_nonneg h2 (by linarith)
  have h4 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (p.wtP : ℝ) := by positivity
  linarith

name: Hunter.ProofsGB2.b2Set_sInf_eq
statement:
theorem b2Set_sInf_eq (k : ℕ) (hne : (Xk' k).Nonempty) :
    sInf {q : ℝ | ∃ p, p ∈ Xk' k ∧
        q = (p.wtP : ℝ) + Rk k * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - (p.numVerts : ℝ))}
      = Rk k * (k.factorial : ℝ) + gInner k (Rk k)
proof:
:= by
  have hRne : {q : ℝ | ∃ p, p ∈ Xk' k ∧ q = (p.wtP : ℝ) - Rk k * (p.numVerts : ℝ)}.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hne; exact ⟨_, p, hp, rfl⟩
  have hBne : {q : ℝ | ∃ p, p ∈ Xk' k ∧
      q = (p.wtP : ℝ) + Rk k * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - (p.numVerts : ℝ))}.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hne; exact ⟨_, p, hp, rfl⟩
  rw [gInner]
  apply le_antisymm
  · 
    have h : sInf {q : ℝ | ∃ p, p ∈ Xk' k ∧
          q = (p.wtP : ℝ) + Rk k * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - (p.numVerts : ℝ))}
        - Rk k * (k.factorial : ℝ)
        ≤ sInf {q : ℝ | ∃ p, p ∈ Xk' k ∧ q = (p.wtP : ℝ) - Rk k * (p.numVerts : ℝ)} := by
      apply le_csInf hRne
      rintro x ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
      have hb := csInf_le (b2Set_bddBelow k)
        (show (p.wtP : ℝ) + Rk k * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - (p.numVerts : ℝ)) ∈ _ from ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩)
      have hdist : Rk k * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - (p.numVerts : ℝ))
          = Rk k * (k.factorial : ℝ) - Rk k * (p.numVerts : ℝ) := by ring
      rw [hdist] at hb; linarith
    linarith [h]
  · 
    apply le_csInf hBne
    rintro y ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    have hR := csInf_le (innerSet_bddBelow k (Rk k))
      (show (p.wtP : ℝ) - Rk k * (p.numVerts : ℝ) ∈ _ from ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩)
    have hdist : Rk k * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - (p.numVerts : ℝ))
        = Rk k * (k.factorial : ℝ) - Rk k * (p.numVerts : ℝ) := by ring
    rw [hdist]; linarith

name: Hunter.Proved.prp_gives_b2_amended
statement:
theorem prp_gives_b2_amended (hk : 2 ≤ k) {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} (hX : X ∈ Xk k) :
    ((numComps X : ℝ) - 1) + (MinThrough X : ℝ) + (wEdges X : ℝ)
      ≥ Rk k * (k.factorial : ℝ)
        + sInf {q : ℝ | ∃ p, IsPathComponent p X ∧
            q = (p.wtP : ℝ) - Rk k * (p.numVerts : ℝ)}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hP, rfl⟩ := hX
  set X := F P with hXdef
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := le_trans (by norm_num) hk
  
  have hncpos : 1 ≤ numComps X := ProofsWP.one_le_numComps_F hP hk
  have hne_comps : (Comps X).Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp hncpos
  have hverts : vertsOf X = Finset.univ := ProofsStructure.vertsOf_F_eq_univ hP hk
  have hsumcard : ∑ C ∈ Comps X, C.card = k.factorial := by
    rw [← ProofsGB2.card_verts_eq_sum X, hverts, Finset.card_univ, ProofsRecursion.card_Vtx]
  
  obtain ⟨Cmax, hCmax_mem, hsup⟩ :=
    Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup (Comps X) hne_comps (compMinto X)
  obtain ⟨pm, hpmV, hpmc⟩ := Hunter.Proved.lem_pathrule hP Cmax hCmax_mem
  have hpmse : pm.StronglyExitless := ProofsB2.stronglyExitless_of_isPathComponent hP hk hpmc
  have hCmaxcard : Cmax.card = pm.numVerts := by rw [← hpmV]; exact ProofsGB2.card_vertsFinset pm
  have hCmaxk : k ≤ Cmax.card := by
    rw [hCmaxcard]
    exact Nat.le_of_dvd pm.numVerts_pos
      (Hunter.Proved.dvd_numVerts_of_stronglyExitless hk1 hpmse)
  have hwEmax : wEdges (inducedEdges X Cmax) = pm.wtP := by
    rw [← hpmV, ProofsGB2.inducedEdges_eq_edges hpmc]
    exact Hunter.Proved.bridge_wEdges_edges_eq_wtP pm
  
  set g : Finset (Vtx k) → ℝ := fun C =>
    (1 : ℝ) + (compMinto X C : ℝ) + (wEdges (inducedEdges X C) : ℝ) with hg
  set A : ℝ := ∑ C ∈ (Comps X).erase Cmax, g C with hA
  
  have hcardR : ∑ C ∈ Comps X, (C.card : ℝ) = (k.factorial : ℝ) := by
    rw [← Nat.cast_sum, hsumcard]
  have hwecast : ∑ C ∈ Comps X, (wEdges (inducedEdges X C) : ℝ) = (wEdges X : ℝ) := by
    rw [← Nat.cast_sum, ← ProofsGB2.wEdges_eq_sum]
  
  have hgsum : ∑ C ∈ Comps X, g C
      = (numComps X : ℝ) + (∑ C ∈ Comps X, (compMinto X C : ℝ)) + (wEdges X : ℝ) := by
    simp only [hg, numComps, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one,
      hwecast]
  
  have hsplit : ∑ C ∈ Comps X, g C = A + g Cmax :=
    (Finset.sum_erase_add (Comps X) g hCmax_mem).symm
  
  have hMTcast : (MinThrough X : ℝ)
      = (∑ C ∈ Comps X, (compMinto X C : ℝ)) - (compMinto X Cmax : ℝ) := by
    have hmt := ProofsGB2.minThrough_add_sup X
    rw [hsup] at hmt
    have := congrArg (Nat.cast : ℕ → ℝ) hmt
    push_cast at this
    linarith
  
  have hA_ge : A ≥ Rk k * (k.factorial : ℝ) - Rk k * (Cmax.card : ℝ) := by
    have hpt : ∀ C ∈ (Comps X).erase Cmax, Rk k * (C.card : ℝ) ≤ g C := by
      intro C hCe
      obtain ⟨hCne, hCmem⟩ := Finset.mem_erase.mp hCe
      exact ProofsGB2.pv_ge hP hk hCmem hCmax_mem hCne hCmaxk hsumcard
    have hsum_ge : ∑ C ∈ (Comps X).erase Cmax, Rk k * (C.card : ℝ) ≤ A :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum hpt
    have hcard_erase : ∑ C ∈ (Comps X).erase Cmax, (C.card : ℝ)
        = (k.factorial : ℝ) - (Cmax.card : ℝ) := by
      have h := Finset.sum_erase_add (Comps X) (fun C => (C.card : ℝ)) hCmax_mem
      linarith [h, hcardR]
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hcard_erase] at hsum_ge
    nlinarith [hsum_ge]
  
  have hCmaxcardR : (Cmax.card : ℝ) = (pm.numVerts : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hCmaxcard
  have hR23 : Rk k * (Cmax.card : ℝ) = Rk k * (pm.numVerts : ℝ) := by rw [hCmaxcardR]
  have hwEmaxR : (wEdges (inducedEdges X Cmax) : ℝ) = (pm.wtP : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hwEmax
  have hBddI : BddBelow {q : ℝ | ∃ p, IsPathComponent p X ∧
      q = (p.wtP : ℝ) - Rk k * (p.numVerts : ℝ)} := by
    refine ⟨-(Rk k * (k.factorial : ℝ)), ?_⟩
    rintro q ⟨p, -, rfl⟩
    have hnv : (p.numVerts : ℝ) ≤ (k.factorial : ℝ) := by
      have := p.nodup.length_le_card
      rw [ProofsRecursion.card_Vtx] at this
      exact_mod_cast this
    have hwt : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (p.wtP : ℝ) := by positivity
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnv (ProofsGB2.Rk_nonneg k)]
  have hsInf : sInf {q : ℝ | ∃ p, IsPathComponent p X ∧
      q = (p.wtP : ℝ) - Rk k * (p.numVerts : ℝ)}
      ≤ (pm.wtP : ℝ) - Rk k * (pm.numVerts : ℝ) :=
    csInf_le hBddI ⟨pm, hpmc, rfl⟩
  
  have hgCmax : g Cmax = (1 : ℝ) + (compMinto X Cmax : ℝ)
      + (wEdges (inducedEdges X Cmax) : ℝ) := by rw [hg]
  linarith [hgsum, hsplit, hMTcast, hA_ge, hCmaxcardR, hR23, hwEmaxR, hsInf, hgCmax]

name: Hunter.Proved.Xk_nonempty
statement: theorem Xk_nonempty (k : ℕ) : (Xk k).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := ProofsSpine.exists_ham k
  exact ⟨F P, P, hP, rfl⟩

name: Hunter.Proved.b2_final
proof:
:=
  b2_of_gives_b2 hk (fun _X hX => prp_gives_b2_amended hk hX) (Xk_nonempty k)
    (ProofsGB2.b2Set_bddBelow k)

name: Hunter.Proved.gInner_mono
statement:
theorem gInner_mono (hk : 2 ≤ k) (r s : ℝ) (hrs : r ≤ s) :
    r * (k.factorial : ℝ) + ProofsGB2.gInner k r
      ≤ s * (k.factorial : ℝ) + ProofsGB2.gInner k s
proof:
:=
  ProofsGB2.gInner_mono hk (Xk_nonempty k) r s hrs

name: Hunter.Proved.b2_gInner
statement:
theorem b2_gInner (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    (L k : ℝ) ≥ Rk k * (k.factorial : ℝ) + ProofsGB2.gInner k (Rk k)
proof:
:= by
  have hb2 := b2_final hk
  rwa [ProofsGB2.b2Set_sInf_eq k (ProofsB2.Xk'_nonempty_of_Xk_nonempty hk (Xk_nonempty k))] at hb2

name: Hunter.Proved.red_R_tightened
statement:
theorem red_R_tightened (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (hkey : ∀ p, p ∈ Xk' k → p.numVerts ≤ k.factorial - k →
        k < p.numVerts + k ∧ HasExitlessPath k (p.numVerts + k) ∧
          ((iExitless k (p.numVerts + k) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
              (((p.numVerts + k : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ))
            ≤ (pValue p : ℝ) / (p.numVerts : ℝ))
    (hne : ∃ p, p ∈ Xk' k ∧ p.numVerts ≤ k.factorial - k) :
    Rk k ≥ sInf {q : ℝ | ∃ ℓ, k < ℓ ∧ HasExitlessPath k ℓ ∧
      q = ((iExitless k ℓ : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) / ((ℓ : ℝ) - (k : ℝ))}
proof:
:= by
  apply Hunter.Proved.red_R hkey hne
  
  refine ⟨(2 : ℝ) - (k : ℝ), ?_⟩
  rintro q ⟨ℓ, hℓ, -, rfl⟩
  have hd1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (ℓ : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) := by
    have : ((k : ℕ) + 1 : ℝ) ≤ (ℓ : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hℓ
    linarith
  have hd : (0 : ℝ) < (ℓ : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hi : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (iExitless k ℓ : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hk2 : (2 : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) ≤ 0 := by
    have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hk
    linarith
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hd]
  nlinarith [hi, hk2, hd1, mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (ℓ : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) - 1)
    (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) - 2)]

name: Hunter.Proved.proof_thm1v2_tightened
statement:
theorem proof_thm1v2_tightened (hk : 3 ≤ k)
    (hpivot : HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)))
    (hgInner_eval : ProofsGB2.gInner k
          (((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2)
            / (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)))
        = (iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ)
          - (((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2)
              / (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)))
            * ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ))
    (hRk_ge : ((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2)
          / (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)) ≤ Rk k) :
    (L k : ℝ) ≥ (iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ)
      + (((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
          (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)))
        * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ))
proof:
:=
  Hunter.Proved.proof_thm1v2 hk hpivot (ProofsGB2.gInner k)
    (b2_gInner (by omega)) (gInner_mono (by omega)) hgInner_eval hRk_ge

name: Hunter.ProofsSPrime.door_marker
statement:
theorem door_marker {x : List ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hx : IsPermWord k x) :
    (door x).getLastD 0 = (rho x).getLastD 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, t, rfl⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil (hx.ne_nil (by omega))
  obtain ⟨b, t', rfl⟩ : ∃ b t', t = b :: t' := by
    rcases t with _ | ⟨b, t'⟩
    · have := hx.length; simp at this; omega
    · exact ⟨b, t', rfl⟩
  have hdoor : door (a :: b :: t') = t' ++ [b, a] := rfl
  have hrho : rho (a :: b :: t') = (b :: t') ++ [a] := by
    show (a :: b :: t').rotate 1 = _; simp
  rw [hdoor, hrho]
  rw [show t' ++ [b, a] = (t' ++ [b]) ++ [a] by simp, List.getLastD_concat,
      show (b :: t') ++ [a] = ((b :: t') ++ [a]) by rfl, List.getLastD_concat]

name: Hunter.ProofsSPrime.door_erase_marker
statement:
theorem door_erase_marker {x : List ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hx : IsPermWord k x) :
    (door x).erase ((rho x).getLastD 0) =
      ((rho x).erase ((rho x).getLastD 0)).rotate 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, t, rfl⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil (hx.ne_nil (by omega))
  obtain ⟨b, t', rfl⟩ : ∃ b t', t = b :: t' := by
    rcases t with _ | ⟨b, t'⟩
    · have := hx.length; simp at this; omega
    · exact ⟨b, t', rfl⟩
  have hnd : (a :: b :: t').Nodup := hx.nodup
  have hrho : rho (a :: b :: t') = (b :: t') ++ [a] := by
    show (a :: b :: t').rotate 1 = _; simp
  have hmark : (rho (a :: b :: t')).getLastD 0 = a := by
    rw [hrho, show (b :: t') ++ [a] = ((b :: t') ++ [a]) by rfl, List.getLastD_concat]
  have hanbt : a ∉ (b :: t') := (List.nodup_cons.mp hnd).1
  have hrhoerase : (rho (a :: b :: t')).erase a = b :: t' := by
    rw [hrho, List.erase_append_right _ hanbt, List.erase_cons_head, List.append_nil]
  have hdoor : door (a :: b :: t') = t' ++ [b, a] := rfl
  have hantb : a ∉ (t' ++ [b]) := by
    intro h; rw [List.mem_append] at h
    rcases h with h | h
    · exact hanbt (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h)
    · simp at h; exact hanbt (h ▸ List.mem_cons_self ..)
  have hdoorerase : (door (a :: b :: t')).erase a = t' ++ [b] := by
    rw [hdoor, show t' ++ [b, a] = (t' ++ [b]) ++ [a] by simp,
        List.erase_append_right _ hantb, List.erase_cons_head, List.append_nil]
  rw [hmark, hdoorerase, hrhoerase]
  show t' ++ [b] = (b :: t').rotate 1
  simp

name: Hunter.ProofsSPrime.alpha_marker
statement:
theorem alpha_marker {x : List ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hx : IsPermWord k x) :
    (alphaWord x).getLastD 0 = (rho x).getLastD 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, t, rfl⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil (hx.ne_nil (by omega))
  obtain ⟨b, c, t'', rfl⟩ : ∃ b c t'', t = b :: c :: t'' := by
    rcases t with _ | ⟨b, _ | ⟨c, t''⟩⟩
    · have := hx.length; simp at this; omega
    · have := hx.length; simp at this; omega
    · exact ⟨b, c, t'', rfl⟩
  have halpha : alphaWord (a :: b :: c :: t'') = t'' ++ [c, b, a] := rfl
  have hrho : rho (a :: b :: c :: t'') = (b :: c :: t'') ++ [a] := by
    show (a :: b :: c :: t'').rotate 1 = _; simp
  rw [halpha, hrho]
  rw [show t'' ++ [c, b, a] = (t'' ++ [c, b]) ++ [a] by simp, List.getLastD_concat,
      show (b :: c :: t'') ++ [a] = ((b :: c :: t'') ++ [a]) by rfl, List.getLastD_concat]

name: Hunter.ProofsSPrime.alpha_erase_marker
statement:
theorem alpha_erase_marker {x : List ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hx : IsPermWord k x) :
    (alphaWord x).erase ((rho x).getLastD 0) =
      door ((rho x).erase ((rho x).getLastD 0))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, t, rfl⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil (hx.ne_nil (by omega))
  obtain ⟨b, c, t'', rfl⟩ : ∃ b c t'', t = b :: c :: t'' := by
    rcases t with _ | ⟨b, _ | ⟨c, t''⟩⟩
    · have := hx.length; simp at this; omega
    · have := hx.length; simp at this; omega
    · exact ⟨b, c, t'', rfl⟩
  have hnd : (a :: b :: c :: t'').Nodup := hx.nodup
  have hrho : rho (a :: b :: c :: t'') = (b :: c :: t'') ++ [a] := by
    show (a :: b :: c :: t'').rotate 1 = _; simp
  have hmark : (rho (a :: b :: c :: t'')).getLastD 0 = a := by
    rw [hrho, show (b :: c :: t'') ++ [a] = ((b :: c :: t'') ++ [a]) by rfl,
        List.getLastD_concat]
  have hanbct : a ∉ (b :: c :: t'') := (List.nodup_cons.mp hnd).1
  have hrhoerase : (rho (a :: b :: c :: t'')).erase a = b :: c :: t'' := by
    rw [hrho, List.erase_append_right _ hanbct, List.erase_cons_head, List.append_nil]
  have halpha : alphaWord (a :: b :: c :: t'') = t'' ++ [c, b, a] := rfl
  have hantcb : a ∉ (t'' ++ [c, b]) := by
    intro h; rw [List.mem_append] at h
    rcases h with h | h
    · exact hanbct (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h))
    · simp at h
      rcases h with h | h
      · exact hanbct (h ▸ List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_cons_self ..))
      · exact hanbct (h ▸ List.mem_cons_self ..)
  have halphaerase : (alphaWord (a :: b :: c :: t'')).erase a = t'' ++ [c, b] := by
    rw [halpha, show t'' ++ [c, b, a] = (t'' ++ [c, b]) ++ [a] by simp,
        List.erase_append_right _ hantcb, List.erase_cons_head, List.append_nil]
  rw [hmark, halphaerase, hrhoerase]
  show t'' ++ [c, b] = door (b :: c :: t'')
  rfl

name: Hunter.ProofsSPrime.mem_Vset3_iff_erase
statement:
theorem mem_Vset3_iff_erase {α₁ α₂ : ℕ} {K : RotClass} {v : Vtx k} :
    v ∈ Vset3 k α₁ α₂ K ↔ rotClass (((v : List ℕ).erase α₁).erase α₂) = K
proof:
:=
  mem_Vset3

name: Hunter.ProofsSPrime.card_le_of_mem_Vset3
statement:
theorem card_le_of_mem_Vset3 (hk : 3 ≤ k) {α₁ α₂ : ℕ} {K : RotClass} {A : Vtx k}
    (hα1 : α₁ = (A : List ℕ).getLastD 0)
    (hα2 : α₂ = ((A : List ℕ).dropLast).getLastD 0)
    (hK : K = rotClass ((A : List ℕ).dropLast.dropLast))
    (S : Finset (Vtx k)) (hmem : ∀ v ∈ S, v ∈ Vset3 k α₁ α₂ K)
    (hdisj : ∀ u ∈ S, ∀ v ∈ S, u ≠ v → rotClass (u : List ℕ) ≠ rotClass (v : List ℕ)) :
    S.card ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
  set bigU : Finset (Vtx k) := S.biUnion (fun v => cyc v) with hbigU
  have hdisj' : ∀ u ∈ S, ∀ v ∈ S, u ≠ v → Disjoint (cyc u) (cyc v) :=
    fun u hu v hv huv => cyc_disjoint (hdisj u hu v hv huv)
  have hcard : bigU.card = k * S.card := by
    rw [hbigU, Finset.card_biUnion hdisj',
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun v _ => card_cyc hk1 v), Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul,
        Nat.mul_comm]
  have hsub : bigU ⊆ Vset3 k α₁ α₂ K := by
    rw [hbigU]
    intro x hx
    rw [Finset.mem_biUnion] at hx
    obtain ⟨v, hvS, hxv⟩ := hx
    exact cyc_subset_Vset3 hk1 (hmem v hvS) hxv
  have hVle : (Vset3 k α₁ α₂ K).card ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) :=
    card_Vset3_le (A := A) hk hα1 hα2 hK
  have hle : k * S.card ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by
    rw [← hcard]; exact le_trans (Finset.card_le_card hsub) hVle
  have hle2 : k * S.card ≤ k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2)) := by rw [← Nat.mul_assoc]; exact hle
  exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left hle2 (by omega)

name: Hunter.ProofsSPrime.excessFrontier_of_deficit
statement:
theorem excessFrontier_of_deficit {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k)
    (hdef : ExcessFrontierDeficit k) : ExcessFrontier k
proof:
:= by
  intro q hqe h0
  by_cases hb : j k q.numVerts ≤
      q.numVerts + (q.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k) + (q.numVerts ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1))) - 3
  · exact excess_frontier_of_j_le_jbase hk hqe h0 hb
  · exact hdef q hqe h0 (by omega)

name: Hunter.ProofsSPrime.thm2_of_deficitFrontier
statement:
theorem thm2_of_deficitFrontier {k ℓ : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k)
    (hdef : ExcessFrontierDeficit k) (hex : HasExitlessPath k ℓ) :
    j k ℓ ≤ iExitless k ℓ
proof:
:=
  thm2_of_frontier hk (excessFrontier_of_deficit hk hdef) hex

name: Hunter.ProofsLstar.wt_le_pos_gap
statement:
theorem wt_le_pos_gap {w : List ℕ} {p q : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hpq : p < q)
    (_hq : q + k ≤ w.length) (hup : IsPermWord k ((w.drop p).take k)) :
    wt k ((w.drop p).take k) ((w.drop q).take k) ≤ q - p
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (q - p) k with hlt | hge
  · refine wt_le (by omega) (by omega) ?_
    rw [List.drop_take, List.drop_drop]
    have h1 : p + (q - p) = q := by omega
    rw [h1, List.take_take]
    congr 1
    omega
  · have := (wt_spec (u := (w.drop p).take k) (v := (w.drop q).take k) hk
      (le_of_eq hup.length)).2.1
    omega

name: Hunter.ProofsLstar.wordOf_length
statement:
theorem wordOf_length (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    ∀ (l : List (List ℕ)), l ≠ [] → (∀ x ∈ l, IsPermWord k x) →
      (wordOf k l).length = k + (List.zipWith (wt k) l l.tail).sum
proof:
| [], h, _ => absurd rfl h
  | [σ], _, hp => by
    show σ.length = k + (List.zipWith (wt k) [σ] []).sum
    rw [(hp σ (List.mem_singleton_self σ)).length]
    simp
  | σ :: τ :: rest, _, hp => by
    have ih := wordOf_length hk (τ :: rest) (by simp)
      (fun x hx => hp x (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx))
    have hσ := hp σ List.mem_cons_self
    have hwt : wt k σ τ ≤ k :=
      (wt_spec (u := σ) (v := τ) hk (le_of_eq hσ.length)).2.1
    show (σ.take (wt k σ τ) ++ wordOf k (τ :: rest)).length = _
    rw [List.length_append, List.length_take, hσ.length, Nat.min_eq_left hwt, ih]
    show wt k σ τ + (k + (List.zipWith (wt k) (τ :: rest) rest).sum)
      = k + (wt k σ τ + (List.zipWith (wt k) (τ :: rest) rest).sum)
    omega

name: Hunter.ProofsLstar.word_prefix_wordOf
statement:
theorem word_prefix_wordOf (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    ∀ (l : List (List ℕ)) (σ : List ℕ), IsPermWord k σ → (∀ x ∈ l, IsPermWord k x) →
      σ <+: wordOf k (σ :: l)
proof:
| [], σ, _, _ => ⟨[], by simp [wordOf]⟩
  | τ :: rest, σ, hσ, hl => by
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := word_prefix_wordOf hk rest τ (hl τ List.mem_cons_self)
      (fun x hx => hl x (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx))
    refine ⟨τ.drop (k - wt k σ τ) ++ t, ?_⟩
    have hover : σ.drop (wt k σ τ) = τ.take (k - wt k σ τ) :=
      (wt_spec (u := σ) (v := τ) hk (le_of_eq hσ.length)).2.2
    show σ ++ (τ.drop (k - wt k σ τ) ++ t) = σ.take (wt k σ τ) ++ wordOf k (τ :: rest)
    calc σ ++ (τ.drop (k - wt k σ τ) ++ t)
        = (σ.take (wt k σ τ) ++ σ.drop (wt k σ τ)) ++ (τ.drop (k - wt k σ τ) ++ t) := by
          rw [List.take_append_drop]
      _ = σ.take (wt k σ τ) ++ (τ.take (k - wt k σ τ) ++ (τ.drop (k - wt k σ τ) ++ t)) := by
          rw [hover, List.append_assoc]
      _ = σ.take (wt k σ τ) ++ (τ ++ t) := by
          rw [← List.append_assoc (τ.take (k - wt k σ τ)), List.take_append_drop]
      _ = σ.take (wt k σ τ) ++ wordOf k (τ :: rest) := by rw [ht]

name: Hunter.ProofsLstar.word_infix_wordOf
statement:
theorem word_infix_wordOf (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    ∀ (l : List (List ℕ)) (v : List ℕ), v ∈ l → (∀ x ∈ l, IsPermWord k x) →
      v <:+: wordOf k l
proof:
| [], v, hv, _ => absurd hv (List.not_mem_nil)
  | σ :: rest, v, hv, hl => by
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hv with rfl | hv'
    · exact (word_prefix_wordOf hk rest v (hl v List.mem_cons_self)
        (fun x hx => hl x (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx))).isInfix
    · rcases rest with _ | ⟨τ, rest'⟩
      · exact absurd hv' (List.not_mem_nil)
      · have ih := word_infix_wordOf hk (τ :: rest') v hv'
          (fun x hx => hl x (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx))
        show v <:+: σ.take (wt k σ τ) ++ wordOf k (τ :: rest')
        exact ih.trans (List.suffix_append _ _).isInfix

name: Hunter.ProofsLstar.zipWith_wt_map_val
statement:
theorem zipWith_wt_map_val : ∀ (A B : List (Vtx k)),
    List.zipWith (wt k) (A.map Subtype.val) (B.map Subtype.val) = List.zipWith (ew k) A B
proof:
| [], _ => by simp
  | _ :: _, [] => by simp
  | a :: A, b :: B => by
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.zipWith_cons_cons, ew]
    rw [zipWith_wt_map_val A B]

name: Hunter.ProofsLstar.zipWith_wt_tail_eq
statement:
theorem zipWith_wt_tail_eq (l : List (Vtx k)) :
    (List.zipWith (wt k) (l.map Subtype.val) (l.map Subtype.val).tail).sum
      = (l.zipWith (ew k) l.tail).sum
proof:
:= by
  have htail : (l.map Subtype.val).tail = l.tail.map Subtype.val := by cases l <;> rfl
  rw [htail, zipWith_wt_map_val]

name: Hunter.ProofsLstar.fpos_mem_set
statement:
theorem fpos_mem_set {w : List ℕ} (hw : IsSuperperm k w) (v : Vtx k) :
    {p | (w.drop p).take k = v.1}.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, t, hst⟩ := hw v.1 v.2
  refine ⟨s.length, ?_⟩
  have hdrop : w.drop s.length = v.1 ++ t := by
    rw [← hst, List.append_assoc, List.drop_left]
  show (w.drop s.length).take k = v.1
  rw [hdrop, List.take_left' v.2.length]

name: Hunter.ProofsLstar.fpos_spec
statement:
theorem fpos_spec {w : List ℕ} (hw : IsSuperperm k w) (v : Vtx k) :
    (w.drop (fpos w v)).take k = v.1
proof:
:=
  Nat.sInf_mem (fpos_mem_set hw v)

name: Hunter.ProofsLstar.fpos_bound
statement:
theorem fpos_bound {w : List ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hw : IsSuperperm k w) (v : Vtx k) :
    fpos w v + k ≤ w.length
proof:
:= by
  have h := fpos_spec hw v
  have hlen : ((w.drop (fpos w v)).take k).length = k := by rw [h]; exact v.2.length
  rw [List.length_take, List.length_drop] at hlen
  have h2 : k ≤ w.length - fpos w v := min_eq_left_iff.mp hlen
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsLstar.fpos_injective
statement:
theorem fpos_injective {w : List ℕ} (hw : IsSuperperm k w) :
    Function.Injective (fpos (k := k) w)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  apply Subtype.ext
  have ha := fpos_spec hw a
  have hb := fpos_spec hw b
  rw [← ha, ← hb, hab]

name: Hunter.ProofsLstar.tele
statement:
theorem tele (w : List ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    ∀ (a : Vtx k) (rest : List (Vtx k)),
      (a :: rest).Pairwise (fun x y => fpos w x < fpos w y) →
      (∀ v ∈ a :: rest, (w.drop (fpos w v)).take k = v.1) →
      (∀ v ∈ a :: rest, fpos w v + k ≤ w.length) →
      ((a :: rest).zipWith (ew k) rest).sum + fpos w a
        ≤ fpos w ((a :: rest).getLast (List.cons_ne_nil a rest))
proof:
:= by
  intro a rest
  induction rest generalizing a with
  | nil =>
    intro _ _ _
    simp
  | cons y rest' ih =>
    intro hpw hwin hbd
    have hpc := List.pairwise_cons.mp hpw
    have hay : fpos w a < fpos w y := hpc.1 y List.mem_cons_self
    have IH := ih y hpc.2
      (fun v hv => hwin v (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hv))
      (fun v hv => hbd v (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hv))
    have hgap : ew k a y ≤ fpos w y - fpos w a := by
      have h1 := wt_le_pos_gap (w := w) hk hay (hbd y (List.mem_cons_of_mem a List.mem_cons_self))
        (by rw [hwin a List.mem_cons_self]; exact a.2)
      rwa [hwin a List.mem_cons_self, hwin y (List.mem_cons_of_mem a List.mem_cons_self)] at h1
    have hgl : (a :: y :: rest').getLast (List.cons_ne_nil _ _)
             = (y :: rest').getLast (List.cons_ne_nil _ _) := List.getLast_cons _
    rw [hgl]
    simp only [List.zipWith_cons_cons, List.sum_cons]
    omega

name: Hunter.ProofsLstar.dirA
statement: theorem dirA {w : List ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hw : IsSuperperm k w) : L k + k ≤ w.length
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fpos w) := fpos_injective hw
  letI : DecidableRel (fun a b : Vtx k => fpos w a ≤ fpos w b) := fun a b => Nat.decLe _ _
  haveI : IsTrans (Vtx k) (fun a b : Vtx k => fpos w a ≤ fpos w b) :=
    ⟨fun a b c hab hbc => le_trans hab hbc⟩
  haveI : Std.Antisymm (fun a b : Vtx k => fpos w a ≤ fpos w b) :=
    ⟨fun a b h1 h2 => hinj (le_antisymm h1 h2)⟩
  haveI : Std.Total (fun a b : Vtx k => fpos w a ≤ fpos w b) := ⟨fun a b => le_total _ _⟩
  set xs := Finset.univ.sort (fun a b : Vtx k => fpos w a ≤ fpos w b) with hxs
  have hnd : xs.Nodup := Finset.sort_nodup _ _
  have hmem : ∀ v : Vtx k, v ∈ xs := fun v => (Finset.mem_sort _).mpr (Finset.mem_univ v)
  have hle : xs.Pairwise (fun a b : Vtx k => fpos w a ≤ fpos w b) := Finset.pairwise_sort _ _
  have hstrict : xs.Pairwise (fun a b : Vtx k => fpos w a < fpos w b) :=
    hle.imp₂ (fun a b h1 h2 => lt_of_le_of_ne h1 (fun he => h2 (hinj he))) hnd
  have hxne : xs ≠ [] := by
    obtain ⟨v⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty (Vtx k))
    exact List.ne_nil_of_mem (hmem v)
  obtain ⟨a, rest, hcons⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil hxne
  
  set P : HPath k := ⟨xs, hxne, hnd⟩ with hP
  have hHam : P.IsHamiltonian := hmem
  
  have hpw : (a :: rest).Pairwise (fun x y => fpos w x < fpos w y) := hcons ▸ hstrict
  have hwin : ∀ v ∈ a :: rest, (w.drop (fpos w v)).take k = v.1 :=
    fun v _ => fpos_spec hw v
  have hbd : ∀ v ∈ a :: rest, fpos w v + k ≤ w.length := fun v _ => fpos_bound hk hw v
  have htel := tele w hk a rest hpw hwin hbd
  have hgl_bd := fpos_bound hk hw ((a :: rest).getLast (List.cons_ne_nil a rest))
  
  have hwtP : P.wtP = ((a :: rest).zipWith (ew k) rest).sum := by
    show (xs.zipWith (ew k) xs.tail).sum = _
    rw [hcons]; rfl
  have hPle : P.wtP + k ≤ w.length := by
    rw [hwtP]; omega
  have hLle : L k ≤ P.wtP := Nat.sInf_le ⟨P, hHam, rfl⟩
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsLstar.exists_superperm_of_ham
statement:
theorem exists_superperm_of_ham (hk : 1 ≤ k) {P : HPath k} (hHam : P.IsHamiltonian) :
    IsSuperperm k (wordOf k (P.verts.map Subtype.val)) ∧
      (wordOf k (P.verts.map Subtype.val)).length = P.wtP + k
proof:
:= by
  set l := P.verts.map Subtype.val with hl
  have hlne : l ≠ [] := by rw [hl, Ne, List.map_eq_nil_iff]; exact P.ne
  have hlperm : ∀ x ∈ l, IsPermWord k x := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨v, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
    exact v.2
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro u hu
    have hmem : u ∈ l := by
      rw [hl, List.mem_map]
      exact ⟨⟨u, hu⟩, hHam ⟨u, hu⟩, rfl⟩
    exact word_infix_wordOf hk l u hmem hlperm
  · rw [wordOf_length hk l hlne hlperm, hl, zipWith_wt_tail_eq]
    show k + P.wtP = P.wtP + k
    omega

name: Hunter.ProofsLstar.exists_ham
statement: theorem exists_ham : ∃ P : HPath k, P.IsHamiltonian
proof:
:= by
  have hne : (Finset.univ : Finset (Vtx k)).toList ≠ [] := by
    have : 0 < (Finset.univ : Finset (Vtx k)).toList.length := by
      rw [Finset.length_toList]; exact Finset.univ_nonempty.card_pos
    exact List.ne_nil_of_length_pos this
  exact ⟨⟨Finset.univ.toList, hne, Finset.nodup_toList _⟩,
    fun v => Finset.mem_toList.mpr (Finset.mem_univ v)⟩

name: Hunter.Proved.bridge_Lstar_eq_Ssuper
statement: theorem bridge_Lstar_eq_Ssuper {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) : Lstar k = Ssuper k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨P₀, hP₀⟩ := (ProofsLstar.exists_ham : ∃ P : HPath k, P.IsHamiltonian)
  obtain ⟨hsuper₀, hlen₀⟩ := exists_superperm_of_ham hk hP₀
  
  have hLne : {m | ∃ P : HPath k, P.IsHamiltonian ∧ P.wtP = m}.Nonempty :=
    ⟨P₀.wtP, P₀, hP₀, rfl⟩
  have hSne : {m | ∃ v : List ℕ, IsSuperperm k v ∧ v.length = m}.Nonempty :=
    ⟨_, _, hsuper₀, rfl⟩
  apply le_antisymm
  · 
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hvlen⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem hSne
    show L k + k ≤ Ssuper k
    calc L k + k ≤ v.length := dirA hk hv
      _ = Ssuper k := hvlen
  · 
    obtain ⟨P, hP, hPwt⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem hLne
    obtain ⟨hsuper, hlen⟩ := exists_superperm_of_ham hk hP
    show Ssuper k ≤ L k + k
    have hSle : Ssuper k ≤ (wordOf k (P.verts.map Subtype.val)).length :=
      Nat.sInf_le ⟨_, hsuper, rfl⟩
    rw [hlen] at hSle
    
    have : P.wtP = L k := hPwt
    omega

name: Hunter.ProofsPu.cd_mul
statement: theorem cd_mul (n d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) : d * (n ⌈/⌉ d) = n + (d - n % d) % d
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, r, hr, rfl⟩ : ∃ q r, r < d ∧ n = d * q + r :=
    ⟨n / d, n % d, Nat.mod_lt n hd, (Nat.div_add_mod n d).symm⟩
  have hmod : (d * q + r) % d = r := by rw [Nat.mul_add_mod]; exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hr
  rw [hmod]
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos r with h0 | hpos
  · subst h0
    rw [Nat.add_zero, Nat.sub_zero, Nat.mod_self, Nat.add_zero,
      ProofsReductions.cd_exact d q hd]
  · have hsub : (d - r) % d = d - r := Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)
    rw [hsub]
    have hcd : (d * q + r) ⌈/⌉ d = q + 1 := by
      rw [Nat.ceilDiv_eq_add_pred_div,
        show d * q + r + d - 1 = d * (q + 1) + (r - 1) from by
          rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one]; omega,
        Nat.mul_add_div hd, Nat.div_eq_of_lt (by omega : r - 1 < d), Nat.add_zero]
    rw [hcd, Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one]; omega

name: Hunter.ProofsPu.cd_mid
statement:
theorem cd_mid (D Q s : ℕ) (hD : 0 < D) (hs0 : 0 < s) (hs : s < D) :
    (D * Q + s) ⌈/⌉ D = Q + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.ceilDiv_eq_add_pred_div,
    show D * Q + s + D - 1 = D * (Q + 1) + (s - 1) from by rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one]; omega,
    Nat.mul_add_div hD, Nat.div_eq_of_lt (by omega : s - 1 < D), Nat.add_zero]

name: Hunter.ProofsPu.ell0_factor
statement: theorem ell0_factor {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) : ell0 k = k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, k = m + 3 := ⟨k - 3, by omega⟩
  simp only [ell0, show m + 3 - 1 = m + 2 from by omega, show m + 3 - 2 = m + 1 from by omega]
  have ha : (m + 2) * (m + 1) = m * m + 3 * m + 2 := by ring
  rw [ha, show m * m + 3 * m + 2 - 1 = m * m + 3 * m + 1 from by omega]
  have hb : (m + 3) * (m + 2) * (m + 1) = (m + 3) * (m * m + 3 * m + 1) + (m + 3) := by ring
  rw [hb]; omega

name: Hunter.ProofsPu.cd_ell0_k
statement: theorem cd_ell0_k {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) : (ell0 k) ⌈/⌉ k = (k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [ell0_factor hk]; exact ProofsReductions.cd_exact k _ (by omega)

name: Hunter.ProofsPu.cd_ell0_kk
statement: theorem cd_ell0_kk {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) : (ell0 k) ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1)) = k - 2
proof:
:= by
  have hrepr : ell0 k = (k * (k - 1)) * (k - 3) + k * (k - 2) := by
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, k = m + 3 := ⟨k - 3, by omega⟩
    simp only [ell0, show m + 3 - 1 = m + 2 from by omega, show m + 3 - 2 = m + 1 from by omega,
      show m + 3 - 3 = m from by omega]
    have e : (m + 3) * (m + 2) * (m + 1)
        = (m + 3) * (m + 2) * m + (m + 3) * (m + 1) + (m + 3) := by ring
    omega
  rw [hrepr]
  have h := cd_mid (k * (k - 1)) (k - 3) (k * (k - 2))
    (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)) (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega))
    (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (by omega : k - 2 < k - 1) (by omega : 0 < k))
  rw [h]; omega

name: Hunter.ProofsPu.jell0_real
proof:
:= by
  have hbase : j k (ell0 k) = ell0 k + (ell0 k) ⌈/⌉ k + (ell0 k) ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1)) - 3 :=
    j_base (Or.inl (by rw [ell0_eq]; exact Nat.sub_le _ _))
  rw [cd_ell0_k hk, cd_ell0_kk hk] at hbase
  have hb1 : 1 ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2) := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)
  have hb1' : 2 ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by
    have := Nat.mul_le_mul (show 2 ≤ k - 1 by omega) (show 1 ≤ k - 2 by omega); omega
  have hb2 : k ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) :=
    le_trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right k (by omega))
      (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by omega))
  have hp : 2 * k ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by
    calc 2 * k = k * 2 := by ring
      _ ≤ k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2)) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left k hb1'
      _ = k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by rw [mul_assoc]
  have hell0_ge : 3 ≤ ell0 k := by rw [ell0_eq]; omega
  have hb3 : 3 ≤ ell0 k + ((k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1) + (k - 2) := le_trans hell0_ge (by omega)
  rw [hbase, Nat.cast_sub hb3]
  push_cast [ell0_eq, Nat.cast_sub hb2, Nat.cast_sub hb1,
    Nat.cast_sub (show 1 ≤ k from by omega), Nat.cast_sub (show 2 ≤ k from by omega)]
  ring

name: Hunter.ProofsPu.cd_frac
statement:
theorem cd_frac (n d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) :
    ((n ⌈/⌉ d : ℕ) : ℝ) = ((n : ℝ) + (((d - n % d) % d : ℕ) : ℝ)) / (d : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hdne : (d : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  rw [eq_div_iff hdne]
  have h := cd_mul n d hd
  have hr : ((d * (n ⌈/⌉ d) : ℕ) : ℝ) = ((n + (d - n % d) % d : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h
  push_cast at hr
  rw [mul_comm]; linarith [hr]

name: Hunter.ProofsPu.orbitList_length
statement: theorem orbitList_length (w : Vtx k) : (orbitList w).length = k
proof:
:= by
  simp [orbitList]

name: Hunter.ProofsPu.orbitList_getElem
statement:
theorem orbitList_getElem (w : Vtx k) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < (orbitList w).length) :
    (orbitList w)[i] = sigma^[i] w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [orbitList, List.getElem_map, List.getElem_range]

name: Hunter.ProofsPu.orbitList_nodup
statement: theorem orbitList_nodup (_hk : 1 ≤ k) (w : Vtx k) : (orbitList w).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  apply List.Nodup.map_on _ List.nodup_range
  intro i hi j hj hij
  rw [List.mem_range] at hi hj
  exact ProofsExitless.sigma_iter_inj w hi hj hij

name: Hunter.ProofsPu.mem_orbitList
statement: theorem mem_orbitList {w x : Vtx k} (hx : x ∈ orbitList w) : ∃ i < k, x = sigma^[i] w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [orbitList, List.mem_map, List.mem_range] at hx
  obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := hx; exact ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsPu.pu_exists_with_verts
statement:
theorem pu_exists_with_verts (hk : 2 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hSE : p.StronglyExitless)
    {u : Vtx k} (hu : u ∉ p.verts) (hmin : ew k u p.first = minto p) :
    ∃ q : HPath k, q.verts = orbitList (sigma u) ++ p.verts ∧
      q.Exitless ∧ q.numVerts = p.numVerts + k ∧
      q.wtP = (k - 1) + minto p + p.wtP
proof:
:= by
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
  set N := p.numVerts with hNdef
  have hpe : p.Exitless := hSE.1
  have huoc : p.IsUnionOfCycles := Proved.clm_1cyclesubset hSE
  
  have hrc : ∀ i, rotClass ((sigma^[i] (sigma u)).1) = rotClass u.1 := fun i => by
    rw [ProofsExitless.rotClass_sigma_iter i (sigma u), ProofsStructure.rotClass_sigma u]
  
  have hpin : ∀ x : Vtx k, x ∈ p.verts → x ∉ orbitList (sigma u) := by
    intro x hx hxo
    obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := mem_orbitList hxo
    have hcyc : u ∈ cyc (sigma^[i] (sigma u)) := ProofsExitless.mem_cyc.mpr (hrc i).symm
    exact hu (HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mp (huoc _ hx hcyc))
  
  have hnodup : (orbitList (sigma u) ++ p.verts).Nodup := by
    rw [List.nodup_append]
    refine ⟨orbitList_nodup hk1 (sigma u), p.nodup, ?_⟩
    intro a ha b hb heq
    exact hpin b hb (heq ▸ ha)
  have hne : orbitList (sigma u) ++ p.verts ≠ [] := by
    simp only [ne_eq, List.append_eq_nil_iff, not_and]; intro _; exact p.ne
  set q : HPath k := ⟨orbitList (sigma u) ++ p.verts, hne, hnodup⟩ with hqdef
  have hqverts : q.verts = orbitList (sigma u) ++ p.verts := rfl
  have hpvl : p.verts.length = N := rfl
  have hqnv : q.numVerts = p.numVerts + k := by
    show (orbitList (sigma u) ++ p.verts).length = p.numVerts + k
    rw [List.length_append, orbitList_length, hpvl]; omega
  
  have hvo : ∀ i, i < k → q.vert i = sigma^[i] (sigma u) := by
    intro i hi
    have hi' : i < (orbitList (sigma u)).length := by rw [orbitList_length]; exact hi
    have hval : q.vert i = (orbitList (sigma u) ++ p.verts)[i]'(by
        rw [List.length_append]; omega) := by
      rw [ProofsExitless.vert_getElem q (by rw [hqnv]; omega)]; rfl
    rw [hval, List.getElem_append_left hi', orbitList_getElem (sigma u) hi']
  have hvp : ∀ t, t < N → q.vert (k + t) = p.vert t := by
    intro t ht
    have hlen : (orbitList (sigma u)).length ≤ k + t := by rw [orbitList_length]; omega
    have hval : q.vert (k + t) = (orbitList (sigma u) ++ p.verts)[k + t]'(by
        rw [List.length_append, orbitList_length, hpvl]; omega) := by
      rw [ProofsExitless.vert_getElem q (by rw [hqnv]; omega)]; rfl
    rw [hval, List.getElem_append_right hlen,
      ProofsExitless.vert_getElem p (show t < p.numVerts from ht)]
    congr 1
    rw [orbitList_length]; omega
  
  have hpos : ∀ v : Vtx k, v ∈ p.verts → q.pos v = k + p.pos v := by
    intro v hv
    show (orbitList (sigma u) ++ p.verts).idxOf v = k + p.verts.idxOf v
    rw [List.idxOf_append_of_notMem (hpin v hv), orbitList_length]
  
  have hlast : sigma^[k - 1] (sigma u) = u := by
    have h1 : sigma u = sigma^[1] u := by rw [Function.iterate_one]
    rw [h1, ← Function.iterate_add_apply sigma (k - 1) 1 u, show k - 1 + 1 = k from by omega,
      ProofsExitless.sigma_iter_period u]
  
  refine ⟨q, hqverts, ?_, hqnv, ?_⟩
  · 
    rw [HPath.Exitless]
    rintro ⟨i, hi1, hw, hlt⟩
    rw [hqnv] at hi1
    rcases lt_trichotomy (i + 1) k with hc1 | hc2 | hc3
    · 
      have hik : i < k := by omega
      have hik1 : i + 1 < k := hc1
      rw [hvo i hik, hvo (i + 1) hik1,
        show sigma^[i + 1] (sigma u) = sigma (sigma^[i] (sigma u)) from
          (Function.iterate_succ_apply' sigma i (sigma u)),
        ew_sigma hk1] at hw
      omega
    · 
      have hik : i < k := by omega
      have hiv : q.vert i = u := by
        rw [hvo i hik, show i = k - 1 from by omega, hlast]
      have hs : sigma (q.vert i) = q.vert 0 := by
        rw [hiv, hvo 0 hk1]; simp [Function.iterate_zero]
      rw [hs, ProofsExitless.pos_vert q (by rw [hqnv]; omega)] at hlt
      omega
    · 
      obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ : ∃ t, i = k + t := ⟨i - k, by omega⟩
      have htN : t + 1 < N := by omega
      have htN' : t < N := by omega
      rw [hvp t htN', show k + t + 1 = k + (t + 1) from by ring, hvp (t + 1) htN] at hw
      
      have hpvt : p.vert t ∈ p.verts := ProofsExitless.vert_mem p htN'
      have hsv : sigma (p.vert t) ∈ p.verts := by
        have hcyc : sigma (p.vert t) ∈ cyc (p.vert t) :=
          ProofsExitless.mem_cyc.mpr (ProofsStructure.rotClass_sigma (p.vert t))
        exact HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mp (huoc _ hpvt hcyc)
      rcases ProofsExitless.exitless_step hk1 hpe htN with heq | hle
      · rw [heq, ew_sigma hk1] at hw; omega
      · have hqs : sigma (q.vert (k + t)) = sigma (p.vert t) := by rw [hvp t htN']
        rw [hqs, hpos _ hsv] at hlt
        omega
  · 
    rw [Proved.wtP_eq_sum q, hqnv]
    
    have hsplit : Finset.range (p.numVerts + k - 1)
        = Finset.range k ∪ Finset.Ico k (p.numVerts + k - 1) := by
      rw [Finset.range_eq_Ico, Finset.range_eq_Ico,
        Finset.Ico_union_Ico_eq_Ico (Nat.zero_le k) (by have := p.numVerts_pos; omega)]
    have hdisj : Disjoint (Finset.range k) (Finset.Ico k (p.numVerts + k - 1)) := by
      rw [Finset.range_eq_Ico]; exact Finset.Ico_disjoint_Ico_consecutive 0 k _
    rw [hsplit, Finset.sum_union hdisj]
    
    have hpart1 : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, ew k (q.vert i) (q.vert (i + 1))
        = (k - 1) + minto p := by
      have hrange : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, ew k (q.vert i) (q.vert (i + 1))
          = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ((k - 1) + 1), ew k (q.vert i) (q.vert (i + 1)) := by
        rw [show (k - 1) + 1 = k from by omega]
      rw [hrange, Finset.sum_range_succ]
      have horbstep : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (k - 1), ew k (q.vert i) (q.vert (i + 1)) = 1 := by
        intro i hi
        rw [Finset.mem_range] at hi
        have hik : i < k := by omega
        have hik1 : i + 1 < k := by omega
        rw [hvo i hik, hvo (i + 1) hik1,
          show sigma^[i + 1] (sigma u) = sigma (sigma^[i] (sigma u)) from
            (Function.iterate_succ_apply' sigma i (sigma u)), ew_sigma hk1]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl horbstep, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, smul_eq_mul,
        mul_one]
      
      have hjunc : ew k (q.vert (k - 1)) (q.vert (k - 1 + 1)) = minto p := by
        have h1 : q.vert (k - 1) = u := by rw [hvo (k - 1) (by omega), hlast]
        have h2 : q.vert (k - 1 + 1) = p.first := by
          rw [show k - 1 + 1 = k + 0 from by omega, hvp 0 p.numVerts_pos, HPath.vert_zero]
        rw [h1, h2, hmin]
      rw [hjunc]
    
    have hpart2 : ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico k (p.numVerts + k - 1), ew k (q.vert i) (q.vert (i + 1))
        = p.wtP := by
      rw [Finset.sum_Ico_eq_sum_range]
      rw [show p.numVerts + k - 1 - k = p.numVerts - 1 from by omega]
      rw [Proved.wtP_eq_sum p]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro t ht
      rw [Finset.mem_range] at ht
      have htN' : t < N := by omega
      have htN : t + 1 < N := by omega  
      rw [hvp t htN', show k + t + 1 = k + (t + 1) from by ring, hvp (t + 1) htN]
    rw [hpart1, hpart2]

name: Hunter.ProofsPu.pu_exists
statement:
theorem pu_exists (hk : 2 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hSE : p.StronglyExitless)
    {u : Vtx k} (hu : u ∉ p.verts) (hmin : ew k u p.first = minto p) :
    ∃ q : HPath k, q.Exitless ∧ q.numVerts = p.numVerts + k ∧
      q.wtP = (k - 1) + minto p + p.wtP
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, _hqverts, hqExitless, hqNumVerts, hqWeight⟩ :=
    pu_exists_with_verts hk hSE hu hmin
  exact ⟨q, hqExitless, hqNumVerts, hqWeight⟩

name: Hunter.Proved.pu_key
statement:
theorem pu_key (hk : 2 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p ∈ Xk' k)
    (hle : p.numVerts ≤ k.factorial - k) :
    k < p.numVerts + k ∧ HasExitlessPath k (p.numVerts + k) ∧
      ((iExitless k (p.numVerts + k) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
          (((p.numVerts + k : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ))
        ≤ (pValue p : ℝ) / (p.numVerts : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hSE : p.StronglyExitless := ProofsB2.Xkcomps_subset hk hp
  
  have hlt : p.numVerts < Fintype.card (Vtx k) := by
    rw [ProofsRecursion.card_Vtx]
    have h1 := Nat.factorial_pos k
    have h2 := p.numVerts_pos
    omega
  have hex : ∃ v : Vtx k, v ∉ p.verts := by
    by_contra h; push Not at h
    have hham : p.IsHamiltonian := h
    rw [HPath.numVerts_eq_card_of_hamiltonian hham] at hlt
    omega
  
  have hne0 : {d | ∃ v : Vtx k, v ∉ p.verts ∧ ew k v p.first = d}.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hex; exact ⟨ew k v p.first, v, hv, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hew⟩ : ∃ u : Vtx k, u ∉ p.verts ∧ ew k u p.first = p.minto :=
    Nat.sInf_mem hne0
  obtain ⟨q, hqe, hqnv, hqw⟩ := pu_exists hk hSE hu hew
  have hnat : iExitless k (p.numVerts + k) + 2 ≤ pValue p + k := by
    have hile : iExitless k (p.numVerts + k) ≤ q.wtP := Nat.sInf_le ⟨q, hqe, hqnv, rfl⟩
    rw [hqw] at hile
    simp only [pValue]
    omega
  have hnvpos : (0 : ℝ) < (p.numVerts : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast p.numVerts_pos
  refine ⟨by have := p.numVerts_pos; omega, ⟨q, hqe, hqnv⟩, ?_⟩
  have hden : ((p.numVerts + k : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) = (p.numVerts : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
  have hnum : (iExitless k (p.numVerts + k) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2 ≤ (pValue p : ℝ) := by
    have : (iExitless k (p.numVerts + k) : ℝ) + 2 ≤ (pValue p : ℝ) + (k : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hnat
    linarith
  rw [hden, div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hnvpos]
  exact hnum

name: Hunter.Proved.red_R_final
statement:
theorem red_R_final (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (hne : ∃ p, p ∈ Xk' k ∧ p.numVerts ≤ k.factorial - k) :
    Rk k ≥ sInf {q : ℝ | ∃ ℓ, k < ℓ ∧ HasExitlessPath k ℓ ∧
      q = ((iExitless k ℓ : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) / ((ℓ : ℝ) - (k : ℝ))}
proof:
:=
  red_R_tightened hk (fun _p hp hle => pu_key hk hp hle) hne

name: Hunter.Proved.subprob1_comp
proof:
:= by
  set A := ℓ - t * ell0 k with hAdef
  have hk3 : (3 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hkne : (k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hk1ne : (k : ℝ) - 1 ≠ 0 := by nlinarith
  have hℓkpos : (0 : ℝ) < (ℓ : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) := by
    have : (k : ℝ) < (ℓ : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hklt
    linarith
  have hℓkne : (ℓ : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hℓkpos
  have hkkne : (k : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) - 1) ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hkne hk1ne
  
  have hjA_nat : j k A = A + A ⌈/⌉ k + A ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1)) - 3 := j_base (Or.inl hℓ'2)
  have h3A : 3 ≤ A + A ⌈/⌉ k + A ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1)) := by omega
  have hjAR : (j k A : ℝ)
      = (A : ℝ) + ((A ⌈/⌉ k : ℕ) : ℝ) + ((A ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1)) : ℕ) : ℝ) - 3 := by
    rw [hjA_nat, Nat.cast_sub h3A]; push_cast; ring
  have hcastkk : ((k * (k - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) = (k : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) - 1) := by
    push_cast [Nat.cast_sub (show 1 ≤ k by omega)]; ring
  rw [cd_frac A k (by omega), cd_frac A (k * (k - 1)) (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)),
    hcastkk] at hjAR
  
  have hjkl : (j k ℓ : ℝ) = (t : ℝ) * ((j k (ell0 k) : ℝ) + 3) + (j k A : ℝ) := by
    have h := congrArg (Nat.cast : ℕ → ℝ) hjrec; push_cast at h; linarith [h]
  have hcastell0 : (ell0 k : ℝ) = (k : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) - 1) * ((k : ℝ) - 2) - (k : ℝ) := by
    rw [ell0_eq, Nat.cast_sub (le_trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right k (by omega))
      (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by omega))), ProofsReductions.castP (by omega)]
  have hcastA : (A : ℝ) = (ℓ : ℝ) - (t : ℝ) * (ell0 k : ℝ) := by
    rw [hAdef, Nat.cast_sub hle]; push_cast; ring
  rw [hjAR, jell0_real hk, hcastA, hcastell0] at hjkl
  rw [hjkl]
  field_simp
  ring

name: Hunter.ProofsProfile.bw_ge_two_in_window
statement:
lemma bw_ge_two_in_window {m : ℕ} {p : HPath (m + 4)} (hp : p.Exitless)
    (hN : (m + 4) * ((m + 3) * (m + 2)) < p.numVerts)
    {t : ℕ} (ht1 : 1 ≤ t) (htM : t ≤ ((m + 3) * (m + 2)) - 1) :
    2 ≤ bw p t
proof:
:= by
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ m + 4 := by omega
  
  have htN : t < (m + 3) * (m + 2) := by
    have hNpos : 1 ≤ (m + 3) * (m + 2) := by nlinarith
    omega
  have htlt : (m + 4) * t < p.numVerts :=
    lt_trans (Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left htN (by omega)) hN
  have hkt : 1 ≤ (m + 4) * t := by
    calc 1 ≤ (m + 4) * 1 := by omega
      _ ≤ (m + 4) * t := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ ht1
  have hkt1 : (m + 4) * t - 1 + 1 = (m + 4) * t := by omega
  have hin : ((m + 4) * t - 1) + 1 < p.numVerts := by rw [hkt1]; exact htlt
  have hd : (m + 4) ∣ (((m + 4) * t - 1) + 1) := by rw [hkt1]; exact ⟨t, rfl⟩
  have hge2 := ProofsWindow.boundary_ge_two hk1 hp hin hd
  rw [hkt1] at hge2
  
  show 2 ≤ ew (m + 4) (p.vert ((m + 4) * t - 1)) (p.vert ((m + 4) * t))
  exact hge2

name: Hunter.ProofsProfile.positive_boundary_count_ge
statement:
lemma positive_boundary_count_ge {m : ℕ} {p : HPath (m + 4)} (hp : p.Exitless)
    (hN : (m + 4) * ((m + 3) * (m + 2)) < p.numVerts) :
    m + 1 ≤ ((Finset.Icc 1 (((m + 3) * (m + 2)) - 1)).filter
        (fun t => 3 ≤ bw p t)).card
proof:
:= by
  have hk3 : 3 ≤ m + 4 := by omega
  have hNpos : 1 ≤ (m + 3) * (m + 2) := by nlinarith
  have hMlt : (m + 4) * (0 + (((m + 3) * (m + 2)) - 1)) < p.numVerts := by
    have hlt : (0 + (((m + 3) * (m + 2)) - 1)) < (m + 3) * (m + 2) := by omega
    exact lt_trans (Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hlt (by omega)) hN
  have hcount := ProofsMeta6.window_heavy_count hk3 hp 0 (((m + 3) * (m + 2)) - 1) hMlt
  have hceil : (((m + 3) * (m + 2)) - 1) ⌈/⌉ (m + 4 - 1) - 1 = m + 1 := by
    have hw := ProofsMeta6.windowM_ceilDiv (k := m + 4) hk3
    have e1 : m + 4 - 1 = m + 3 := by omega
    have e2 : m + 4 - 2 = m + 2 := by omega
    rw [e1, e2] at hw
    rw [e1, hw]
    omega
  rw [hceil] at hcount
  
  have hfe : ((Finset.Icc 1 (((m + 3) * (m + 2)) - 1)).filter
        (fun j => 3 ≤ ew (m + 4) (p.vert ((m + 4) * (0 + j) - 1)) (p.vert ((m + 4) * (0 + j))))).card
      = ((Finset.Icc 1 (((m + 3) * (m + 2)) - 1)).filter (fun t => 3 ≤ bw p t)).card := by
    congr 1
    apply Finset.filter_congr
    intro t _
    simp only [Nat.zero_add, ProofsLedger.bw]
  rw [hfe] at hcount
  exact hcount

name: Hunter.ProofsProfile.positive_boundary_count_le_sum
statement:
lemma positive_boundary_count_le_sum {m : ℕ} {p : HPath (m + 4)} (_hp : p.Exitless)
    (_hN : (m + 4) * ((m + 3) * (m + 2)) < p.numVerts) :
    ((Finset.Icc 1 (((m + 3) * (m + 2)) - 1)).filter (fun t => 3 ≤ bw p t)).card
      ≤ (Finset.Icc 1 (((m + 3) * (m + 2)) - 1)).sum (fun t => bw p t - 2)
proof:
:= by
  set R := Finset.Icc 1 (((m + 3) * (m + 2)) - 1) with hR
  set S := R.filter (fun t => 3 ≤ bw p t) with hS
  calc S.card = ∑ _t ∈ S, 1 := by rw [Finset.card_eq_sum_ones]
    _ ≤ ∑ t ∈ S, (bw p t - 2) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro t ht
        rw [hS, Finset.mem_filter] at ht
        omega
    _ ≤ ∑ t ∈ R, (bw p t - 2) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
        intro t _ _; exact Nat.zero_le _

name: Hunter.ProofsProfile.positive_boundary_count_eq
statement:
lemma positive_boundary_count_eq {m : ℕ} {p : HPath (m + 4)} (hp : p.Exitless)
    (hN : (m + 4) * ((m + 3) * (m + 2)) < p.numVerts)
    (hlow : (Finset.Icc 1 (((m + 3) * (m + 2)) - 1)).sum (fun t => bw p t - 2) ≤ m + 1) :
    ((Finset.Icc 1 (((m + 3) * (m + 2)) - 1)).filter (fun t => 3 ≤ bw p t)).card = m + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hge := positive_boundary_count_ge hp hN
  have hle := positive_boundary_count_le_sum hp hN
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsProfile.boundary_weights_exact
statement:
lemma boundary_weights_exact {m : ℕ} {p : HPath (m + 4)} (hp : p.Exitless)
    (hN : (m + 4) * ((m + 3) * (m + 2)) < p.numVerts)
    (hlow : (Finset.Icc 1 (((m + 3) * (m + 2)) - 1)).sum (fun t => bw p t - 2) ≤ m + 1) :
    (∀ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (((m + 3) * (m + 2)) - 1), 3 ≤ bw p t → bw p t = 3) ∧
    (∀ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (((m + 3) * (m + 2)) - 1), ¬ 3 ≤ bw p t → bw p t = 2)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hpart2 : ∀ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (((m + 3) * (m + 2)) - 1), ¬ 3 ≤ bw p t → bw p t = 2 := by
    intro t htR hnh
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at htR
    have := bw_ge_two_in_window hp hN htR.1 htR.2
    omega
  refine ⟨?_, hpart2⟩
  
  have hsub : (((Finset.Icc 1 (((m + 3) * (m + 2)) - 1)).filter (fun t => 3 ≤ bw p t)).sum
        (fun t => bw p t - 2))
      = (Finset.Icc 1 (((m + 3) * (m + 2)) - 1)).sum (fun t => bw p t - 2) := by
    apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
    intro t htR htnS
    have hnh : ¬ 3 ≤ bw p t := fun hh => htnS (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨htR, hh⟩)
    have := hpart2 t htR hnh
    omega
  
  have hge := positive_boundary_count_ge hp hN
  have hle := positive_boundary_count_le_sum hp hN
  have hcard := positive_boundary_count_eq hp hN hlow
  
  have hge' : ∀ t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 (((m + 3) * (m + 2)) - 1)).filter (fun t => 3 ≤ bw p t),
      (1 : ℕ) ≤ bw p t - 2 := by
    intro t ht; rw [Finset.mem_filter] at ht; omega
  have hSsum : ((Finset.Icc 1 (((m + 3) * (m + 2)) - 1)).filter (fun t => 3 ≤ bw p t)).sum
        (fun _ => (1 : ℕ))
      = ((Finset.Icc 1 (((m + 3) * (m + 2)) - 1)).filter (fun t => 3 ≤ bw p t)).sum
        (fun t => bw p t - 2) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul, Nat.mul_one, hcard, hsub]
    omega
  have hforce := (Finset.sum_eq_sum_iff_of_le hge').mp hSsum
  intro t htR hh
  have htS : t ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 (((m + 3) * (m + 2)) - 1)).filter (fun t => 3 ≤ bw p t) :=
    Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨htR, hh⟩
  have := hforce t htS
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsProfile.door_run_length_cap
statement:
lemma door_run_length_cap {m : ℕ} {p : HPath (m + 4)} (hp : p.Exitless)
    (hN : (m + 4) * ((m + 3) * (m + 2)) < p.numVerts)
    {a L : ℕ} (hLast : a + L ≤ (m + 3) * (m + 2))
    (hdoors : ∀ r, 1 ≤ r → r ≤ L - 1 → bw p (a + r) = 2) :
    L ≤ m + 3
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon   
  have hlt : a + (m + 4) - 1 < (m + 3) * (m + 2) := by omega
  have hlast : (m + 4) * (a + (m + 4) - 1) < p.numVerts :=
    lt_trans (Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hlt (by omega)) hN
  refine ProofsConfinement.confinement (by omega : (2 : ℕ) ≤ m + 4) hp hlast ?_
  intro t ht1 ht2
  have hbwt := hdoors (t - a) (by omega) (by omega)
  rw [show a + (t - a) = t from by omega] at hbwt
  
  exact hbwt

name: Hunter.ProofsProfile.sum_tsub_telescope
statement:
private lemma sum_tsub_telescope (g : ℕ → ℕ) (hg : Monotone g) :
    ∀ M, (Finset.range M).sum (fun i => g (i + 1) - g i) = g M - g 0
proof:
:= by
  intro M
  induction M with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih]
      have h1 := hg (Nat.zero_le k)
      have h2 := hg (show k ≤ k + 1 by omega)
      omega

name: Hunter.ProofsProfile.positive_positions_zero_slack
statement:
lemma positive_positions_zero_slack {n r : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (P : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred P]
    (hcount : ((Finset.Icc 1 (n * r - 1)).filter P).card = r - 1)
    (hcap : ∀ a L, 1 ≤ L → a + L ≤ n * r →
        (∀ s, 1 ≤ s → s ≤ L - 1 → ¬ P (a + s)) → L ≤ n) :
    ∀ t, t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (n * r - 1) →
      (P t ↔ ∃ j, j < r - 1 ∧ t = (j + 1) * n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r', rfl⟩ : ∃ r', r = r' + 1 := ⟨r - 1, by omega⟩
  simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at hcount ⊢
  
  set S : Finset ℕ := (Finset.Icc 1 (n * (r' + 1) - 1)).filter P with hSdef
  have hSc : S.card = r' := hcount
  set e : Fin r' ↪o ℕ := S.orderEmbOfFin hSc with hedef
  have emem : ∀ i, e i ∈ S := fun i => S.orderEmbOfFin_mem hSc i
  have erange : Set.range e = ↑S := S.range_orderEmbOfFin hSc
  have hein : ∀ i : Fin r', 1 ≤ e i ∧ e i ≤ n * (r' + 1) - 1 := by
    intro i
    have := emem i
    rw [hSdef, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc] at this
    exact this.1
  
  set e' : ℕ → ℕ := fun j => if hj : j < r' then e ⟨j, hj⟩ else n * (r' + 1) with he'def
  have he'lt : ∀ j (hj : j < r'), e' j = e ⟨j, hj⟩ := fun j hj => dif_pos hj
  have he'ge : ∀ j, r' ≤ j → e' j = n * (r' + 1) := fun j hj => dif_neg (by omega)
  have he'bound : ∀ j, e' j ≤ n * (r' + 1) := by
    intro j; by_cases hj : j < r'
    · rw [he'lt j hj]; have := (hein ⟨j, hj⟩).2; omega
    · rw [he'ge j (by omega)]
  have he'mono : Monotone e' := by
    intro a b hab
    by_cases hb : b < r'
    · have ha : a < r' := by omega
      rw [he'lt a ha, he'lt b hb]; exact e.monotone (by exact_mod_cast Fin.mk_le_mk.mpr hab)
    · rw [he'ge b (by omega)]
      by_cases ha : a < r'
      · rw [he'lt a ha]; have := (hein ⟨a, ha⟩).2; omega
      · rw [he'ge a (by omega)]
  set cut : ℕ → ℕ := fun j => if j = 0 then 0 else e' (j - 1) with hcutdef
  have hcut0 : cut 0 = 0 := if_pos rfl
  have hcutS : ∀ i, cut (i + 1) = e' i := by
    intro i; show (if i + 1 = 0 then 0 else e' (i + 1 - 1)) = e' i
    rw [if_neg (by omega), Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  have hcutbound : ∀ j, cut j ≤ n * (r' + 1) := by
    intro j; rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j with h | h
    · rw [h, hcut0]; exact Nat.zero_le _
    · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ : ∃ i, j = i + 1 := ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩
      rw [hcutS]; exact he'bound i
  have hcutval : ∀ i : Fin r', cut (i.val + 1) = e i := by
    intro i; rw [hcutS, he'lt i.val i.isLt]
  have hmono : Monotone cut := by
    apply monotone_nat_of_le_succ
    intro i
    cases i with
    | zero => rw [hcut0]; exact Nat.zero_le _
    | succ k => rw [hcutS k, hcutS (k + 1)]; exact he'mono (Nat.le_succ k)
  
  set L : Fin (r' + 1) → ℕ := fun i => cut (i.val + 1) - cut i.val with hLdef
  
  have hsum : (Finset.univ.sum fun i => L i) = n * (r' + 1) := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun j => cut (j + 1) - cut j) (r' + 1)]
    rw [sum_tsub_telescope cut hmono (r' + 1), hcut0, Nat.sub_zero]
    
    rw [hcutS r', he'ge r' (le_refl r')]
  
  have hcapL : ∀ i, L i ≤ n := by
    intro i
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (L i) with h0 | hpos
    · rw [h0]; exact Nat.zero_le _
    · have hmi := hmono (show i.val ≤ i.val + 1 by omega)   
      have hsegeq : cut i.val + L i = cut (i.val + 1) := by simp only [hLdef]; omega
      apply hcap (cut i.val) (L i) hpos
      · rw [hsegeq]; exact hcutbound (i.val + 1)
      · intro s hs1 hs2 hPs
        
        
        have hlt1 : cut i.val < cut i.val + s := by omega
        have hlt2 : cut i.val + s < cut (i.val + 1) := by
          simp only [hLdef] at hs2; omega
        have hmemwin : cut i.val + s ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (n * (r' + 1) - 1) := by
          rw [Finset.mem_Icc]
          have hub : cut (i.val + 1) ≤ n * (r' + 1) := hcutbound (i.val + 1)
          exact ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
        have hmemS : cut i.val + s ∈ S := by
          rw [hSdef, Finset.mem_filter]; exact ⟨hmemwin, hPs⟩
        obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k : Fin r', e k = cut i.val + s := by
          have : cut i.val + s ∈ Set.range e := by rw [erange]; exact hmemS
          exact this
        rw [← hcutval k] at hk    
        
        have hA : i.val < k.val + 1 := by
          by_contra hc; push Not at hc
          exact absurd (hmono hc) (by omega)
        have hB : k.val + 1 < i.val + 1 := by
          by_contra hc; push Not at hc
          exact absurd (hmono hc) (by omega)
        omega
  
  obtain ⟨_, hLn⟩ := ProofsRigidity2.runlen_pigeonhole (r := r' + 1) (m := r' + 1)
    (n := n) hn (le_refl _) L hcapL hsum
  
  have hcuteq : ∀ i, i ≤ r' + 1 → cut i = i * n := by
    intro i
    induction i with
    | zero => intro _; rw [hcut0]; ring
    | succ k ih =>
        intro hk1
        have hkr : k < r' + 1 := by omega
        have hLk : cut (k + 1) - cut k = n := hLn ⟨k, hkr⟩
        have hmk := hmono (show k ≤ k + 1 by omega)
        have hck := ih (by omega)
        have hstep : cut (k + 1) = cut k + n := by omega
        rw [hstep, hck]; ring
  
  have hej : ∀ j : Fin r', e j = (j.val + 1) * n := by
    intro j
    rw [← hcutval j, hcuteq (j.val + 1) (by omega)]
  
  intro t ht
  constructor
  · intro hPt
    have htS : t ∈ S := by rw [hSdef, Finset.mem_filter]; exact ⟨ht, hPt⟩
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k : Fin r', e k = t := by
      have : t ∈ Set.range e := by rw [erange]; exact htS
      exact this
    exact ⟨k.val, k.isLt, by rw [← hk, hej k]⟩
  · rintro ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
    have hkt : e ⟨j, hj⟩ = (j + 1) * n := hej ⟨j, hj⟩
    have : (j + 1) * n ∈ S := by rw [← hkt]; exact emem ⟨j, hj⟩
    rw [hSdef, Finset.mem_filter] at this
    exact this.2

name: Hunter.ProofsProfile.positive_boundary_positions
statement:
lemma positive_boundary_positions {m : ℕ} {p : HPath (m + 4)} (hp : p.Exitless)
    (hN : (m + 4) * ((m + 3) * (m + 2)) < p.numVerts)
    (hlow : (Finset.Icc 1 (((m + 3) * (m + 2)) - 1)).sum (fun t => bw p t - 2) ≤ m + 1) :
    ∀ t, t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (((m + 3) * (m + 2)) - 1) →
      (3 ≤ bw p t ↔ ∃ j, j < m + 1 ∧ t = (j + 1) * (m + 3))
proof:
:= by
  have hcount : ((Finset.Icc 1 ((m + 3) * (m + 2) - 1)).filter (fun t => 3 ≤ bw p t)).card
      = (m + 2) - 1 := by
    have := positive_boundary_count_eq hp hN hlow; omega
  have hcap : ∀ a L, 1 ≤ L → a + L ≤ (m + 3) * (m + 2) →
      (∀ s, 1 ≤ s → s ≤ L - 1 → ¬ 3 ≤ bw p (a + s)) → L ≤ m + 3 := by
    intro a L _ hLN hnoP
    apply door_run_length_cap hp hN hLN
    intro r hr1 hr2
    have h2 := bw_ge_two_in_window hp hN (show 1 ≤ a + r by omega)
      (show a + r ≤ (m + 3) * (m + 2) - 1 by omega)
    have hnp := hnoP r hr1 hr2
    omega
  have hpz := positive_positions_zero_slack (n := m + 3) (r := m + 2) (by omega) (by omega)
    (fun t => 3 ≤ bw p t) hcount hcap
  intro t ht
  have hres := hpz t ht
  simpa using hres

name: Hunter.ProofsProfile.run_profile_of_front_low
statement:
theorem run_profile_of_front_low {m : ℕ} {p : HPath (m + 4)} (hp : p.Exitless)
    (hN : (m + 4) * ((m + 3) * (m + 2)) < p.numVerts)
    (hlow : (Finset.Icc 1 (((m + 3) * (m + 2)) - 1)).sum (fun t => bw p t - 2) ≤ m + 1) :
    (∀ j i, j ≤ m + 1 → i < m + 2 → bw p (j * (m + 3) + i + 1) = 2) ∧
    (∀ j, j < m + 1 → bw p (j * (m + 3) + (m + 2) + 1) = 3)
proof:
:= by
  have hpos := positive_boundary_positions hp hN hlow
  have hwt := boundary_weights_exact hp hN hlow
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro j i hj hi
    have h1 : j * (m + 3) ≤ (m + 1) * (m + 3) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hj
    have hlt : j * (m + 3) + i + 1 < (m + 3) * (m + 2) := by nlinarith [h1, hi]
    have htmem : j * (m + 3) + i + 1 ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ((m + 3) * (m + 2) - 1) := by
      rw [Finset.mem_Icc]; exact ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
