    have hnh : ¬ 3 ≤ bw p (j * (m + 3) + i + 1) := by
      intro hheavy
      obtain ⟨j', _, heq⟩ := (hpos _ htmem).mp hheavy
      have hd1 : (m + 3) ∣ (j * (m + 3)) := ⟨j, by ring⟩
      have hdt : (m + 3) ∣ (j * (m + 3) + (i + 1)) := by
        rw [show j * (m + 3) + (i + 1) = (j' + 1) * (m + 3) from by omega]
        exact ⟨j' + 1, by ring⟩
      have hdj : (m + 3) ∣ (i + 1) := (Nat.dvd_add_right hd1).mp hdt
      have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hdj
      omega
    exact hwt.2 _ htmem hnh
  · 
    intro j hj
    have hteq : j * (m + 3) + (m + 2) + 1 = (j + 1) * (m + 3) := by ring
    have h1 : j * (m + 3) ≤ m * (m + 3) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega)
    have hlt : j * (m + 3) + (m + 2) + 1 < (m + 3) * (m + 2) := by nlinarith [h1]
    have htmem : j * (m + 3) + (m + 2) + 1 ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ((m + 3) * (m + 2) - 1) := by
      rw [Finset.mem_Icc]; exact ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
    have hheavy : 3 ≤ bw p (j * (m + 3) + (m + 2) + 1) :=
      (hpos _ htmem).mpr ⟨j, hj, hteq⟩
    exact hwt.1 _ htmem hheavy

name: Hunter.ProofsProfile.front_low_chart_heavy
statement:
theorem front_low_chart_heavy {m : ℕ} {p : HPath (m + 4)} (hp : p.Exitless)
    (hN : (m + 4) * ((m + 3) * (m + 2)) < p.numVerts)
    (hlow : (Finset.Icc 1 (((m + 3) * (m + 2)) - 1)).sum (fun t => bw p t - 2) ≤ m + 1) :
    4 ≤ bw p ((m + 3) * (m + 2))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hbw2, hbw3⟩ := run_profile_of_front_low hp hN hlow
  exact Hunter.ProofsFinale.hpath_chart_heavy hp hN hbw2 hbw3

name: Hunter.ProofsHrev.orbitList_ne
statement: theorem orbitList_ne (hk : 1 ≤ k) (u : Vtx k) : ProofsPu.orbitList u ≠ []
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hl : (ProofsPu.orbitList u).length = k := ProofsPu.orbitList_length u
  rw [h, List.length_nil] at hl; omega

name: Hunter.ProofsHrev.orbitPath_numVerts
statement:
theorem orbitPath_numVerts (hk : 1 ≤ k) (u : Vtx k) :
    (orbitPath hk u).numVerts = k
proof: := ProofsPu.orbitList_length u

name: Hunter.ProofsHrev.orbitPath_vert
statement:
theorem orbitPath_vert (hk : 1 ≤ k) (u : Vtx k) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < k) :
    (orbitPath hk u).vert i = sigma^[i] u
proof:
:= by
  have hi' : i < (ProofsPu.orbitList u).length := by rw [ProofsPu.orbitList_length]; exact hi
  have ht : i < (orbitPath hk u).numVerts := by
    show i < (ProofsPu.orbitList u).length; exact hi'
  rw [ProofsExitless.vert_getElem (orbitPath hk u) ht]
  exact ProofsPu.orbitList_getElem u hi'

name: Hunter.ProofsHrev.orbitPath_vertsFinset
statement:
theorem orbitPath_vertsFinset (hk : 1 ≤ k) (u : Vtx k) :
    (orbitPath hk u).vertsFinset = cyc u
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [HPath.mem_vertsFinset]
  show x ∈ ProofsPu.orbitList u ↔ x ∈ cyc u
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := ProofsPu.mem_orbitList hx
    exact ProofsExitless.sigma_iter_mem_cyc i u
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ := (ProofsExitless.mem_cyc_iff_exists hk).mp hx
    simp only [ProofsPu.orbitList, List.mem_map, List.mem_range]
    exact ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsHrev.orbitPath_exitless
statement: theorem orbitPath_exitless (hk : 1 ≤ k) (u : Vtx k) : (orbitPath hk u).Exitless
proof:
:= by
  rw [HPath.Exitless]
  rintro ⟨i, hi1, hw, _⟩
  rw [orbitPath_numVerts hk u] at hi1
  have hik : i < k := by omega
  have hik1 : i + 1 < k := hi1
  rw [orbitPath_vert hk u hik, orbitPath_vert hk u hik1,
    Function.iterate_succ_apply' sigma i u, ew_sigma hk] at hw
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsHrev.orbitPath_SE
statement: theorem orbitPath_SE (hk : 1 ≤ k) (u : Vtx k) : (orbitPath hk u).StronglyExitless
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨orbitPath_exitless hk u, ?_⟩
  
  have hlast_mem : (orbitPath hk u).last ∈ (orbitPath hk u).verts := (orbitPath hk u).last_mem
  have hlast_cyc : (orbitPath hk u).last ∈ cyc u := by
    rw [← orbitPath_vertsFinset hk u]; exact HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mpr hlast_mem
  have hrc : rotClass ((orbitPath hk u).last).1 = rotClass u.1 := ProofsExitless.mem_cyc.mp hlast_cyc
  have hsig : sigma ((orbitPath hk u).last) ∈ (orbitPath hk u).vertsFinset := by
    rw [orbitPath_vertsFinset hk u, ProofsExitless.mem_cyc, ProofsStructure.rotClass_sigma]
    exact hrc
  exact HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mp hsig

name: Hunter.ProofsHrev.cyc_nonempty
statement: theorem cyc_nonempty (u : Vtx k) : (cyc u).Nonempty
proof: := ⟨u, ProofsExitless.mem_cyc.mpr rfl⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsHrev.cyc_eq_of_mem
statement: theorem cyc_eq_of_mem {x u : Vtx k} (h : x ∈ cyc u) : cyc x = cyc u
proof:
:= by
  have hr : rotClass x.1 = rotClass u.1 := ProofsExitless.mem_cyc.mp h
  simp only [cyc, hr]

name: Hunter.ProofsHrev.cyc_disjoint_of_ne
statement: theorem cyc_disjoint_of_ne {a b : Vtx k} (h : cyc a ≠ cyc b) : Disjoint (cyc a) (cyc b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro x hxa hxb
  exact h ((cyc_eq_of_mem hxa).symm.trans (cyc_eq_of_mem hxb))

name: Hunter.ProofsHrev.repF_mem
statement: theorem repF_mem (v₀ u : Vtx k) : repF v₀ (cyc u) ∈ cyc u
proof:
:= by
  have h := cyc_nonempty u
  simp only [repF, dif_pos h]
  exact h.choose_spec

name: Hunter.ProofsHrev.compl_cyc_disjoint
statement:
theorem compl_cyc_disjoint {p : HPath k} (huoc : p.IsUnionOfCycles) {w : Vtx k}
    (hw : w ∉ p.vertsFinset) : Disjoint (cyc w) p.vertsFinset
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro x hxw hxp
  have hxpv : x ∈ p.verts := HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mp hxp
  have hsub : cyc x ⊆ p.vertsFinset := huoc x hxpv
  have hcxw : cyc x = cyc w := cyc_eq_of_mem hxw
  have hwcyc : w ∈ cyc w := ProofsExitless.mem_cyc.mpr rfl
  rw [← hcxw] at hwcyc
  exact hw (hsub hwcyc)

name: Hunter.ProofsHrev.edge_endpoints_mem
statement:
theorem edge_endpoints_mem {p : HPath k} {e : Vtx k × Vtx k} (he : e ∈ p.edges) :
    e.1 ∈ p.verts ∧ e.2 ∈ p.verts
proof:
:= by
  rw [ProofsSpine.mem_edges_iff] at he
  obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := e
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := List.of_mem_zip he
  exact ⟨h1, List.mem_of_mem_tail h2⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsHrev.two_k_le_factorial
statement: theorem two_k_le_factorial (hk : 3 ≤ k) : 2 * k ≤ k.factorial
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Nat.factorial_succ]
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge 3 (n + 1) with h | h
    · have hn : 3 ≤ n := by omega
      have ihn : 2 * n ≤ n.factorial := ih hn
      nlinarith [ihn, Nat.self_le_factorial n]
    · have hn2 : n = 2 := by omega
      subst hn2; decide

name: Hunter.Proved.hrev
statement: theorem hrev (hk : 2 ≤ k) : {p : HPath k | p.StronglyExitless} ⊆ Xk' k
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  have hSE : p.StronglyExitless := hp
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
  have huoc : p.IsUnionOfCycles := Hunter.Proved.clm_1cyclesubset hSE
  
  set comp : Finset (Vtx k) := Finset.univ \ p.vertsFinset with hcomp
  set reps : Finset (Vtx k) := comp.image (fun u => repF p.first (cyc u)) with hreps
  set orbitPaths : List (HPath k) := reps.toList.map (orbitPath hk1) with horb
  set ps : List (HPath k) := p :: orbitPaths with hps_def
  
  have hrep_idem : ∀ r ∈ reps, repF p.first (cyc r) = r := by
    intro r hr
    rw [hreps, Finset.mem_image] at hr
    obtain ⟨u, _, rfl⟩ := hr
    rw [cyc_eq_of_mem (repF_mem p.first u)]
  have hrep_in_comp : ∀ r ∈ reps, r ∈ comp := by
    intro r hr
    rw [hreps, Finset.mem_image] at hr
    obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := hr
    have hucomp : u ∉ p.vertsFinset := by rw [hcomp, Finset.mem_sdiff] at hu; exact hu.2
    have hdis : Disjoint (cyc u) p.vertsFinset := compl_cyc_disjoint huoc hucomp
    rw [hcomp, Finset.mem_sdiff]
    exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, Finset.disjoint_left.mp hdis (repF_mem p.first u)⟩
  
  have hp_disj_orbit : ∀ q ∈ orbitPaths, Disjoint p.vertsFinset q.vertsFinset := by
    intro q hq
    rw [horb, List.mem_map] at hq
    obtain ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ := hq
    rw [Finset.mem_toList] at hr
    rw [orbitPath_vertsFinset hk1 r]
    have hrp : r ∉ p.vertsFinset := by
      have := hrep_in_comp r hr; rw [hcomp, Finset.mem_sdiff] at this; exact this.2
    exact (compl_cyc_disjoint huoc hrp).symm
  
  have hps : ps ≠ [] := by rw [hps_def]; exact List.cons_ne_nil _ _
  
  have hSE_all : ∀ q ∈ ps, q.StronglyExitless := by
    intro q hq
    rw [hps_def, List.mem_cons] at hq
    rcases hq with rfl | hqo
    · exact hSE
    · rw [horb, List.mem_map] at hqo
      obtain ⟨r, _, rfl⟩ := hqo
      exact orbitPath_SE hk1 r
  
  have hpair : ps.Pairwise (fun a b : HPath k => Disjoint a.vertsFinset b.vertsFinset) := by
    rw [hps_def, List.pairwise_cons]
    refine ⟨hp_disj_orbit, ?_⟩
    rw [horb, List.pairwise_map]
    refine (Finset.nodup_toList reps).pairwise_of_forall_ne ?_
    intro r1 hr1 r2 hr2 hne12
    rw [Finset.mem_toList] at hr1 hr2
    rw [orbitPath_vertsFinset hk1 r1, orbitPath_vertsFinset hk1 r2]
    apply cyc_disjoint_of_ne
    intro heq
    exact hne12 (by rw [← hrep_idem r1 hr1, ← hrep_idem r2 hr2, heq])
  
  have hcover : ∀ v : Vtx k, ∃ q ∈ ps, v ∈ q.verts := by
    intro v
    by_cases hv : v ∈ p.verts
    · exact ⟨p, by rw [hps_def]; exact List.mem_cons_self, hv⟩
    · have hvcomp : v ∈ comp := by
        rw [hcomp, Finset.mem_sdiff]
        exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, fun h => hv (HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mp h)⟩
      have hrreps : repF p.first (cyc v) ∈ reps := by
        rw [hreps, Finset.mem_image]; exact ⟨v, hvcomp, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨orbitPath hk1 (repF p.first (cyc v)), ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hps_def]; refine List.mem_cons_of_mem _ ?_
        rw [horb, List.mem_map]; exact ⟨_, Finset.mem_toList.mpr hrreps, rfl⟩
      · have hcycr : cyc (repF p.first (cyc v)) = cyc v := cyc_eq_of_mem (repF_mem p.first v)
        refine HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mp ?_
        rw [orbitPath_vertsFinset hk1 _, hcycr]
        exact ProofsExitless.mem_cyc.mpr rfl
  
  have hnd : (unwindVerts ps).Nodup := ProofsUnwind4.unwindVerts_nodup_of_pairwise hpair
  
  set X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k) := Finset.univ.filter (fun e => ∃ q ∈ ps, e ∈ q.edges)
    with hXset
  have hXdef : ∀ e, e ∈ X ↔ ∃ q ∈ ps, e ∈ q.edges := by
    intro e; rw [hXset, Finset.mem_filter]
    exact ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨Finset.mem_univ e, h⟩⟩
  have hXmem : X ∈ Xk k :=
    prp_Xk_se_sufficiency_unwind3 hps hnd hcover hSE_all hk hpair hXdef
  
  have hPC : IsPathComponent p X := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro e he
      rw [hXdef]; exact ⟨p, by rw [hps_def]; exact List.mem_cons_self, he⟩
    · intro e heX
      rw [hXdef] at heX
      obtain ⟨q, hq, heq⟩ := heX
      obtain ⟨h1q, h2q⟩ := edge_endpoints_mem heq
      rw [hps_def, List.mem_cons] at hq
      rcases hq with rfl | hqo
      · exact ⟨fun _ => HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mpr h2q, fun _ => HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mpr h1q⟩
      · have hdisj := hp_disj_orbit q hqo
        constructor
        · intro h1
          exact absurd (HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mpr h1q) (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hdisj h1)
        · intro h2
          exact absurd (HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mpr h2q) (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hdisj h2)
    · intro e heX h1
      rw [hXdef] at heX
      obtain ⟨q, hq, heq⟩ := heX
      rw [hps_def, List.mem_cons] at hq
      rcases hq with rfl | hqo
      · exact heq
      · obtain ⟨h1q, _⟩ := edge_endpoints_mem heq
        have hdisj := hp_disj_orbit q hqo
        exact absurd (HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mpr h1q) (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hdisj h1)
  exact ⟨X, hXmem, hPC⟩

name: Hunter.Proved.prp_Xkcomps_closed
statement:
theorem prp_Xkcomps_closed (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    Xk' k = {p : HPath k | p.StronglyExitless}
proof:
:=
  prp_Xkcomps_amended hk (hrev hk)

name: Hunter.Proved.red_pstar_closed
proof:
:=

name: Hunter.Proved.red_R_closed
proof:
:= by
  have hk2 : 2 ≤ k := by omega
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
  set u : Vtx k := (ProofsSpine.vtx_nonempty k).some with hu
  have hmem : (orbitPath hk1 u) ∈ Xk' k := hrev hk2 (orbitPath_SE hk1 u)
  have hle : (orbitPath hk1 u).numVerts ≤ k.factorial - k := by
    rw [orbitPath_numVerts hk1 u]
    have := two_k_le_factorial hk; omega
  exact red_R_final hk2 ⟨orbitPath hk1 u, hmem, hle⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta6.window_heavy_count
statement:
theorem window_heavy_count (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless)
    (a M : ℕ) (hM : k * (a + M) < p.numVerts) :
    M ⌈/⌉ (k - 1) - 1 ≤
      ((Finset.Icc 1 M).filter
        (fun j => 3 ≤ ew k (p.vert (k * (a + j) - 1)) (p.vert (k * (a + j))))).card
proof:
:= by
  set J : Finset ℕ := (Finset.Icc 1 M).filter
    (fun j => 3 ≤ ew k (p.vert (k * (a + j) - 1)) (p.vert (k * (a + j)))) with hJdef
  apply ProofsConfinement.cover_bound (d := k - 1) (T := M) (by omega) J
  intro b hb1 hbd
  by_contra hcon
  refine ProofsConfinement.confinement (by omega : 2 ≤ k) hp (t₀ := a + b - 1) ?_ ?_
  · 
    have he1 : (a + b - 1) + k - 1 + 1 ≤ a + M := by omega
    have hmul : k * ((a + b - 1) + k - 1 + 1) ≤ k * (a + M) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) he1
    have hexp : k * ((a + b - 1) + k - 1 + 1) = k * ((a + b - 1) + k - 1) + k := by ring
    omega
  · intro t ht1 ht2
    
    have hta : a + (t - a) = t := by omega
    have htle : t ≤ a + M - 1 := by omega
    have hktle : k * t ≤ k * (a + M - 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) htle
    have hexp2 : k * (a + M - 1) + k = k * (a + M) := by
      have : a + M - 1 + 1 = a + M := by omega
      calc k * (a + M - 1) + k = k * (a + M - 1 + 1) := by ring
        _ = k * (a + M) := by rw [this]
    have hktlt : k * t < p.numVerts := by omega
    have hkt1 : k * t - 1 + 1 = k * t := by
      have : 1 ≤ k * t := by
        have : 1 ≤ t := by omega
        calc 1 ≤ k := by omega
          _ = k * 1 := by ring
          _ ≤ k * t := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) this
      omega
    have hin : (k * t - 1) + 1 < p.numVerts := by rw [hkt1]; exact hktlt
    have hd : k ∣ ((k * t - 1) + 1) := by rw [hkt1]; exact ⟨t, rfl⟩
    have hge2 := ProofsWindow.boundary_ge_two (by omega : 1 ≤ k) hp hin hd
    rw [hkt1] at hge2
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (ew k (p.vert (k * t - 1)) (p.vert (k * t))) 3 with hlt3 | hge3
    · omega
    · exfalso
      apply hcon
      refine ⟨t - a, ?_, by omega, by omega⟩
      rw [hJdef, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc]
      refine ⟨⟨by omega, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [hta]; exact hge3

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta6.windowM_ceilDiv
statement: theorem windowM_ceilDiv (hk : 3 ≤ k) : ((k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1) ⌈/⌉ (k - 1) = k - 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, k = m + 3 := ⟨k - 3, by omega⟩
  have e1 : m + 3 - 1 = m + 2 := by omega
  have e2 : m + 3 - 2 = m + 1 := by omega
  rw [e1, e2]
  have hMpos : 1 ≤ (m + 2) * (m + 1) - 1 := by
    have : 2 ≤ (m + 2) * (m + 1) := by nlinarith
    omega
  rw [Proved.ceilDiv_succ_pred hMpos (by omega : 0 < m + 2)]
  have hval : (m + 2) * (m + 1) - 1 - 1 = (m + 2) * m + m := by
    have : (m + 2) * (m + 1) = (m + 2) * m + (m + 2) := by ring
    omega
  have hdiv : ((m + 2) * (m + 1) - 1 - 1) / (m + 2) = m := by
    rw [hval, Nat.mul_add_div (by omega : 0 < m + 2), Nat.div_eq_of_lt (by omega : m < m + 2),
        Nat.add_zero]
  rw [hdiv]

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta6.window_heavy3_ge
statement:
theorem window_heavy3_ge (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p q : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless)
    (hlt : k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) < p.numVerts)
    (hprefix : q.verts = p.verts.take (p.numVerts - ell0 k)) :
    edgeCountGe q 3 + (k - 3) ≤ edgeCountGe p 3
proof:
:= by
  set N := p.numVerts with hNdef
  set n := N - ell0 k with hndef
  
  have he0val : ell0 k = k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) - k := rfl
  have hm2 : 2 ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by nlinarith [show 2 ≤ k - 1 by omega, show 1 ≤ k - 2 by omega]
  have hkprod : k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2)) = k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by ring
  have hPk : k ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by
    have h1 : k * 1 ≤ k * (k - 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) (by omega)
    have h2 : k * (k - 1) * 1 ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl _) (by omega)
    omega
  have he0lt : ell0 k < N := by rw [he0val]; omega
  have hNsum : N = n + ell0 k := by rw [hndef]; omega
  have hn1 : k < n := by rw [hndef, he0val]; omega
  have hnle : n ≤ N := by omega
  
  have hqn : q.numVerts = n := by
    have hlen : q.verts.length = (p.verts.take (N - ell0 k)).length := by rw [hprefix]
    have hNl : p.verts.length = N := rfl
    rw [List.length_take, hNl] at hlen
    show q.verts.length = n
    rw [hlen, hndef]; omega
  
  have hdvd : k ∣ ell0 k := k_dvd_ell0 hk
  set M := ell0 k / k with hMdef
  have hkM : k * M = ell0 k := Nat.mul_div_cancel' hdvd
  have hMval : M = (k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1 := by
    have hB1 : (k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1 + 1 = (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by omega
    have hkB : k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1) + k = k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2)) := by
      calc k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1) + k
          = k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1 + 1) := by ring
        _ = k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2)) := by rw [hB1]
    have hkMk : k * M + k = k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2)) := by
      rw [hkM, he0val, hkprod]; omega
    have hcancel : k * M = k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1) := by omega
    exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (by omega) hcancel
  
  set a := (n - 1) / k with hadef
  have hdivmod : k * a + (n - 1) % k = n - 1 := Nat.div_add_mod (n - 1) k
  have hmodlt : (n - 1) % k < k := Nat.mod_lt (n - 1) (by omega)
  clear_value a
  
  have hM_lt : k * (a + M) < N := by
    have hexp : k * (a + M) = k * a + ell0 k := by rw [Nat.mul_add, hkM]
    omega
  have hcount := window_heavy_count hk hp a M hM_lt
  have hMc : M ⌈/⌉ (k - 1) = k - 2 := by rw [hMval]; exact windowM_ceilDiv hk
  
  set Wf : Finset ℕ := (Finset.Ico (n - 1) (N - 1)).filter
    (fun i => 3 ≤ ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1))) with hWfdef
  set J : Finset ℕ := (Finset.Icc 1 M).filter
    (fun j => 3 ≤ ew k (p.vert (k * (a + j) - 1)) (p.vert (k * (a + j)))) with hJdef
  
  have hJW : J.card ≤ Wf.card := by
    apply Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn (fun j => k * (a + j) - 1)
    · intro j hj
      rw [hJdef] at hj
      obtain ⟨hjIcc, hjh⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hj
      obtain ⟨hj1, hjM⟩ := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hjIcc
      have haj_lo : k * (a + 1) ≤ k * (a + j) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) (by omega)
      have haj_hi : k * (a + j) ≤ k * (a + M) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) (by omega)
      have ha1 : k * (a + 1) = k * a + k := by ring
      have haM : k * (a + M) = k * a + ell0 k := by rw [Nat.mul_add, hkM]
      have hajpos : 1 ≤ k * (a + j) := by omega
      have haj1 : k * (a + j) - 1 + 1 = k * (a + j) := by omega
      show k * (a + j) - 1 ∈ Wf
      rw [hWfdef, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Ico]
      refine ⟨⟨by omega, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [haj1]; exact hjh
    · intro j1 hj1 j2 hj2 heq
      simp only [Finset.mem_coe] at hj1 hj2
      rw [hJdef] at hj1 hj2
      have hb1 : 1 ≤ j1 := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj1).1).1
      have hb2 : 1 ≤ j2 := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj2).1).1
      have heq' : k * (a + j1) - 1 = k * (a + j2) - 1 := heq
      have h1 : 0 < k * (a + j1) := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)
      have h2 : 0 < k * (a + j2) := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)
      have heq2 : k * (a + j1) = k * (a + j2) := by omega
      have hcancel := Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (by omega : 0 < k) heq2
      omega
  
  have hsplit : edgeCountGe p 3 = edgeCountGe q 3 + Wf.card := by
    have hunion : Finset.range (N - 1) = Finset.Ico 0 (n - 1) ∪ Finset.Ico (n - 1) (N - 1) := by
      rw [Finset.Ico_union_Ico_eq_Ico (Nat.zero_le _) (by omega), Finset.range_eq_Ico]
    have hdisj : Disjoint (Finset.Ico 0 (n - 1)) (Finset.Ico (n - 1) (N - 1)) := by
      rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
      intro x hx hx2
      rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hx hx2
      omega
    rw [edgeCountGe, ← hNdef, hunion, Finset.filter_union,
        Finset.card_union_of_disjoint (Finset.disjoint_filter_filter hdisj)]
    congr 1
    · 
      rw [edgeCountGe, hqn, Finset.range_eq_Ico]
      congr 1
      apply Finset.filter_congr
      intro i hi
      rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hi
      rw [prefix_vert_eq hprefix hnle (show i < n by omega),
          prefix_vert_eq hprefix hnle (show i + 1 < n by omega)]
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta6.windowExcess_ge_km3
statement:
theorem windowExcess_ge_km3 (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p q : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless)
    (hlt : k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) < p.numVerts)
    (hprefix : q.verts = p.verts.take (p.numVerts - ell0 k)) :
    excess q + (k - 3) ≤ excess p
proof:
:= by
  have hnle : p.numVerts - ell0 k ≤ p.numVerts := Nat.sub_le _ _
  have hqn : q.numVerts = p.numVerts - ell0 k := by
    have hlen : q.verts.length = (p.verts.take (p.numVerts - ell0 k)).length := by rw [hprefix]
    have hN : p.verts.length = p.numVerts := rfl
    rw [List.length_take, hN] at hlen
    show q.verts.length = _
    rw [hlen]; omega
  have hmono : ∀ r, edgeCountGe q r ≤ edgeCountGe p r :=
    fun r => edgeCountGe_prefix_le hprefix hnle hqn r
  have hres : edgeCountGe q 3 + (k - 3) ≤ edgeCountGe p 3 := window_heavy3_ge hk hp hlt hprefix
  rw [excess, excess]
  have h3mem : (3 : ℕ) ∈ Finset.Icc 3 k := by rw [Finset.mem_Icc]; omega
  rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ (edgeCountGe p) h3mem,
      ← Finset.add_sum_erase _ (edgeCountGe q) h3mem]
  have hsum : ∑ r ∈ (Finset.Icc 3 k).erase 3, edgeCountGe q r
            ≤ ∑ r ∈ (Finset.Icc 3 k).erase 3, edgeCountGe p r :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum (fun r _ => hmono r)
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta6.amortizedWindow_of_metaSupply
statement:
theorem amortizedWindow_of_metaSupply (hk : 3 ≤ k) {Φ : HPath k → ℕ}
    (hsupply : MetaWindowSupply k Φ) : AmortizedWindow k Φ
proof:
:= by
  intro p q hpe hqe hlt hprefix
  rcases hsupply p q hpe hqe hlt hprefix with hrel | hdirect
  · have hfloor : excess q + (k - 3) ≤ excess p := windowExcess_ge_km3 hk hpe hlt hprefix
    omega
  · exact hdirect

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta6.baseBound_phiSurplus
statement: theorem baseBound_phiSurplus (hk : 3 ≤ k) : BaseBound k (PhiSurplus k)
proof:
:= by
  intro p hpe h0 hle
  have hDb : (p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1)) - 1) ≤ excess p := excess_ge_Dbase hk hpe
  have hPhi : PhiSurplus k p ≤ excess p - (p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1)) - 1) := by
    unfold PhiSurplus; exact min_le_right _ _
  have hj : j k p.numVerts
      = p.numVerts + (p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k) + (p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1))) - 3 :=
    j_base (Or.inl hle)
  have hck1 : 1 ≤ p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k := by
    rw [Proved.ceilDiv_succ_pred h0 (by omega : 0 < k)]; exact Nat.le_add_left 1 _
  have hck2 : 1 ≤ p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1)) := by
    rw [Proved.ceilDiv_succ_pred h0 (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega))]; exact Nat.le_add_left 1 _
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta6.thm2_of_metaSupply
statement:
theorem thm2_of_metaSupply {k ℓ : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) (Φ : HPath k → ℕ)
    (hbase : BaseBound k Φ) (hsupply : MetaWindowSupply k Φ) (hℓ : HasExitlessPath k ℓ) :
    j k ℓ ≤ iExitless k ℓ
proof:
:=
  ProofsMeta5.thm2_of_amortizedWindow hk Φ hbase (amortizedWindow_of_metaSupply hk hsupply) hℓ

name: Hunter.ProofsClosure3.rotClass_rotate
statement: theorem rotClass_rotate (w : List ℕ) (n : ℕ) : rotClass (w.rotate n) = rotClass w
proof:
:=
  Quotient.sound (List.IsRotated.forall w n)

name: Hunter.ProofsClosure3.chartWord_00
statement: theorem chartWord_00 : chartWord A' z b c 0 0 = A' ++ [z, b, c]
proof:
:= by
  simp [chartWord, List.rotate_zero, List.append_assoc]

name: Hunter.ProofsClosure3.chartWord_0n
statement: theorem chartWord_0n : chartWord A' z b c 0 A'.length = z :: b :: A' ++ [c]
proof:
:= by
  unfold chartWord
  rw [List.rotate_zero, show (A' ++ [z]) ++ [b] = A' ++ [z, b] by simp,
    List.rotate_append_length_eq]
  rfl

name: Hunter.ProofsClosure3.chartWord_0n1
statement:
theorem chartWord_0n1 :
    chartWord A' z b c 0 (A'.length + 1) = b :: A' ++ [z, c]
proof:
:= by
  unfold chartWord
  rw [List.rotate_zero, show A'.length + 1 = (A' ++ [z]).length by simp,
    List.rotate_append_length_eq]
  simp [List.append_assoc]

name: Hunter.ProofsClosure3.chartWord_n0
statement: theorem chartWord_n0 : chartWord A' z b c A'.length 0 = z :: A' ++ [b, c]
proof:
:= by
  unfold chartWord
  rw [List.rotate_append_length_eq, List.rotate_zero]
  simp [List.append_assoc]

name: Hunter.ProofsClosure3.chartWord_n1
statement: theorem chartWord_n1 : chartWord A' z b c A'.length 1 = A' ++ [b, z, c]
proof:
:= by
  unfold chartWord
  rw [List.rotate_append_length_eq,
    show ([z] ++ A') ++ [b] = [z] ++ (A' ++ [b]) by simp,
    show (1 : ℕ) = ([z] : List ℕ).length from rfl, List.rotate_append_length_eq]
  simp

name: Hunter.ProofsClosure3.chartWord_nn1
statement:
theorem chartWord_nn1 :
    chartWord A' z b c A'.length (A'.length + 1) = b :: z :: A' ++ [c]
proof:
:= by
  unfold chartWord
  rw [List.rotate_append_length_eq,
    show A'.length + 1 = ([z] ++ A').length by simp, List.rotate_append_length_eq]
  simp

name: Hunter.ProofsClosure3.door_finalExit
statement: theorem door_finalExit : door (finalExit A' z b c) = z :: A' ++ [b, c]
proof: := rfl

name: Hunter.ProofsClosure3.rotate2_finalExit
statement: theorem rotate2_finalExit : (finalExit A' z b c).rotate 2 = z :: A' ++ [c, b]
proof:
:= by
  rw [show finalExit A' z b c = [c, b] ++ (z :: A') from rfl,
    show (2 : ℕ) = ([c, b] : List ℕ).length from rfl, List.rotate_append_length_eq]

name: Hunter.ProofsClosure3.finalExit_rotate1
statement:
theorem finalExit_rotate1 :
    (finalExit A' z b c).rotate 1 = chartWord A' z b c A'.length (A'.length + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartWord_nn1]
  rw [show finalExit A' z b c = [c] ++ (b :: z :: A') from rfl,
    show (1 : ℕ) = ([c] : List ℕ).length from rfl, List.rotate_append_length_eq]

name: Hunter.ProofsClosure3.perm_finalExit_start
statement: theorem perm_finalExit_start : (finalExit A' z b c) ~ (A' ++ [z, b, c])
proof:
:= by
  show c :: b :: z :: A' ~ A' ++ [z, b, c]
  have h1 : c :: b :: z :: A' ~ A' ++ [c, b, z] :=
    (List.perm_append_comm (l₁ := A') (l₂ := [c, b, z])).symm
  refine h1.trans (List.Perm.append_left A' ?_)
  
  exact (List.Perm.cons c (List.Perm.swap z b [])).trans
    ((List.Perm.swap z c [b]).trans (List.Perm.cons z (List.Perm.swap b c [])))

name: Hunter.ProofsClosure3.isPermWord_finalExit
statement:
theorem isPermWord_finalExit (hs : IsPermWord (A'.length + 3) (A' ++ [z, b, c])) :
    IsPermWord (A'.length + 3) (finalExit A' z b c)
proof:
:=
  hs.perm (perm_finalExit_start A' z b c).symm

name: Hunter.ProofsClosure3.visited_finalExit
statement:
theorem visited_finalExit :
    VisitedByChart A' z b c (rotClass (finalExit A' z b c))
proof:
:=
  ⟨A'.length, A'.length + 1, le_refl _, le_refl _, by
    rw [← finalExit_rotate1, rotClass_rotate]⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsClosure3.visited_door
statement:
theorem visited_door :
    VisitedByChart A' z b c (rotClass (door (finalExit A' z b c)))
proof:
:=
  ⟨A'.length, 0, le_refl _, by omega, by rw [door_finalExit, chartWord_n0]⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsClosure3.chart_closure_w2
statement:
theorem chart_closure_w2 (hs : IsPermWord (A'.length + 3) (A' ++ [z, b, c]))
    {v : List ℕ} (hv : IsPermWord (A'.length + 3) v)
    (hover : (finalExit A' z b c).drop 2 = v.take (A'.length + 3 - 2)) :
    VisitedByChart A' z b c (rotClass v)
proof:
:= by
  have hx : IsPermWord (A'.length + 3) (finalExit A' z b c) := isPermWord_finalExit A' z b c hs
  rcases ProofsConfinement.wt_two_word_cases (k := A'.length + 3) (by omega) hx hv hover with
    hrot | hdoor
  · 
    rw [hrot, rotClass_rotate]
    exact visited_finalExit A' z b c
  · 
    rw [hdoor]
    exact visited_door A' z b c

name: Hunter.ProofsClosure3.visited_V1
statement: theorem visited_V1 : VisitedByChart A' z b c (rotClass (A' ++ [z, b, c]))
proof:
:=
  ⟨0, 0, by omega, by omega, by rw [chartWord_00]⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsClosure3.visited_V2
statement: theorem visited_V2 : VisitedByChart A' z b c (rotClass (A' ++ [z, c, b]))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨0, A'.length + 1, by omega, le_refl _, ?_⟩
  rw [← rotClass_rotate (chartWord A' z b c 0 (A'.length + 1)) 1, chartWord_0n1,
    show b :: A' ++ [z, c] = [b] ++ (A' ++ [z, c]) from rfl,
    show (1 : ℕ) = ([b] : List ℕ).length from rfl, List.rotate_append_length_eq,
    show (A' ++ [z, c]) ++ [b] = A' ++ [z, c, b] by simp]

name: Hunter.ProofsClosure3.visited_V3
statement: theorem visited_V3 : VisitedByChart A' z b c (rotClass (A' ++ [b, z, c]))
proof:
:=
  ⟨A'.length, 1, le_refl _, by omega, by rw [chartWord_n1]⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsClosure3.visited_V4
statement: theorem visited_V4 : VisitedByChart A' z b c (rotClass (A' ++ [b, c, z]))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨A'.length, 0, le_refl _, by omega, ?_⟩
  rw [← rotClass_rotate (chartWord A' z b c A'.length 0) 1, chartWord_n0,
    show z :: A' ++ [b, c] = [z] ++ (A' ++ [b, c]) from rfl,
    show (1 : ℕ) = ([z] : List ℕ).length from rfl, List.rotate_append_length_eq,
    show (A' ++ [b, c]) ++ [z] = A' ++ [b, c, z] by simp]

name: Hunter.ProofsClosure3.visited_V5
statement: theorem visited_V5 : VisitedByChart A' z b c (rotClass (A' ++ [c, z, b]))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨0, A'.length, by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
  rw [← rotClass_rotate (chartWord A' z b c 0 A'.length) 2, chartWord_0n,
    show z :: b :: A' ++ [c] = [z, b] ++ (A' ++ [c]) from rfl,
    show (2 : ℕ) = ([z, b] : List ℕ).length from rfl, List.rotate_append_length_eq,
    show (A' ++ [c]) ++ [z, b] = A' ++ [c, z, b] by simp]

name: Hunter.ProofsClosure3.visited_V6
statement: theorem visited_V6 : VisitedByChart A' z b c (rotClass (A' ++ [c, b, z]))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨A'.length, A'.length + 1, le_refl _, le_refl _, ?_⟩
  rw [← rotClass_rotate (chartWord A' z b c A'.length (A'.length + 1)) 2, chartWord_nn1,
    show b :: z :: A' ++ [c] = [b, z] ++ (A' ++ [c]) from rfl,
    show (2 : ℕ) = ([b, z] : List ℕ).length from rfl, List.rotate_append_length_eq,
    show (A' ++ [c]) ++ [b, z] = A' ++ [c, b, z] by simp]

name: Hunter.ProofsClosure3.w3_six_cases
statement:
theorem w3_six_cases (hx : IsPermWord (A'.length + 3) (finalExit A' z b c))
    {v : List ℕ} (hv : IsPermWord (A'.length + 3) v)
    (hover : (finalExit A' z b c).drop 3 = v.take (A'.length + 3 - 3)) :
    v = A' ++ [z, b, c] ∨ v = A' ++ [z, c, b] ∨ v = A' ++ [b, z, c] ∨
      v = A' ++ [b, c, z] ∨ v = A' ++ [c, z, b] ∨ v = A' ++ [c, b, z]
proof:
:= by
  have hvlen : v.length = A'.length + 3 := hv.length
  
  rw [show (finalExit A' z b c).drop 3 = A' from rfl, show A'.length + 3 - 3 = A'.length by omega]
    at hover
  set r := v.drop A'.length with hrdef
  have hvsplit : v = A' ++ r := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← List.take_append_drop A'.length v]; rw [← hover]
  have hrlen : r.length = 3 := by
    have h := hvlen; rw [hvsplit, List.length_append] at h; omega
  
  have hnd : (c :: b :: z :: A').Nodup := hx.nodup
  obtain ⟨hcm, hbm, hzm, hAnd⟩ := by
    rw [List.nodup_cons, List.nodup_cons, List.nodup_cons] at hnd; exact hnd
  simp only [List.mem_cons, not_or] at hcm hbm
  obtain ⟨hcb, hcz, hcA⟩ := hcm
  obtain ⟨hbz, hbA⟩ := hbm
  
  have hrnd : r.Nodup := by
    have := hv.nodup; rw [hvsplit] at this; exact (List.nodup_append.mp this).2.1
  
  have hmemv : ∀ {w : ℕ}, w ∈ (c :: b :: z :: A') → w ∈ v := by
    intro w hw
    rw [← List.mem_toFinset, hv.toFinset_eq, ← hx.toFinset_eq]; exact List.mem_toFinset.mpr hw
  have hzr : z ∈ r := by
    have := hmemv (w := z) (by simp); rw [hvsplit, List.mem_append] at this
    exact this.resolve_left hzm
  have hbr : b ∈ r := by
    have := hmemv (w := b) (by simp); rw [hvsplit, List.mem_append] at this
    exact this.resolve_left hbA
  have hcr : c ∈ r := by
    have := hmemv (w := c) (by simp); rw [hvsplit, List.mem_append] at this
    exact this.resolve_left hcA
  
  have hcard3 : ({z, b, c} : Finset ℕ).card = 3 := by
    rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem (by simp [Ne.symm hbz, Ne.symm hcz]),
      Finset.card_insert_of_notMem (by simp [Ne.symm hcb]), Finset.card_singleton]
  have hsub : ({z, b, c} : Finset ℕ) ⊆ r.toFinset := by
    intro w hw; simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hw
    rcases hw with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact List.mem_toFinset.mpr hzr
    · exact List.mem_toFinset.mpr hbr
    · exact List.mem_toFinset.mpr hcr
  have hrtf : ({z, b, c} : Finset ℕ) = r.toFinset :=
    Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub
      (by rw [hcard3]; exact le_trans (List.toFinset_card_le r) (le_of_eq hrlen))
  
  obtain ⟨r0, r1, r2, hr⟩ := List.length_eq_three.mp hrlen
  have hmem : ∀ {w : ℕ}, w ∈ r → w = z ∨ w = b ∨ w = c := by
    intro w hw
    have : w ∈ ({z, b, c} : Finset ℕ) := hrtf ▸ List.mem_toFinset.mpr hw
    simpa only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] using this
  have m0 := hmem (show r0 ∈ r by rw [hr]; simp)
  have m1 := hmem (show r1 ∈ r by rw [hr]; simp)
  have m2 := hmem (show r2 ∈ r by rw [hr]; simp)
  
  rw [hr, List.nodup_cons, List.nodup_cons, List.nodup_cons] at hrnd
  simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false, not_or] at hrnd
  obtain ⟨⟨hr01, hr02⟩, hr12, _⟩ := hrnd
  
  rw [hvsplit, hr]
  rcases m0 with h0 | h0 | h0 <;> rcases m1 with h1 | h1 | h1 <;> rcases m2 with h2 | h2 | h2 <;>
    subst h0 <;> subst h1 <;> subst h2 <;>
    first
      | exact absurd rfl hr01
      | exact absurd rfl hr02
      | exact absurd rfl hr12
      | tauto

name: Hunter.ProofsClosure3.chart_closure_w3
statement:
theorem chart_closure_w3 (hs : IsPermWord (A'.length + 3) (A' ++ [z, b, c]))
    {v : List ℕ} (hv : IsPermWord (A'.length + 3) v)
    (hover : (finalExit A' z b c).drop 3 = v.take (A'.length + 3 - 3)) :
    VisitedByChart A' z b c (rotClass v)
proof:
:= by
  have hx : IsPermWord (A'.length + 3) (finalExit A' z b c) := isPermWord_finalExit A' z b c hs
  rcases w3_six_cases A' z b c hx hv hover with h | h | h | h | h | h
  · rw [h]; exact visited_V1 A' z b c
  · rw [h]; exact visited_V2 A' z b c
  · rw [h]; exact visited_V3 A' z b c
  · rw [h]; exact visited_V4 A' z b c
  · rw [h]; exact visited_V5 A' z b c
  · rw [h]; exact visited_V6 A' z b c

name: Hunter.ProofsClosure3.chart_closure
statement:
theorem chart_closure (hn : 1 ≤ A'.length)
    (hs : IsPermWord (A'.length + 3) (A' ++ [z, b, c]))
    {v : List ℕ} (hv : IsPermWord (A'.length + 3) v)
    (hvis : ¬ VisitedByChart A' z b c (rotClass v)) :
    4 ≤ wt (A'.length + 3) (finalExit A' z b c) v
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hlt
  have hx : IsPermWord (A'.length + 3) (finalExit A' z b c) := isPermWord_finalExit A' z b c hs
  have hk : (1 : ℕ) ≤ A'.length + 3 := by omega
  obtain ⟨h1, _, hov⟩ := wt_spec (u := finalExit A' z b c) (v := v) hk (le_of_eq hx.length)
  have hval : wt (A'.length + 3) (finalExit A' z b c) v = 1 ∨
      wt (A'.length + 3) (finalExit A' z b c) v = 2 ∨
      wt (A'.length + 3) (finalExit A' z b c) v = 3 := by omega
  rcases hval with hw | hw | hw
  · 
    apply hvis
    rw [eq_rho_of_wt_one hk hx hv hw,
      show rho (finalExit A' z b c) = (finalExit A' z b c).rotate 1 from rfl, rotClass_rotate]
    exact visited_finalExit A' z b c
  · 
    exact hvis (chart_closure_w2 A' z b c hs hv (by rw [hw] at hov; exact hov))
  · 
    exact hvis (chart_closure_w3 A' z b c hs hv (by rw [hw] at hov; exact hov))

name: Hunter.Proved.chart_closure
statement:
theorem chart_closure (A' : List ℕ) (z b c : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ A'.length)
    (hs : IsPermWord (A'.length + 3) (A' ++ [z, b, c]))
    {v : List ℕ} (hv : IsPermWord (A'.length + 3) v)
    (hvis : ¬ ChartVisited A' z b c (rotClass v)) :
    4 ≤ wt (A'.length + 3) (Hunter.ProofsClosure3.finalExit A' z b c) v
proof:
:=
  Hunter.ProofsClosure3.chart_closure A' z b c hn hs hv hvis

name: Hunter.Proved.chart_closure_w2
statement:
theorem chart_closure_w2 (A' : List ℕ) (z b c : ℕ)
    (hs : IsPermWord (A'.length + 3) (A' ++ [z, b, c]))
    {v : List ℕ} (hv : IsPermWord (A'.length + 3) v)
    (hover : (Hunter.ProofsClosure3.finalExit A' z b c).drop 2 = v.take (A'.length + 3 - 2)) :
    ChartVisited A' z b c (rotClass v)
proof:
:=
  Hunter.ProofsClosure3.chart_closure_w2 A' z b c hs hv hover

name: Hunter.Proved.chart_closure_w3
statement:
theorem chart_closure_w3 (A' : List ℕ) (z b c : ℕ)
    (hs : IsPermWord (A'.length + 3) (A' ++ [z, b, c]))
    {v : List ℕ} (hv : IsPermWord (A'.length + 3) v)
    (hover : (Hunter.ProofsClosure3.finalExit A' z b c).drop 3 = v.take (A'.length + 3 - 3)) :
    ChartVisited A' z b c (rotClass v)
proof:
:=
  Hunter.ProofsClosure3.chart_closure_w3 A' z b c hs hv hover

name: Hunter.ProofsPotential.Dfr_base
statement: theorem Dfr_base {a : ℕ} (ha : a ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : Dfr k a = (a - 1) / (k - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Dfr]
  rw [dif_neg]
  rintro ⟨h1, _⟩
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsPotential.Dfr_shift_rec
statement:
theorem Dfr_shift_rec (hk : 3 ≤ k) {a : ℕ} (ha : (k - 1) * (k - 2) < a) :
    Dfr k a = Dfr k (a - Mper k) + (k - 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : 2 ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by
    have := Nat.mul_le_mul (show 2 ≤ k - 1 by omega) (show 1 ≤ k - 2 by omega); omega
  rw [Dfr]
  rw [dif_pos ⟨ha, h2⟩]
  rfl

name: Hunter.ProofsPotential.Dfr_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem Dfr_zero : Dfr k 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Dfr_base (Nat.zero_le _)]; simp

name: Hunter.ProofsPotential.Dfr_one
statement: @[simp] theorem Dfr_one (hk : 3 ≤ k) : Dfr k 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : 2 ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by
    have := Nat.mul_le_mul (show 2 ≤ k - 1 by omega) (show 1 ≤ k - 2 by omega); omega
  rw [Dfr_base (by omega)]; simp

name: Hunter.ProofsPotential.Mper_pos
statement: theorem Mper_pos (hk : 3 ≤ k) : 0 < Mper k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, k = m + 3 := ⟨k - 3, by omega⟩
  simp only [Mper]
  have h2 : (m + 3 - 1) * (m + 3 - 2) = m * m + 3 * m + 2 := by
    have : (m + 3 - 1) * (m + 3 - 2) = (m + 2) * (m + 1) := by
      congr 1
    rw [this]; ring
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsPotential.Mper_div
statement: theorem Mper_div (hk : 3 ≤ k) : Mper k / (k - 1) = k - 3
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, k = m + 3 := ⟨k - 3, by omega⟩
  simp only [Mper]
  have hm : (m + 3 - 1) * (m + 3 - 2) - 1 = (m + 1) + (m + 2) * m := by
    have : (m + 3 - 1) * (m + 3 - 2) = (m + 1) + (m + 2) * m + 1 := by
      have e : (m + 3 - 1) * (m + 3 - 2) = (m + 2) * (m + 1) := by
        congr 1
      rw [e]; ring
    omega
  have hk1 : m + 3 - 1 = m + 2 := by omega
  rw [hm, hk1, Nat.add_mul_div_left _ _ (by omega : 0 < m + 2), Nat.div_eq_of_lt (by omega),
      Nat.zero_add]
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsPotential.Mper_mod
statement: theorem Mper_mod (hk : 3 ≤ k) : Mper k % (k - 1) = k - 2
proof:
:= by
  have hdm := Nat.div_add_mod (Mper k) (k - 1)
  rw [Mper_div hk] at hdm
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, k = m + 3 := ⟨k - 3, by omega⟩
  simp only [Mper] at hdm ⊢
  have e : (m + 3 - 1) * (m + 3 - 2) - 1 = (m + 1) + (m + 2) * m := by
    have h2 : (m + 3 - 1) * (m + 3 - 2) = (m + 1) + (m + 2) * m + 1 := by
      have ee : (m + 3 - 1) * (m + 3 - 2) = (m + 2) * (m + 1) := by
        congr 1
      rw [ee]; ring
    omega
  rw [e] at hdm ⊢
  simp only [show m + 3 - 1 = m + 2 from by omega, show m + 3 - 3 = m from by omega,
    show m + 3 - 2 = m + 1 from by omega] at hdm ⊢
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsPotential.prod_ge
statement: theorem prod_ge (hk : 4 ≤ k) : 6 ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2)
proof:
:= by
  have := Nat.mul_le_mul (show 3 ≤ k - 1 by omega) (show 2 ≤ k - 2 by omega); omega

name: Hunter.ProofsPotential.Dfr_two
statement: theorem Dfr_two (hk : 4 ≤ k) : Dfr k 2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Dfr_base (by have := prod_ge hk; omega)]
  exact Nat.div_eq_of_lt (by omega)

name: Hunter.ProofsPotential.Dfr_shift_exact
statement:
theorem Dfr_shift_exact (hk : 3 ≤ k) {x : ℕ} (hx : 2 ≤ x) :
    Dfr k (x + Mper k) = Dfr k x + (k - 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hlt : (k - 1) * (k - 2) < x + Mper k := by simp only [Mper]; omega
  rw [Dfr_shift_rec hk hlt]
  congr 2
  simp only [Mper]; omega

name: Hunter.ProofsPotential.Dfr_le_succ
statement: theorem Dfr_le_succ (hk : 4 ≤ k) (a : ℕ) : Dfr k a ≤ Dfr k (a + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction a using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ a ih =>
    have hP := prod_ge hk
    have hMdef : Mper k = (k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1 := rfl
    by_cases hbase : a + 1 ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2)
    · rw [Dfr_base (by omega), Dfr_base hbase]
      exact Nat.div_le_div_right (by omega)
    · by_cases hbig : (k - 1) * (k - 2) < a
      · rw [Dfr_shift_rec (by omega) hbig,
            Dfr_shift_rec (by omega) (by omega : (k - 1) * (k - 2) < a + 1)]
        have hmp := Mper_pos (show 3 ≤ k by omega)
        have hMlt : Mper k ≤ a := by omega
        have hdec : a - Mper k < a := by omega
        have hstep : a + 1 - Mper k = (a - Mper k) + 1 := by omega
        rw [hstep]
        exact Nat.add_le_add_right (ih (a - Mper k) hdec) _
      · have haeq : a = (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by omega
        have hlhs : Dfr k a = k - 3 := by
          rw [Dfr_base (le_of_eq haeq), haeq]; exact Mper_div (by omega)
        have hrhs : Dfr k (a + 1) = k - 2 := by
          rw [Dfr_shift_rec (by omega) (by omega : (k - 1) * (k - 2) < a + 1)]
          have : a + 1 - Mper k = 2 := by simp only [Mper]; omega
          rw [this, Dfr_two hk, Nat.zero_add]
        omega

name: Hunter.ProofsPotential.Dfr_succ_le
statement: theorem Dfr_succ_le (hk : 4 ≤ k) (a : ℕ) : Dfr k (a + 1) ≤ Dfr k a + 1
proof:
:= by
  induction a using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ a ih =>
    have hP := prod_ge hk
    have hMdef : Mper k = (k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1 := rfl
    by_cases hbase : a + 1 ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2)
    · rw [Dfr_base hbase, Dfr_base (show a ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2) by omega)]
      calc (a + 1 - 1) / (k - 1) ≤ ((a - 1) + (k - 1)) / (k - 1) :=
            Nat.div_le_div_right (by omega)
        _ = (a - 1) / (k - 1) + 1 := Nat.add_div_right _ (by omega)
    · by_cases hbig : (k - 1) * (k - 2) < a
      · rw [Dfr_shift_rec (by omega) hbig,
            Dfr_shift_rec (by omega) (by omega : (k - 1) * (k - 2) < a + 1)]
        have hmp := Mper_pos (show 3 ≤ k by omega)
        have hMlt : Mper k ≤ a := by omega
        have hdec : a - Mper k < a := by omega
        have hstep : a + 1 - Mper k = (a - Mper k) + 1 := by omega
        rw [hstep]
        have := ih (a - Mper k) hdec
        omega
      · have haeq : a = (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by omega
        have hlhs : Dfr k a = k - 3 := by
          rw [Dfr_base (le_of_eq haeq), haeq]; exact Mper_div (by omega)
        have hrhs : Dfr k (a + 1) = k - 2 := by
          rw [Dfr_shift_rec (by omega) (by omega : (k - 1) * (k - 2) < a + 1)]
          have : a + 1 - Mper k = 2 := by omega
          rw [this, Dfr_two hk, Nat.zero_add]
        omega

name: Hunter.ProofsPotential.Dfr_mono
statement: theorem Dfr_mono (hk : 4 ≤ k) {a b : ℕ} (h : a ≤ b) : Dfr k a ≤ Dfr k b
proof:
:= by
  induction b, h using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => exact le_refl _
  | succ n _ ih => exact le_trans ih (Dfr_le_succ hk n)

name: Hunter.ProofsPotential.Dfr_window
statement:
theorem Dfr_window (hk : 4 ≤ k) {x : ℕ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    Dfr k x + 1 ≤ Dfr k (x + (k - 1))
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ x ih =>
    have hP := prod_ge hk
    have hMdef : Mper k = (k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1 := rfl
    by_cases hbase : x + (k - 1) ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2)
    · rw [Dfr_base (by omega), Dfr_base hbase]
      have he : x + (k - 1) - 1 = (x - 1) + (k - 1) := by omega
      rw [he, Nat.add_div_right _ (by omega : 0 < k - 1)]
    · by_cases hbig : (k - 1) * (k - 2) < x
      · rw [Dfr_shift_rec (by omega) hbig,
            Dfr_shift_rec (by omega) (by omega : (k - 1) * (k - 2) < x + (k - 1))]
        have hmp := Mper_pos (show 3 ≤ k by omega)
        have hMlt : Mper k ≤ x := by omega
        have hstep : x + (k - 1) - Mper k = (x - Mper k) + (k - 1) := by omega
        rw [hstep]
        have hdec : x - Mper k < x := by omega
        have hpos : 1 ≤ x - Mper k := by omega
        have := ih (x - Mper k) hdec hpos
        omega
      · 
        have hlhs : Dfr k x ≤ k - 3 := by
          rw [Dfr_base (by omega)]
          calc (x - 1) / (k - 1) ≤ ((k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1) / (k - 1) :=
                Nat.div_le_div_right (by omega)
            _ = k - 3 := Mper_div (by omega)
        have hrhs : k - 2 ≤ Dfr k (x + (k - 1)) := by
          rw [Dfr_shift_rec (by omega) (by omega : (k - 1) * (k - 2) < x + (k - 1))]
          omega
        omega

name: Hunter.ProofsPotential.Dfr_floor
statement:
theorem Dfr_floor (hk : 4 ≤ k) {x : ℕ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) (W : ℕ) :
    Dfr k x + W / (k - 1) ≤ Dfr k (x + W)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ q : ℕ, Dfr k x + q ≤ Dfr k (x + (k - 1) * q) := by
    intro q
    induction q with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
      have hstep : x + (k - 1) * (n + 1) = (x + (k - 1) * n) + (k - 1) := by ring
      rw [hstep]
      have hw := Dfr_window hk (show 1 ≤ x + (k - 1) * n by omega)
      omega
  have hq := key (W / (k - 1))
  have hle : W / (k - 1) * (k - 1) ≤ W := Nat.div_mul_le_self W (k - 1)
  have hmono := Dfr_mono hk (show x + (k - 1) * (W / (k - 1)) ≤ x + W by
    rw [Nat.mul_comm]; omega)
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsPotential.Wpot_ge
statement:
theorem Wpot_ge (hk : 4 ≤ k) {d j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ k - 3) (hd : d ≤ k - 2) :
    (k - 1) * (k - 3 - j) ≤ Wpot k d j
proof:
:= by
  have hWdef : Wpot k d j = (k - 1) * (k - 2 - j) - 1 - d := rfl
  have hsplit : (k - 1) * (k - 2 - j) = (k - 1) * (k - 3 - j) + (k - 1) := by
    rw [show k - 2 - j = (k - 3 - j) + 1 from by omega, Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one]
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsPotential.Dfr_add_Wpot_ge
statement:
theorem Dfr_add_Wpot_ge (hk : 4 ≤ k) {b d j : ℕ} (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hj : j ≤ k - 3) (hd : d ≤ k - 2) :
    Dfr k b + (k - 3 - j) ≤ Dfr k (b + Wpot k d j)
proof:
:= by
  have hfloor := Dfr_floor hk hb (Wpot k d j)
  have hWlb := Wpot_ge hk hj hd
  have hdiv : (k - 3 - j) ≤ Wpot k d j / (k - 1) := by
    rw [Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (by omega : 0 < k - 1)]
    calc (k - 3 - j) * (k - 1) = (k - 1) * (k - 3 - j) := by ring
      _ ≤ Wpot k d j := hWlb
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsPotential.hpot_val
statement:
theorem hpot_val (hk : 4 ≤ k) {b d j : ℕ} (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hj : j ≤ k - 3) (hd : d ≤ k - 2) :
    hpot k d j b + (k - 3 - j) + Dfr k b = Dfr k (b + Wpot k d j)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Dfr_add_Wpot_ge hk hb hj hd
  have hm : Dfr k b ≤ Dfr k (b + Wpot k d j) :=
    Dfr_mono hk (by omega)
  simp only [hpot]
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsPotential.hpot_00
statement: theorem hpot_00 (hk : 4 ≤ k) {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 ≤ b) : hpot k 0 0 (b + 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hv := hpot_val hk (show 1 ≤ b + 1 by omega) (show (0 : ℕ) ≤ k - 3 by omega)
    (show (0 : ℕ) ≤ k - 2 by omega)
  have hW : Wpot k 0 0 = Mper k := by simp only [Wpot, Mper, Nat.sub_zero]
  rw [hW, Dfr_shift_exact (show 3 ≤ k by omega) (show 2 ≤ b + 1 by omega)] at hv
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsPotential.door_ineq
statement:
theorem door_ineq (hk : 4 ≤ k) {b d j : ℕ} (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hd : d < k - 2) (hj : j ≤ k - 3) :
    hpot k (d + 1) j (b + 1) + Dfr k (b + 1) ≤ hpot k d j b + Dfr k b
proof:
:= by
  have hAlb : k - 1 ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2 - j) := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right (k - 1) (by omega)
  have h1 : Wpot k d j = (k - 1) * (k - 2 - j) - 1 - d := rfl
  have h2 : Wpot k (d + 1) j = (k - 1) * (k - 2 - j) - 1 - (d + 1) := rfl
  have hidx : (b + 1) + Wpot k (d + 1) j = b + Wpot k d j := by omega
  have v1 := hpot_val hk hb hj (by omega : d ≤ k - 2)
  have v2 := hpot_val hk (show 1 ≤ b + 1 by omega) hj (by omega : d + 1 ≤ k - 2)
  rw [hidx] at v2
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsPotential.alpha_ineq
statement:
theorem alpha_ineq (hk : 4 ≤ k) {b j : ℕ} (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hj : j ≤ k - 4) :
    hpot k 0 (j + 1) (b + 1) + Dfr k (b + 1) ≤ 1 + hpot k (k - 2) j b + Dfr k b
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit : (k - 1) * (k - 2 - j) = (k - 1) * (k - 3 - j) + (k - 1) := by
    rw [show k - 2 - j = (k - 3 - j) + 1 from by omega, Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one]
  have hQlb : k - 1 ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 3 - j) := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right (k - 1) (by omega)
  have h1 : Wpot k (k - 2) j = (k - 1) * (k - 2 - j) - 1 - (k - 2) := rfl
  have h2 : Wpot k 0 (j + 1) = (k - 1) * (k - 2 - (j + 1)) - 1 - 0 := rfl
  have h3 : k - 2 - (j + 1) = k - 3 - j := by omega
  rw [h3] at h2
  have hidx : (b + 1) + Wpot k 0 (j + 1) = b + Wpot k (k - 2) j := by
    rw [h1, h2, hsplit]; omega
  have v1 := hpot_val hk hb (by omega : j ≤ k - 3) (by omega : k - 2 ≤ k - 2)
  have v2 := hpot_val hk (show 1 ≤ b + 1 by omega) (by omega : j + 1 ≤ k - 3)
    (by omega : (0 : ℕ) ≤ k - 2)
  rw [hidx] at v2
  have hcred : k - 3 - j = (k - 3 - (j + 1)) + 1 := by omega
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsPotential.heavy_ineq
statement:
theorem heavy_ineq (hk : 4 ≤ k) {b d j : ℕ} (hb : 1 ≤ b) (_hd : d ≤ k - 2)
    (_hj : j ≤ k - 3) :
    hpot k 0 0 (b + 1) + Dfr k (b + 1) ≤ 2 + hpot k d j b + Dfr k b
proof:
:= by
  have h00 := hpot_00 hk hb
  have hle := Dfr_succ_le hk b
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsPotential.reset_ineq
statement:
theorem reset_ineq (hk : 4 ≤ k) {b d j : ℕ} (hb : 1 ≤ b) (hd : d ≤ k - 3) (hj : j ≤ k - 3) :
    hpot k 0 0 (b + 1) + Dfr k (b + 1) ≤ 1 + hpot k d j b + Dfr k b
proof:
:= by
  have h00 := hpot_00 hk hb
  have v1 := hpot_val hk hb hj (by omega : d ≤ k - 2)
  have hsplit : (k - 1) * (k - 2 - j) = (k - 1) * (k - 3 - j) + (k - 1) := by
    rw [show k - 2 - j = (k - 3 - j) + 1 from by omega, Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one]
  have hWdef : Wpot k d j = (k - 1) * (k - 2 - j) - 1 - d := rfl
  have hWval : Wpot k d j = (k - 1) * (k - 3 - j) + (k - 2 - d) := by rw [hWdef, hsplit]; omega
  have hWge1 : 1 ≤ Wpot k d j := by rw [hWval]; omega
  have hidx : b + Wpot k d j = (b + 1) + (Wpot k d j - 1) := by rw [hWval]; omega
  have hWm1 : (k - 1) * (k - 3 - j) ≤ Wpot k d j - 1 := by rw [hWval]; omega
  have hdiv : (k - 3 - j) ≤ (Wpot k d j - 1) / (k - 1) := by
    rw [Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (by omega : 0 < k - 1)]
    calc (k - 3 - j) * (k - 1) = (k - 1) * (k - 3 - j) := by ring
      _ ≤ Wpot k d j - 1 := hWm1
  have hfloor := Dfr_floor hk (show 1 ≤ b + 1 by omega) (Wpot k d j - 1)
  rw [← hidx] at hfloor
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsPotential.potential_certificate
statement:
theorem potential_certificate (hk : 4 ≤ k) {b d j : ℕ} (hb : 1 ≤ b) :
    
    (d < k - 2 → j ≤ k - 3 →
      hpot k (d + 1) j (b + 1) + Dfr k (b + 1) ≤ hpot k d j b + Dfr k b) ∧
    
    (j ≤ k - 4 →
      hpot k 0 (j + 1) (b + 1) + Dfr k (b + 1) ≤ 1 + hpot k (k - 2) j b + Dfr k b) ∧
    
    (d ≤ k - 2 → j ≤ k - 3 →
      hpot k 0 0 (b + 1) + Dfr k (b + 1) ≤ 2 + hpot k d j b + Dfr k b) ∧
    
    (d ≤ k - 3 → j ≤ k - 3 →
      hpot k 0 0 (b + 1) + Dfr k (b + 1) ≤ 1 + hpot k d j b + Dfr k b)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hd hj => door_ineq hk hb hd hj,
   fun hj => alpha_ineq hk hb hj,
   fun hd hj => heavy_ineq hk hb hd hj,
   fun hd hj => reset_ineq hk hb hd hj⟩

name: Hunter.Proved.excess_frontier_final
statement: theorem excess_frontier_final {k : ℕ} (hM1 : M1WalkBound k) : ExcessFrontier k
proof:
:=
  ProofsM1.excessFrontier_of_m1 hM1

name: Hunter.Proved.thm2
statement:
theorem thm2 {k ℓ : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hM1 : M1WalkBound k) (hℓ : HasExitlessPath k ℓ) :
    j k ℓ ≤ iExitless k ℓ
proof:
:=
  Proved.thm2_of_m1 hk hM1 hℓ

name: Hunter.Proved.thm1v1_final
statement:
theorem thm1v1_final (hM1 : Proved.M1WalkBoundAll)
    (hproof : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) →
        (L k : ℝ) ≥ (iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ)
          + (((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
              (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)))
            * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ)))
    (hexists : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2))) :
    ∃ (C : ℝ) (k₀ : ℕ), ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k →
      (Lstar k : ℝ) ≥ coeff k * (k.factorial : ℝ) + (k : ℝ) - C
proof:
:=
  Proved.thm1v1_of_m1 hM1 hproof hexists

name: Hunter.Proved.thm1v2_final
statement:
theorem thm1v2_final (hM1 : Proved.M1WalkBoundAll)
    (hproof : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) →
        (L k : ℝ) ≥ (iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ)
          + (((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
              (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)))
            * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ)))
    (hexists : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2))) :
    ∃ (C : ℝ) (k₀ : ℕ), ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k → (L k : ℝ) ≥ coeff k * (k.factorial : ℝ) - C
proof:
:=
  Proved.thm1v2_of_m1 hM1 hproof hexists

name: Hunter.Proved.eq_weak_final
statement:
theorem eq_weak_final (hM1 : Proved.M1WalkBoundAll)
    (hproof : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) →
        (L k : ℝ) ≥ (iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ)
          + (((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
              (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)))
            * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ)))
    (hexists : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2))) :
    ∃ (C : ℝ) (k₀ : ℕ), ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k →
      (Lstar k : ℝ) ≥ (k.factorial : ℝ) + ((k - 1).factorial : ℝ) + ((k - 2).factorial : ℝ)
        + ((k - 4).factorial : ℝ) - 2 * ((k - 5).factorial : ℝ) - C * ((k - 6).factorial : ℝ)
proof:
:=
  ProofsMF.eq_weak_of_MF (Proved.frontierTightHeavyAll_of_m1All hM1) hproof hexists

name: Hunter.ProofsChartEq.chartWord_perm
statement:
theorem chartWord_perm (A' : List ℕ) (z b c : ℕ) (j i : ℕ) :
    chartWord A' z b c j i ~ A' ++ [z, b, c]
proof:
:= by
  unfold chartWord
  have h1 : ((A' ++ [z]).rotate j ++ [b]).rotate i ++ [c]
      ~ ((A' ++ [z]).rotate j ++ [b]) ++ [c] :=
    (List.perm_append_right_iff _).mpr (List.rotate_perm _ i)
  refine h1.trans ?_
  have h2 : (A' ++ [z]).rotate j ~ A' ++ [z] := List.rotate_perm _ j
  calc (A' ++ [z]).rotate j ++ [b] ++ [c]
      ~ (A' ++ [z]) ++ [b] ++ [c] := ((h2.append_right [b]).append_right [c])
    _ = A' ++ [z, b, c] := by simp

name: Hunter.ProofsChartEq.chartWord_isPermWord
proof:
:=
  hs.perm (chartWord_perm A' z b c j i).symm

name: Hunter.ProofsChartEq.start_split
statement:
theorem start_split (A' : List ℕ) (z b c : ℕ) :
    A' ++ [z, b, c] = (A' ++ [z]) ++ [b, c]
proof: := by simp

name: Hunter.ProofsChartEq.A_nodup
statement:
theorem A_nodup {A' : List ℕ} {z b c : ℕ}
    (hs : IsPermWord (A'.length + 3) (A' ++ [z, b, c])) : (A' ++ [z]).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  have hnd := hs.nodup
  rw [start_split] at hnd
  exact (List.nodup_append.mp hnd).1

name: Hunter.ProofsChartEq.b_notMem_A
statement:
theorem b_notMem_A {A' : List ℕ} {z b c : ℕ}
    (hs : IsPermWord (A'.length + 3) (A' ++ [z, b, c])) : b ∉ (A' ++ [z])
proof:
:= by
  have hnd := hs.nodup
  rw [start_split] at hnd
  have hdisj := (List.nodup_append.mp hnd).2.2
  intro hmem
  exact hdisj b hmem b (by simp) rfl

name: Hunter.ProofsChartEq.chart_distinct
statement:
theorem chart_distinct {A' : List ℕ} {z b c : ℕ}
    (hs : IsPermWord (A'.length + 3) (A' ++ [z, b, c]))
    {j i j' i' : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ A'.length + 1) (hi' : i' ≤ A'.length + 1)
    (hj : j ≤ A'.length) (hj' : j' ≤ A'.length)
    (heq : rotClass (chartWord A' z b c j i) = rotClass (chartWord A' z b c j' i')) :
    j = j' ∧ i = i'
proof:
:= by
  set k := A'.length + 3 with hk
  set A := A' ++ [z] with hA
  have hAlen : A.length = A'.length + 1 := by rw [hA]; simp
  have hAnd : A.Nodup := A_nodup hs
  have hbA : b ∉ A := b_notMem_A hs
  
  set W := (A.rotate j ++ [b]).rotate i with hW
  set W' := (A.rotate j' ++ [b]).rotate i' with hW'
  have hWlen : W.length = A'.length + 2 := by
    rw [hW, List.length_rotate, List.length_append, List.length_rotate, hAlen]; simp
  have hW'len : W'.length = A'.length + 2 := by
    rw [hW', List.length_rotate, List.length_append, List.length_rotate, hAlen]; simp
  have hcw : chartWord A' z b c j i = W ++ [c] := rfl
  have hcw' : chartWord A' z b c j' i' = W' ++ [c] := rfl
  have hnd_c : (W ++ [c]).Nodup := by rw [← hcw]; exact (chartWord_isPermWord hs j i).nodup
  
  rw [hcw, hcw'] at heq
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := rotClass_eq_iff.mp heq
  have hlen_c : (W ++ [c]).length = k := by rw [List.length_append, hWlen, hk]; simp
  
  have htmod : (W ++ [c]).rotate (t % k) = (W ++ [c]).rotate t := by
    conv_rhs => rw [← List.rotate_mod (W ++ [c]) t]
    rw [hlen_c]
  have ha_le : t % k ≤ W.length := by
    have : t % k < k := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
    rw [hWlen]; omega
  have houter : (W ++ [c]).rotate (t % k) = (W' ++ [c]).rotate 0 := by
    rw [htmod, ht, List.rotate_zero]
  obtain ⟨_, hWW⟩ := ProofsGreedy2.marker_pins hnd_c (hWlen.trans hW'len.symm)
    ha_le (by omega) houter
  
  rw [hW, hW'] at hWW
  have hnd_b : (A.rotate j ++ [b]).Nodup := by
    rw [List.nodup_append]
    refine ⟨(List.rotate_perm A j).nodup_iff.mpr hAnd, List.nodup_singleton b, ?_⟩
    intro x hx y hy
    rw [List.mem_singleton] at hy; subst hy
    intro hxy; subst hxy
    exact hbA ((List.rotate_perm A j).mem_iff.mp hx)
  have hrjlen : (A.rotate j).length = (A.rotate j').length := by
    rw [List.length_rotate, List.length_rotate]
  have hi_le : i ≤ (A.rotate j).length := by rw [List.length_rotate, hAlen]; omega
  have hi'_le : i' ≤ (A.rotate j').length := by rw [List.length_rotate, hAlen]; omega
  obtain ⟨hii, hAjj⟩ := ProofsGreedy2.marker_pins hnd_b hrjlen hi_le hi'_le hWW
  
  have hj_lt : j < A.length := by rw [hAlen]; omega
  have hj'_lt : j' < A.length := by rw [hAlen]; omega
  exact ⟨rotate_injOn_lt hAnd hj_lt hj'_lt hAjj, hii⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsChartEq.run_iter
statement:
theorem run_iter {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) {q : ℕ → List ℕ} (t₀ M : ℕ)
    (hperm : ∀ s, IsPermWord k (q s))
    (hdist : ∀ i, i < M → rotClass (q (t₀ + i + 1)) ≠ rotClass (q (t₀ + i)))
    (hw2 : ∀ i, i < M → bwt k (q (t₀ + i)) (q (t₀ + i + 1)) = 2) :
    ∀ i, i ≤ M → q (t₀ + i) = (tau2 k)^[i] (q t₀)
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  induction i with
  | zero => intro _; simp
  | succ n ih =>
    intro hn
    have hnM : n < M := by omega
    have hstep : q (t₀ + n + 1) = tau2 k (q (t₀ + n)) :=
      fresh_w2_forced hk (hperm _) (hperm _) (hw2 n hnM) (hdist n hnM)
    rw [show t₀ + (n + 1) = t₀ + n + 1 from by ring, hstep, ih (by omega),
      Function.iterate_succ_apply' (tau2 k) n (q t₀)]

name: Hunter.ProofsChartEq.chartWord_eq_runW
statement:
theorem chartWord_eq_runW (A' : List ℕ) (z b c j i : ℕ) :
    chartWord A' z b c j i = runW ((A' ++ [z]).rotate j) b c i
proof: := rfl

name: Hunter.ProofsChartEq.tight_is_chart
statement:
theorem tight_is_chart {A' : List ℕ} {z b c : ℕ}
    {q : ℕ → List ℕ}
    (hperm : ∀ s, IsPermWord (A'.length + 3) (q s))
    (hstart : q 0 = A' ++ [z, b, c])
    (hdist : ∀ s t, s < (A'.length + 2) * (A'.length + 1) →
        t < (A'.length + 2) * (A'.length + 1) → s ≠ t → rotClass (q s) ≠ rotClass (q t))
    (hw2 : ∀ j i, j ≤ A'.length → i < A'.length + 1 →
        bwt (A'.length + 3) (q (j * (A'.length + 2) + i)) (q (j * (A'.length + 2) + i + 1)) = 2)
    (hw3 : ∀ j, j < A'.length →
        bwt (A'.length + 3) (q (j * (A'.length + 2) + (A'.length + 1)))
          (q (j * (A'.length + 2) + (A'.length + 1) + 1)) = 3) :
    ∀ j i, j ≤ A'.length → i ≤ A'.length + 1 →
      q (j * (A'.length + 2) + i) = chartWord A' z b c j i
proof:
:= by
  set n := A'.length with hn
  set A := A' ++ [z] with hA
  have hk2 : 2 ≤ n + 3 := by omega
  have hAlen : A.length = n + 1 := by
    rw [hA]; simp only [List.length_append, List.length_cons, List.length_nil]; omega
  
  have hpolyN : (n + 2) * (n + 1) = n * (n + 2) + (n + 1) + 1 := by ring
  have hblt : ∀ jj i, jj ≤ n → i ≤ n + 1 → jj * (n + 2) + i < (n + 2) * (n + 1) := by
    intro jj i hjj hi
    have h1 : jj * (n + 2) ≤ n * (n + 2) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hjj
    omega
  
  have hAjpw : ∀ jj, IsPermWord (n + 3) (A.rotate jj ++ [b, c]) := by
    intro jj
    have hstart' : IsPermWord (n + 3) (A ++ [b, c]) := by
      have := hperm 0; rw [hstart] at this; rw [hA]; simpa using this
    have hperm2 : A.rotate jj ++ [b, c] ~ A ++ [b, c] :=
      ((List.rotate_perm A jj).append_right [b, c])
    exact hstart'.perm hperm2.symm
  have hArotlen : ∀ jj, (A.rotate jj).length = n + 1 := by
    intro jj; rw [List.length_rotate, hAlen]
  have hArotlen2 : ∀ jj, (A.rotate jj).length = n + 3 - 2 := by
    intro jj; rw [hArotlen jj]; omega
  
  have hiter : ∀ jj, jj ≤ n → ∀ i, i ≤ n + 1 →
      q (jj * (n + 2) + i) = (tau2 (n + 3))^[i] (q (jj * (n + 2))) := by
    intro jj hjj
    refine run_iter hk2 (jj * (n + 2)) (n + 1) hperm ?_ ?_
    · intro i hi
      exact hdist _ _ (hblt jj (i + 1) hjj (by omega)) (hblt jj i hjj (by omega)) (by omega)
    · intro i hi; exact hw2 jj i hjj hi
  
  have hEntry : ∀ jj, jj ≤ n → q (jj * (n + 2)) = A.rotate jj ++ [b, c] →
      ∀ i, i ≤ n + 1 → q (jj * (n + 2) + i) = runW (A.rotate jj) b c i := by
    intro jj hjj hst i hi
    rw [hiter jj hjj i hi, hst, ← runW_eq_iter hk2 (hArotlen2 jj) b c i]
  
  have hrun : ∀ jj, jj ≤ n → q (jj * (n + 2)) = A.rotate jj ++ [b, c] := by
    intro jj
    induction jj with
    | zero => intro _; rw [Nat.zero_mul, List.rotate_zero, hstart, hA]; simp
    | succ j ih =>
      intro hj1
      have hjn : j < n := by omega
      have hjle : j ≤ n := by omega
      have hst_j : q (j * (n + 2)) = A.rotate j ++ [b, c] := ih hjle
      
      have hEj : ∀ i, i ≤ n + 1 → q (j * (n + 2) + i) = runW (A.rotate j) b c i :=
        hEntry j hjle hst_j
      
      obtain ⟨a₁, As, hAj⟩ : ∃ a₁ As, A.rotate j = a₁ :: As := by
        rcases hr : A.rotate j with _ | ⟨a₁, As⟩
        · exfalso; have := hArotlen j; rw [hr] at this; simp at this
        · exact ⟨a₁, As, rfl⟩
      have hAslen : As.length = n := by
        have := hArotlen j; rw [hAj] at this; simpa using this
      
      have hnextidx : (j + 1) * (n + 2) = j * (n + 2) + (n + 1) + 1 := by ring
      set v := q ((j + 1) * (n + 2)) with hvdef
      
      have hEj1 : ∀ i, i ≤ n + 1 → q ((j + 1) * (n + 2) + i) = (tau2 (n + 3))^[i] v :=
        hiter (j + 1) hj1
      
      have hlastentry : q (j * (n + 2) + (n + 1)) = runW (A.rotate j) b c (n + 1) :=
        hEj (n + 1) (le_refl _)
      have hbexit : bexit (n + 3) (runW (A.rotate j) b c (n + 1)) = c :: b :: A.rotate j := by
        have := bexit_runW_last (k := n + 3) (A := A.rotate j) hk2 (hArotlen2 j) b c
        rwa [hArotlen j] at this
      
      have hrunWpw : IsPermWord (n + 3) (runW (A.rotate j) b c (n + 1)) :=
        isPermWord_runW (hAjpw j) (n + 1)
      have hepw : IsPermWord (n + 3) (c :: b :: a₁ :: As) := by
        have := isPermWord_bexit hrunWpw
        rw [hbexit, hAj] at this; exact this
      
      have hwt3 : wt (n + 3) (c :: b :: a₁ :: As) v = 3 := by
        have h := hw3 j hjn
        rw [bwt, hlastentry, hbexit, hAj] at h
        rw [show j * (n + 2) + (n + 1) + 1 = (j + 1) * (n + 2) from by rw [hnextidx]] at h
        exact h
      have hover : (c :: b :: a₁ :: As).drop 3 = v.take As.length := by
        have hlen : (c :: b :: a₁ :: As).length ≤ n + 3 := by simp [hAslen]
        have hsp := (wt_spec (u := c :: b :: a₁ :: As) (v := v) (by omega) hlen).2.2
        rw [hwt3] at hsp
        rw [hAslen]; simpa using hsp
      
      have hvfresh : ¬ RunVisited (a₁ :: As) b c (rotClass v) := by
        rintro ⟨ii, hii, hiiv⟩
        rw [List.length_cons, hAslen] at hii
        have hqii : runW (a₁ :: As) b c ii = q (j * (n + 2) + ii) := by
          rw [← hAj, ← hEj ii hii]
        rw [hqii] at hiiv
        exact hdist ((j + 1) * (n + 2)) (j * (n + 2) + ii)
          (by simpa using hblt (j + 1) 0 hj1 (by omega))
          (hblt j ii hjle hii) (by rw [hnextidx]; omega) hiiv
      have hlast : ¬ RunVisited (a₁ :: As) b c
          (rotClass ((tau2 (As.length + 3))^[As.length] v)) := by
        rw [hAslen,
          show (tau2 (n + 3))^[n] v = q ((j + 1) * (n + 2) + n) from (hEj1 n (by omega)).symm]
        rintro ⟨ii, hii, hiiv⟩
        rw [List.length_cons, hAslen] at hii
        have hqii : runW (a₁ :: As) b c ii = q (j * (n + 2) + ii) := by
          rw [← hAj, ← hEj ii hii]
        rw [hqii] at hiiv
        exact hdist ((j + 1) * (n + 2) + n) (j * (n + 2) + ii)
          (hblt (j + 1) n hj1 (by omega)) (hblt j ii hjle hii)
          (by rw [hnextidx]; omega) hiiv
      
      have hkey := forced_step (As := As) (a₁ := a₁)
        (show IsPermWord (As.length + 3) (c :: b :: a₁ :: As) by rw [hAslen]; exact hepw)
        (v := v)
        (show IsPermWord (As.length + 3) v by rw [hAslen]; exact hperm ((j + 1) * (n + 2)))
        hover hvfresh hlast
      
      rw [hkey, runW_zero, ← hAj, List.rotate_rotate]
  
  intro j i hj hi
  rw [hEntry j hj (hrun j hj) i hi, chartWord_eq_runW]

name: Hunter.ProofsChartEq.chart_continuation_heavy
statement:
theorem chart_continuation_heavy {A' : List ℕ} {z b c : ℕ}
    (hn : 1 ≤ A'.length)
    (hs : IsPermWord (A'.length + 3) (A' ++ [z, b, c]))
    {q : ℕ → List ℕ}
    (hperm : ∀ s, IsPermWord (A'.length + 3) (q s))
    (hstart : q 0 = A' ++ [z, b, c])
    (hdist : ∀ s t, s < (A'.length + 2) * (A'.length + 1) →
        t < (A'.length + 2) * (A'.length + 1) → s ≠ t → rotClass (q s) ≠ rotClass (q t))
    (hw2 : ∀ j i, j ≤ A'.length → i < A'.length + 1 →
        bwt (A'.length + 3) (q (j * (A'.length + 2) + i)) (q (j * (A'.length + 2) + i + 1)) = 2)
    (hw3 : ∀ j, j < A'.length →
        bwt (A'.length + 3) (q (j * (A'.length + 2) + (A'.length + 1)))
          (q (j * (A'.length + 2) + (A'.length + 1) + 1)) = 3)
    (hfresh : ∀ t, t < (A'.length + 2) * (A'.length + 1) →
        rotClass (q ((A'.length + 2) * (A'.length + 1))) ≠ rotClass (q t)) :
    4 ≤ bwt (A'.length + 3) (q ((A'.length + 2) * (A'.length + 1) - 1))
          (q ((A'.length + 2) * (A'.length + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  set n := A'.length with hn'
  have hpolyN : (n + 2) * (n + 1) = n * (n + 2) + (n + 1) + 1 := by ring
  have hLidx : (n + 2) * (n + 1) - 1 = n * (n + 2) + (n + 1) := by omega
  have hblt : ∀ jj i, jj ≤ n → i ≤ n + 1 → jj * (n + 2) + i < (n + 2) * (n + 1) := by
    intro jj i hjj hi
    have h1 : jj * (n + 2) ≤ n * (n + 2) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hjj
    omega
  have hchart := tight_is_chart hperm hstart hdist hw2 hw3
  have hlast : q (n * (n + 2) + (n + 1)) = chartWord A' z b c n (n + 1) :=
    hchart n (n + 1) (le_refl _) (le_refl _)
  
  have hbexit_last :
      bexit (n + 3) (chartWord A' z b c n (n + 1)) = ProofsClosure3.finalExit A' z b c := by
    have hlen : (ProofsClosure3.finalExit A' z b c).length = n + 3 := by
      simp [ProofsClosure3.finalExit]; omega
    rw [bexit, ← ProofsClosure3.finalExit_rotate1, List.rotate_rotate,
      show 1 + (n + 3 - 1) = (ProofsClosure3.finalExit A' z b c).length by rw [hlen]; omega,
      List.rotate_length]
  
  have hvis : ¬ ProofsClosure3.VisitedByChart A' z b c (rotClass (q ((n + 2) * (n + 1)))) := by
    rintro ⟨j, i, hj, hi, hK⟩
    rw [← hchart j i hj hi] at hK
    exact hfresh (j * (n + 2) + i) (hblt j i hj hi) hK
  rw [hLidx, hlast, bwt, hbexit_last]
  exact ProofsClosure3.chart_closure A' z b c hn hs (hperm _) hvis

name: Hunter.ProofsChartEq.blockWord_isPermWord
statement:
theorem blockWord_isPermWord {k : ℕ} (p : HPath k) (t : ℕ) :
    IsPermWord k (blockWord p t)
proof: := (p.vert (k * t)).2

name: Hunter.ProofsChartEq.bw_eq_bwt
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t', rfl⟩ : ∃ t', t = t' + 1 := ⟨t - 1, by omega⟩
  have hms : k * (t' + 1) = k * t' + k := by ring
  have hB : k * t' + (k - 1) < p.numVerts := by omega
  
  have hcyc : p.vert (k * t' + (k - 1)) = sigma^[k - 1] (p.vert (k * t')) :=
    block_is_full_cycle hk hp (B := k * t') (r := k - 1) ⟨t', rfl⟩ (by omega) hB
  have hidx : k * t' + (k - 1) = k * (t' + 1) - 1 := by omega
  rw [hidx] at hcyc
  have hexitword : (p.vert (k * (t' + 1) - 1) : List ℕ) = bexit k (p.vert (k * t') : List ℕ) := by
    rw [hcyc, sigma_iter_val]; rfl
  simp only [ProofsLedger.bw, bwt, ew, blockWord, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  rw [hexitword]

name: Hunter.ProofsChartEq.blockWord_distinct
proof:
:= by
  wlog hlt : s < t generalizing s t
  · exact (this ht hs hst.symm (by omega)).symm
  have hle : k * s + k ≤ k * t := by
    have h := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) (show s + 1 ≤ t from by omega)
    simpa [Nat.mul_succ] using h
  have := no_reentry hk hp (B := k * s) (B' := k * t) ⟨s, rfl⟩ hle ht
  simpa [blockWord] using this

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta7.phiState_le_one
statement: theorem phiState_le_one (p : HPath k) : PhiState k p ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold PhiState
  split
  · exact Nat.zero_le _
  · split <;> simp

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta7.phiState_base
statement:
theorem phiState_base {p : HPath k} (hle : p.numVerts ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) :
    PhiState k p = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold PhiState; rw [if_pos hle]

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta7.baseBound_of_baseVanish
statement:
theorem baseBound_of_baseVanish {Φ : HPath k → ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k)
    (hbv : ∀ p : HPath k, p.numVerts ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) → Φ p = 0) :
    BaseBound k Φ
proof:
:= by
  intro p hpe h0 hle
  rw [hbv p hle, Nat.add_zero]
  exact ProofsRecursion.excess_frontier_base hk hpe h0 hle

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta7.baseBound_phiState
statement: theorem baseBound_phiState (hk : 3 ≤ k) : BaseBound k (PhiState k)
proof:
:=
  baseBound_of_baseVanish hk (fun _ hle => phiState_base hle)

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta7.metaWindowSupply_of_nonRelease
statement:
theorem metaWindowSupply_of_nonRelease {Φ : HPath k → ℕ}
    (hnr : NonReleaseSupply k Φ) : MetaWindowSupply k Φ
proof:
:= by
  intro p q hpe hqe hlt hprefix
  by_cases hrel : Φ p + 1 ≤ Φ q
  · exact Or.inl hrel
  · exact Or.inr (hnr p q hpe hqe hlt hprefix (by omega))

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta7.bkind_eq_door_iff
statement:
theorem bkind_eq_door_iff (p : HPath k) (i : ℕ) :
    bkind p i = BKind.door ↔ ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) = 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold bkind
  by_cases h2 : ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) = 2
  · rw [if_pos h2]; simp [h2]
  · rw [if_neg h2]
    constructor
    · intro h
      by_cases h3 : ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) = 3
      · rw [if_pos h3] at h; split at h <;> exact absurd h (by decide)
      · rw [if_neg h3] at h; exact absurd h (by decide)
    · intro h; exact absurd h h2

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta7.bkind_door_word
proof:
:= by
  have hw2 : ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) = 2 := (bkind_eq_door_iff p i).mp hk_door
  exact door_of_boundary (by omega : 2 ≤ k) hp hi hd hw2

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta7.bkind_contribution
statement:
theorem bkind_contribution (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) {i : ℕ}
    (hi : i + 1 < p.numVerts) (hd : k ∣ (i + 1)) :
    (bkind p i = BKind.door ∧ ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) - 2 = 0) ∨
    (bkind p i ≠ BKind.door ∧ ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) - 2 = 1) ∨
    (bkind p i ≠ BKind.door ∧ 2 ≤ ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) - 2)
proof:
:= by
  rcases boundary_classify hk hp hi hd with ⟨_, hw2⟩ | ⟨hw3, _⟩ | ⟨hw3, _⟩ | hw4
  · exact Or.inl ⟨(bkind_eq_door_iff p i).mpr hw2, by omega⟩
  · refine Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨?_, by omega⟩); rw [ne_eq, bkind_eq_door_iff]; omega
  · refine Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨?_, by omega⟩); rw [ne_eq, bkind_eq_door_iff]; omega
  · refine Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨?_, by omega⟩); rw [ne_eq, bkind_eq_door_iff]; omega

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta7.isDoorRun_ew
statement:
theorem isDoorRun_ew (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} {t s : ℕ} (h : IsDoorRun p t s) :
    ∀ r, 1 ≤ r → r ≤ s → ew k (p.vert (k * (t + r) - 1)) (p.vert (k * (t + r))) = 2
proof:
:= by
  intro r hr1 hrs
  have := h r hr1 hrs
  have heq : k * (t + r) - 1 + 1 = k * (t + r) := by
    have : 1 ≤ k * (t + r) := by
      have h1 : 1 ≤ t + r := by omega
      calc 1 ≤ k := by omega
        _ = k * 1 := (Nat.mul_one k).symm
        _ ≤ k * (t + r) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) h1
    omega
  have hd := (bkind_eq_door_iff p (k * (t + r) - 1)).mp this
  rwa [heq] at hd

name: Hunter.Proved.thm2_closed
statement:
theorem thm2_closed {k ℓ : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k)
    (hsupply : NonReleaseSupply k (PhiState k)) (hℓ : HasExitlessPath k ℓ) :
    j k ℓ ≤ iExitless k ℓ
proof:
:=
  ProofsMeta6.thm2_of_metaSupply hk (PhiState k) (baseBound_phiState hk)
    (metaWindowSupply_of_nonRelease hsupply) hℓ

name: Hunter.Proved.thm1v2_of_metaResidual
statement:
theorem thm1v2_of_metaResidual
    (hsupply : ∀ k, ProofsMeta7.NonReleaseSupply k (ProofsMeta7.PhiState k))
    (hproof : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) →
        (L k : ℝ) ≥ (iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ)
          + (((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
              (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)))
            * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ)))
    (hexists : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2))) :
    ∃ (C : ℝ) (k₀ : ℕ), ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k → (L k : ℝ) ≥ coeff k * (k.factorial : ℝ) - C
proof:
:=
  Proved.thm1v2_current
    (fun k _ hk hℓ => Proved.thm2_closed hk (hsupply k) hℓ)
    (fun _ _ hk hℓ0 hle hex => Proved.thm2_equality hk hℓ0 hle hex)
    hproof hexists

name: Hunter.Proved.thm1v1_of_metaResidual
statement:
theorem thm1v1_of_metaResidual
    (hsupply : ∀ k, ProofsMeta7.NonReleaseSupply k (ProofsMeta7.PhiState k))
    (hproof : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) →
        (L k : ℝ) ≥ (iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ)
          + (((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
              (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)))
            * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ)))
    (hexists : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2))) :
    ∃ (C : ℝ) (k₀ : ℕ), ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k →
      (Lstar k : ℝ) ≥ coeff k * (k.factorial : ℝ) + (k : ℝ) - C
proof:
:=
  Proved.thm1v1_current
    (fun k _ hk hℓ => Proved.thm2_closed hk (hsupply k) hℓ)
    (fun _ _ hk hℓ0 hle hex => Proved.thm2_equality hk hℓ0 hle hex)
    hproof hexists

name: Hunter.Refutations.le_wt
statement:
theorem le_wt {u v : List ℕ} {d : ℕ} (hu : u.length ≤ 5)
    (h : ∀ d', 1 ≤ d' → d' < d → u.drop d' ≠ v.take (5 - d')) : d ≤ wt 5 u v
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hlt
  push Not at hlt
  obtain ⟨h1, _, h3⟩ := wt_spec (by norm_num : (1 : ℕ) ≤ 5) hu (v := v)
  exact h _ h1 hlt h3

name: Hunter.Refutations.wt_eq_wtc5
statement: theorem wt_eq_wtc5 {u v : List ℕ} (hu : u.length = 5) : wt 5 u v = wtc5 u v
proof:
:= by
  have hule : u.length ≤ 5 := by omega
  have hge1 : 1 ≤ wt 5 u v := (wt_spec (by norm_num) hule (v := v)).1
  unfold wtc5
  split_ifs with h1 h2 h3 h4
  · 
    have hle : wt 5 u v ≤ 1 := wt_le (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by simpa using h1)
    omega
  · 
    have hle : wt 5 u v ≤ 2 := wt_le (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by simpa using h2)
    have hge : 2 ≤ wt 5 u v := le_wt hule (by
      intro d' hd1 hd2
      interval_cases d'; simpa using h1)
    omega
  · 
    have hle : wt 5 u v ≤ 3 := wt_le (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by simpa using h3)
    have hge : 3 ≤ wt 5 u v := le_wt hule (by
      intro d' hd1 hd2
      interval_cases d' <;> simp_all)
    omega
  · 
    have hle : wt 5 u v ≤ 4 := wt_le (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by simpa using h4)
    have hge : 4 ≤ wt 5 u v := le_wt hule (by
      intro d' hd1 hd2
      interval_cases d' <;> simp_all)
    omega
  · 
    have hle : wt 5 u v ≤ 5 := wt_le (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by
      have : u.drop 5 = [] := by rw [List.drop_eq_nil_iff]; omega
      simp [this])
    have hge : 5 ≤ wt 5 u v := le_wt hule (by
      intro d' hd1 hd2
      interval_cases d' <;> simp_all)
    omega

name: Hunter.Refutations.ew5_eq
statement: theorem ew5_eq (u v : Vtx 5) : ew 5 u v = wtc5 u.1 v.1
proof:
:=
  wt_eq_wtc5 u.2.length

name: Hunter.Refutations.zipWith_ew_eq_map
statement:
theorem zipWith_ew_eq_map (p : HPath 5) :
    p.verts.zipWith (ew 5) p.verts.tail
      = (List.range (p.numVerts - 1)).map (fun i => ew 5 (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · rw [List.length_zipWith, List.length_map, List.length_range, List.length_tail]
    have : p.numVerts = p.verts.length := rfl
    omega
  · intro i h1 h2
    have hlen : i < p.verts.tail.length := by
      rw [List.length_tail]
      rw [List.length_zipWith, List.length_tail] at h1
      omega
    have hi1 : i < p.numVerts := by
      rw [List.length_zipWith, List.length_tail] at h1
      have : p.numVerts = p.verts.length := rfl
      omega
    have hi2 : i + 1 < p.numVerts := by
      rw [List.length_tail] at hlen
      have : p.numVerts = p.verts.length := rfl
      omega
    rw [List.getElem_zipWith, List.getElem_map, List.getElem_range, List.getElem_tail]
    exact (congrArg₂ (ew 5) (vert_getElem p hi1) (vert_getElem p hi2)).symm

name: Hunter.Refutations.ewcList_eq
statement:
theorem ewcList_eq (p : HPath 5) :
    p.verts.zipWith (ew 5) p.verts.tail = ewcList p.verts
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : (ew 5 : Vtx 5 → Vtx 5 → ℕ) = (fun u v => wtc5 u.1 v.1) :=
    funext fun u => funext fun v => ew5_eq u v
  rw [ewcList, hfun]

name: Hunter.Refutations.edgeCountGe_eq
statement:
theorem edgeCountGe_eq (p : HPath 5) (r : ℕ) :
    edgeCountGe p r
      = ((ewcList p.verts).map (fun w => if r ≤ w then (1 : ℕ) else 0)).sum
proof:
:= by
  have key : edgeCountGe p r
      = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p.numVerts - 1),
          (if r ≤ ew 5 (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) then (1 : ℕ) else 0) := by
    rw [edgeCountGe, Finset.card_filter]
  rw [key, ← list_range_map_sum]
  rw [show (fun i => if r ≤ ew 5 (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) then (1 : ℕ) else 0)
        = (fun w => if r ≤ w then (1 : ℕ) else 0) ∘
            (fun i => ew 5 (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1))) from rfl]
  rw [← List.map_map, ← zipWith_ew_eq_map, ewcList_eq]

name: Hunter.Refutations.excess_eq
statement:
theorem excess_eq (p : HPath 5) :
    excess p
      = ∑ r ∈ Finset.Icc 3 5,
          ((ewcList p.verts).map (fun w => if r ≤ w then (1 : ℕ) else 0)).sum
proof:
:= by
  rw [excess]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun r _ => edgeCountGe_eq p r)

name: Hunter.Refutations.getD_vtx0_eq

name: Hunter.Refutations.hasEarlyExit_of_earlyExit

theorem hasEarlyExit_of_earlyExit {p : HPath 5} (h : EarlyExit p) :
    hasEarlyExit p.verts = true
proof:

  obtain ⟨i, hi, hw, hpos⟩ := h
  have hi0 : i < p.numVerts := by omega
  have hi1 : i + 1 < p.numVerts := hi
  rw [hasEarlyExit, List.any_eq_true]
  refine ⟨i, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [List.mem_range]
    have : p.numVerts = p.verts.length := rfl
    omega
  · rw [getD_vtx0_eq p hi0, getD_vtx0_eq p hi1, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq,
      decide_eq_true_eq, ← ew5_eq]

name: Hunter.Refutations.windowExcess_false
statement: theorem windowExcess_false : ¬ WindowExcess 5
proof:
:= by
  intro hW
  have hp : P.Exitless := P_exitless
  have hlt : 5 * (5 - 1) * (5 - 2) < P.numVerts := by rw [P_numVerts]; norm_num
  obtain ⟨q, hqv, hqe⟩ :=
    prefix_exitless hp (by norm_num : (1 : ℕ) ≤ 65) (by rw [P_numVerts]; norm_num)
  have hpre : q.verts = P.verts.take (P.numVerts - ell0 5) := by rw [hqv, prefix_len]
  have hdemand := hW P q hp hqe hlt hpre
  have hep : excess P = 6 := by rw [excess_eq]; decide
  have heq : excess q = 4 := by rw [excess_eq, hqv]; decide
  rw [hep, heq] at hdemand
  omega

  have hdemand := hW P q hp hqe hlt hpre
  have hep : edgeCountGe P 3 = 5 := by rw [edgeCountGe_eq]; decide
  have heq : edgeCountGe q 3 = 3 := by rw [edgeCountGe_eq, hqv]; decide
