name: Hunter.Proved.b2_of_gives_b2
statement:
theorem b2_of_gives_b2 (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (hgb2 : ∀ X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k), X ∈ Xk k →
      ((numComps X : ℝ) - 1) + (MinThrough X : ℝ) + (wEdges X : ℝ)
        ≥ Rk k * (k.factorial : ℝ)
          + sInf {q : ℝ | ∃ p, IsPathComponent p X ∧
              q = (p.wtP : ℝ) - Rk k * (p.numVerts : ℝ)})
    (hne_Xk : (Xk k).Nonempty)
    (hBddB : BddBelow {q : ℝ | ∃ p, p ∈ Xk' k ∧
      q = (p.wtP : ℝ) + Rk k * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - (p.numVerts : ℝ))}) :
    (L k : ℝ) ≥ sInf {q : ℝ | ∃ p, p ∈ Xk' k ∧
      q = (p.wtP : ℝ) + Rk k * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - (p.numVerts : ℝ))}
proof:
:= by
  
  have hb1 := b1_final (k := k) hk
  set S : Set ℕ := {m | ∃ X, X ∈ Xk k ∧ m = (numComps X - 1) + MinThrough X + wEdges X} with hS
  have hSne : S.Nonempty := ProofsB2.b1Set_nonempty hne_Xk
  have hmem : sInf S ∈ S := Nat.sInf_mem hSne
  obtain ⟨X, hX, hval⟩ := hmem
  
  have hnc1 : 1 ≤ numComps X := ProofsB2.one_le_numComps hk hX
  have hcastVal : ((sInf S : ℕ) : ℝ)
      = ((numComps X : ℝ) - 1) + (MinThrough X : ℝ) + (wEdges X : ℝ) := by
    rw [hval]; push_cast [Nat.cast_sub hnc1]; ring
  
  have hgives := hgb2 X hX
  set I : Set ℝ := {q : ℝ | ∃ p, IsPathComponent p X ∧
      q = (p.wtP : ℝ) - Rk k * (p.numVerts : ℝ)} with hI
  have hIne : I.Nonempty := ProofsB2.innerSet_nonempty hk hX
  set B : Set ℝ := {q : ℝ | ∃ p, p ∈ Xk' k ∧
      q = (p.wtP : ℝ) + Rk k * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - (p.numVerts : ℝ))} with hB
  
  have hshift : sInf B ≤ Rk k * (k.factorial : ℝ) + sInf I := by
    have h1 : sInf B - Rk k * (k.factorial : ℝ) ≤ sInf I := by
      apply le_csInf hIne
      rintro y ⟨p, hpc, rfl⟩
      have hpXk' : p ∈ Xk' k := ⟨X, hX, hpc⟩
      have hmemB : (p.wtP : ℝ) + Rk k * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - (p.numVerts : ℝ)) ∈ B :=
        ⟨p, hpXk', rfl⟩
      have hle : sInf B ≤ (p.wtP : ℝ) + Rk k * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - (p.numVerts : ℝ)) :=
        csInf_le hBddB hmemB
      have hdist : Rk k * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - (p.numVerts : ℝ))
          = Rk k * (k.factorial : ℝ) - Rk k * (p.numVerts : ℝ) := by ring
      rw [hdist] at hle; linarith
    linarith
  
  have hLcast : (L k : ℝ) ≥ ((sInf S : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hb1
  linarith [hLcast, hcastVal.ge, hcastVal.le, hgives, hshift]

name: Hunter.ProofsB2.stronglyExitless_of_isPathComponent
statement:
theorem stronglyExitless_of_isPathComponent {P p : HPath k} (hP : P.IsHamiltonian)
    (hk2 : 2 ≤ k) (hp : IsPathComponent p (F P)) : p.StronglyExitless
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    rw [HPath.Exitless]
    intro hEE
    obtain ⟨i, hi1, hw, hlt⟩ := hEE
    by_cases hvCm1 : p.vert i ∈ Cm1 P
    · have hi : i < p.numVerts := by omega
      have hviv : p.vert i ∈ p.verts := ProofsExitless.vert_mem p hi
      have hsvV : sigma (p.vert i) ∈ p.verts := by
        have hcyc : sigma (p.vert i) ∈ cyc (p.vert i) :=
          ProofsExitless.mem_cyc.mpr (ProofsStructure.rotClass_sigma (p.vert i))
        exact HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mp
          (ProofsPathrule.cyc_subset_pc hP hk2 hp (HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mpr hviv) hcyc)
      have hposvi : p.pos (p.vert i) = i := ProofsExitless.pos_vert p hi
      have hlt' : p.pos (p.vert i) < p.pos (sigma (p.vert i)) := by rw [hposvi]; exact hlt
      have hord := Proved.clm_ordering hP hp (Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inr hvCm1)) hviv hsvV hlt'
      have hsvC0 : sigma (p.vert i) ∈ C0 P := ProofsPathrule.mem_Cm1_iff.mp hvCm1
      have hle : P.pos (sigma (p.vert i)) ≤ P.pos (p.vert i) :=
        (ProofsPathrule.mem_C0_iff.mp hsvC0) (p.vert i)
          (ProofsStructure.rotClass_sigma (p.vert i)).symm
      omega
    · have h2 := Proved.clm_rule2 hP hvCm1
      have hmem : (p.vert i, p.vert (i + 1)) ∈ outV (F P) (p.vert i) := by
        simp only [outV, mem_out, Finset.mem_singleton]
        exact ⟨hp.1 (ProofsStructure.vert_consec_mem_edges hi1), trivial⟩
      rw [h2, Finset.mem_singleton] at hmem
      have hsucc : p.vert (i + 1) = sigma (p.vert i) := (Prod.ext_iff.mp hmem).2
      rw [hsucc, ew_sigma (show (1 : ℕ) ≤ k by omega) (p.vert i)] at hw
      omega
  · 
    have hcyc : sigma p.last ∈ cyc p.last :=
      ProofsExitless.mem_cyc.mpr (ProofsStructure.rotClass_sigma p.last)
    exact HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mp
      (ProofsPathrule.cyc_subset_pc hP hk2 hp (HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mpr p.last_mem) hcyc)

name: Hunter.ProofsB2.Xk'_nonempty_of_Xk_nonempty

proof:

  obtain ⟨P, hP, rfl⟩ := hX
  have h1 : 1 ≤ numComps (F P) := ProofsWP.one_le_numComps_F hP hk
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp h1

name: Hunter.Proved.red_pstar_tightened

name: Hunter.Proved.thm1v2_current
statement:
theorem thm1v2_current
    (hthm2 : ∀ k ℓ, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k ℓ → j k ℓ ≤ iExitless k ℓ)
    (hthm2eq : ∀ k ℓ, 3 ≤ k → 0 < ℓ → ℓ ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) → HasExitlessPath k ℓ →
        iExitless k ℓ = j k ℓ)
    (hproof : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) →
        (L k : ℝ) ≥ (iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ)
          + (((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
              (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)))
            * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ)))
    (hexists : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2))) :
    ∃ (C : ℝ) (k₀ : ℕ), ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k → (L k : ℝ) ≥ coeff k * (k.factorial : ℝ) - C
proof:
:=
  Hunter.Proved.thm1v2 hthm2 hthm2eq hproof hexists

name: Hunter.Proved.thm1v1_current
statement:
theorem thm1v1_current
    (hthm2 : ∀ k ℓ, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k ℓ → j k ℓ ≤ iExitless k ℓ)
    (hthm2eq : ∀ k ℓ, 3 ≤ k → 0 < ℓ → ℓ ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) → HasExitlessPath k ℓ →
        iExitless k ℓ = j k ℓ)
    (hproof : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) →
        (L k : ℝ) ≥ (iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ)
          + (((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
              (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)))
            * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ)))
    (hexists : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2))) :
    ∃ (C : ℝ) (k₀ : ℕ), ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k →
      (Lstar k : ℝ) ≥ coeff k * (k.factorial : ℝ) + (k : ℝ) - C
proof:
:=
  Hunter.Proved.thm1v1 hthm2 hthm2eq hproof hexists

name: Hunter.ProofsUnwind4.first_not_mem_drop1
statement: theorem first_not_mem_drop1 (p : HPath k) : p.first ∉ p.verts.drop 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, t, hat⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil p.ne
  have hf : p.first = a := ProofsSpine.first_eq hat
  have hd : p.verts.drop 1 = t := by rw [hat, List.drop_one, List.tail_cons]
  rw [hf, hd]
  have hnd : (a :: t).Nodup := hat ▸ p.nodup
  exact (List.nodup_cons.mp hnd).1

name: Hunter.ProofsUnwind4.unwindVerts_nodup_of_pairwise
proof:
:= by
  
  haveI : Std.Symm (fun a b : HPath k => Disjoint a.vertsFinset b.vertsFinset) :=
    ⟨fun a b h => h.symm⟩
  rw [unwindVerts, List.nodup_append']
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    rw [show ((ps.map HPath.first).Nodup) = ((ps.map HPath.first).Pairwise (· ≠ ·)) from rfl,
      List.pairwise_map]
    refine hpair.imp ?_
    intro p q hd heq
    have : p.first ∈ q.vertsFinset := by rw [heq]; exact HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mpr q.first_mem
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp hd (HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mpr p.first_mem) this
  · 
    rw [List.nodup_flatten]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro l hl
      rw [List.mem_map] at hl
      obtain ⟨p, _, rfl⟩ := hl
      exact p.nodup.sublist (List.drop_sublist 1 p.verts)
    · rw [List.pairwise_map, List.pairwise_reverse]
      refine hpair.imp ?_
      intro p q hd a haq hap
      have hap' : a ∈ p.verts := List.mem_of_mem_drop hap
      have haq' : a ∈ q.verts := List.mem_of_mem_drop haq
      exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp hd (HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mpr hap')
        (HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mpr haq')
  · 
    intro a ha hfl
    rw [List.mem_map] at ha
    obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := ha
    simp only [List.mem_flatten, List.mem_map] at hfl
    obtain ⟨l, ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩, hal⟩ := hfl
    have hq' : q ∈ ps := List.mem_reverse.mp hq
    have hal' : p.first ∈ q.verts := List.mem_of_mem_drop hal
    by_cases hpq : p = q
    · subst hpq
      exact first_not_mem_drop1 p hal
    · exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (hpair.forall hp hq' hpq)
        (HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mpr p.first_mem) (HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mpr hal')

name: Hunter.Proved.prp_Xk_se_sufficiency
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI := ProofsSpine.vtx_nonempty k
  
  set ps : List (HPath k) := (Comps X).attach.toList.map (fun C => (hse C.1 C.2).choose)
    with hps_def
  
  have hmem_ps : ∀ p ∈ ps, ∃ (C : Finset (Vtx k)) (hC : C ∈ Comps X),
      p = (hse C hC).choose ∧ p.vertsFinset = C ∧ IsPathComponent p X ∧ p.StronglyExitless := by
    intro p hp
    rw [hps_def, List.mem_map] at hp
    obtain ⟨⟨C, hC⟩, _, rfl⟩ := hp
    obtain ⟨hV, hPC, hSE⟩ := (hse C hC).choose_spec
    exact ⟨C, hC, rfl, hV, hPC, hSE⟩
  
  have hmem_f : ∀ (C : Finset (Vtx k)) (hC : C ∈ Comps X), (hse C hC).choose ∈ ps := by
    intro C hC
    rw [hps_def, List.mem_map]
    exact ⟨⟨C, hC⟩, Finset.mem_toList.mpr (Finset.mem_attach _ _), rfl⟩
  
  have hvne : (vertsOf X).Nonempty := by rw [hspan]; exact Finset.univ_nonempty
  have hCne : (Comps X).Nonempty := by rw [Comps]; exact hvne.image _
  
  have hps : ps ≠ [] := by
    rw [hps_def, Ne, List.map_eq_nil_iff, Finset.toList_eq_nil, Finset.attach_eq_empty_iff]
    exact hCne.ne_empty
  
  have hSE : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.StronglyExitless := fun p hp => (hmem_ps p hp).choose_spec.choose_spec.2.2.2
  
  have hpair : ps.Pairwise (fun p q : HPath k => Disjoint p.vertsFinset q.vertsFinset) := by
    rw [hps_def, List.pairwise_map]
    refine (Finset.nodup_toList _).imp ?_
    rintro ⟨C, hC⟩ ⟨C', hC'⟩ hne
    have hCC' : C ≠ C' := fun h => hne (Subtype.ext h)
    rw [(hse C hC).choose_spec.1, (hse C' hC').choose_spec.1]
    exact ProofsWP.comps_disjoint hC hC' hCC'
  
  have hcover : ∀ v : Vtx k, ∃ p ∈ ps, v ∈ p.verts := by
    intro v
    have hvV : v ∈ vertsOf X := by rw [hspan]; exact Finset.mem_univ v
    have hblk : ProofsWP.block X v ∈ Comps X := ProofsWP.block_mem_comps hvV
    refine ⟨(hse _ hblk).choose, hmem_f _ hblk, ?_⟩
    rw [← HPath.mem_vertsFinset, (hse _ hblk).choose_spec.1]
    exact ProofsWP.self_mem_block hvV
  
  have hnd : (unwindVerts ps).Nodup := ProofsUnwind4.unwindVerts_nodup_of_pairwise hpair
  
  have hXdef : ∀ e, e ∈ X ↔ ∃ p ∈ ps, e ∈ p.edges := by
    intro e
    constructor
    · intro heX
      have h1V : e.1 ∈ vertsOf X := ProofsWP.mem_vertsOf.mpr ⟨e, heX, Or.inl rfl⟩
      have hblk : ProofsWP.block X e.1 ∈ Comps X := ProofsWP.block_mem_comps h1V
      obtain ⟨hVeq, hPC, _⟩ := (hse _ hblk).choose_spec
      refine ⟨(hse _ hblk).choose, hmem_f _ hblk, ?_⟩
      have h1p : e.1 ∈ (hse _ hblk).choose.vertsFinset := by
        rw [hVeq]; exact ProofsWP.self_mem_block h1V
      exact hPC.2.2 e heX h1p
    · rintro ⟨p, hp, hep⟩
      obtain ⟨C, hC, _, _, hPC, _⟩ := hmem_ps p hp
      exact hPC.1 hep
  exact prp_Xk_se_sufficiency_unwind3 hps hnd hcover hSE hk hpair hXdef

name: Hunter.Proved.prp_Xkcomps_final
proof:
:=
  prp_Xkcomps_amended hk hrev

name: Hunter.Proved.red_pstar_final
proof:
:=
  red_pstar_tightened hr hk hrev hne_Xk

name: Hunter.ProofsStructure.F_eq
statement: theorem F_eq (P : HPath k) : F P = fPS P (Sset P)
proof: := rfl

name: Hunter.ProofsStructure.getElem_eq_of_index_eq
statement:
theorem getElem_eq_of_index_eq {α : Type*} {l : List α} {a b : ℕ}
    (hab : a = b) (ha : a < l.length) (hb : b < l.length) : l[a]'ha = l[b]'hb
proof:
:= by
  subst hab; rfl

name: Hunter.ProofsStructure.sigma_sigmaInv
statement: theorem sigma_sigmaInv (v : Vtx k) : sigma (sigmaInv v) = v
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  show ((v : List ℕ).rotate (k - 1)).rotate 1 = (v : List ℕ)
  rw [List.rotate_rotate]
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with hk | hk
  · subst hk
    have hv : (v : List ℕ) = [] := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp v.2.length
    rw [hv]; simp
  · have hlen : (v : List ℕ).length = k := v.2.length
    have hkk : k - 1 + 1 = k := by omega
    rw [hkk]
    have hr := List.rotate_length (v : List ℕ)
    rwa [hlen] at hr

name: Hunter.ProofsStructure.rotClass_sigma
statement: theorem rotClass_sigma (v : Vtx k) : rotClass (sigma v).1 = rotClass v.1
proof:
:= by
  have h := ProofsExitless.rotClass_sigma_iter 1 v
  simpa using h

name: Hunter.ProofsStructure.edge_pos_succ
statement:
theorem edge_pos_succ {P : HPath k} {a b : Vtx k} (h : (a, b) ∈ P.edges) :
    P.pos b = P.pos a + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [HPath.edges, List.mem_toFinset] at h
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hia⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp h
  have hlen_i : i < P.verts.length := List.lt_length_left_of_zip hi
  have hlen_i1 : i + 1 < P.verts.length := by
    have h' := List.lt_length_right_of_zip hi; rw [List.length_tail] at h'; omega
  have ea : P.verts[i]'hlen_i = a := by
    have h' : ((P.verts.zip P.verts.tail)[i]'hi).1 = a := by rw [hia]
    simpa using h'
  have eb : P.verts[i + 1]'hlen_i1 = b := by
    have h' : ((P.verts.zip P.verts.tail)[i]'hi).2 = b := by rw [hia]
    simpa using h'
  have hidxa : P.verts.idxOf a = i := by rw [← ea]; exact P.nodup.idxOf_getElem i hlen_i
  have hidxb : P.verts.idxOf b = i + 1 := by rw [← eb]; exact P.nodup.idxOf_getElem (i + 1) hlen_i1
  show P.verts.idxOf b = P.verts.idxOf a + 1
  rw [hidxa, hidxb]

name: Hunter.ProofsStructure.consec_mem_edges
statement:
theorem consec_mem_edges {p : HPath k} {i : ℕ} (hi : i + 1 < p.verts.length) :
    (p.verts[i]'(by omega), p.verts[i + 1]'hi) ∈ p.edges
proof:
:= by
  rw [HPath.edges, List.mem_toFinset]
  have hzip : i < (p.verts.zip p.verts.tail).length := by
    rw [List.length_zip, List.length_tail]; omega
  refine List.mem_iff_getElem.mpr ⟨i, hzip, ?_⟩
  rw [List.getElem_zip, List.getElem_tail]

name: Hunter.ProofsStructure.vert_consec_mem_edges
statement:
theorem vert_consec_mem_edges {p : HPath k} {i : ℕ} (hi : i + 1 < p.numVerts) :
    (p.vert i, p.vert (i + 1)) ∈ p.edges
proof:
:= by
  have hb : i + 1 < p.verts.length := hi
  have hi0 : i < p.numVerts := by omega
  rw [ProofsExitless.vert_getElem p hi0, ProofsExitless.vert_getElem p hi]
  exact consec_mem_edges (p := p) (i := i) hb

name: Hunter.ProofsStructure.pos_first
statement: theorem pos_first (p : HPath k) : p.pos p.first = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← p.vert_zero]; exact ProofsExitless.pos_vert p p.numVerts_pos

name: Hunter.ProofsStructure.vtx_subsingleton
statement: theorem vtx_subsingleton (hk : k ≤ 1) : Subsingleton (Vtx k)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun a b => Subtype.ext ?_⟩
  have hla : (a : List ℕ).length = k := a.2.length
  have hlb : (b : List ℕ).length = k := b.2.length
  rcases Nat.le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one.mp hk with rfl | rfl
  · rw [List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp hla, List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp hlb]
  · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := List.length_eq_one_iff.mp hla
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := List.length_eq_one_iff.mp hlb
    have hax : x ∈ Finset.Icc 1 1 := by rw [← a.2.2, hx]; simp
    have hby : y ∈ Finset.Icc 1 1 := by rw [← b.2.2, hy]; simp
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hax hby
    rw [hx, hy]; congr 1; omega

name: Hunter.ProofsStructure.mem_Cm1_of_le_one
statement: theorem mem_Cm1_of_le_one (hk : k ≤ 1) (P : HPath k) (v : Vtx k) : v ∈ Cm1 P
proof:
:= by
  have hsub := vtx_subsingleton hk
  rw [Cm1, Finset.mem_filter]
  refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
  rw [C0, Finset.mem_filter]
  refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
  intro u _
  rw [Subsingleton.elim u (sigma v)]

name: Hunter.ProofsStructure.two_le_of_not_Cm1
statement: theorem two_le_of_not_Cm1 {P : HPath k} {v : Vtx k} (hv : v ∉ Cm1 P) : 2 ≤ k
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hc
  exact hv (mem_Cm1_of_le_one (by omega) P v)

name: Hunter.ProofsStructure.double_imp_added_inedge
statement:
theorem double_imp_added_inedge {P : HPath k} {S : Finset (Vtx k)} {u : Vtx k}
    (hu : u ∈ doubles P S) : (intoV (addedEdges S) u).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  simp only [doubles, Finset.mem_filter] at hu
  obtain ⟨-, hu2⟩ := hu
  have hdecomp : intoV (Xstep1 P S) u =
      intoV (P.edges \ E1removed P S) u ∪ intoV (addedEdges S) u := by
    unfold Xstep1; exact ProofsSpine.intoV_union _ _ u
  have hAle : (intoV (P.edges \ E1removed P S) u).card ≤ 1 :=
    le_trans (Finset.card_le_card (ProofsSpine.intoV_mono Finset.sdiff_subset u))
      (ProofsSpine.path_into_le_one P u)
  rw [Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
  intro hB
  rw [hdecomp, hB, Finset.union_empty] at hu2
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsStructure.mem_S_of_sigma_double
statement:
theorem mem_S_of_sigma_double {P : HPath k} {S : Finset (Vtx k)} {v : Vtx k}
    (hd : sigma v ∈ doubles P S) : v ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := double_imp_added_inedge hd
  simp only [intoV, mem_into, addedEdges, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_singleton] at he
  obtain ⟨⟨w, hwS, hwe⟩, he2⟩ := he
  rw [← hwe] at he2
  have hww : sigma w = sigma v := he2
  rw [ProofsSpine.sigma_inj hww] at hwS
  exact hwS

name: Hunter.ProofsStructure.mem_F_sigma_of_not_Cm1
statement:
theorem mem_F_sigma_of_not_Cm1 {P : HPath k} {v : Vtx k} (hv : v ∉ Cm1 P) :
    (v, sigma v) ∈ F P
proof:
:= by
  rw [F_eq, fPS, Finset.mem_sdiff]
  set S := Sset P with hS
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · by_cases hvP : (v, sigma v) ∈ P.edges
    · rw [Xstep1, Finset.mem_union]; left
      rw [Finset.mem_sdiff]
      refine ⟨hvP, ?_⟩
      intro hc
      rw [E1removed, Finset.mem_filter] at hc
      have hvS : v ∈ S := hc.2
      rw [hS, Sset, Finset.mem_filter] at hvS
      exact hvS.2.2 hvP
    · have hvS : v ∈ S := by
        rw [hS, Sset, Finset.mem_filter]; exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ v, hv, hvP⟩
      rw [Xstep1, Finset.mem_union]; right
      rw [addedEdges, Finset.mem_image]; exact ⟨v, hvS, rfl⟩
  · intro hc
    have hcP : (v, sigma v) ∈ P.edges := E2removed_subset P S hc
    have hvnS : v ∉ S := by
      intro hvS; rw [hS, Sset, Finset.mem_filter] at hvS; exact hvS.2.2 hcP
    rw [E2removed, Finset.mem_filter] at hc
    have hd : sigma v ∈ doubles P S := hc.2
    exact hvnS (mem_S_of_sigma_double hd)

name: Hunter.ProofsStructure.C0_not_Cm1
statement:
theorem C0_not_Cm1 {P : HPath k} (hP : P.IsHamiltonian) (hk : 2 ≤ k) {v : Vtx k}
    (hv : v ∈ C0 P) : v ∉ Cm1 P
proof:
:= by
  intro hvm
  rw [C0, Finset.mem_filter] at hv
  rw [Cm1, Finset.mem_filter] at hvm
  have hsuC0 := hvm.2
  rw [C0, Finset.mem_filter] at hsuC0
  have hf1 := hv.2
  have hf2 := hsuC0.2
  have hrc : rotClass (sigma v).1 = rotClass v.1 := rotClass_sigma v
  have hle1 := hf1 (sigma v) hrc
  have hle2 := hf2 v hrc.symm
  have hposeq : P.pos v = P.pos (sigma v) := le_antisymm hle1 hle2
  have hveq : v = sigma v :=
    (ProofsExitless.vert_pos P (hP v)).symm.trans
      (by rw [hposeq]; exact ProofsExitless.vert_pos P (hP (sigma v)))
  have hne : sigma v ≠ v := by
    intro hc
    have := ProofsExitless.sigma_iter_inj v (a := 1) (b := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
      (by simpa using hc)
    omega
  exact hne hveq.symm

name: Hunter.ProofsStructure.vertsOf_F_eq_univ
statement:
theorem vertsOf_F_eq_univ {P : HPath k} (hP : P.IsHamiltonian) (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    vertsOf (F P) = Finset.univ
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.eq_univ_of_forall
  intro v
  rw [vertsOf, Finset.mem_filter]
  refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
  by_cases hvC0 : v ∈ C0 P
  · exact ⟨(v, sigma v), mem_F_sigma_of_not_Cm1 (C0_not_Cm1 hP hk hvC0), Or.inl rfl⟩
  · have hun : sigmaInv v ∉ Cm1 P := by
      intro h; rw [Cm1, Finset.mem_filter] at h
      rw [sigma_sigmaInv] at h; exact hvC0 h.2
    have hedge : (sigmaInv v, v) ∈ F P := by
      have h := mem_F_sigma_of_not_Cm1 hun; rwa [sigma_sigmaInv] at h
    exact ⟨(sigmaInv v, v), hedge, Or.inr rfl⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsStructure.wEdges_union_disjoint
statement:
theorem wEdges_union_disjoint {A B : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} (h : Disjoint A B) :
    wEdges (A ∪ B) = wEdges A + wEdges B
proof:
:= by
  simp only [wEdges]; exact Finset.sum_union h

name: Hunter.ProofsStructure.wEdges_sdiff
statement:
theorem wEdges_sdiff {A B : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} (h : B ⊆ A) :
    wEdges (A \ B) + wEdges B = wEdges A
proof:
:= by
  simp only [wEdges]; exact Finset.sum_sdiff h

name: Hunter.ProofsStructure.E2removed_subset_Xstep1
statement:
theorem E2removed_subset_Xstep1 {P : HPath k} {S : Finset (Vtx k)} :
    E2removed P S ⊆ Xstep1 P S
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  have heP : e ∈ P.edges := E2removed_subset P S he
  rw [E2removed, Finset.mem_filter] at he
  have hd : e.2 ∈ doubles P S := he.2
  simp only [doubles, Finset.mem_filter] at hd
  obtain ⟨-, hd2⟩ := hd
  have hdecomp : intoV (Xstep1 P S) e.2 =
      intoV (P.edges \ E1removed P S) e.2 ∪ intoV (addedEdges S) e.2 := by
    unfold Xstep1; exact ProofsSpine.intoV_union _ _ e.2
  have hBle : (intoV (addedEdges S) e.2).card ≤ 1 := ProofsSpine.intoV_addedEdges_le_one S e.2
  have hAne : (intoV (P.edges \ E1removed P S) e.2).Nonempty := by
    rw [Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty]; intro hA
    rw [hdecomp, hA, Finset.empty_union] at hd2; omega
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hAne
  simp only [intoV, mem_into, Finset.mem_singleton] at hx
  obtain ⟨hxPE1, hx2⟩ := hx
  have hxP : x ∈ P.edges := (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hxPE1).1
  have hxe : x = e :=
    Finset.card_le_one.mp (ProofsSpine.path_into_le_one P e.2) x
      (by simp only [intoV, mem_into, Finset.mem_singleton]; exact ⟨hxP, hx2⟩) e
      (by simp only [intoV, mem_into, Finset.mem_singleton]; exact ⟨heP, trivial⟩)
  rw [← hxe, Xstep1, Finset.mem_union]; exact Or.inl hxPE1

name: Hunter.ProofsStructure.wEdges_addedEdges
statement:
theorem wEdges_addedEdges {S : Finset (Vtx k)} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    wEdges (addedEdges S) = S.card
proof:
:= by
  rw [wEdges, addedEdges,
    Finset.sum_image (by intro a _ b _ hab; exact (Prod.ext_iff.mp hab).1)]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun v _ => ew_sigma hk v), Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: Hunter.ProofsStructure.pos_last
statement: theorem pos_last (p : HPath k) : p.pos p.last = p.numVerts - 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Proved.last_eq_vert]
  exact ProofsExitless.pos_vert p (by have := p.numVerts_pos; omega)

name: Hunter.ProofsStructure.ne_last_of_out_edge
statement:
theorem ne_last_of_out_edge {P : HPath k} {a b : Vtx k} (h : (a, b) ∈ P.edges) :
    a ≠ P.last
proof:
:= by
  intro hcon
  have hps := edge_pos_succ h
  have hbz : (a, b) ∈ P.verts.zip P.verts.tail := ProofsSpine.mem_edges_iff.mp h
  have hbt : b ∈ P.verts.tail := ProofsSpine.snd_mem_tail hbz
  have hb : b ∈ P.verts := P.verts.tail_sublist.subset hbt
  have hposb := ProofsExitless.pos_lt P hb
  have hposlast := pos_last P
  rw [hcon, hposlast] at hps
  have := P.numVerts_pos
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsStructure.out_edge_of_ne_last
statement:
theorem out_edge_of_ne_last {P : HPath k} {v : Vtx k} (hv : v ∈ P.verts)
    (hne : v ≠ P.last) : ∃ w, (v, w) ∈ P.edges
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : P.pos v < P.numVerts := ProofsExitless.pos_lt P hv
  have hposlast := pos_last P
  have hne' : P.pos v ≠ P.numVerts - 1 := by
    intro hcon
    apply hne
    have h1 := ProofsExitless.vert_pos P hv
    have h2 := Proved.last_eq_vert P
    rw [← h1, hcon, ← h2]
  have hbound : P.pos v + 1 < P.numVerts := by omega
  have hedge : (P.vert (P.pos v), P.vert (P.pos v + 1)) ∈ P.edges :=
    vert_consec_mem_edges hbound
  rw [ProofsExitless.vert_pos P hv] at hedge
  exact ⟨P.vert (P.pos v + 1), hedge⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsStructure.E1removed_card
statement:
theorem E1removed_card {P : HPath k} {S : Finset (Vtx k)} (hSV : S ⊆ P.vertsFinset) :
    (E1removed P S).card + indicatorI P S = S.card
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Set.InjOn Prod.fst (E1removed P S : Set (Vtx k × Vtx k)) := by
    intro a ha b hb hab
    simp only [Finset.mem_coe, E1removed, Finset.mem_filter] at ha hb
    exact Finset.card_le_one.mp (ProofsSpine.path_out_le_one P a.1) a
      (by simp only [outV, mem_out, Finset.mem_singleton]; exact ⟨ha.1, trivial⟩) b
      (by simp only [outV, mem_out, Finset.mem_singleton]; exact ⟨hb.1, hab.symm⟩)
  have himg : (E1removed P S).image Prod.fst = S.filter (fun v => ¬ v = P.last) := by
    ext v
    simp only [Finset.mem_image, E1removed, Finset.mem_filter]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨e, ⟨heP, heS⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨heS, ne_last_of_out_edge heP⟩
    · rintro ⟨hvS, hvne⟩
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := out_edge_of_ne_last (HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mp (hSV hvS)) hvne
      exact ⟨(v, w), ⟨hw, hvS⟩, rfl⟩
  have hcard1 : (E1removed P S).card = (S.filter (fun v => ¬ v = P.last)).card := by
    rw [← himg, Finset.card_image_of_injOn hinj]
  have hI : indicatorI P S = (S.filter (fun v => v = P.last)).card := by
    rw [indicatorI, Finset.filter_eq']
    by_cases h : P.last ∈ S <;> simp [h]
  have hkey := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := S) (p := fun v => v = P.last)
  rw [hcard1, hI]; omega

name: Hunter.Proved.clm_rule2
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem.mpr
  have hmem : (v, sigma v) ∈ outV (F P) v := by
    simp only [outV, mem_out, Finset.mem_singleton]
    exact ⟨mem_F_sigma_of_not_Cm1 hv, trivial⟩
  refine ⟨hmem, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  have hle : (outV (F P) v).card ≤ 1 := by
    rw [F_eq]; exact ProofsSpine.outV_fPS_le_one P (Sset P) v
  exact Finset.card_le_one.mp hle x hx (v, sigma v) hmem

name: Hunter.Proved.clm_rule2_75
proof:
:=
  mem_F_sigma_of_not_Cm1 hu

name: Hunter.Proved.clm_rule1
proof:
:= by
  have hvnS : v ∉ Sset P := by
    intro h; rw [Sset, Finset.mem_filter] at h; exact h.2.1 hv
  have hsub : outV (F P) v ⊆ outV P.edges v := by
    intro e he
    simp only [outV, mem_out, Finset.mem_singleton] at he ⊢
    obtain ⟨heF, he1⟩ := he
    refine ⟨?_, he1⟩
    have heX1 : e ∈ Xstep1 P (Sset P) := fPS_subset_step1 P (Sset P) heF
    rw [Xstep1, Finset.mem_union] at heX1
    rcases heX1 with hPE | hA
    · exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hPE).1
    · exfalso
      rw [addedEdges, Finset.mem_image] at hA
      obtain ⟨w, hwS, hwe⟩ := hA
      have hwv : w = v := by rw [← hwe] at he1; exact he1
      exact hvnS (hwv ▸ hwS)
  have hcard : (outV P.edges v).card ≤ 1 := ProofsSpine.path_out_le_one P v
  have hpos : 1 ≤ (outV (F P) v).card :=
    Finset.Nonempty.card_pos (Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hne)
  exact Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub (le_trans hcard hpos)

name: Hunter.Proved.clm_rule2_5
proof:
:= by
  have hsu : sigma (sigmaInv v) = v := sigma_sigmaInv v
  have hunC : sigmaInv v ∉ Cm1 P := by
    intro h; rw [Cm1, Finset.mem_filter] at h
    rw [hsu] at h; exact hv h.2
  have hedge : (sigmaInv v, v) ∈ F P := by
    have h := mem_F_sigma_of_not_Cm1 hunC
    rwa [hsu] at h
  have hmem : (sigmaInv v, v) ∈ intoV (F P) v := by
    simp only [intoV, mem_into, Finset.mem_singleton]; exact ⟨hedge, trivial⟩
  apply Finset.eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem.mpr
  refine ⟨hmem, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  have hle : (intoV (F P) v).card ≤ 1 := by
    rw [F_eq]; exact ProofsSpine.intoV_fPS_le_one P (Sset P) (sset_sPrecond P) v
  exact Finset.card_le_one.mp hle x hx (sigmaInv v, v) hmem

name: Hunter.Proved.clm_rule3
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := clm_rule1 hP hu hne
  have hnesub : (outV P.edges u).Nonempty := by
    rw [← h1]; exact Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hne
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hnesub
  have he1 : e.1 = u := by
    simp only [outV, mem_out, Finset.mem_singleton] at he; exact he.2
  set v := e.2 with hvdef
  have hev : e = (u, v) := by rw [← he1, hvdef]
  have heF : e ∈ F P := by
    have hmem : e ∈ outV (F P) u := by rw [h1]; exact he
    simp only [outV, mem_out] at hmem; exact hmem.1
  have huvF : (u, v) ∈ F P := hev ▸ heF
  refine ⟨v, ?_, ?_⟩
  · by_contra hvnC0
    have h25 := clm_rule2_5 hP hvnC0
    have hin : (u, v) ∈ intoV (F P) v := by
      simp only [intoV, mem_into, Finset.mem_singleton]; exact ⟨huvF, trivial⟩
    rw [h25, Finset.mem_singleton] at hin
    have husi : u = sigmaInv v := (Prod.ext_iff.mp hin).1
    have hvsu : v = sigma u := by rw [husi, sigma_sigmaInv]
    have hsuC0 : sigma u ∈ C0 P := by rw [Cm1, Finset.mem_filter] at hu; exact hu.2
    rw [← hvsu] at hsuC0
    exact hvnC0 hsuC0
  · rw [h1]
    apply Finset.eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem.mpr
    refine ⟨hev ▸ he, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    exact Finset.card_le_one.mp (ProofsSpine.path_out_le_one P u) x hx e he |>.trans hev

name: Hunter.Proved.rmk_rule3
statement:
theorem rmk_rule3 {P : HPath k} (hP : P.IsHamiltonian) {u v : Vtx k}
    (hu : u ∈ Cm1 P) (h : (u, v) ∈ F P) : v ≠ sigma u
proof:
:= by
  intro hvsu
  subst hvsu
  have hne : outV (F P) u ≠ ∅ := by
    rw [← Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
    exact ⟨(u, sigma u), by simp only [outV, mem_out, Finset.mem_singleton]; exact ⟨h, trivial⟩⟩
  have h1 := clm_rule1 hP hu hne
  have huv : (u, sigma u) ∈ P.edges := by
    have hmem : (u, sigma u) ∈ outV (F P) u := by
      simp only [outV, mem_out, Finset.mem_singleton]; exact ⟨h, trivial⟩
    rw [h1] at hmem
    simp only [outV, mem_out] at hmem; exact hmem.1
  have hpos := edge_pos_succ huv
  have hsuC0 : sigma u ∈ C0 P := by rw [Cm1, Finset.mem_filter] at hu; exact hu.2
  rw [C0, Finset.mem_filter] at hsuC0
  have hfirst := hsuC0.2
  have hrc : rotClass u.1 = rotClass (sigma u).1 := (rotClass_sigma u).symm
  have hle := hfirst u hrc
  omega

name: Hunter.Proved.walking_aux
statement:
theorem walking_aux {P : HPath k} (hP : P.IsHamiltonian) {D : List (Vtx k)}
    (hD : IsWalk (F P) D) :
    ∀ (g i j : ℕ) (hi : i < D.length) (hj : j < D.length), j - i = g → i < j →
      D[i] ∈ C0 P ∪ Cm1 P → P.pos D[i] < P.pos D[j]
proof:
:= by
  intro g
  induction g using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ g IH =>
    intro i j hi hj hg hij hDi
    rcases Classical.em (∃ t : ℕ, ∃ (ht : t < D.length),
        i < t ∧ t < j ∧ D[t]'ht ∈ C0 P ∪ Cm1 P) with hA | hA
    · obtain ⟨t, ht, hit, htj, hDt⟩ := hA
      have h1 := IH (t - i) (by omega) i t hi ht (by omega) hit hDi
      have h2 := IH (j - t) (by omega) t j ht hj (by omega) htj hDt
      omega
    · have hi1 : i + 1 < D.length := by omega
      have hedge0 : (D[i], D[i + 1]) ∈ F P := List.IsChain.getElem hD i hi1
      by_cases huCm1 : D[i] ∈ Cm1 P
      · have hne : outV (F P) D[i] ≠ ∅ := by
          rw [← Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
          exact ⟨(D[i], D[i + 1]), by
            simp only [outV, mem_out, Finset.mem_singleton]; exact ⟨hedge0, trivial⟩⟩
        obtain ⟨w, hwC0, hout⟩ := clm_rule3 hP huCm1 hne
        have hDi1w : D[i + 1] = w := by
          have hmem : (D[i], D[i + 1]) ∈ outV (F P) D[i] := by
            simp only [outV, mem_out, Finset.mem_singleton]; exact ⟨hedge0, trivial⟩
          rw [hout, Finset.mem_singleton] at hmem
          exact (Prod.ext_iff.mp hmem).2
        have hij1 : i + 1 = j := by
          by_contra hne'
          exact hA ⟨i + 1, hi1, by omega, by omega,
            show D[i + 1]'hi1 ∈ C0 P ∪ Cm1 P by
              rw [hDi1w]; exact Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inl hwC0)⟩
        have h1 := clm_rule1 hP huCm1 hne
        have hPedge : (D[i], w) ∈ P.edges := by
          have hmem : (D[i], w) ∈ outV (F P) D[i] := by
            rw [hout]; exact Finset.mem_singleton_self _
          rw [h1] at hmem
          simp only [outV, mem_out] at hmem; exact hmem.1
        have hpossucc := edge_pos_succ hPedge
        subst hij1
        rw [hDi1w]; omega
      · have huC0 : D[i] ∈ C0 P := by
          rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hDi with h | h
          · exact h
          · exact absurd h huCm1
        have hk2 : 2 ≤ k := two_le_of_not_Cm1 huCm1
        have orbit : ∀ m, m ≤ g → ∀ (hm : i + m < D.length),
            D[i + m]'hm = sigma^[m] D[i] := by
          intro m
          induction m with
          | zero => intro _ hm; simp
          | succ n ih =>
            intro hmg hm
            have hnlt : i + n < D.length := by omega
            have hDn := ih (by omega) hnlt
            have hnotCm1 : D[i + n]'hnlt ∉ Cm1 P := by
              rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with hn0 | hn0
              · subst hn0; simpa using huCm1
              · intro hc
                exact hA ⟨i + n, hnlt, by omega, by omega, Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inr hc)⟩
            have hedge : (D[i + n], D[i + n + 1]) ∈ F P :=
              List.IsChain.getElem hD (i + n) (by omega)
            have hr2 := clm_rule2 hP hnotCm1
            have hmem : (D[i + n], D[i + n + 1]) ∈ outV (F P) D[i + n] := by
              simp only [outV, mem_out, Finset.mem_singleton]; exact ⟨hedge, trivial⟩
            rw [hr2, Finset.mem_singleton] at hmem
            have hnext : D[i + n + 1] = sigma D[i + n] := (Prod.ext_iff.mp hmem).2
            show D[(i + n) + 1]'hm = sigma^[n + 1] D[i]
            rw [hnext, hDn, Function.iterate_succ_apply']
        have hg1 : 1 ≤ g := by omega
        have hvorbit : D[j] = sigma^[g] D[i] := by
          have h := orbit g (le_refl g) (by omega)
          rw [getElem_eq_of_index_eq (show j = i + g from by omega) hj (by omega)]
          exact h
        have hrc : rotClass D[j].1 = rotClass D[i].1 := by
          rw [hvorbit]; exact ProofsExitless.rotClass_sigma_iter g D[i]
        have hfirst : firstInCycle P D[i] := by
          rw [C0, Finset.mem_filter] at huC0; exact huC0.2
        have hle : P.pos D[i] ≤ P.pos D[j] := hfirst D[j] hrc
        have hne_uv : D[j] ≠ D[i] := by
          rw [hvorbit]
          intro hcon
          have hgk : g < k := by
            by_contra hgk'
            push Not at hgk'
            have hspecial : sigma^[k - 1] D[i] ∈ Cm1 P := by
              rw [Cm1, Finset.mem_filter]
              refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
              have hstep : sigma (sigma^[k - 1] D[i]) = D[i] := by
                have e1 : sigma (sigma^[k - 1] D[i]) = sigma^[(k - 1) + 1] D[i] :=
                  (Function.iterate_succ_apply' sigma (k - 1) D[i]).symm
                rw [e1, show (k - 1) + 1 = k from by omega, ProofsExitless.sigma_iter_period]
              rw [hstep]; exact huC0
            have hik1 : i + (k - 1) < D.length := by omega
            have hik : D[i + (k - 1)]'hik1 = sigma^[k - 1] D[i] :=
              orbit (k - 1) (by omega) hik1
            exact hA ⟨i + (k - 1), hik1, by omega, by omega,
              show D[i + (k - 1)]'hik1 ∈ C0 P ∪ Cm1 P by
                rw [hik]; exact Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inr hspecial)⟩
          have hcon' : sigma^[g] D[i] = sigma^[0] D[i] := by simpa using hcon
          have := ProofsExitless.sigma_iter_inj D[i] hgk (by omega) hcon'
          omega
        have hposne : P.pos D[i] ≠ P.pos D[j] := by
          intro hcon
          apply hne_uv
          have hui := ProofsExitless.vert_pos P (hP D[i])
          have hvj := ProofsExitless.vert_pos P (hP D[j])
          rw [← hui, ← hvj, hcon]
        omega

name: Hunter.Proved.lem_walking
statement:
theorem lem_walking {P : HPath k} (hP : P.IsHamiltonian)
    {D : List (Vtx k)} (hD : IsWalk (F P) D) {u v : Vtx k}
    (hu : u ∈ C0 P ∪ Cm1 P) (_hv : v ∈ C0 P ∪ Cm1 P)
    (huD : u ∈ D) (hvD : v ∈ D) (hlt : D.idxOf u < D.idxOf v) :
    P.pos u < P.pos v
proof:
:= by
  have hiu : D.idxOf u < D.length := List.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem huD
  have hiv : D.idxOf v < D.length := List.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem hvD
  have hgu : D[D.idxOf u]'hiu = u := List.getElem_idxOf hiu
  have hgv : D[D.idxOf v]'hiv = v := List.getElem_idxOf hiv
  have key := walking_aux hP hD (D.idxOf v - D.idxOf u) (D.idxOf u) (D.idxOf v) hiu hiv rfl hlt
    (by rw [hgu]; exact hu)
  rwa [hgu, hgv] at key

name: Hunter.Proved.isWalk_verts
statement:
theorem isWalk_verts {P : HPath k} {p : HPath k} (hp : IsPathComponent p (F P)) :
    IsWalk (F P) p.verts
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsWalk, List.isChain_iff_getElem]
  intro i hi
  exact hp.1 (ProofsStructure.consec_mem_edges hi)

name: Hunter.Proved.clm_ordering
statement:
theorem clm_ordering {P : HPath k} (hP : P.IsHamiltonian)
    {p : HPath k} (hp : IsPathComponent p (F P)) {v u : Vtx k}
    (hv : v ∈ C0 P ∪ Cm1 P) (hvp : v ∈ p.verts) (hup : u ∈ p.verts)
    (hlt : p.pos v < p.pos u) : P.pos v < P.pos u
proof:
:= by
  have hwalk := isWalk_verts hp
  have hiv : p.pos v < p.verts.length := ProofsExitless.pos_lt p hvp
  have hiu : p.pos u < p.verts.length := ProofsExitless.pos_lt p hup
  have hgv : p.verts[p.pos v]'hiv = v := by
    rw [← ProofsExitless.vert_getElem p hiv]; exact ProofsExitless.vert_pos p hvp
  have hgu : p.verts[p.pos u]'hiu = u := by
    rw [← ProofsExitless.vert_getElem p hiu]; exact ProofsExitless.vert_pos p hup
  have key := walking_aux hP hwalk (p.pos u - p.pos v) (p.pos v) (p.pos u) hiv hiu rfl hlt
    (by rw [hgv]; exact hv)
  rwa [hgv, hgu] at key

name: Hunter.Proved.cor_pathfirst
statement:
theorem cor_pathfirst {P : HPath k} (hP : P.IsHamiltonian)
    {p : HPath k} (hp : IsPathComponent p (F P)) {u : Vtx k} (hu : u ∈ p.verts) :
    P.pos p.first ≤ P.pos u
proof:
:= by
  have htail : intoV (F P) p.first = ∅ := by
    have h := ProofsSpine.compTails_eq hp
    have hmem : p.first ∈ compTails (F P) p.vertsFinset := by
      rw [h]; exact Finset.mem_singleton_self _
    rw [compTails, Finset.mem_filter] at hmem
    exact hmem.2
  have hfirstC0 : p.first ∈ C0 P := by
    by_contra hc
    have h25 := clm_rule2_5 hP hc
    rw [h25] at htail
    exact absurd htail (Finset.singleton_ne_empty _)
  by_cases heq : u = p.first
  · rw [heq]
  · have h0 : p.pos p.first = 0 := ProofsStructure.pos_first p
    have hupos : 0 < p.pos u := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (p.pos u) with h | h
      · exfalso
        have hvp := ProofsExitless.vert_pos p hu
        rw [h, p.vert_zero] at hvp
        exact heq hvp.symm
      · exact h
    exact le_of_lt (clm_ordering hP hp (Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inl hfirstC0))
      p.first_mem hu (by omega))

name: Hunter.Proved.clm_eqq_amended
statement:
theorem clm_eqq_amended {P : HPath k} {S : Finset (Vtx k)} (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (hSV : S ⊆ P.vertsFinset) (hS : SPrecond P S) :
    (P.wtP : ℤ) = (wEdges (fPS P S) : ℤ)
      + ∑ e ∈ E1removed P S, ((ew k e.1 e.2 : ℤ) - 1)
      - (indicatorI P S : ℤ)
      + ∑ e ∈ E2removed P S, (ew k e.1 e.2 : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hstar : wEdges (fPS P S) + wEdges (E1removed P S) + wEdges (E2removed P S)
      = wEdges P.edges + wEdges (addedEdges S) := by
    have hb : wEdges (Xstep1 P S) = wEdges (fPS P S) + wEdges (E2removed P S) :=
      (ProofsStructure.wEdges_sdiff
        (ProofsStructure.E2removed_subset_Xstep1 (P := P) (S := S))).symm
    have hdisj : Disjoint (P.edges \ E1removed P S) (addedEdges S) := by
      rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
      intro e he heA
      rw [addedEdges, Finset.mem_image] at heA
      obtain ⟨w, hwS, hwe⟩ := heA
      have heP : e ∈ P.edges := (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp he).1
      rw [← hwe] at heP
      exact hS w hwS heP
    have hc : wEdges (Xstep1 P S)
        = wEdges (P.edges \ E1removed P S) + wEdges (addedEdges S) := by
      rw [Xstep1]; exact ProofsStructure.wEdges_union_disjoint hdisj
    have hd : wEdges (P.edges \ E1removed P S) + wEdges (E1removed P S) = wEdges P.edges :=
      ProofsStructure.wEdges_sdiff (E1removed_subset P S)
    omega
  have hL2 : wEdges (addedEdges S) = S.card := ProofsStructure.wEdges_addedEdges hk
  have hL3 : (E1removed P S).card + indicatorI P S = S.card :=
    ProofsStructure.E1removed_card hSV
  have hcastE1 : (wEdges (E1removed P S) : ℤ) = ∑ e ∈ E1removed P S, (ew k e.1 e.2 : ℤ) := by
    rw [wEdges, Nat.cast_sum]
  have hcastE2 : (wEdges (E2removed P S) : ℤ) = ∑ e ∈ E2removed P S, (ew k e.1 e.2 : ℤ) := by
    rw [wEdges, Nat.cast_sum]
  have hsplit1 : ∑ e ∈ E1removed P S, ((ew k e.1 e.2 : ℤ) - 1)
      = (wEdges (E1removed P S) : ℤ) - ((E1removed P S).card : ℤ) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hcastE1, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  have hbridge : (P.wtP : ℤ) = (wEdges P.edges : ℤ) := by
    rw [bridge_wEdges_edges_eq_wtP]
  have hstarZ : (wEdges (fPS P S) : ℤ) + (wEdges (E1removed P S) : ℤ)
      + (wEdges (E2removed P S) : ℤ) = (wEdges P.edges : ℤ) + (wEdges (addedEdges S) : ℤ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hstar
  have hL2Z : (wEdges (addedEdges S) : ℤ) = (S.card : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hL2
  have hL3Z : ((E1removed P S).card : ℤ) + (indicatorI P S : ℤ) = (S.card : ℤ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hL3
  rw [hbridge, hsplit1, ← hcastE2]
  linarith [hstarZ, hL2Z, hL3Z]

name: Hunter.Proved.prp_Xk_se_necessity_amended
statement:
theorem prp_Xk_se_necessity_amended {k : ℕ} {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (h_se : ∀ P : HPath k, P.IsHamiltonian → IsUnionOfStronglyExitlessPaths (F P))
    (hX : X ∈ Xk k) :
    vertsOf X = Finset.univ ∧ IsUnionOfStronglyExitlessPaths X
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hP, hFX⟩ := hX
  subst hFX
  exact ⟨ProofsStructure.vertsOf_F_eq_univ hP hk, h_se P hP⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsFillPath.marker_reconstruct
statement:
theorem marker_reconstruct {w : List ℕ} (hnd : w.Nodup) (hne : w ≠ []) :
    w = w.erase (w.getLastD 0) ++ [w.getLastD 0]
proof:
:= by
  rw [erase_getLastD hnd]; exact list_dropLast_getLastD w hne

name: Hunter.ProofsFillPath.blockrun_eq
statement:
theorem blockrun_eq (hk : 2 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) (t₀ d : ℕ)
    (hN : k * (t₀ + d) < p.numVerts)
    (hdoor : ∀ r, 1 ≤ r → r ≤ d →
        ew k (p.vert (k * (t₀ + r) - 1)) (p.vert (k * (t₀ + r))) = 2) :
    ∀ r, r ≤ d →
      (p.vert (k * (t₀ + r)) : List ℕ)
        = ((p.vert (k * t₀) : List ℕ).erase ((p.vert (k * t₀) : List ℕ).getLastD 0)).rotate r
          ++ [(p.vert (k * t₀) : List ℕ).getLastD 0]
proof:
:= by
  intro r hr
  obtain ⟨hmk, hmeta⟩ := door_run_metaWord hk hp t₀ d hN hdoor r hr
  have hne : (p.vert (k * (t₀ + r)) : List ℕ) ≠ [] := by
    intro h
    have hl := (p.vert (k * (t₀ + r))).2.length
    rw [h] at hl; simp at hl; omega
  calc (p.vert (k * (t₀ + r)) : List ℕ)
      = (p.vert (k * (t₀ + r)) : List ℕ).erase ((p.vert (k * (t₀ + r)) : List ℕ).getLastD 0)
          ++ [(p.vert (k * (t₀ + r)) : List ℕ).getLastD 0] :=
        marker_reconstruct (p.vert (k * (t₀ + r))).2.nodup hne
    _ = _ := by rw [hmk, hmeta]

name: Hunter.ProofsFillPath.fill_path
statement:
theorem fill_path (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) {t : ℕ} (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (hN : k * (t + (k - 2)) < p.numVerts)
    (hmm : IsMarkerMove p t) (hcomp : IsComplete p (t - 1)) :
    ¬ IsComplete p (t + (k - 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
  have hk2 : 2 ≤ k := by omega
  
  have hcomp' : doorDepth p (t - 1) = k - 2 := hcomp
  have hk2t : k - 2 ≤ t - 1 := by rw [← hcomp']; exact doorDepth_le p (t - 1)
  
  
  
  obtain ⟨a, b, c, s, hxeq⟩ :
      ∃ a b c s, (p.vert (k * t - 1) : List ℕ) = a :: b :: c :: s := by
    have hlen : (p.vert (k * t - 1) : List ℕ).length = k := (p.vert (k * t - 1)).2.length
    set X : List ℕ := (p.vert (k * t - 1) : List ℕ) with hXd
    clear_value X
    match X, hlen with
    | a :: b :: c :: s, _ => exact ⟨a, b, c, s, rfl⟩
    | [], h => simp only [List.length_nil] at h; omega
    | [a], h => simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at h; omega
    | [a, b], h => simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at h; omega
  have hslen : s.length = k - 3 := by
    have hlen : (p.vert (k * t - 1) : List ℕ).length = k := (p.vert (k * t - 1)).2.length
    rw [hxeq] at hlen; simp at hlen; omega
  
  have hXnd : (a :: b :: c :: s).Nodup := by rw [← hxeq]; exact (p.vert (k * t - 1)).2.nodup
  have habcs : a ∉ (b :: c :: s) := (List.nodup_cons.mp hXnd).1
  have hbcsnd : (b :: c :: s).Nodup := (List.nodup_cons.mp hXnd).2
  have hbcs' : b ∉ (c :: s) := (List.nodup_cons.mp hbcsnd).1
  have hcsnd : (c :: s).Nodup := (List.nodup_cons.mp hbcsnd).2
  have hcs' : c ∉ s := (List.nodup_cons.mp hcsnd).1
  have hab : a ≠ b := fun h => habcs (by rw [h]; simp)
  have hac : a ≠ c := fun h => habcs (by rw [h]; simp)
  have hbc : b ≠ c := fun h => hbcs' (by rw [h]; simp)
  have hbs : b ∉ s := fun h => hbcs' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h)
  
  
  
  set g0 : ℕ := (t - 1) - (k - 2) with hg0def
  have hg0 : g0 + (k - 2) = t - 1 := by omega
  
  have hBfull : k * (t - 1) + (k - 1) < p.numVerts := by
    have hkt : k * t = k * (t - 1) + k := by
      rw [← Nat.mul_succ]; congr 1; omega
    have h2 : k * t ≤ k * (t + (k - 2)) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) (by omega)
    omega
  
  have hbt1 : (p.vert (k * (t - 1)) : List ℕ) = (b :: c :: s) ++ [a] := by
    have hfc : p.vert (k * (t - 1) + (k - 1)) = sigma^[k - 1] (p.vert (k * (t - 1))) :=
      block_is_full_cycle hk1 hp ⟨t - 1, rfl⟩ (by omega) hBfull
    have hidx : k * (t - 1) + (k - 1) = k * t - 1 := by
      have hkt : k * t = k * (t - 1) + k := by
        rw [← Nat.mul_succ]; congr 1; omega
      omega
    rw [hidx] at hfc
    have hxrot : (p.vert (k * t - 1) : List ℕ) = (p.vert (k * (t - 1)) : List ℕ).rotate (k - 1) := by
      rw [hfc]; exact sigma_iter_val (k - 1) (p.vert (k * (t - 1)))
    have hroteq : (p.vert (k * (t - 1)) : List ℕ).rotate (k - 1) = a :: b :: c :: s := by
      rw [← hxrot]; exact hxeq
    have hlen : (p.vert (k * (t - 1)) : List ℕ).length = k := (p.vert (k * (t - 1))).2.length
    have hcong : ((p.vert (k * (t - 1)) : List ℕ).rotate (k - 1)).rotate 1
        = (a :: b :: c :: s).rotate 1 := congrArg (·.rotate 1) hroteq
    have hrotk : (p.vert (k * (t - 1)) : List ℕ).rotate k = (p.vert (k * (t - 1)) : List ℕ) := by
      have hrl := List.rotate_length (p.vert (k * (t - 1)) : List ℕ)
      rw [hlen] at hrl; exact hrl
    rw [List.rotate_rotate, show (k - 1) + 1 = k from by omega, hrotk] at hcong
    rw [hcong]; show (a :: b :: c :: s).rotate 1 = (b :: c :: s) ++ [a]; simp
  have hsrc0 : (p.vert (k * (t - 1)) : List ℕ) = srcBlock a b c s 0 := by
    rw [hbt1]; simp [ProofsFill.srcBlock, ProofsFill.markBlock, List.rotate_zero]
  
  have hdoor_src : ∀ r, 1 ≤ r → r ≤ k - 2 →
      ew k (p.vert (k * (g0 + r) - 1)) (p.vert (k * (g0 + r))) = 2 := by
    intro r hr1 hr2
    have hj : (k - 2) - r < doorDepth p (t - 1) := by rw [hcomp']; omega
    have hd := isDoor_of_lt_doorDepth p (t - 1) ((k - 2) - r) hj
    have hidx : (t - 1) - ((k - 2) - r) = g0 + r := by omega
    rw [hidx, IsDoor, bw] at hd; exact hd
  have hNsrc : k * (g0 + (k - 2)) < p.numVerts := by rw [hg0]; omega
  have hLsrc := blockrun_eq hk2 hp g0 (k - 2) hNsrc hdoor_src
  set sm : ℕ := (p.vert (k * g0) : List ℕ).getLastD 0 with hsmdef
  set sb : List ℕ := (p.vert (k * g0) : List ℕ).erase sm with hsbdef
  have hsblen : sb.length = k - 1 := by
    rw [hsbdef, hsmdef, erase_getLastD (p.vert (k * g0)).2.nodup, List.length_dropLast,
        (p.vert (k * g0)).2.length]
  
  have hLsrc_km2 := hLsrc (k - 2) (le_refl _)
  rw [hg0] at hLsrc_km2
  have happ : sb.rotate (k - 2) ++ [sm] = (b :: c :: s) ++ [a] := by rw [← hLsrc_km2]; exact hbt1
  have hlen1 : (sb.rotate (k - 2)).length = (b :: c :: s).length := by
    rw [List.length_rotate, hsblen]; simp only [List.length_cons]; omega
  obtain ⟨hrot, htt⟩ := List.append_inj happ hlen1
  have hma : sm = a := by injection htt
  have hsb1 : sb = (b :: c :: s).rotate 1 := by
    have h : (sb.rotate (k - 2)).rotate 1 = (b :: c :: s).rotate 1 := congrArg (·.rotate 1) hrot
    rw [List.rotate_rotate, show (k - 2) + 1 = k - 1 from by omega] at h
    have hid : sb.rotate (k - 1) = sb := by
      have hrl := List.rotate_length sb
      rw [hsblen] at hrl; exact hrl
    rw [hid] at h; exact h
  have hsrc1 : (p.vert (k * g0) : List ℕ) = srcBlock a b c s 1 := by
    have h0 := hLsrc 0 (by omega)
    rw [Nat.add_zero, List.rotate_zero, hsb1, hma] at h0
    rw [h0]; rfl
  have hsrc2 : (p.vert (k * (g0 + 1)) : List ℕ) = srcBlock a b c s 2 := by
    have h1 := hLsrc 1 (by omega)
    rw [hsb1, hma, List.rotate_rotate] at h1
    rw [h1]; rfl
  
  
  
  have collide : ∀ (pos srcidx : ℕ), srcidx + 1 ≤ t → k * (t + pos) < p.numVerts →
      rotClass (p.vert (k * (t + pos)) : List ℕ) = rotClass (p.vert (k * srcidx) : List ℕ) →
      False := by
    intro pos srcidx hle hlt hcls
    have hBk : k * srcidx + k ≤ k * (t + pos) := by
      have h := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) (show srcidx + 1 ≤ t + pos by omega)
      rwa [Nat.mul_succ] at h
    exact no_reentry hk1 hp (⟨srcidx, rfl⟩ : k ∣ k * srcidx) hBk hlt hcls.symm
  
  
  
  intro hLcomp
  have hLcomp' : doorDepth p (t + (k - 2)) = k - 2 := hLcomp
  have hdoor_land : ∀ r, 1 ≤ r → r ≤ k - 2 →
      ew k (p.vert (k * (t + r) - 1)) (p.vert (k * (t + r))) = 2 := by
    intro r hr1 hr2
    have hj : (k - 2) - r < doorDepth p (t + (k - 2)) := by rw [hLcomp']; omega
    have hd := isDoor_of_lt_doorDepth p (t + (k - 2)) ((k - 2) - r) hj
    have hidx : (t + (k - 2)) - ((k - 2) - r) = t + r := by omega
    rw [hidx, IsDoor, bw] at hd; exact hd
  have hLland := blockrun_eq hk2 hp t (k - 2) hN hdoor_land
  
  have hbw : bw p t = 3 := hmm.1
  have hwt3 : wt k (p.vert (k * t - 1) : List ℕ) (p.vert (k * t) : List ℕ) = 3 := hbw
  have hover : (p.vert (k * t - 1) : List ℕ).drop 3 = (p.vert (k * t) : List ℕ).take (k - 3) := by
    have hspec := (wt_spec (u := (p.vert (k * t - 1) : List ℕ)) (v := (p.vert (k * t) : List ℕ)) hk1
      (le_of_eq (p.vert (k * t - 1)).2.length)).2.2
    rw [hwt3] at hspec; exact hspec
  have hstake : s = (p.vert (k * t) : List ℕ).take (k - 3) := by rw [← hover, hxeq]; rfl
  have hV : (p.vert (k * t) : List ℕ) = s ++ (p.vert (k * t) : List ℕ).drop (k - 3) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← List.take_append_drop (k - 3) (p.vert (k * t) : List ℕ)]
    rw [← hstake]
  have hrlen : ((p.vert (k * t) : List ℕ).drop (k - 3)).length = 3 := by
    rw [List.length_drop, (p.vert (k * t)).2.length]; omega
  obtain ⟨pp, qq, zz, hrtail⟩ := List.length_eq_three.mp hrlen
  have hVform : (p.vert (k * t) : List ℕ) = s ++ [pp, qq, zz] := by rw [hV, hrtail]
  have hmarkV : (p.vert (k * t) : List ℕ).getLastD 0 = zz := by
    rw [hVform, show s ++ [pp, qq, zz] = (s ++ [pp, qq]) ++ [zz] by simp, List.getLastD_concat]
  
  have hVnd : (s ++ [pp, qq, zz]).Nodup := by rw [← hVform]; exact (p.vert (k * t)).2.nodup
  have hnd3 : ([pp, qq, zz] : List ℕ).Nodup := (List.nodup_append.mp hVnd).2.1
  have hdisj := (List.nodup_append.mp hVnd).2.2
  have hpq : pp ≠ qq := by intro h; subst h; simp at hnd3
  have hpz : pp ≠ zz := by intro h; subst h; simp at hnd3
  have hqz : qq ≠ zz := by intro h; subst h; simp at hnd3
  have hpps : pp ∉ s := fun hm => hdisj pp hm pp (by simp) rfl
  have hqqs : qq ∉ s := fun hm => hdisj qq hm qq (by simp) rfl
  have hzzs : zz ∉ s := fun hm => hdisj zz hm zz (by simp) rfl
  
  have hmarkerA : marker p (k * t - 1) = a := by
    rw [marker, hxeq]
    show (rho (a :: b :: c :: s)).getLastD 0 = a
    rw [show rho (a :: b :: c :: s) = (b :: c :: s) ++ [a] by
          show (a :: b :: c :: s).rotate 1 = _; simp, List.getLastD_concat]
  have hzza : zz ≠ a := by
    intro h; apply hmm.2; unfold markPres; rw [hmarkV, hmarkerA]; exact h
  
  have hsym : (p.vert (k * t) : List ℕ).toFinset = (a :: b :: c :: s).toFinset := by
    have h1 := (p.vert (k * t)).2.toFinset_eq
    have h2 := (p.vert (k * t - 1)).2.toFinset_eq
    rw [hxeq] at h2; rw [h1, h2]
  have hmemabc : ∀ y, y ∈ (p.vert (k * t) : List ℕ) → y ∉ s → (y = a ∨ y = b ∨ y = c) := by
    intro y hy hys
    have hym : y ∈ (a :: b :: c :: s) := by
      have := List.mem_toFinset.mpr hy
      rw [hsym, List.mem_toFinset] at this; exact this
    rw [List.mem_cons, List.mem_cons, List.mem_cons] at hym
    rcases hym with h | h | h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr h)
    · exact absurd h hys
  have hppmem := hmemabc pp (by rw [hVform]; exact List.mem_append_right _ (by simp)) hpps
  have hqqmem := hmemabc qq (by rw [hVform]; exact List.mem_append_right _ (by simp)) hqqs
  have hzzmem := hmemabc zz (by rw [hVform]; exact List.mem_append_right _ (by simp)) hzzs
  
  have hVerase : (p.vert (k * t) : List ℕ).erase zz = s ++ [pp, qq] := by
    have hznotin : zz ∉ (s ++ [pp, qq]) := by
      intro h
      rcases List.mem_append.mp h with h1 | h1
      · exact hzzs h1
      · rcases List.mem_cons.mp h1 with h2 | h2
        · exact hpz h2.symm
        · exact hqz (List.mem_singleton.mp h2).symm
    rw [hVform, show s ++ [pp, qq, zz] = (s ++ [pp, qq]) ++ [zz] by simp,
        List.erase_append_right _ hznotin, List.erase_cons_head, List.append_nil]
  have hblock : ∀ r, r ≤ k - 2 →
      (p.vert (k * (t + r)) : List ℕ) = (s ++ [pp, qq]).rotate r ++ [zz] := by
    intro r hr
    rw [hLland r hr, hmarkV, hVerase]
  
  have hrange : ∀ pos, pos ≤ k - 2 → k * (t + pos) < p.numVerts := by
    intro pos hpos
    have := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) (show t + pos ≤ t + (k - 2) by omega)
    omega
  
  
  
  rcases hzzmem with hzv | hzv | hzv
  · exact hzza hzv
  · 
    rcases hppmem with hpv | hpv | hpv
    · 
      rcases hqqmem with hqv | hqv | hqv
      · exact hpq (hpv.trans hqv.symm)
      · exact hqz (hqv.trans hzv.symm)
      · 
        have hbk := hblock s.length (by omega)
        rw [hpv, hqv, hzv] at hbk
        have hcls : rotClass (p.vert (k * (t + s.length)) : List ℕ)
            = rotClass (p.vert (k * g0) : List ℕ) := by
          rw [hbk]
          show rotClass (mmaBlock a b c s s.length) = rotClass (p.vert (k * g0) : List ℕ)
          rw [mm_a_share1 a b c s, ← hsrc1]
        exact collide s.length g0 (by omega) (hrange s.length (by omega)) hcls
    · exact hpz (hpv.trans hzv.symm)
    · 
      rcases hqqmem with hqv | hqv | hqv
      · 
        have hbk := hblock s.length (by omega)
        rw [hpv, hqv, hzv] at hbk
        have hcls : rotClass (p.vert (k * (t + s.length)) : List ℕ)
            = rotClass (p.vert (k * (g0 + 1)) : List ℕ) := by
          rw [hbk]
          show rotClass (mmbBlock a b c s s.length) = rotClass (p.vert (k * (g0 + 1)) : List ℕ)
          rw [mm_b_share a b c s, ← hsrc2]
        exact collide s.length (g0 + 1) (by omega) (hrange s.length (by omega)) hcls
      · exact hqz (hqv.trans hzv.symm)
      · exact hpq (hpv.trans hqv.symm)
  · 
    rcases hppmem with hpv | hpv | hpv
    · 
      rcases hqqmem with hqv | hqv | hqv
      · exact hpq (hpv.trans hqv.symm)
      · 
        have hbk := hblock 0 (by omega)
        rw [Nat.add_zero, hpv, hqv, hzv] at hbk
        have hcls : rotClass (p.vert (k * t) : List ℕ)
            = rotClass (p.vert (k * (t - 1)) : List ℕ) := by
          rw [hbk]
          show rotClass (mmcBlock a b c s 0) = rotClass (p.vert (k * (t - 1)) : List ℕ)
          rw [mm_c_share a b c s, ← hsrc0]
        exact collide 0 (t - 1) (by omega) (hrange 0 (by omega)) hcls
      · exact hqz (hqv.trans hzv.symm)
    · 
      rcases hqqmem with hqv | hqv | hqv
      · 
        have hbk := hblock 0 (by omega)
        rw [Nat.add_zero, hpv, hqv, hzv] at hbk
        have hcls : rotClass (p.vert (k * t) : List ℕ)
            = rotClass (p.vert (k * g0) : List ℕ) := by
          rw [hbk]
          show rotClass (mmdBlock a b c s 0) = rotClass (p.vert (k * g0) : List ℕ)
          rw [mm_d_share a b c s, ← hsrc1]
        exact collide 0 g0 (by omega) (hrange 0 (by omega)) hcls
      · exact hpq (hpv.trans hqv.symm)
      · exact hqz (hqv.trans hzv.symm)
    · exact hpz (hpv.trans hzv.symm)

name: Hunter.Proved.fill_path
statement:
theorem fill_path {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) {t : ℕ} (ht : 1 ≤ t)
    (hN : k * (t + (k - 2)) < p.numVerts)
    (hmm : IsMarkerMove p t) (hcomp : IsComplete p (t - 1)) :
    ¬ IsComplete p (t + (k - 2))
proof:
:=
  ProofsFillPath.fill_path hk hp ht hN hmm hcomp

name: Hunter.Proved.no_reset_from_complete_opens_complete
proof:
:=
  fun ⟨hmm, hc1, hc2⟩ => ProofsFillPath.fill_path hk hp ht hN hmm hc1 hc2

name: Hunter.ProofsUnwind3.vert1_eq_sigma_first
statement:
theorem vert1_eq_sigma_first {p : HPath k} (hpSE : p.StronglyExitless) (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    p.vert 1 = sigma p.first
proof:
:= by
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
  have hdvd := Proved.dvd_numVerts_of_stronglyExitless hk1 hpSE
  have hkle : k ≤ p.numVerts := Nat.le_of_dvd p.numVerts_pos hdvd
  have h1lt : 1 < p.numVerts := by omega
  have hkndvd : ¬ k ∣ (0 + 1) := by
    intro h; have := Nat.le_of_dvd (show 0 < 0 + 1 by omega) h; omega
  have h := ProofsExitless.vert_succ hk1 hpSE.1 (i := 0) (show 0 + 1 < p.numVerts by omega) hkndvd
  rwa [p.vert_zero] at h

name: Hunter.ProofsUnwind3.one_lt_numVerts
statement:
theorem one_lt_numVerts {p : HPath k} (hpSE : p.StronglyExitless) (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    1 < p.numVerts
proof:
:= by
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
  have hdvd := Proved.dvd_numVerts_of_stronglyExitless hk1 hpSE
  have hkle : k ≤ p.numVerts := Nat.le_of_dvd p.numVerts_pos hdvd
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsUnwind3.first_edge_mem_self
statement:
theorem first_edge_mem_self {p : HPath k} (hpSE : p.StronglyExitless) (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    (p.first, sigma p.first) ∈ p.edges
proof:
:= by
  have h1lt : 1 < p.numVerts := one_lt_numVerts hpSE hk
  have h01 := ProofsStructure.vert_consec_mem_edges (p := p) (i := 0) (by omega)
  rwa [p.vert_zero, vert1_eq_sigma_first hpSE hk] at h01

name: Hunter.ProofsUnwind3.edge_eq_consec
statement:
theorem edge_eq_consec {p : HPath k} {e : Vtx k × Vtx k} (he : e ∈ p.edges) :
    e = (p.vert (p.pos e.1), p.vert (p.pos e.1 + 1)) ∧ p.pos e.1 + 1 < p.numVerts
proof:
:= by
  have hpos := ProofsStructure.edge_pos_succ he
  
  have h1mem : e.1 ∈ p.verts := by
    have := ProofsSpine.mem_edges_iff.mp he
    exact List.of_mem_zip this |>.1
  have h2mem : e.2 ∈ p.verts := by
    have := ProofsSpine.mem_edges_iff.mp he
    exact List.mem_of_mem_tail (List.of_mem_zip this |>.2)
  have hv1 : p.vert (p.pos e.1) = e.1 := ProofsExitless.vert_pos p h1mem
  have hv2 : p.vert (p.pos e.2) = e.2 := ProofsExitless.vert_pos p h2mem
  have hlt : p.pos e.2 < p.numVerts := ProofsExitless.pos_lt p h2mem
  refine ⟨?_, by rw [← hpos]; exact hlt⟩
  rw [hv1, ← hpos, hv2]

name: Hunter.ProofsUnwind3.mem_headSet
statement:
theorem mem_headSet {ps : List (HPath k)} {v : Vtx k} :
    v ∈ headSet ps ↔ ∃ q ∈ ps.dropLast, q.first = v
proof:
:= by
  rw [headSet, List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_map]

name: Hunter.ProofsUnwind3.first_edge_mem_addedEdges
proof:
:= by
  rw [addedEdges, Finset.mem_image]
  exact ⟨p.first, mem_headSet.mpr ⟨p, hpdl, rfl⟩, rfl⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsUnwind3.mem_addedEdges_iff
statement:
theorem mem_addedEdges_iff {ps : List (HPath k)} {e : Vtx k × Vtx k} :
    e ∈ addedEdges (headSet ps) ↔ ∃ q ∈ ps.dropLast, e = (q.first, sigma q.first)
proof:
:= by
  rw [addedEdges, Finset.mem_image]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := mem_headSet.mp hv
    exact ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨q.first, mem_headSet.mpr ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩, rfl⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsUnwind3.component_edge_mem_P
statement:
theorem component_edge_mem_P {ps : List (HPath k)} (hps : ps ≠ [])
    (hnd : (unwindVerts ps).Nodup) (hSE : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.StronglyExitless) (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    {p : HPath k} (hp : p ∈ ps) {e : Vtx k × Vtx k} (he : e ∈ p.edges)
    (heFE : e ∉ addedEdges (headSet ps)) :
    e ∈ (unwindP ps hps hnd).edges
proof:
:= by
  have hpSE := hSE p hp
  obtain ⟨heq, hlt⟩ := edge_eq_consec he
  set j := p.pos e.1 with hj
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j with hj0 | hj1
  · 
    rw [hj0] at heq hlt
    have he0 : e = (p.first, sigma p.first) := by
      rw [heq, p.vert_zero, vert1_eq_sigma_first hpSE hk]
    by_cases hpdl : p ∈ ps.dropLast
    · exact absurd (he0 ▸ first_edge_mem_addedEdges hpdl) heFE
    · 
      have hsplit := List.dropLast_append_getLast hps
      have hmem2 : p ∈ ps.dropLast ++ [ps.getLast hps] := hsplit.symm ▸ hp
      rw [List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at hmem2
      have hpeq : p = ps.getLast hps := hmem2.resolve_left hpdl
      rw [he0, hpeq]
      exact junction_edge_mem hps hnd hSE hk
  · 
    rw [heq]
    exact interior_edge_mem hps hnd hp hj1 hlt

name: Hunter.ProofsUnwind3.sdiff_subset_edges
statement:
theorem sdiff_subset_edges {ps : List (HPath k)} (hps : ps ≠ [])
    (hnd : (unwindVerts ps).Nodup) (hSE : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.StronglyExitless) (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} (hXdef : ∀ e, e ∈ X ↔ ∃ p ∈ ps, e ∈ p.edges) :
    X \ addedEdges (headSet ps) ⊆ (unwindP ps hps hnd).edges
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  rw [Finset.mem_sdiff] at he
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hep⟩ := (hXdef e).mp he.1
  exact component_edge_mem_P hps hnd hSE hk hp hep he.2

name: Hunter.ProofsUnwind3.addedEdges_subset_X
statement:
theorem addedEdges_subset_X {ps : List (HPath k)}
    (hSE : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.StronglyExitless) (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} (hXdef : ∀ e, e ∈ X ↔ ∃ p ∈ ps, e ∈ p.edges) :
    addedEdges (headSet ps) ⊆ X
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := mem_addedEdges_iff.mp he
  have hqmem : q ∈ ps := List.dropLast_subset ps hq
  exact (hXdef _).mpr ⟨q, hqmem, first_edge_mem_self (hSE q hqmem) hk⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsUnwind3.mem_doubles_of
proof:
:= by
  rw [doubles, Finset.mem_filter]
  refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
  have hdecomp : intoV (Xstep1 P S) b =
      intoV (P.edges \ E1removed P S) b ∪ intoV (addedEdges S) b := by
    unfold Xstep1; exact ProofsSpine.intoV_union _ _ b
  have hab1 : (a, b) ∈ intoV (P.edges \ E1removed P S) b := by
    rw [intoV, mem_into, Finset.mem_singleton]
    refine ⟨?_, rfl⟩
    rw [Finset.mem_sdiff]
    exact ⟨hab, fun hc => haS (by rw [E1removed, Finset.mem_filter] at hc; exact hc.2)⟩
  have hvb1 : (v, b) ∈ intoV (addedEdges S) b := by
    rw [intoV, mem_into, Finset.mem_singleton]
    exact ⟨by rw [addedEdges, Finset.mem_image]; exact ⟨v, hvS, by rw [hσ]⟩, rfl⟩
  have hne : ((a, b) : Vtx k × Vtx k) ≠ (v, b) := by
    intro h; rw [Prod.mk.injEq] at h; exact haS (h.1 ▸ hvS)
  have hsub : ({(a, b), (v, b)} : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)) ⊆ intoV (Xstep1 P S) b := by
    intro x hx
    rw [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hx
    rw [hdecomp, Finset.mem_union]
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl
    · exact Or.inl hab1
    · exact Or.inr hvb1
  have hge : 2 ≤ (intoV (Xstep1 P S) b).card := by
    have hpc : ({(a, b), (v, b)} : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)).card = 2 := by
      rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem (by simp [hne]), Finset.card_singleton]
    calc 2 = ({(a, b), (v, b)} : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)).card := hpc.symm
      _ ≤ _ := Finset.card_le_card hsub
  have hAle : (intoV (P.edges \ E1removed P S) b).card ≤ 1 :=
    le_trans (Finset.card_le_card (ProofsSpine.intoV_mono Finset.sdiff_subset b))
      (ProofsSpine.path_into_le_one P b)
  have hBle : (intoV (addedEdges S) b).card ≤ 1 := ProofsSpine.intoV_addedEdges_le_one S b
  have hle : (intoV (Xstep1 P S) b).card ≤ 2 := by
    rw [hdecomp]
    exact le_trans (Finset.card_union_le _ _) (by omega)
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsUnwind3.mem_doubles_imp
statement:
theorem mem_doubles_imp {P : HPath k} {S : Finset (Vtx k)} {b : Vtx k}
    (hb : b ∈ doubles P S) : ∃ v ∈ S, sigma v = b
proof:
:= by
  have hne := ProofsStructure.double_imp_added_inedge hb
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hne
  rw [intoV, mem_into, Finset.mem_singleton] at he
  obtain ⟨heA, he2⟩ := he
  rw [addedEdges, Finset.mem_image] at heA
  obtain ⟨v, hvS, rfl⟩ := heA
  exact ⟨v, hvS, he2⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsUnwind3.comp_eq_of_shared
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  haveI : Std.Symm (fun a b : HPath k => Disjoint a.vertsFinset b.vertsFinset) :=
    ⟨fun a b h => h.symm⟩
  have hdisj := hpair.forall hp hq hne
  have h1 : v ∈ p.vertsFinset := HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mpr hvp
  have h2 : v ∈ q.vertsFinset := HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mpr hvq
  exact absurd (Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨h1, h2⟩)
    (by rw [Finset.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mp hdisj]; exact Finset.notMem_empty v)

name: Hunter.ProofsUnwind3.head_pred_mem_headSet
statement:
theorem head_pred_mem_headSet {ps : List (HPath k)} (hps : ps ≠ [])
    (hnd : (unwindVerts ps).Nodup) {e : Vtx k × Vtx k}
    (he : e ∈ (unwindP ps hps hnd).edges) (hb : e.2 ∈ ps.map HPath.first) :
    e.1 ∈ headSet ps
proof:
:= by
  set P := unwindP ps hps hnd with hP
  set heads := ps.map HPath.first with hh
  set tails := (ps.reverse.map (fun p => p.verts.drop 1)).flatten with htl
  have hLeq : unwindVerts ps = heads ++ tails := rfl
  have he1mem : e.1 ∈ unwindVerts ps := by
    have := ProofsSpine.mem_edges_iff.mp he
    exact (List.of_mem_zip this).1
  have hidx_b : (unwindVerts ps).idxOf e.2 = heads.idxOf e.2 := by
    rw [hLeq, List.idxOf_append_of_mem hb]
  have hsucc : (unwindVerts ps).idxOf e.2 = (unwindVerts ps).idxOf e.1 + 1 :=
    ProofsStructure.edge_pos_succ he
  set t := heads.idxOf e.2 with ht
  have ht_lt : t < heads.length := List.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem hb
  have hidx_e1 : (unwindVerts ps).idxOf e.1 = t - 1 := by omega
  
  have he1_head : e.1 ∈ heads := by
    rcases List.mem_append.mp (hLeq ▸ he1mem) with h | h
    · exact h
    · exfalso
      have hnh : e.1 ∉ heads := tail_not_mem_heads hnd (htl ▸ h)
      have hval : (unwindVerts ps).idxOf e.1 = heads.length + tails.idxOf e.1 := by
        rw [hLeq, List.idxOf_append_of_notMem hnh]
      omega
  have hheads_idx : heads.idxOf e.1 = t - 1 := by
    have : (unwindVerts ps).idxOf e.1 = heads.idxOf e.1 := by
      rw [hLeq, List.idxOf_append_of_mem he1_head]
    omega
  have he1_dl : e.1 ∈ heads.dropLast :=
    (List.mem_dropLast_iff_idxOf_lt he1_head).mpr (by rw [hheads_idx]; omega)
  rw [headSet, List.mem_toFinset, hh, ← List.map_dropLast] at *
  exact he1_dl

name: Hunter.ProofsUnwind3.edge_classify
statement:
theorem edge_classify {ps : List (HPath k)} (hps : ps ≠ [])
    (hnd : (unwindVerts ps).Nodup) (hSE : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.StronglyExitless) (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} (hXdef : ∀ e, e ∈ X ↔ ∃ p ∈ ps, e ∈ p.edges)
    {e : Vtx k × Vtx k} (he : e ∈ (unwindP ps hps hnd).edges) :
    e ∈ X ∨ e.1 ∈ headSet ps ∨ ∃ v ∈ headSet ps, sigma v = e.2
proof:
:= by
  set P := unwindP ps hps hnd with hP
  have hb_mem : e.2 ∈ unwindVerts ps := by
    have hz := ProofsSpine.mem_edges_iff.mp he
    have h2 : e.2 ∈ P.verts := List.mem_of_mem_tail (List.of_mem_zip hz).2
    exact h2
  obtain ⟨pb, hpb, hbpb⟩ := mem_unwindVerts.mp hb_mem
  have hpbSE := hSE pb hpb
  set m := pb.pos e.2 with hm
  have hmlt : m < pb.numVerts := ProofsExitless.pos_lt pb hbpb
  have hbvm : pb.vert m = e.2 := ProofsExitless.vert_pos pb hbpb
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with hm0 | hm1
  · 
    right; left
    have hbf : e.2 = pb.first := by rw [← hbvm, hm0, pb.vert_zero]
    exact head_pred_mem_headSet hps hnd he (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨pb, hpb, hbf.symm⟩)
  · 
    have hcons : (pb.vert (m - 1), pb.vert m) ∈ pb.edges := by
      have h := ProofsStructure.vert_consec_mem_edges (p := pb) (i := m - 1) (by omega)
      rwa [show m - 1 + 1 = m from by omega] at h
    by_cases hcP : (pb.vert (m - 1), pb.vert m) ∈ P.edges
    · 
      left
      have h1 : e ∈ intoV P.edges e.2 := by
        rw [intoV, mem_into, Finset.mem_singleton]; exact ⟨he, rfl⟩
      have h2 : (pb.vert (m - 1), pb.vert m) ∈ intoV P.edges e.2 := by
        rw [intoV, mem_into, Finset.mem_singleton]; exact ⟨hcP, hbvm⟩
      have heq : e = (pb.vert (m - 1), pb.vert m) :=
        Finset.card_le_one.mp (ProofsSpine.path_into_le_one P e.2) e h1 _ h2
      rw [heq]; exact (hXdef _).mpr ⟨pb, hpb, hcons⟩
    · 
      have hm_eq1 : m = 1 := by
        by_contra hmne
        apply hcP
        have h := interior_edge_mem hps hnd hpb (show 1 ≤ m - 1 by omega)
          (show (m - 1) + 1 < pb.numVerts by omega)
        rwa [show m - 1 + 1 = m from by omega] at h
      have hpdl : pb ∈ ps.dropLast := by
        by_contra hpdl'
        apply hcP
        have hsplit := List.dropLast_append_getLast hps
        have hmem2 : pb ∈ ps.dropLast ++ [ps.getLast hps] := hsplit.symm ▸ hpb
        rw [List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at hmem2
        have hpeq : pb = ps.getLast hps := hmem2.resolve_left hpdl'
        have h11 : (1 : ℕ) - 1 = 0 := rfl
        rw [hm_eq1, h11, pb.vert_zero, vert1_eq_sigma_first hpbSE hk, hpeq]
        exact junction_edge_mem hps hnd hSE hk
      right; right
      refine ⟨pb.first, mem_headSet.mpr ⟨pb, hpdl, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      have hb1 : pb.vert 1 = e.2 := by rw [← hm_eq1]; exact hbvm
      rw [vert1_eq_sigma_first hpbSE hk] at hb1
      exact hb1

name: Hunter.ProofsUnwind3.edges_decomp
statement:
theorem edges_decomp {ps : List (HPath k)} (hps : ps ≠ [])
    (hnd : (unwindVerts ps).Nodup) (hSE : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.StronglyExitless) (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} (hXdef : ∀ e, e ∈ X ↔ ∃ p ∈ ps, e ∈ p.edges) :
    (unwindP ps hps hnd).edges =
      (X \ addedEdges (headSet ps)) ∪ E1removed (unwindP ps hps hnd) (headSet ps) ∪
        E2removed (unwindP ps hps hnd) (headSet ps)
proof:
:= by
  set P := unwindP ps hps hnd with hP
  apply Finset.Subset.antisymm
  · 
    intro e heP
    rcases edge_classify hps hnd hSE hk hXdef heP with hX | hSrc | ⟨v, hvS, hσ⟩
    · 
      have heFE : e ∉ addedEdges (headSet ps) := by
        intro hFE
        obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := mem_addedEdges_iff.mp hFE
        exact first_edge_not_mem_edges hps hnd hq (hSE q (List.dropLast_subset ps hq)) hk heP
      exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hX, heFE⟩))
    · 
      exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_right _
        (by rw [E1removed, Finset.mem_filter]; exact ⟨heP, hSrc⟩))
    · 
      by_cases hsrc : e.1 ∈ headSet ps
      · exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_right _
          (by rw [E1removed, Finset.mem_filter]; exact ⟨heP, hsrc⟩))
      · have hd : e.2 ∈ doubles P (headSet ps) := by
          have : ((e.1, e.2) : Vtx k × Vtx k) ∈ P.edges := heP
          exact mem_doubles_of P (headSet ps) this hsrc hvS hσ
        exact Finset.mem_union_right _ (by rw [E2removed, Finset.mem_filter]; exact ⟨heP, hd⟩)
  · 
    apply Finset.union_subset
    apply Finset.union_subset
    · exact sdiff_subset_edges hps hnd hSE hk hXdef
    · exact E1removed_subset _ _
    · exact E2removed_subset _ _

name: Hunter.ProofsUnwind3.disjoint_E1_X
statement:
theorem disjoint_E1_X {ps : List (HPath k)} (hps : ps ≠ [])
    (hnd : (unwindVerts ps).Nodup) (hSE : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.StronglyExitless) (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (hpair : ps.Pairwise (fun p q : HPath k => Disjoint p.vertsFinset q.vertsFinset))
    {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} (hXdef : ∀ e, e ∈ X ↔ ∃ p ∈ ps, e ∈ p.edges) :
    Disjoint (E1removed (unwindP ps hps hnd) (headSet ps)) X
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro e he1 hX
  rw [E1removed, Finset.mem_filter] at he1
  obtain ⟨heP, hsrc⟩ := he1
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqf⟩ := mem_headSet.mp hsrc
  have hqmem : q ∈ ps := List.dropLast_subset ps hq
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hep⟩ := (hXdef e).mp hX
  have hvp : e.1 ∈ p.verts := by
    have := ProofsSpine.mem_edges_iff.mp hep; exact (List.of_mem_zip this).1
  have hvq : e.1 ∈ q.verts := by rw [← hqf]; exact q.first_mem
  have hpq : p = q := comp_eq_of_shared hpair hp hqmem hvp hvq
  rw [hpq] at hep
  obtain ⟨heqc, -⟩ := edge_eq_consec hep
  have hp0 : q.pos e.1 = 0 := by rw [← hqf]; exact ProofsStructure.pos_first q
  rw [hp0, q.vert_zero, show q.vert (0 + 1) = q.vert 1 from rfl,
    vert1_eq_sigma_first (hSE q hqmem) hk] at heqc
  exact first_edge_not_mem_edges hps hnd hq (hSE q hqmem) hk (heqc ▸ heP)

name: Hunter.ProofsUnwind3.disjoint_X_E2
statement:
theorem disjoint_X_E2 {ps : List (HPath k)} (hps : ps ≠ [])
    (hnd : (unwindVerts ps).Nodup) (hSE : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.StronglyExitless) (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (hpair : ps.Pairwise (fun p q : HPath k => Disjoint p.vertsFinset q.vertsFinset))
    {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)} (hXdef : ∀ e, e ∈ X ↔ ∃ p ∈ ps, e ∈ p.edges) :
    Disjoint X (E2removed (unwindP ps hps hnd) (headSet ps))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro e hX he2
  rw [E2removed, Finset.mem_filter] at he2
  obtain ⟨heP, hd⟩ := he2
  obtain ⟨v, hvS, hσ⟩ := mem_doubles_imp hd
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqf⟩ := mem_headSet.mp hvS
  have hqmem : q ∈ ps := List.dropLast_subset ps hq
  have hq1lt : 1 < q.numVerts := one_lt_numVerts (hSE q hqmem) hk
  
  have hb1 : q.vert 1 = e.2 := by
    rw [vert1_eq_sigma_first (hSE q hqmem) hk, hqf, hσ]
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hep⟩ := (hXdef e).mp hX
  have hvp : e.2 ∈ p.verts := by
    have := ProofsSpine.mem_edges_iff.mp hep
    exact List.mem_of_mem_tail (List.of_mem_zip this).2
  have hvq : e.2 ∈ q.verts := by rw [← hb1]; exact ProofsExitless.vert_mem q hq1lt
  have hpq : p = q := comp_eq_of_shared hpair hp hqmem hvp hvq
  rw [hpq] at hep
  obtain ⟨heqc, hltc⟩ := edge_eq_consec hep
  
  have hsnd : e.2 = q.vert (q.pos e.1 + 1) := congrArg Prod.snd heqc
  have hposeq : q.pos e.1 + 1 = 1 := by
    have h1 := ProofsExitless.pos_vert q hltc
    have h2 := ProofsExitless.pos_vert q hq1lt
    have hvv : q.vert (q.pos e.1 + 1) = q.vert 1 := by rw [← hsnd, ← hb1]
    rw [hvv] at h1
    rw [← h1, h2]
  have hp0 : q.pos e.1 = 0 := by omega
  rw [hp0, q.vert_zero, show q.vert (0 + 1) = q.vert 1 from rfl,
    vert1_eq_sigma_first (hSE q hqmem) hk] at heqc
  exact first_edge_not_mem_edges hps hnd hq (hSE q hqmem) hk (heqc ▸ heP)

name: Hunter.ProofsUnwind3.disjoint_E1_E2
statement:
theorem disjoint_E1_E2 {ps : List (HPath k)} (hps : ps ≠ [])
    (hnd : (unwindVerts ps).Nodup) :
    Disjoint (E1removed (unwindP ps hps hnd) (headSet ps))
      (E2removed (unwindP ps hps hnd) (headSet ps))
proof:
:= by
  set P := unwindP ps hps hnd with hP
  set S := headSet ps with hS
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro e he1 he2
  rw [E1removed, Finset.mem_filter] at he1
  rw [E2removed, Finset.mem_filter] at he2
  obtain ⟨heP, hsrc1⟩ := he1
  obtain ⟨-, hd⟩ := he2
  have hd2 : (intoV (Xstep1 P S) e.2).card = 2 := by
    rw [doubles, Finset.mem_filter] at hd; exact hd.2
  have hdecomp : intoV (Xstep1 P S) e.2 =
      intoV (P.edges \ E1removed P S) e.2 ∪ intoV (addedEdges S) e.2 := by
    unfold Xstep1; exact ProofsSpine.intoV_union _ _ e.2
  have hBle : (intoV (addedEdges S) e.2).card ≤ 1 := ProofsSpine.intoV_addedEdges_le_one S e.2
  have hApos : 1 ≤ (intoV (P.edges \ E1removed P S) e.2).card := by
    have hunion : (intoV (Xstep1 P S) e.2).card ≤
        (intoV (P.edges \ E1removed P S) e.2).card + (intoV (addedEdges S) e.2).card := by
      rw [hdecomp]; exact Finset.card_union_le _ _
    omega
  obtain ⟨e', he'⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp hApos
  rw [intoV, mem_into, Finset.mem_singleton] at he'
  obtain ⟨he'mem, he'2⟩ := he'
  have he'P : e' ∈ P.edges := (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp he'mem).1
  
  have hee' : e = e' := by
    refine Finset.card_le_one.mp (ProofsSpine.path_into_le_one P e.2) e ?_ e' ?_
    · rw [intoV, mem_into, Finset.mem_singleton]; exact ⟨heP, rfl⟩
    · rw [intoV, mem_into, Finset.mem_singleton]; exact ⟨he'P, he'2⟩
  
  have he'notE1 : e' ∉ E1removed P S := (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp he'mem).2
  exact he'notE1 (hee' ▸ (by rw [E1removed, Finset.mem_filter]; exact ⟨heP, hsrc1⟩))

name: Hunter.Proved.prp_Xk_se_sufficiency_unwind3
statement:
theorem prp_Xk_se_sufficiency_unwind3 {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)}
    {ps : List (HPath k)} (hps : ps ≠ [])
    (hnd : (unwindVerts ps).Nodup)
    (hcover : ∀ v : Vtx k, ∃ p ∈ ps, v ∈ p.verts)
    (hSE : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.StronglyExitless) (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (hpair : ps.Pairwise (fun p q : HPath k => Disjoint p.vertsFinset q.vertsFinset))
    (hXdef : ∀ e, e ∈ X ↔ ∃ p ∈ ps, e ∈ p.edges) :
    X ∈ Xk k
proof:
:=
  prp_Xk_se_sufficiency_unwind2 hps hnd hcover hSE hk
    (edges_decomp hps hnd hSE hk hXdef)
    (addedEdges_subset_X hSE hk hXdef)
    (disjoint_E1_X hps hnd hSE hk hpair hXdef)
    (disjoint_E1_E2 hps hnd)
    (disjoint_X_E2 hps hnd hSE hk hpair hXdef)

name: Hunter.ProofsChart.sigma_vert_eq_block_start
proof:
:= by
  have S0 := vert_eq_sigma_iter hk hp j hj
  have him := mod_eq_pred_of_dvd_succ hk hd
  rw [S0, ← Function.iterate_succ_apply' sigma (j % k) (p.vert (k * (j / k))),
      show (j % k).succ = k from by omega, sigma_iter_period]

name: Hunter.ProofsChart.suffix_exitless
proof:
:= by
  have hnv : p.numVerts = p.verts.length := rfl
  have hne : p.verts.drop B ≠ [] := by
    have : 0 < (p.verts.drop B).length := by rw [List.length_drop]; omega
    exact List.ne_nil_of_length_pos this
  have hnodup : (p.verts.drop B).Nodup := p.nodup.sublist (List.drop_sublist _ _)
  refine ⟨⟨p.verts.drop B, hne, hnodup⟩, rfl, ?_⟩
  set q : HPath k := ⟨p.verts.drop B, hne, hnodup⟩ with hqdef
  have hqnv : q.numVerts = p.numVerts - B := by
    show (p.verts.drop B).length = p.verts.length - B
    rw [List.length_drop]
  
  have hqvert : ∀ i, i < q.numVerts → q.vert i = p.vert (B + i) := by
    intro i hi
    have hi' : B + i < p.numVerts := by rw [hqnv] at hi; omega
    rw [vert_getElem q hi, vert_getElem p hi']
    exact List.getElem_drop
  
  intro hEE
  obtain ⟨i, hi1, hi2, hi3⟩ := hEE
  have hBi1 : B + i + 1 < p.numVerts := by rw [hqnv] at hi1; omega
  have hBi : B + i < p.numVerts := by omega
  
  have hvi : q.vert i = p.vert (B + i) := hqvert i (by omega)
  have hvi1 : q.vert (i + 1) = p.vert (B + i + 1) := by
    have := hqvert (i + 1) hi1; rwa [show B + (i + 1) = B + i + 1 from by ring] at this
  have hw2 : 2 ≤ ew k (p.vert (B + i)) (p.vert (B + i + 1)) := by rw [← hvi, ← hvi1]; exact hi2
  have hbndry : k ∣ (B + i + 1) := by
    by_contra hnd
    have hone : ew k (p.vert (B + i)) (p.vert (B + i + 1)) = 1 :=
      (prp_periodicedges hk hp (i := B + i) hBi1).mpr hnd
    omega
  
  set C := k * ((B + i) / k) with hCdef
  have hsig : sigma (p.vert (B + i)) = p.vert C :=
    sigma_vert_eq_block_start hk hp hBi hbndry
  have hCge : B ≤ C := by
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hBdvd
    rw [hCdef]
    have ht : t ≤ (k * t + i) / k := by
      calc t = (k * t) / k := (Nat.mul_div_cancel_left t hk).symm
        _ ≤ (k * t + i) / k := Nat.div_le_div_right (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) ht
  have hCle : C ≤ B + i := by
    rw [hCdef]; exact Nat.mul_div_le (B + i) k
  
  have hCBlt : C - B < q.numVerts := by rw [hqnv]; omega
  have hqCB : q.vert (C - B) = p.vert C := by
    have := hqvert (C - B) hCBlt
    rwa [show B + (C - B) = C from by omega] at this
  have hsigeq : sigma (q.vert i) = q.vert (C - B) := by rw [hvi, hsig, hqCB]
  
  have hpos : q.pos (sigma (q.vert i)) = C - B := by rw [hsigeq]; exact pos_vert q hCBlt
  rw [hpos] at hi3
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsChart.excess_eq_sum_perEdge
statement:
theorem excess_eq_sum_perEdge (p : HPath k) :
    excess p = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p.numVerts - 1), perEdgeExc p i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [excess, edgeCountGe, Finset.card_filter, perEdgeExc]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]

name: Hunter.ProofsChart.excess_split
proof:
:= by
  
  have hnv : p.numVerts = p.verts.length := rfl
  have hqnv : q.numVerts = p.numVerts - B := by
    show q.verts.length = p.verts.length - B
    rw [hq, List.length_drop]
  have hqvert : ∀ i, i < q.numVerts → q.vert i = p.vert (B + i) := by
    intro i hi
    have hi' : B + i < p.numVerts := by rw [hqnv] at hi; omega
    rw [vert_getElem q hi, vert_getElem p hi']
    simp only [hq]
    exact List.getElem_drop
  have hperEdge : ∀ i, i + 1 < q.numVerts → perEdgeExc q i = perEdgeExc p (B + i) := by
    intro i hi
    have hvi : q.vert i = p.vert (B + i) := hqvert i (by omega)
    have hvi1 : q.vert (i + 1) = p.vert (B + i + 1) := by
      have := hqvert (i + 1) hi; rwa [show B + (i + 1) = B + i + 1 from by ring] at this
    simp only [perEdgeExc, hvi, hvi1, Nat.add_assoc]
  
  have hBle : B ≤ p.numVerts - 1 := by omega
  have hqpos := q.numVerts_pos
  have hqedges : (p.numVerts - 1) - B = q.numVerts - 1 := by rw [hqnv]; omega
  have hexcq : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico B (p.numVerts - 1), perEdgeExc p j = excess q := by
    rw [Finset.sum_Ico_eq_sum_range, excess_eq_sum_perEdge q, hqedges]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hi
    exact (hperEdge i (by omega)).symm
  
  rw [excess_eq_sum_perEdge p, ← hexcq,
    ← Finset.sum_range_add_sum_Ico (fun j => perEdgeExc p j) hBle]

name: Hunter.ProofsChart.perEdgeExc_eq
statement:
theorem perEdgeExc_eq (hk : 1 ≤ k) (p : HPath k) (i : ℕ) :
    perEdgeExc p i = ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) - 2
proof:
:=
  sum_indicator_Icc3 (ew_le_k hk _ _)

name: Hunter.ProofsChart.s1_door_determinism
statement:
theorem s1_door_determinism (hk : 2 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) {i : ℕ}
    (hi : i + 1 < p.numVerts) (hd : k ∣ (i + 1))
    (hw : ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) = 2) :
    (p.vert (i + 1) : List ℕ) = door (p.vert i : List ℕ)
proof:
:=
  door_of_boundary hk hp hi hd hw

name: Hunter.ProofsChart.s1_door_run_le
statement:
theorem s1_door_run_le (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) (t : ℕ)
    (hN : k * t < p.numVerts) : doorDepth p t ≤ k - 2
proof:
:=
  doorDepth_le_km2 hk hp t hN

name: Hunter.ProofsChart.doorDepth_eq_of_all_doors
statement:
theorem doorDepth_eq_of_all_doors (p : HPath k) (t : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ s, 1 ≤ s → s ≤ t → IsDoor p s) : doorDepth p t = t
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ t ih =>
    rw [doorDepth_door (h (t + 1) (by omega) (le_refl _)),
        ih (fun s hs1 hs2 => h s hs1 (by omega))]

name: Hunter.ProofsChart.excess_zero_block_bound
statement:
theorem excess_zero_block_bound (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless)
    (h0 : excess p = 0) : p.numVerts ≤ k * (k - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
