  have hN1 : 1 ≤ p.numVerts := p.numVerts_pos
  set t := (p.numVerts - 1) / k with htdef
  have hkt : k * t ≤ p.numVerts - 1 := by
    rw [htdef, Nat.mul_comm]; exact Nat.div_mul_le_self _ _
  have hktlt : k * t < p.numVerts := by omega
  
  have hterm : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (p.numVerts - 1),
      ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) - 2 = 0 := by
    have hsz : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p.numVerts - 1),
        (ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) - 2) = 0 := by
      rw [← excess_eq_sum_edgeWeight hk1 p]; exact h0
    exact (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff.mp hsz)
  
  have hdoors : ∀ s, 1 ≤ s → s ≤ t → IsDoor p s := by
    intro s hs1 hst
    have hkspos : 0 < k * s := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)
    have hks : k * s - 1 + 1 = k * s := by omega
    have hksle : k * s ≤ p.numVerts - 1 := le_trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hst) hkt
    have hmem : k * s - 1 ∈ Finset.range (p.numVerts - 1) := by
      rw [Finset.mem_range]; omega
    have hd : k ∣ (k * s - 1 + 1) := by rw [hks]; exact ⟨s, rfl⟩
    have hin : k * s - 1 + 1 < p.numVerts := by rw [hks]; omega
    have hne1 : ew k (p.vert (k * s - 1)) (p.vert (k * s - 1 + 1)) ≠ 1 := by
      intro he1
      have hnd := (prp_periodicedges hk1 hp hin).mp he1
      rw [hks] at hnd
      exact hnd ⟨s, rfl⟩
    have hge1 := ew_ge_one hk1 (p.vert (k * s - 1)) (p.vert (k * s - 1 + 1))
    have hle2 := hterm (k * s - 1) hmem
    have hbw : ew k (p.vert (k * s - 1)) (p.vert (k * s - 1 + 1)) = bw p s := by
      simp only [bw]; rw [hks]
    show bw p s = 2
    rw [← hbw]; omega
  
  have hcap := doorDepth_le_km2 hk hp t hktlt
  rw [doorDepth_eq_of_all_doors p t hdoors] at hcap
  
  have hlt : p.numVerts - 1 < k * (t + 1) := by
    have hdm := Nat.div_add_mod (p.numVerts - 1) k
    rw [← htdef] at hdm
    have hmod : (p.numVerts - 1) % k < k := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
    have hexp : k * (t + 1) = k * t + k := by ring
    omega
  calc p.numVerts ≤ k * (t + 1) := by omega
    _ ≤ k * (k - 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)

name: Hunter.ProofsChart.s2_meta_period
statement:
theorem s2_meta_period (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) (t : ℕ)
    (hN : k * t ≤ p.numVerts) : metaDepth p t ≤ k - 2
proof:
:=
  metaDepth_le hk hp t hN

name: Hunter.ProofsChart.meta_chart_block_bound
statement:
theorem meta_chart_block_bound (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless)
    (hno : ∀ s, 1 ≤ s → s ≤ (p.numVerts - 1) / k → ¬ IsMetaHeavy p s) :
    p.numVerts ≤ k * (k * (k - 2) + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
  have hN1 : 1 ≤ p.numVerts := p.numVerts_pos
  set t := (p.numVerts - 1) / k with htdef
  have hkt : k * t ≤ p.numVerts - 1 := by
    rw [htdef, Nat.mul_comm]; exact Nat.div_mul_le_self _ _
  have hktlt : k * t < p.numVerts := by omega
  
  have hrs0 : runStart p t = 0 := by
    have hc := runStart_const p 0 t (fun s hs1 hs2 => hno s (by omega) (by omega))
    rwa [Nat.zero_add, runStart_zero] at hc
  have hmd := metaDepth_le hk hp t (by omega)
  have hdd := doorDepth_le_km2 hk hp t hktlt
  have hlen := runLen_eq hk p t
  rw [hrs0] at hlen
  
  have hkk : (k - 2) * (k - 1) + (k - 2) = k * (k - 2) := by
    have h : k - 1 + 1 = k := by omega
    calc (k - 2) * (k - 1) + (k - 2) = (k - 2) * ((k - 1) + 1) := by ring
      _ = (k - 2) * k := by rw [h]
      _ = k * (k - 2) := by ring
  have h1 : metaDepth p t * (k - 1) ≤ (k - 2) * (k - 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hmd
  have htle : t ≤ k * (k - 2) := by omega
  
  have hlt : p.numVerts - 1 < k * (t + 1) := by
    have hdm := Nat.div_add_mod (p.numVerts - 1) k
    rw [← htdef] at hdm
    have hmod : (p.numVerts - 1) % k < k := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
    have hexp : k * (t + 1) = k * t + k := by ring
    omega
  calc p.numVerts ≤ k * (t + 1) := by omega
    _ ≤ k * (k * (k - 2) + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)

name: Hunter.Proved.suffix_exitless
proof:
:=
  ProofsChart.suffix_exitless hk hp hBdvd hBlt

name: Hunter.Proved.excess_split
statement:
theorem excess_split {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) {B : ℕ}
    (hBdvd : k ∣ B) (hBlt : B < p.numVerts) {q : HPath k} (hq : q.verts = p.verts.drop B) :
    ProofsRecursion.excess p =
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range B, ProofsChart.perEdgeExc p j) + ProofsRecursion.excess q
proof:
:=
  ProofsChart.excess_split hk hp hBdvd hBlt hq

name: Hunter.Proved.excess_zero_block_bound
statement:
theorem excess_zero_block_bound {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless)
    (h0 : ProofsRecursion.excess p = 0) : p.numVerts ≤ k * (k - 1)
proof:
:=
  ProofsChart.excess_zero_block_bound hk hp h0

name: Hunter.Proved.s2_meta_period
statement:
theorem s2_meta_period {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) (t : ℕ)
    (hN : k * t ≤ p.numVerts) : ProofsLedger.metaDepth p t ≤ k - 2
proof:
:=
  ProofsChart.s2_meta_period hk hp t hN

name: Hunter.Proved.meta_chart_block_bound
statement:
theorem meta_chart_block_bound {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless)
    (hno : ∀ s, 1 ≤ s → s ≤ (p.numVerts - 1) / k → ¬ ProofsLedger.IsMetaHeavy p s) :
    p.numVerts ≤ k * (k * (k - 2) + 1)
proof:
:=
  ProofsChart.meta_chart_block_bound hk hp hno

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy.W0_length
statement: theorem W0_length (k : ℕ) : (W0 k).length = k - 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [W0]

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy.W0_nodup
statement: theorem W0_nodup (k : ℕ) : (W0 k).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  simp [W0, List.nodup_range']

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy.mem_W0
statement: theorem mem_W0 {k x : ℕ} : x ∈ W0 k ↔ 1 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ k - 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [W0, List.mem_range'_1]
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy.W0_toFinset
statement: theorem W0_toFinset (k : ℕ) : (W0 k).toFinset = Finset.Icc 1 (k - 1)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [List.mem_toFinset, mem_W0, Finset.mem_Icc]

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy.baseW_isPermWord
statement:
theorem baseW_isPermWord (hk : 1 ≤ k) (c : ℕ) :
    IsPermWord k ((W0 k).rotate c ++ [k])
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [List.nodup_append]
    refine ⟨(List.rotate_perm (W0 k) c).nodup_iff.mpr (W0_nodup k), List.nodup_singleton k, ?_⟩
    intro a ha b hb
    rw [List.mem_singleton] at hb
    subst hb
    rw [List.mem_rotate, mem_W0] at ha
    omega
  · have hrot : ((W0 k).rotate c).toFinset = (W0 k).toFinset :=
      List.toFinset_eq_of_perm _ _ (List.rotate_perm (W0 k) c)
    rw [List.toFinset_append, hrot, W0_toFinset]
    ext x
    simp only [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_Icc, List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_singleton]
    omega

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy.baseV_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem baseV_val (hk : 1 ≤ k) (c : ℕ) :
    (baseV k hk c : List ℕ) = (W0 k).rotate c ++ [k]
proof: := rfl

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy.div_mod_add
statement:
theorem div_mod_add (hk : 0 < k) (q r : ℕ) (hr : r < k) :
    (k * q + r) / k = q ∧ (k * q + r) % k = r
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Nat.mul_add_div hk, Nat.div_eq_of_lt hr, Nat.add_zero]
  · rw [Nat.mul_add_mod]; exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hr

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy.step_within
statement:
theorem step_within (hk : 1 ≤ k) {i : ℕ} (h : i % k < k - 1) :
    (i + 1) / k = i / k ∧ (i + 1) % k = i % k + 1
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : i + 1 = k * (i / k) + (i % k + 1) := by have := Nat.div_add_mod i k; omega
  rw [h2]; exact div_mod_add hk _ _ (by omega)

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy.step_boundary
statement:
theorem step_boundary (hk : 1 ≤ k) {i : ℕ} (h : i % k = k - 1) :
    (i + 1) / k = i / k + 1 ∧ (i + 1) % k = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hexp : k * (i / k + 1) + 0 = k * (i / k) + k := by ring
  have h2 : i + 1 = k * (i / k + 1) + 0 := by have := Nat.div_add_mod i k; omega
  rw [h2]; exact div_mod_add hk _ _ hk

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy.gV_succ_within
statement:
theorem gV_succ_within (hk : 1 ≤ k) {i : ℕ} (h : i % k < k - 1) :
    gV k hk (i + 1) = sigma (gV k hk i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hd, hm⟩ := step_within hk h
  unfold gV
  rw [hd, hm, Function.iterate_succ_apply']

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy.gV_boundary_sigma
statement:
theorem gV_boundary_sigma (hk : 1 ≤ k) {i : ℕ} (h : i % k = k - 1) :
    sigma (gV k hk i) = gV k hk (k * (i / k))
proof:
:= by
  have hrhs : gV k hk (k * (i / k)) = baseV k hk (i / k) := by
    unfold gV
    rw [Nat.mul_mod_right, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hk, Function.iterate_zero_apply]
  rw [hrhs]
  have hlhs : sigma (gV k hk i) = sigma^[i % k + 1] (baseV k hk (i / k)) := by
    unfold gV; exact (Function.iterate_succ_apply' sigma (i % k) _).symm
  rw [hlhs, show i % k + 1 = k from by omega, sigma_iter_period]

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy.gV_val
statement:
theorem gV_val (hk : 1 ≤ k) (i : ℕ) :
    (gV k hk i : List ℕ) = ((W0 k).rotate (i / k) ++ [k]).rotate (i % k)
proof:
:= by
  unfold gV
  rw [sigma_iter_val, baseV_val]

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy.rot_snoc
statement: theorem rot_snoc (L : List ℕ) (a : ℕ) : (L ++ [a]).rotate L.length = a :: L
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.rotate_eq_drop_append_take (by simp)]
  simp

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy.gV_boundary_word_i
statement:
theorem gV_boundary_word_i (hk : 1 ≤ k) {i : ℕ} (h : i % k = k - 1) :
    (gV k hk i : List ℕ) = k :: (W0 k).rotate (i / k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gV_val, h, show k - 1 = ((W0 k).rotate (i / k)).length from by
    rw [List.length_rotate, W0_length], rot_snoc]

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy.gV_boundary_word_succ
statement:
theorem gV_boundary_word_succ (hk : 1 ≤ k) {i : ℕ} (h : i % k = k - 1) :
    (gV k hk (i + 1) : List ℕ) = ((W0 k).rotate (i / k)).rotate 1 ++ [k]
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hd, hm⟩ := step_boundary hk h
  rw [gV_val, hd, hm, List.rotate_zero, List.rotate_rotate]

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy.ew_within_eq_one
statement:
theorem ew_within_eq_one (hk : 1 ≤ k) {i : ℕ} (h : i % k < k - 1) :
    ew k (gV k hk i) (gV k hk (i + 1)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [gV_succ_within hk h, ew_sigma hk]

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy.ew_boundary_le_two
statement:
theorem ew_boundary_le_two (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hk2 : 2 ≤ k) {i : ℕ} (h : i % k = k - 1) :
    ew k (gV k hk i) (gV k hk (i + 1)) ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h3 : (gV k hk i : List ℕ).drop 2 = (gV k hk (i + 1) : List ℕ).take (k - 2) := by
    rw [gV_boundary_word_i hk h, gV_boundary_word_succ hk h]
    set L := (W0 k).rotate (i / k) with hL
    have hLlen : L.length = k - 1 := by rw [hL, List.length_rotate, W0_length]
    rw [List.rotate_eq_drop_append_take (l := L) (n := 1) (by rw [hLlen]; omega)]
    have hdrop : (k :: L).drop 2 = L.drop 1 := rfl
    rw [hdrop, List.append_assoc,
      List.take_left' (l₁ := L.drop 1) (by rw [List.length_drop, hLlen]; omega)]
  exact wt_le (by norm_num) hk2 h3

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy.marker_index
statement:
theorem marker_index (hk : 1 ≤ k) (c r : ℕ) (hr : r < k) :
    (((W0 k).rotate c ++ [k]).rotate r)[(k - 1) - r]? = some k
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : ((W0 k).rotate c ++ [k]).length = k := by
    rw [List.length_append, List.length_rotate, W0_length, List.length_singleton]; omega
  rw [List.getElem?_rotate (l := (W0 k).rotate c ++ [k]) (n := r) (m := (k - 1) - r)
      (by rw [hlen]; omega), hlen,
    show ((k - 1) - r + r) % k = k - 1 from by
      rw [show (k - 1) - r + r = k - 1 from by omega]; exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega),
    List.getElem?_append_right (by rw [List.length_rotate, W0_length]),
    List.length_rotate, W0_length, show (k - 1) - (k - 1) = 0 from by omega]
  rfl

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy.gV_inj
statement:
theorem gV_inj (hk : 1 ≤ k) {i j : ℕ} (hik : i / k < k - 1) (hjk : j / k < k - 1)
    (h : gV k hk i = gV k hk j) : i = j
proof:
:= by
  have hkpos : 0 < k := hk
  have hril : i % k < k := Nat.mod_lt i hkpos
  have hrjl : j % k < k := Nat.mod_lt j hkpos
  have hw : (gV k hk i : List ℕ) = (gV k hk j : List ℕ) := by rw [h]
  have lenw : (gV k hk i : List ℕ).length = k := (gV k hk i).2.length
  have hmi : (k - 1) - i % k < (gV k hk i : List ℕ).length := by rw [lenw]; omega
  have hmj : (k - 1) - j % k < (gV k hk i : List ℕ).length := by rw [lenw]; omega
  
  have ei : (gV k hk i : List ℕ)[(k - 1) - i % k]? = some k := by
    rw [gV_val]; exact marker_index hk (i / k) (i % k) hril
  have ej : (gV k hk i : List ℕ)[(k - 1) - j % k]? = some k := by
    rw [hw, gV_val]; exact marker_index hk (j / k) (j % k) hrjl
  have gi : (gV k hk i : List ℕ)[(k - 1) - i % k] = k := by
    have := ei; rwa [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hmi, Option.some_inj] at this
  have gj : (gV k hk i : List ℕ)[(k - 1) - j % k] = k := by
    have := ej; rwa [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hmj, Option.some_inj] at this
  have hidx : (k - 1) - i % k = (k - 1) - j % k :=
    ((gV k hk i).2.nodup.getElem_inj_iff).mp (gi.trans gj.symm)
  have hr_eq : i % k = j % k := by omega
  
  have hbase : (W0 k).rotate (i / k) ++ [k] = (W0 k).rotate (j / k) ++ [k] := by
    have h2 : ((W0 k).rotate (i / k) ++ [k]).rotate (i % k)
        = ((W0 k).rotate (j / k) ++ [k]).rotate (j % k) := by
      rw [← gV_val, ← gV_val]; exact hw
    rw [hr_eq] at h2
    exact List.rotate_injective (j % k) h2
  have hW : (W0 k).rotate (i / k) = (W0 k).rotate (j / k) :=
    List.append_cancel_right hbase
  have hc_eq : i / k = j / k :=
    rotate_injOn_lt (W0_nodup k) (by rw [W0_length]; omega) (by rw [W0_length]; omega) hW
  have hkci : k * (i / k) = k * (j / k) := by rw [hc_eq]
  have hi := Nat.div_add_mod i k
  have hj := Nat.div_add_mod j k
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy.block_lt
statement: theorem block_lt (hk : 1 ≤ k) {ℓ i : ℕ} (hℓ : ℓ ≤ k * (k - 1)) (hi : i < ℓ) : i / k < k - 1
proof:
:=
  (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hk).mpr (by rw [Nat.mul_comm]; omega)

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy.greedyP_numVerts
statement:
theorem greedyP_numVerts (hk : 1 ≤ k) {ℓ : ℕ} (hℓ0 : 0 < ℓ) (hℓ : ℓ ≤ k * (k - 1)) :
    (greedyP k hk ℓ hℓ0 hℓ).numVerts = ℓ
proof:
:= by
  show ((List.range ℓ).map (gV k hk)).length = ℓ
  rw [List.length_map, List.length_range]

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy.greedyP_vert
statement:
theorem greedyP_vert (hk : 1 ≤ k) {ℓ : ℕ} (hℓ0 : 0 < ℓ) (hℓ : ℓ ≤ k * (k - 1)) {t : ℕ}
    (ht : t < ℓ) : (greedyP k hk ℓ hℓ0 hℓ).vert t = gV k hk t
proof:
:= by
  rw [vert_getElem _ (by rw [greedyP_numVerts hk hℓ0 hℓ]; exact ht)]
  show ((List.range ℓ).map (gV k hk))[t]'_ = gV k hk t
  rw [List.getElem_map, List.getElem_range]

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy.greedyP_exitless
statement:
theorem greedyP_exitless (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hk2 : 2 ≤ k) {ℓ : ℕ} (hℓ0 : 0 < ℓ)
    (hℓ : ℓ ≤ k * (k - 1)) : (greedyP k hk ℓ hℓ0 hℓ).Exitless
proof:
:= by
  set p := greedyP k hk ℓ hℓ0 hℓ with hpdef
  have hnum : p.numVerts = ℓ := greedyP_numVerts hk hℓ0 hℓ
  intro he
  obtain ⟨i, hi1, hi2, hi3⟩ := he
  rw [hnum] at hi1
  have hil : i < ℓ := by omega
  have hi1l : i + 1 < ℓ := hi1
  have hvi : p.vert i = gV k hk i := greedyP_vert hk hℓ0 hℓ hil
  have hvi1 : p.vert (i + 1) = gV k hk (i + 1) := greedyP_vert hk hℓ0 hℓ hi1l
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (i % k) (k - 1) with hlt | hge
  · 
    rw [hvi, hvi1, ew_within_eq_one hk hlt] at hi2
    omega
  · 
    have hb : i % k = k - 1 := by have := Nat.mod_lt i (show 0 < k from hk); omega
    have hmul : k * (i / k) ≤ i := Nat.mul_div_le i k
    have hml : k * (i / k) < ℓ := by omega
    have hσ : sigma (p.vert i) = p.vert (k * (i / k)) := by
      rw [hvi, gV_boundary_sigma hk hb, greedyP_vert hk hℓ0 hℓ hml]
    rw [hσ, pos_vert p (by rw [hnum]; exact hml)] at hi3
    omega

name: Hunter.ProofsGreedy.greedyP_wtP
statement:
theorem greedyP_wtP (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hk3 : 3 ≤ k) {ℓ : ℕ} (hℓ0 : 0 < ℓ) (hℓ : ℓ ≤ k * (k - 1)) :
    (greedyP k hk ℓ hℓ0 hℓ).wtP = j k ℓ
proof:
:= by
  set p := greedyP k hk ℓ hℓ0 hℓ with hpdef
  have hnum : p.numVerts = ℓ := greedyP_numVerts hk hℓ0 hℓ
  have hpe : p.Exitless := greedyP_exitless hk (by omega) hℓ0 hℓ
  
  have hexcess : excess p = 0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro r hr
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hr
    rw [edgeCountGe, Finset.card_eq_zero, Finset.filter_eq_empty_iff]
    intro i hi
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hi
    have hile : i + 1 < ℓ := by rw [hnum] at hi; omega
    rw [greedyP_vert hk hℓ0 hℓ (by omega : i < ℓ), greedyP_vert hk hℓ0 hℓ hile]
    have hle2 : ew k (gV k hk i) (gV k hk (i + 1)) ≤ 2 := by
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (i % k) (k - 1) with hlt | hge
      · exact (ew_within_eq_one hk hlt).le.trans (by norm_num)
      · have hb : i % k = k - 1 := by have := Nat.mod_lt i (show 0 < k from hk); omega
        exact ew_boundary_le_two hk (by omega) hb
    omega
  rw [wtP_decompose hk3 hpe, hnum, hexcess,
    j_base (Or.inl (le_trans hℓ (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (show 0 < k - 2 from by omega))))]
  
  have hcd : ℓ ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1)) = 1 := by
    have hM : 0 < k * (k - 1) := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)
    rw [Nat.ceilDiv_eq_add_pred_div,
      show ℓ + k * (k - 1) - 1 = (ℓ - 1) + k * (k - 1) from by omega,
      Nat.add_div_right _ hM, Nat.div_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
  have hck1 : 1 ≤ ℓ ⌈/⌉ k := by
    rw [Nat.ceilDiv_eq_add_pred_div, Nat.one_le_div_iff (by omega)]; omega
  rw [hcd]
  omega

name: Hunter.Proved.greedy_g_le_kk
statement:
theorem greedy_g_le_kk {k ℓ : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hℓ0 : 0 < ℓ) (hℓ : ℓ ≤ k * (k - 1)) :
    ∃ p : HPath k, p.Exitless ∧ p.numVerts = ℓ ∧ p.wtP = j k ℓ
proof:
:= by
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
  exact ⟨greedyP k hk1 ℓ hℓ0 hℓ, greedyP_exitless hk1 (by omega) hℓ0 hℓ,
    greedyP_numVerts hk1 hℓ0 hℓ, greedyP_wtP hk1 hk hℓ0 hℓ⟩

name: Hunter.Proved.thm2_equality_le_kk
statement:
theorem thm2_equality_le_kk {k ℓ : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hℓ0 : 0 < ℓ) (hℓ : ℓ ≤ k * (k - 1)) :
    iExitless k ℓ = j k ℓ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hpe, hpv, hpw⟩ := greedy_g_le_kk hk hℓ0 hℓ
  have hle : iExitless k ℓ ≤ j k ℓ := by
    rw [← hpw]; exact Nat.sInf_le ⟨p, hpe, hpv, rfl⟩
  have hge : j k ℓ ≤ iExitless k ℓ :=
    thm2_base_unconditional hk hℓ0 (le_trans hℓ (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by omega)))
      ⟨p, hpe, hpv⟩
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsRFrame.rSum_eq_complete
statement:
theorem rSum_eq_complete (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) (a M : ℕ)
    (hM : k * (a + M) < p.numVerts)
    (hcomp : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ M → IsDoor p (a + j) ∨ k - 2 ≤ doorDepth p (a + j - 1)) :
    ∀ e, e ≤ M → rSum p a e = (e - dCount p a e) * (k - 2)
proof:
:= by
  intro e
  induction e with
  | zero => intro _; simp [rSum, dCount]
  | succ e ih =>
    intro heM
    have ihe := ih (by omega)
    have hdle := dCount_le p a e
    by_cases h : IsDoor p (a + (e + 1))
    · rw [rSum, dCount, if_pos h, if_pos h, Nat.add_zero]
      have hR : ((e + 1) - (dCount p a e + 1)) * (k - 2) = (e - dCount p a e) * (k - 2) := by
        congr 1; omega
      rw [hR]; exact ihe
    · rw [rSum, dCount, if_neg h, if_neg h]
      have hrange : k * (a + e) < p.numVerts := by
        have : k * (a + e) ≤ k * (a + M) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) (by omega)
        omega
      have hup : doorDepth p (a + e) ≤ k - 2 := doorDepth_le_km2 hk hp (a + e) hrange
      have hlo : k - 2 ≤ doorDepth p (a + e) := by
        have := hcomp (e + 1) (by omega) heM
        have hidx : a + (e + 1) - 1 = a + e := by omega
        rcases this with hd | hc
        · exact absurd hd h
        · rw [hidx] at hc; exact hc
      have hdd : doorDepth p (a + e) = k - 2 := le_antisymm hup hlo
      have hR : ((e + 1) - dCount p a e) * (k - 2)
          = (e - dCount p a e) * (k - 2) + (k - 2) := by
        rw [show (e + 1) - dCount p a e = (e - dCount p a e) + 1 from by omega]; ring
      simp only [Nat.add_zero]
      rw [ihe, hdd, hR]

name: Hunter.ProofsRFrame.windowSat_count
statement:
theorem windowSat_count (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) (a : ℕ)
    (hM : k * (a + ((k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1)) < p.numVerts)
    (hsat : WindowSaturated p a ((k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1))
    (hpos : doorDepth p a ≠ 0) :
    k - 2 ≤ ((Finset.Icc 1 ((k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1)).filter
        (fun j => 3 ≤ ew k (p.vert (k * (a + j) - 1)) (p.vert (k * (a + j))))).card
proof:
:= by
  set M := (k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1 with hMdef
  set W := M - dCount p a M with hWdef
  have hdle := dCount_le p a M
  have htele := doorTele p a M
  have hrs := rSum_eq_complete hk hp a M hM hsat.2 M (le_refl M)
  rw [← hWdef] at hrs                               
  have hfin : doorDepth p (a + M) ≤ k - 2 := doorDepth_le_km2 hk hp (a + M) hM
  have hpos1 : 1 ≤ doorDepth p a := by omega
  
  have hWk : k - 2 ≤ W := by
    have hdc : dCount p a M + W = M := by omega
    have hWid : W * (k - 2) + W = W * (k - 1) := by
      rw [show k - 1 = (k - 2) + 1 from by omega]; ring
    
    have hcollapse : doorDepth p a + M = doorDepth p (a + M) + W * (k - 1) := by
      rw [hrs] at htele; omega
    have hM1 : M + 1 = (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by
      have hprodpos : 1 ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by
        calc 1 = 1 * 1 := by ring
          _ ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2) := Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (by omega)
      rw [hMdef]; omega
    have hAid : (k - 1) * (k - 2) = (k - 3) * (k - 1) + (k - 1) := by
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, k - 3 = m := ⟨k - 3, rfl⟩
      have e1 : k - 1 = m + 2 := by omega
      have e2 : k - 2 = m + 1 := by omega
      rw [e1, e2, hm]; ring
    by_contra hlt
    have hWle : W ≤ k - 3 := by omega
    have hWmul : W * (k - 1) ≤ (k - 3) * (k - 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hWle
    omega
  
  have hWcard : W = ((Finset.Icc 1 M).filter (fun j => ¬ IsDoor p (a + j))).card := by
    have hdcard := dCount_eq_card p a M
    have hpart : ((Finset.Icc 1 M).filter (fun j => IsDoor p (a + j))).card
        + ((Finset.Icc 1 M).filter (fun j => ¬ IsDoor p (a + j))).card = M := by
      rw [Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not, Nat.card_Icc]; omega
    rw [hWdef, hdcard]; omega
  rw [hWcard] at hWk
  refine le_trans hWk (Finset.card_le_card ?_)
  intro j hj
  rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc] at hj ⊢
  obtain ⟨⟨hj1, hjM⟩, hjnd⟩ := hj
  refine ⟨⟨hj1, hjM⟩, ?_⟩
  have hN' : k * (a + j) < p.numVerts := by
    have : k * (a + j) ≤ k * (a + M) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) (by omega)
    omega
  have hkt : 1 ≤ k * (a + j) := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)
  have hi1 : k * (a + j) - 1 + 1 = k * (a + j) := by omega
  have hin : (k * (a + j) - 1) + 1 < p.numVerts := by rw [hi1]; exact hN'
  have hd : k ∣ ((k * (a + j) - 1) + 1) := by rw [hi1]; exact ⟨a + j, rfl⟩
  have hge2 := ProofsWindow.boundary_ge_two (by omega : 1 ≤ k) hp hin hd
  rw [hi1] at hge2
  rw [IsDoor, bw] at hjnd
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsRFrame.saturatedHeavy_of_doorPos
statement:
theorem saturatedHeavy_of_doorPos (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p q : HPath k}
    (hpe : p.Exitless) (_hqe : q.Exitless)
    (hlt : k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) < p.numVerts)
    (hprefix : q.verts = p.verts.take (p.numVerts - ell0 k))
    (hsat : WindowSaturated p (winA p) ((k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1))
    (hpos : doorDepth p (winA p) ≠ 0) :
    excess q + (k - 2) ≤ excess p
proof:
:= by
  set a := winA p with hadef
  set M := (k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1 with hMdef
  have hrange : k * (a + M) < p.numVerts := by rw [hadef, hMdef]; exact winA_range hk hlt
  have hsplit := excess_window_split hk hlt hprefix
  rw [← hadef, ← hMdef] at hsplit
  set W3 := (Finset.filter (fun j => 3 ≤ bw p (a + j)) (Finset.Icc 1 M)).card with hW3
  have hpay : W3 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 M, (bw p (a + j) - 2) := by
    rw [hW3, Finset.card_filter]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro j _
    by_cases h3 : 3 ≤ bw p (a + j) <;> simp only [h3, if_true, if_false] <;> omega
  have hcount : k - 2 ≤ W3 := by
    have h := windowSat_count hk hpe a (by rw [← hMdef]; exact hrange)
      (by rw [← hMdef]; exact hsat) hpos
    have hcard : (Finset.filter (fun j => 3 ≤ ew k (p.vert (k * (a + j) - 1)) (p.vert (k * (a + j))))
        (Finset.Icc 1 M)).card = W3 := rfl
    rw [← hMdef] at h; rw [hcard] at h; exact h
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsRFrame.saturatedTightHeavy_of_loopEntryFree
statement:
theorem saturatedTightHeavy_of_loopEntryFree (hk : 3 ≤ k)
    (hlef : TightLoopEntryFree k) : SaturatedTightHeavy k
proof:
:= by
  intro p q hpe hqe hlt hprefix htight hsat
  exact saturatedHeavy_of_doorPos hk hpe hqe hlt hprefix hsat
    (hlef p q hpe hqe hlt hprefix htight)

name: Hunter.ProofsRFrame.saturatedTightHeavyAll_of_loopEntryFreeAll
statement:
theorem saturatedTightHeavyAll_of_loopEntryFreeAll (hlef : TightLoopEntryFreeAll) :
    SaturatedTightHeavyAll
proof:
:=
  fun k hk => saturatedTightHeavy_of_loopEntryFree hk (hlef k hk)

name: Hunter.ProofsRFrame.thm2_of_loopEntryFree
statement:
theorem thm2_of_loopEntryFree (hlef : TightLoopEntryFreeAll) :
    ∀ k ℓ, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k ℓ → j k ℓ ≤ iExitless k ℓ
proof:
:=
  ProofsAssembly.thm2_of_saturated (saturatedTightHeavyAll_of_loopEntryFreeAll hlef)

name: Hunter.ProofsFill.necklace_erase_invariance
statement:
theorem necklace_erase_invariance {c : ℕ} {W : List ℕ} (hnd : W.Nodup) (r : ℕ) :
    rotClass ((W.rotate r).erase c) = rotClass (W.erase c)
proof:
:=
  ProofsConfinement.rotClass_erase_rotate hnd r

name: Hunter.ProofsFill.necklace_erase_invariance₂
statement:
theorem necklace_erase_invariance₂ {α₁ α₂ : ℕ} {W : List ℕ} (hnd : W.Nodup) (r : ℕ) :
    rotClass (((W.rotate r).erase α₁).erase α₂) = rotClass ((W.erase α₁).erase α₂)
proof:
:= by
  
  
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ : (W.rotate r).erase α₁ ~r (W.erase α₁) :=
    rotClass_eq_iff.mp (necklace_erase_invariance (c := α₁) hnd r)
  
  have hLnd : ((W.rotate r).erase α₁).Nodup := ((List.rotate_perm W r).nodup_iff.mpr hnd).erase _
  calc rotClass (((W.rotate r).erase α₁).erase α₂)
      = rotClass ((((W.rotate r).erase α₁).rotate q).erase α₂) :=
        (necklace_erase_invariance hLnd q).symm
    _ = rotClass ((W.erase α₁).erase α₂) := by rw [hq]

name: Hunter.ProofsFill.rotate_append_left
statement: theorem rotate_append_left (P Q : List ℕ) : (P ++ Q).rotate P.length = Q ++ P
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.rotate_eq_drop_append_take (by simp)]
  simp

name: Hunter.ProofsFill.rotate_append_left'
statement:
theorem rotate_append_left' (P Q : List ℕ) {n : ℕ} (hn : n = P.length) :
    (P ++ Q).rotate n = Q ++ P
proof: := by subst hn; exact rotate_append_left P Q

name: Hunter.ProofsFill.rotClass_rotate
statement: theorem rotClass_rotate (w : List ℕ) (m : ℕ) : rotClass (w.rotate m) = rotClass w
proof:
:=
  (rotClass_eq_iff.mpr ⟨m, rfl⟩).symm

name: Hunter.ProofsFill.mm_a_share1
statement: theorem mm_a_share1 : rotClass (mmaBlock a b c s s.length) = rotClass (srcBlock a b c s 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (mmaBlock a b c s s.length).rotate 1 = srcBlock a b c s 1 := by
    unfold mmaBlock srcBlock markBlock
    rw [rotate_append_left s [a, c]]
    
    have h1 : ([a, c] ++ s ++ [b]) = [a] ++ (c :: s ++ [b]) := by simp
    have h2 : (b :: c :: s).rotate 1 ++ [a] = (c :: s ++ [b]) ++ [a] := by
      rw [show b :: c :: s = [b] ++ (c :: s) from rfl,
          rotate_append_left' [b] (c :: s) (by simp)]
    rw [h1, rotate_append_left' [a] (c :: s ++ [b]) (by simp), h2]
  rw [← h, rotClass_rotate]

name: Hunter.ProofsFill.mm_a_share2
statement:
theorem mm_a_share2 :
    rotClass (mmaBlock a b c s (s.length + 1)) = rotClass (srcBlock a b c s 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (mmaBlock a b c s (s.length + 1)).rotate (s.length + 2) = srcBlock a b c s 0 := by
    unfold mmaBlock srcBlock markBlock
    rw [show s ++ [a, c] = (s ++ [a]) ++ [c] by simp,
        show s.length + 1 = (s ++ [a]).length by simp, rotate_append_left (s ++ [a]) [c]]
    
    rw [show [c] ++ (s ++ [a]) ++ [b] = (c :: s ++ [a]) ++ [b] by simp,
        show s.length + 2 = (c :: s ++ [a]).length by simp,
        rotate_append_left (c :: s ++ [a]) [b]]
    simp
  rw [← h, rotClass_rotate]

name: Hunter.ProofsFill.mm_b_share
statement: theorem mm_b_share : rotClass (mmbBlock a b c s s.length) = rotClass (srcBlock a b c s 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (srcBlock a b c s 2).rotate (s.length + 1) = mmbBlock a b c s s.length := by
    unfold mmbBlock srcBlock markBlock
    rw [rotate_append_left s [c, a],
        show b :: c :: s = [b, c] ++ s from rfl, rotate_append_left' [b, c] s (by simp)]
    
    rw [show s ++ [b, c] ++ [a] = (s ++ [b]) ++ [c, a] by simp,
        show s.length + 1 = (s ++ [b]).length by simp, rotate_append_left (s ++ [b]) [c, a]]
    simp
  rw [← h, rotClass_rotate]

name: Hunter.ProofsFill.mm_c_share
statement: theorem mm_c_share : rotClass (mmcBlock a b c s 0) = rotClass (srcBlock a b c s 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (srcBlock a b c s 0).rotate 2 = mmcBlock a b c s 0 := by
    unfold mmcBlock srcBlock markBlock
    rw [List.rotate_zero, List.rotate_zero,
        show b :: c :: s ++ [a] = [b, c] ++ (s ++ [a]) by simp,
        rotate_append_left' [b, c] (s ++ [a]) (by simp)]
    simp
  rw [← h, rotClass_rotate]

name: Hunter.ProofsFill.mm_d_share
statement: theorem mm_d_share : rotClass (mmdBlock a b c s 0) = rotClass (srcBlock a b c s 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (srcBlock a b c s 1).rotate 1 = mmdBlock a b c s 0 := by
    unfold mmdBlock srcBlock markBlock
    rw [List.rotate_zero, show b :: c :: s = [b] ++ (c :: s) from rfl,
        rotate_append_left' [b] (c :: s) (by simp)]
    
    rw [show c :: s ++ [b] ++ [a] = [c] ++ (s ++ [b, a]) by simp,
        rotate_append_left' [c] (s ++ [b, a]) (by simp)]
  rw [← h, rotClass_rotate]

name: Hunter.ProofsFill.fresh_run_le
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  exact hfresh p (by omega) hp

name: Hunter.ProofsFill.fill_le_of_visited
statement:
theorem fill_le_of_visited {a b c : ℕ} {s base : List ℕ} {m F : ℕ}
    (hvis : ∃ p, p ≤ s.length ∧ SourceVisited a b c s (rotClass (markBlock base m p)))
    (hfresh : ∀ j, j < F → ¬ SourceVisited a b c s (rotClass (markBlock base m j))) :
    F ≤ s.length
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hv⟩ := hvis
  exact le_trans (fresh_run_le hv hfresh) hp

name: Hunter.ProofsFill.markerMove_from_complete_fill_le
statement:
theorem markerMove_from_complete_fill_le (base : List ℕ) (m F : ℕ)
    (hfam : (base = s ++ [a, c] ∧ m = b) ∨ (base = s ++ [c, a] ∧ m = b) ∨
            (base = s ++ [a, b] ∧ m = c) ∨ (base = s ++ [b, a] ∧ m = c))
    (hfresh : ∀ j, j < F → ¬ SourceVisited a b c s (rotClass (markBlock base m j))) :
    F ≤ s.length
proof:
:= by
  refine fill_le_of_visited ?_ hfresh
  rcases hfam with ⟨rfl, hm⟩ | ⟨rfl, hm⟩ | ⟨rfl, hm⟩ | ⟨rfl, hm⟩
  · exact ⟨s.length, le_refl _, ⟨1, by rw [hm]; exact mm_a_share1 a b c s⟩⟩
  · exact ⟨s.length, le_refl _, ⟨2, by rw [hm]; exact mm_b_share a b c s⟩⟩
  · exact ⟨0, Nat.zero_le _, ⟨0, by rw [hm]; exact mm_c_share a b c s⟩⟩
  · exact ⟨0, Nat.zero_le _, ⟨1, by rw [hm]; exact mm_d_share a b c s⟩⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsFill.anchor_source_membership
statement:
theorem anchor_source_membership {u : List ℕ} (hu : u.Nodup) (μ c : ℕ) (hμ : μ ∉ u) (r : ℕ) :
    rotClass (((u.rotate r ++ [μ]).erase μ).erase c) = rotClass (u.erase c)
proof:
:= by
  have hμr : μ ∉ u.rotate r := fun h => hμ ((List.rotate_perm u r).mem_iff.mp h)
  rw [List.erase_append_right _ hμr, List.erase_cons_head, List.append_nil]
  exact necklace_erase_invariance hu r

name: Hunter.ProofsReductions.cd_exact
statement: theorem cd_exact (d q : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) : (d * q) ⌈/⌉ d = q
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.ceilDiv_eq_add_pred_div, show d * q + d - 1 = (d - 1) + d * q from by omega,
    Nat.add_mul_div_left (d - 1) q hd, Nat.div_eq_of_lt (by omega : d - 1 < d), Nat.zero_add]

name: Hunter.ProofsReductions.ceilDiv_ge_mul
statement: theorem ceilDiv_ge_mul (n d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) : (n : ℝ) ≤ (d : ℝ) * ((n ⌈/⌉ d : ℕ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have h : n ≤ d * (n ⌈/⌉ d) := by
    have h0 := (ceilDiv_le_iff_le_smul hd).mp (le_refl (n ⌈/⌉ d))
    simpa [smul_eq_mul] using h0
  calc (n : ℝ) ≤ ((d * (n ⌈/⌉ d) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h
    _ = (d : ℝ) * ((n ⌈/⌉ d : ℕ) : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring

name: Hunter.ProofsReductions.j_pivot
statement:
theorem j_pivot {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) :
    j k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) = k ^ 2 * (k - 2) - 3
proof:
:= by
  have hc1 : (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) ⌈/⌉ k = (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by
    rw [mul_assoc]; exact cd_exact k ((k - 1) * (k - 2)) (by omega)
  have hc2 : (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1)) = (k - 2) :=
    cd_exact (k * (k - 1)) (k - 2) (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega))
  have hsum : k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) + (k - 1) * (k - 2) + (k - 2) = k ^ 2 * (k - 2) := by
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, k = m + 3 := ⟨k - 3, by omega⟩
    have e1 : m + 3 - 1 = m + 2 := by omega
    have e2 : m + 3 - 2 = m + 1 := by omega
    rw [e1, e2]; ring
  rw [j_base (Or.inl (le_refl _)), hc1, hc2, hsum]

name: Hunter.ProofsReductions.castP
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, k = m + 2 := ⟨k - 2, by omega⟩
  rw [show m + 2 - 1 = m + 1 from by omega, show m + 2 - 2 = m from by omega]
  push_cast; ring

name: Hunter.ProofsReductions.castI
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, k = m + 3 := ⟨k - 3, by omega⟩
  rw [show m + 3 - 2 = m + 1 from by omega]
  have hge : 3 ≤ (m + 3) ^ 2 * (m + 1) := by nlinarith [Nat.zero_le m]
  rw [Nat.cast_sub hge]; push_cast; ring

name: Hunter.ProofsReductions.D_pos
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, k = m + 3 := ⟨k - 3, by omega⟩
  have hm : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg m
  push_cast
  nlinarith [hm, mul_nonneg hm hm, mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hm hm) hm]

name: Hunter.ProofsReductions.ratio_eq_coeff
statement:
theorem ratio_eq_coeff {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) :
    ((k : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((k : ℝ) - 2) - 3 - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
        ((k : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) - 1) * ((k : ℝ) - 2) - (k : ℝ)) = coeff k
proof:
:= by
  have hk3 : (3 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hk0 : (k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hk1 : (k : ℝ) - 1 ≠ 0 := by nlinarith
  have hDne : (k : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) - 1) * ((k : ℝ) - 2) - (k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := (D_pos hk).ne'
  rw [coeff]
  set D := (k : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) - 1) * ((k : ℝ) - 2) - (k : ℝ) with hDdef
  field_simp
  rw [hDdef]
  ring

name: Hunter.ProofsReductions.tail_ge
proof:
:= by
  have hk3 : (3 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hDpos : (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) - 1) * ((k : ℝ) - 2) - (k : ℝ) := D_pos hk
  rw [ge_iff_le, ← sub_nonneg]
  set D := (k : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) - 1) * ((k : ℝ) - 2) - (k : ℝ) with hDdef
  have hDne : D ≠ 0 := hDpos.ne'
  have hEq : (((k : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((k : ℝ) - 2) - 3) -
        (((k : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((k : ℝ) - 2) - 3 - (k : ℝ) + 2) / D) *
          ((k : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) - 1) * ((k : ℝ) - 2))) - (-4)
      = (((k : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((k : ℝ) - 2) - 3 + 4) * D
          - ((k : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((k : ℝ) - 2) - 3 - (k : ℝ) + 2)
            * ((k : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) - 1) * ((k : ℝ) - 2))) / D := by
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hEq]
  apply div_nonneg _ (le_of_lt hDpos)
  rw [hDdef]
  nlinarith [hk3, mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ (k:ℝ))
    (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ (k:ℝ) - 1)) (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ (k:ℝ) - 3)]

name: Hunter.ProofsReductions.bound_pack
statement:
theorem bound_pack {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k)
    (hi : iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) = k ^ 2 * (k - 2) - 3)
    (hL : (L k : ℝ) ≥ (iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ)
      + (((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
          (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)))
        * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ))) :
    (L k : ℝ) ≥ coeff k * (k.factorial : ℝ) - 4
proof:
:= by
  rw [hi, castI hk, castP (by omega)] at hL
  apply le_trans _ hL
  rw [ratio_eq_coeff hk]
  have htl := tail_ge hk
  rw [ratio_eq_coeff hk] at htl
  have hexp : ((k : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((k : ℝ) - 2) - 3)
      + coeff k * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) - 1) * ((k : ℝ) - 2))
      = coeff k * (k.factorial : ℝ)
        + (((k : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((k : ℝ) - 2) - 3)
          - coeff k * ((k : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) - 1) * ((k : ℝ) - 2))) := by ring
  rw [hexp]
  linarith [htl]

name: Hunter.Proved.thm2_imp_thm1v2
statement:
theorem thm2_imp_thm1v2
    (_hthm2 : ∀ k ℓ, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k ℓ → j k ℓ ≤ iExitless k ℓ)
    (hthm2eq : ∀ k ℓ, 3 ≤ k → 0 < ℓ → ℓ ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) → HasExitlessPath k ℓ →
        iExitless k ℓ = j k ℓ)
    (hproof : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) →
        (L k : ℝ) ≥ (iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ)
          + (((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
              (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)))
            * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ)))
    (hexists : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2))) :
    ∃ (C : ℝ) (k₀ : ℕ), ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k → (L k : ℝ) ≥ coeff k * (k.factorial : ℝ) - C
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨4, 3, fun k hk => ?_⟩
  have hex := hexists k hk
  have hL := hproof k hk hex
  have hpos : 0 < k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, k = m + 3 := ⟨k - 3, by omega⟩
    rw [show m + 3 - 1 = m + 2 from by omega, show m + 3 - 2 = m + 1 from by omega]; positivity
  have hi : iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) = j k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) :=
    hthm2eq k _ hk hpos (le_refl _) hex
  rw [j_pivot hk] at hi
  exact bound_pack hk hi hL

name: Hunter.Proved.thm1v2
statement:
theorem thm1v2
    (hthm2 : ∀ k ℓ, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k ℓ → j k ℓ ≤ iExitless k ℓ)
    (hthm2eq : ∀ k ℓ, 3 ≤ k → 0 < ℓ → ℓ ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) → HasExitlessPath k ℓ →
        iExitless k ℓ = j k ℓ)
    (hproof : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) →
        (L k : ℝ) ≥ (iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ)
          + (((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
              (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)))
            * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ)))
    (hexists : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2))) :
    ∃ (C : ℝ) (k₀ : ℕ), ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k → (L k : ℝ) ≥ coeff k * (k.factorial : ℝ) - C
proof:
:=
  thm2_imp_thm1v2 hthm2 hthm2eq hproof hexists

name: Hunter.Proved.thm1v1
statement:
theorem thm1v1
    (hthm2 : ∀ k ℓ, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k ℓ → j k ℓ ≤ iExitless k ℓ)
    (hthm2eq : ∀ k ℓ, 3 ≤ k → 0 < ℓ → ℓ ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) → HasExitlessPath k ℓ →
        iExitless k ℓ = j k ℓ)
    (hproof : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) →
        (L k : ℝ) ≥ (iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ)
          + (((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
              (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)))
            * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ)))
    (hexists : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2))) :
    ∃ (C : ℝ) (k₀ : ℕ), ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k →
      (Lstar k : ℝ) ≥ coeff k * (k.factorial : ℝ) + (k : ℝ) - C
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, k₀, h⟩ := thm2_imp_thm1v2 hthm2 hthm2eq hproof hexists
  refine ⟨C, k₀, fun k hk => ?_⟩
  have hb := h k hk
  have hls : (Lstar k : ℝ) = (L k : ℝ) + (k : ℝ) := by rw [lstar_eq]; push_cast; ring
  rw [hls]; linarith

name: Hunter.Proved.subprob2_comp
statement:
theorem subprob2_comp {k : ℕ} (_hk : 3 ≤ k) {t ℓ : ℕ} (R : ℝ) (hle : t * ell0 k ≤ ℓ)
    (hjrec : j k ℓ = t * (j k (ell0 k) + 3) + j k (ℓ - t * ell0 k)) :
    (j k ℓ : ℝ) - R * (ℓ : ℝ)
      = ((t : ℝ) * ((j k (ell0 k) : ℝ) + 3) - R * (t : ℝ) * (ell0 k : ℝ))
        + ((j k (ℓ - t * ell0 k) : ℝ) - R * (((ℓ - t * ell0 k : ℕ) : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  have hcast : ((ℓ - t * ell0 k : ℕ) : ℝ) = (ℓ : ℝ) - (t : ℝ) * (ell0 k : ℝ) := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hle]; push_cast; ring
  rw [hjrec]
  push_cast
  rw [hcast]
  ring

name: Hunter.Proved.proof_thm1v2
statement:
theorem proof_thm1v2 {k : ℕ} (_hk : 3 ≤ k)
    (_hpivot : HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)))
    (gInner : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hb2red : (L k : ℝ) ≥ Rk k * (k.factorial : ℝ) + gInner (Rk k))
    (hg_mono : ∀ r s : ℝ, r ≤ s →
        r * (k.factorial : ℝ) + gInner r ≤ s * (k.factorial : ℝ) + gInner s)
    (hgInner_eval : gInner (((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2)
          / (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)))
        = (iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ)
          - (((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2)
              / (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)))
            * ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ))
    (hRk_ge : ((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2)
          / (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)) ≤ Rk k) :
    (L k : ℝ) ≥ (iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ)
      + (((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
          (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)))
        * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  set rP : ℝ := ((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2)
      / (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)) with hrP
  calc (L k : ℝ) ≥ Rk k * (k.factorial : ℝ) + gInner (Rk k) := hb2red
    _ ≥ rP * (k.factorial : ℝ) + gInner rP := hg_mono rP (Rk k) hRk_ge
    _ = (iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ)
          + rP * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
        rw [hgInner_eval]; ring

name: Hunter.Proved.red_pstar
proof:
:= by
  have hr0 : (0 : ℝ) < r := by linarith
  have hN : ∀ ℓ, HasExitlessPath k ℓ → ℓ ≤ Fintype.card (Vtx k) := by
    rintro ℓ ⟨p, _, hpℓ⟩
    rw [← hpℓ]; exact p.nodup.length_le_card
  have hBbb : BddBelow {q : ℝ | ∃ ℓ, HasExitlessPath k ℓ ∧ q = (iExitless k ℓ : ℝ) - r * (ℓ : ℝ)} := by
    refine ⟨-r * (Fintype.card (Vtx k) : ℝ), ?_⟩
    rintro q ⟨ℓ, hℓ, rfl⟩
    have hcard : (ℓ : ℝ) ≤ (Fintype.card (Vtx k) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hN ℓ hℓ
    have hi : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (iExitless k ℓ : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    nlinarith [hcard, hi, hr0]
  rw [ge_iff_le]
  apply le_csInf
  · obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hne
    exact ⟨(p.wtP : ℝ) - r * (p.numVerts : ℝ), p, hp, rfl⟩
  · rintro a ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    have hse : p.StronglyExitless := by rw [hXk] at hp; exact hp
    have hex : p.Exitless := hse.1
    have hmem : ((iExitless k p.numVerts : ℝ) - r * (p.numVerts : ℝ)) ∈
        {q : ℝ | ∃ ℓ, HasExitlessPath k ℓ ∧ q = (iExitless k ℓ : ℝ) - r * (ℓ : ℝ)} :=
      ⟨p.numVerts, ⟨p, hex, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    have hle_i : iExitless k p.numVerts ≤ p.wtP := Nat.sInf_le ⟨p, hex, rfl, rfl⟩
    have hicast : (iExitless k p.numVerts : ℝ) ≤ (p.wtP : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hle_i
    calc sInf {q : ℝ | ∃ ℓ, HasExitlessPath k ℓ ∧ q = (iExitless k ℓ : ℝ) - r * (ℓ : ℝ)}
          ≤ (iExitless k p.numVerts : ℝ) - r * (p.numVerts : ℝ) := csInf_le hBbb hmem
      _ ≤ (p.wtP : ℝ) - r * (p.numVerts : ℝ) := by linarith

name: Hunter.Proved.prop4
statement:
theorem prop4 {k : ℕ} (_hk : 3 ≤ k) {ℓ : ℕ} (h : k < ℓ) (hex : HasExitlessPath k ℓ)
    (_hpivot : HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)))
    (hprop3 : ∀ m, k < m →
        ((j k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
            (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ))
          ≤ ((j k m : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) / ((m : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)))
    (hthm2 : ∀ m, HasExitlessPath k m → j k m ≤ iExitless k m)
    (hthm2eq : iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) = j k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2))) :
    ((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
        (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ))
      ≤ ((iExitless k ℓ : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) / ((ℓ : ℝ) - (k : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hd : (0 : ℝ) < (ℓ : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) := by
    have : (k : ℝ) < (ℓ : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h
    linarith
  have hji : (j k ℓ : ℝ) ≤ (iExitless k ℓ : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hthm2 ℓ hex
  have step1 : ((j k ℓ : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) / ((ℓ : ℝ) - (k : ℝ))
      ≤ ((iExitless k ℓ : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) / ((ℓ : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)) :=
    (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hd).mpr (by linarith)
  have step2 := hprop3 ℓ h
  have step3 : ((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
        (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ))
      = ((j k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
          (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)) := by rw [hthm2eq]
  rw [step3]
  linarith [step1, step2]

name: Hunter.Proved.prop1
proof:
:= by
  have hkR : (3 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hk1 : (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hPk : (0 : ℝ) < ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) := by
    rw [castP (by omega)]; exact D_pos hk
  have hℓk : (0 : ℝ) < (ℓ : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) := by
    have : (k : ℝ) < (ℓ : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h1
    linarith
  have hjP : (j k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) = (k : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((k : ℝ) - 2) - 3 := by
    rw [j_pivot hk, castI hk]
  have hjℓnat : j k ℓ = ℓ + (ℓ ⌈/⌉ k) + (ℓ ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1))) - 3 := j_base (Or.inl h2)
  have hsum3 : 3 ≤ ℓ + (ℓ ⌈/⌉ k) + (ℓ ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1))) := by omega
  have hjℓ : (j k ℓ : ℝ)
      = (ℓ : ℝ) + ((ℓ ⌈/⌉ k : ℕ) : ℝ) + ((ℓ ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1)) : ℕ) : ℝ) - 3 := by
    rw [hjℓnat, Nat.cast_sub hsum3]; push_cast; ring
  have hc1 : (ℓ : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) * ((ℓ ⌈/⌉ k : ℕ) : ℝ) := ceilDiv_ge_mul ℓ k (by omega)
  have hc2 : (ℓ : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) - 1) * ((ℓ ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1)) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    have hh := ceilDiv_ge_mul ℓ (k * (k - 1)) (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega))
    rwa [show ((k * (k - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) = (k : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) - 1) from by
      push_cast [Nat.cast_sub (show 1 ≤ k by omega)]; ring] at hh
  
  have hC : (ℓ : ℝ) ≤ ((k : ℝ) - 1) *
      (((ℓ ⌈/⌉ k : ℕ) : ℝ) + ((ℓ ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1)) : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
    have e1 : ((k : ℝ) - 1) * (ℓ : ℝ) ≤ ((k : ℝ) - 1) * ((k : ℝ) * ((ℓ ⌈/⌉ k : ℕ) : ℝ)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hc1 (by linarith)
    nlinarith [e1, hc2, hk1]
  have hℓP : (ℓ : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) - 1) * ((k : ℝ) - 2) := by
    rw [← castP (by omega)]; exact_mod_cast h2
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hPk hℓk, hjP, hjℓ, castP (by omega)]
  nlinarith [hC, hℓP, hPk, hℓk, mul_pos hPk (show (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) - 1 by linarith),
    mul_nonneg (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) - 1 by linarith) (sub_nonneg.mpr hC),
    mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hPk) (sub_nonneg.mpr hℓP),
    mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hℓP) (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) - 1 by linarith)]

name: Hunter.Proved.red_R
statement:
theorem red_R {k : ℕ}
    (hkey : ∀ p, p ∈ Xk' k → p.numVerts ≤ k.factorial - k →
        k < p.numVerts + k ∧ HasExitlessPath k (p.numVerts + k) ∧
          ((iExitless k (p.numVerts + k) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
              (((p.numVerts + k : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ))
            ≤ (pValue p : ℝ) / (p.numVerts : ℝ))
    (hne : ∃ p, p ∈ Xk' k ∧ p.numVerts ≤ k.factorial - k)
    (hBddR : BddBelow {q : ℝ | ∃ ℓ, k < ℓ ∧ HasExitlessPath k ℓ ∧
        q = ((iExitless k ℓ : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) / ((ℓ : ℝ) - (k : ℝ))}) :
    Rk k ≥ sInf {q : ℝ | ∃ ℓ, k < ℓ ∧ HasExitlessPath k ℓ ∧
      q = ((iExitless k ℓ : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) / ((ℓ : ℝ) - (k : ℝ))}
proof:
:= by
  rw [ge_iff_le, Rk]
  apply le_csInf
  · obtain ⟨p, hp, hle⟩ := hne
    exact ⟨(pValue p : ℝ) / (p.numVerts : ℝ), p, hp, hle, rfl⟩
  · rintro a ⟨p, hp, hle, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨hklt, hHEP, hbound⟩ := hkey p hp hle
    have hmem : ((iExitless k (p.numVerts + k) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
          (((p.numVerts + k : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)) ∈
        {q : ℝ | ∃ ℓ, k < ℓ ∧ HasExitlessPath k ℓ ∧
          q = ((iExitless k ℓ : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) / ((ℓ : ℝ) - (k : ℝ))} :=
      ⟨p.numVerts + k, hklt, hHEP, by push_cast; ring_nf⟩
    exact le_trans (csInf_le hBddR hmem) hbound

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta.weight3_marker_cases
statement:
theorem weight3_marker_cases {x v : List ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hx : IsPermWord k x)
    (hv : IsPermWord k v) (hover : x.drop 3 = v.take (k - 3))
    (hmark : v.getLastD 0 = (rho x).getLastD 0) :
    v = alphaWord x ∨ v = sigmaSqWord x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, t, rfl⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil (hx.ne_nil (by omega))
  obtain ⟨b, c, s, rfl⟩ : ∃ b c s, t = b :: c :: s := by
    rcases t with _ | ⟨b, _ | ⟨c, s⟩⟩
    · have := hx.length; simp at this; omega
    · have := hx.length; simp at this; omega
    · exact ⟨b, c, s, rfl⟩
  
  have hxlen : (a :: b :: c :: s).length = k := hx.length
  have hslen : s.length = k - 3 := by simp at hxlen; omega
  have hdrop : (a :: b :: c :: s).drop 3 = s := rfl
  
  have hrho : rho (a :: b :: c :: s) = (b :: c :: s) ++ [a] := by
    show (a :: b :: c :: s).rotate 1 = _; simp
  have hmarkval : (rho (a :: b :: c :: s)).getLastD 0 = a := by
    rw [hrho, show (b :: c :: s) ++ [a] = ((b :: c :: s) ++ [a]) by rfl, List.getLastD_concat]
  rw [hmarkval] at hmark
  
  set r := v.drop (k - 3) with hr
  have hvsplit : v = s ++ r := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← List.take_append_drop (k - 3) v]
    rw [← hover, hdrop]
  have hrlen : r.length = 3 := by rw [hr, List.length_drop, hv.length]; omega
  have hnd : (a :: b :: c :: s).Nodup := hx.nodup
  
  have hab' : a ∉ (b :: c :: s) := (List.nodup_cons.mp hnd).1
  have hbcs : (b :: c :: s).Nodup := (List.nodup_cons.mp hnd).2
  have hbc' : b ∉ (c :: s) := (List.nodup_cons.mp hbcs).1
  have hcs : (c :: s).Nodup := (List.nodup_cons.mp hbcs).2
  have hcs' : c ∉ s := (List.nodup_cons.mp hcs).1
  have has : a ∉ s := fun h => hab' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h))
  have hbs : b ∉ s := fun h => hbc' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h)
  have hbc : b ≠ c := fun h => hbc' (h ▸ List.mem_cons_self ..)
  
  have hsymbols : v.toFinset = (a :: b :: c :: s).toFinset := by
    rw [hv.toFinset_eq, hx.toFinset_eq]
  have hbr : b ∈ r := by
    have hbv : b ∈ v := by rw [← List.mem_toFinset, hsymbols]; simp
    rw [hvsplit, List.mem_append] at hbv
    exact hbv.resolve_left hbs
  have hcr : c ∈ r := by
    have hcv : c ∈ v := by rw [← List.mem_toFinset, hsymbols]; simp
    rw [hvsplit, List.mem_append] at hcv
    exact hcv.resolve_left hcs'
  
  obtain ⟨x1, x2, x3, hxyz⟩ := List.length_eq_three.mp hrlen
  have hz : x3 = a := by
    have hgl : v.getLastD 0 = x3 := by
      rw [hvsplit, hxyz, show s ++ [x1, x2, x3] = (s ++ [x1, x2]) ++ [x3] by simp,
          List.getLastD_concat]
    rw [hgl] at hmark; exact hmark
  rw [hz] at hxyz
  have hxy : x1 ≠ x2 := by
    have hvnd : v.Nodup := hv.nodup
    rw [hvsplit, hxyz] at hvnd
    have := (List.nodup_append.mp hvnd).2.1
    rw [List.nodup_cons, List.nodup_cons] at this
    exact fun h => this.1 (by simp [h])
  rw [hxyz] at hbr hcr
  simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hbr hcr
  
  have hbne : b ≠ a := fun h => hab' (h ▸ List.mem_cons_self ..)
  have hcne : c ≠ a := fun h => hab' (h ▸ List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_cons_self ..))
  have halpha : alphaWord (a :: b :: c :: s) = s ++ [c, b, a] := by
    show (a :: b :: c :: s).drop 3 ++ ((a :: b :: c :: s).take 3).reverse = _
    rfl
  have hsig : sigmaSqWord (a :: b :: c :: s) = s ++ [b, c, a] := rfl
  rcases hbr with rfl | (rfl | hbfalse)
  · 
    rcases hcr with hc1 | (rfl | hcfalse)
    · exact absurd hc1.symm hbc
    · right; rw [hvsplit, hxyz, hsig]
    · exact absurd hcfalse hcne
  · 
    rcases hcr with rfl | (hc2 | hcfalse)
    · left; rw [hvsplit, hxyz, halpha]
    · exact absurd hc2.symm hbc
    · exact absurd hcfalse hcne
  · exact absurd hbfalse hbne

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta.sigmaSqWord_marker
statement:
theorem sigmaSqWord_marker {x : List ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hx : IsPermWord k x) :
    (sigmaSqWord x).getLastD 0 = (rho x).getLastD 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, t, rfl⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil (hx.ne_nil (by omega))
  obtain ⟨b, c, t'', rfl⟩ : ∃ b c t'', t = b :: c :: t'' := by
    rcases t with _ | ⟨b, _ | ⟨c, t''⟩⟩
    · have := hx.length; simp at this; omega
    · have := hx.length; simp at this; omega
    · exact ⟨b, c, t'', rfl⟩
  have hsig : sigmaSqWord (a :: b :: c :: t'') = t'' ++ [b, c, a] := rfl
  have hrho : rho (a :: b :: c :: t'') = (b :: c :: t'') ++ [a] := by
    show (a :: b :: c :: t'').rotate 1 = _; simp
  rw [hsig, hrho]
  rw [show t'' ++ [b, c, a] = (t'' ++ [b, c]) ++ [a] by simp, List.getLastD_concat,
      show (b :: c :: t'') ++ [a] = ((b :: c :: t'') ++ [a]) by rfl, List.getLastD_concat]

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta.sigmaSqWord_erase_marker
statement:
theorem sigmaSqWord_erase_marker {x : List ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hx : IsPermWord k x) :
    (sigmaSqWord x).erase ((rho x).getLastD 0) =
      ((rho x).erase ((rho x).getLastD 0)).rotate 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, t, rfl⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil (hx.ne_nil (by omega))
  obtain ⟨b, c, t'', rfl⟩ : ∃ b c t'', t = b :: c :: t'' := by
    rcases t with _ | ⟨b, _ | ⟨c, t''⟩⟩
    · have := hx.length; simp at this; omega
    · have := hx.length; simp at this; omega
    · exact ⟨b, c, t'', rfl⟩
  have hnd : (a :: b :: c :: t'').Nodup := hx.nodup
  have hrho : rho (a :: b :: c :: t'') = (b :: c :: t'') ++ [a] := by
    show (a :: b :: c :: t'').rotate 1 = _; simp
  have hmark : (rho (a :: b :: c :: t'')).getLastD 0 = a := by
    rw [hrho, show (b :: c :: t'') ++ [a] = ((b :: c :: t'') ++ [a]) by rfl,
        List.getLastD_concat]
  have hanbct : a ∉ (b :: c :: t'') := (List.nodup_cons.mp hnd).1
  have hrhoerase : (rho (a :: b :: c :: t'')).erase a = b :: c :: t'' := by
    rw [hrho, List.erase_append_right _ hanbct, List.erase_cons_head, List.append_nil]
  have hsig : sigmaSqWord (a :: b :: c :: t'') = t'' ++ [b, c, a] := rfl
  have hantcb : a ∉ (t'' ++ [b, c]) := by
    intro h; rw [List.mem_append] at h
    rcases h with h | h
    · exact hanbct (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h))
    · simp at h
      rcases h with h | h
      · exact hanbct (h ▸ List.mem_cons_self ..)
      · exact hanbct (h ▸ List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_cons_self ..))
  have hsigerase : (sigmaSqWord (a :: b :: c :: t'')).erase a = t'' ++ [b, c] := by
    rw [hsig, show t'' ++ [b, c, a] = (t'' ++ [b, c]) ++ [a] by simp,
        List.erase_append_right _ hantcb, List.erase_cons_head, List.append_nil]
  rw [hmark, hsigerase, hrhoerase]
  rw [List.rotate_eq_drop_append_take (by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega :
    2 ≤ (b :: c :: t'').length)]
  rfl

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta.weight3_marker_erase_cases
statement:
theorem weight3_marker_erase_cases {x v : List ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hx : IsPermWord k x)
    (hv : IsPermWord k v) (hover : x.drop 3 = v.take (k - 3))
    (hmark : v.getLastD 0 = (rho x).getLastD 0) :
    (v = alphaWord x ∧
        v.erase ((rho x).getLastD 0) = door ((rho x).erase ((rho x).getLastD 0)))
      ∨ (v = sigmaSqWord x ∧
        v.erase ((rho x).getLastD 0) = ((rho x).erase ((rho x).getLastD 0)).rotate 2)
proof:
:= by
  rcases weight3_marker_cases hk hx hv hover hmark with hα | hσ
  · exact Or.inl ⟨hα, by rw [hα]; exact alpha_erase_marker hk hx⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨hσ, by rw [hσ]; exact sigmaSqWord_erase_marker hk hx⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta.weight3_marker_edge_cases
statement:
theorem weight3_marker_edge_cases (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} {i : ℕ}
    (hw : ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) = 3)
    (hmark : (p.vert (i + 1) : List ℕ).getLastD 0 = (rho (p.vert i : List ℕ)).getLastD 0) :
    (p.vert (i + 1) : List ℕ) = alphaWord (p.vert i) ∨
      (p.vert (i + 1) : List ℕ) = sigmaSqWord (p.vert i)
proof:
:= by
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
  have hu : IsPermWord k (p.vert i : List ℕ) := (p.vert i).2
  have hv : IsPermWord k (p.vert (i + 1) : List ℕ) := (p.vert (i + 1)).2
  have hew : wt k (p.vert i : List ℕ) (p.vert (i + 1) : List ℕ) = 3 := hw
  have hspec := (wt_spec (u := (p.vert i : List ℕ)) (v := (p.vert (i + 1) : List ℕ))
    hk1 (le_of_eq hu.length)).2.2
  rw [hew] at hspec
  exact weight3_marker_cases hk hu hv hspec hmark

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta.genLoop_door_eq_rho_of_len
statement:
theorem genLoop_door_eq_rho_of_len {w : List ℕ} (hw : 2 ≤ w.length) :
    genLoop (door w) = genLoop (rho w)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, s, rfl⟩ : ∃ a b s, w = a :: b :: s := by
    rcases w with _ | ⟨a, _ | ⟨b, s⟩⟩
    · simp at hw
    · simp at hw
    · exact ⟨a, b, s, rfl⟩
  have hrho : rho (a :: b :: s) = b :: s ++ [a] := by
    show (a :: b :: s).rotate 1 = _; simp
  have hdoor : door (a :: b :: s) = s ++ [b, a] := rfl
  rw [hrho, hdoor]
  unfold genLoop
  have h1 : (s ++ [b, a]).getLastD 0 = a := by
    have : s ++ [b, a] = (s ++ [b]) ++ [a] := by simp
    rw [this, List.getLastD_concat]
  have h2 : (b :: s ++ [a]).getLastD 0 = a := by
    have : b :: s ++ [a] = (b :: s) ++ [a] := by simp
    rw [this, List.getLastD_concat]
  have h3 : (s ++ [b, a]).dropLast = s ++ [b] := by
    have : s ++ [b, a] = (s ++ [b]) ++ [a] := by simp
    rw [this, List.dropLast_concat]
  have h4 : (b :: s ++ [a]).dropLast = b :: s := by
    have : b :: s ++ [a] = (b :: s) ++ [a] := by simp
    rw [this, List.dropLast_concat]
  rw [h1, h2, h3, h4]
  refine Prod.ext rfl ?_
  show rotClass (s ++ [b]) = rotClass (b :: s)
  apply Quotient.sound
  exact List.IsRotated.symm ⟨1, by simp⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta.metaWord_door_step
statement:
theorem metaWord_door_step (hk : 2 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) {i : ℕ}
    (hi : i + 1 < p.numVerts) (hd : k ∣ (i + 1))
    (hw : ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) = 2) :
    (p.vert (i + 1) : List ℕ).erase ((rho (p.vert i : List ℕ)).getLastD 0) =
      ((rho (p.vert i : List ℕ)).erase ((rho (p.vert i : List ℕ)).getLastD 0)).rotate 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [door_of_boundary hk hp hi hd hw]
  exact door_erase_marker hk (p.vert i).2

name: Hunter.ProofsMeta.metaWord_alpha_step
statement:
theorem metaWord_alpha_step (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} {i : ℕ}
    (_hi : i + 1 < p.numVerts) (_hw : ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) = 3)
    (_hmark : (p.vert (i + 1) : List ℕ).getLastD 0 = (rho (p.vert i : List ℕ)).getLastD 0)
    (hα : (p.vert (i + 1) : List ℕ) = alphaWord (p.vert i)) :
    (p.vert (i + 1) : List ℕ).erase ((rho (p.vert i : List ℕ)).getLastD 0) =
      door ((rho (p.vert i : List ℕ)).erase ((rho (p.vert i : List ℕ)).getLastD 0))
proof:
:= by
  rw [hα]; exact alpha_erase_marker hk (p.vert i).2

name: Hunter.ProofsDeficit.excessFrontier_of_windowExcess
statement:
theorem excessFrontier_of_windowExcess (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hw : WindowExcess k) :
    ExcessFrontier k
proof:
:= by
  have main : ∀ ℓ : ℕ, ∀ p : HPath k, p.Exitless → p.numVerts = ℓ →
      j k p.numVerts ≤ (p.numVerts - 1) + (p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k - 1) + excess p := by
    intro ℓ
    induction ℓ using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | _ ℓ ih =>
      intro p hpe hpℓ
      have h0 : 0 < p.numVerts := p.numVerts_pos
      by_cases hbase : p.numVerts ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)
      · exact excess_frontier_base hk hpe h0 hbase
      · rw [Nat.not_le] at hbase
        
        have he0pos : 0 < ell0 k := ell0_pos hk
        have hm : 2 ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by
          have h := Nat.mul_le_mul (show 2 ≤ k - 1 by omega) (show 1 ≤ k - 2 by omega)
          omega
        have hprod : k * 2 ≤ k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2)) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) hm
        have heq : k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2)) = k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by ring
        have he0val : ell0 k = k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) - k := rfl
        have hkle0 : k ≤ ell0 k := by rw [he0val]; omega
        have he0base : ell0 k ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by rw [he0val]; omega
        
        set n := p.numVerts - ell0 k with hn
        have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := by rw [hn]; omega
        have hnle : n ≤ p.numVerts := by rw [hn]; omega
        have hnlt : n < p.numVerts := by rw [hn]; omega
        have hNsum : p.numVerts = n + ell0 k := by rw [hn]; omega
        obtain ⟨q, hqv, hqe⟩ := prefix_exitless hpe hn1 hnle
        have hqnv : q.numVerts = n := by
          have hlen : p.verts.length = p.numVerts := rfl
          show q.verts.length = n
          rw [hqv, List.length_take, hlen]; omega
        
        have hnltℓ : n < ℓ := by rw [← hpℓ]; exact hnlt
        have hIH := ih n hnltℓ q hqe hqnv
        rw [hqnv] at hIH
        
        have hwin : excess q + (k - 2) ≤ excess p := by
          apply hw p q hpe hqe hbase
          rw [hqv, hn]
        
        have hdvd : k ∣ ell0 k := k_dvd_ell0 hk
        have hje0 : j k (ell0 k) = ell0 k + (ell0 k / k) + (k - 2) - 3 := by
          rw [j_base (Or.inl he0base), Proved.ceilDiv_of_dvd (show 0 < k by omega) hdvd,
              ceilDiv_ell0 hk]
        have hsplit : p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k = n ⌈/⌉ k + ell0 k / k := by
          rw [hNsum]; exact ceilDiv_add_dvd (show 0 < k by omega) hdvd
        have hjrec : j k p.numVerts = j k n + j k (ell0 k) + 3 := by
          have hr := j_rec_unfold_one hk hbase
          rw [← hn] at hr; exact hr
        
        have hXn1 : 1 ≤ n ⌈/⌉ k := by
          rw [Proved.ceilDiv_succ_pred hn1 (show 0 < k by omega)]; exact Nat.le_add_left 1 _
        have hXe1 : 1 ≤ ell0 k / k :=
          (Nat.one_le_div_iff (show 0 < k by omega)).mpr hkle0
        omega
  intro q hqe h0
  exact main q.numVerts q hqe rfl

name: Hunter.ProofsDeficit.excessFrontierDeficit_of_windowExcess
statement:
theorem excessFrontierDeficit_of_windowExcess (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hw : WindowExcess k) :
    ExcessFrontierDeficit k
proof:
:= by
  intro q hqe h0 _
  exact excessFrontier_of_windowExcess hk hw q hqe h0

name: Hunter.ProofsDeficit.thm2_of_windowExcess
statement:
theorem thm2_of_windowExcess {k ℓ : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hw : WindowExcess k)
    (hℓ : HasExitlessPath k ℓ) :
    j k ℓ ≤ iExitless k ℓ
proof:
:=
  thm2_of_frontier hk (excessFrontier_of_windowExcess hk hw) hℓ

name: Hunter.ProofsUnwind.firstInCycle_block_start
statement:
theorem firstInCycle_block_start (hk : 1 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless)
    {B : ℕ} (hdvd : k ∣ B) (hB : B + k ≤ p.numVerts) :
    firstInCycle p (p.vert B)
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu
  have hBlt : B < p.numVerts := by omega
  rw [ProofsExitless.pos_vert p hBlt]
  by_cases hmem : u ∈ p.verts
  · 
    set j := p.pos u with hj
    have hjlt : j < p.numVerts := ProofsExitless.pos_lt p hmem
    have hvj : p.vert j = u := ProofsExitless.vert_pos p hmem
    by_contra hlt
    push Not at hlt  
    
    set B'' := k * (j / k) with hB''
    have hB''dvd : k ∣ B'' := ⟨j / k, hB''⟩
    have hjmod : k * (j / k) + j % k = j := Nat.div_add_mod j k
    have hBB : k * (B / k) = B := Nat.mul_div_cancel' hdvd
    have hquot : j / k < B / k := by
      by_contra hc
      push Not at hc
      have h1 : k * (B / k) ≤ k * (j / k) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left k hc
      omega
    have hB''k : B'' + k ≤ B := by
      have h2 : k * (j / k + 1) ≤ k * (B / k) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left k hquot
      have : k * (j / k) + k = k * (j / k + 1) := by ring
      omega
    have hnre := ProofsExitless.no_reentry hk hp hB''dvd hB''k hBlt
    
    apply hnre
    have hjstruct := ProofsExitless.vert_eq_sigma_iter hk hp j hjlt
    have hrc_j : rotClass (p.vert j).1 = rotClass (p.vert B'').1 := by
      rw [hjstruct, ProofsExitless.rotClass_sigma_iter]
    have hrc_u : rotClass u.1 = rotClass (p.vert B'').1 := by rw [← hvj]; exact hrc_j
    rw [hrc_u] at hu
    exact hu
  · rw [ProofsExitless.pos_of_not_mem p hmem]
    omega

name: Hunter.ProofsUnwind.sset_empty_of_stronglyExitless
statement:
theorem sset_empty_of_stronglyExitless (hk : 1 ≤ k) {p : HPath k}
    (hham : p.IsHamiltonian) (hp : p.StronglyExitless) : Sset p = ∅
proof:
:= by
  rw [Sset, Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
  intro v hv
  rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hv
  obtain ⟨-, hvC, hedge⟩ := hv
  
  set i := p.pos v with hi
  have hmem : v ∈ p.verts := hham v
  have hilt : i < p.numVerts := ProofsExitless.pos_lt p hmem
  have hvi : p.vert i = v := ProofsExitless.vert_pos p hmem
  by_cases hdvd : k ∣ (i + 1)
  · 
    apply hvC
    rw [Cm1, Finset.mem_filter]
    refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    
    set B := k * (i / k) with hB
    have hBdvd : k ∣ B := ⟨i / k, hB⟩
    have himod : i % k = k - 1 := ProofsExitless.mod_eq_pred_of_dvd_succ hk hdvd
    have hiB : B + (k - 1) = i := by
      have hdm := Nat.div_add_mod i k; rw [← hB] at hdm; omega
    have hBk : B + k ≤ p.numVerts := by omega
    
    have hstruct := ProofsExitless.vert_eq_sigma_iter hk hp.1 i hilt
    rw [himod, ← hB] at hstruct
    
    have hv_eq : v = sigma^[k - 1] (p.vert B) := by rw [← hvi]; exact hstruct
    have hsig : sigma v = p.vert B := by
      rw [hv_eq, Proved.sigma_iter_succ' (k - 1) (p.vert B),
        show k - 1 + 1 = k from by omega, ProofsExitless.sigma_iter_period]
    rw [ProofsPathrule.mem_C0_iff, hsig]
    exact firstInCycle_block_start hk hp.1 hBdvd hBk
  · 
    apply hedge
    
    have hi1 : i + 1 < p.numVerts := by
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (i + 1) p.numVerts with h | h
      · exact h
      · exfalso
        have hle : p.numVerts ≤ i + 1 := h
        have : i + 1 = p.numVerts := by omega
        exact hdvd (this ▸ Proved.dvd_numVerts_of_stronglyExitless hk hp)
    have hsucc := ProofsExitless.vert_succ hk hp.1 hi1 hdvd
    have hedgemem := ProofsStructure.vert_consec_mem_edges hi1
    rw [hsucc, hvi] at hedgemem
    exact hedgemem

name: Hunter.ProofsUnwind.fPS_empty
statement: theorem fPS_empty (p : HPath k) : fPS p (∅ : Finset (Vtx k)) = p.edges
proof:
:= by
  have hE1 : E1removed p ∅ = ∅ := by
    rw [E1removed]; apply Finset.filter_false_of_mem
    intro e _; exact Finset.notMem_empty _
  have hadd : addedEdges (∅ : Finset (Vtx k)) = ∅ := by rw [addedEdges, Finset.image_empty]
  have hstep1 : Xstep1 p ∅ = p.edges := by
    rw [Xstep1, hE1, hadd, Finset.sdiff_empty, Finset.union_empty]
  have hdbl : doubles p ∅ = ∅ := by
    rw [doubles]; apply Finset.filter_false_of_mem
    intro u _; rw [hstep1]
    have := ProofsSpine.path_into_le_one p u; omega
  have hE2 : E2removed p ∅ = ∅ := by
    rw [E2removed, hdbl]; apply Finset.filter_false_of_mem
    intro e _; exact Finset.notMem_empty _
  rw [fPS, hstep1, hE2, Finset.sdiff_empty]

name: Hunter.ProofsUnwind.F_eq_edges_of_sset_empty
statement:
theorem F_eq_edges_of_sset_empty (hk : 1 ≤ k) {p : HPath k}
    (hham : p.IsHamiltonian) (hp : p.StronglyExitless) : F p = p.edges
proof:
:= by
  rw [F, sset_empty_of_stronglyExitless hk hham hp, fPS_empty]

name: Hunter.Proved.prp_Xk_se_sufficiency_single
statement:
theorem prp_Xk_se_sufficiency_single (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)}
    (hspan : vertsOf X = Finset.univ) (hse : IsUnionOfStronglyExitlessPaths X)
    (hone : numComps X ≤ 1) : X ∈ Xk k
proof:
:= by
  haveI := ProofsSpine.vtx_nonempty k
  
  have hvne : (vertsOf X).Nonempty := by rw [hspan]; exact Finset.univ_nonempty
  have hCompNe : (Comps X).Nonempty := by
    rw [Comps]; exact hvne.image _
  obtain ⟨C, hCmem⟩ := hCompNe
  obtain ⟨p, hpV, hpPC, hpSE⟩ := hse C hCmem
  
  have hCuniv : C = Finset.univ := by
    apply Finset.eq_univ_of_forall
    intro w
    have hwV : w ∈ vertsOf X := by rw [hspan]; exact Finset.mem_univ w
    set blk := (vertsOf X).filter (fun u => weakConn X w u) with hblkdef
    have hblkmem : blk ∈ Comps X := by
      rw [Comps]; exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨w, hwV, rfl⟩
    have hCeq : C = blk := Finset.card_le_one.mp hone C hCmem blk hblkmem
    have hwblk : w ∈ blk := by
      rw [hblkdef, Finset.mem_filter]
      exact ⟨hwV, Relation.ReflTransGen.refl⟩
    rw [hCeq]; exact hwblk
  
  have hVuniv : p.vertsFinset = Finset.univ := by rw [hpV, hCuniv]
  have hham : p.IsHamiltonian := by
    intro v
    exact HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mp (by rw [hVuniv]; exact Finset.mem_univ v)
  
  have hmemV : ∀ e : Vtx k × Vtx k, e.1 ∈ p.vertsFinset := by
    intro e; rw [hVuniv]; exact Finset.mem_univ _
  have hXsub : X ⊆ p.edges := fun e he => hpPC.2.2 e he (hmemV e)
  have hedgesX : p.edges = X := Finset.Subset.antisymm hpPC.1 hXsub
  
  refine ⟨p, hham, ?_⟩
  rw [F_eq_edges_of_sset_empty hk hham hpSE, hedgesX]

name: Hunter.ProofsUnwind.mem_unwindVerts
statement:
theorem mem_unwindVerts {ps : List (HPath k)} {v : Vtx k} :
    v ∈ unwindVerts ps ↔ ∃ p ∈ ps, v ∈ p.verts
proof:
:= by
  rw [unwindVerts, List.mem_append, List.mem_flatten]
  constructor
  · rintro (h | ⟨l, hl, hvl⟩)
    · rw [List.mem_map] at h
      obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := h
      exact ⟨p, hp, p.first_mem⟩
    · rw [List.mem_map] at hl
      obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := hl
      exact ⟨p, List.mem_reverse.mp hp, List.mem_of_mem_drop hvl⟩
  · rintro ⟨p, hp, hv⟩
    
    obtain ⟨a, t, hat⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil p.ne
    have hfirst : p.first = a := ProofsSpine.first_eq hat
    have hdrop : p.verts.drop 1 = t := by rw [hat, List.drop_one, List.tail_cons]
    rw [hat, List.mem_cons] at hv
    rcases hv with rfl | hv
    · exact Or.inl (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨p, hp, hfirst⟩)
    · refine Or.inr ⟨p.verts.drop 1, ?_, by rw [hdrop]; exact hv⟩
      exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨p, List.mem_reverse.mpr hp, rfl⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsUnwind.unwindVerts_ne
statement: theorem unwindVerts_ne {ps : List (HPath k)} (hps : ps ≠ []) : unwindVerts ps ≠ []
proof:
:= by
  cases ps with
  | nil => exact absurd rfl hps
  | cons a t => simp [unwindVerts]

name: Hunter.ProofsUnwind.unwind_isHamiltonian
statement:
theorem unwind_isHamiltonian {ps : List (HPath k)} (hps : ps ≠ [])
    (hnd : (unwindVerts ps).Nodup)
    (hcover : ∀ v : Vtx k, ∃ p ∈ ps, v ∈ p.verts) :
    (unwindP ps hps hnd).IsHamiltonian
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  show v ∈ unwindVerts ps
  exact mem_unwindVerts.mpr (hcover v)

name: Hunter.Proved.prp_Xk_se_sufficiency_unwind
statement:
theorem prp_Xk_se_sufficiency_unwind {X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k)}
    {ps : List (HPath k)} (hps : ps ≠ [])
    (hnd : (unwindVerts ps).Nodup)
    (hcover : ∀ v : Vtx k, ∃ p ∈ ps, v ∈ p.verts)
    (hFPX : F (unwindP ps hps hnd) = X) : X ∈ Xk k
proof:
:=
  ⟨unwindP ps hps hnd, unwind_isHamiltonian hps hnd hcover, hFPX⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsEndgame.excessBlockCeil_of_tightJumpFree
statement:
theorem excessBlockCeil_of_tightJumpFree (hk : 4 ≤ k) (h : TightJumpFree k) :
    ProofsRigid.ExcessBlockCeil k
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp h0
  set T := (p.numVerts - 1) / k with hT
  have hceil : p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k = T + 1 := ceilDiv_succ_pred h0 (by omega)
  rw [hceil]
  
  have hpred : T ≤ ProofsInduction.G k (excess p) := by
    have hbp := ProofsRigid.blockCeil_pred_le_G hk hp h0
    rwa [hceil, Nat.add_sub_cancel] at hbp
  have hDfrT : Dfr k T ≤ excess p := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos T with hz | hpos
    · rw [hz, Dfr_zero]; exact Nat.zero_le _
    · exact (ProofsInduction.Dfr_le_iff_le_G hk T hpos (excess p)).mpr hpred
  have hinc : Dfr k (T + 1) ≤ Dfr k T + 1 := Dfr_succ_le hk T
  by_cases hjump : Dfr k (T + 1) = Dfr k T + 1
  · have hstrict : Dfr k T < excess p := h p hp h0 hjump
    omega
  · 
    omega

name: Hunter.ProofsEndgame.thm1v1_of_blockCeilAll
statement:
theorem thm1v1_of_blockCeilAll (h : ExcessBlockCeilAll)
    (hproof : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) →
        (L k : ℝ) ≥ (iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ)
          + (((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
              (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)))
            * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ))) :
    ∃ (C : ℝ) (k₀ : ℕ), ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k →
      (Lstar k : ℝ) ≥ coeff k * (k.factorial : ℝ) + (k : ℝ) - C

              (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)))
            * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ))) :

name: Hunter.ProofsEndgame.eq_weak_of_blockCeilAll
statement:
theorem eq_weak_of_blockCeilAll (h : ExcessBlockCeilAll)
    (hproof : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) →
        (L k : ℝ) ≥ (iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ)
          + (((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /

name: Hunter.ProofsExitless.rotate_injOn_lt
statement:
theorem rotate_injOn_lt {w : List ℕ} (hnd : w.Nodup) {a b : ℕ} (ha : a < w.length)
    (hb : b < w.length) (heq : w.rotate a = w.rotate b) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : 0 < w.length := by omega
  have e := congrArg (fun l => l[0]?) heq
  simp only [List.getElem?_rotate h0, Nat.zero_add, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt ha,
    Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hb] at e
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem ha, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hb] at e
  exact (hnd.getElem_inj_iff).mp (Option.some_inj.mp e)

name: Hunter.ProofsExitless.sigma_iter_val
statement: theorem sigma_iter_val (r : ℕ) (v : Vtx k) : (sigma^[r] v).1 = (v : List ℕ).rotate r
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
    change ((sigma^[n] v : Vtx k) : List ℕ).rotate 1 = (v : List ℕ).rotate (n + 1)
    rw [ih, List.rotate_rotate, Nat.add_comm]

name: Hunter.ProofsExitless.sigma_iter_mod
statement: theorem sigma_iter_mod (r : ℕ) (v : Vtx k) : sigma^[r % k] v = sigma^[r] v
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [sigma_iter_val, sigma_iter_val]
  have h : r % k = r % (v : List ℕ).length := by rw [v.2.length]
  rw [h, List.rotate_mod]

name: Hunter.ProofsExitless.sigma_iter_period
statement: theorem sigma_iter_period (v : Vtx k) : sigma^[k] v = v
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [sigma_iter_val]
  have h : (v : List ℕ).rotate k = (v : List ℕ).rotate (v : List ℕ).length := by rw [v.2.length]
  rw [h, List.rotate_length]

name: Hunter.ProofsExitless.sigma_iter_inj
statement:
theorem sigma_iter_inj (v : Vtx k) {a b : ℕ} (ha : a < k) (hb : b < k)
    (h : sigma^[a] v = sigma^[b] v) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : (v : List ℕ).length = k := v.2.length
  apply rotate_injOn_lt v.2.nodup (a := a) (b := b) (by rw [hlen]; exact ha)
    (by rw [hlen]; exact hb)
  have := congrArg (Subtype.val) h
  rwa [sigma_iter_val, sigma_iter_val] at this
