name: Hunter.ProofsExitless.mem_cyc_iff_exists
statement:
theorem mem_cyc_iff_exists (hk : 1 ≤ k) {u v : Vtx k} :
    u ∈ cyc v ↔ ∃ r < k, u = sigma^[r] v
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_cyc]
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (rotClass_eq_iff.mp h).symm
    refine ⟨n % k, Nat.mod_lt _ hk, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [sigma_iter_val]
    have hmod : n % k = n % (v : List ℕ).length := by rw [v.2.length]
    rw [hmod, List.rotate_mod, hn]
  · rintro ⟨r, -, rfl⟩
    exact rotClass_sigma_iter r v

name: Hunter.ProofsExitless.cyc_eq_image
statement:
theorem cyc_eq_image (hk : 1 ≤ k) (v : Vtx k) :
    cyc v = (Finset.range k).image (fun r => sigma^[r] v)
proof:
:= by
  ext u
  rw [mem_cyc_iff_exists hk, Finset.mem_image]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩; exact ⟨r, Finset.mem_range.mpr hr, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩; exact ⟨r, Finset.mem_range.mp hr, rfl⟩

name: Hunter.ProofsExitless.card_cyc
statement: theorem card_cyc (hk : 1 ≤ k) (v : Vtx k) : (cyc v).card = k
proof:
:= by
  rw [cyc_eq_image hk, Finset.card_image_of_injOn, Finset.card_range]
  intro a ha b hb hab
  exact sigma_iter_inj v (Finset.mem_range.mp ha) (Finset.mem_range.mp hb) hab

name: Hunter.ProofsExitless.ew_ge_one
statement: theorem ew_ge_one (hk : 1 ≤ k) (u v : Vtx k) : 1 ≤ ew k u v
proof:
:=
  (wt_spec hk (le_of_eq u.2.length)).1

name: Hunter.ProofsExitless.ew_eq_one_iff
statement: theorem ew_eq_one_iff (hk : 1 ≤ k) {u v : Vtx k} : ew k u v = 1 ↔ v = sigma u
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply Subtype.ext
    have := eq_rho_of_wt_one hk u.2 v.2 h
    rw [this]; rfl
  · rintro rfl; exact ew_sigma hk u

name: Hunter.ProofsExitless.exitless_step
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hcon
  apply hp
  refine ⟨i, hi, ?_, h2⟩
  have hne : ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) ≠ 1 := by
    intro he
    exact h1 ((ew_eq_one_iff hk).mp he)
  have hge := ew_ge_one hk (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1))
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsExitless.mul_add_mod_lt
statement: theorem mul_add_mod_lt (a b c : ℕ) (h : c < b) : (b * a + c) % b = c
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.mul_add_mod, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h]

name: Hunter.ProofsExitless.mul_add_div_lt
statement:
theorem mul_add_div_lt (a b c : ℕ) (hb : 0 < b) (h : c < b) :
    b * ((b * a + c) / b) = b * a
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.mul_add_div hb, Nat.div_eq_of_lt h, Nat.add_zero]

name: Hunter.ProofsExitless.vert_eq_sigma_iter
statement:
theorem vert_eq_sigma_iter (hk : 1 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) :
    ∀ i, i < p.numVerts → p.vert i = sigma^[i % k] (p.vert (k * (i / k)))
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  induction i using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ i IH =>
    intro hi
    set B := k * (i / k) with hBdef
    set m := i % k with hmdef
    have hdm : B + m = i := by rw [hBdef, hmdef]; exact Nat.div_add_mod i k
    have hmk : m < k := by rw [hmdef]; exact Nat.mod_lt i hk
    have hB_dvd : k ∣ B := ⟨i / k, hBdef⟩
    
    have blockComplete : ∀ (C0 r : ℕ), k ∣ C0 → C0 + k ≤ i → r < k →
        p.vert (C0 + r) = sigma^[r] (p.vert C0) := by
      intro C0 r hdvd hle hr
      obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hdvd
      have hlt_i : k * q + r < i := by omega
      have hlt_n : k * q + r < p.numVerts := lt_trans hlt_i hi
      have H := IH (k * q + r) hlt_i hlt_n
      rw [mul_add_mod_lt q k r hr, mul_add_div_lt q k r hk hr] at H
      exact H
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with hm0 | hmpos
    · 
      have hBi : B = i := by omega
      rw [hm0, hBi]; simp
    · 
      have hi_pos : 1 ≤ i := by omega
      have hIHi' : p.vert (i - 1) = sigma^[m - 1] (p.vert B) := by
        have hlt_i : i - 1 < i := by omega
        have hlt_n : i - 1 < p.numVerts := by omega
        have H := IH (i - 1) hlt_i hlt_n
        have hrepr : i - 1 = k * (i / k) + (m - 1) := by rw [← hBdef]; omega
        rw [show (i - 1) % k = m - 1 from by
              rw [hrepr, mul_add_mod_lt (i / k) k (m - 1) (by omega)],
            show k * ((i - 1) / k) = B from by
              rw [hrepr, mul_add_div_lt (i / k) k (m - 1) hk (by omega), ← hBdef]] at H
        exact H
      have hsm : sigma^[m] (p.vert B) = sigma (p.vert (i - 1)) := by
        rw [hIHi']
        conv_lhs => rw [show m = (m - 1) + 1 from by omega]
        rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
      rw [hsm]
      have hi'succ : (i - 1) + 1 = i := by omega
      have hstep := exitless_step hk hp (i := i - 1) (by rw [hi'succ]; exact hi)
      rw [hi'succ] at hstep
      rcases hstep with hgood | hbad
      · exact hgood
      · exfalso
        rw [← hsm] at hbad
        set j := p.pos (sigma^[m] (p.vert B)) with hjdef
        have hj_lt_n : j < p.numVerts := by omega
        have hwmem : sigma^[m] (p.vert B) ∈ p.verts := by
          by_contra hcon
          have := pos_of_not_mem p hcon
          rw [← hjdef] at this; omega
        have hvj : p.vert j = sigma^[m] (p.vert B) := by rw [hjdef]; exact vert_pos p hwmem
        rcases lt_or_ge j B with hjB | hBj
        · 
          set B' := k * (j / k) with hB'def
          have hB'_dvd : k ∣ B' := ⟨j / k, hB'def⟩
          have hjdm : k * (j / k) + j % k = j := Nat.div_add_mod j k
          have hr0k : j % k < k := Nat.mod_lt j hk
          have hj_lt_B : j < k * (i / k) := by rw [← hBdef]; exact hjB
          have hquot : j / k < i / k := by
            by_contra hc
            push Not at hc
            have h1 : k * (i / k) ≤ k * (j / k) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) hc
            have h2 : k * (j / k) ≤ j := by omega
            omega
          have hB'k_le_B : B' + k ≤ B := by
            have h2 : k * (j / k + 1) ≤ k * (i / k) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) hquot
            rw [hB'def, hBdef]
            calc k * (j / k) + k = k * (j / k + 1) := by ring
              _ ≤ k * (i / k) := h2
          have hB'k_le_i : B' + k ≤ i := by omega
          have hjvert : p.vert j = sigma^[j % k] (p.vert B') := by
            have hbc := blockComplete B' (j % k) hB'_dvd hB'k_le_i hr0k
            rw [show B' + j % k = j from by rw [hB'def]; exact hjdm] at hbc
            exact hbc
          have hcls : rotClass (p.vert B).1 = rotClass (p.vert B').1 := by
            have e1 := rotClass_sigma_iter m (p.vert B)
            have e2 := rotClass_sigma_iter (j % k) (p.vert B')
            have heq : sigma^[m] (p.vert B) = sigma^[j % k] (p.vert B') := by
              rw [← hvj]; exact hjvert
            rw [← e1, heq]; exact e2
          obtain ⟨r1, hr1k, hr1eq⟩ := (mem_cyc_iff_exists hk).mp (mem_cyc.mpr hcls)
          have hbc1 := blockComplete B' r1 hB'_dvd hB'k_le_i hr1k
          rw [← hr1eq] at hbc1
          have hlt1 : B' + r1 < B := by omega
          have hn1 : B' + r1 < p.numVerts := by omega
          have hnB : B < p.numVerts := by omega
          have := vert_inj p hn1 hnB hbc1
          omega
        · 
          set d := j - B with hddef
          have hdk : d < k := by omega
          have hjeq : j = k * (i / k) + d := by rw [← hBdef]; omega
          have hIHj : p.vert j = sigma^[d] (p.vert B) := by
            have hlt_i : j < i := by omega
            have hlt_n : j < p.numVerts := lt_trans hlt_i hi
            have H := IH j hlt_i hlt_n
            rw [show j % k = d from by rw [hjeq, mul_add_mod_lt (i / k) k d hdk],
                show k * (j / k) = B from by
                  rw [hjeq, mul_add_div_lt (i / k) k d hk hdk, ← hBdef]] at H
            exact H
          have hww : sigma^[m] (p.vert B) = sigma^[d] (p.vert B) := by rw [← hvj]; exact hIHj
          have hmd : m = d := sigma_iter_inj (p.vert B) hmk hdk hww
          omega

name: Hunter.ProofsExitless.block_is_full_cycle
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hdvd
  have S := vert_eq_sigma_iter hk hp (k * q + r) hB
  rwa [mul_add_mod_lt q k r hr, mul_add_div_lt q k r hk hr] at S

name: Hunter.ProofsExitless.no_reentry
proof:
:= by
  intro hcls
  have hmem : p.vert B' ∈ cyc (p.vert B) := mem_cyc.mpr hcls.symm
  obtain ⟨r1, hr1k, hr1eq⟩ := (mem_cyc_iff_exists hk).mp hmem
  have hbc := block_is_full_cycle hk hp hdvd hr1k (by omega : B + r1 < p.numVerts)
  rw [← hr1eq] at hbc
  have hlt : B + r1 < B' := by omega
  have := vert_inj p (by omega) hB'n hbc
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsExitless.mod_eq_pred_of_dvd_succ
statement:
theorem mod_eq_pred_of_dvd_succ (hk : 1 ≤ k) {i : ℕ} (h : k ∣ (i + 1)) :
    i % k = k - 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := h
  have hq1 : 1 ≤ q := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos q with h0 | h1
    · rw [h0, Nat.mul_zero] at hq; omega
    · exact h1
  have hkq : k * (q - 1) + k = k * q := by
    cases q with
    | zero => omega
    | succ n => rw [Nat.succ_sub_one, Nat.mul_succ]
  have hirepr : i = k * (q - 1) + (k - 1) := by omega
  rw [hirepr, mul_add_mod_lt (q - 1) k (k - 1) (by omega)]

name: Hunter.ProofsExitless.succ_mod_div_of_not_dvd
statement:
theorem succ_mod_div_of_not_dvd (hk : 1 ≤ k) {i : ℕ} (h : ¬ k ∣ (i + 1)) :
    (i + 1) % k = i % k + 1 ∧ (i + 1) / k = i / k
proof:
:= by
  have hik : i % k < k := Nat.mod_lt i hk
  have hlt : i % k + 1 < k := by
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (i % k + 1) k with h1 | h1
    · exact h1
    · exfalso; apply h
      refine ⟨i / k + 1, ?_⟩
      have hd := Nat.div_add_mod i k
      have hik2 : i % k + 1 = k := by omega
      rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one]; omega
  have hrepr : i + 1 = k * (i / k) + (i % k + 1) := by have := Nat.div_add_mod i k; omega
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hrepr, mul_add_mod_lt (i / k) k (i % k + 1) hlt]
  · rw [hrepr, Nat.mul_add_div hk, Nat.div_eq_of_lt hlt, Nat.add_zero]

name: Hunter.ProofsExitless.vert_succ
proof:
:= by
  have hi' : i < p.numVerts := by omega
  have S1 := vert_eq_sigma_iter hk hp (i + 1) hi
  have S0 := vert_eq_sigma_iter hk hp i hi'
  obtain ⟨hmod, hdiv⟩ := succ_mod_div_of_not_dvd hk hnd
  rw [S1, hdiv, hmod, Function.iterate_succ_apply', ← S0]

name: Hunter.ProofsExitless.vert_succ_ne
proof:
:= by
  have hi' : i < p.numVerts := by omega
  have S0 := vert_eq_sigma_iter hk hp i hi'
  have him := mod_eq_pred_of_dvd_succ hk hd
  have key : sigma (p.vert i) = p.vert (k * (i / k)) := by
    rw [S0]
    have hstep := (Function.iterate_succ_apply' sigma (i % k) (p.vert (k * (i / k)))).symm
    have hexp : (i % k).succ = k := by omega
    rw [hstep, hexp, sigma_iter_period]
  rw [key]
  intro heq
  have hblt : k * (i / k) < i + 1 := by have := Nat.div_add_mod i k; omega
  have hb : k * (i / k) < p.numVerts := by omega
  have := vert_inj p hi hb heq
  omega

name: Hunter.Proved.sigma_iter_succ'
statement:
theorem sigma_iter_succ' {k : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (v : Vtx k) :
    sigma (sigma^[n] v) = sigma^[n + 1] v
proof: := by rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']

name: Hunter.Proved.last_eq_vert
statement: theorem last_eq_vert {k : ℕ} (p : HPath k) : p.last = p.vert (p.numVerts - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h : p.numVerts - 1 < p.numVerts := by have := p.numVerts_pos; omega
  rw [HPath.last]
  exact (List.getLast_eq_getElem p.ne).trans (vert_getElem p h).symm

name: Hunter.Proved.vtx_zero_elim
statement: theorem vtx_zero_elim (u v : Vtx 0) : u = v
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hu : (u : List ℕ).toFinset = ∅ := by
    have h := u.2.2; rwa [Finset.Icc_eq_empty (by omega : ¬ (1 : ℕ) ≤ 0)] at h
  have hv : (v : List ℕ).toFinset = ∅ := by
    have h := v.2.2; rwa [Finset.Icc_eq_empty (by omega : ¬ (1 : ℕ) ≤ 0)] at h
  rw [List.toFinset_eq_empty_iff] at hu hv
  rw [hu, hv]

name: Hunter.Proved.dvd_numVerts_of_stronglyExitless
statement:
theorem dvd_numVerts_of_stronglyExitless {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) {p : HPath k}
    (hp : p.StronglyExitless) : k ∣ p.numVerts
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hpe, hlast⟩ := hp
  by_contra hnd
  have hN : 1 ≤ p.numVerts := p.numVerts_pos
  have hrk : p.numVerts % k < k := Nat.mod_lt _ hk
  have hr1 : 1 ≤ p.numVerts % k := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (p.numVerts % k) with h | h
    · exact absurd (Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero h) hnd
    · exact h
  have hdmN : k * (p.numVerts / k) + p.numVerts % k = p.numVerts := Nat.div_add_mod _ _
  have hNm1 : p.numVerts - 1 < p.numVerts := by omega
  have hS := vert_eq_sigma_iter hk hpe (p.numVerts - 1) hNm1
  have hrepr : p.numVerts - 1 = k * (p.numVerts / k) + (p.numVerts % k - 1) := by omega
  rw [show (p.numVerts - 1) % k = p.numVerts % k - 1 from by
        rw [hrepr, mul_add_mod_lt (p.numVerts / k) k (p.numVerts % k - 1) (by omega)],
      show k * ((p.numVerts - 1) / k) = k * (p.numVerts / k) from by
        rw [hrepr, mul_add_div_lt (p.numVerts / k) k (p.numVerts % k - 1) hk (by omega)]] at hS
  have hlv : p.last = p.vert (p.numVerts - 1) := last_eq_vert p
  rw [hlv, hS,
      sigma_iter_succ' (p.numVerts % k - 1) (p.vert (k * (p.numVerts / k))),
      show p.numVerts % k - 1 + 1 = p.numVerts % k from by omega] at hlast
  set B := k * (p.numVerts / k) with hBdef
  have hBdvd : k ∣ B := ⟨p.numVerts / k, hBdef⟩
  set j := p.pos (sigma^[p.numVerts % k] (p.vert B)) with hjdef
  have hjlt : j < p.numVerts := pos_lt p hlast
  have hvj : p.vert j = sigma^[p.numVerts % k] (p.vert B) := vert_pos p hlast
  rcases lt_or_ge j B with hjB | hBj
  · have hj_lt_B : j < k * (p.numVerts / k) := by rw [← hBdef]; exact hjB
    have hquot : j / k < p.numVerts / k := by
      by_contra hc; push Not at hc
      have h1 : k * (p.numVerts / k) ≤ k * (j / k) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) hc
      have h2 : k * (j / k) ≤ j := by have := Nat.div_add_mod j k; omega
      omega
    have hB'dvd : k ∣ k * (j / k) := ⟨j / k, rfl⟩
    have hB'k : k * (j / k) + k ≤ B := by
      have h2 : k * (j / k + 1) ≤ k * (p.numVerts / k) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) hquot
      rw [hBdef]
      calc k * (j / k) + k = k * (j / k + 1) := by ring
        _ ≤ k * (p.numVerts / k) := h2
    have hBn : B < p.numVerts := by rw [hBdef]; omega
    have hjvert := vert_eq_sigma_iter hk hpe j hjlt
    have hcls : rotClass (p.vert B).1 = rotClass (p.vert (k * (j / k))).1 := by
      have e1 := rotClass_sigma_iter (p.numVerts % k) (p.vert B)
      have e2 := rotClass_sigma_iter (j % k) (p.vert (k * (j / k)))
      have heq : sigma^[p.numVerts % k] (p.vert B) = sigma^[j % k] (p.vert (k * (j / k))) := by
        rw [← hvj]; exact hjvert
      rw [← e1, heq]; exact e2
    exact no_reentry hk hpe hB'dvd hB'k hBn hcls.symm
  · set d := j - B with hddef
    have hjb2 : d < k := by omega
    have hjrepr : j = k * (p.numVerts / k) + d := by rw [← hBdef]; omega
    have hjstruct := vert_eq_sigma_iter hk hpe j hjlt
    rw [show j % k = d from by rw [hjrepr, mul_add_mod_lt (p.numVerts / k) k d hjb2],
        show k * (j / k) = B from by
          rw [hjrepr, mul_add_div_lt (p.numVerts / k) k d hk hjb2, ← hBdef]] at hjstruct
    have hww : sigma^[p.numVerts % k] (p.vert B) = sigma^[d] (p.vert B) := by
      rw [← hvj]; exact hjstruct
    have := sigma_iter_inj (p.vert B) hrk hjb2 hww
    omega

name: Hunter.Proved.clm_1cyclesubset
statement:
theorem clm_1cyclesubset {k : ℕ} {p : HPath k} (hp : p.StronglyExitless) :
    p.IsUnionOfCycles
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with hk0 | hk
  · subst hk0
    intro v hv u _
    rw [vtx_zero_elim u v]; exact HPath.mem_vertsFinset.mpr hv
  · have hdvd := dvd_numVerts_of_stronglyExitless hk hp
    obtain ⟨hpe, _⟩ := hp
    intro v hv u hu
    have hposv : p.pos v < p.numVerts := pos_lt p hv
    have hvv : p.vert (p.pos v) = v := vert_pos p hv
    set i := p.pos v with hidef
    have hBk : k * (i / k) + k ≤ p.numVerts := by
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hdvd
      have hit : i / k < t := by
        by_contra hc; push Not at hc
        have h1 : k * t ≤ k * (i / k) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) hc
        have h2 : k * (i / k) ≤ i := by have := Nat.div_add_mod i k; omega
        rw [ht] at hposv; omega
      have hit' : i / k + 1 ≤ t := hit
      have h2 : k * (i / k + 1) ≤ k * t := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) hit'
      rw [ht]
      calc k * (i / k) + k = k * (i / k + 1) := by ring
        _ ≤ k * t := h2
    have hS := vert_eq_sigma_iter hk hpe i hposv
    rw [mem_cyc] at hu
    have hvB : rotClass v.1 = rotClass (p.vert (k * (i / k))).1 := by
      rw [← hvv, hS]; exact rotClass_sigma_iter _ _
    have huB : u ∈ cyc (p.vert (k * (i / k))) := mem_cyc.mpr (hu.trans hvB)
    obtain ⟨r, hrk, hru⟩ := (mem_cyc_iff_exists hk).mp huB
    have hbc := block_is_full_cycle hk hpe (⟨i / k, rfl⟩ : k ∣ k * (i / k)) hrk
      (by omega : k * (i / k) + r < p.numVerts)
    rw [← hru] at hbc
    rw [HPath.mem_vertsFinset, ← hbc]
    exact vert_mem p (by omega)

name: Hunter.Proved.clm_prefix
statement:
theorem clm_prefix {k : ℕ} {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) (h2 : 2 ≤ p.numVerts) :
    ∃ q : HPath k, q.verts = p.verts.dropLast ∧ q.Exitless
proof:
:= by
  have h2' : 2 ≤ p.verts.length := h2
  have hne : p.verts.dropLast ≠ [] := by
    have : 0 < p.verts.dropLast.length := by rw [List.length_dropLast]; omega
    exact List.ne_nil_of_length_pos this
  have hnodup : p.verts.dropLast.Nodup := p.nodup.sublist (List.dropLast_sublist _)
  refine ⟨⟨p.verts.dropLast, hne, hnodup⟩, rfl, ?_⟩
  set q : HPath k := ⟨p.verts.dropLast, hne, hnodup⟩ with hq
  have hqnv : q.numVerts = p.numVerts - 1 := by
    show p.verts.dropLast.length = p.verts.length - 1
    rw [List.length_dropLast]
  have hqvert : ∀ i (hi : i < q.numVerts), q.vert i = p.vert i := by
    intro i hi
    have hi' : i < p.numVerts := by rw [hqnv] at hi; omega
    rw [vert_getElem q hi, vert_getElem p hi']
    exact List.getElem_dropLast _
  have hqpos : ∀ w : Vtx k, q.pos w ≤ p.pos w := by
    intro w
    show (p.verts.dropLast).idxOf w ≤ p.verts.idxOf w
    conv_rhs => rw [← List.dropLast_append_getLast p.ne]
    by_cases hw : w ∈ p.verts.dropLast
    · exact le_of_eq (List.idxOf_append_of_mem hw).symm
    · rw [List.idxOf_append_of_notMem hw, List.idxOf_of_notMem hw]
      omega
  intro hEE
  obtain ⟨i, hi1, hi2, hi3⟩ := hEE
  have hiq : i + 1 < p.numVerts := by rw [hqnv] at hi1; omega
  have hvi : q.vert i = p.vert i := hqvert i (by omega)
  apply hp
  refine ⟨i, hiq, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hvi, ← hqvert (i + 1) hi1]; exact hi2
  · rw [← hvi]; exact lt_of_lt_of_le hi3 (hqpos _)

name: Hunter.Proved.prp_periodicedges
statement:
theorem prp_periodicedges {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless)
    {i : ℕ} (hi : i + 1 < p.numVerts) :
    ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) = 1 ↔ ¬ (k ∣ (i + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [ew_eq_one_iff hk]
  constructor
  · intro heq hd
    exact vert_succ_ne hk hp hi hd heq
  · intro hnd
    exact vert_succ hk hp hi hnd

name: Hunter.Proved.prp_1edgebound
statement:
theorem prp_1edgebound {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (_hp : p.Exitless) :
    edgeCountGe p 1 = p.numVerts - 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgeCountGe,
    Finset.filter_true_of_mem (fun i _ => ew_ge_one hk (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1))),
    Finset.card_range]

name: Hunter.Proved.ceilDiv_succ_pred
statement:
theorem ceilDiv_succ_pred {N k : ℕ} (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hk : 0 < k) :
    N ⌈/⌉ k = (N - 1) / k + 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n, N = n + 1 := ⟨N - 1, by omega⟩
  rw [Nat.ceilDiv_eq_add_pred_div, show n + 1 + k - 1 = n + k from by omega,
      show n + 1 - 1 = n from by omega, Nat.add_div_right _ hk]

name: Hunter.Proved.prp_2edgebound
statement:
theorem prp_2edgebound {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) :
    edgeCountGe p 2 = p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hN : 1 ≤ p.numVerts := p.numVerts_pos
  have hpos := ceilDiv_succ_pred hN hk
  have hc : p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k - 1 = (p.numVerts - 1) / k := by rw [hpos, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  rw [hc, edgeCountGe]
  rw [show (Finset.range (p.numVerts - 1)).filter
          (fun i => 2 ≤ ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)))
        = (Finset.range (p.numVerts - 1)).filter (fun i => k ∣ (i + 1)) from ?_]
  · exact Nat.card_multiples (p.numVerts - 1) k
  · apply Finset.filter_congr
    intro i hi
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hi
    have hi' : i + 1 < p.numVerts := by omega
    have hpe := prp_periodicedges hk hp hi'
    have hge := ew_ge_one hk (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1))
    constructor
    · intro h2
      by_contra hnd
      exact absurd (hpe.mpr hnd) (by omega)
    · intro hd
      have hne : ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) ≠ 1 := fun he => (hpe.mp he) hd
      omega

name: Hunter.Proved.ceilDiv_of_dvd
statement: theorem ceilDiv_of_dvd {a b : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (h : b ∣ a) : a ⌈/⌉ b = a / b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := h
  rw [Nat.ceilDiv_eq_add_pred_div, show b * c + b - 1 = b * c + (b - 1) from by omega,
      Nat.mul_add_div hb, Nat.div_eq_of_lt (by omega : b - 1 < b), Nat.add_zero,
      Nat.mul_div_cancel_left c hb]

name: Hunter.Proved.j_at_pivot
statement:
theorem j_at_pivot {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) :
    j k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) = k ^ 2 * (k - 2) - 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [j_base (Or.inl (le_refl _))]
  have hk0 : 0 < k := by omega
  have hkk0 : 0 < k * (k - 1) := by
    have : 0 < k - 1 := by omega
    exact Nat.mul_pos hk0 this
  have hd1 : k ∣ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := ⟨(k - 1) * (k - 2), by rw [Nat.mul_assoc]⟩
  have hd2 : k * (k - 1) ∣ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := ⟨k - 2, rfl⟩
  rw [ceilDiv_of_dvd hk0 hd1, ceilDiv_of_dvd hkk0 hd2]
  have e1 : k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) / k = (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by
    rw [Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hk0]
  have e2 : k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) / (k * (k - 1)) = k - 2 := by
    rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hkk0]
  rw [e1, e2]
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, k = m + 3 := ⟨k - 3, by omega⟩
  have s1 : m + 3 - 1 = m + 2 := by omega
  have s2 : m + 3 - 2 = m + 1 := by omega
  rw [s1, s2]
  have core : (m + 3) * (m + 2) * (m + 1) + (m + 2) * (m + 1) + (m + 1)
      = (m + 3) ^ 2 * (m + 1) := by ring
  omega

name: Hunter.Proved.list_range_map_sum
statement:
theorem list_range_map_sum {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : ℕ → M) (n : ℕ) :
    ((List.range n).map f).sum = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, f i
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [List.range_succ, List.map_append, List.sum_append, ih, Finset.sum_range_succ]
    simp

name: Hunter.Proved.wtP_eq_sum
statement:
theorem wtP_eq_sum {k : ℕ} (p : HPath k) :
    p.wtP = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p.numVerts - 1), ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [HPath.wtP]
  rw [show p.verts.zipWith (ew k) p.verts.tail
        = (List.range (p.numVerts - 1)).map (fun i => ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1))) from ?_]
  · exact list_range_map_sum _ _
  · apply List.ext_getElem
    · rw [List.length_zipWith, List.length_map, List.length_range, List.length_tail]
      have : p.numVerts = p.verts.length := rfl
      omega
    · intro i h1 h2
      have hlen : i < p.verts.tail.length := by
        rw [List.length_tail]
        rw [List.length_zipWith, List.length_tail] at h1
        omega
      have hi1 : i < p.numVerts := by
        rw [List.length_zipWith, List.length_tail] at h1
        have : p.numVerts = p.verts.length := rfl
        omega
      have hi2 : i + 1 < p.numVerts := by
        rw [List.length_tail] at hlen
        have : p.numVerts = p.verts.length := rfl
        omega
      rw [List.getElem_zipWith, List.getElem_map, List.getElem_range, List.getElem_tail]
      exact (congrArg₂ (ew k) (vert_getElem p hi1) (vert_getElem p hi2)).symm

name: Hunter.Proved.indicator_sum_le
statement:
theorem indicator_sum_le (e : ℕ) :
    (if 1 ≤ e then 1 else 0) + (if 2 ≤ e then 1 else 0) + (if 3 ≤ e then 1 else 0) ≤ e
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs <;> omega

name: Hunter.Proved.wtP_ge_edgeCounts
statement:
theorem wtP_ge_edgeCounts {k : ℕ} (_hk : 1 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} :
    edgeCountGe p 1 + edgeCountGe p 2 + edgeCountGe p 3 ≤ p.wtP
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ q : ℕ, edgeCountGe p q = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p.numVerts - 1),
      (if q ≤ ew k (p.vert i) (p.vert (i + 1)) then 1 else 0) := by
    intro q; rw [edgeCountGe, Finset.card_filter]
  rw [key 1, key 2, key 3, wtP_eq_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i _
  exact indicator_sum_le _

name: Hunter.Proved.wtP_ge_j
statement:
theorem wtP_ge_j {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless)
    (hℓ0 : 0 < p.numVerts) (hℓ : p.numVerts ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2))
    (h3 : p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1)) - 1 ≤ edgeCountGe p 3) :
    j k p.numVerts ≤ p.wtP
proof:
:= by
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
  have hN1 : 1 ≤ p.numVerts := hℓ0
  have h1 := prp_1edgebound hk1 hp
  have h2 := prp_2edgebound hk1 hp
  have hsum := wtP_ge_edgeCounts hk1 (p := p)
  have hck1 : 1 ≤ p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k := by
    rw [ceilDiv_succ_pred hN1 (by omega : 0 < k)]; exact Nat.le_add_left 1 _
  have hck2 : 1 ≤ p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1)) := by
    rw [ceilDiv_succ_pred hN1 (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega : 0 < k - 1))]
    exact Nat.le_add_left 1 _
  rw [j_base (Or.inl hℓ)]
  set A := p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k
  set B := p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1))
  omega

name: Hunter.Proved.thm2_base
statement:
theorem thm2_base {k ℓ : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hℓ0 : 0 < ℓ) (hℓ : ℓ ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2))
    (hex : HasExitlessPath k ℓ)
    (h3 : ∀ q : HPath k, q.Exitless → q.numVerts ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1)) - 1 ≤ edgeCountGe q 3) :
    j k ℓ ≤ iExitless k ℓ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hpe, hpv⟩ := hex
  have hne : {m | ∃ q : HPath k, q.Exitless ∧ q.numVerts = ℓ ∧ q.wtP = m}.Nonempty :=
    ⟨p.wtP, p, hpe, hpv, rfl⟩
  have hmem := Nat.sInf_mem hne
  obtain ⟨q, hqe, hqv, hqw⟩ := hmem
  calc j k ℓ = j k q.numVerts := by rw [hqv]
    _ ≤ q.wtP := wtP_ge_j hk hqe (by rw [hqv]; exact hℓ0) (by rw [hqv]; exact hℓ) (h3 q hqe)
    _ = iExitless k ℓ := hqw

name: Hunter.Proved.verts_eq_map_vert
statement:
theorem verts_eq_map_vert {k : ℕ} (p : HPath k) :
    p.verts = (List.range p.numVerts).map (fun i => p.vert i)
proof:
:= by
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp only [List.length_map, List.length_range, HPath.numVerts]
  · intro i h1 h2
    rw [List.getElem_map, List.getElem_range]
    have hi : i < p.numVerts := by rw [List.length_map, List.length_range] at h2; exact h2
    exact (vert_getElem p hi).symm

name: Hunter.Proved.range_reshape
statement:
theorem range_reshape {α : Type*} (f : ℕ → α) (k t : ℕ) :
    (List.range (k * t)).map f
      = ((List.range t).map (fun s => (List.range k).map (fun r => f (k * s + r)))).flatten
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Nat.mul_succ, List.range_add, List.map_append, ih, List.range_succ, List.map_append,
        List.flatten_append]
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.flatten_cons, List.flatten_nil,
      List.append_nil, List.map_map]
    rfl

name: Hunter.Proved.clm_phi_necessity_amended
statement:
theorem clm_phi_necessity_amended {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) {p : HPath k}
    (hp : p.StronglyExitless) : IsPhiForm p
proof:
:= by
  have hdvd := dvd_numVerts_of_stronglyExitless hk hp
  obtain ⟨hpe, _⟩ := hp
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hdvd
  have hcase : ∀ a b : ℕ, a < b → b < t →
      rotClass (p.vert (k * a)).1 ≠ rotClass (p.vert (k * b)).1 := by
    intro a b hab hbt
    have hBk : k * a + k ≤ k * b := by
      have h1 : k * a + k = k * (a + 1) := by ring
      rw [h1]; exact Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) hab
    have hB'n : k * b < p.numVerts := by rw [ht]; exact Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hbt hk
    exact no_reentry hk hpe ⟨a, rfl⟩ hBk hB'n
  refine ⟨(List.range t).map (fun s => p.vert (k * s)), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [List.map_map]
    refine List.Nodup.map_on ?_ List.nodup_range
    intro a ha b hb hab
    simp only [List.mem_range] at ha hb
    rcases Nat.lt_trichotomy a b with h | h | h
    · exact absurd hab (hcase a b h hb)
    · exact h
    · exact absurd hab.symm (hcase b a h ha)
  · rw [verts_eq_map_vert p, ht, range_reshape, List.map_map]
    congr 1
    apply List.map_congr_left
    intro s hs
    simp only [List.mem_range] at hs
    apply List.map_congr_left
    intro r hr
    simp only [List.mem_range] at hr
    have hb : k * s + r < p.numVerts := by
      rw [ht]
      calc k * s + r < k * s + k := by omega
        _ = k * (s + 1) := by ring
        _ ≤ k * t := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) hs
    exact block_is_full_cycle hk hpe ⟨s, rfl⟩ hr hb

name: Hunter.ProofsRigid.ceilDiv_sub_mul
statement:
theorem ceilDiv_sub_mul (hk : 1 ≤ k) {m q : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hle : k * q ≤ m) :
    (m - k * q) ⌈/⌉ k = m ⌈/⌉ k - q
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (m - k * q) with h0 | hpos
  · 
    have hmeq : m = k * q := by omega
    rw [h0, hmeq, Proved.ceilDiv_of_dvd (by omega) ⟨q, rfl⟩, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left q (by omega),
        Nat.sub_self, Nat.ceilDiv_eq_add_pred_div, Nat.zero_add, Nat.div_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
  · rw [ceilDiv_succ_pred (by omega) (by omega), ceilDiv_succ_pred hm (by omega)]
    have hqle : q ≤ (m - 1) / k := by
      rw [Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (by omega), Nat.mul_comm]; omega
    have hkey : (m - k * q - 1) / k = (m - 1) / k - q := by
      have h1 : m - k * q - 1 = (m - 1) - k * q := by omega
      rw [h1]
      have hmod : (m - 1) % k < k := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
      have hexp : (m - 1) - k * q = k * ((m - 1) / k - q) + (m - 1) % k := by
        have hmul : k * ((m - 1) / k - q) = k * ((m - 1) / k) - k * q := by rw [Nat.mul_sub]
        have hmle : k * q ≤ k * ((m - 1) / k) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left k hqle
        have := Nat.div_add_mod (m - 1) k
        omega
      rw [hexp, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_mul_div_left _ _ (by omega : 0 < k),
          Nat.div_eq_of_lt hmod, Nat.zero_add]
    omega

name: Hunter.ProofsRigid.Dfr_Mper
statement: theorem Dfr_Mper (hk : 4 ≤ k) : Dfr k (Mper k) = k - 3
proof:
:= by
  have hle : Mper k ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by rw [Mper]; omega
  rw [Dfr_base hle, Mper]
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ : ∃ a, k = a + 4 := ⟨k - 4, by omega⟩
  show ((a + 3) * (a + 2) - 1 - 1) / (a + 3) = a + 1
  have hnum : (a + 3) * (a + 2) - 1 - 1 = (a + 1) + (a + 3) * (a + 1) := by
    have h1 : (a + 3) * (a + 2) = a * a + 5 * a + 6 := by ring
    have h2 : (a + 3) * (a + 1) = a * a + 4 * a + 3 := by ring
    omega
  rw [hnum, Nat.add_mul_div_left _ _ (by omega : 0 < a + 3), Nat.div_eq_of_lt (by omega),
      Nat.zero_add]

name: Hunter.ProofsRigid.j_frontier_eq
statement:
theorem j_frontier_eq (hk : 4 ≤ k) :
    ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → j k m = Dfr k (m ⌈/⌉ k) + (m - 1) + (m ⌈/⌉ k - 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ m ih =>
    intro hm1
    have hkpos : 0 < k := by omega
    have hkk1pos : 0 < k * (k - 1) := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)
    set base := k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) with hbase
    have hB1 : 1 ≤ m ⌈/⌉ k := by
      rw [ceilDiv_succ_pred hm1 hkpos]; exact Nat.le_add_left 1 _
    by_cases hbaseR : m ≤ base
    · 
      have hble : m ⌈/⌉ k ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by
        rw [ceilDiv_succ_pred hm1 hkpos]
        have hstep : (m - 1) / k ≤ (base - 1) / k := Nat.div_le_div_right (by omega)
        have hb : (base - 1) / k = (k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1 := by
          have hbeq : base = k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2)) := by rw [hbase]; ring
          rw [hbeq]
          set X := (k - 1) * (k - 2) with hXdef
          have hXpos : 1 ≤ X := by rw [hXdef]; exact Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)
          have hkX : k ≤ k * X := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right k hXpos
          rw [show k * X - 1 = k * (X - 1) + (k - 1) from by
                rw [Nat.mul_sub, Nat.mul_one]; omega,
              Nat.mul_add_div hkpos, Nat.div_eq_of_lt (by omega), Nat.add_zero]
        have hXpos : 1 ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2) := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (by omega)
        omega
      
      have hDBval : m ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1)) = Dfr k (m ⌈/⌉ k) + 1 := by
        rw [Dfr_base hble, ← ProofsConfinement.ceilDiv_ceilDiv hkpos (by omega),
            ceilDiv_succ_pred hB1 (by omega)]
      have hj : j k m = m + (m ⌈/⌉ k) + (m ⌈/⌉ (k * (k - 1))) - 3 := j_base (Or.inl hbaseR)
      omega
    · 
      rw [Nat.not_le] at hbaseR
      have hbaseR' : k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) < m := by rw [← hbase]; exact hbaseR
      have hjr : j k m = j k (m - ell0 k) + j k (ell0 k) + 3 :=
        j_rec_unfold_one (by omega) hbaseR'
      have hell0 : ell0 k = k * Mper k := ProofsWalk.ell0_eq_k_mul_Mper (by omega)
      have hMper_pos : 1 ≤ Mper k := ProofsPotential.Mper_pos (by omega)
      have hell0_le : ell0 k ≤ base := by rw [hbase, ell0]; omega
      have hml : 1 ≤ m - ell0 k := by omega
      have hmlt : m - ell0 k < m := by
        have : 1 ≤ ell0 k := ProofsRecursion.ell0_pos (by omega); omega
      have hshift : (m - ell0 k) ⌈/⌉ k = m ⌈/⌉ k - Mper k := by
        rw [hell0]; exact ceilDiv_sub_mul (by omega) hm1 (by rw [← hell0]; omega)
      
      have hbgt : (k - 1) * (k - 2) < m ⌈/⌉ k := by
        rw [ceilDiv_succ_pred hm1 hkpos]
        have hbasek : base / k = (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by
          rw [hbase, show k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) = k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2)) from by ring,
              Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hkpos]
        have hstep : base / k ≤ (m - 1) / k := Nat.div_le_div_right (by omega)
        omega
      have hMperv : Mper k = (k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1 := rfl
      
      have hIH := ih (m - ell0 k) hmlt hml
      rw [hshift] at hIH
      
      have hjg : j k (k * Mper k) = Dfr k (Mper k) + (k * Mper k - 1) + (Mper k - 1) :=
        ProofsWalk.j_glue hk hMper_pos
      rw [← hell0] at hjg
      have hDfrM : Dfr k (Mper k) = k - 3 := Dfr_Mper hk
      
      have hDfrb : Dfr k (m ⌈/⌉ k) = Dfr k (m ⌈/⌉ k - Mper k) + (k - 2) :=
        Dfr_shift_rec (by omega) hbgt
      
      omega

name: Hunter.ProofsRigid.Dfrontier_eq_Dfr_ceil
statement:
theorem Dfrontier_eq_Dfr_ceil (hk : 4 ≤ k) {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    Dfrontier k m = Dfr k (m ⌈/⌉ k)
proof:
:= by
  have hkpos : 0 < k := by omega
  have hB1 : 1 ≤ m ⌈/⌉ k := by
    rw [ceilDiv_succ_pred hm hkpos]; exact Nat.le_add_left 1 _
  have h := j_frontier_eq hk m hm
  rw [Dfrontier]
  set B := m ⌈/⌉ k with hBdef
  clear_value B
  clear hBdef
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsRigid.terminalFrontierTail_of_blockCeil
statement:
theorem terminalFrontierTail_of_blockCeil (hk : 4 ≤ k) (hbc : ExcessBlockCeil k) :
    TerminalFrontierTail k
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp h0 _
  have hj := j_frontier_eq hk p.numVerts h0
  have hbound := hbc p hp h0
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsRigid.one_le_ceil
statement: theorem one_le_ceil {p : HPath k} (hk : 4 ≤ k) (h0 : 0 < p.numVerts) : 1 ≤ p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [ceilDiv_succ_pred h0 (by omega)]; exact Nat.le_add_left 1 _

name: Hunter.ProofsRigid.blockCeil_iff_G
statement:
theorem blockCeil_iff_G (hk : 4 ≤ k) :
    ExcessBlockCeil k ↔
      ∀ p : HPath k, p.Exitless → 0 < p.numVerts → p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k ≤ G k (excess p)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h p hp h0
    exact (Dfr_le_iff_le_G hk _ (one_le_ceil hk h0) _).mp (h p hp h0)
  · intro h p hp h0
    exact (Dfr_le_iff_le_G hk _ (one_le_ceil hk h0) _).mpr (h p hp h0)

name: Hunter.ProofsRigid.blockCeil_pred_le_G
statement:
theorem blockCeil_pred_le_G (hk : 4 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) (h0 : 0 < p.numVerts) :
    p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k - 1 ≤ G k (excess p)
proof:
:= by
  have hbc := blockCount_le_G_excess hk hp h0
  rwa [ceilDiv_succ_pred h0 (by omega), Nat.add_sub_cancel]

name: Hunter.ProofsClose.metaDepth_le_km3
statement:
theorem metaDepth_le_km3 (hk : 4 ≤ k) {p : HPath k} (hp : p.Exitless) (t : ℕ)
    (hN : k * t < p.numVerts) : metaDepth p t ≤ k - 3
proof:
:= by
  have hk3 : 3 ≤ k := by omega
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
  obtain ⟨hA, _, _, _⟩ := runExtract (by omega) p t
  set t₀ := runStart p t with ht0
  set m := metaDepth p t with hm
  set d := doorDepth p t with hd
  
  have hle : t₀ + m * (k - 1) ≤ t := by omega
  set base := p.vert (k * t₀) with hbase
  set α₁ := (base : List ℕ).getLastD 0 with hα1
  set α₂ := ((base : List ℕ).erase α₁).getLastD 0 with hα2
  set K : RotClass := rotClass (((base : List ℕ).erase α₁).dropLast) with hK
  
  have hconf : ∀ i, i ≤ m * (k - 1) → p.vert (k * (t₀ + i)) ∈ Vset3 k α₁ α₂ K := by
    intro i hi
    set j := i / (k - 1) with hj
    set r := i % (k - 1) with hr
    have hdm : j * (k - 1) + r = i := by
      rw [hj, hr, Nat.mul_comm]; exact Nat.div_add_mod i (k - 1)
    have hrlt : r < k - 1 := Nat.mod_lt i (by omega)
    have hpos : t₀ + i = t₀ + j * (k - 1) + r := by omega
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos r with hr0 | hrpos
    · 
      have hjm : j ≤ m := by
        rcases Nat.lt_or_ge m j with hlt | hge
        · exfalso
          have hmul : (m + 1) * (k - 1) ≤ j * (k - 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (le_refl _)
          have hexp : (m + 1) * (k - 1) = m * (k - 1) + (k - 1) := by ring
          omega
        · exact hge
      have hgl := run_loopStart_confined hk3 hp t hN j hjm
      have hglpair : genLoop ((p.vert (k * (t₀ + j * (k - 1))) : List ℕ).erase α₁) = (α₂, K) := by
        rw [hgl.2]; rfl
      have hmem := mem_Vset3_of_genLoop_metaWord hglpair
      rw [hpos, hr0, Nat.add_zero]
      exact hmem
    · 
      have hjm : j < m := by
        by_contra hjc
        push Not at hjc
        have hmul : m * (k - 1) ≤ j * (k - 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul hjc (le_refl _)
        omega
      have hmem := run_confined hk3 hp t hN j r (Or.inl ⟨hjm, hrpos, by omega⟩)
      rw [hpos]
      exact hmem
  
  have hlt_nv : ∀ i, i ≤ m * (k - 1) → k * (t₀ + i) < p.numVerts := by
    intro i hi
    have : t₀ + i ≤ t := by omega
    calc k * (t₀ + i) ≤ k * t := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) this
      _ < p.numVerts := hN
  
  set N := m * (k - 1) + 1 with hNdef
  have hcyc : ∀ i i' : Fin N, i ≠ i' →
      rotClass (p.vert (k * (t₀ + (i : ℕ))) : List ℕ)
        ≠ rotClass (p.vert (k * (t₀ + (i' : ℕ))) : List ℕ) :=
    meta_no_reentry hk1 hp (fun i : Fin N => k * (t₀ + (i : ℕ)))
      (fun i => ⟨t₀ + (i : ℕ), rfl⟩)
      (fun i i' h => by
        have hii : (i : ℕ) < (i' : ℕ) := h
        calc k * (t₀ + (i : ℕ)) + k = k * (t₀ + (i : ℕ) + 1) := by ring
          _ ≤ k * (t₀ + (i' : ℕ)) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) (by omega))
      (fun i => hlt_nv i.1 (by have := i.2; omega))
  have hmem : ∀ i : Fin N, p.vert (k * (t₀ + (i : ℕ))) ∈ Vset3 k α₁ α₂ K :=
    fun i => hconf i.1 (by have := i.2; omega)
  
  have hbound : N ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2) :=
    rotStep_confined hk3 (A := base) hα1
      (by rw [hα2, hα1, erase_getLastD base.2.nodup])
      (by rw [hK, hα1, erase_getLastD base.2.nodup])
      (fun i : Fin N => p.vert (k * (t₀ + (i : ℕ)))) hmem hcyc
  
  by_contra hc
  push Not at hc
  have hmge : k - 2 ≤ m := by omega
  have hmul : (k - 2) * (k - 1) ≤ m * (k - 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul hmge (le_refl _)
  rw [Nat.mul_comm (k - 1) (k - 2)] at hbound
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsClose.thm1v1_of_residuals
statement:
theorem thm1v1_of_residuals (hbase : M1WalkBound 3)
    (hG2 : MMExclusionAll) (hG3 : TerminalFrontierTailAll)
    (hproof : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) →
        (L k : ℝ) ≥ (iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ)
          + (((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
              (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)))
            * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ)))
    (hexists : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2))) :
    ∃ (C : ℝ) (k₀ : ℕ), ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k →
      (Lstar k : ℝ) ≥ coeff k * (k.factorial : ℝ) + (k : ℝ) - C
proof:
:=
  Proved.thm1v1_of_m1 (m1WalkBoundAll_of_residuals hbase hG2 hG3) hproof hexists

name: Hunter.ProofsClose.thm1v2_of_residuals
statement:
theorem thm1v2_of_residuals (hbase : M1WalkBound 3)
    (hG2 : MMExclusionAll) (hG3 : TerminalFrontierTailAll)
    (hproof : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) →
        (L k : ℝ) ≥ (iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ)
          + (((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
              (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)))
            * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ)))
    (hexists : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2))) :
    ∃ (C : ℝ) (k₀ : ℕ), ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k → (L k : ℝ) ≥ coeff k * (k.factorial : ℝ) - C

name: Hunter.ProofsClose.eq_weak_of_residuals
statement:
theorem eq_weak_of_residuals (hbase : M1WalkBound 3)
    (hG2 : MMExclusionAll) (hG3 : TerminalFrontierTailAll)
    (hproof : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) →
        (L k : ℝ) ≥ (iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ)
          + (((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
              (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)))
            * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ)))
    (hexists : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2))) :
    ∃ (C : ℝ) (k₀ : ℕ), ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k →
      (Lstar k : ℝ) ≥ (k.factorial : ℝ) + ((k - 1).factorial : ℝ) + ((k - 2).factorial : ℝ)
        + ((k - 4).factorial : ℝ) - 2 * ((k - 5).factorial : ℝ) - C * ((k - 6).factorial : ℝ)
proof:
:=
  ProofsMF.eq_weak_of_MF
    (Proved.frontierTightHeavyAll_of_m1All (m1WalkBoundAll_of_residuals hbase hG2 hG3))
    hproof hexists

theorem rigidity_chart {A' : List ℕ} {z b c : ℕ} {q : ℕ → List ℕ}
    (hperm : ∀ s, IsPermWord (A'.length + 3) (q s))
    (hstart : q 0 = A' ++ [z, b, c])
    (hdist : ∀ s t, s < (A'.length + 2) * (A'.length + 1) →
        t < (A'.length + 2) * (A'.length + 1) → s ≠ t → rotClass (q s) ≠ rotClass (q t))
    (hw2 : ∀ j i, j ≤ A'.length → i < A'.length + 1 →
        ProofsRigidity2.bwt (A'.length + 3) (q (j * (A'.length + 2) + i))
          (q (j * (A'.length + 2) + i + 1)) = 2)
    (hw3 : ∀ j, j < A'.length →
        ProofsRigidity2.bwt (A'.length + 3) (q (j * (A'.length + 2) + (A'.length + 1)))
          (q (j * (A'.length + 2) + (A'.length + 1) + 1)) = 3) :
    ∀ j i, j ≤ A'.length → i ≤ A'.length + 1 →
      q (j * (A'.length + 2) + i) = ProofsClosure3.chartWord A' z b c j i
proof:
:=
  ProofsChartEq.tight_is_chart hperm hstart hdist hw2 hw3

name: Hunter.Paper.periodicity
statement:
theorem periodicity {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) :
    (j k (ell0 k) : ℝ) + 3 = coeff k * ((ell0 k : ℕ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hle : ell0 k ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by rw [ell0_eq]; omega
  have hj0 : j k (ell0 k) = ell0 k + ((k - 1) * (k - 2) - 1) + (k - 2) - 3 := by
    rw [j_base (Or.inl hle), ProofsPu.cd_ell0_k hk, ProofsPu.cd_ell0_kk hk]
  have hD := ProofsReductions.D_pos hk
  have hratio := ProofsReductions.ratio_eq_coeff hk
  
  have hq : coeff k * ((k : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) - 1) * ((k : ℝ) - 2) - (k : ℝ))
      = (k : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((k : ℝ) - 2) - 3 - (k : ℝ) + 2 := by
    rw [← hratio, div_mul_cancel₀]
    exact ne_of_gt hD
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, k = m + 3 := ⟨k - 3, by omega⟩
  
  have hp2 : 2 * 1 ≤ (m + 2) * (m + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (by omega)
  have h3 : (m + 3) * 2 ≤ (m + 3) * ((m + 2) * (m + 1)) :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)
  have hassoc : (m + 3) * (m + 2) * (m + 1) = (m + 3) * ((m + 2) * (m + 1)) :=
    Nat.mul_assoc _ _ _
  have hsub : (m + 3) ≤ (m + 3) * (m + 2) * (m + 1) := by omega
  
  have hcast0 : ((ell0 (m + 3) : ℕ) : ℝ)
      = ((m + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (((m + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ) - 1) * (((m + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ) - 2)
        - ((m + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    rw [ell0_eq]
    simp only [show m + 3 - 1 = m + 2 by omega, show m + 3 - 2 = m + 1 by omega]
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hsub]
    push_cast; ring
  
  have hval : j (m + 3) (ell0 (m + 3)) + ((m + 3) + 4) = (m + 3) ^ 2 * (m + 1) := by
    rw [hj0, ell0_eq]
    simp only [show m + 3 - 1 = m + 2 by omega, show m + 3 - 2 = m + 1 by omega]
    have h1 : 1 ≤ (m + 2) * (m + 1) := by omega
    have h2 : 3 ≤ (m + 3) * (m + 2) * (m + 1) - (m + 3) + ((m + 2) * (m + 1) - 1)
        + (m + 1) := by omega
    zify [hsub, h1, h2]
    ring
  
  rw [hcast0, hq]
  have hIcast : ((m + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 * (((m + 3 : ℕ) : ℝ) - 2)
      = (((m + 3) ^ 2 * (m + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
  rw [hIcast]
  have hvalR : ((j (m + 3) (ell0 (m + 3)) : ℕ) : ℝ) + (((m + 3) : ℕ) : ℝ) + 4
      = ((((m + 3) ^ 2 * (m + 1) : ℕ)) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hval
  linarith

    ((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
        (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ))
      ≤ ((iExitless k ℓ : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) / ((ℓ : ℝ) - (k : ℝ))
proof:

name: Hunter.Paper.pivot_ratio_eq_coeff
statement:
theorem pivot_ratio_eq_coeff {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) :
    ((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
        (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)) = coeff k
proof:

  rw [pivot_value hk, ProofsReductions.castI hk, ProofsReductions.castP (by omega),

name: Hunter.Paper.hunters_bound
statement:
theorem hunters_bound {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) :
    (Ssuper k : ℝ) ≥ coeff k * (k.factorial : ℝ) + (k : ℝ) + ((k : ℝ) - 2)
      - coeff k * (k : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := superperm_length_ge_hunterPointwise hk
  have hD := ProofsReductions.D_pos hk
  have hq : coeff k * ((k : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) - 1) * ((k : ℝ) - 2) - (k : ℝ))
      = (k : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((k : ℝ) - 2) - 3 - (k : ℝ) + 2 := by
    rw [← ProofsReductions.ratio_eq_coeff hk, div_mul_cancel₀]
    exact ne_of_gt hD
  have e1 : coeff k * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) - 1) * ((k : ℝ) - 2))
      = coeff k * (k.factorial : ℝ)
        - coeff k * ((k : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) - 1) * ((k : ℝ) - 2)) := by ring
  have e2 : coeff k * ((k : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) - 1) * ((k : ℝ) - 2) - (k : ℝ))
      = coeff k * ((k : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) - 1) * ((k : ℝ) - 2)) - coeff k * (k : ℝ) := by ring
  linarith [h, hq, e1, e2]

name: Hunter.Paper.hunters_bound_L
statement:
theorem hunters_bound_L {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) :
    (L k : ℝ) ≥ coeff k * (k.factorial : ℝ) + ((k : ℝ) - 2) - coeff k * (k : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hS := hunters_bound hk
  rw [S_eq_k_add_L (by omega)] at hS
  push_cast at hS
  linarith

name: Hunter.Paper.factorial_exact
statement:
theorem factorial_exact {k : ℕ} (hk : 3 ≤ k) :
    (Ssuper k : ℝ) ≥ (k.factorial : ℝ) + ((k - 1).factorial : ℝ) + ((k - 2).factorial : ℝ)
      + (((k - 2).factorial : ℝ) - ((k : ℝ) - 2)) / ((k : ℝ) ^ 2 - 3 * (k : ℝ) + 1)
      + (k : ℝ) - 3
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, k = m + 3 := ⟨k - 3, by omega⟩
  have h := hunters_bound (k := m + 3) (by omega)
  have e1 : m + 3 - 1 = m + 2 := by omega
  have e2 : m + 3 - 2 = m + 1 := by omega
  rw [e1, e2]
  have hm : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg m
  have f2 : ((m + 2).factorial : ℝ) = ((m : ℝ) + 2) * ((m + 1).factorial : ℝ) := by
    rw [show m + 2 = (m + 1) + 1 from rfl, Nat.factorial_succ]; push_cast; ring
  have f3 : ((m + 3).factorial : ℝ) = ((m : ℝ) + 3) * ((m + 2).factorial : ℝ) := by
    rw [show m + 3 = (m + 2) + 1 from rfl, Nat.factorial_succ]; push_cast; ring
  set x : ℝ := ((m + 1).factorial : ℝ) with hx
  have key : coeff (m + 3) * (((m + 3).factorial : ℝ)) + ((m : ℝ) + 3)
        + (((m : ℝ) + 3) - 2) - coeff (m + 3) * ((m : ℝ) + 3)
      = ((m + 3).factorial : ℝ) + ((m + 2).factorial : ℝ) + x
        + ((x - (((m : ℝ) + 3) - 2)) / (((m : ℝ) + 3) ^ 2 - 3 * ((m : ℝ) + 3) + 1))
        + ((m : ℝ) + 3) - 3 := by
    rw [f3, f2, coeff]
    push_cast
    have hne1 : ((m : ℝ) + 3) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hne2 : ((m : ℝ) + 3 - 1) ≠ 0 :=
      ne_of_gt (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < (m : ℝ) + 3 - 1)
    have hne3 : ((m : ℝ) + 3) * ((m : ℝ) + 3 - 1) * ((m : ℝ) + 3 - 2) - ((m : ℝ) + 3) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [show ((m : ℝ) + 3) * ((m : ℝ) + 3 - 1) * ((m : ℝ) + 3 - 2) - ((m : ℝ) + 3)
          = ((m : ℝ) + 3) * ((m : ℝ) ^ 2 + 3 * (m : ℝ) + 1) from by ring]
      positivity
    have hne4 : ((m : ℝ) + 3) ^ 2 - 3 * ((m : ℝ) + 3) + 1 ≠ 0 := by
      rw [show ((m : ℝ) + 3) ^ 2 - 3 * ((m : ℝ) + 3) + 1
          = (m : ℝ) ^ 2 + 3 * (m : ℝ) + 1 from by ring]
      positivity
    have hne5 : (1 + (m : ℝ) * 3 + (m : ℝ) ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    field_simp
    linear_combination mul_inv_cancel₀ hne5
  push_cast at h ⊢
  linarith [h, key.ge, key.le]

name: Hunter.Paper.factorial_clean
statement:
theorem factorial_clean {k : ℕ} (hk : 6 ≤ k) :
    (Ssuper k : ℝ) ≥ (k.factorial : ℝ) + ((k - 1).factorial : ℝ) + ((k - 2).factorial : ℝ)
      + ((k - 4).factorial : ℝ) - 2 * ((k - 5).factorial : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, k = m + 6 := ⟨k - 6, by omega⟩
  have h := factorial_exact (k := m + 6) (by omega)
  have e1 : m + 6 - 1 = m + 5 := by omega
  have e2 : m + 6 - 2 = m + 4 := by omega
  have e4 : m + 6 - 4 = m + 2 := by omega
  have e5 : m + 6 - 5 = m + 1 := by omega
  rw [e1, e2] at h
  rw [e1, e2, e4, e5]
  have hm : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg m
  have f2 : ((m + 2).factorial : ℝ) = ((m : ℝ) + 2) * ((m + 1).factorial : ℝ) := by
    rw [show m + 2 = (m + 1) + 1 from rfl, Nat.factorial_succ]; push_cast; ring
  have f3 : ((m + 3).factorial : ℝ) = ((m : ℝ) + 3) * ((m + 2).factorial : ℝ) := by
    rw [show m + 3 = (m + 2) + 1 from rfl, Nat.factorial_succ]; push_cast; ring
  have f4 : ((m + 4).factorial : ℝ) = ((m : ℝ) + 4) * ((m + 3).factorial : ℝ) := by
    rw [show m + 4 = (m + 3) + 1 from rfl, Nat.factorial_succ]; push_cast; ring
  set x : ℝ := ((m + 1).factorial : ℝ) with hx
  have hxpos : (0 : ℝ) ≤ x := by positivity
  have hD : ((m : ℝ) + 6) ^ 2 - 3 * ((m : ℝ) + 6) + 1 = (m : ℝ) ^ 2 + 9 * (m : ℝ) + 19 := by
    ring
  have hDpos : (0 : ℝ) < (m : ℝ) ^ 2 + 9 * (m : ℝ) + 19 := by positivity
  have hDne : ((m : ℝ) ^ 2 + 9 * (m : ℝ) + 19) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hDpos
  
  have sur : (((m + 4).factorial : ℝ) - (((m : ℝ) + 6) - 2))
        / (((m : ℝ) + 6) ^ 2 - 3 * ((m : ℝ) + 6) + 1) + ((m : ℝ) + 6) - 3
      - (((m + 2).factorial : ℝ) - 2 * x)
      = (x * (7 * (m : ℝ) + 24)
          + ((m : ℝ) ^ 3 + 12 * (m : ℝ) ^ 2 + 45 * (m : ℝ) + 53))
        / ((m : ℝ) ^ 2 + 9 * (m : ℝ) + 19) := by
    rw [f4, f3, f2, hD]
    field_simp
    ring
  have surpos : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (x * (7 * (m : ℝ) + 24)
      + ((m : ℝ) ^ 3 + 12 * (m : ℝ) ^ 2 + 45 * (m : ℝ) + 53))
    / ((m : ℝ) ^ 2 + 9 * (m : ℝ) + 19) := by positivity
  push_cast at h ⊢
  linarith [h, sur.ge, sur.le, surpos]

name: Hunter.Paper.factorial_form
statement:
theorem factorial_form :
    ∃ (C : ℝ) (k₀ : ℕ), ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k →
      (Ssuper k : ℝ) ≥ (k.factorial : ℝ) + ((k - 1).factorial : ℝ)
        + ((k - 2).factorial : ℝ) + ((k - 4).factorial : ℝ)
        - 2 * ((k - 5).factorial : ℝ) - C * ((k - 6).factorial : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, k₀, h⟩ := Hunter.eq_weak
  refine ⟨C, max k₀ 1, fun k hk => ?_⟩
  have h1 : (1 : ℕ) ≤ k := le_trans (le_max_right k₀ 1) hk
  rw [← Proved.bridge_Lstar_eq_Ssuper h1]
  exact h k (le_trans (le_max_left k₀ 1) hk)

name: Hunter.ProofsMF.frontierTightHeavy_of_excessFrontier
statement:
theorem frontierTightHeavy_of_excessFrontier (hk : 3 ≤ k) (hfr : ExcessFrontier k) :
    FrontierTightHeavy k
proof:
:= by
  intro p q hpe hqe hbaseR hpre htight
  have h0 : 0 < p.numVerts := p.numVerts_pos
  
  have hfrp : j k p.numVerts ≤ (p.numVerts - 1) + (p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k - 1) + excess p :=
    hfr p hpe h0
  
  have he0pos : 0 < ell0 k := ell0_pos hk
  have he0val : ell0 k = k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) - k := rfl
  have hm : 2 ≤ (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by
    have h := Nat.mul_le_mul (show 2 ≤ k - 1 by omega) (show 1 ≤ k - 2 by omega)
    omega
  have hprod : k * 2 ≤ k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2)) := Nat.mul_le_mul (le_refl k) hm
  have heq : k * ((k - 1) * (k - 2)) = k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by ring
  have hkle0 : k ≤ ell0 k := by rw [he0val]; omega
  have he0base : ell0 k ≤ k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) := by rw [he0val]; omega
  
  set n := p.numVerts - ell0 k with hn
  have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := by rw [hn]; omega
  have hNsum : p.numVerts = n + ell0 k := by rw [hn]; omega
  have hqnv : q.numVerts = n := by
    have hlen : p.verts.length = p.numVerts := rfl
    show q.verts.length = n
    rw [hpre, List.length_take, hlen]; omega
  
  rw [hqnv] at htight
  
  have hdvd : k ∣ ell0 k := k_dvd_ell0 hk
  have hje0 : j k (ell0 k) = ell0 k + (ell0 k / k) + (k - 2) - 3 := by
    rw [j_base (Or.inl he0base), Proved.ceilDiv_of_dvd (show 0 < k by omega) hdvd,
        ceilDiv_ell0 hk]
  have hsplit : p.numVerts ⌈/⌉ k = n ⌈/⌉ k + ell0 k / k := by
    rw [hNsum]; exact ceilDiv_add_dvd (show 0 < k by omega) hdvd
  have hjrec : j k p.numVerts = j k n + j k (ell0 k) + 3 := by
    have hr := j_rec_unfold_one hk hbaseR
    rw [← hn] at hr; exact hr
  have hXn1 : 1 ≤ n ⌈/⌉ k := by
    rw [Proved.ceilDiv_succ_pred hn1 (show 0 < k by omega)]; exact Nat.le_add_left 1 _
  have hXe1 : 1 ≤ ell0 k / k := (Nat.one_le_div_iff (show 0 < k by omega)).mpr hkle0
  
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsMF.thm1v2_of_MF
statement:
theorem thm1v2_of_MF (hMF : FrontierTightHeavyAll)
    (hproof : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) →
        (L k : ℝ) ≥ (iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ)
          + (((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
              (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)))
            * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ)))
    (hexists : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2))) :
    ∃ (C : ℝ) (k₀ : ℕ), ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k → (L k : ℝ) ≥ coeff k * (k.factorial : ℝ) - C
proof:
:=
  Proved.thm1v2_current (thm2_global_of_MF hMF)
    (fun _ _ hk hℓ0 hle hex => Proved.thm2_equality hk hℓ0 hle hex)
    hproof hexists

name: Hunter.ProofsMF.thm1v1_of_MF
statement:
theorem thm1v1_of_MF (hMF : FrontierTightHeavyAll)
    (hproof : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) →
        (L k : ℝ) ≥ (iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ)
          + (((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
              (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)))
            * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ)))
    (hexists : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2))) :
    ∃ (C : ℝ) (k₀ : ℕ), ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k →
      (Lstar k : ℝ) ≥ coeff k * (k.factorial : ℝ) + (k : ℝ) - C
proof:
:=
  Proved.thm1v1_current (thm2_global_of_MF hMF)
    (fun _ _ hk hℓ0 hle hex => Proved.thm2_equality hk hℓ0 hle hex)
    hproof hexists

name: Hunter.ProofsMF.eq_weak_of_MF
statement:
theorem eq_weak_of_MF (hMF : FrontierTightHeavyAll)
    (hproof : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) →
        (L k : ℝ) ≥ (iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ)
          + (((iExitless k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2)) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) + 2) /
              (((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)))
            * ((k.factorial : ℝ) - ((k * (k - 1) * (k - 2) : ℕ) : ℝ)))
    (hexists : ∀ k, 3 ≤ k → HasExitlessPath k (k * (k - 1) * (k - 2))) :
    ∃ (C : ℝ) (k₀ : ℕ), ∀ k, k₀ ≤ k →
      (Lstar k : ℝ) ≥ (k.factorial : ℝ) + ((k - 1).factorial : ℝ) + ((k - 2).factorial : ℝ)
        + ((k - 4).factorial : ℝ) - 2 * ((k - 5).factorial : ℝ) - C * ((k - 6).factorial : ℝ)
proof:
:=
  Proved.eq_weak_of_thm1v1 (thm1v1_of_MF hMF hproof hexists)

name: Hunter.ProofsUnwind2.fPS_eq_of_edges
statement:
theorem fPS_eq_of_edges (P : HPath k) (S : Finset (Vtx k)) (X : Finset (Vtx k × Vtx k))
    (hEdges : P.edges = (X \ addedEdges S) ∪ E1removed P S ∪ E2removed P S)
    (hFEsub : addedEdges S ⊆ X)
    (hHCX : Disjoint (E1removed P S) X)
    (hHCBL : Disjoint (E1removed P S) (E2removed P S))
    (hXBL : Disjoint X (E2removed P S)) :
    fPS P S = X
proof:
:= by
  set FE := addedEdges S with hFE
  set HC := E1removed P S with hHC
  set BL := E2removed P S with hBL
  
  have hHC_XFE : Disjoint (X \ FE) HC := (hHCX.mono_right Finset.sdiff_subset).symm
  
  have hstep1 : (P.edges \ HC) ∪ FE = X ∪ BL := by
    rw [hEdges]
    
    have hrm : ((X \ FE) ∪ HC ∪ BL) \ HC = (X \ FE) ∪ BL := by
      rw [Finset.union_sdiff_distrib, Finset.union_sdiff_distrib,
        Finset.sdiff_eq_self_of_disjoint hHC_XFE, Finset.sdiff_self,
        Finset.sdiff_eq_self_of_disjoint hHCBL.symm, Finset.union_empty]
    rw [hrm]
    
    rw [Finset.union_right_comm, Finset.sdiff_union_of_subset hFEsub]
  rw [fPS, Xstep1, ← hFE, ← hHC, ← hBL, hstep1]
  
  rw [Finset.union_sdiff_right, Finset.sdiff_eq_self_of_disjoint hXBL]

name: Hunter.ProofsUnwind2.idxOf_flatten_lt
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨pre, post, rfl⟩ := List.append_of_mem hD
  have hform : (pre ++ D :: post).flatten = pre.flatten ++ (D ++ post.flatten) := by
    rw [List.flatten_append, List.flatten_cons]
  rw [hform] at hnd ⊢
  have hdisj : List.Disjoint pre.flatten (D ++ post.flatten) :=
    List.disjoint_of_nodup_append hnd
  have ha_pre : a ∉ pre.flatten := fun h => (List.disjoint_left.mp hdisj h) (List.mem_append_left _ ha)
  have hb_pre : b ∉ pre.flatten := fun h => (List.disjoint_left.mp hdisj h) (List.mem_append_left _ hb)
  rw [List.idxOf_append_of_notMem ha_pre, List.idxOf_append_of_notMem hb_pre,
    List.idxOf_append_of_mem ha, List.idxOf_append_of_mem hb]
  omega

name: Hunter.ProofsUnwind2.tail_not_mem_heads
statement:
theorem tail_not_mem_heads {ps : List (HPath k)} (hnd : (unwindVerts ps).Nodup)
